Sa. sarveṇa prakāreṇa netrabalāya-cakṣuḥsāmarthyāya, nasyādibhir yatnaṃ kuryāt| dṛṣṭiś ceti ca hetau| yato dṛṣṭir yadi na syāt tato jagad vividham api tamomayaṃ-andhakārarūpaṃ, ekarūpaṃ-ekalakṣaṇaṃ, sampadyata iti| upajātir vṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne tarpaṇapuṭapākavidhir nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 24||

Ā. rā. netrarakṣaṇe yatnaḥ kārya ity āha-sarvātmaneti| dṛṣṭiś ceti caśabdaś cedarthe|
iti hemādriṭīkāyām āyurvedarasāyane|
dṛktarpaṇaprakaraṇam sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 24||

div.head: yantravidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. athedānīṃ pañcaviṃśādhyāyārambho yantravidhānapradarśanārthaḥ| yato bastinasyāñhjanakṣārādīni yantrāśrayaṇy evety āha-
athāto yantravidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti sa smādur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. yantrasya vidhir yantravidhiḥ śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| arśobhagandarādiṣu niruje 'ṅhge yamyate-niyamyate śastrakṣārāgnikarmeti yantram|
Ā. rā. yantravidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

etad eva spaṣṭayann āha ----
nānāvidhānāṃ śalyānāṃ nānādeśaprabādhinām|
āhartum abhyupāyo yas tad yantraṃ yac ca darśane||1||
arśobhagandarādīnāṃ śastrakṣārāgniyojane|
śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyāṃ tathā bastyādikarmaṇi||2||
ghaṭikālābuśṛṅgaṃ ca jāmbavauṣṭhādikāni ca| ----------------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. anekaprakārāṇi yāni śalyāni-śastraveṇupāṣāṇādirūpāṇi, vividheṣu śarīrapradeśeṣu niviśante, teṣām āharaṇe ākṛṣṭuṃ, yo 'bhyupāyas tad yantram| 'ucyate' iti śeṣaḥ| tathā, arśobhagandaranāḍīvraṇādīnāṃ śastrādiyojane sati śeṣasya-nirujasyāṅgasya, parirakṣāyāṃ-rakṣānimittam, svasthasyāṅgasya śastrādyābādhānivṛttyartham ity arthaḥ| tathā, bastinasyādikarmaṇi ya upāyas tac ca yantram| tathā ghaṭikādi ca yantraṃ pavanākarṣaṇāya raktādyākarṣaṇāya ca| jāmbavauṣṭhasandaṃśādīni ca yantrāṇi|

Ā. rā. yantralakṣaṇam āha-nānāvidhānām iti| śalyāharaṇe ya upāyaḥ, yaś cārśaḥprabhṛtidarśane, yaś ca śāstrādicchedyasamīpāṅgarakṣaṇe, yaś ca bastyādipraṇayane, yaś ca ghāṭikādir ācūṣaṇādau, tad yantram| evaṃvidha upāyaviśeśo yantram ity arthaḥ|

yantrāṇāṃ kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ |
ca] kāryaṃ syāt? ity āha- ----------------------------------------------------|
anekarūpakāryāṇi yantrāṇi vividhāny ataḥ||3||
vikalpya kalpayed buddhyā yathāsthūlaṃ tu vakṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. rūpāṇi ca kāryāṇi ca rūpakāryāṇi| anekāni vicitrāṇi, rūpakāryāṇi teṣāṃ tāni yantrāṇi nānāprakārāṇi| tatra rūpaṃ-kaṅkamukhasvastikādyākāratvam| kāryaṃ-asthyādilagnaśalyaharaṇādikam| yataś caivaṃ yantrāṇāṃ nānāvidhatvam, atas tāni buddhyā vikalpya kāryānurodhāt kalpayet| nanu, yantrāṇāṃ diṅmātre 'py anabhijñaḥ katham iva kalpanāṃ kartuṃ pārayet ? ity āha- saṃ-yāni yāni sthūlāni yathāsthūlam| "yathā sādṛśye" ity avyayībhāvaḥ| yathāsthūlayantrakaraṇena vyutpannamatiḥ śeṣāṇām api yantrāṇām utpādane vikalpaṃ kartuṃ samartho bhaved iti bhāvaḥ|

Ā. rā. yantraviśeṣāṇām anantatvāt buddhyā kalpyatvam āha-anekarūpakāryāṇīti| ā raṃ-nidarśanārthaṃ kāṃścid yantraviśeṣān vaktum āha-yathāsthūlam iti| svastikasandaṃśatālanāḍīśalākānuyantrabhedāt ṣoḍhā yantrāṇi|

atha yantrāṇy āha ---- ----------------------------------------------------|
tulyāni kaṅkasiṃharkṣakākādimṛgapakṣiṇām||4||
mukhair mukhāni yantrāṇāṃ kuryāt tatsaṃjñakāni ca|
aṣṭādaśāṅgulāyāmāny āyasāni ca bhūriśaḥ||5||
masūrākāraparyantaiḥ kaṇṭhe baddhāni kīlakaiḥ|
vidyāt svastikayantrāṇi mūle 'ṅkuśanatāni ca||6||
tair dṛḍhair asthisaṃlagnaśalyāharaṇam iṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. yena pārśvena śalyam uddhriyate tad yantrāṇāṃ mukhaṃ vedyam| kaṅkādīnāṃ pakṣimṛgāṇāṃ mukhais tulyāni yantrāṇāṃ mukhāni kuryāt| ādiśabdena gṛdhrahaṃsahariṇādiparigrahaḥ| tāni tatsaṃjñakāni| ca evārthe, tāni yantrāṇi tannāmāny eva| yathā,-kaṅkumukhaṃ siṃhamukham ity ādi| aṣṭādaśāṅgulety ādi, svastikākhyāni yantrāṇi vidyāt| kīdṛśāni ? aṣṭādaśāṅguladairghyāṇi, bhūriśo-bāhulyena, āyasāni-śastramayāni| dantādimayānām api kvacid darśanāt bhūriśa ity uktam| tathā, kaṇṭhapradeśe kīlakair baddhāni| kīdṛśaiḥ kīlakaiḥ ? masūrākārāḥ paryantā yeṣāṃ taiḥ| yatra pradeśe yantrāṇāṃ hastagrahas tatra tanmūlam| tatrāṅkuśavan natāni-pariṇatāni| taiḥ-kaṅkamukhādibhiḥ, asthisaṃlagnaśalyasya-kāṇḍaphalādeḥ, āharaṇaṃ-ākarṣaṇam iṣyate|

Ā. rā. tatra svastikāny āha-tulyānīti| tatsaṃjñakāni-kaṅkamukhasiṃhamukhādināmāni| āyāmo-dairghyam| bhūriśa iti vacanāt dārvādikṛtāny api| kaṇṭhe-mukhākārasampādakaśakaladvayasandhānasthāne| mūle-dhāraṇasthāne| svastikānāṃ kāryam āha-tairddaḍhair iti|

----------------------------------------------------|
kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau sandaṃśau ṣoḍaśāṅgulau||7||
tvakśirāsnāyupiśitalagnaśalyāpakarṣaṇau| ----------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. kīlena-masūrākāraparyantena, baddhaṃ tathā vimuktam agraṃ- mukhaṃ, yayos tau kīlabaddhavimuktāgrau sandaṃśau bhavataḥ| kīdṛśau ? ṣoḍaśāṅgulapramāṇau| kvopayoga etayoḥ syāt ? ity āha-tvag ity ādi| tvagādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ| tvakśirāstrāyupiśitalagnaṃ ca tac chhalyaṃ ca, tasyāpakarṣṇe-āharaṇe, tāv upayujyete|
Ā. rā. sandaṃśāś catvāraḥ| tatra krīlabaddhāgrakīlamuktāgrau sandaṃśāv āha-kīlabaddhavimuktāgrāv iti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
ṣaḍaṅgulo 'nyo haraṇe sūkṣmaśalyopapakṣmaṇām||8||

div.ab: Sa. ṣoḍaśāṅgulasandaṃśadvayād anyaḥ sandaṃśaḥ (ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaḥ) sūkṣmaśalyānāṃ-nāsāromādīnāṃ, haraṇe-ākarṣaṇe, tathā, upapakṣmaṇāṃ vartmādibhavānāṃ haraṇe yujyate|
Ā. rā. ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ sandaṃśam āha-ṣaḍaṅgula iti| upapakṣmaṇāṃ-netreṣv avāntarapakṣmaṇām|

Sa. sā ca mucuṇḍīsaṃjñā| kimbhūtā mucuṇḍī? sūkṣmā dantā yasyāḥ sā sūkṣmadantā, tathā, ṛjuḥ-avakrā, na ca sandaṃśavad vakrā dvibāhur ity ārthaḥ| tathā, mūle-hastagrahaṇasthāne, rucakaṃ-aṅgulīyakarūpaṃ, bhūṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā rucakabhūṣaṇā| rucakapīḍanena sā karma karotīty arthaḥ| gambhīraś cāsau vraṇaś ca gambhīravraṇas tasmin māṃsāni-tasyādhimāṃsaṃ, etadviṣaya āharaṇe| armaṇaś ca śeṣitasya cchhinnaśeṣasyāharaṇe mucuṇḍī|
Ā. rā. mucuṇḍyākhyaṃ sandaṃśam āha-mucuṇḍīti| sūkṣmadantā-sūkṣmāgrā| ṛjuḥ-avakrā| rucakabhūṣaṇā-mūle mudrikābaddhā| gambhīreṣu vraṇeṣu yāni māṃsāni, yāni ca netreṣu chinnaśeṣāṇy armāṇi, teṣāṃ haraṇe|

Sa. dve tālayantre bhavataḥ| kiṃpramāṇe ? dvādaśāṅgule| saṃsthānam āha-matsyatālavat mīnagalatālavat, dvitālakaṃ-ekaṃ dvayoḥ pārśvayor matsyamukhasadṛśam, aparam ekatālakaṃ-ekapārśve matsyamukhākāram eva| te dve tālayantre bhavataḥ| karṇety ādi| karṇanāḍī śalyam apaharataḥ-karṇanāḍīśalyāpahāriṇī|
Ā. rā. tālayantradvayam āha-dve dvādaśāṅgula iti| matsyatālo-matsyagalatālaḥ|

Sa. nāḍīyantrāṇi bastinetrādivat suṣirāṇi syuḥ| ekaṃ cānekaṃ caikānekaṃ mukhaṃ yeṣām| tani ca kānicid ekamukhāni ekadvārāṇi, kānicid anekamukhāni-anekadvārāṇi| etat karmācaṣṭe-srota ity ādi| tāni ca karṇādisrotogatānāṃ śalyānāṃ darśananimittaṃ vidadhīta| tathā, kaṇṭhādisrotogatānāṃ rogāṇāṃ darśane-darśananimittaṃ, vidadhīta| tathā, kriyāṇāṃ-śastrakṣārāgniprakṣālanauṣadhapraṇidhānādīnāṃ, sukaratvārtham| tathā, viṣidigdhāṅgādīnām ācūṣaṇāya vidadhīta| tadvistārety ādi| teṣāṃ-nāḍīyantrāṇāṃ, vistāraś ca parīṇāhaś ca dairghyaṃ ca, tāni srotovaśāt bhavanti| yathā,-anuvāsanottarabastinasyanāḍikādiṣu nirdiṣṭam|
Ā. rā. nāḍīyantrāṇy āha-nāḍīyantrāṇīti| vistāro-vivarasya| parīṇāhaḥ-sthaulyaṃ yantrasya|
daśāṅgulā'rdhanāhā'ntaḥkaṇṭhaśalyāvalokinī| nāḍī----------------------------------------|13|
Sa. kaṇṭhe śalyaṃ kaṇṭhaśalyam| kaṇṭhābhyantaraśalyāvalokanārthaṃ daśāṅgulā nāḍī| ardhanāhā-pañcāṅgulapariṇāhā|
Ā. rā. kaṇṭhāntaḥśalyāvalokinīṃ nāḍīm āha-daśāṅguleti| ardhanāhā-pañcāṅgulasthaulyā|

----------------------------------------------------| --------pañcamukhacchhidrā catuṣkarṇasya saṅgrahe||13||
vāraṅgasya, dvikarṇasya tricchhidrā tatpramāṇataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. pañcamukhāni chhidrāṇi yasyāḥ sā| catuṣkarṇasya vāraṅgasya saṅgrahe-saṅgrahaṇanimittam idaṃ yantram| catvāraḥ karṇā yasya vāraṅgasyeti samāsaḥ| tatra śarādidaṇḍapraveśaḥ śikhākāraḥ kīlako vāraṅga ucyate| dvikarṇasya vāraṅgasya tricchhidrā nāḍī syāt| trīṇi chhidrāṇi yasyāḥ sā tricchhidrā| chhidraśabdasyopalakṣaṇarthatvāt trimukhety etad api draṣṭavyam| tasya vāraṅgasya pramāṇaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ tasmād vāraṅgapramāṇataḥ-tadanusāreṇa nāḍīpramāṇaṃ jñeyam|

Ā. rā. catuṣkarṇavāraṅgasaṅgrahaṇīṃ nāḍīm āha-nāḍīti| pañcamukhacchidrā-mukhe chidrapañcakayutā| dvikarṇasaṅgrahaṇīṃ nāḍīm āha-dvikarṇasyeti| tatpramāṇataḥ-saṅgrahyapramāṇena| etac ca nāḍīdvaye chidramānam|

----------------------------------------------------|
vāraṅgakarṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyānurodhataḥ||14||
nāḍīr evaṃvidhāś cānyā draṣṭuṃ śalyāni kārayet| ----------------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. tathā, karṇaś ca saṃsthānaṃ cānāhaś ca dairghyaṃ ca tāny evam| vāraṅgasya karṇasaṃsthānānāhadairghyāṇi, teṣām anurodhas tasmāt, evaṃprakārā anyā api nāḍīḥ śalyāni śarīrāntargatāni draṣṭuṃ kārayet|
Ā. rā. anyāni nāḍīyantrāṇy āha-vāraṅgakarṇeti| saṃsthānaṃ-ākṛtiḥ| ānāhaḥ-sthaulyam|

Sa. mūrdhni-mūrddhabhāge, padmakarṇikayā-jalajakarṇikayā, sadṛśī| kiyatpramāṇā ? dvādaśāṅgulā| tathā, caturthaḥ-caturbhāgaḥ, suṣiro yasyāḥ sā, tryaṅhgulasuṣireti yāvat| sā nāḍī śalyanirghātinī matā| munīnām iti śeṣaḥ| arśoyantraṃ lakṣayitum āha-
Ā. rā. śalyanirghātinīṃ nāḍīm āha-padmakarṇikayeti| caturthasuṣirā-tryaṅguladīrghavivarā|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
arśasāṃ gostanākāraṃ yantrakaṃ caturaṅgulam||16||

lg.l: dvicchhidraṃ darśane vyādher ekacchhidraṃ tu karmaṇi||17||

div.ab: Sa. arśasāṃ sambandhi yantrakaṃ gostanākṛti caturaṅgulaṃ mānato dairghyeṇa syāt| yantrakam ity ākarṣakaṃ syāt| nāhe-pariṇāhe, pañcāṅgulam| yat pañcāṅguladīrgheṇa sūtreṇa veṣṭyate, tatpramāṇaṃ sthaulyam ity arthaḥ| etat puṃsām eva pañcāṅgulaṃ nāhe syāt| strīṇāṃ tu pariṇāhe ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yantrakaṃ syāt, svabhāvata eva tāsāṃ gudasya mahattvāt| vyādher darśane dvicchhidraṃ-ubhayapārśvacchhidraṃ yantram| karmaṇi-śastrakṣārādyavacāraṇe, ekacchhidraṃ yantram| asya yantrasya madhye tryaṅgulaṃ chhidram| aṅhguṣṭhamadhyatulyavistāraṃ, tathā tadūrdhvato 'rdhāṅgulocchhritā uddṛttā karṇikā yasya tad evam|

Ā. rā. arśoyantrākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-arśasām iti| caturaṅgulaṃ dairghye| pariṇāhe tu puṃsāṃ pañcāṅgulaṃ, strīṇāṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam| vyādher darśane dvicchidram, kṣārādiyojane tu śeṣāṅgaparirakṣāyām ekacchidram| dvicchidrasya tu dvayoḥ pārśvayoś cchidram, ekacchidrasyaikasmin pārśve| tac ca tryaṅguladairghyam aṅguṣṭhodaravistāraṃ madhye kāryam| chidrād urdhvabhage mūle 'rdhāṅgulocchrāyā bahiḥkuñcitāgrā karṇikā kāryā|
śamyākhyaṃ tādṛg acchhidraṃ yantram arśaḥprapīḍanam| ----------------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. śamyākhyaṃ-śamīsaṃjñaṃ, tṛtīyaṃ yantrakaṃ tādṛg-gostanākāram ity ādilakṣaṇalakṣitayantrasadṛśaṃ syāt| atra viśeṣam āha-acchhidram ity ādi| acchhidraṃ-chhidrarahitam, yantre chhidraṃ na vidheyam ity arthaḥ| idaṃ ca yantram arśaḥprapīḍanaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. tṝtīyam arśaḥpīḍanaṃ śamyākhyaṃ yantram āha-śamyākhyam iti| tādṛk-gostanākārādilakṣaṇam| acchidraṃ-pārśvacchidrarahitam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
sarvathā'panayed oṣṭhaṃ chhidrād ūrdhvaṃ bhagandare||19||

div.ab: Sa. sarvathā bhagandare-bhagandarayantre, oṣṭham apanayet| kutaḥ prabhṛti ? chhidrād ūrdhvam,-upariṣṭād ardhāṅgulam apakarṣayed ity arthaḥ| karṇikā tu kāryaiva (?)|
Ā. rā. bhagandarayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-sarvatheti| arśoyantram evāpanītauṣṭhaṃ bhagandarayantram| mukhacchidrasya pārśvabhāga oṣṭhaḥ|
Sa. ghrāṇārbude ghrāṇārśasi caikacchhidrā nāḍī dairghyeṇāṅguladvayapramāṇā| tathā, pradeśinītulyaḥ parīṇāho yasyāḥ saivam| sā ca bhagandarayantratulyā syāt, apanītauṣṭhety arthaḥ|
Ā. rā. ghrāṇārśorbudayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-ghrāṇārbudeti|

Sa. aṅgulitrāṇakākhyaṃ yantraṃ dantamayaṃ kāṣṭhamayaṃ vā caturaṅgulapramāṇam arśasāṃ yantrasadṛśaṃ dvicchhidraṃ gostanākṛti syāt| tac ca vaktrasya vivṛtau-prasāraṇe, sukham| yato vaktraprasāraṇe aṅguler dantebhyo rakṣaṇād anvartham aṅgulitrāṇakam iti nāma|
Ā. rā. aṅgulitrāṇākhyaṃ nāḍīyantram āha-aṅgulitrāṇakam iti| vaktravivṛtau-vaktravikāśanārthaṃ, praveśitām aṅgulīṃ rakṣatīty aṅgulitrāṇakam|

yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ madhye suṣiraṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulam|
mudrābaddhaṃ caturbhittam ambhojamukulānanam||22||
catuḥśalākam ākrāntaṃ mūle tad vikasen mukhe| ----------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. yonivraṇam īkṣate 'neneti tat yonivraṇekṣaṇaṃ yantrakam| madhye-madhyabhāge, suṣiram| tathā, dairdhyeṇa ṣoḍaśāṅgulam| tathā mudrikayā-ūrmikayā'sañcāriṇyā, baddhaṃ-yuktam| tathā, catvāro (ri) bhittāḥ(ttāni)-patrāṇi, yasya tac caturbhittam| tathā, jalajamukulasadṛśamukham| tathā, catasraḥ śalākā yatra tat catuḥśalākam| tathā, tat-yantraṃ, mūla ākrāntaṃ-mūlaśalākākramaṇāt mukhe vikaset-prasaret|
Ā. rā. yonivraṇekṣaṇākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-yonivraṇekṣaṇam iti| caturbhittaṃ-catuḥśakalam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
yantre nāḍīvraṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya ṣaḍaṅgule||23||

div.ab: Sa. yantre dve ṣaḍaṅgule bhavataḥ| kimartham ? nāḍīvrāṇābhyaṅgakṣālanāya,-abhyaṅgaś ca kṣālanaṃ cābhyaṅgakṣālane tadarthaṃ, upayujyete| ākaraṇaṃ-ākṛt, sampadāditvāt kvip| pūrvavihitasya bastiyantrasyeva ākṛt-ākāro, yayos te bastiyantrākṛtī,-vṛtte gopucchhākāre| tathā, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mūle mukhe 'ṅguṣṭhakalāyakhe-mūle 'ṅguṣṭhatulyacchhidre, mukhe kalāyatulyacchhidre| agrato 'karṇike- karṇikārahite, iti bastiyantrād viśeṣaḥ| mūle tu karṇike dve 'pi puṭakayojanārthaṃ kārya evety agragrahaṇam| mūle-mūladeśe, nibaddhaṃ- yojitaṃ, mṛdu carma-bastipuṭakākāraṃ, yayos te nibaddhamṛducarmaṇī|

Ā. rā. nāḍīvraṇābhyañjananāḍīvraṇakṣālanākhyaṃ nāḍīdvayam āha-yantra iti| mūle 'ṅguṣṭhapraveśacchidre, agre kalāyapraveśacchidre| agrato 'karṇike-agre karṇikārahite| bastiyantrākṛtīni nāḍīviśeṣaṇam, yantraviśeṣaṇatve tu numprasaṅgaḥ|
Sa. udakodare jalasrāvaṇārthaṃ nalikā dvidvārā-ubhayamukhī, syāt| athavā, picchanalikā-mayūrapicchhajety arthaḥ|
Ā. rā. jalodarayantrākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-dvidvāreti| nalikā-veṇvādināḍī| picchanalikā-pakṣipicchanāḍī|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
dhūmabastyādiyantrāṇi nirdiṣṭāni yathāyatham||25||

div.ab: Sa. dhūmādiyantrāṇi yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānādyadhyāyeṣūktāni|
Ā. rā. dhūmayantrādyā nāḍya uktā ity āha-dhūmabastyādīti|

Sa. śṛṅgaṃ tryaṅgulamukham| duṣṭavātaviṣaraktāmbuduṣṭastanyādeś cūṣaṇe-cūṣaṇanimittaṃ, aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ syāt| aṣṭādaśeti ""hyaṣṭana" ity ādinā''kārādeśaḥ| tathā, agre-prānte, sarṣapapramāṇacchhidram| yaḥ pradeśaś cūṣaṇāya śarīre yojyate tad agram| tathā, suṣṭhu naddhaṃ-samyag baddham| cūcukasya-strīkucāgrasyeva, ākṛtiḥ-ākāro, yasya tad evam|

Ā. rā. śṛṅgaṃ tryaṅgulamukham| duṣṭavātaviṣaraktāmbuduṣṭastanyādeś cūṣaṇe-cūṣaṇanimittaṃ, aṣṭādaśāṅgulaṃ-aṣṭāṅgulaṃ daśāṅgulaṃ vā| saṅgrahe tu dvādaśāṅgulam apy uktam (sū.a.34)- "śṛṅgaṃ tu hRasvamadhyadīrgham aśṭādaśadvādaśāṅgulāyatam" iti|

Sa. alābuḥ-tumbaḥ, dvādaśāṅgulo dairghyeṇa syāt| pariṇāhe 'ṣṭādaśāṅgulaḥ| catvāri vā trīṇi vā'ṅhgulāni yasya tac catustryaṅgulam, tat tādṛśaṃ vṛtaṃ-vartulaṃ, āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasya sa evam| tathā, antaḥ-madhye, dīpto-jvalitaḥ, picur bhūrjādi garbha ity arthaḥ| sa īdṛśo duṣṭakapharaktaharaḥ syāt|
Ā. rā. tumbākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-syādvādaśeti| caturaṅgulāsyas tryaṅgulāsyo vā| antardīptaḥ-pradīptatṛṇasṛṣṭapicunā|
Sa. tadvat-tenālābunā tulyadairghyānāhādiḥ, tulyakāryākārā ca, ghaṭī syāt| sā ca gulmasya vilaya unnamane ca hitā, na kevalaṃ kapharaktahṛd iti cārthaḥ|
Ā. rā. ghatikākhyāṃ nāḍīm āha-tadva-ṭīti| tadvat-alābusadṛśī| gulmavilayane gulmonnamane ca| cakārāt śleṣmaraktāvacūṣaṇe ca|
Sa. śalākāsaṃjñāni yantrāṇi vividhakarmāṇi vividhākārāṇi yathāyogapramāṇāni syuḥ|
Ā. rā. śalākāyantrāṇy āha-śalākākhyānīti|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhya ubhe gaṇḍūpadatulyāsya eṣaṇakarmaṇī|
Ā. rā. eṣiṇyau śalāke āha-teṣām iti| eṣaṇaṃ avalokanam|
Sa. tathā srotobhyaḥ śalyahāriṇī śalākāyantre bhavataḥ| kimbhūte ? masūrety ādi| masūradalamiva vaktraṃ yayos te, masūradalamukhe dve śalāke 'ṣṭāṅgule navāṅgule vā syātām|
Ā. rā. śalyahāriṇyau śalāke āha-srotobhya iti|
Sa. śaṅkavaḥ ṣaṭ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. śaṅkvākhyāḥ śalākā gaṇayati-śaṅkava iti|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhye dvau ṣoḍaśāṅguladvādaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ| vyūhane-nyūhanakarmaṇi, sarpaphaṇāmukhau|
Ā. rā. vyūhanau śaṅkū āha-ubhāv iti| vyūhanaṃ-prasṛtamāṃsādīnām yathāsthānaṃ vinyāsaḥ|
------------------------dvau daśadvādaśāṅgulau| cālane śarapuṅkhāsyau-----------------------------|31|
Sa. dvau śaṅkū daśāṅguladvādaśāṅgulau bhavataḥ| cālane kāṇḍavāja iva mukhaṃ yayos tau śarapuṅkhāsyau bhavataḥ|
Ā. rā. cālanau śaṅkū āha-dvāv iti| śarapuṅkaṃ-śarakartarī|
Sa. āhārye-ākarṣaṇe, baḍiśākārau| ṣaṭśaṅhkūn ākhyāya garbhaśaṅkum āha-
Ā. rā. āharaṇau śaṅkū āha-āhārye baḍiśākṛtīti| baḍiśaṃ-matsyavedhanam|

lg.l: nato 'gre śaṅkunā tulyo garbhaśaṅkur iti smṛtaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. nato 'gre-agrabhāge, tathā śaṅkunā samaḥ-kīlakākāraḥ, aṣṭāṅguladīrghaḥ sa garbhaśaṅkur iti smṛtaḥ, 'munibhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| tena-garbhaśaṅkunā, mūḍhagarbha-aniḥsarantaṃ, haret|
Ā. rā. saptamaṃ garbhaśaṅkum āha-nato 'gra iti| nato-vakraḥ| śaṅkunā tulyaḥ-kīlakākāraḥ|
aśmaryāharaṇaṃ sarpaphāṇāvad vaktram agrataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. aśmaryākarṣaṇe sarpaphaṇāvad agre vaktraṃ syāt| sarpaphaṇākhyam eva caitad yantram|
Ā. rā. aśmaryāharaṇaṃ śalākāyantram āha-aśmaryāharaṇam iti|

----------------------------------------------------|
śarapuṅkhamukhaṃ dantapātanaṃ caturaṅgulam||33||
kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣāḥ śalākāḥ ṣaṭ pramārjane| ----------------------------------------------------|34|

Sa. śarapuṅkhamukhākhyaṃ yantraṃ caturaṅgulaṃ dantapātanaṃ syāt| anena hi dantāś calantaḥ pātyante kṛmyādibhakṣitā vā| saṃ-pramārjane-kṣālane kṣārakledādeḥ, ṣaṭ śalākāḥ syuḥ| kimbhūtāḥ ? kārpāsena vihitam uṣṇīṣaṃ-śiroveṣṭanamiva, yāsāṃ tās tathoktāḥ|
Ā. rā. dantapātanaṃ śalākāyantram āha-śarapuṅkhamukham iti| ā raṃ-pramārjanīḥ śalākā gaṇayati-kārpāsavihitoṣṇīṣā iti| uṣṇīṣaṃ-śiroveṣṭanam|
Sa. pāyāv āsannadūrārthe daśadvādaśāṅgule dve bhavataḥ| āsannārthe daśāṅgulā, dūrārthe dvādaśāṅgulety arthaḥ|
Ā. rā. pāyupramārjanyau śalāke āha-pāyāv iti|
dve ṣaṭsaptāṅgule ghrāṇe, dve karṇe 'ṣṭanavāṅule| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. ghrāṇe ṣaṭsaptāṅgule dve bhavataḥ| 'āsannadūrārthe' ity atrāpy anuvartate| tathaiva karṇe 'ṣṭanavāṅgule bhavataḥ|
Ā. rā. ghrāṇapramārjanyau śalāke āha-dve ṣaḍ iti| karṇapramārjanyau śalāke āha-dve karṇa iti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
karṇaśodhanam aśvatthapatraprāntaṃ sruvānanam||35||

div.ab: Sa. karṇaśodhanākhyaṃ yantram| aśvatthapatrasyeva prānto yasya tat tathā| tathā, sruvasyevānanaṃ yasya tad evam|
Ā. rā. karṇaśodhanaṃ śalākāyantram āha-karṇaśodhanam iti| dravasya malasyāpanayanaṃ-mārjanam, kaṭhinasya-śodhanam|

Sa. śalākāś ca jāmbavauṣṭhāni ca teṣāṃ pṛthak trayaṃ kṣāre kṣārapātane, [ āgnau-] āgnidāhakaraṇe ca yuñjyāt| kimbhūtānāṃ śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānām ? sthūlāṇudīrghāṇāṃ,-sthūlāś cāṇavaś ca dīrghāś ca, teṣām| tatra śalākās tistro jāmbavauṣṭhāni ca trīṇi, kṣāre tathā dāhane, evaṃ dvādaśaitāni śalākākhyāni yantrāṇīti|

Ā. rā. kṣārāgniprayogārthaṃ tisraḥ śalākās trīṇi ca jāmbavauṣṭhāny āha-śalākājāmbavauṣṭhānām iti| sthūlaṃ ca sthūlāṃ ca aṇuś ca aṇu ca dīrghā ca dīrghaṃ ca tāni sthūlāṇudīrghāṇīty ekaśeṣeṇa nirdeśaḥ| aṇu-sūkṣmaṃ hrasvaṃ ca| tena sthūladīrghaṃ sūkṣmahasvaṃ madhyaṃ ceti trividhaṃ śalākāyantraṃ jāmbavauṣṭhaṃ ca| jambūphalavad oṣṭho yasya taj jāmbavauṣṭham, śalākāviśeṣa eva| saṅgrahe 'py uktam (sū.a. 34)-"kṣārāgnikarmārthaṃ jāmbavauṣṭhāni dvādaśadaśāṣṭāṅgulāni kramāt vdyaṅgulāṅgulārddhāṅgulaphalāni| śalākāś ca sthūlasūkṣmadīrghahrasvamadhyāḥ|" iti|
Sa. antravardhmani-antravṛddhau, śalākāṃ yuñjyāt| kīdṛśīm ? madhyād ūrdhvaṃ vṛtto daṇḍo yasyās tām| tathā, mūle-mūlabhāge, ardhendusannibhāṃ-ardhacandrākārām|
Ā. rā. antravṛddhau dāhārthaṃ śalākām āha-śalākām iti| mūle-grahaṇasthāne| madhyordhvavṛttadaṇḍāṃ-ardhacandrākṛtiṃ śalākāṃ vidhāya tanmadhye ūrdhvo vṛtto daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ|
Sa. badarāsthikhaṇḍasamaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā kolāsthidalatulyāsyā| sā nāsārśaḥsu nāsārbudeṣu ca dāhaṃ karoti|
Ā. rā. nāsārśorbudadāhārthaṃ śalākām āha-kolāsthidaleti|
Sa. kṣārauṣadhakrame tisraḥ śalākā nimnamukhā aṣṭāṅgulāḥ syuḥ| kīdṛśyaḥ ? kanīnī ca madhyamā cānāmī ca, tāsāṃ nakhāḥ, teṣāṃ mānaṃ-pramāṇaṃ, tena samaiḥ-tulyaiḥ, mukhair upalakṣitāḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. darvyākhyās tisraḥ śalākā āha-aṣṭāṅgulā iti|
svaṃ svam uktāni yantrāṇi meḍhraśuddhyañjanādiṣu| -----------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. meḍhrādiṣu viṣayeṣu-uttarabastyādiṣu, svaṃ svaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, yantrāṇi gaditāni| ādiśabdena nāvanādiparigrahaḥ|
Ā. rā. meḍhraśodhanādyāḥ śalākās tatra tatroktā ity āha svaṃ svam uktānīti|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
anuyantrāṇy ayaskāntarajjuvastrāśmamudgarāḥ||39||

lg.l: kālaḥ pākaḥ karaḥ pādo bhayaṃ harṣaś ca, tatkriyāḥ||40||

div.ab: Sa. ayaskāntādīny aṇuyantrāṇi, svalpayantrakāryakaraṇāt| teṣāṃ kriyās tatkriyāḥ-nirghātanādikāḥ, buddhyā nipuṇam ālocya pravibhajet,-nirghātanādikarmāṇi pravibhajya yuñjyād ity arthaḥ|

Ā. rā. anuyantrāṇy āha-anuyantrāṇīti| ayaskāntādīny ekonaviṃśatir anuyantrāṇi| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.
34)-"etāni dehe sarvasmin dehasyāvayave 'pi vā|
sandhau koṣṭhe dhamanyāṃ ca yathāyogaṃ prayojayet||" iti| anuyantrakarmāṇi svayam ūhyānīty ata āha tatkriyā iti|

tāny eva yantrāṇāṃ karmāṇy āha ----
nirghātanonmathanapūraṇamārgaśuddhi- saṃvyūhanāharaṇabandhanapīḍanāni|
ācūṣaṇonnamananāmanacālabhaṅga- vyāvartanarjukaraṇāni ca yantrakarma||41.5||
Sa. nirghātanādi yantrasya karma| nirghātanaṃ-tāḍanaṃ paripātanam, unmathanaṃ-āloḍanaṃ unmūlanam, evam anyad api cintyam| caḥ samuccaye, tena prakṣālanādīni samuccīyante|
Ā. rā. yantrakarmāṇy āha-nirghātaneti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 34)-"vivaraṇavikarṣaṇavyathanaiṣaṇadāraṇaprakṣālanapradhamanāñjanapramārjanāni" iti navādhikānīti caturviṃśatiḥ|

vivartate sādhv avagāhate ca grāhyaṃ gṛhītvoddharate ca yasmāt|
yantreṣv ataḥ kaṅkamukhaṃ pradhānaṃ sthāneṣu sarveṣv adhikāri yac ca| 42 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhir nāma pañcaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. vivartanādibhiś caturbhiḥ kāraṇair yantreṣu madhye kaṅkamukhaṃ śreṣṭham iti| yasmāc ca sarveṣu pradeśeṣv adhikāri-adhikriyate iti| vasantatilakopajātī vṛtte| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne yantravidhir nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 25||

Ā. rā. yantreṣu kaṅkamukhasya prādhānyam āha-vivartata iti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.34)-"hrasvadīrghasthūlatanuvakraviṣamagrāhyagrāhiśithilatety aṣṭau yantradoṣāḥ|" iti|
iti hemādriṭīkāyām āyurvedarasāyane|
yantrakarmaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 25||

div.head: śastravidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. athedānīṃ ṣaḍviṃśādhyāyarambhaḥ śastrasvarūpavijñānārthaḥ|
athātaḥ śastravidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|
Sa. śastrasya vidhiḥ śastravidhiḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
Ā. rā. śastravidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti|

ab.seg:
kuśāsyaṃ sāṭavadanam antarvakrārdhacandrake (kam)|
vrīhimukhaṃ kuṭhārī ca śalākāṅguliśastrake||2||

div.ab: Sa. bāhulyena śastrāṇi ṣaḍaṅgulāni bhavanti| tathā ṣaḍviṃśatisaṅkhyāni, tathā sukarmāraiḥ-karmakuśalair naraiḥ, yathāvidhi { ghaṭitāni }-samyaṅ niṣpāditāni, tathā romavāhīni-lomaśātanasamarthāni, tathā surūpāṇi-śobhanākārāṇi, tathā sudhārāṇi-śobhanadhārāṇi, tathā sukhena gṛhyante-sugrahāṇi ca, kārayet| kva ? ayasi| kīdṛśe ? suṣṭhu dhmātaṃ sudhmātaṃ, tathā sutīkṣṇaṃ svāvartitaṃ ca yad ayaḥ-śastraṃ, tasmin| kīdṛśāni śastrāṇi ? akarālāni-sudarśanāni| tathā, samāhitaṃ-suṣṭhukṛtaṃ, mukhāgraṃ-phalaṃ, yeṣāṃ tāni samāhitamukhāgrāṇi| tathā, nīlotpaladyutīni| tathā, nāmnā'nugataṃ rūpaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni-anvarthanāmānīty arthaḥ| tathā, sarvakālaṃ sannihitāni-samīpasthāni| tathā, svaṃ ca tad unmānaṃ ca svonmānaṃ-ātmīyaṃ pramāṇaṃ, tasmāt sakāśād ardham, tasya caturthāṃśaḥ-aṣṭabhāgaḥ, phalaṃ yeṣāṃ tāny evam| api ceti samuccaye| evaṃvidhāni śastrāṇy ekaikaśaḥ sthānaviśeṣāt dvitrāṇi prayuñjīta| ekaikaśa iti "ekaṃ bahuvrīhivat " iti dvitvasublopau, tataḥ śaspratyayaḥ|

Ā. rā. śastrāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha-ṣaḍviṃśatir iti| sukarmāraiḥ-uttamalohakāraiḥ| romavāhīni-romacchedīni| akarālāni-ārjavavanti| ayasi-lohe ghaṭitāni, tṛtīyārthe saptamī| samāhitaṃ-samyag ghāṭitaṃ, mukhāgraṃ-phalaṃ, yeṣāṃ tāni| svonmānasya-aṅgulaṣaṭkasya, ardhacaturthāṃśaḥ-adhyuṣṭo bhāgaḥ,- saptamāṃśadvayasahitaṃ yavadaśakam, tatparimāṇaṃ phalaṃ yeṣāṃ tāni| ekaikaśo dvitrāṇi-pratyekaṃ dve trīṇi vā, kārayet| ṣaḍviṃśater upayogam āha-yuñjīteti|

Sa. teṣāṃ śastrāṇāṃ madhye maṇḍalāgraṃ nāma śastram| kīdṛk ? phaloddeśe tarjanyā antarnakhas tarjanyantarnakhaḥ tasyevākṛtir yasya tad evam| kvaitad yojyam ? ity āha-lekhane chedane ca pothakyādiṣu yojyam| ādiśabdena vartmarogādayo gṛhyante|
Ā. rā. maṇḍalāgraṃ śastram āha-maṇḍalāgram iti| śuṇḍikā-galaśuṇḍikā|

vṛddhipatraṃ kṣurākāraṃ chedabhedanapāṭane|
ṛjvagram unnate śophe gambhīre ca tad anyathā||6||
natāgraṃ pṛṣṭhato dīrghahrasvavaktraṃ yathāśrayam| -----------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. vṛddhipatraṃ nāma śastraṃ kṣurākāraṃ syāt| tac ca chedanādiṣu yojyam iti prakṛtam| phalaparimāṇaṃ tūktam eva| kīdṛk ? ṛju-spaṣṭam agraṃ yasya tad ṛjvagram, tad unnate śophe syāt| gambhīre tu śophe tat-vṛddhipatram anyathā| katham anyathā ? ity āha-natety ādi| pṛṣṭhataḥ-pṛṣṭhadeśe, natam agraṃ yasya tan natāgraṃ bhavatīti|
Ā. rā. vṛddhipatram āha-vṛddhipatram iti| unnate gambhīre ca śophe ṛjvagram| anyathābhūte śophe pṛṣṭhato natāgram| sthānavaśena dīrghamukhaṃ hrasvamukhaṃ ca|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
utpalādhyardhadhārākhye bhedane chedane tathā||7||

div.ab: Sa. { yathāyathaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, dīrghavaktraṃ hrasvavaktraṃ ca yuñjyāt| } utpalaṃ cādhyardhadhāraṃ ca, te ākhye yayos ta utpalādhyardhadhārākhye śastre yathākramaṃ dīrghahrasvavaktre bhavathaḥ| utpalapatraṃ dīrghamukham adhyardhadhāraṃ tu hrasvavaktram ity arthaḥ| te bhedane chedane ca yojye| tatheti samuccaye, pāṭane ca yojya ity arthaḥ|
Ā. rā. utpalapatram adhyarddhadhāraṃ ceti śastradvayam āha-utpaleti| ete svanāmānugatarūpe|
sarpāsyaṃ ghrāṇakarṇārśaścchedane 'rdhāṅgulaṃ phale| -----------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. sarpavaktraṃ nāma śastraṃ nāmānugatākāraṃ ghrāṇārśaścchedane karṇārśaśchedane ca yojyam| tac ca phale 'rdhāṅgulaṃ bhavati|
Ā. rā. sarpavaktram āha-sarpāsyam iti|

Sa. eṣaṇī nāma śastram gater vraṇānām anveṣaṇe yojyam| kīdṛśī ? ślakṣṇā-komalasparśā| tathā, gaṇḍūpadamukham iva mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā gaṇḍūpadamukhā| dvitīyām eṣaṇīm āha- aparaiṣaṇī bhedanārthe sūcīmukhā syāt| tathā, mūle niviṣṭaṃ-kṛtaṃ, khaṃ-chidraṃ, yasyāḥ sā mūlaniviṣṭakhā|
Ā. rā. anveṣaṇārtham eṣaṇīm āha-gater iti| gateḥ-nāḍīvraṇasya| bhedanārtham eṣaṇīm āha-bhedanārtha iti| bhedanatvaṃ kṣārāktasūtrapraveśanena|
Sa. vetasaṃ- vetasapatrākāraṃ śastram, ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ pūrvoktaphalam| tac ca vyadhane yojyam|
Ā. rā. vetasaśastram āha-vetasam iti|
Sa. śarāriḥ-āṭhyākhyaḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ| śarāryāsyaṃ nāma śastraṃ trikūrcake ca srāvye yojyam|
Ā. rā. śarārimukhaṃ trikūrcakaṃ ceti śastradvayam āha srāvya iti| srāvye-pracchānena raktasrutau| bhāve kṛtyapratyayaḥ| śarāriḥ-pakṣiviśeṣaḥ|
kuśāṭāvadane srāvye hy aṅgulaṃ syāt tayoḥ phalam| -----------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. kuśāṭā nāma śastraṃ vadane srāvye yojyam| tayoḥ-śarārikuśāṭayoḥ, phalaṃ dvyaṅgulapramāṇaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. kuśapatram āṭāmukhaṃ ceti śastradvayam āha-kuśāṭeti| āṭā-pakṣiviśeṣaḥ|
Sa. antarmukhaṃ nāma śastraṃ tadvat-kuśāṭātulyam| tasya-antarmukhasya, phalaṃ sārdham aṅgulaṃ syāt| tathā-kuśāṭātulyam etad api, ardhacandrāsyasaṃjñaṃ śastram| caḥ samuccaye bhinnakrame|
Ā. rā. antarmukham āha-tadvad iti| tadvat-srāvye|

ab.seg:
----------------------tathādhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale|
vrīhivaktraṃ prayojyaṃ ca tac chirodarayor vyadhe||11||

div.ab: Sa. vrīhivaktram apy adhyardhāṅgulaṃ phale syāt| tac ca śirāvyadha udaravyadhe ca yojyam|
Ā. rā. vrīhimukham āha-tatheti|

lg.l: tayordhvadaṇḍayā vidhyed upary asthāṃ sthitāṃ śirām||12||

div.ab: Sa. kuṭhārī nāma śastraṃ pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇasaṃsthānadaṇḍā| tathā, godantasadṛśam ardhāṅgulam ānanaṃ yasyāḥ saivam| tayā-kuṭhārikayā, ūrdhvadaṇḍayā satyā śirām asthnām upari sthitāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. kuṭhārīm āha-pṛthur iti| kuṭhāryāḥ kāryam āha-tayeti|

Sa. tāmramayī śalākā dvimukhī syāt| sā ca mukhe kurubakākṛtiḥ-raktasahacarapuṣpamukulākārā syāt| tayā śalākayā, liṅganāśaṃ-kaphotthapaṭalasaṃjñaṃ, vidhyet| raṃ0-śalākām āha-tāmrīti| kurubakaṃ-kuraṇṭakamukulam|

Sa. aṅguliśastrakaṃ kuryāt| kīdṛśam ? mudrikayā-ūrmikayā, nirgataṃ-niṣkrāntaṃ, mukhaṃ yasya tan mudrikānirgatamukham| phale tu-tasmin mukhe, ardhāṅguladīrgham| yogataḥ-saṃsthānena, vṛddhipatreṇa maṇḍalāgreṇa vā tulyam| kiyatpramāṇā'sya mudrikā kāryā ? ity āha-tatpradeśinyagrety ādi| tasya-vaidyasya, yā pradeśinī tasyā yad agraparva tasya yat pramāṇaṃ tenārpyata iti tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇī-bhiṣaktarjanyagraparvapraveśāgracchhidrā, mudrikā yasmin tat tatpradeśinyagraparvapramāṇārpaṇamudrikam| tathā, sūtreṇa baddhaṃ-sūtrabaddham, sūtreṇa baddhvā maṇibandhe yojyam ity arthaḥ| galasrotorogāṇāṃ chedane bhedane ca tad yojyam|
Ā. rā. aṅguliśastrakam āha-kuryād iti| mudrikānirgatamukhaṃ-kaṇṭhasthamudrikam| yogataḥ-sthānarogayogyatānusāreṇa vikalpya|
grahaṇe śuṇḍikārmāder baḍiśaṃ sunatānanam| ----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. baḍiśaṃ nāma śastraṃ śuṇḍikārmāder grahaṇe yojyam| ādiśabdena pratijihvikāder grahaṇam| kīdṛśaṃ tat ? sunataṃ-aṅkuśavad ānataṃ, ānanaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasya tad evam|
Ā. rā. baḍiśam āha-grahaṇa iti|

----------------------------------------------|
chede 'stthnāṃ karapatraṃ tu kharadhāraṃ daśāṅgulam||16||
vistāre dvyaṅgulaṃ sūkṣmadantaṃ sutsarubandhanam| ----------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. karapatraṃ nāma śastraṃ kharadhāraṃ, tathā daśāṅgulaṃ dairghyeṇa, dvyaṅgulaṃ vistāreṇa, sūkṣmā dantā yasya tat sūkṣmadantam| tathā, tsaruḥ-muṣṭiḥ, bandhanaṃ-grahaṇam, śobhane tsarubandhane yasya tat sutsarubandhanam| abhidhānakośe yady api 'tsaruḥ-asimuṣṭiḥ' ity abhyadhāyi, tathā'pi muṣṭimātrasyehopalakṣaṇārthatvāt muṣṭāv apy upapannam eva|
Ā. rā. karapatram āha-chede 'sthnām iti| suṣṭhu tsarubandhanaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ yasya|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
snāyusūtrakacacchede kartarī kartarīnibhā||17||

div.ab: Sa. kartarī nāma śastraṃ kartarīsadṛśaṃ snāyvādicchede yojyam|
Ā. rā. kartarīm āha-srāyusūtrakacaccheda iti|

Sa. nakhaśastraṃ-nakhacchedakaṃ, prasiddham| tac ca vaktrā ṛjuś ca dhārā yasya tad evam| tasyaikaṃ mukhaṃ vaktram anyad ṛju-spaṣṭam| tathā, navāṅgulaṃ-navāṅulapramāṇam, na tu ṣaḍaṅgulam| etac ca sūkṣmaśalyasya-kaṇṭakāder uddharaṇadau nakhacchedane bhedane { pracchaane lekhane } ca yojyam|
Ā. rā. nakhaśastram āha-vakrarjudhāram iti| navāṅgulaṃ na tu ṣaḍaṅgulam| nakhacchedanakaṃ-prasiddham| vakrarjudhāraṃ ekasmin mukhe vakrā dhārā, anyasmin ṛjuḥ|

ab.seg:
adhunā dantalekhanaśastram āha ----
ekadhāraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prabaddhākṛti caikataḥ|
dantalekhanakaṃ tena śodhayed vantaśarkarām||19||

div.ab: Sa. ekadhāraṃ-ekasmin pradeśe { dhārā yasya tad evam| } tathā, catuṣkoṇam| tathā, ekataḥ-ekasmin deśe prabaddhā ākṛtir yasya tat| tad dantalekhanakaṃ nāma śastram| tena dantaśarkarāṃ śodhayet|
Ā. rā. adhunā sūcīśastram āha-dantalekhanam āha-ekadhāram iti| prabaddhavat-veṣṭitavat, ākṛtir yasya tat prabaddhākṛti|

adhunā sūcīśastram āha ----
vṛttā gūḍhadṛḍhāḥ pāśe tisraḥ sūcyo 'tra sīvane|
māṃsalānāṃ pradeśānāṃ tryasrā tryaṅgulam āyatā||20||
alpamāṃsāsthisandhisthavraṇānāṃ dvyaṅgulāyatā|
vrīhivaktrā dhanurvaktrā pakvāmāśayamarmasu||21|| sā sārdhadvyaṅgulā-------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. atra-eṣu śastreṣu madhye, sīvane-sīvanaviṣaye, tisraḥ sūcyaḥ syuḥ| kimbhūtāḥ ? vṛttāḥ-vartulāḥ, pāśe gūḍhās tathā dṛḍhāḥ sāratvāt| āsāṃ ca pratyekaṃ saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇa viśeṣopayogam āha- māṃsalānāṃ-bahumāṃsānāṃ, śarīradeśānāṃ tryasrā mukhe sūcī syāt| saṅgrahe 'py avocat (sū.a.34)-"tryasrāgrā" iti| tryasreti cintyam| tathā, tryaṅgulam āyatā-tryaṅguladīrghā| vṛttatvaṃ dṛḍhapāśatvaṃ coktam eva sāmānyalakṣaṇena| alpamāṃsānāṃ vraṇānāṃ sandhyasthisaṃśritānāṃ ca dvyaṅgulam āyatā-dīrghā| vṛttamukhatvaṃ cāsyāḥ sāmānyenoktam| tṛtīyām āha- vrīhimukhā, cāpavat kuṭilā, dairghyeṇa dve 'ṅgule sārdhe syāt| sā ca pakvāśaya āmāśaye marmasu ca vraṇānāṃ sīvane yojyā|
Ā. rā. sūcītrayam āha-vṛttā iti| pāśe-chidrasthāne, gūḍhā dṛḍhāś ca| tatra tryaṅgulāṃ sūcīm āha-māṃsalānām iti| dvyaṅgulāṃ sūcīm āha-alpamāṃseti| sārddhyaṅgulāṃ sūcīm āha-vrīhivakreti|

adhunā kūrcaṃ lilakṣayiṣur āha ---- ------------------------sarvavṛttās tāś caturaṅgulāḥ|
kūrco vṛttaikapīṭhasthāḥ saptāṣṭau vā subandhanāḥ||22||
sa yojyo nīlikāvyaṅgakeśaśāteṣu kuṭṭane| ----------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. tāḥ-sūcyaḥ, sarvato vartulā dairghyeṇa caturaṅgulāḥ kūrca ity ucyate| kimbhūtāḥ ? vṛtta ekasmin pīṭhe saṃsthitāḥ| tathā, saptasaṅkhyā aṣṭau vā| tathā, śobhanaṃ bandhanaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ subandhanāḥ| ata evedaṃ śastraṃ sūcīkūrcasaṃjñaṃ śaṃsanti| tathā cārśaścikitsite jagāda (hṛ. ci. a. 8|29)- "arśobhyo jalajaśśastrasūcīkūrcaiḥ" ity ādi| sa ca-subaddhasaptāṣṭasūcīkaḥ kūrco, nīlikādiṣu ca kuṭṭanaviṣaye yojyaḥ| upalakṣaṇārthatvāc cāsya(sau) śvitrendraluptādiṣv api yojyaḥ|
Ā. rā. kūrcam āha-sarvavṛttā iti| sarvavṛttāḥ-pāśarahitāḥ, tāḥ-sūcyaḥ, vṛtta ekasmin pīṭhe nikhātāḥ|

----------------------------------------------|
ardhāṅgulamukhair vṛttair aṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khajaḥ||23||
pāṇibhyāṃ mathyamānena ghrāṇāt tena hared asṛk| ----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. aṣṭābhiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ khaja ucyate| kīdṛśaiḥ ? ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ mukhaṃ yeṣāṃ taiḥ, tathā vartulaiḥ| tena-khajena, hastābhyāṃ viloḍyamānena, nāsikāto 'straṃ haret|
Ā. rā. khajam āha-arddhāṅgulamukhair iti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
vyadhanaṃ karṇapālīnāṃ yūthikāmukulānanam||24||

div.ab: Sa. karṇapālīnāṃ vyadhane yūthikā nāma śastraṃ syāt| kīdṛśī ? mukulānanā|
Ā. rā. karṇavyadhanam āha-vyadhanam iti|

ārā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā tatpraveśā tathordhvataḥ|
caturasrā, tayā vidhyec chhophaṃ pakvāmasaṃśaye||25||
karṇapālīṃ ca bahalāṃ-----------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. ardhāṅgulapramāṇaṃ vṛttaṃ āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, yasyāḥ sā'rdhāṅgulavṛttāsyā| tathā, sa eva-ardhāṅgulapramāṇaḥ praveśo yasyāḥ sā tatpraveśā| tathordhvata iti vṛttārdhāṅgulād upariṣṭāt tathaiva-ardhāṅgulapramāṇaiva caturasrā syāt| sā ārā nāma śastram| tayā ārayā, śophaṃ vidhyet| kadā ? pakvāmasaṃśaye,-kim ayaṃ pakvaḥ śopha utāma iti sandehe| bahalāṃ ca karṇapalīṃ tayā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. ārām āha-āreti| tatpraveśā-arddhāṅgulapraveśā| ūrdhvataḥ-vṛttān mukhād ūrdhvaṃ, caturasrā| pakvāmasaṃśaye pakvatvāmatvasandehe| bahalāṃ-ghanām|

ab.seg:
-----------------------bahalāyaaś ca śasyate|
sūcī tribhāgasuṣirā tryaṅgulā karṇavedhanī||26||

div.ab: Sa. bahalāyāḥ-atimāṃsalāyāḥ karṇapālyāś ca, sūcī śasyate,-na kevalam ārā| kīdṛśī sūcī ? tribhāgaḥ-prāntabhāgāt suṣiro yasyāḥ saivam| tathā, tryaṅgulā-dairghyeṇa| sā ca karṇavedhanī syāt|
Ā. rā. bahalakarṇapālīvyadhanārthaṃ sūcīm āha-bahalāyāś ceti|

jalaukaḥkṣāradahanakācopalanakhādayaḥ|
alauhāny anuśastrāṇi, tāny evaṃ ca vikalpayet||27||
aparāṇy api yantrādīnv upayogaṃ ca yaugikam| ----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. jalaukaḥprabhṛtayo 'nuśastrāṇi raktasrāvakāryakāraṇāt| tāni cālauhāni-lohavarjitāni| ādiśabdenāyaskāntaśākaśophālikādikharapatrādīnāṃ grahaṇam| evaṃ coktena nyāyenānyāny api yantrādīni vikalpayet| ādiśabdena śastrāṇāṃ grahaṇam| upayogaṃ ca yaugikaṃ-sādhutaraṃ, buddhyā nirūpayet|

Ā. rā. anuśastrāṇy āha-jalauka iti| uktebhyaḥ śastrayantrebhyo 'nyāny api svabuddhyā kalpyānīty āha-tāny evam iti| tāni-śastrānuśastrāṇi, yantrādīni yantrānuyantrāṇi, teśāṃ yogyam upayogaṃ ca, vikalpayet|

----------------------------------------------|
utpāṭyapāṭyasīvyaiṣyalekhyapracchhānakuṭṭanam||28||
chhedyaṃ bhedyaṃ vyadho mantho graho dāhaś ca tatkriyāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. utpāṭyādīni tatkriyāḥ,-teṣāṃ-ṣaḍviṃśatiśastrāṇāṃ, kriyāḥ-karmāṇi, tatkriyāḥ| { tāni ṣaḍviṃśatiśastrāṇi saṅgrahoktāni (sū. a. 34)- "tad yathā-dantalekhanamaṇḍalāgravṛddhipatrotpalapatrādhyardhadhāramudrikākartarīsarpavaktrakarapatrakuśapatrāṭāmukhā-ntarmukhaśarārimukhatrikūrcakūṭhārikāvrīhimukhaśalākāvetasapatrārākarṇavyadhanasūcīsūcīkurcakhajaiṣaṇī-baḍiśanakhaśastrāṇi|" iti| } utpāṭyaṃ-uddhāryam, tatra nakhaśastraṃ prayojyam| pāṭane vṛddhipatrādi| sīvane sūcyaḥ| lekhane maṇḍalāgrādiḥ| pracchāne nakhaśastrādi| kuṭṭane kūrcaḥ| chedane utpalapatrādi| bhedane eṣaṇī sūcīmukhā| vyadhane vetasādi| manthane khajaḥ| grahe sandaṃśaḥ| dāhe śalākādir iti|
Ā. rā. śastradoṣān āha-śastrakāryāṇi gaṇayati-utpāṭyeti| utpāṭhyaṃ-utpāṭanam, bhāve yatpratyayaḥ| evaṃ pāṭhyādiṣu| sīvyaṃ-sīvanam|

śastradośān aha ---- ----------------------------------------------|
kuṇṭhakhaṇḍatanusthūlahrasvadīrghatvavakratāḥ||29||
śastrāṇāṃ kharadhāratvam aṣṭau doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. spaṣṭam
Ā. rā. śastradoṣān āha-kuṇṭhakhaṇḍeti| te ca doṣā anyatra karapatrāt|

ab.seg:
adhunā śastrāṇāṃ grahaṇavidhiṃ darśayati ---- ----------------------------------------------|
chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare||30||

div.ab: Sa. chedabhedanalekhyārthaṃ tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhair militaiḥ śastraṃ vṛntaphalāntare-vṛntaphalamadhyabhāge, gṛhṇīyāt| kīdṛk ? susamāhitaḥ,-tadgatamanāḥ| visrāvaṇakāryāṇi śarāryāsyādīni śastrāṇi vṛntāgre tarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ gṛhṇīyāt| gṛhṇīyād ity anuvartate| talaśabdena pāṇitalam ucyate, ādilopākhyayā tantrayuktyā| talena pracchhannaṃ vṛntāgraṃ yasya tat vrīhimukhaṃ mukhe gṛhṇīyāt| śeṣaṃ śastraṃ kriyāsaukaryato gṛhṇīyāt| sukarasya bhāvaḥ saukaryam| yathā sukarā pāṭanādikā kriyā syāt tathā''dadītety arthaḥ|

Ā. rā. śastrakośam ācaṣṭe-śastradhāraṇavidhim āha-chedabhedaneti| chedanādikarmaṇi vṛntaphalayor madhye tarjanyādibhir militaiḥ śastraṃ gṛhṇīyāt| visrāvaṇe tu tarjanyaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ vṛntāgre gṛhṇīyāt| vrīhimukhaṃ tu pāṇitalena vṛntāgraṃ pracchādya mukhe grāhyam| āhāraṇe tu śastraṃ mūle grāhyam| pāśasyopari madhye laghusandaṃśaḥ kartarī ca| śeṣeṣu tu karmasu yatra gṛhīte kriyāsaukaryaṃ tatra grāhyam|

ab.seg:
śastrakośam ācaṣṭate ----
syān navāṅgulavistāraḥ sughano dvādaśāṅgulaḥ|
kṣau mapatrorṇakauśeyadukūlamṛducarmajaḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. navāṅgulavistāraḥ śastrakośaḥ syāt| tathā, suṣṭhu ghano nibiḍaḥ| tathā, dvādaśāṅgulapramāṇo dairdhyeṇa| tathā, kṣau mādijaḥ| tathā, vinyastaḥ-kṛtaḥ, pāśo yasya sa vinyastapāśaḥ| tathā, suṣṭhu syūtaḥ| tathā, sāntarāṇi-savyavadhānāni, ūrṇāsthāni śastrāṇi yasmin sa sāntarorṇāsthaśastrakaḥ| tathā, śalākayā pihitaṃ-sthagitaṃ, āsyaṃ yasya sa evam| tathā, śobhanaḥ sañcayo yasya sa susañcayaḥ, nāpitabhāṇḍikāvat| tantrāntare coktam "niśānī tu śastrāṇāṃ ślakṣṇā śilikā māṣamudgaprabhā" ity ādi|

Ā. rā. sukumārabālānām astravisrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso nirdidikṣur āha-śastrasthāpanārthaṃ śastrakośam āha-syād iti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 34)-"hasta eva cātra pradhānatamas tadadhīnatvād yantraśastrāṇām| tatra kṣāreṇa pāyitaṃ śastraṃ śaraśalyāsthicchedaneṣu, udakena māṃsacchedane, tailena pāṭanabhedanaśirāvyadhasnāyucchedaneṣu ca prayuñjīta| dhārā punar bhedanānāṃ māsūrī, lekhanānām ardhamāsūrī, vyadhanānāṃ visrāvaṇānāṃ ca kaiśikī, chedanānām ardhakaiśikī| niśānī tu teṣāṃ ślakṣṇā śilikā māṣamudgaprabhā| dhārāsaṃsthāpanaṃ ca śālmalīphalakam| atha yogyā| na cādhikṛtaśāstre 'py akṛtayogyaḥ, yogyā-abhyāsaḥ, subahuśo vā'py adṛṣṭakarmā śastrakarmaṇi pravarteta, śirāsnāyumarmādivyāptatvād dehasya| tasmāt saromacarmapuṣpaphalālābutrapusodakapaṅkapūrṇadṛtibastivadhramāṃsapeśikotpalanālādiṣu yathārham āharaṇādiyogyāṃ kuryāt| tathā ghaṭapārśvasrotasy ambhobhiḥ paripūrṇena netreṇa bastipīḍanayogyām| mṛdumāṃsakhaṇḍeṣv agnikṣārāvacaraṇayogyām| pustamayapuruṣāṅgapratyaṅgeṣu bandhanayogyām| api ca| yuktakārī bhiṣag bubhūṣuḥ puruṣaṃ sampūrṇagātram aviṣahatam adīrghavyādhipīḍitaṃ niṣkṛṣṭāntram avahantyām āpagāyāṃ muñjabalvajaveṣṭitaṃ pañjarastham aprakāśe deśe kothayet| taṃ samyak prakuthitaṃ coddhṛtyāyatadehaṃ kṛtvośīraveṇukūrcādīnām anyatamena śanaiḥ śanair avaghṛṣya tvagādīn sarvān eva vāhyābhyantarān aṅgasirāsrāyvādīn avayavān ācāryopadarśitenāgamena cakṣuṣā ca lakṣayet|
iti śāstreṇa yad dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣataś ca yat|
samāgataṃ tad ubhayaṃ bhūyo jñānaṃ vivardhayet||" iti|

sukumārabālānām asravisrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso yojayet ----
jalaukasas tu sukhināṃ raktasrāvāya yojayet| ----------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. sukhināṃ-sukhocitānāṃ, raktasrāvaṇārthaṃ jalaukaso yojayet| tāś ca dviprakāraaḥ,-saviṣānirviṣāś ca| tatra saviṣāṇāṃ sāpāyatvāt tā eva tāval lakṣayati-
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ viṣayam āha-jalaukasas tv iti|

tāś ca dwiprakārāḥ,- saviṣā nirviṣāś ca| tatra saviṣāṇāṃ sāpāyatvāt tā eva tāval lakṣayati ---- ----------------------------------------------|
duṣṭāmbumatsyabhekāhiśavakothamalodbhavāḥ||35||
raktāḥ śvetā bhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇāś capalāḥ sthūlapicchhilāḥ|
indrāyudhavicitrordhvarājayo romaśāś ca tāḥ||36|| saviṣā varjayet------------------------------| ----------------------------------------------|37|

Sa. duṣṭāmbūdbhavāś ca jalaukasaḥ saviṣā iti varjayet| tathā matsyabhekasarpādiśavakothodbhavāḥ, tathā teṣām eva matsyādīnāṃ ye malāḥ-mūtrapurīṣādayaḥ, tadudbhavāś ca saviṣā iti varjayet| saviṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇam āha-raktā ity ādi| yāval lomaśā yās tāḥ saviṣā yataḥ, tato varjayet-tā na yojayet|
Ā. rā. varjyāṃ jalaukasa āha-duṣṭāmtrviti| duṣṭāmbuni matsyādiśavakothamaleṣu ca jātāḥ|
-------------------------tābhiḥ kaṇḍūpākajvarabhramāḥ| viṣapittāsranut kāryaṃ tatra----------------------|37|
Sa. tābhir hi yojitābhiḥ kaṇḍvādayaḥ syuḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam| dāhaśoṣamūrcchhādayo 'pi syuḥ| { tatra- } tāsu mohād yojitāsu, viṣādijit kāryam|
Ā. rā. varjyāprayoge doṣam āha-tābhir iti| varjyādoṣe cikitsām āha-viṣapittāsranud iti|

Sa. jalaukasa ity anuvartate| śuddhajalodbhavāḥ (śuddhāmbujāḥ)-saugandhikotpalakamalavipulasalilaśaivālajā jalaukaso, nirviṣāḥ syuḥ| āsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam āha-śaivalety ādi| śaivalam iva śyāvāḥ, tathā vṛttāḥ, tathā nīlordhvarājayaḥ, tathā kaṣāyaṃ-nyagrodhādivalkalasadṛśavarṇaṃ, pṛṣṭhaṃ yāsāṃ tā evam, tathā tanuśarīrāḥ kiñcitpītavarṇajaṭharāś ca nirviṣā vedyāḥ|
Ā. rā. grāhyā jalaukasa āha-śuddhāmbusambhavā iti|

lg.l: tā apy asamyagvamanāt pratataṃ ca nipātanāt|
sīdantīḥ salilaṃ prāpya raktamattā iti tyajet||39||

div.ab: Sa. nirviṣā api jalaukaso raktamattā iti tyajet| na kevalaṃ saviṣā iti pratipādanārtho 'piśabdaḥ| raktamattatve hetudvayam āha-asamyagvamanāt, duṣṭaraktasyeti śeṣaḥ| pratataṃ ca lāganāt, duṣṭaraktavāsitvena raktamattā ity uktāḥ| tāś ca kathaṃ lakṣyante ? ity āha-sīdantīr ity ādi| jalaṃ (salilaṃ) prāpya toyapūrṇabhāṇḍam āsādya, sīdantīḥ-na tathā ceṣṭamānāḥ, iti jñātvā tyajet|
Ā. rā. grāhyāsv api mattā varjyā ity āha-tā iti| pratataṃ nipātanāt-aviśramayya prayogāt| sīdantīḥ-śramamatyajantīḥ| raktamattā iti- raktamattatvād dhetoḥ|

lg.l: avantisome takre vā punaś cāśvāsitā jale||40||

div.ab: Sa. atha-parikṣāto 'nantaraṃ, itarā lāgayet| kimbhūtāḥ ? haridrākalkayuktajale pariplutāḥ, kāñjike kālaśeye vā pariplutāḥ, punaś ca jale samāśvāsitāḥ-sātmyabhūte jale plavanārhāḥ sotsāhāḥ satīḥ, yojayet| alagantīḥ kathaṃ lāgayet ? ity āha-ghṛtety ādi| ghṛtādipātanais tā yojayet| pātanaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yojyaḥ| śastreṇāṅge raktaṃ mokṣayitvā vā ta yojayet| tāś ca pibantīḥ sūkṣmavāsasā''cchhādayet| evaṃ hi tāsāṃ makṣikādyanupadravāt samyagyojanā syāt| atha kim etāḥ pibanty uta neti kathaṃ jñāyate ? ity atra viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetum āha-unnataskandhā iti| unnataḥ skandho yāsāṃ tā evam| unnataskandhatvena tāsāṃ pānaṃ jñāyata ity arthaḥ|

Ā. rā. nanu, śuddharaktaduṣṭaraktayor ekalkībhūtatvāt śuddharaktākarṣaṇāj jālaukā doṣāya syaad ity āha-jalaukasāṃ prayogam āha-athetarā iti| itarāḥ-avarjyāḥ| avantisome-kāñjike| ghṛtādyanyatamena pradeśam abhyajya śastreṇa vā pracchāya lāgayet|

lg.l: ādatte prathamaṃ haṃsaḥ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodakād iva||42||

ab.seg:
(gulmārśovidradhīn kuṣṭhavātaraktagalāmayān|
netrarugviṣavīsarpān śamayanti jalaukasaḥ| )||1||

div.ab: Sa. duṣṭaśuddhāsrān militād api jalaukā duṣṭaraktam eva pūrvam ādatte, na śuddhaṃ dehadhātustham, iti dṛṣṭāntena darśayati-haṃsa ity ādi| haṃso yathā kṣīrajalān miśritāt prāg dugdham ādatte na tu jalam, tathā jalaukāḥ prāg śuddhaṃ raktam ādatte paścād itarad iti nyāyyam etat|
Ā. rā. duṣṭaśuddhasamparke jalaukāḥ prathamaṃ duṣṭaṃ pibatīty āha sampṛktād iti|

Sa. daṃśasya tode sati kaṇḍvāṃ satyāṃ vā mokṣayet, śuddharaktarakṣārtham atiyogabhayāc ca| tām ity ekavacananirdeśād ekaikāṃ mokṣayet, na tu sarvāḥ sakṛd eveti gamayati| atha pānalaulyalyādṛśaṃ, - na tyajet tato haridrācūrṇaṃ vā vadane dattvā mokṣayet|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ mokṣaṇakālam āha-daṃśasyeti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------vāmayec ca tām|
paṭutailāktavadanāṃ ślakṣṇakaṇḍanarūṣitām||43||

div.ab: Sa. mokṣitāṃ ca jalaukasaṃ vāmayet| vamanavidhānam āha paṭv ity ādi| saindhavayutena tailena rūṣitāsyāṃ tathā sūkṣmeṇa taṇḍulakaṇḍanena rūṣitāṃ-avakīrṇāṃ, vāmayet| taṇḍulaśabdasyātra lopo jñeyas tantrayuktyā|
Ā. rā. mokṣitānāṃ kṛtyam āha-vāmayed iti| kaṇḍanaṃ tuṣaḥ|
rakṣan raktamadād bhūyaḥ saptāhaṃ tā na pātayet| ----------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. tāḥ-kṛtavamanā jalaukaso, raktamadād rakṣan punaḥ saptāhaṃ na yojayet|
Ā. rā. saptāhād arvāk jalaukasāṃ punaḥprayogaṃ niṣedhati-rakṣann iti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
pūrvavat paṭutā dārḍhyaṃ samyag vānte jalaukasām||44||

div.ab: Sa. jalaukasāṃ samyag vānte sati pūrvavat-alāgitānām iva, paṭutādi bhavati|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ samyagvamanalakṣaṇam āha-pūrvavad iti|
Sa. atiyogād vamanasya klamo mṛtyur vā syāt|
Ā. rā. ativānte lakṣaṇam āha-klama iti|
Sa. durvānte sati stabdhatā madaś ca syāt|
Ā. rā. durvānte lakṣaṇam āha-durvānta iti|

------------------------------------------------------|
anyatrānyatra tāḥ sthāpyā ghaṭe mṛtsnāmbugarbhiṇi||45||
lālādikothanāśārthaṃ, saviṣāḥ syus tadanvayāt| ------------------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. tāś cānyasminn anyasmin ghaṭe tryahāt pañcāhād vā sthāpyāḥ| kimbhūte ? mṛtsnāpṛktena jalena garbhiṇi, tadyukta ity arthaḥ| praśastā mṛt-mṛtsnā, "sasnau praśaṃsāyām" iti snapratyayaḥ| anekabhājanasthāpane ko 'rthaḥ ? ity āha-lālādikothanāśārtham| ādiśabdena mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ grahaṇam| lālādīnāṃ_jalaukaḥsambandhināṃ, kothaḥ-kuthitatvaṃ klinnatā, tannāśāya| tadanvayāt-lālādiyogāt, tāḥ saviṣāḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ pālanavidhim āha-anyatrānyatreti|

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------------|
aśuddhau srāvayed daṃśān haridrāguḍamākṣikaiḥ||46||

div.ab: Sa. aśuddhau-aśuddhaliṅgānumite rakte sati, daṃśān haridrādibhiḥ srāvayet|
Ā. rā. daṃśāparisrāve srāvaṇauṣadham āha-aśuddhāv iti|

Sa. anantaraṃ śatadhautaghṛtasampṛktāḥ picavo 'yojyāḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| śataśabdo 'nekaparyāyaḥ, bahukṛtvo dhautam ity arthaḥ| tathā, śītalā lepāḥ-yaṣṭīcandanośīrādijāḥ, yojyāḥ| daṃśasthitacalitaraktaprasādanāyeti bhāvaḥ|
Ā. rā. daṃśastrāvānantaraṃ kṛtyam āha-śatadhauteti|
Sa. duṣṭaraktasyāpagamanāt-niḥsaraṇāt, sadyo-drāg eva, rāgapīḍāśāntir bhavati| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam| śvayathuśaithilyadāhaśamo 'pi hi bhavaty eva|
Ā. rā. srāvaphalam āha-duṣṭaraktāpagamanād iti|

lg.l: aśuddhaṃ calitaṃ sthānāt sthitaṃ raktaṃ vraṇāśaye|
vyamlībhavet paryuṣitaṃ tasmāt tat srāvayet punaḥ||48||

div.ab: Sa. aśuddhaṃ raktaṃ svāśayaac calitaṃ vraṇasthāne sthitaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sat vyamlībhaved yataḥ, tasmāt tat-raktaṃ, bhūyaḥ srāvayet|
Ā. rā. dvitīye 'hni punaḥ srāvam āha-aśuddham iti| amlībhavet-pākonmukhaṃ bhavet|
Sa. rakte pittena dūṣite sati, alābughaṭikā na lāgayet| tāsāṃ-alābūnāṃ ghaṭikānāṃ ca, agnisaṃyogāt pittaraktakopopapatter iti bhāvaḥ|
Ā. rā. alābudhaghaṭikayor aviṣayam āha-yuñjyān neti|
Sa. tās tu kaphavātena duṣṭe 'sṛji yuñjyāt|
Ā. rā. alābughaṭikayor viṣayam āha-yuñjyāt tv iti|
kaphena duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ na śṛṅgeṇa vinirharet| skannatvāt--------------------------------------|50|
Sa. kaphena duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sat śṛṅgeṇa nākarṣet| skannatvāt styānatvād dhetoḥ| śṛṅgasya cāgnisaṃyogābhāvena kaphavilayane sāmarthyābhāvāt|
Ā. rā. śṛṅgasyāviṣayam āha-kaphena duṣṭam iti|
Sa. vātapittābhyāṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ śṛṅgeṇa nirharet|
Ā. rā. śṛṅgasya viṣayam āha-vātapittābhyām iti|

lg.l: gātraṃ baddhopari dṛḍhaṃ rajjvā paṭṭena vā samam|
na gāḍhaghanatiryagbhir na pade padam ācaran||52||

ab.seg:
pracchaanenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ|
harec chṛṅgādibhiḥ suptam asṛg vyāpi śirāvyadhaiḥ||53||

div.ab: Sa. gātraṃ rajjvā paṭṭena vā dṛḍhaṃ samaṃ baddhopari pracchanīyapradeśasya, tathā snāyvādi pariharan, pracchānaṃ kuryāt| katham ? adhodeśāt pravisṛtaiḥ-pravṛttaiḥ, padair uparigāmibhiḥ-ūrdhvaprasāribhiḥ| kimbhūtaiḥ padaiḥ ? na gāḍhaiḥ-na kharaiḥ, na ghanaiḥ-na nirantaraiḥ, na ca tiryagbhiḥ-tiraścīnaiḥ| tathā, pade padaṃ nācaran-padasyopari padam akurvann ity arthaḥ| ekadeśasthitaṃ raktaṃ pracchānenākarṣet| grathitaṃ granthyarbudādiṣu raktaṃ jalaukābhir apaharet| suptaṃ-niścetanaṃ sat sthāne prasuptyādivikāri, śṛṅgādibhir haret| vyāpi-sarvaśarīrasya, lohitaṃ śirāvyadhair ākarṣet|

Ā. rā. pracchānavidhim āha-gātram iti| padaiḥ-śastrakṛtaiḥ| adhodeśapravisṛtaiḥ-adhastād ākṛṣṭaśastrair adhodeśam ārabhyordhvam ūrdhvaṃ kriyamāṇaiḥ| pracchānasya viṣayam āha-pracchāneneti| jalaukasāṃ viṣayam āha-grathitam iti| grathitaṃ-granthībhūtam| śṛṅgālābughaṭikānāṃ viṣayam āha-śṛṅgādibhir iti| suptaṃ ajñātasparśam| śirāvyadhasya viṣayam āha-vyāpīti| vyāpi-sarvadehastham|
Sa. piṇḍite rakte pracchhānaṃ vā syāt|
Ā. rā. pracchānasya viṣayāntaram āha-pracchānam iti| piṇḍite-ghane|
Sa. avagāḍhe rakte jalaukasaḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. jalaukasāṃ viṣayāntaram āha-avagāḍha iti| avagāḍhe-gambhīre|
Sa. tvaksthe-uttāne rakte, alābughaṭīśṛṅgāṇi syuḥ|
Ā. rā. alābvādīnāṃ viṣayāntaram āha-tvakstha iti|
Sa. sarvaśarīravyāpake rakte śiraiva bhavati| śirāyāṃ matavikalpo nāsty evety evaśabdārthaḥ|
Ā. rā. śirāvyadhasya niyatatvam āha-śiraiveti|
Sa. athavā vātādisthānasthitaṃ raktaṃ yathākramaṃ śṛṅgādibhir haret|
Ā. rā. śṛṅgādīnāṃ viṣayāntarāṇy āha-vātādidhāmeti|

stratāsṛjaḥ pradehādyaiḥ śītaiḥ syād vāyukopataḥ|55|
satodakaṇḍūḥ śophas taṃ sarpiṣoṣṇena secayet| 55 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastravi- dhir nāma ṣaṅviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|26|

Sa. srutaraktasya narasya śītalaiḥ pralepādibhisthodakaṇḍūyutaḥ śopho vātakopāt syāt| taṃ-tādṛśaṃ śophaṃ, ghṛtenoṣṇena secayed iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkā- yāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śastravidhir nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 26||

Ā. rā. srutaraktasya śītopacārātiśaye doṣam āha srutāsṛja iti| uktadoṣe pratīkāram āha-tam iti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 35)-"sarvāsāṃ ca paraṃ pramāṇam aṣṭādaśāṅgulāni| tatra catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṅgulā nṛṣu yojayet| gajavājiṣv aparāḥ| tāsu sukumārās tanutvaco 'lpaśiraskā bṛhadadharakāyāś ca striyaḥ| viparītāḥ pumāṃso 'rddhacandrākṛtipurovṛttāś ca| tatra bahudoṣeṣu cirotthiteśu cāmayeṣu pumāṃso yojayitavyāḥ| striyo viparīteṣu| jalaukasas tv ārdracarmādyupāyair gṛhītvā surabhipaṅkagarbhe nave ghaṭe sthāpayet| śṛṅgāṭakakaserukaśālūkaśaivālamṛṇālavallūramṛtsrāpuṣkarabījacūrṇaṃ svāduśītaṃ svacchaṃ ca toyam annapānārthe tābhyo dadyāt| lālādikothaparihārartham eva ca tryahān tryahāt purvam annapānam apanīyānyad dadyāt| pañcāhāc ca tadvidha eva ghaṭāntare tāḥ sañcārayet|" iti|
iti hemādriṭīkāyām āyurvedarasāyane|
śastraprakaraṇaṃ nāma sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 26||

div.head: sirāvyadhavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. anantarātīte 'dhyāye śṛṅgādīn lohitāvasecanopāyān uktvā 'pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ' ity ādivākyena teṣāṃ viṣayo darśitaḥ| sirāvyadhasya tu bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthag adhyāyau yukta ity āha-
athātaḥ sirāvyadhavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. saraty ābhī raktam iti sirāḥ, tāsāṃ vyadhaḥ, tasya vidhiḥ, tam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

Ā. rā. śirāvyadhavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte-atheti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 36)-"bahavo hi raktāvasecanopāyāḥ prāg abhihitāḥ| teṣām anyeṣāṃ ca virekādīnām upakramāṇāṃ tatsādhyeṣv āmayeṣu śirāvyadhaḥ pradhānam| amunā hi te samūlāḥ śoṣam āyānti kedārasetubhedena śālyādaya iva| tathā ca|
śirāvyadhaś chikitsārdhaṃ sampūrṇaṃ vā cikitsitam|
śalyatantre smṛto yadvad bastiḥ kāyacikitsite||
yathā raktam adhiṣṭhānaṃ vikārāṇāṃ vikāriṇām|
anyan na hi tathā dūṣyaṃ karmedaṃ prathamaṃ tataḥ|| tatrāmbu śārīram āhārasārabhūtaṃ rasākhyam avikṛtam avikṛtena tejasā rañjitaṃ raktam āhuḥ|" iti|

madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ kiñcid aśītoṣṇam asaṃhatam|
padmendragopahemāviśaśalohitalohitam||1||
lohitaṃ prabhavaḥ śuddhaṃ, tanos tenaiva ca sthitiḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|2|

Sa. lohitaṃ madhuraguṇaṃ(rasaṃ) , tathā, īṣallavaṇaṃ, kiñcicchabda īṣadarthe, tathā'śītoṣṇaṃ-nañ īṣadarthe, īṣacchītam īṣaduṣṇaṃ, tathā'saṃhataṃ-dravaṃ, śuddhaṃ syāt| samprati varṇataḥ śuddhalohitalakṣaṇam āha-padmety ādi| indragopaḥ-mṛganakṣatrotpannaḥ kīṭakaviśeṣaḥ| hema-kanakam| aviḥ-meṣaḥ| aviśaśayor lohitaśabdena raktavācinā sambandhaḥ| padmādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ| padmendragopahemāviśaśalohitam iva lohitaṃ-raktavarṇaṃ, yad raktaṃ tac chuddhaṃ syāt| tac ca tanoḥ-śarīrasya, prabhavaḥ-utpattihetuḥ| tenaiva raktena, tanoḥ sthitiḥ-prabandhāvicchedalakṣaṇā| anekadṛṣṭāntopādānaṃ ca śuddharaktasyānekavarṇadarśanāt|

Ā. rā. śuddharaktasya lakṣaṇam āha-madhuram iti| asaṃhataṃ-dravam| hemā-mañjiṣṭhā| śuddharaktasyārogyahetutvam āha-tanor iti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 36) "tathā dūṣyam| doṣam iti kecit| ubhayātmakam anye| tac caivaṃvidham eva vidhivad āhāravihārābhyāsād viśuddhaṃ balavarṇasukhāyuṣāṃ yoniḥ|" iti|

Sa. tac ca-raktaṃ, bāhulyena pittaśleṣmalair dūṣyate| pittalaiḥ-kṣāroṣṇatīkṣṇādibhiḥ| śleṣmalaiḥ-māṣatilādibhiḥ| tathā purākṛtād daivād api, śaratkālasvabhāvāt kadācid vātalair api dūṣyata iti prāyograhaṇam|
Ā. rā. raktasya duṣṭikāraṇam āha-tat pittaśleṣmalair iti|

-------------------------------------------------| ------------------------------------kurute tataḥ||2||
visarpavidradhiplīhagulmāgnisadanajvarān|
mukhanetraśirorogamadatṛḍlavaṇāsyatāḥ||3||
kuṣṭhavātāsrapittāsrakaṭvamlodgiraṇabhramān|
śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyair ūpakrāntāś ca ye gadāḥ||4||
samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti te ca raktaprakopajāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. tato-dūṣaṇāt kāraṇāt, visarpādīn bhramāntān kurute| tathā, śītoṣṇādibhiḥ samyak cikitsitāḥ sādhyā api rogā ye na sidhyanti, te ca raktaprakopajāḥ| na kevalaṃ visarpādayaḥ, iti cārthaḥ| ādiśabdena stambhasvedanādiparigrahaḥ|
Ā. rā. duṣṭaraktasya kāryam āha-kuruta iti| duṣṭaraktakāryasya sāmānyalakṣaṇam āha-śītoṣṇeti| cakāradbayakaraṇād ukteṣv anukteṣu cedaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
teṣu srāvayituṃ raktam udriktaṃ vyadhayet sirām||5||

div.ab: Sa. tathā, teṣu-visarpādiṣu rogeṣu, ulbaṇaṃ raktaṃ srāvayitaṃ sirāṃ vyadhayet| adantatvād atra vṛddher abhāvaḥ|
Ā. rā. duṣṭaraktakāryasya pratīkāram āha-teṣv iti|

na tūnaṣoḍaśātītasaptatyabdasrutāsṛjām|
asnigdhāsveditātyarthasveditānilarogiṇām||6||
garbhiṇīsūtikājīrṇapittāsraśvāsakāsinām|
atīsārodaracchardipāṇḍusarvāṅgaśophinām||7||
snehapīte prayukteṣu tathā pañcasu karmasu|
nāyantritāṃ sirāṃ vidhyen na tiryaṅgāpy anutthitām||8||
nātiśītoṣṇavātābhreṣv anyatrātyayikād gadāt| -------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣādīnāṃ tu sirāṃ na vyadhayet| snehapīte-pītasneha ity arthaḥ, āhitāgnyāditvāt paranipātaḥ| tathā, pañcasu-vamanādiṣu, karmasu vihiteṣu satsu, sirāṃ na vyadhayet| tathā, ayantritāṃ-abaddhāṃ, sirāṃ na vyadhayet| tathā, na tiryak, na cānutthitāṃ, nātiśīte, nātyuṣṇe, nātivāte, na ca meghodaye, sirāṃ vyadhayet| ātyayikāt-rohiṇīviṣādikāt, anyatra na vyadhayet| ātyayike tu roge śītoṣṇavṛṣṭīnāṃ yathāyathaṃ pratīkāraṃ vidhāya sirāṃ mokṣayed eva|

Ā. rā. ūnaṣoḍaśābdādīnāṃ śirāvyadhaṃ niṣedhati-na tūneti| pañcasu karmasu-vamanavirecananirūhānuvāsananasyeṣu| vamanādau snehapāne yāvat tatkṛtadoṣakṣobha(bhā)nivṛttis tāvan niṣedhaḥ| ayantritāṃ-akṛtavakṣyamāṇayantraṇām| tiryak-tiryaggatām| anutthitāṃ-aprakaṭām| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.36)-"tatra snehapītādiṣu samyag viddhā api śirā na sravanty atisravanti vā| samyak snigdhasvinnasya punar dravībhūtā doṣāḥ śoṇitam anupraviṣṭāḥ samyak pracyavante| na tv eṣa niṣedho viṣasaṃsṛṣṭopasargātyayikavyādhiṣu|" iti|
Sa. śironayanavikāreṣu lalāṭyāṃ sirāṃ mokṣayet| lalāṭe bhavā-lalāṭyā, śarīrāvayavād yat, evam agre 'pi| apāṅge bhavāṃ apāṅgyāṃ, nāsikāsamīpe bhavāṃ-upanāsyāṃ, vā|
Ā. rā. śiroroge netraroge ca vedhyāḥ śirā āha-śironetravikāreṣv iti| lalāṭe bhavā lalāṭyāḥ| "śarīrāvayavād yat" iti yat| evam apāṅgyā upanāsyāḥ [ca]| upanāsyāḥ-kanīnikābhavāḥ (?)|
Sa. karṇāmayeṣu karṇajāṃ-karṇasamīpabhavāṃ, sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. karṇarogeṣu śirā āha-karṇarogeṣv iti|
Sa. nāsāmayeṣu nāsāgre sthitāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. nāsārogeṣu śirā āha-nāsārogeṣv iti|
Sa. pīnase-pratiśyāye, nāsālalāṭamadhyasthāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. pīnase śirā āha-nāsālalāṭayor iti|
Sa. mukharogeṣu jihvādigāḥ sirā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. mukharogeṣu śirā āha-mukharogeṣv iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
jatrūrdhvagranthiṣu grīvākarṇaśaṅkhaśiraḥśritāḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. jatrūrdhvaṃ-vakṣoṃsayoḥ sandhyūrdhvaṃ, ye granthayas teṣu grīvādyāśritāḥ sirā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. jatrūrdhvagranthiṣu śirā āha-jatrūrdhvagranthiṣv iti|
Sa. unmāde uraḥsthā apāṅgasthā lalāṭāśritāś ca vidhyet|
Ā. rā. unmāde śirā āha-uropāṅgalalāṭasthā iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------'pasmṛtau punaḥ|
hanusandhau samaste vā śirāṃ bhrūmadhyagāminīm||12||

div.ab: Sa. apasmāre tu hanusandhau sthitāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet| samaste-sarvasmin, vā hanau sirāṃ vidhyet| bhrūmadhyagāminīṃ- bhrūmadhyasthāṃ, sirāṃ vā'parasmṛtau vidhyed iti vāśabdo 'trānuvartya yojyaḥ|
Ā. rā. apasmāre śirā āha-apasmṛtāv iti| ukteṣu śirorogādiṣu samānyataḥ śirā āha-samaste veti|
vidradhau pārśvaśūle ca pārśvakakṣāstanāntare| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. vidradhau pārśvaśūle ca pārśvasthāḥ kakṣāsthāḥ stanāntarasthāś ca sirā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. vidradhipārśvaśūlayoḥ śirā āha-vidradhāv iti|
Sa. tṛtīyake jvareṃ'sayor madhye-skandhasandhau sthitāṃ sirāṃ, vidhyet|
Ā. rā. tṛtīyakajvare śirā āha-tṛtīyaka iti|
Sa. caturthake jvare skandhasyādhogatāṃ-anyatarapārśvāśrayāṃ, sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. caturthakajvare śirā āha-skandhasyādha iti|
pravāhikāyāṃ śūlinyāṃ śroṇito dvyaṅgule sthitāṃ| ---------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. pravāhikāyāṃ śūlayuktāyāṃ śroṇitaḥ-kaṭhyāḥ, dvyaṅgule sthitāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. saśūlapravāhikāyāṃ śirā āha-pravāhikāyām iti|
Sa. śukraroge meḍhraroge ca meḍrasthitāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. śukraroge meḍhraroge ca śirā āha-śukrameḍhrāmaya iti|
Sa. galagaṇḍayoś cobhayor ūrusthāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. galagaṇḍamālayoḥ śirā āha-ūrugām iti| dvivacanasāmarthyāt gaṇḍamālāgrahaṇam|
gṛdhrasyāṃ jānuno 'dhastād ūrdhvaṃ vā caturaṅgule| -------------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. gṛdhrasyāṃ jānuno 'dhastāc caturaṅgula ūrdhvaṃ vā jānunaś caturaṅgule sthitāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. gṛdhrasyāṃ śirā āha-gṛdhrasyām iti|
Sa. apacīsaṃjñe roge indrabaster adho dvyaṅgule sirāṃ vidhyet| indrabastiḥ-jaṅghāntare vakṣyamāṇaḥ (hṛ. śā. a. 4|5)
Ā. rā. apacyāṃ śirā āha-indrabaster iti| indrabastiḥ-jaṅghāmadhye marma|
Sa. sakthipīḍāyāṃ gulphasyordhvaṃ caturaṅgule sirāṃ vidhyet| kroṣṭukaśīrṣākhye vātarogaviśeṣe gulphasyordhvaṃ caturaṅgule vidhyet|
Ā. rā. sakthiśūle kroṣṭukaśīrṣake ca śirā āha-caturaṅgula iti|

-------------------------------------------------|
pādadāhe khuḍe harṣe vipādyāṃ vātakaṇṭake||16||
cippe ca dvyaṅgule vidhyed upari kṣipramarmaṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. pādadāhādiṣu kṣipramamarṇa upari dvyaṅgule vidhyet| khuḍaṃ-vātaraktam|

Ā. rā. pādadāhādiṣu ṣaṭsu śirā āha-pādadāha iti| harṣe-pādaharṣe| cippe-nakharoge| kṣipraṃ-aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimadhye marma| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.36)-"etenetarasakthibāhū ca vyākhyātau| viśeṣatas tu vāmabāhāv abhyantarato bāhumadhye plīhodare| evam eva ca dakṣiṇabāhau yakṛdākhye| tathā kāsaśvāsayor apy ādiśanti|" iti|
Sa. viśvācyāṃ gṛdhrasīproktāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet| "gṛdhrasyāṃ jānuno 'dhastāt " iti|
Ā. rā. viśvācyāṃ śirā āha-gṛdhrasyām iveti| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a.36)-"bāhuśoṣāvabāhukayor apy eke|" iti|
Sa. yathoktānāṃ sirāṇām adarśane sati marmavarjite yathāsanne sthāne vyādhivaśād aparāṃ vyadhayet|
Ā. rā. yathoktaśirāṇām adarśane tadāsannā śirā vedhyā ity āha-yathoktānām iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
atha snigdhatanuḥ sajjasarvopakaraṇo balī||18||

lg.l: pṛṣṭhato yantrayec cainaṃ vastram āveṣṭayan naraḥ||21||

div.ab: Sa. athety ānantarye| snigdhā tanur yasya sa snigdhatanuḥ| tathā, sajjāni-praguṇāni, { sarvāṇi } upakaraṇāni-vastraṣaṇḍapaṭodakasnehagairikādīni, yasya sa sajjasarvopakaraṇaḥ| tathā, balī puṣṭaḥ| tathā, kṛtaṃ svastyayanaṃ-balimaṅgalahomādikaṃ, yasya sa kṛtasvastyayanaḥ| tathā, snigdharasayuktenānnena pratibhojitaḥ| tathā, agnitāpaś cātapaś ca, tābhyāṃ svinnaḥ| tathā, jānutulye uccāsane, saṃsthitaḥ-samupaviṣṭaḥ| tathā, mṛdunā-sūkṣmeṇa, vastrapaṭṭenātto-gṛhīto baddhaḥ keśānto yasya sa evam| tathā, jānunoḥ sthāpitau kūrparau yena sa evam| tathā, muṣṭibhyāṃ vastragarbhābhyāṃ manye 'tiśayena pīḍayet| tathā, dantaprapīḍanādīny ācaret| enaṃ cāturaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe vasanam āveṣṭayan naro yantrayet| katham ? grīvāyāṃ vastraṃ parikṣipya, tathā'ntaḥ-madhye, vāmatarjanīṃ nyasya| sirāṇāṃ yantraṇa eṣa vidhiḥ-etadvidhānam| kimbhūtānām ? antarmukhavarjyānām|

Ā. rā. śirāvyadhavidhim āha-atheti| alpaṃ snigdhaṃ rasānnaṃ-snigdharasānnaprati| "suppratinā mātrārthe" ityvyayībhāvaḥ| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 36)-"vyādhibalasātmyādy apekṣya snigdhaṃ jāṅgalarasaṃ yavāgūṃ vā pāyayitvā muhūrtamātram āśvāsitaṃ pūrvāhṇe 'parāhṇe vā|" iti|
tato madhyamayā'ṅgulyā vaidyo 'ṅguṣṭhavimuktayā| tāḍayet--------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. tato-yantraṇādanantaraṃ, vaidyo 'ṅguṣṭhavimuktayā vāmapāṇijayā madhyamayā'ṅgulyā tāḍayet|
Ā. rā. śirotthāpanavidhim āha-tata iti|

-------------------------------------------------| -----------utthitāṃ jñātvā sparśād vā'ṅguṣṭhapīḍanaiḥ||23||
kuṭhāryā lakṣayen madhye vāmahastagṛhītayā|
phaloddeśe suniṣkampaṃ sirāṃ, tadvac ca mokṣayet||24||
tāḍayan pīḍayaṃś caināṃ-----------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|25|

Sa. sparśena tathā'ṅguṣṭhapīḍanair votthitāṃ jñātvā, ūrdhvadaṇḍasirāyā madhye nyasya phaloddeśe suniṣkampaṃ vāmahastagṛhītayā kuṭhāryā sirāṃ lakṣayet| tadvac ca mokṣayet| yathaiva lakṣayet tathaivety arthaḥ| vrīhimukhena punas tāḍayan-vyathayan, tathā'ṅguṣṭhādinā pīḍayan, enāṃ-kuṭhārikāviṣayajāṃ sirāṃ, vidhyet| nanu, kuṭhārikāviṣaye kathaṃ vrīhivaktrasya prayogaḥ ? yataḥ 'apavādaviṣayaṃ parihṛtyotsargaḥ pravartate' iti nyāyāt vrīhivaktrasyaiva sāmānyena prayogo 'nujñātaḥ| tathā cāha (hṛ. sū. a. 26|11)- "vrīhivaktraṃ prayojyaṃ ca tat sirodarayor vyadhe|" iti| kuṭhāryāḥ punar viśeṣo 'bhihitaḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 26|12)-"tayordhvadaṇḍayāvidhyed upary asthnāṃ sthitāṃ śirām|" iti| tasmād ayuktam etat| atrocyate jñāpakam| kuṭhārikāviṣaye vrīhivaktrasya prayogo nyāyya eva| yad ayam ācāryo vakṣyati (ślo.33)-"māṃsale nikṣiped deśe vrīhāsyaṃ vrīhimātrakam|" iti| anena hi vacanena granthakāra idaṃ pratyapādayat,- bahumāṃse śarīrāvayave vrīhimukhaṃ vrīhimātraṃ nikṣepyam, anyatra tv āśayānurodhena vrīhivaktrasya prayogaḥ kārya iti| anenaivābhiprāyeṇa śāstrakṛtā "pramāṇaparimāṇābhyāṃ saṅkhyāyāś cāpi saṃśaye mātrac vaktavyaḥ ity anena mātrac kṛtaḥ| anyathā tu spaṣṭaṃ kṛtvā "vrīhipramāṇaṃ vrīhyāsyaṃ māṃsale nikṣiped vyadhe|" iti pāṭhaṃ kuryāt| tasmād yukto vrīhimukhasya kuṭhārikāviṣaye prayoga iti|

Ā. rā. śirālakṣīkaraṇavidhim āha-utthitām iti| utthitāṃ-spandamānāṃ, sparśena jñātvā| gambhīrāṃ tv aṅguṣṭhapīḍanena jñātvā| phaloddeśe vāmena hastena suniṣkampaṃ gṛhītayā kuṭhāryā madhye lakṣayet| śirāmokṣaṇavidhim āha-tadvad iti| enāṃ-kuṭhārikāṃ, aṅguṣṭagṛhītayā madhyamāṅgulyā tāḍayan, aṅguṣṭhodareṇa vā pīḍayan, śirāṃ mokṣayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------vidhyed vrīhimukhena tu|
aṅguṣṭhenonnamayyāgre nāsikām upanāsikām||25||

div.ab: Sa. agre-agradeśe, nāsikām aṅguṣṭhenonnamayya, upanāsikāṃ- nāsikāsannadeśasthāṃ sirāṃ, vidhyet|
Ā. rā. upanāsikāyā vyadhanam āha-vidhyed iti|
abhyunnatavidaṣṭāgrajihvasyādhas tadāśrayām| -------------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. ābhimukhyenonnatā-upari tāludeśe nītā, tathā viśeṣeṇa dantair daṣṭā-vidaṣṭā, agre jihvā-agrajihvā, yenāsāv abhyunnatavidaṣṭāgrajihvaḥ, tasyādhaḥ-prakṛtatvāj jihvāyā evādhastāt, tadāśrayāṃ-jihvādhaḥsthāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet| tad ity anena jihvādhaḥ parāmṛśyate| jihvādha āśrayo yasyāḥ siRrāyāḥ, tām|
Ā. rā. jihvādhaḥ śirāvyadhanam āha-abhyunnateti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
yantrayet stanayor ūrdhvaṃ grīvāśritasirāvyadhe||26||

div.ab: Sa. grīvāśritānāṃ sirāṇāṃ vyadho-grīvāśritasirāvyadhaḥ, tasmin stanayor ūrdhvaṃ yantrayet-vāsasā veṣṭayet|
Ā. rā. grīvāśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-yantrayed iti|

Sa. pāṣāṇagarbhau hastau yasya, tasya narasya bhuje jānusthe-jānupṛṣṭhasthite, prasṛte-prasārite| 'bhuje' ity ekavacanam atantram, dvāv api hi bhujau gṛhyete| kukṣer ārabhya yāvadgrīvaṃ tāvan mṛdite- malite| kasmin ? grīvāśritasirāvyardhārhe 'ṅge| tathā baddha ūrdhvaṃ paṭṭako yasmiṃs tasmin vidhyet| prakṛtatvāt sirām|
Ā. rā. bhujaśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-pāṣāṇagarbhahastasyeti|

vidhyed dhastaśirāṃ bāhāv anākuñcitakūrpare|
baddhvā sukhopaviṣṭasya muṣṭim aṅguṣṭhagārbhiṇam||28||
ūrdhvaṃ vedhyapradeśāc ca paṭṭikāṃ caturaṅgule| -------------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. hastasirāṃ vidhyet| katham ? bāhāv anākuñcitakūrpare,-anākuñcitaḥ-prasāritaḥ, kūrparo yasya bāhos tasmin| tathā, sukhopaviṣṭasya-sukhāsīnasya| tathā, muṣṭiṃ baddhvā| kimbhūtam ? aṅguṣṭhena garbhiṇaṃ-aṅguṣṭhagarbhiṇam| gūḍhāṅguṣṭhaṃ muṣṭiṃ baddhvety arthaḥ| tathā, vedhyasthānād upari caturaṅgulaparimāṇe sthāne paṭṭikāṃ baddhvā vidhyet|
Ā. rā. hastaśirāṇāṃ yantraṇavidhim āha-vidhyed iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
vidhyed ālambamānasya bāhubhyāṃ pārśvayoḥ sirām||29||

div.ab: Sa. bāhubhyām ālambamānasya-avalambyaṃ vastu bhujābhyām āsajataḥ pārśvayoḥ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. pārśvaśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-vidhyed iti|
Sa. prahṛṣṭe-stabdhe, meḍhre tadāśritāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. meḍhraśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-prahṛṣṭa iti|
Sa. jānuny akuñcite spaṣṭe sthite sati, jaṅghāyāṃ sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. jaṅghāśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-jaṅghāśirām iti|

-------------------------------------------------|
pāde tu susthite 'dhastāj jānusandher nipīḍite||30||
gāḍhaṃ karābhyām āgulphaṃ caraṇe tasya copari|
dvitīye kuñcite kiñcid ārūḍhe hastavat tataḥ||31|| baddhvā vidhyet sirām----------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. sukhaṃ kṛtvā bhūmyādideśe sthite pāde sati pādasirāṃ vidhyet| tathā jānusandher adhastād āgulphaṃ-gulphaṃ yāvat, karābhyāṃ gāḍhaṃ kṛtvā pīḍite sati, tasya caraṇasyopari-upariṣṭāt dvitīye caraṇa īṣatsaṅkucite, tathā ārūḍhe-tatkalite sati, tato hastavat-vedhyasthānād upari caturaṅgule paṭṭikāṃ, baddhvā sirāṃ vidhyet|
Ā. rā. pādaśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-pāde tv iti| hastavad vedhyapradeśād ūrdhvaṃ caturaṅgule paṭṭikāṃ baddhvā|

ab.seg:
--------------------ittham anukteṣv api kalpayet|
teṣu teṣu pradeśeṣu tattadyantram upāyavit||32||

div.ab: Sa. itthaṃ-anena prakāreṇa yantralakṣaṇoddeśena, anuktam api yantraṃ tattaddeśamāhātmyāt kriyāsaukaryārthaṃ teṣu teṣu śarīrāvayaveṣu svabuddhyā tattadyantraṃ yathāyogaṃ kalpayet, upāyajño vaidyaḥ|
Ā. rā. anuktaśirāṇāṃ yantraṇam āha-ittham iti|

lg.l: yavārdham asthnām upari sirāṃ vidhyan kuṭhārikām||33||

div.ab: Sa. māṃsale śarīrāvayave vrīhimukhaṃ śastraṃ vrīhipramāṇaṃ nikṣipet| asthnām upari kuṭhārikāṃ yavārdhamātrāṃ nikṣipet| kiṃ kurvan ? sirāṃ vidhyan|
Ā. rā. vrīhimukhasya nikhananam āha-māṃsala iti| kuṭhārikāyā nikhananam āha-yavārdham iti|
samyag viddhā sraved dhārāṃ yantre mukte tu na sravet| -------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. samyag viddhe sati(dvā satī) dhārāṃ sravet| yantre ca mukte sati na sravet|
Ā. rā. samyagviddhālakṣaṇam āha-samyag viddha iti|

-------------------------------------------------|
alpakālaṃ vahaty alpaṃ, durviddhā tailacūrṇanaiḥ||34||
saśabdam atividdhā tu sraved duḥkhena dhāryate| -------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. alpaṃ viddhā satī sirā stokaṃ kālaṃ vahati| durviddhā-asamyagviddhā satī, sirā tailayuktaiś cūrṇanaiḥ sravet| atividdhā tu sirā saśabdaṃ sravet| duḥkhena-kṛcchreṇa dhāryate|
Ā. rā. durviddhālakṣaṇam āha-alpakālam iti| tailacūrṇenaiḥ-tailakṣārasecanaiḥ| atividdhālakṣaṇam āha-saśabdam iti|

-------------------------------------------------|
bhīmūrcchāyantraśaithilyakuṇṭhaśastrātitṛptayaḥ||35||
kṣāmatvavegitāsvedā raktasyāsrutihetavaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. bhīmūrchādayo raktasyāsravaṇahetavaḥ| bhīḥ-bhayam| mūrcchā-mohas tamasīva praveśaḥ| yantraśaithilyam-agāḍhaṃ kṛtvā yantrapīḍanam| tathā, kuṇṭhaṃ-bhagnaṃ śastram| tathā, atitṛptiḥ-atisauhityam| kṣāmatvaṃ-nirbalatā| vegitā-sañjātavegatvam| asvedaḥ-svedāyogaḥ| yataś caite rudhirasyāsrutihetavas tato raktasrutāv ete parihāryāḥ|
Ā. rā. raktāvarodhakāraṇāny āha-bhīmūrccheti| vegitā-mūtritatvādiḥ| asvedo-asamyaksvedaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
asamyag astre sravati vellavyoṣaniṣānataiḥ||36||
sāgāradhūmalavaṇatailair dihyāc chirāmukham| -------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. asamyag astre sravati vellādibhiḥ sirāvadanaṃ dihyāt pralepayet|
Ā. rā. samyaksrāvārtham auṣadham āha-asamyag asra iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
samyak pravṛtte koṣṇena tailena lavaṇena ca||37||

div.ab: Sa. samyak pravṛtte rakte sirāmukhaṃ koṣṇābhyāṃ tailalavaṇābhyāṃ dihyāt|
Ā. rā. samyaksrāvanirvāhārtham auṣadham āha-samyak pravṛtta iti| dihyād ity anuṣajyate|
agre sravati duṣṭāsraṃ kusumbhād iva pītikā| -------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. yathā rāgapītikāmiśrībhūtāt kusumbhād agre-pūrvaṃ, pītikā sravati, evaṃ duṣṭāduṣṭaraktād ekalolībhūtāt pūrvaṃ duṣṭam asraṃ sravati|
Ā. rā. agragrahaṇāt paścād aduṣṭam api raktam avaśyaṃ sravatīty āśaṅkyedam āha-svabhāvād duṣṭāsram evāgre śirāḥ sravantīty āha agra iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
samyak srutvā svayaṃ tiṣṭhec chuddhaṃ tad iti nāharet||38||

div.ab: Sa. yathāvat prasrutya svayaṃ-yatnena vinā, yat tiṣṭhet-na sravet, śuddhaṃ tad iti nāharet-na srāvayet, jīvitahetutvāt|
Ā. rā. samyak srutvā yat svayaṃ sthitaṃ raktaṃ tac chuddhatvān nāhared ity āha-samyak srutveti|

lg.l: yantraṃ vimucya mūrcchāyāṃ vījite vyajanaiḥ punaḥ|
srāvayen mūrcchati punas tv aparedyus tryahe 'pi vā||39||

div.ab: Sa. mūrcchāyāṃ satyāṃ yantraṃ vimucya vyajanair vījite-samāśvaste nare sati, punar asraṃ srāvayet| punar mūrcchati tv āture 'śuddham api raktaṃ tasminn ahani na srāvayet| kadā tarhi srāvayet ? ity āha-aparedyuḥ,-anyasmin dine, tryahe 'pi vā-tṛtīye vā'hni, srāvayet|
Ā. rā. mūrcchāyāṃ pratīkāram āha-yantram iti| punar mūrcchāyām aparadinādau srāvayed ity āha-srāvayed iti|
vātāc chyāvāruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ vegasrāvy acchaphenilam| -------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. vātāt śyāvādilakṣaṇaṃ raktaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. vātaduṣṭaraktasya lakṣaṇam āha-vātād iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
pittāt pītāsitaṃ visram askandy auṣṇyāt sacandrikam||40||

div.ab: Sa. pittāt pītādilakṣaṇam asraṃ syāt| askandi-astyānam, uṣṇatvāt| sacandrikaṃ ca|
Ā. rā. pittaduṣṭaraktasya lakṣaṇam āha-pittād iti| auṣṇyād askandi-ghanībhāvarahitam|
kaphāt snigdham asṛk pāṇḍu tantumat picchhilaṃ ghanam| -------------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. kaphāt snigdhādilakṣaṇam asṛk syāt|
Ā. rā. kaphaduṣṭaraktasya lakṣaṇam āha-kaphād iti| ghanaṃ srāvarahitam|
Sa. saṃsargād doṣāṇāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ raktaṃ syāt|
Ā. rā. dvandvaduṣṭaraktasya lakṣaṇam āha-saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgam iti|
Sa. tridoṣaraktaṃ malinaṃ-kaluṣaṃ, āvilaṃ-ghanaṃ ca| etac ca doṣatrayasaṃsargalakṣaṇād adhikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mantavyam| na caitāvad eva tridoṣalakṣaṇaṃ mantavyam|

Ā. rā. tridoṣaduṣṭaraktasya lakṣaṇam āha-tridoṣam iti| malinaṃ-nīlam| āvilaṃ-kaluṣam| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 36)-"kaṣāyarasaṃ lohagandhi śītaṃ ca raktaṃ vātāt| gṛhadhūmāñjanodakakṛṣṇaṃ haritaṃ matsyagandhi kaṭutvān makṣikāniṣṭhaṃ gomūtrābhaṃ ca pittāt| kovidārapuṣpagairikodakapāṇḍu śītaṃ skandi vraṇadvārā vasādilavaṇarasaṃ vasāgandhi ca kaphāt| kāṃsyanīlaṃ durgandhi ca sannipātāt|" iti|

lg.l: aśuddhau balino 'py asraṃ na prasthāt srāvayet param|
atisrutau hi mṛtyuḥ syād dāruṇā vā calāmayāḥ||42||

div.ab: Sa. aśuddham asraṃ balino 'pi-kiṃ punar abalinaḥ, prasthāt paraṃ-adhikaṃ, na srāvayet| { kasmāt ? ity āha- } atisrāve hi raktasya, mṛtyur bhavet| athavā vātarogāś ca kṛcchrāḥ syuḥ|
Ā. rā. srāvapramāṇam āha-aśuddhāv iti| aśuddhau-kiṃ punaḥ śuddhau| balino 'pi-kiṃ punar abalasya| prastho 'tra sārddhatrayodaśapalaḥ|
tatrābhyaṅgarasakṣīraraktapānāni bheṣajam| -------------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. tatra-raktātisrutau, abhyaṅgādīni bheṣajam|
Ā. rā. atisrāve bheṣajam āha-tatreti|

-------------------------------------------------|
srute rakte śanair yantram apanīya himāmbunā||43||
prakṣālya tailaplotāktaṃ bandhanīyaṃ sirāmukham| -------------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. srute rakte sati yantraṃ śanair vimurcya-mandaṃ mandam apanīya, sirāmukhaṃ śītodakena prakṣālya, tailaplotenāktaṃ sad bandhanīyam|
Ā. rā. srutaraktasthānantaraṃ kṛtyam āha-sruta iti| plotaṃ-vastrakhaṇḍam|

-------------------------------------------------|
aśuddhaṃ srāvayed bhūyaḥ sāyam ahny apare 'pi vā||44||
snehopaskṛtadehasya pakṣād vā bhṛśadūṣitam| -------------------------------------------------|45|

Sa. aśuddhaṃ-vātādiduṣṭarudhiralakṣaṇena duṣṭaṃ jñātvā, bhūyaḥ-punaḥ, srāvayet| kadā ? sāyaṃ-aparāhne, tasminn eva dine| athavā, apare 'hni-dvitīye dine| athavā snehenopaskṛto bhāvito, deho yasya tathāvidhasya bhṛśadūṣitaṃ-atiśayena duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ, pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ punaḥ srāvayet| evam aśuddhaṃ raktaṃ yathāyogaṃ sāyam ahny apare pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ vā prasthaparimāṇam eva srāvayen na tato 'dhikam iti raktasrutau kramaḥ| prasthaparimāṇaṃ ca tantrāntare gaditam
"vamane ca vireke ca raktātīsārayor api|
sārddhatrayodaśapalaṃ prastham āhur manīṣiṇaḥ||" iti|

Ā. rā. kiñcic chheṣaṃ duṣṭaraktaṃ sthāpayed uta sarvaṃ srāvayet ? iti saṃśayāpanodārtham idam āha-[prathamasrāveṇāsamyak śuddhau] punaḥ srāvakālam āha-aśuddham iti| bhṛśadūṣitaṃ tu punaḥ snehayitvā pakṣāt srāvayet|

-------------------------------------------------|
kiñcid dhi śeṣe duṣṭāsre naiva rogo 'tivartate||45||
saśeṣam apy ato dhāryaṃ na cātisrutim ācaret| -------------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. yasmāt kiñcic cheṣe duṣṭarakte naiva rogo-duṣṭaraktodbhavo vyādhiḥ, ativartate-kriyāpatham atikramya mārgāntaram asau nāsādayati| ato duṣṭam api raktaṃ saśeṣaṃ dhāryam| nāsya duṣṭaraktasyātisrutim ācaret, prāṇāyatanatvāt| suśruto 'py adhyagīṣṭa
(?) "saśeṣaṃ duṣṭarudhiram api kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ|
na cātiprasrutaṃ kuryāc cheṣaṃ saṃśamanair jayet||" iti|
Ā. rā. atha kiñcic cheṣaṃ raktam upekṣaṇīyam uta pratikriyā kācit tatra kāryāḥ ? ity āha-duṣṭe 'py anenaiva krameṇa srutiḥ kāryā| na tv atisrutir ity āha-kiñcid dhīti| ativartate-bādhate|
Sa. srutaśeṣaṃ duṣṭaraktaṃ śṛṅgatumbaghaṭikādibhir haret, na tu sirayā|
Ā. rā. śirāvyadhe 'tisrutiśaṅkāyāṃ śṛṅgādibhir hared ity āha-hared iti|

lg.l: duṣṭaṃ raktam anudriktam evam eva prasādayet||47||

div.ab: Sa. athavā śītopacāreṇa, pittāsrakriyayā, śuddhyā-vamanavirecanādirūpayā, viśoṣaṇena-laṅghanarūpeṇa, tad duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ prasādayet-kaluṣatāṃ parityajya tasya prasannatvam upapādayet| na tu kevalaṃ srutaśeṣaṃ rudhiraṃ śītopacāreṇa (cārādinā) prasādayet| yāvad anudrikta-apravṛddhaṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ, evam eva-anenaiva śītopacārādinā, prasādaṃ nayet| na tu tannirharaṇe sirāvyadhādinā yatanīyam, anudriktaraktanirharaṇasya sāpāyatvāt|

Ā. rā. śṛṅgādibhir apy atisrutiśaṅkāyāṃ śamayed ity āha-prasādam iti| pittāsrakriyā-raktapittacikitsā| akṛtaśirāvyadhasyāpy etad eva raktaprasādanam ity āha-duṣṭaṃ raktam iti| anudriktaṃ-udrekābhāvāt srāvāyogyam|
rakte tv atiṣṭhati kṣipraṃ stambhanīm ācaret kriyām| -------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. rakte tv atiṣṭhati-sthitim alabhamāne, tvaritam eva stambhanīṃ kriyāṃ-vakṣyamāṇāṃ, kuryāt, raktasya prāṇāyatanatvāt|
Ā. rā. tad eva stambhanam āha-atisrāve stambhanam āha-rakte tv iti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
rodhrapriyaṅgupattaṅgamāṣayaṣṭyāhvagairikaiḥ||48||

lg.l: tām eva vā sirāṃ vidhyed vyadhāt tasmād anantaram|

div.ab: Sa. rodhrādibhiḥ sirāvraṇamukhaṃ vicūrṇayet| padmakādihimaṃ-śītakaṣāyaṃ, pibet| tām eva-prāgviddhāṃ, sirāṃ tasmāt prāgvyadhād anantaraṃ, avyavahitaṃ vidhyet| athavā sirādvāraṃ kṣipraṃ kṛtvā'gninopataptayā śalākayā dahet|

Ā. rā. raktasya srāvaṇādanantaraṃ yad vidheyaṃ tad āha-stambhanaviśeṣam āha-rodhrapriyaṅgv iti| mṛtkapālaṃ-kharparam| kṣaumamaṣī-vastrabhasma| vicūrṇayet-cūrṇaṃ vikiret| padmakādihimaṃ-padmakādigaṇasya śītakaṣāyam| saṅgrahe tu (sū.a. 36)-"atiṣṭhati tu rakte śirāmukhaṃ saṃdhātuṃ cūrṇair avacurṇyāṅgulyagreṇa pīḍayet| śālmalyupodakāpicchāṃ vā vraṇamukhe dattvā gāḍhaṃ badhnīyāt| madhūcchiṣṭapraliptaṃ vā paṭṭakam| śītāmbunā vā siñcet| śītamadhurakaṣāyānnapānasekapradehapravātaveśmabhir vā skandanāyopacaret| padmakādikvāthaṃ śarkarāmadhumadhuraṃ kṣīram ikṣurasam eṇahariṇājorabhramahiṣavarāhāṇām anyatamasya vā sirāṃ viddhvā rudhiram āmaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā pānaṃ dadyāt| tenaiva vā darbhapādamṛditenānuvāsayet| snigdhaiś ca yūṣarasair bhojayet| sarvathā cānavatiṣṭhamāne pācanāya kṣāraṃ dadyāt| na ca kṣaṇam apy upekṣeta| kṣīṇaraktasya hi vāyur marmāṇy upasaṅgṛhya mūrcchāsaṃjñānāśaśiraḥkampabhramamanyāstambhāpatānakahanubhraṃśahidhmāpāṇḍutvabādhiryadhātukṣayākṣepakādīn karoti, maraṇaṃ vā|
prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ raktaṃ tatkṣayāt kṣīyate 'nalaḥ|
varddhate cānilas tasmād yuktyā bṛṃhaṇam ācaret|| durvyadhātivyadhakuṭṭitatiryagvyadhāder vyadhadoṣāvdyāpado yāḥ syus tā yathāsvaṃ sādhayed iti|" iti|

lg.l: unmārgagā yantranipīḍanena svasthānamāyānti punar na yāvat|
doṣāḥ praduṣṭā rudhiraṃ prapannā stāvad dhitāhāravihārabhāk syāt||51||

div.ab: Sa. yantranipīḍanenonmārgagāḥ-svamārgam ullaṅghya mārgāntarasamāśrayaṇenotpathaṃ pratipannāḥ| kiṃbhūtā doṣāḥ? pradṛṣṭāḥ, tathāvidhaṃ raktaṃ prāptā |te punar yāvat svāśrayaṃ na pratipadyante tāvad dhitāhāravihārabhāk syāt-hitāvāhāravihārau bhajet| "bhajo ṇviḥ iti ṇviḥ| indravajrāvṛttam|
Ā. rā. srutaraktasya pathyaniyamakālāvadhim āha-unmārgagā iti|

lg.l: nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ laghu dīpanīyaṃ rakte 'panīte hitam annapānam|
tadā śarīraṃ hy anavasthitāsṛ gagnir viśeṣād iti rakṣitavyaḥ||52||

div.ab: Sa. rakte srāvite 'nnapānaṃ nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ hitam| atyuṣṇaṃ hy annapānaṃ raktaṃ pradūṣayet| atiśītaṃ tv agniṃ sādayet| tathā, laghu-svabhāvato mātrāsaṃskārādinā vā, tathā dīpanīyam| kuta evam annapānaṃ hitam ? ity āha-yasmāt tasmin kāle śarīram anavasthitaṃ-calitavṛtti, raktaṃ yasya śarīrasya tad evaṃbhūtaṃ bhavati| tac cāsṛk śarīrasyādhāro, raktasya ca pittaṃ, pittaṃ ca vahniḥ| tathā ca vakṣyati (hṛ. śā. a. 3|90)- "pittaṃ vahniḥ" iti| tasmād viśeṣāt-mahatā yatnena, vahnir nātyuṣṇaśītādinā''hāravihāreṇa rakṣitavyaḥ|

Ā. rā. kṛtasirāvyadhasya puruṣasya lakṣaṇam antareṇonmārgagāmināṃ doṣāṇāṃ svasthānapratipattau kālo nāvagamyate, na ca nirhṛtaduṣṭaraktaḥ puruṣo lakṣaṇaṃ vinā jñāyate, iti dvayasyāpi parijñānārtham āha-pathyam āha-nātyuṣṇaśītam iti| ukte pathye yuktim āha-tadā śarīram iti| iti-ato hetoḥ|

prasannavarṇendriyam indriyārthā- nicchhantam avyāhatapaktṛvegam|
sukhānvitaṃ puṣṭibalopapannaṃ viśuddharaktaṃ puruṣaṃ vadanti|53| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śirāvyadhavidhir nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|27|

Sa. varṇaś cendriyāṇi ca varṇendriyāṇi, prasannāni varṇendriyāṇi yasya taṃ prasannavarṇendriyam| tathā, indriyārthān śabdādīn svabhāvābhipretān, icchantaṃ-abhilaṣantam| tathā, paktur vegaḥ-sāmarthyam, avyāhataḥ-anabhibhūtaḥ, paktṛvego yasya tam avyāhatapaktṛvegam| tathā, sukhānvitaṃ-ārogyayuktaṃ prakṛtim āpannam| tathā puṣṭibalābhyāṃ yuktam| evaṃvidhaṃ viśuddharaktaṃ puruṣaṃ vadanti, iti śarīrasya lakṣaṇam uktam| "madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ" ity ādinā tu raktasyaiva viśuddhalakṣaṇam abhihitam iti| upajātir vṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ sūtrasthāne śirāvyadhavidhir nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 27||

Ā. rā. viśuddharaktasya lakṣaṇam āha-prasannavarṇeti| paktāagniḥ| vego-viṇmūtrādipravṛttiḥ|
iti hemādriṭīkāyām āyurvedarasāyane|
śirāvyadhaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam|| 27||

div.head: śalyāharaṇavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. śirāvyadhavidher anantaraṃ śalyāharaṇavidhir ārabhyate| yataḥ sirāvyadhavidhyadhyāye śalyarūpasya raktasya sakalakāyavyāpinaḥ sirāvyadhopāyena nirharaṇam uktam| idānīṃ prādeśikasya lohādeḥ śalyasya pratideśasthitasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirharaṇopāyādiś cāsminn adhyāye śalyāharaṇavidhau nirdiśyata ity āha-

athātaḥ śalyāharaṇavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
