div.ab: Sa. mārutaś ca dūṣito dhātūn-vātapramehasampādanayogyān, bastim upānīya-samantān mūtrādhārasamīpaṃ nītvā, tatkṣaye 'pi ca pramehān kurute| teṣāṃ-dhātūnāṃ, kṣayas tasmiṃś ca sati| na kevalaṃ dhātūn bastim upānīya yāvad adhaḥkṣaraṇatvādinā teṣām api svayaṃ kṛtvety api cety asyārthaḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
atha sādhyāsādhyavibhāgam āha -
- - - sādhyayāpyaparityājyā mehās tenaiva tadbhavāḥ|
samāsamakriyatayā mahātyayatayā'pi ca||6||

div.ab: Sa. saḥ-śleṣmādiḥ, bhavo-janma, yeṣāṃ te tadbhavāḥ kaphādisamutthāḥ, tenaiva-viśiṣṭena samprāptiviśeṣeṇa, sādhyayāpyaparityājyāḥ syuḥ| tathā ca,-kaphapramehā vapurādidūṣaṇamātrotthitatvāt sādhyāḥ, pittapramehāṇāṃ saumyadhātukṣaye vapurāde raktasya ca dūṣaṇena samutthānād yāpyatvam, vātapramehās tu sarvadhātukṣayodbhūtatvād asādhyāḥ| anyad api hetvantaraṃ sādhyayāpyāsādhyatve vakti-samety ādi| samaṃ cāsamaṃ ca samāsame,-samānāsamāne, samāsame kriye yayos tāv evam, tayor bhāvaḥ samāsamakriyatā, tayā| tathā, mahātyayatayā| mahāṃś cāsāv atyayo-vināśaḥ śarīravighaṭanarūpo mahātyayaḥ, tasya bhāvo mahātyayatā, tayā| tatra kaphasya tathā śarīrakledādeḥ pramehadūṣyasyāpy atarpaṇarūpayaikayaiva kriyayā sādhyatvāt kaphapramehāḥ sādhyāḥ| pittasya śītamadhurādirūpā kriyā pramehāṇāṃ rūkṣatīkṣṇādikā dūṣyapratipakṣatvād aupayikīti tasmāt te pittapramehā yāpyāḥ| vātapramehāṇāṃ rūkṣatīkṣṇādi tu pathyam| vātasya snigdhamadhurādikaṃ santarpaṇarūpaṃ pathyam| tad evaṃ viruddhakriyatvād vātapramehā asādhyāḥ| api ceti samuñcaye| 00000
sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ prabhūtāvilamūtratā| ----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. teṣāṃ-pramehāṇāṃ, sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ prabhūtamūtratā''vilamūtratā ca| 00000

nanu, doṣasya-kaphādeḥ, dūṣyasya ca-vapuḥkledādeḥ, tulyatvāt kathaṃ pratidoṣaṃ pramehānekatvaṃ syāt ? ity āha - - - - ----------------------------------------------|
doṣadūṣyāviśeṣe 'pi tatsaṃyogaviśeṣataḥ||7||
mūtravarṇādibhedena bhedo meheṣu kalpyate| ----------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. doṣadūṣyāviśeṣe 'pi-samānatve 'pi sati, tatsaṃyogaviśeṣato meheṣu bhedaḥ-anekatvaṃ kalpyate| tayoḥ-doṣadūṣyayoḥ, saṃyogaḥ-saṃśleṣaḥ, tatsaṃyogaḥ, tasya viśeṣaḥ-prākkṛtakarmavaśād bhedo, doṣadūṣyayoḥ saṃyogānekatvam ity arthaḥ| tasmān mūtrasya yo varṇādibhedo-varṇagandharasasparśādiviśeṣaḥ, tena bhedena bhedo meheṣu kalpyate-nirūpyate| 00000

athodakamehādīn lakṣayati - - - - -----------------------------------------------|
acchaṃ bahu sitaṃ śītaṃ nirgandham udakopamam||8||
mehaty udakamehena kiñcic cāvilapicchilam| ----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. udakamehenācchādiguṇayuktaṃ mehati| kiñcic cāvilapicchilam iti īṣatsvacchamūtrād āvilaṃ picchalaṃ ca bhavati| 00000

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
ikṣo rasam ivātyarthaṃ madhuraṃ cekṣumehataḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. ikṣor mehād ikṣurasasadṛśaṃ mehati| atyarthaṃ madhuraṃ cetīkṣurasād viśeṣam āha| 00000
sāndrībhavet paryuṣitaṃ sāndramehena mehati| ----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. sāndramehena yan mehati tat paryuṣitaṃ-rātristhitaṃ, ghanībhavet| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
surāmehī surātulyam upary accham adho ghanam||10||

div.ab: Sa. surāmehī surātulyaṃ mehati| tac ca mūtraṃ paryuṣitam evoparibhāge 'ccham adhaḥ-adhastāt, ghanaṃ bhavet| 00000
saṃhṛṣṭaromā piṣṭena piṣṭavad bahalaṃ sitam| ------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. piṣṭena-piṣṭamehena, saṃhṛṣṭaromā san piṣṭavat-piṣṭasadṛśaṃ, bahalaṃ śuklaṃ ca mehati| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
śukrābhaṃ śukramiśraṃ vā śukramehi pramehati||11||

div.ab: Sa. śukramehī śukrābhaṃ śukramiśraṃ vā pramehati| 00000
Sa. sikatāmehi mūrtāṇūn-saṃhatān- sūkṣmāṃś ca, malān sikatāsadṛśān mehati| malān iti bahuvacanaṃ jātau, kaphākhyo hy eka eva malo 'tra gṛhyate| 00000
Sa. śītamehī suṣṭhu bahuśo madhuram atiśītalaṃ ca mehati| 00000
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śanairmehī mandaṃ mandaṃ pramehati| ------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. śanairmehī śanaiḥ śanair mehatīty uddeśe mandaṃ mandam iti nirdeśa ity api paunaruktyam| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
lālātantuyutaṃ mūtraṃ lālāmehena picchilam||13||

div.ab: Sa. lālāmehena lālātantuyutaṃ vicchilaṃ ca mūtraṃ pramehati| iti kaphapramehā daśa| 00000

pittajān āha -
- - - gandhavarṇarasasparśaiḥ kṣāreṇa kṣāratoyavat| ------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. kṣāratoyam iva gandhavarṇarasasparśaiḥ kṣāramehena mehati| 00000
Sa. nīlamehena nīlābhaṃ gandhādibhir mehati| 00000
Sa. kālamehī maṣīsadṛśaṃ mūtraṃ mehati| 00000
hāridramehī kaṭukaṃ haridrāsannibhaṃ dahat| ------------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. hāridramehi haridrāsadṛśaṃ kaṭukaṃ dahat-dahad iva, mūtraṃ mehati| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
visraṃ māñjiṣṭhamehena mañjiṣṭhāsalilopamam||15||

div.ab: Sa. māñjiṣṭhamehī mañjiṣṭhājalasadṛśaṃ visraṃ ca mehati| 00000
visram uṣṇaṃ salavaṇaṃ raktābhaṃ raktamehataḥ| ------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. raktamehena visrādikaṃ mehati| 00000

lg.l: vasāmehī vasāmiśraṃ vasāṃ vā mūtrayen muhuḥ||16||

div.ab: Sa. vasāmehī vasāmiśraṃ vasāṃ vā punaḥ punar mūtrayet| 00000
majjānaṃ majjamiśraṃ vā majjamehī muhur muhuḥ| ------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. majjamehī majjānaṃ majjamiśraṃ vā punaḥ punar mehati| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
hastī matta ivājasraṃ mūtraṃ vegavivarjitam||17||
salasīkaṃ vibaddhaṃ ca hastimehī pramehati| ------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. hastimehī mattagaja ivānavarataṃ vegarahitaṃ lasīkayā saha vibaddhaṃ ca mūtraṃ pramehati| 00000
Sa. madhumehī madhusamaṃ pramehati| 00000

Sa. sa tu-madhumeho, vāyau dhātukṣayāt kupite sati, athavā doṣāvṛtapathe maruti, kila dvidhā jāyate| atra ca kecid evācāryā dvidhā āhuḥ| bahavas tv ekam eva dhātukṣayavātakopajam āhuḥ, na tu mārgāvṛtavātakopajam iti sūcanārthaḥ kilaśabdaḥ| vāyos tu dvidhā kopaḥ| tathā coktam-"vāyor dhātukṣayāt kopo mārgasyāvaraṇena ca|" iti| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
āvṛto doṣaliṅgāni so 'nimittaṃ pradarśayet||19||
kṣīṇaḥ kṣaṇāt kṣaṇāt pūrṇo bhajate kṛcchrasādhyatām| ------------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. saḥ-vāyuḥ, āvṛtamārgo liṅgāni-vātāvarakadoṣalakṣaṇāni vātaśoṇitanidānoktāni, animittaṃ-akasmāt, pradarśayet calasvabhāvatvād vāyoḥ| ata eva ca kṣaṇāt kṣīṇo-baster apūraṇād riktaḥ| kṣaṇāc ca pūrṇo-mūtrāśayapūraṇāt pūrṇo, na tu riktaḥ| ata eva doṣāvṛtamārgavātakopajatvād asau kṛcchrasādhyatāṃ bhajate, na tu dhātukṣayavātakopajavad atyantāsādhyatām| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
kālenopekṣitāḥ sarve yad yānti madhumehatām||20||

lg.l: madhuraṃ yac ca sarveṣu prāyo madhv iva mehati|
sarve 'pi madhumehākhyā mādhuryāc ca tanor ataḥ||21||

div.ab: Sa. yat-yasmāt, sarve mehāḥ kālenopekṣitāḥ santo madhumehatāṃ yānti| yac ca-yasmāc ca, sarveṣu meheṣu madhuraṃ madhv iva-madhusadṛśaṃ, mehati| tanoḥ-śarīrasya, ca svabhāvād eva mādhuryam (ryāt)| ataḥ-asmāt kāraṇasandohāt, sarve 'pi madhumehasaṃjñāḥ| 00000
Sa. kaphajānāṃ mehānām avipākādaya upadravāḥ prajāyante| 00000
Sa. pittajanmanāṃ bastyāditodādayo jāyante| 00000

lg.l: śūlam unnidratā śoṣaḥ kāsaḥ śvāsaś ca jāyate||24||

div.ab: Sa. vātikānām udāvartādayaḥ syuḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
pramehiṇāṃ ca piṭikāḥ śarāvikādyāḥ prāyeṇa bhavanti, iti tā evāha -
- - - śarāvikā kacchapikā jālinī vinatā'lajī|
masūrikā sarṣapikā putriṇī savidārikā||25||

div.ab: Sa. śarāvikādayo daśa piṭikāḥ pramehāṇām upekṣayā jāyante| sandhimarmasu māṃsaleṣu ca-bahumāṃseṣu sthāneṣu| 00000
Sa. śarāvikāsaṃjñā piṭikā'ntonnatatvādiguṇayuktā bhavati| tathā śarāvasyeva mānaṃ-pramāṇaṃ, saṃsthānaṃ-ākāraś ca, yasyāḥ saivam| 00000

Sa. artiḥ-pīḍā| nistedo-vicchinnaṃ vyathanam| avagāḍhāvartinistodau yasyāḥ saivam| tathā, mahān vastuparigrahaḥ-śarīrāvayavaviśeṣa āśrayo, yasyāḥ saivam| tathā, ślakṣṇā kacchapapṛṣṭhatulyā ca kacchapīsaṃjñā piṭikā matā| tantrakṛtām iti śeṣaḥ| 00000
Sa. stabdhādiguṇayuktā jālinīsaṃjñā| 00000

lg.l: mahatī piṭikā nīlā vinatā vinatā smṛtā||30||

div.ab: Sa. avagāḍharujādiyuktā piṭikā mahati tathā nīlā-nīlavarṇā, vinatā ca| sā ca vinatāsaṃjñā pṛṣṭhe jaṭhare vā syāt| 00000

lg.l: dahati tvacam utthāne bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭā visarpiṇī|

div.ab: Sa. alajīsaṃjñā utthāne sati tvacaṃ dahati| atiduḥsahā visarpaṇaśīlā tathā raktakṛṣṇā'titṛḍādiyuktā ca| 00000
mānasaṃsthānayos tulyā masūreṇa masūrikā| ------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. masūrikāsaṃjñā masūreṇa pramāṇākṛtibhyāṃ tulyā| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā kṣiprapākā mahārujā||32||
sarṣapī sarṣapātulyapiṭikāparivāritā| ------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. sarṣapīsaṃjñā sarṣapatulyapramāṇākārā tathā śīghrapākā mahārujā ca| tathā sarṣapasadṛśībhiḥ piṭikābhiḥ parivāritā ca| 00000
Sa. putriṇīsaṃjñā pramāṇenāparapiṭikāpekṣayā mahatī| tathā bhūribhiḥ susūkṣmābhiḥ piṭikābhir ācitā ca| 00000
vidārīkandavad vṛttā kaṭhinā ca vidārikā| ------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. vidārikāsaṃjñā śṛugālikākanda iva vartulā kaṭhinā ca syāt| 00000
Sa. vidradhir anyatrety ato 'dhyāyād anyasminn anantarādhyāye vakṣyate-bhaṇiṣyate| 00000

lg.l: putriṇī ca vidārī ca duḥsahā bahumedasaḥ|
sahyāḥ pittolbaṇās tv anyāḥ sambhavanty alpamedasaḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-tāsu piṭikāsu madhye, ādyaṃ-śarāvikākacchapikājālinīty etata, piṭikātrayaṃ tathā putriṇī vidārikā ceti pañca duḥsahāḥ, kṛcchrasādhyatvāt| yato bahumedasa etāḥ sambhavanti|anyāḥ-etābhyo 'parās tu, pittolbaṇāś catasraḥ (śca tāḥ) sahyāḥ-soḍhuṃ śakyāḥ, sukhasādhyatvāt| tāś cālpamedasaḥ sambhavanti| 00000
tāsu mehavaśāc ca syād doṣodreko yathāyatham| ------------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. tāsu-piṭikāsu, mehānurodhād doṣodreko yathāyathaṃ-yathāsvaṃ syāt| vātamehajāsu vātādhikyaṃ pittamehajāsu pittādhikyaṃ kaphamehajāsu kaphādhikyam| udrekaśabdenaitad''dyotayati,-tridoṣajāḥ sarvā evaitā iti| 00000

Sa. etāḥ-pūrvoktāḥ piṭikāḥ, prameheṇa vinā'pi-apramehiṇo 'pi puṃso, duṣṭamedaso jāyante| jātā api tās tathāvidhasya narasya tāvan na lakṣyante-yathāyathaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ notpadyate, yāvat-yathāsvaṃ, pṛṣṭhodarādi vastv āsām ādhāratvena tantrakṛtā yat paribhāṣitaṃ tan na parigṛhītam| evaṃ cireṇa kālenotpannā api jñāyanta ity arthaḥ | 00000

lg.l: yo mūtrayen na taṃ mehaṃ raktapittaṃ tu tad viduḥ||37||
bhaviṣyato mehagaṇasya rūpaṃ mūtre 'bhidhāvanti pipīlikāś ca||39||

div.ab: Sa. mehasya yat prāgrūpaṃ tena varjitaṃ hāridravarṇaṃ raktaṃ vā yo mūtrayet taṃ mehaṃ na viduḥ, kin tarhi ? tat raktapittam ity āhuḥ| etad bhaviṣyato-bhāvino, mehagaṇasya-viṃśatisaṅkhyasya, sveda ity ādi rūpam| na kevalam etat prāgrūpaṃ yāvat pipīlikā mūtre 'bhidhāvanti| madhurarasapriyatvāt teṣāṃ| munis tv atra nakhavṛddhiṃ na jagāda (?)| 00000

lg.l: dṛṣṭvā pramehaṃ madhuraṃ sapicchaṃ madhūpamaṃ syād dvividho vicāraḥ|
sampūraṇād vā kaphasambhavaḥ syāt kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣv anilātmako vā||40||

div.ab: Sa. madhūpamaṃ-mākṣikatulyaṃ, madhuraṃ tathā saha picchayā-śālmalīniryāsatulyayā, vartata iti sapiccham| evaṃvidhaṃ pramehaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadānīṃ dvividho vicāraḥ syāt| sampūraṇāt kāraṇāt kim ayaṃ kaphasambhavo meho 'patarpaṇasādhyaḥ ? uta kṣīṇeṣu doṣeṣu-kaphādidoṣakṣayāt, santarpaṇasādhyo 'nilātmakaḥ syāt ? iti sandeho mandabuddheḥ| tīkṣṇamatis tu kaphamehān vātamehāṃś ca liṅgāntaraiḥ samyag vetty eva| 00000

adhunā yad uktaṃ sādhyayāpyaparityājyāḥ kaphādisambhavā ity asyāpavādam āha -
- - - sapūrvarūpāḥ kaphapittemehāḥ krameṇa ye vātakṛtāś ca mehāḥ|
sādhyā na te, pittakṛtās tu yāpyāḥ sādhyās tu medo yadi nātiduṣṭam|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|10|

Sa. saha pūrvarūpaiḥ-"svedo 'ṅgagandhaḥ" (ślo. 38) ity ādibhir vartante 'navarataṃ kṛtvā'nubadhyante ye te sapūrvarūpā asādhyāḥ| sarveṣāṃ pūrvarūpāvyabhicāre 'pi viśeṣaṇaṃ sākalyaprāpaṇārtham| sarvaiḥ pūrvarūpaiḥ saha ye vartante te kaphamehāḥ pittamehāś cāsādhyāḥ, sādhayitum aśakyatvāt| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam,-apare 'pi hi rogāḥ sapūrvarūpāḥ prāyeṇāsādhyā eva| tathā krameṇa kaphānupūrvyā ye vātakṛtā mehās te 'sādhyāḥ| nanu, vātakṛtā mehā asādhyā iti prāg uktam eva, tat kim anena granthena ? iti| brūmaḥ| akrameṇa prathamam eva ye vātotpannās te tyājyā iti pūrvam uktam| iha tu krameṇa prathamaṃ kaphapramehās tataḥ pittapramehās tataḥ kālena ta eva ye vātapramehāḥ sampannās te pūrvaṃ kaphapramehatvāt sādhayitum api śakyanta ity āśaṅkāyāṃ krameṇa ye vātakṛtās te 'sādhyā ity uktam| pittakṛtās tv asapūrvarūpā api yāpyā asamakriyatvād iti prāṅ nirdiṣṭam| teṣāṃ yadi medo nātiduṣṭaṃ bhavet tadā te 'pi yāpyāḥ santaḥ sādhyā bhavanti| medo nātiduṣṭam ity anenaitaj jñāpayati,-sarvameheṣu medoduṣṭir avaśyaṃbhāvinīti| mehino rājayakṣmiṇaś ca keśanakhātivṛddhiḥ kiṭṭabāhulyād bhavati, rogasvabhāvād ity anye| vṛttāny upajātisaṃjñāni| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pramehanidānaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 10|| 00000

div.head: vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. pramehanidānād anantaraṃ vidradhinidānārambhaḥ, yato 'nantare 'dhyāye piṭikālakṣaṇāvasare "vidradhir vakṣyate" (ślo. 34) ity uktam| 00000

ab.seg: atas tam eva vidradhiṃ lakṣayitum asyādhyāyasya prasaṅga ity āha - - - - athāto vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

lg.l: yaḥ śopho bahir antar vā mahāmūlo mahārujaḥ||2||

ab.seg:
ṣoḍhety uktam| atha tad eva ṣoḍhatvaṃ pratipādayitum āha -
- - - vṛttaḥ syād āyato yo vā smṛtaḥ ṣoḍhā sa vidradhiḥ|
doṣaiḥ pṛthak samuditaiḥ śoṇitena kṣatena ca||3||

div.ab: Sa. paryuṣitādibhir bhuktaiḥ, tathā jihmaśayyāviceṣṭābhiḥ, vividhāś ceṣṭā viceṣṭāḥ, śayyā ca viceṣṭāś ca śayyāviceṣṭāḥ, jihmāś ca tāḥ śayyāviceṣṭāś ca, tābhiḥ| jihmāḥ kuṭilā vakrā iti paryāyāḥ| tathā tais taiḥ-tatra tatrāsṛkpradūṣaṇaiś ca nirdiṣṭaiḥ, yaḥ śopho jāyate duṣṭatvagādyāśrayo bahiḥ-bahirbhāge, antaḥ-antarbhāge vā, sa śīghravidāhitvāc chophaḥ ṣoḍhā-ṣaṭprakāro, vidradhiḥ smṛtaḥ-abhihitaḥ| śophaśabdaḥ pṛṣodarāditvāt sādhuḥ| tvak ca māṃsaṃ ca medaś ca asthi ca snāyuś cāsṛk ca kaṇḍarā ca, tā evam| "sumahān snāyusaṅghātaḥ kaṇḍarety abhidhīyate|" duṣṭāḥ-doṣair dūṣitāḥ, tvaṅmāṃsādaya ādhāro yasya sa duṣṭatvaṅmāṃsamedosthisnāyvasṛkkaṇḍarāśrayaḥ| tathā, mahamūlas tathā mahārujaḥ, anenāsya durupakramatvam uktam| tathā, vṛttaḥ syāt, athavā āyato-na vartulaḥ, ity anenāsya saṃsthānam uktam| pṛthag doṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphais trayaḥ, samuditaiḥ-sannipātena caikaḥ, tathā śoṇitena-doṣādhiṣṭhitena, kṣatena-śastrādighātādinā, ceti| 00000

ṣaḍvidhasyāpi śophasya vidradhyākhyasyāntarbahīrūpatayā dvidhātvam ity āha -
- - - bāhyo 'tra tatra tatrāṅge dāruṇo grathitonnataḥ|
āntaro dāruṇataro gambhīro gulmavaddhanaḥ||4||
valmīkavat samucchrāyī śīghraghāty agniśastravat| ----------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. atra-anayor bāhyābhyantarabhedabhinnayor vidradhyor madhyāt, bāhyo vidradhis tatra tatra-nābhyādāv aṅge, jāyate| tathā, dāruṇo grathitonnataḥ| grathita iva grathitaḥ| unnataḥ-uttuṇḍitaḥ| śophasya svabhāvonnatatvād unnatagrahaṇam atiśayārtham| āntaro dāruṇataraḥ tathā, gambhīraḥ-antarnigūḍhaḥ| tathā, gulmavaddhano-gulmena tulyaḥ| tathā, samucchrāyī-unnato valmīkaśikharavat| tathā, śīghraghātī-bāhyavidradhitaḥ śīghravyāpādakaḥ| agniśastravat-agniśastrābhyāṃ tulyaḥ| 00000
Sa. nābhyādyanyatame deśe cāyaṃ syāt| 00000

--------------------------vātāt tatrātitīvraruk|
śyāvāruṇaś cirotthānapāko viṣamasaṃsthitaḥ||6||
vyadhacchedabhramānāhaspandasarpaṇaśabdavān| --------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. tatra-teṣu vidradhiṣu madhye, vātāt tīvrarugādiḥ śabdavān ityetadantalakṣaṇaḥ syāt| 00000
Sa. pittād raktatāmrāsitādikaḥ kṣiprotthānaprapākaś cety antalakṣaṇaḥ syāt| 00000

---------------------pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūyutaḥ kaphāt|
sotkleśaśītakastambhajṛmbhārocakagauravaḥ||8||
cirotthānavipākaś ca-----------------------| --------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. kaphāt pāṇḍuḥ-varṇena| tathā, kaṇḍūyuta ity ādicirotthānavipākaś cety antalakṣaṇaḥ syāt| 00000
Sa. sannipātajo vidradhiḥ saṅkīrṇo-vātādidoṣavyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
sāmarthyāc cātra vibhajed bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇam||9||

div.ab: Sa. atra-vidradhau, pūrvoktād dāruṇād dā(ṇadā)ruṇataratvādilakṣaṇāt-sāmarthyāt, bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇaṃ vibhajet-bāhyasya vidradhes tathā''bhyantarasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ vadet| raktena vidradhiḥ kṛṣṇasphoṭair āvṛtaḥ-cito, yāvat tīvradāharujājvaraḥ| tathā pittaliṅgo-"raktatāmrāsitaḥ" (ślo. 7) ity ādilakṣaṇaḥ sa ca bāhyo-bāhya eva nāntaro narāṇām, vastusvābhāvyāt| āntaro yo vidradhir asṛjā jāyate, sa strīṇām eva-na narāṇām, vastusvābhāvyāt| 00000

atha kṣatavidradhiṃ lakṣayati -
- - - śastrādyair abhighātena kṣate vā'pathyakāriṇaḥ|
kṣatoṣmā vāyuvikṣiptaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan||11||
pittāsṛglakṣaṇaṃ kuryād vidradhiṃ bhūryupadravam| --------------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. śastraloṣṭādyair yo 'bhighātas tena hetunā yaḥ kṣatoṣmā, athavā'bhighātam antareṇāpi vraṇādyudbhavāt kṣate jāte saty apathyakāriṇaḥ puṃso yaḥ kṣatoṣmā-agniḥ, sa vāyunā vikṣiptaḥ pittam īrayan-kopayan| kimbhūtaṃ pittam ? saraktam| tathā, pittāsṛgbhyām utpannayor vidradhyor yal lakṣaṇaṃ tatsamānalakṣaṇaṃ vidradhiṃ kuryāt| tathā, bhūryupadravam| iyān eva cāsya viśeṣaḥ, pittāsṛgvidradhyoḥ sakāśāt| 00000

--------------------------------------------------|
teṣūpadravabhedaś ca smṛto 'dhiṣṭhānabhedataḥ||12|| tam evopadravabhedaṃ darśayati -
- - - nābhyāṃ hidhmā, bhaved bastau mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa pūti ca|
śvāso yakṛti, rodhas tu plīhny ucchvāsasya, tṛṭ punaḥ||13||
galagrahaś ca klomni, syāt sarvāṅgapragraho hṛdi|
pramohas tamakaḥ kāso hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā||14||
kukṣipārśvāntarāṃsārtiḥ kukṣāv āṭopajanma ca|
sakthnor graho vaṅkṣaṇayor vṛkkayoḥ kaṭipṛṣṭhayoḥ||15||
pārśvayoś ca vyathā pāyau pavanasya nirodhanam| --------------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. teṣu-vidradhiṣu, upadravaviśeṣo 'dhiṣṭhānaviśeṣād bhavati| nābhyāṃ jāte vidradhau hidhmā viśeṣeṇa bhavet| bastau jāte mūtraṃ pūti kṛcchreṇa ca bhavet| yakṛti jāte śvāsaḥ syāt| plīhni jāta ucchvāsasya rodhaḥ| klomni jāte galagraha iva galagraho vyādhiviśeṣaḥ syāt tṛṣṇā ca| hṛdi jāte sarvasyāṅgasya prakarṣeṇa grahaḥ syāt| tathā, pramohādayaḥ syuḥ| tamakaḥ-śvāsaviśeṣaḥ| hṛdaye ghaṭṭanaṃ vyathā ca| kukṣau jāte sati kukṣipārśvayor antareṃ'sayoś ca pīḍā bhavati, tathā kukṣāv āṭopasambhavaḥ| vaṅkṣaṇayor jāte sakthnor graho niścala iva sakthinī jāyete| vṛkkayor jāte kaṭyāḥ pṛṣṭhasya ca grahaḥ, pīḍā ca pārśvayoḥ syāt| pāyau-gude jāte, pavanasya-apānākhyasya vāyoḥ, nirodhaḥ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śophavad ādiśet||16||

div.ab: Sa. teṣāṃ-vidradhīnāṃ, āmatvaṃ pakvatvaṃ vidagdhatvaṃ-pākātikrāntatvaṃ, śophavad ādiśet| śophānām iva śophavat, ṣaṣṭhyantād vatiḥ| tatra śophasya śastrakarmavidhau (hṛ. sū. a. 29|2) - "śopho 'lpo 'lpoṣmaruk" ity ādinā granthenāmādilakṣaṇam uktam, tathaiva vidradhiṣu bodhyam| 00000
nābher ūrdhvaṃ mukhāt pakvāḥ prasravanty adhare gudāt| gudāsyān nābhijo----------------------------------|17|

Sa. nābher ūrdhvaṃ-ūrdhvapradeśeṣūtpannāḥ, pakvāḥ santo mukhāt-āsyāt, srāvaṃ sravanti| nābher adhare-adhastāt, pakvāḥ santo gudāt srāvaṃ sravanti| nābhijaḥ punar vidradhir utpanno gudāsyāt-ubhayataḥ, srāvaṃ sravati| gudaṃ cāsyaṃ ca gudāsyam, tasmāt| 00000

Sa. vidradhau vraṇa iva yathāsvaṃ vātādidoṣaṃ kledād vidyāt| vraṇapratiṣedhoktayā rītyā (hṛ. u. a. 25|6) mastumāṃsapulākāmbutulyatanvalpasaṃsratyādikayā vātikaṃ vidradhiṃ vidyāt| mūtrakiṃśukabhasmāmbutailāmbhoṣṇabahusrutety ādikayā ca paittikaṃ vidradhiṃ vidyāt| bahuśvetaghanasrutyādikayā ca kaphajaṃ vidradhiṃ vidyāt| caśabdān na kevalaṃ pūrvoktāt "vātāt tatrātitīvraruk" (ślo. 6) ityāder vātādilakṣaṇād vātādidoṣavidradhiṃ jānīyat, kledāc cety arthaḥ| vraṇavad iti saptamyantād vatiḥ, vidradhāv iti saptamyantanirdeśāt| tathā coktaṃ bhāṣye-"upamāne yaḥ saṃśayaḥ sa upameyād byāvartate|" iti| 00000

athaiṣāṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārtham āha - - - - --------------------tatra vivarjyaḥ sannipātajaḥ|
pakvo hṛnnābhibastistho bhinno 'ntar bahir eva vā||18||
pakvaś cāntaḥ sravan vakkrāt kṣīṇasyopadravānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. sannipātajo yo vidradhiḥ sa vivarjyo 'sādhyatvāt| tathā, pakvo 'ntar bahir eva vā bhinno 'ntaḥ-antarbhinno, bāhyo-bahirbhinno, hṛnnābhibastistho varjya eva| pakvaś cāntaro hṛdādibhyo 'nyatrāpi jāto vaktreṇa sravan kṣīṇasyopadravaiḥ-hidhmādibhiḥ, yukto varjya eva| 00000

idānīṃ stanavidradhir yoṣitāṃ yathā syāt tathā vakti - - - - ---------------------------------------------------------------|
evam eva stanasirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām||19||
sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ vā sambhavec chvayathur ghanaḥ|
stane sadugdhe 'dugdhe vā bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ||20||
nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmavaktratvāt kanyānāṃ na sa jāyate| ------------------------------------------|21| iti vidradhinidānam|21|

Sa. [ evam eva- ] yathaiva vidradhyākhyaḥ śvayathuviśeṣo bhuktaiḥ paryuṣitādibhis tais taiś cāsṛkpradūṣaṇair duṣṭatvaṅmāṃsamedosthisnāyvasṛkkaṇḍarāśrayaḥ, tathaiva sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ vā strīṇāṃ stane sadugdhe 'thavā'dugdhe stanasirā vivṛtāḥ prāpya-ākramya, bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ-"bāhyo 'tra tatra tatrāṅge" (ślo. 4) ity ādilakṣaṇo ghano-nibiḍo, yaḥ śvayathuḥ sambhavet sa stanavidradhisaṃjñaḥ| nāḍīnāṃ-stanasirāṇāṃ, sūkṣmavaktratvāt sa kanyānāṃ na jāyate| 00000

ab.seg:
atha śvayathusāmānyād idānīṃ vṛddhiṃ-vardhmāparanāmānaṃ vyādhiṃ, vaktum upakramate - - - - atha vṛddhinidānam| ------------------------------------------------|
kṛddho ruddhagatir vāyuḥ śophaśūlakaraś caran||21||

div.ab: Sa. vāyuḥ prakupito vṛddhiṃ karoti| kiṃ dhātukṣayāt kupitaḥ ? nety āha-ruddhagatiḥ| ruddhā gatir yasyeti ruddhagatiḥ, āvṛtamārga ity arthaḥ| kimbhūtaḥ ? śophaśūlakaraḥ| tathā, caran-deśād deśāntaraṃ gacchan| vaṅkṣaṇataḥ-tato deśāt, muṣkau-vṛṣaṇau, yathā prāpya tathā phalakośābhivāhinīḥ sirāḥ prakarṣeṇa pīḍayitvā| kasya vṛddhiṃ karoti ? ity āha-phalakośayoḥ,-vṛṣaṇayoḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
adhunā'sya vyādheḥ saṅkhyāṃ kurvann āha -
- - - doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ|
mūtrāntrajāv apy anilād dhetubhedas tu kevalam||23||

div.ab: Sa. pṛthag vātapittakaphair doṣais tathā'sreṇa medasā mūtreṇa ca tathā''ntreṇa ca, evaṃ doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhyākhyo gadaḥ saptadhā-saptaprakāro, mataḥ| na kevalaṃ [ vāta ] vṛddhākhyo yo gadaḥ sa evānilajo yāvan mūtrāntrajāv api yau vṛddhyākhyau gadau tāv apy anilajau| nanu, evaṃ pṛthaṅnirdeśo mūtrāntrajayoḥ kartuṃ na yukto 'nilajatvāt, ity āha-hetubhedas tu kevalam| satyam| mūtrāntrajāv apy anilāj jāyete| kintu kāraṇabhedān mūtrāntrajāv iti nirdiṣṭau| yato mūtrāntre 'dhiṣṭhāya vāyur mūtrāntrajau gadau vṛddhyākhyau karoti| evaṃ tau paramārthato vātajāv api mūtrāntrajāv ucyate, tathārūpād dhetubhūtād utpannatvāt| etac copalakṣaṇamātram| medoraktajāv api vṛddhigadau doṣajāv eva, kaphapittābhyāṃ dūṣyasaṃjñake medorakte 'dhiṣṭhāya kṛtatvāt| tasmān medoraktahetuvaśān medoraktajāv iti saṃjñayā tāv uktau| evam anye 'py evaṃrūpā vyādhayo bodhyāḥ| 00000
vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātād aheturuk| ------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. tatra vātād vṛddhir vātena pūritā yā dṛtiḥ-bhasrā, tasyā iva sparśo yasya sa evaṃbhūto bhavati| tathā, rūkṣaḥ| tathā, ahetuḥ-nimittaṃ vinā, ruk-pīḍā, yasmin sa evam| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittād dāhoṣmapākavān||24||

div.ab: Sa. pittād vṛddhiḥ pakvodumbaraphalatulyo dāhādimāṃś ca syāt| 00000
kaphāc chito guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino 'lparuk| ------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kaphād vṛddhiḥ śītādiyuktaḥ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaś ca raktataḥ||25||

div.ab: Sa. raktādvṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇasphoṭaiś citaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaś ca| pittavṛddhiliṅgānīva liṅgāni yasya sa evam| saptamyupamānapūrvasyety ādinottarapadalopī samāsaḥ| 00000
kaphavanmedasā vṛddhir mṛdus tālaphalopamaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. medasā vṛddhiḥ kaphavad iti kārye kāraṇopacārāt kaphakāryo rogaḥ kapha uktaḥ| viśeṣam atrāha-mṛdus tālaphalopama iti| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ||26||

lg.l: ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅ mṛduḥ|

div.ab: Sa. mūtrajo vṛddhir mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya jalapūrṇabhastreva syāt| sa tu-mūtrajo vṛddhiḥ, gacchato-vrajataḥ, kṣobhaṃ yāti saruk mṛduś ca syāt| tathā, mūtrakṛcchraṃ syāt| phalakośayor adhastāc ca valayaṃ-kaṭakaṃ, syāt| 00000

lg.l: upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhi- mādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ|
prapīḍito 'ntaḥ svanavān prayāti pradhmāpayann eti punaś ca muktaḥ||30||

ab.seg: iti vṛddhinidānam||2||

div.ab: Sa. vātakopyāhārādibhir anyaiś ca pūrvoktaiḥ kṣobhaṇaiḥ-kopanaiḥ, kṣubhitaḥ-kupito, yadā'lpasyāntrasyāvayavaḥ-ekadeśaḥ, taṃ svaniveśāt-svasthānāt, viguṇīkṛtyādho nayet tadā pavano vaṅkṣaṇasandhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ kuryāt| upekṣyamāṇasyety ādi| upekṣyamāṇasya-acikitsyamānasya vṛddhyākhyagadasya, sa pūrvanirdiṣṭo vāyur muṣkayor vṛddhiṃ-varddhanaṃ, kuryāt| kimbhūtām ? ādhmānaruk''stambhavatīm| tathā, prapīḍito bāhyād antaḥ svanavān-saśabdaḥ, prayāti| muktaḥ-aprapīḍitaḥ, pradhmāpayan punar eti-āgacchati| upajātivṛttam| ayaṃ-evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ, antravṛddhir asādhyo na punaḥ sarva evety ayaṃśabdena dyotayati| kim asya lakṣaṇam ? ity āha-vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ,-"vātapūrṇadṛtisparśa" (ślo. 24) ity ādilakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ| 00000

vṛdhyākhyasya vyādher anantaraṃ śophasāmānyāt gulmasyāvasaraḥ, iti taṃ lakṣayitum āha - - - - atha gulmanidānam|
rūkṣakṛṣṇāruṇasirātantujālagavākṣitaḥ|
gulmo 'ṣṭadhā pṛthag doṣaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭair nicayaṃ gataiḥ||32||
ārtavasya ca doṣeṇa nārīṇāṃ jāyate 'ṣṭamaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. sarvagulmānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ rūkṣakṛṣṇety ādigranthanirdiṣṭam| gavākṣito-nirantaram ākrāntaḥ| gulmo 'ṣṭadheti saṅkhyārūpā samprāptiḥ| tad evāṣṭadhātvaṃ pratipādayitum āha-pṛthag doṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphaiḥ, trayaḥ| tathā, saṃsṛṣṭaiḥ-saṃsargeṇa, trayaḥ| nicayaṃ gataiḥ-sannipātena, ekaḥ| tathā, aṣṭamo nārīṇāṃ cārtavasya doṣeṇa-duṣṭatayā, syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
jvaracchardyatisārādyair vamanādyaiś ca karmabhiḥ||33||

lg.l: karśito vātalāny atti śītaṃ vā'mbu bubhukṣitaḥ|
anudīrṇām udīrṇān vā vātādīn na vimuñcati||35||
vātolbaṇās tasya malāḥ pṛthak kruddhā dviśo 'thavā|

div.ab:
Sa. "jvaracchardi" ity ādi yāvat "bhajate syandanāni vā" iti nidānam| atisārādyair ity ādiśabdena grahaṇyādayo gṛhyante, vamanādyair ity atra ca virecanāsthāpanādayaḥ| jvarādibhir vyādhibhir vamanādibhiś ca karśito yo vātalāny annāni bhuṅkte| athavā, bubhukṣito-bhojanaṃ vinaiva, śītaṃ-apakvam ambu, yaḥ pibati| tathā coktam (saṅgrahe sū. a. 6)-
"anavasthitadoṣāgner vyādhikṣīṇabalasya ca|
nālpam apy āmam udakaṃ hitaṃ, tad dhi tridoṣakṛt||" iti| anu cānnāni-bhojanād anantaraṃ, laṅghanādikaṃ yat karma dehasaṅkṣobhi-śarīrasaṃrambhotpādakaṃ, tat sevate| chardiṃ vā yo 'nudīrṇāṃ-anutkliṣṭāṃ, samudīrayet-samantād ūrdhvaṃ nayet| udīrṇān vātādīn-vātamūtrapurīṣādīn āgatān, na vimuñcati| tathā yaḥ kaścana snehasvedāv anabhyasya-punaḥ punar akṛtvā, śodhanaṃ-vamanavirecanādi, niṣevate| athavā, śuddhaḥ-kṛtavamanavirecanaḥ, āśu-samanantaram eva, vidāhīny annapānāni bhajate-santāpanāny annapānāni bhuṅkte| pacyamānāny annapānāni yāni vidāhāvasthāṃ prāptāny āmāśaya eva ciram avatiṣṭhante tāni vidāhīny ucyante| athavā, kṛtavamanavirecano 'nantaram eva syandanāni-srutirūpaśleṣmakārīṇy annapānāni, bhajate| tasya malāḥ-vātādayo, gulmasaṃjñaṃ vyādhiṃ kurvate| kīdṛśāḥ ? vātolbaṇāḥ-vātakāraṇāḥ| na hi pavanakāraṇam antareṇa śleṣmapittaraktānāṃ saṃghaṭṭanā ghaṭate| tasmāt pittādīnām utpattikāraṇānāṃ vātasya ca pittādigulmeṣu gulmaniṣpādanaṃ prati tulyakakṣatām anena viśeṣaṇena pratipādayaty ācāryaḥ| yadi punar ulbaṇaḥ-adhikaḥ, iti vyākhyāyate| tadānīṃ pittagulme 'py adhikatvaṃ vātasyeti vātagulmapittagulmādīnāṃ viṣayavibhāgo na syāt| tasmād vātakāraṇatvaṃ vātolbaṇā ity anena vivakṣitam iti vedyam| kimbhūtā doṣāḥ ? kruddhāḥ-kupitāḥ| katham ? pṛthak-pratyekaṃ kṛtvā| athavā, dviśo-dvau dvau kṛtvā, saṃsargasthā ity arthaḥ| sarve vā-samastā raktayuktā veti| vāśabdaḥ samuccaye, raktayuktāś cety arthaḥ| tathā ca kharanāde 'bhihitam-"vāyuḥ, kruddhaḥ kaphaṃ raktaṃ pittaṃ cādāya piṇḍitam| gulmaṃ kuryāt" ity ādi yāvat "raktapittakaphā vātapiṇḍitā gulma ucyate|" iti| tathā mahāsrotonuśāyinaḥ| mahāsrotaḥ-āmapakvāśayasthānaṃ, tad anuśerate ye te mahāsrotonuśāyinaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā gulmaṃ niṣpādayanti ? ity āha-ūrdhvādha ity ādi| ūrdhvādhomārgam āvṛtya-āpūrya, anenāsya samprāptir uktā| śūlaṃ pūrvaṃ yasmin sa evaṃ taṃ śūlapūrvakam,-pūrvaṃ śūlaṃ kṛtvā paścād doṣā gulmaṃ kurvanti, anenāsya prāgrūpam uktam| tathā sparśopalabhyaṃ-aśmādisadṛśam, tathā utplutaṃ-ūrdhvaṃ gatam| tathā granthirūpiṇaṃ-granthyākāram, ity anenāsya saṃsthānam uktam| 00000

adhunā vātagulmaṃ lakṣayati -
- - - karśanāt kaphaviṭpittair mārgasyāvaraṇena vā|
vāyuḥ kṛtāśrayaḥ koṣṭhe raukṣyāt kāṭhinyam āgataḥ||39||
svatantraḥ svāśraye duṣṭaḥ paratantraḥ parāśraye|
piṇḍitatvād amūrto 'pi mūrtatvam iva saṃśritaḥ||40||
gulma ity ucyate bastinābhihṛtpārśvasaṃśrayaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|41|

Sa. karśanāt-dhātukṣayāt, vāyur duṣṭaḥ kadācit kaphaviṭpittaiḥ kṛtena mārgasyāvaraṇena-rodhena, koṣṭhe-āmapakvāśayākhye, kṛtāśrayo-gṛhītāspadaḥ, tathā raukṣyāt kāraṇāt kāṭhinyam āgataḥ-piṇḍitatvaṃ prāptaḥ, svāśraye-pakvāśayasthāne, duṣṭaḥ svatantraḥ, parāśraye-āmāśayasthāne, duṣṭaḥ paratantraḥ pittakaphayor āyattaḥ, piṇḍitatvāt kāraṇāt sparśopalabhyaḥ san, amūrto 'pi-akaṭhino 'pi, mūrtatvam iva-kāṭhinyam iva, saṃśritaḥ-sampanno, gulma ity abhidhīyate, tantrakṛdbhir iti śeṣaḥ| bastinābhihṛtpārśvasaṃśrayaḥ, bastyādiḥ saṃśrayaḥ-ādhāro, yasya sa evam| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
vātān manyāśiraḥśūlaṃ jvaraplīhāntrakūjanam||41||
vyadhaḥ sūcyeva viṭsaṅgaḥ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ muhuḥ|
stambho gātre mukhe śoṣaḥ kārśyaṃ viṣamavahnitā||42||
rūkṣakṛṣṇatvagāditvaṃ calatvād anilasya ca|
anirūpitasaṃsthānasthānavṛddhikṣayavyathaḥ||43||
pipīlikāvyāpta iva gulmaḥ sphurati tudyate| ------------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. vātād gulme sati manyāśūlādayo bhavanti| tathā, calatvāc ca vāyor gulmo 'nirūpitasaṃsthānasthānavṛddhikṣayavyathaḥ syāt| anirūpitāḥ saṃsthānādayo yasya sa evam| saṃsthānaṃ-ākāraḥ| sthānaṃ-āśrayaḥ| tathā, pipīlikābhir vyāptaḥ-cita iva, gulmaḥ sphurati tudyate ca| tudyata iti karmakartari| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
pittād dāho 'mlako mūrcchāviḍbhedasvedatṛḍūjvarāḥ||44||

lg.l: dūyate dīpyate soṣmā svasthānaṃ dahatīva ca||45||

div.ab: Sa. pittād gulme dāhādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā tvaṅnakhādiṣu hāridro varṇaḥ syāt| gulmaś ca sparśanaṃ na sahate-sparśanāsahaḥ, syāt| tathā, dūyate-upatapyate, dīpyate-jvalatīva| soṣmā ca syāt| sa ca svasthānaṃ-gulmāśritam āspadaṃ, dahatīva-taptāyaḥpiṇḍa iva| dūyata iti "dūḍ paritāpe" divādiḥ| 0000

kaphāt staimityam aruciḥ sadanaṃ śiśirajvaraḥ|
pīnasālasyahṛllāsakāsaśuklatvagāditāḥ||46||
gulmo 'vagāḍhaḥ kaṭhino guruḥ suptaḥ sthiro 'lparuk| ------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. kaphād gulme sati staimityādayaḥ syuḥ| gulmo 'vagāḍhādiyuktaḥ syāt| 00000

Sa. te ca gulmāḥ svadoṣasthānadhāmāno doṣasya-vātādeḥ, sthānaṃ-pakvāśayādi svam ātmīyam ātmīyaṃ, doṣasthānaṃ tad dhāma-sthānaṃ, yeṣāṃ-vātapittakaphagulmānāṃ, te prāyo-bāhulyena, svadoṣasthānadhāmānaḥ| tathā sve sve kāle-ātmīye vayohorātribhuktānām antamadhyādilakṣaṇe, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vātapittakaphagulmākkarāḥ-śūlakarāḥ, bhavanti| 00000

-----------trayas tu dvandvotthā gulmāḥ saṃsṛṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ|
sarvajas tīvrarugdāhaḥ śīghrapākī ghanonnataḥ||48|| so 'sādhyo------------------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. dvandvotthāḥ-saṃsargajā gulmās trayaḥ,saṃsṛṣṭalakṣaṇāḥ syuḥ| sarvajas tridoṣajo gulmas tīvrarugādiyuktaḥ| sa cāsādhyaḥ| 00000

-----------raktagulmas tu striyā eva prajāyate| atraivopapattim āha -
- - - ṛtau vā navasūtā vā yadi vā yonirogiṇī||49||
sevate vātalāni strī kruddhas tasyāḥ samīraṇaḥ|
niruṇaddhy ārtavaṃ yonyāṃ pratimāsam avasthitam||50||
kukṣiṃ karoti tad garbhaliṅgam āviṣkaroti ca|
hṛllāsadauhṛdastanyadarśanakṣāmatādikam||51||
krameṇa vāyusaṃsargāt pittayonitayā ca tat|
śoṇitaṃ kurute tasyā vātapittotthugulmajān||52||
rukstambhadāhātīsāratṛḍjvarādīn upadravān|
garbhāśaye ca sutarāṃ śūlaṃ duṣṭāsṛgāśraye||53||
yonyāś ca srāvadaurgandhyatodaspandanavedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. raktagulmaḥ punaḥ striyā eva prajāyate| ṛtau-ārtavakāle, navaprasūtā vā yonirogiṇī vā strī vātalāny annapānāni yadi sevate tasyāḥ-striyāḥ samīraṇaḥ-pavanaḥ, kupito yonyāṃ pratimāsaṃ yad avasthitam ārtavaṃ tad uparuṇaddhi| tat-ārtavaṃ, kukṣiṃ karoti, garbhaliṅgaṃ cāviṣkaroti-prakaṭayati| garbhaliṅgam iva liṅgaṃ yasyeti "saptamyupamānapūrvasya" iti bahubrīhir uttarapadalopaś ca| atha tad eva garbhaliṅgam āha-hṛllāsety ādi| munis tu raktagulme (ca. ni. a. 3|14)- "pādayoḥ śvayathur bhavati|" ity ūce| ādiśabdena mūrcchādīnāṃ grahaṇam| krameṇa-anantaraṃ, vāyusaṃsargāt-marutsaṃśleṣāt, tathā pittayonitayā ca-pittasya kāraṇatvena, tac choṇitaṃ vātapittotthagulmajān upadravān kurute rukstambhadāhātīsāratṛḍjvarādīn| anayā ca bhaṅgyā vātapittagulmayor upadravā apy uktā bhavanti| garbhāśaya ity ādi| gulmaś ca garbhāśaye sutarāṃ śūlaṃ karoti| kimbhūte ? duṣṭasyāsṛja āśraye-ādhārabhūte| yonyāś ca srāvādīn kurute| 00000

ab.seg:
garbhalakṣaṇād raktagulmasya vilakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇam āha - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
na cāṅgair garbhavad gulmaḥ sphuraty api tu śūlavān||54||

lg.l: piṇḍībhūtaḥ sa evāsyāḥ kadācit spandate cirāt|
na cāsyā varddhate kukṣigulma eva tu varddhate||55||

div.ab: Sa. na ca garbha ivāṅgaiḥ-pāṇyādibhir avayavaiḥ, sphurati-niḥspandate gulmo 'ṅgābhāvāt, api tu śūlavān| sa eva-gulmaḥ, piṇḍībhūtaḥ kadācic cireṇāsyāḥ spandate-na garbhavac chīghram| tathā, garbhe 'ntaḥsthite kukṣir asyā vardhate| gulme tv antaḥsthite sa eva vardhate gulmo, na kukṣiḥ| iti garbharaktagulmayor lakṣaṇabhedaḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
atha gulmavidradhyor lakṣaṇabhedaṃ kathayati -
- - - svadoṣasaṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati tena saḥ|
pākaṃ cireṇa bhajate naiva vā, vidradhiḥ punaḥ||56||

div.ab: Sa. sarvo gulmaḥ svadoṣaḥ saṃśrayo yasya sa evam| yena yena doṣeṇa vātādyanyatamenāthavā dvandvasvarūpeṇa sannipātenānyena vā gulmo jāyate sa doṣas tasya gulmasyāśrayaḥ| tad evaṃ vātagulmasya vāta evāśrayo, na tasya pittādayaḥ| pittādikṛtānāṃ ta evāśrayāḥ, na pavana āśrayaḥ| evaṃ svadoṣasaṃśrayo gulmaḥ sarvo bhavati| tena-svadoṣasaṃśrayākhyena kāraṇena, gulmaś cireṇa kālena pākaṃ bhajate| etac ca pittagulmaṃ prati prāyeṇa tathaikīyamatenoktam| ata evāha-naiva veti| athavā gulmaḥ pākaṃ na bhajata eva| vidradhis tu śīghraṃ-acireṇaiva kālena, pākaṃ bhajate, atyarthaṃ duṣṭaraktāśrayatvāt| ataḥ śīghravidāhitvāt kāraṇād asau vidradhir abhidhīyate| tathā cāgamaḥ (suśrute ni. a. 9|32)- "māṃsaśoṇibhūyastvāt pākaṃ gacchati vidradhiḥ| māṃsaśoṇitahīnatvād gulmaḥ pākaṃ na gacchati||" iti| tathā prāyeṇa vātātmakaḥ sarvo gulmo jāyate| vāta evāmūrto 'pi mūrtatvam iva saṃśrito gulma ity ucyate| ata eva vātasyaiva sarvagulmekāraṇaṃ prati prādhānyam| tasmād gulmasya pākānupapattiḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
atha gulmasya bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇam āha -
- - - gulme 'ntarāśraye bastikukṣihṛtplīhavedanāḥ|
agnivarṇabalabhraṃśo vegānāṃ cāpravartanam||58||

lg.l: ato viparyayo bāhye koṣṭhāṅgeṣu tu nātiruk|

ab.seg: iti gulmanidānam||3||

div.ab: Sa. gulme 'ntarāśraye-ābhyantare, bastyādivedanādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā, agnyādibhraṃśo-vināśo, vegānāṃ ca pravartanaṃ na bhavati| ataḥ-asmād bāhye, viparyayo-vaiparītyam| yathā,-agnyādibhraṃśābhāvo vegānāṃ ca pravartanaṃ bhavati| tathā, bastihṛdayādiṣu koṣṭhāṅgeṣv atiruṅ na bhavati| yathā'ntare tathā'vakāśasya gulmapradeśasya vaivarṇyaṃ-śarīrād anyavarṇatvam| bahiḥ-bāhyabhāge, unnatatvam adhikaṃ bhavati| 00000

ab.seg:
gulmānām ānāhabhūyiṣṭhatvād ānāhalakṣaṇam āha -
- - - sāṭopam atyugrarujam ādhmānam udare bhṛśam|
ūrdhvādhovātarodhena tam ānāhaṃ pracakṣate||60||

div.ab: Sa. [ ghano- ]nibiḍo, yo granthir aṣṭhīlayopamīyate tathordhvaṃ samunnataḥ-nādhastāt, sa granthir ānāhaliṅgo 'ṣṭhīlā bhaṇyate| tiryak ca (punaḥ) yo granthiḥ-nordhvaṃ samunnataḥ, tadākṛtiḥ-aṣṭhīlāsadṛśaḥ, sa granthiḥ pratyaṣṭhīlocyate| 00000

ab.seg:
tūnīpratūnyau lakṣayati -
- - - pakvāśayād gudopasthaṃ vāyus tīvrarujaḥ prayān|
tūnī, pratūnī tu bhavet sa evāto viparyaye||62||

div.ab: Sa. gudaṃ copasthaṃ ca gudopastham| pakvāśayāt-tato deśāt, vāyus tīvrarujaḥ san gudopasthaṃ prayān-gacchan, tūnīty ucyate| sa eva-vāyuḥ, ato viparyaye-gudopasthāt pakvāśayaṃ gacchan, tīvrarujaḥ san pratūnīti gadyate| 00000

udgārabāhulyapurīṣabandha- tṛptyakṣamatvāntravikūjanāni|
āṭopam ādhmānam apaktiśakti- māsannagulmasya vadanti cihnam|63| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|11|

Sa. udgārabāhulyādīny āsannagulmasya cihnaṃ-prāgrūpaṃ, vadanti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne vidradhivṛddhigulmanidānaṃ nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 11|| 00000

div.head: udaranidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. athodaranidānam ārabhyate| yato 'nantare 'dhyāya ānāhalakṣaṇam uktam| udaraṃ ca kukṣim ānahya doṣāḥ kurvate| 00000

ab.seg:
tasmād ato 'nantaram udaranidānam ucyate ity āha - - - - athāta udaranidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
rogāḥ sarve 'pi mande 'gnau sutarām udarāṇi tu|
ajīrṇān malinaiś cānnair jāyante malasañcayāt||1||

div.ab: Sa. sarve 'pi-jvarātīsārādayo, rogā mande 'gnau sati jāyante, atiśayena punar udarāṇi| anyebhyaś codarahetubhyo mandāgnitvaṃ pradhānam udarāṇāṃ kāraṇam iti mandegnāv ity anena prāg uddiṣṭena dyotayati| ajīrṇād ity ādi| caturvidhād ajīrṇāt-āmaviṣṭabdhavidagdharasaśeṣākhyāt, tathā malinaiś cānnaiḥ-pūtiparyuṣitasaṅkīrṇādilakṣaṇaiḥ, tathā malasañcayāt-cirakālasambhṛtād doṣāṇāṃ pracayāt, udarāṇi jāyante| 00000

adhunā samprāptiviśeṣam āha -
- - - ūrdhvādho dhātavo ruddhvā vāhinīr ambuvāhinīḥ|
prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya kuryas tvaṅmāṃsasandhigāḥ||2||
ādhmāpya kukṣim udaram------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. ambuvāhinīr vāhinīḥ-jalavāhinī srotāṃsi, ūrdhvādho ruddhvā dhātavo-vātādayaḥ, udaraṃ kuryuḥ| kīdṛśāḥ ? tvak ca māṃsaṃ ca tvaṅmāṃse, tayoḥ sandhiḥ-antaraṃ, tatra gacchantīti tvaṅmāṃsasandhigāḥ, tatrasthā ity arthaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā ? kukṣim ādhmāpya-ānahya| tathā, prāṇaś cāgniś cāpānaś ca tān prāṇāgnyapānān sandūṣya dūṣayitvā| prakṛtyā mando 'gniḥ punar vātādibhiḥ sandūṣito jaṭharaṃ karotīty arthaḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
-----------------------------aṣṭadhā tac ca bhidyate|
pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiś ca plīhabaddhakṣatodakaiḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. tac ca-udaraṃ, aṣṭadhā syāt| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphais trayaḥ, samastaiḥ-sannipātena caikaḥ, plīhodaraṃ baddhodaraṃ kṣatodaraṃ jalodaram iti [ ca catvāraḥ, evam aṣṭau ]| vātādikṛtāny api plīhādyudarāṇi plīhādinimittasaṃjñayoktāni| yathā, vṛddhyākhyo rogaḥ| saṃjñāviśeṣaś ca cikitsāviśeṣapratipattyarthaḥ| 00000

tenārtāḥ śuṣkatālvoṣṭhāḥ śūnapādakarodarāḥ|
naṣṭaceṣṭābalāhārāḥ kṛśāḥ pradhmātakukṣayaḥ||4||
syuḥ pretarūpāḥ puruṣāḥ------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. tena-udareṇa, ārtāḥ-pīḍitāḥ puruṣāḥ, śuṣkatālvoṣṭhāḥ śūnapādādayo naṣṭaceṣṭādikāḥ kṛśādayaś ca syuḥ| 00000

--------------------------bhāvinas tasya lakṣaṇam|
kṣunnāśo 'nnaṃ cirāt sarvaṃ savidāhaṃ ca pacyate||5||
jīrṇājīrṇaṃ na jānāti sauhityaṃ sahate na ca|
kṣīyate balataḥ śaśvac chvasity alpe 'pi ceṣṭite||6||
vṛddhir viśo 'pravṛttiś ca kiñcic chophaś ca pādayoḥ|
rug bastisandhau tatatā laghvalpābhojanair api||7|| rājījanma valīnāśo jaṭhare-----------------| ------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. tasya bhāvino-bhaviṣyato, lakṣaṇaṃ kṣunnāśādikaṃ syāt| tathā, bastisandhau ruk-śūlam| tathā, lagubhojanair alpabhojanair abhojanair api ca bastisandhau tatatā-vistīrṇatā, ādhmātatety arthaḥ| tathā, rājīnāṃ janma-sambhavo, valīnāṃ ca nāśo jaṭhare syāt| 00000

----------------------------------jaṭhareṣu tu|
sarveṣu tandrā sadanaṃ malasaṅgo 'lpavahnitā||8||
dāhaḥ śvayathur ādhmānam ante salilasambhavaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. jaṭhareṣu-jaṭharākhyeṣu, sarveṣu tu rogeṣu tandrā-ālasyaṃ, tathā sadanaṃ dehasya bhavati| tathā, malasya saṅgaḥ-purīṣasyāpravṛttiḥ| tathā, alpāgnitvam| tathā, dāhaḥ śvayathur ādhmānaṃ ca| ante-avasāne, salilasambhavaḥ| 00000

atoyam aduraṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇam ? ity āha - - - - ----------------------------------------------------|
sarvaṃ tv atoyam aruṇam aśophaṃ nātibhārikam||9||
gavākṣitaṃ sirājālaiḥ sadā guḍaguḍāyate|
nābhim antraṃ ca viṣṭabhya vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati||10||
māruto hṛtkaṭīnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇavedanāḥ|
saśabdo niścared vāyur viḍbaddhā mūtram alpakam||11||
nātimando 'nalo laulpaṃ na ca syād virasaṃ mukham| ------------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. sarvam udaram atoyaṃ-jalodaratām aprāptaṃ, varṇato 'ruṇaṃ, tathā'śophaṃ-śophenānākrāntaṃ, tathā nātibhārikaṃ-nātiśayena guru, tathā sirājālaiḥ-sirāsamūhair jālākṛtibhiḥ, gavākṣitaṃ-nirantaram ākrāntaṃ, sadā-sarvakālaṃ, guḍaguḍāyate-guḍaguḍa īdṛśam avyaktaṃ śabdam ācarati| tathā, māruto nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya-stabdhatāṃ nītvā, tathā'ntraṃ ca viṣṭabhya, vegaṃ kṛtvā-hṛtkaṭīnābhipāyuvaṅkṣaṇavedanā ity evaṃrūpam ātmīyaṃ saṃrambhaṃ pradarśyānantaraṃ, praṇaśyati| tathā, saśabdo vāyur antar niścaret-niryāti| tathā viḍbaddhā, tathā mūtram atiśayenālpaṃ syāt| tathā kiñcin mando 'gniḥ, tathā laulyaṃ-gṛddhiḥ, na ca virasaṃ mukhaṃ syāt| yatra tad atoyasambhavaṃ vedyam| asmāc ca viparītalakṣaṇaṃ sāmarthyāt satoyam| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
tatra vātodare śophaḥ pāṇipānmuṣkakukṣiṣu||12||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-teṣūdareṣu madhye, vātodare śophaḥ pāṇyādiṣu, tathā kukṣyādiṣu ruk parvabhedanaṃ tathā śuṣkakāsādayaḥ syuḥ| akasmāt-nimittaṃ vinā, udaraṃ vṛddhihrāsayutaṃ syāt, tathā satodabhedaṃ, tathā tanukṛṣṇasirābhis tataṃ-vyāptam, āhataṃ ca tad udaram ādhmātabhastreva śabdaṃ karoti| atra ca-vātodare, vāyuḥ sarukśabdaḥ sarvatogatiś ca san vicaret-bhramati| 00000

lg.l: pittodare jvaro mūrcchā dāhas tṛṭ kaṭukāsyatā|

div.ab: Sa. pittodare jvarādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā, tvagādau pītatvaṃ bhavati| jaṭharaṃ haritavarṇaṃ tathā pītatāmrābhiḥ sirābhir naddhaṃ-yuktaṃ, sasvedaṃ śoṣma ca syāt, dahyate-tapyate ca| tathā, dhūmāyati| tathā, mṛduḥ-akaṭhinaḥ, sparśo yasya tad evam| tathā, kṣiprapākaṃ syāt| pradūyate-upatapyate ca| 00000

Sa. śleṣmodare 'ṅgasādādayaḥ syuḥ| tathodaraṃ stimitaṃ-niścalam, tathā ślakṣṇaṃ-komalasparśam, tathā śuklarājībhis tataṃ-vyāptam, tathā bṛhat, tathā cirābhivṛddhi kaṭhinaṃ ca tathā śītasparśam, tathā guru, tathā sthiraṃ-na tu calam| 00000

adhunā sannipātodaraṃ lakṣayitum āha -
- - - tridoṣakopanais tais taiḥ strīdattaiś ca rajomalaiḥ|
garadūṣīviṣādyaiś ca saraktāḥ sañcitā malāḥ||20||
koṣṭhaṃ prāpya vikurvāṇāḥ śoṣamūrcchābhramānvitam|
kuryus triliṅgam udaraṃ śīghrapākaṃ sudāruṇam||21||
bādhate tac ca sutarāṃ śītavātābhradarśane| ------------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. malāḥ-vātādayaḥ, saraktāḥ sañcitās triliṅgaṃ-tridoṣalakṣaṇaṃ, tathā śoṣādiyutaṃ, tathā śīghrapākaṃ, tathā sudāruṇam udaraṃ kuryuḥ| kimbhūtaiḥ sañcitāḥ ? tridoṣakopanaiḥ-saṅkīrṇādibhojanaiḥ, tais taiḥ-sarvaroganidānoktaiḥ, tathā striyā dattai rajomalaiḥ-kārmaṇāparaparyāyair vaśīkaraṇaiḥ, tathā gareṇa dūṣīviṣādyaiś ca| ādiśabdena viruddhābhyavahārāder grahaṇam| anenāsya hetuviśeṣakathanam| kīdṛśā doṣāḥ ? koṣṭhaṃ prāpya-āśritya, vikurvāṇāḥ-vikriyāṃ yātāḥ| tac ca-jaṭharaṃ, sutarāṃ śītavātābhradarśane bādhate| ity anenāsya viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ kathitam| 00000

ab.seg:
plīhodarādīny adhunā lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
atyāśitasya saṅkṣobhād yānayānādiceṣṭitaiḥ||22||

lg.l: śoṇitaṃ vā rasādibhyo vivṛddhaṃ taṃ vivarddhayet|
krameṇa varddhamānaś ca kukṣāv udaram āvahet|

div.ab: Sa. atitṛptasya narasya yānagamanādiceṣṭitair yaḥ saṅkṣobhas tasmāt, tathā'tivyavāyādibhiḥ karśanaiḥ plīhā sthānāt-svāśayāt, cyuto vivardhate-viśeṣeṇa vṛddhiṃ gacchati| kimbhūtaḥ plīhā ? vāmapārśvāśritaḥ| athavā rasādibhyo dhātubhyaḥ śoṇitaṃ vivṛddhaṃ-vṛddhihetubhir adhikaṃ kṛtvā vṛddhiṃ prāptaṃ, anantaraṃ taṃ-plīhānaṃ svasthānāc cyutam acyutaṃ vā, viśeṣeṇa vardhayet-svapramāṇād ādhikyaṃ janayet| saḥ-plīhā, aṣṭhīlevātikaṭhinaḥ prāg bhūtvā, tataḥ-anantaraṃ, kacchapapṛṣṭhākṛtiḥ krameṇa-na sahasaiva, vardhamānaḥ-ādhikyaṃ gacchan, kukṣau-svīye sthāne, udaraṃ vidadhyāt| kīdṛśam ? śvāsādibhir dāhamohaparyantaiḥ saṃyutam| tathā, aruṇābhaṃ-aruṇavarṇam, athavā vivarṇaṃ-aniścitavarṇam, tathā nīlahāridrarājimat evaṃvidhā rājayo vidyante yasmiṃs tad evam| 00000

Sa. tatra-plīhodare, pṛthaglakṣaṇalakṣitān malān-vātādīn, krameṇodāvartādinā vidyāt| tatrodāvartarujānāhair vātaṃ vidyāt| mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ pittaṃ vidyāt| gauravārucikāṭhinyaiḥ kaphaṃ vidyāt| 00000

atha yakṛl lakṣayati -
- - - plīhavad dakṣiṇāt pārśvāt kuryād yakṛd api cyutam| ------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. yathā pūrvoktair hetubhiḥ plīhā vāmapārśvāc cyuto vivardhate-vivṛddho bhūtvā'nantaram udaram āvahet, tadvad yakṛd api dakṣiṇāt pārśvāc cyutaṃ sad vardhate-vṛddhaṃ sad udaraṃ kurute| athavā śoṇitaṃ svahetuto vivṛddhaṃ yakṛd vivardhayet, tac ca vivṛddham udaram āvahet| iti plīhodarayakṛdudarayoḥ sādṛśyam| 00000

atha baddhodaraṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
pakṣmavālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktair baddhāyane gude||28||
durnāmabhir udāvatair anyair vā'ntropalopibhiḥ|
varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā karoti kupito 'nilaḥ||29||
apāno jaṭharaṃ tena syur dāhajvaratṛṭkṣavāḥ|
kāsaśvāsorusadanaṃ śirohṛnnābhipāyuruk||30||
malasaṅgo 'ruciś cchardir udaraṃ mūḍhamārutam|
sthiraṃ nīlāruṇasirārājinaddham arāji vā||31||
nābher upari ca prāyo gopucchākṛti jāyate| ------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. pakṣmāṇi ca vālāś ca pakṣmavālāḥ, tair annena saha bhuktair baddhāyane gude saty apāno vāyurviguṇaḥ-kupito, jaṭharaṃ karoti| baddham ayanaṃ-dvāraṃ purīṣānilavāhi, yasya tad evaṃvidhe gude| tathā durnāmabhir gude baddhāyane, tathodāvartair baddhāyane, tathā'nyair vā'ntropalepibhiḥ-upadehibhir dadhyodanamāśomādibhiḥ, gude baddhāyane, apāno jaṭharaṃ karoti| kiṃ kṛtvā ? varcaḥpittakaphān ruddhvā-āvṛtya, tad baddhodaram ucyate| tena-baddhodareṇa, dāhajvaratṛṭkṣavāḥ syuḥ| tathā, kāsaśvāsāv ūrusadanaṃ śirohunnābhipāyuruk syāt| tathā, malānāṃ-mūtrapurīṣādīnāṃ, saṅgaḥ-apravartanam| arucis tathā chardiḥ syāt| tathodaraṃ mūḍhamārutaṃ bhavet| mūḍho-bahiraniḥsaraṇarūpo, māruto yasmiṃs tad evam| mūḍhamārutatvasya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva gṛhītatvāt punargrahaṇam atiśayārtham| tathā, sthiraṃ-acalam| tathā, nīlāruṇasirārājibhir naddhaṃ-vyāptam, athavā'rāji syāt| tac codaraṃ prāyo nābher upariṣṭād gopucchākṛti jāyate| yathā yathordhvaṃ tathā tathā sūkṣmam ity arthaḥ| anenāsya saṃsthānam uktam| 00000

adhunā chidrodaraṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
asthyādiśalyaiḥ sānnaiś cadbhuktair atyaśanena vā||32||
bhidyate pacyate vā'ntraṃ tacchidraiś ca sravan bahiḥ|
āma eva gudād eti tato 'lpālpaṃ saviḍrasaḥ||33||
tulyaḥ kuṇapagandhena picchilaḥ pītalohitaḥ|
śeṣaś cāpūrya jaṭharaṃ jaṭharaṃ ghoram āvahet||34||
varddhayet tad adho nābher āśu caiti jalātmatām|
udriktadoṣarūpaṃ ca vyāptaṃ ca śvāsatṛḍbhramaiḥ||35||
chidrodaram idaṃ prāhuḥ parisrāvīti cāpare| ------------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. asthitṛṇakaṇṭakapāṣāṇadhātuśṛṅgadārvādiśalyaiḥ sānnaiḥ-sahabhojanena bhuktaiḥ| athavā, atyaśanena-atimātrabhojanena, yadā'ntraṃ bhidyate-sacchidraṃ sampadyate, athavā pacyate-pākaṃ yāti| tacchidraiś ca-antracchidrair bhedotpannaiḥ, pākato vā, bahir āma eva-aparipakva eva, saviḍrasaḥ sravann alpālpam eva gudād eti-āyāti| tulyaḥ-sadṛśaḥ, kuṇapagandhena-śavagandhena| tathā picchilaḥ, pītalohitaś ca varṇena| śeṣaś ca raso-yo gudān nāgacchati, sa jaṭharam āpūrya-pūrayitvā, ghoraṃ-kaṣṭataraṃ, jaṭharākhyaṃ vyādhiṃ kuryāt| tat-udaraṃ, adho nābher vardhayet-vṛddhiṃ gacchet| vardhiś curādiḥ| tathā, āśu-śīghram eva, jalātmatāṃ-jalodaratvam eti, udriktadoṣarūpaṃ ca| udriktaṃ-adhikaṃ, doṣāṇāṃ-vātapittakaphānāṃ, rūpaṃ-ākṛtiḥ, yasya tad evam| tathā, śvāsatṛḍbhramair vyāptam idam udaraṃ chidrodaraṃ prāhur ācāryāḥ| apare tv ācāryāḥ parisrāvīty āhuḥ| 00000

athodakodaradarśanārtham āha - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
pravṛttasnehapānādeḥ sahasā''māmbupāyinaḥ||36||
atyambupānān mandāgneḥ kṣīṇasyātikṛśasya vā|
ruddhvā'mbumārgān anilaḥ kaphaś ca jalamūrchitaḥ||37||
vardhayetāṃ tad evāmbu tatsthānād udarāśritau|
tataḥ syād udaraṃ tṛṣṇāgudasrutirujānvitam||38||
kāsaśvāsāruciyutaṃ nānāvarṇasirātatam|
toyapūrṇadṛtisparśaśabdaprakṣobhavepathu||39||
dakodaraṃ mahat snigdhaṃ sthiram āvṛttanābhi tat| ------------------------------------------------|40|

Sa. pravṛttaṃ-ārabdhaṃ, snehapānādi yena sa pravṛttasnehapānādiḥ| ādigrahaṇād vamanādikaṃ karma pañcavidhaṃ gṛhyate| tasya tathābhūtasya sahasā''māmbupāyinaḥ-sahasaivāpakvapānīyapasya, tathā mandāgneḥ-naṣṭavahneḥ, tathā kṣīṇasya-viśiṣṭavyādhyākrāntatayā dhātvapacayavataḥ, tathā'tikṛśasya-anaśanādinā kṣīṇamedomāṃsasya, evaṃvidhasya puruṣasyātyambupānād ambumārgān-toyavāhini srotāṃsi, ruddhvā'nilaḥ kaphaś ca| kimbhūtaḥ ? jalamūrchitaḥ-toyamiśritaḥ| tāvubhau vātakaphau jalamūrchitāv udarāśritau tad evāmbu tatsthānāt-udakasthānāt klemato, varddhayetām| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, udaraṃ syāt| tṛṣṇādiyutaṃ, tathā kāsādiyutaṃ, tathā nānāvarṇābhiḥ-anekavarṇābhiḥ sirābhiḥ, tataṃ-vyāptam| toyety ādi| śabdasya prakṣobhaḥ-saṃrambhaḥ śabdaprakṣobhaḥ, vepathuḥ-kampaḥ, sparśaś ca śabdaprakṣobhaś ca vepathuś ca ta evam, toyena pūrṇā toyapūrṇā, sā cāsau dṛtiś ca toyapūrṇadṛtiḥ, toyapūrṇadṛtivat sparśaśabdaprakṣobhavepathavo yasminn udare tat toyapūrṇadṛtisparśaśabdaprakṣobhavepathu, dakodaraṃ-jalodaraṃ, syāt| tac ca mahat-anyebhya udarebhyo vistīrṇam, tathā snigdhaṃ, tathā sthiraṃ-acalam, āvṛttanābhi tat, āsamantād vṛttā-vartulā, nābhir yasya tad evam| 00000

adhunā jaṭhare 'py avasāne yathā jalasambhavaḥ syāt tathā''ha - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
upekṣayā ca sarveṣu doṣāḥ svasthānataś cyutāḥ||40||
pākād dravā dravīkuryuḥ sandhisrotomukhāny api|
svadeś ca bāhyasrotaḥsu vihatastiryag āsthitaḥ||41||
tad evodakam āpyāyya picchāṃ kuryāt tadā bhavet|
gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ vṛttam āhataṃ ca na śabdavat||42||
mṛdu vyapetarājīkaṃ nābhyāṃ spṛṣṭaṃ ca sarpati|
tadanūdakajanmāsmin kukṣivṛddhis tato 'dhikam||43||
sirāntardhānam udakajaṭharoktaṃ ca lakṣaṇam| ------------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. upekṣayā-acikitsanāt, sarveṣūdareṣu, doṣāḥ-vātapittakaphāḥ, svasthānataḥ-ātmīyāt sthānāt, cyutāḥ-sthānāntaraṃ gatāḥ, tathā pākād dhetos te doṣā dravā adhikaṃ dravīkuryuḥ sandhisrotomukhāny api| andhayaś ca srotomukhāni ca sandhisrotomukhāni-dvārāṇi| na kevalaṃ svayaṃ doṣā dravatvaṃ gatāḥ, yāvat sandhisrotomukhāny api dravīkuryuḥ, ity apiśabdārthaḥ| svedaś ca bāhyasrotaḥsu saṃvṛteṣu vihato-niruddhaḥ, tiryagāsthitaḥ-tiryak pravṛttaś ca, tad evodakaṃ prāk kukṣau vṛddhiṃ gatam āpyāyya-vṛddhiṃ gamayitvā, picchāṃ kuryāt| tadā bhaved gurūdaraṃ sthiraṃ-acalaṃ, vṛttaṃ-vartulaṃ, ca| tathā''hataṃ ca pāṇyādinā na śabdavat-naśabdayuktam, tathā mṛdu-akaṭhinam, tathā vyapetā rājyo yasmāt tad vyapetarājīkaṃ syāt| nābhyāṃ ca spṛṣṭaṃ sat sarpati-prasāri sampadyate| tadanu-tato 'nantaram, asmin-udarākhye vyādhau, udakajanma-jalasambhavaḥ| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, adhikaṃ kṛtvā kukṣivṛddhir bhavet| tathā, sirāntardhānaṃ-sirāṇām adarśanam| kim etad eva lakṣaṇam? nety āha-udakajaṭharoktaṃ ca lakṣaṇam| na kevalaṃ yad adhunaivoktaṃ lakṣaṇam, yāvaj jalodaroktaṃ ceti caśabdasyārthaḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
idānīm udarāṇāṃ sukhasādhyatvābhāvāt kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyatve vedayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
vātapittakaphaplīhasannipātodakodaram||44||

lg.l: kṛcchraṃ yathottaram pakṣāt paraṃ prāyo 'pare hataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. vātādyudbhavam udaraṃ yathottaraṃ kṛcchram| tena vātodarāt pittodarāt pittodaraṃ yāvad udakodaram atyarthaṃ kṛcchram, kṛcchrasādhyatvāt| pāṭhāpekṣayā ye dve apare-baddhakṣatodare, te prāyaḥ pakṣāt paraṃ-anantaraṃ, hato-mārayataḥ| prāyograhaṇāt-kadācin niyatāyuṣy utpanne naiva mārayataḥ| kilopekṣayā sarveṣūdareṣv ante salilasambhava ity uktam| sarvaṃ ca jaṭharaṃ jātodakaṃ yad vātādisamutthaṃ kṛcchram uktaṃ tad api hanty eva| atrāpi prāyograhaṇam anuvartanīyam| kadācij jātodakam api na mārayati, api tu yāpayaty eva| tathā, riṣṭoktopadravānvitaṃ-riṣṭādhyāyoktair upadravair yuktaṃ "jaṭharaṃ hanti durbalam| śūnākṣaṃ kuṭilopasthaṃ" (hṛ. śā. a. 5|90) ity ādibhiś ca, tad api hanti| 00000

janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam|
balinas tad ajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam|46| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|12|

Sa. janmanaiva-jātyaiva svabhāvenaiva, udaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam, vyādhisvabhāvāt| prāyograhaṇāt kiñcid udaraṃ kṛcchram eva bhavati, na kṛcchratamam| ata evāha-balina ity ādi| balino-balavataḥ, tad udaram utthitaṃ navaṃ sat ajātodakaṃ sat, yatnasādhyam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne udaranidānaṃ nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 12|| 00000

div.head: pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānadhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. udaranidānād anantaraṃ pāṇḍuśophavisarpanidānam ārabhyate| 00000

yato yathaivodaraṃ doṣasaṅghātajaṃ tathaite 'pi, ity āha - - - - athātaḥ pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
pittapradhānāḥ kupitā yathoktaiḥ kopanair malāḥ|
tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam||1||
dhamanīrdaśa samprāpya vyāpnuvat sakalāṃ tanum|
śleṣmatvagraktamāṃsāni pradūṣyāntaram āśritam||2||
tvaṅmāṃsayos tat kurute tvaci varṇān pṛthagvidhān|
pāṇḍuhāridraharitān pāṇḍutvaṃ teṣu cādhikam||3|| yato 'taḥ pāṇḍur ity uktaḥ sa rogaḥ-------------| ------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. yatra malāḥ-vātādayaḥ, pittapradhānā yathoktaiḥ-sarvaroganidānādyuktaiḥ, kopanaiḥ kupitāḥ-kruddhāḥ, pāṇḍurogahetavaḥ| katham ? ity āha-tatrety ādi| [ tatra- ] teṣu tathābhūteṣu satsu, vātena balinā-balavatā, kṣiptaṃ pittaṃ hṛdi sthitam anantaraṃ tat pittaṃ dhamanīr daśa-hṛdi sthitāḥ, samprāpya-āśritya, sakalāṃ tanuṃ vyāpnuvat-aśnuvānam| sakalaśabdopādānaṃ mūtrapurīṣādīnām api grahaṇārtham| ata evākhyāsyati (ślo. 9) - "kṛṣṇarūkṣāruṇasirānakhaviṇmūtranetratā|" iti| tathā śleṣmatvagraktamāṃsāni pradūṣya| kimbhūtaṃ pittam ? tvaṅmāsayor antaraṃ-madhyam āśritam| tat-pittaṃ, tvaci varṇān pṛthagvidhān-nānāprakārān, pāṇḍuhāridraharitān kurute| teṣu-varṇeṣu madhye, yato-yasmāt, atiśayena pāṇḍutvam adhikam ataḥ-asmāt, sa rogaḥ pāṇḍur ity uktaḥ-saṃjñitaḥ| nanu, 'pittapradhānāḥ' iti katham uktam ? yāvatā (yato) vāyor balīyastvāt 'vātapradhānāḥ' iti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ syāt| balīyastvaṃ cānantaram eva pratipāditaṃ 'tatrānilena balinā kṣiptaṃ' iti| asad etat| yato nātra balīyastvābalīyastvakṛte prādhānyāprādhānye vivakṣite| kin tarhi ? pāṇḍurogakaraṇaṃ prati kartṛtvākartṛtve| pittasya ca pāṇḍurogakaraṇaṃ prati mukhyaṃ kartṛtvam, ataḥ 'pittapradhānāḥ' iti yuktam uktam| nanu, yadi trayo doṣāḥ pāṇḍurogahetavaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi vakṣyati ? (ślo. 7) - "sa pañcadhā pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastair mṛttikādanāt|" iti| ucyate| sarvaḥ pāṇḍurogas tridoṣaja eva| kintu hetuviśeṣair yo rūpabhedas tena pañcātmakaḥ śophavat, iti na kiñcid atrāyuktam| 00000

----------------------------------tena gauravam|
dhātūnāṃ syāc ca śaithilyam ojasaś ca guṇakṣayaḥ||4||
tato 'lparaktamedasko niḥsāraḥ syāc chlathendriyaḥ|
mṛdyamānair ivāṅgair nā dravatā hṛdayena ca||5||
śūnākṣikūṭaḥ sadanaḥ kopanaḥ ṣṭhīvano 'lpavāk|
annadviṭ śiśiradveṣī śīrṇaromā hatānalaḥ||6||
sannasaktho jvarī śvāsī karṇakṣveḍī bhramī śramī| ------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. tena-pāṇḍurogeṇa, dhātūnāṃ-rasarudhirādīnāṃ, gauravaṃ śaithilyaṃ ca syāt| tathā, ojaso guṇakṣayo-mādhurya(manda)śaityādīnām ojoguṇānāṃ (hṛ. ni. a. 6|1) vināśaḥ| tata eva-ojoguṇakṣayāt, pāṇḍvāmayī naro 'lparaktamedaskaḥ| alpe raktamedasī yasya sa evam| tathā, niḥsāro-durbalaḥ syāt|tathā ślathendriyaḥ| [ ślathāni- ] śithilāni, indriyāṇi-vākpāṇipādapāyūpastharūpāṇi, yasya sa ślathendriyaḥ| tathā, indriyaśabdena buddhīndriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnām adhiṣṭhānāny upalakṣyante| nanu, pittapradhānāḥ kupitā iti pittavṛddhir uktā| pittavṛddhyā ca raktavṛddhyā bhavitavyam| tat katham uktam alparaktateti ? atrocyate| doṣāṇām anyonyadūṣaṇāt dūṣasya ca doṣair dūṣitatvāt prasādaparamparayā'puṣṭau satyāṃ kiṭṭabāhulyāt pitta[sya]adhikyam, na raktasya prasādātmakasya, iti pittādhikyam alparaktatā cety upapannam| tathā, aṅgaiḥ-avayavaiḥ, mṛdyamānair ivāsau nara upalakṣitaḥ, tathā hṛdayena dravatā ca| tathā, śūnāv akṣikūṭau yasya sa evam| tathā, sadanaḥ-aṅgasādavān| tathā, kopanādikaḥ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
sa pañcadhā pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastair mṛttikādanāt||7||

div.ab: Sa. saḥ-pāṇḍurogaḥ, pañcadhā syāt| katham ? ity āha-pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sannipātena mṛdbhakṣaṇāc ca| nanu, mṛttikādanāt pṛthag pāṇḍurogo na vācyaḥ, pṛthagvātādidoṣaje pāṇḍuroge 'ntarbhūtatvāt| mṛdā hi vātādiprakopo vidhīyate tiktoṣaṇādibhir iva| vātādiprakopaś ca pāṇḍurogakṛt| tasmāt pṛthaṅ mṛdo na yukto nirdeśaḥ| atra brūmaḥ| mṛdo 'nye ye vātādiprakopahetavaḥ pāṇḍurogasampādane sambhāvanāyogyāḥ, te pāṇḍurogaṃ sampādya hetusvarūpasattayā vinivartante| mṛttikā tu tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanair vinā pāṇḍurogaṃ yāvat kāye 'vatiṣṭhate| ity ayaṃ vātādikopahetubhyo 'nyebhyo mṛdaḥ pāṇḍurogaṃ prati viśeṣaḥ| tasmān mṛdā pṛthak pāṇḍurogo vaktuṃ nyāyyaḥ| 00000

prāgrūpam asya hṛdayaspandanaṃ rūkṣatā tvaci|
aruciḥ pītamūtratvaṃ svedābhāvo 'lpavahnitā||8|| sādaḥ śramo-------------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. asya pāṇḍurogasya hṛdayaspandanādi prāgrūpam| 00000

--------------anilāt tatra gātraruktodakampanam|
kṛṣṇarūkṣāruṇasirānakhaviṇmūtranetratā||9||
śophānāhāsyavairasyaviṭśoṣāḥ pārśvamūrdharuk| ------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. tatra-teṣu pāṇḍurogeṣu madhye, vātāt pāṇḍuroge gātrarugādayaḥ syuḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
pittād dharitapītābhasirāditvaṃ jvaras tamaḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. pittād dharitapītābhasirāditvaṃ(tvādi) syāt| 00000
Sa. kaphāc chuklasirāditā[di] syāt| 00000
Sa. nicayāt-sannipātāt, miśraliṅgaḥ pāṇḍurogaḥ so 'tiduḥsaho-ghoratamaḥ| 00000

mṛtkaṣāyā'nilaṃ pittam ūṣarā madhurā kapham|
dūṣayitvā rasādīṃś ca raukṣyād bhuktaṃ virūkṣya ca||13||
srotāṃsy apakvaivāpūrya kuryād ruddhvā ca pūrvavat|
pāṇḍurogaṃ tataḥ śūnanābhipādāsyamehanaḥ||14||
purīṣaṃ kṛmiman muñced bhinnaṃ sāsṛkkaphaṃ naraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. mṛdbhakṣitā kaṣāyarasā vātaṃ dūṣayitvā pāṇḍurogaṃ kuryāt| ūṣarā-sakṣāramṛttikā, pittaṃ dūṣayitvā pāṇḍurogaṃ kuryāt| madhurā mṛttikā kaphaṃ dūṣayitvā pāṇḍurogaṃ kuryāt| tathā, rasādīṃś ca dhātūn dūṣayitvā raukṣyāc ca hetor bhuktaṃ virūkṣya ceti| yataḥ svabhāvata eva mṛttikā rūkṣā| tasmād bhuktaṃ virūkṣayati| srotāṃsi cāpūrya ruddhvā'pakvaiva satī pāṇḍurogaṃ pūrvavat pittapradhānāḥ kupitā ity ādinā nyāyena kuryāt| mṛttikāyā gurutvāt pākābhāvaḥ| athavā aśabdo 'treṣadarthe| alomikā eḍaketi yathā| tena kiñcit pakveti gamyate| tataḥ-tena pāṇḍurogeṇa, śūnanābhyādikaḥ san kṛmyādiyutaṃ purīṣaṃ muñcet| 00000

ab.seg:
atha pratijñāvākye 'nuktām api kāmalāṃ tulyahetvādikatvāt pradarśayann āha - - - - ------------------------------------------------------|
yaḥ pāṇḍurogī seveta pittalaṃ tasya kāmalām||15||

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- kiṃ pāṇḍurogiṇa eva pittalāny āsevamānasya kāmalā bhavet, utāpāṇḍurogiṇo 'pi ? ity āha -
- - - bhavet pittolbaṇasyāsau pāṇḍurogād ṛte 'pi ca||17||

div.ab: Sa. yo naraḥ pāṇḍurogī san pittalaṃ-maricakāñcikādidravyam atyarthaṃ, seveta-upayuṅkte, tasya-pāṇḍurogiṇaḥ, pittaṃ kartṛ kāmalām āvahet| kīdṛśīm| koṣṭhaśākhāśrayām| koṣṭho-mahāsrotaḥ, śākhā-raktādayastvak ca, iti tad ubhayam āśrayo yasyās tām, kiṃ kṛtvā ? raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca dagdhvā| katham ? hāridranetramūtratvaṅnakhavaktraśakṛttayā| tadā ca puruṣo dāhādimān maṇḍūkacchāyo durbalendriyaś ca syāt| durbalāni-svaviṣaye 'py aśaktāni, indriyāṇi yasya sa evam| pāṇḍurogam antareṇāpi pittādhikasya narasya pittalāny āsevamānasyāsau koṣṭhaśākhāśrayā kāmalā syāt, na kevalaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇaḥ| 00000
upekṣayā ca śophāḍhyā sā kṛcchrā kumbhakāmalā| ------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. upekṣayā-cikitsāṃ vinā, saiva-kāmalā, yadā śophāḍhyā-śvayathubahulā, syāt tadā kumbhakāmalety ucyate| kṛcchrā-kṛcchrasādhyā| 00000

halīmakaṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
haritaśyāvapītatvaṃ pāṇḍuroge yadā bhavet||18||
vātapittād bhramas tṛṣṇā strīṣv aharṣo mṛdur jvaraḥ|
tandrābalānalabhraṃśo loḍharaṃ taṃ halīmakam||19||
alasaṃ ceti śaṃsanti----------------------| ------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. pāṇḍuroge sati yadā haritaśyāvapītatā bhramādayaś ca vātapittāt syuḥ, ataś ca taṃ halīmakaṃ śaṃsanti, munaya iti śeṣaḥ| taṃ ca halīmakaṃ, loḍharaṃ tathā'lasaṃ cācakṣate| 00000

----------------------teṣāṃ pūrvam upadravāḥ|
śophapradhānāḥ kathitāḥ sa evāto nigadyate||20|| iti pāṇḍuroganidānam| ------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------ atha śophanidānam|
pittaraktakaphān vāyur duṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥsirāḥ|
nītvā ruddhagatis tair hi kuryāt tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam||21||
utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śophaṃ tam āhur nicayād ataḥ| sarvaṃ---------------------------------------|22|

Sa. teṣāṃ-pāṇḍurogaprakārāṇāṃ, pūrvam upadravā yataḥ śophapradhānāḥ kathitāḥ| ataḥ-asmād dhetoḥ, pāṇḍuroganidānād anantaraṃ śopha eva bhaṇyate, na visarpaḥ| śophaḥ pradhānaḥ-prathamo, yeṣāṃ ta evaṃ kathitāḥ| kvaḥ ? ihaiva| yathoktam (ślo. 6)- "śūnākṣikūṭaḥ" ity ādi| tathā (ślo. 14)- "śūnanābhipādāsyamehanaḥ" iti| bahirbhūtāḥ sirā bahiḥsirāḥ,-bāhyāḥ sirāḥ| vāyuḥ pittaraktakaphān karmabhūtān bahiḥ sirāḥ karmabhūtā nītvotsedhaṃ kuryāt| nayater dvikarmakatvāt pittādayo bahiḥsirāś ca karma| yathā,-ajāṃ nayati grāmam iti| tenāyam artho 'vatiṣṭhate-bahiḥsirāsu pittādīn nītveti| kimbhūto vāyuḥ ? duṣṭaḥ san,-kopanaiḥ kupitaḥ| kimbhūtam utsedham ? tvak ca māṃsaṃ ca tvaṅmāṃse, te saṃśrayaḥ-āśrayo, yasya tam| tair hīti hiśabdo 'vadhāraṇe| tair eva-bahiḥsirāḥ prāptaiḥ pittaraktakaphaiḥ, ruddhagatiḥ| ata eva saṃhataṃ-samantād dhataṃ niścalam iva sampannaṃ, utsedham| yataś caivaṃ vātapittakaphaiḥ śophaḥ sañjāyate, tasmāt sarvaṃ śophaṃ nicayāt-doṣatrayāt, āhuḥ| 00000

nanu, evaṃ satīdaṃ virudhyate "doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvai" iti| ata āha - - - - -----------------------------------------| ------------hetuviśeṣais tu rūpabhedān navātmakam||22||
doṣaiḥ pṛthag dvayaiḥ sarvair abhighātād viṣād api| ------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. tuśabdo viśeṣārthaḥ| yady api sarvas tridoṣajaḥ śophas tathā'pi hetuviśeṣair yo rūpabhedas tasmān navātmakaṃ śopham āhuḥ| tathā hi-yo 'yaṃ sannipātaḥ śophahetur eṣa kadācit samaṃ kṛtvā kupyati kadācid viṣamaṃ kṛtvaikadoṣavṛddhisvarūpatayā| evaṃ ca hetuviśeṣair yo lakṣaṇabhedas tasmān navaprakāratvaṃ śophasya nyāyyam eva| lakṣaṇabhedaś caiṣāṃ spaṣṭa eva| tathā cābhighātād dhetoś ca yathāvad anyal lakṣaṇaṃ viṣād dhetor anyal lakṣaṇaṃ tadvat pṛthagvātādeś ca yathāvad anyat dvandvaje cānyat sannipātaje cānyad iti| evaṃ lakṣaṇaviśeṣān navātmakam āhuḥ| upalakṣaṇaṃ cedam, cikitsāviśeṣād api hi navātmaka eva śophaḥ| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
dvidhā vā nijam āgantuṃ sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ ca tam||23||
pṛthūnnatagrathitatāviśeṣaiś ca tridhā viduḥ| ------------------------------------------------|24|

Sa. athavā nijāgantubhedena dvidhā śvayathum āhuḥ| tathā, taṃ-śophaṃ, sarvāṅgajaṃ-sarvaśarīrajaṃ, ekāṅgajaṃ-ekāvayavajaṃ ca, iti punar dviprakāram āhuḥ| pṛthuś connataś ca grathitaś ca teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ pṛthūnnatagrathitatā, tayā viśeṣās tais tridhā-triprakāraṃ, śophaṃ viduḥ| vidur iti "vida jñāne" ity asmād usādeśaḥ| pṛthutvena-vistīrṇakṛtatvena viśeṣeṇa, tathonnatatvena viśeṣeṇa, tathā grathitasvarūpatvena viśeṣeṇeti yojyam| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
sāmānyahetuḥ śophānāṃ doṣajānāṃ viśeṣataḥ||24||

lg.l: anye ca mithyopakrāntās tair doṣā vakṣasi sthitāḥ||28||
ūrdhvaṃ śopham adho bastau madhye kurvanti madhyagāḥ|

div.ab: Sa. vakṣyamāṇo gurvamlasnigdhādiko vargaḥ [ śophānāṃ- ] śvayathūnāṃ nijānām āgantūnāṃ ca, sāmānyahetuḥ-utpattau kāraṇam| doṣajānāṃ śvayathūnāṃ punar atiśayena hetuḥ, na tathā''gantūnāṃ, iti viśeṣaśabdena dyotayati| vyādhikarmopavāsādibhiḥ kṣīṇasya, vyādhinā-jvarādinā kṣīṇasya, tathā karmaṇā-pañcavidhena vamanavirecananirūhānuvāsananasyākhyena, tathopavāsena, ādigrahaṇād anyena ca mārgādinā kṣīṇasya, drutaṃ kṛtvā-sahasaiva, gurvādikaṃ bhajataḥ| atheti samuccaye| vyādhyādikṣīṇalakṣaṇebhyaḥ sakāśādanyasya svasthāder apy atimātraṃ-mātrām atikramya, bhajato doṣā vakṣasi sthitā ūrdhvaṃ śophaṃ kurvanti, prakṛtatvād vakṣasa ūrdhvam| bastau sthitā adhaḥ śophaṃ kurvanti| madhye sthitā doṣā madhye śophaṃ kurvanti| grāmyāṇāṃ-caṭakakukkuṭādīnāṃ, māṃsaṃ grāmyamāṃsam| vallūraṃ-śuṣkamāṃsam| svapno 'trāhaḥsvapno jāgaraś ca rātrijāgaro bodhyaḥ| yānena-turagādinā, kṣobhiṇā-śarīrasaṃrambhajanakena| tathā, śvāsādayaḥ pāṇḍuparyantā rogāḥ prādhānyena| tathā, anye 'pi-śvāsakāsādivyatiriktā rogāḥ, mithyopakrāntāḥ-mithyopacaritā ayathāśāstram upakrāntāḥ, śophahetavaḥ| tair api doṣā vakṣasi sthitā ūrdhvaṃ śophaṃ kurvanti| bastau sthitā adho, madhyagā madhye, sarvāṅgagāḥ sarvagataṃ, pratyaṅgeṣu tadāśrayāḥ, doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvanti| 00000
tatpūrvarūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo 'ṅgagauravam| ------------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. tasya-śvayathoḥ, pūrvarūpaṃ tatpūrvarūpam| davathuḥ-cakṣurādiṣu yas tīvra ūṣmā sa bhaṇyate| yad uktam-"davathuś cakṣurādibhyas tīvram ūṣmapravartanam|" iti| tathā, sirāyāmo-yatra pradeśe śvayathur udbubhūṣus tatra sirāṇāṃ dairghyam iva| tathā, aṅgagauravaṃ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
vātāc chophaś calo rūkṣaḥ khararomā'ruṇāsitaḥ||30||

lg.l: snigdhoṣṇamardanaiḥ śāmyed rātrāv alpo divā mahān|

div.ab: Sa. vātāc chophaś calādilakṣaṇaḥ| 00000
Sa. pittāc chophaḥ pītaraktāsitābhāsādilakṣaṇaḥ| sa ca madhye-madhyapradeśe, prāk-pūrvaṃ, jāyate| prāggrahaṇaṃ paścāt sakale 'pi dehadeśe syād iti dyotayati| 00000

kaṇḍūmān pāṇḍuromatvak kaṭhinaḥ śītalo guruḥ|
snigdhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ sthiraḥ styāno nidrācchardyagnisādakṛt||35||
ākrānto nonnamet kṛcchraśamajanmā niśābalaḥ|
sraven nāsṛk cirāt picchāṃ kuśaśastrādivikṣataḥ||36||
sparśoṣṇakāṅkṣī ca kaphāt------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|37|

Sa. kaphāc chophaḥ kaṇḍūyutādilakṣaṇaḥ syāt| tathā, ākrāntaḥ-pīḍitaḥ san, vātika iva nonnamet| tathā, kṛcchre śamajanmanī yasya sa evam| tathā, niśābalo-rātrāv adhika ity arthaḥ| tathā, kuśaśastrādibhir vikṣataḥ sa śopho na raktaṃ sravet| kin tarhi ? cireṇa picchāṃ-lasīkāparaparyāyāṃ, sravet| tathā, sparśābhilāṣī uṣṇābhilāṣī ca syāt| 00000
-----------------------yathāsvaṃ dvandvajās trayaḥ| saṅkarād dhetuliṅgānām---------------------------|37|
Sa. hetavaś ca liṅgāni ca, teṣāṃ saṅkarāt-saṅkīrṇatvena, yathāsvaṃ dvandvajās trayaḥ śophāḥ, syur iti śeṣaḥ| 00000
Sa. nicayātmako-doṣatrayajaḥ śopho, nicayāt-hetuliṅganicayāt, syāt| 00000

lg.l: rasaiḥ śūkaiś ca saṃsparśāc chvayathuḥ syād visarpavān|

div.ab: Sa. tathā, śastrādicchedabhedakṣatādibhir yaḥ śophaḥ so 'bhighātena, vedya iti śeṣaḥ| tathā, himenānilena tathodadhyanilena-sāgarajena vāyunā, tathā rasaiḥ śūkaiś ca bhallātakapikacchujaiḥ saṃsparśāc chvayathur visarpavān bhavet| sa ca bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaś ca bāhulyena ca pittalakṣaṇaḥ syāt| pittaśophasya lakṣaṇaṃ pittaśophalakṣaṇam, pittaśophalakṣaṇam iva lakṣaṇaṃ yasya sa pittalakṣaṇaḥ| saptamyupamānapūrvasyeti bahuvrīhir uttarapadalopaś ca| 00000

viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt|
daṃṣṭrādantanakhāpātād aviṣaprāṇinām api||40||
viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāt|
viṣavṛkṣānilasparśād garayogāvacūrṇanāt||41||
mṛduś calo 'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ| ------------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. viṣajaḥ śophaḥ saviṣāṇāṃ prāṇinām aṅge parisarpaṇāt-gamanāt, tathā teṣām eva mūtraṇāt| tathā, daṃṣṭrādantanakhānām āpātāt aviṣaprāṇinām api śophaḥ syāt| apiśabdān na kevalaṃ saviṣaprāṇinām| tathā, viṇmūtraśukrair upahataṃ-tatsparśād dūṣitam apraśastam| viṇmūtraśukropahataṃ ca tan malavac ca viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavat, tathāvidhaṃ ca tad vastraṃ ca, tasya saṅkaraḥ-saṃsparśaḥ, tasmād api śophaḥ syāt| tathā viṣavṛkṣāṇām anilas tasya saṃsparśāt, garayogasyāvacūrṇanaṃ-avadhvaṃsanaṃ, tasmāc ca mṛdvādiguṇayuktaḥ śvayathuḥ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
navo 'nupadravaḥ śophaḥ sādhyo 'sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ||42||
iti śophanidānam||4||

div.ab:
śvayathuvad doṣair dūṣyaiś ca yato visarpo bhavati,atas tannidānaṃ prakamyate - - - - ------------------------------------- atha visarpanidānam|
syād visarpo 'bhighātāntair doṣair dūṣyaiś ca śophavat| ------------------------------------------------|43|

Sa. visarpaḥ sarva eva śophavat| doṣaiḥ-pṛthagvātapittakaphair dvayaiḥ samastais tathā'bhighātāt, evamabhighātāntair doṣaiḥ śophavad visarpasambhavaḥ| dūṣyair api śophavat| evaṃ "pittaraktakaphān vāyuḥ" (ślo. 21) ity ādir api grantho 'tra yojyaḥ| 00000

Sa. taṃ ca-visarpaṃ, tryadhiṣṭhānaṃ prāhuḥ, ātreyādaya iti śeṣaḥ| [ kasmāt ? ] bāhyāntarubhayāśrayāt-pūrvārjitakarmavaśāt kadācid bāhyāśrayo visarpo jāyate, bāhya āśrayo yasya sa tathā, evaṃ kadācid antarāśrayaḥ, kadācid ubhayāśrayaḥ, [ tasmāt ]| te ca bāhyāntarubhayāśrayā visarpā yathottaraṃ duḥsādhyāḥ| duḥkhena sādhyanta iti duḥsādhyāḥ| 00000

ab.seg:
--------------------tatra doṣā yathāyatham|
prakopaṇaiḥ prakupitā viśeṣeṇa vidāhibhiḥ||44||

lg.l: dehe śīghraṃ visarpanti te 'ntar antaḥsthitā bahiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. tasmin visarpe yathāyathaṃ prakopaṇaiḥ-tiktoṣaṇādibhiḥ, prakupitā viśeṣeṇa punar vidāhibhir atyarthaṃ kṛtvā prakupitā dehe śīghraṃ-āśv eva, visarpanti| te 'ntaḥsthitā antar visarpanti| bahiḥsthā doṣā bahir visarpanti| dvitaye 'ntarbahīrūpe, dvisthāḥ-ubhayasthāḥ santo, visarpanti| 00000

------------------------------------------------| ------------------------vidyāt tatrāntarāśrayam||45||
marmopatāpāt sammohād ayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt|
tṛṣṇātiyogād vegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt||46||
āśu cāgnibalabhraṃśād ato bāhyaṃ viparyayāt| ------------------------------------------------|47|

Sa. tatra-teṣu triṣu visarpeṣu madhye, antarāśrayaṃ visarpaṃ marmopatāpādibhir vidyāt| marmaṇāṃ-hṛdayādīnāṃ, upatāpo-duḥkhaṃ, tasmāt| tathā, sammohāt-mūrcchodbhavāt| ayanānāṃ-karṇanāsādīnāṃ, vighaṭṭanāt-viśeṣeṇa calanād atiśayena parisphuraṇād ity arthaḥ| tathā, tṛṣṇāyā atiyogāt| tathā vegānāṃ-nānārūpāṇāṃ vedanānāṃ, viṣamaṃ kṛtvā-vicchidya vicchidya kṛtvā, pravartanāt| āśu ca-śīghram eva, agnibalayor bhraṃśāt-vināśāt| ato [ viparyayāt-pūrvoktāntarvisarpa ] lakṣaṇaviparyayāt, bāhyaṃ-bāhyāśrayaṃ, visarpaṃ vidyāt| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
tatra vātāt parīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ||47||
śophasphuraṇanistodabhedāyāmārtiharṣavān| ------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. [tatra-] teṣu visarpeṣu madhye, vātādyo visarpaḥ sa vātajvaratulyavyathaḥ syāt śophādiyutaś ca| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
pittād drutagatiḥ pittajvaraliṅgo 'tilohitaḥ||48||

div.ab: Sa. pittād visarpo drutagatiḥ-śīghravyāpī, tathā pittajvaraliṅgo 'tilohitaś ca syāt| pittajvaraliṅgānīva liṅgāni yasya, iti saptamyupamānapūrvasyety ādinā bahuvrīhir uttarapadalopaś ca| 00000
kaphāt kaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk| ------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. kaphād visarpaḥ kaṇḍūmān snigdhaḥ kaphajvaratulyaruk ca| vātādijvaralakṣaṇaṃ yathoktam (hṛ. ni. a. 2|11) - "vaiṣamyaṃ tatra tatrāṅge tās tāḥ syur vedanāś calāḥ|" ity ādi| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
svadoṣaliṅgaiś cīyante sarve sphoṭair upekṣitāḥ||49||
te pakvabhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ca bibhrati vraṇalakṣaṇam| ------------------------------------------------|50|

Sa. sarve ca visarpā upekṣitāḥ-upakramarahitāḥ, sphoṭaiś cīyante-vyāpyante| kimbhūtaiḥ ? svadoṣaliṅgaiḥ-yathāyathaṃ svadoṣalakṣaṇaiḥ| te ca pakvabhinnāḥ svaṃ svaṃ-ātmīyam ātmīyaṃ doṣaṃ(ṣajaṃ), vraṇalakṣaṇaṃ bibhrati-dhārayanti| pūrvaṃ pakvāḥ paścād bhinnāḥ pakvabhinnāḥ, "pūrvakāla" ity ādinā samāsaḥ| "tatra mārutāt| śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo 'ruṇaḥ" (hṛ. u. a. 25|5) ity ādigranthanirdiṣṭaṃ vraṇalakṣaṇam| "pittena kṣiprajaḥ" ity ādigranthanirdiṣṭam| evaṃ kaphādilakṣaṇam api bodhyam| 00000

adhunā dvandvajaṃ lakṣayati - - - - ------------------------------------------------|
vātapittāj jvaracchardimūrcchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ||50||
asthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakair yutaḥ|
karoti sarvam aṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat||51||
yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaś ca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ|
śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vā''śu ca cīyate||52||
agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvād drutaṃ ca saḥ|
marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syād vāto 'tibalas tataḥ||53||
vyathetāṅgaṃ haret saṃjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsam īrayet|
hidhmāṃ ca sa gato 'vasthām īdṛśīṃ labhate na nā||54||
kvacic charmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu|
ceṣṭamānas tataḥ kliṣṭo manodehaśramodbhavām||55||
duṣprabodho 'śnute nidrāṃ so 'gnivīsarpa ucyate| ------------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. vātapittād visarpo jvarādibhir yutaḥ sakalam aṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat-jvalitāṅgāravyāptasadṛśaṃ karoti| yaṃ yaṃ ca śarīradeśaṃ visarpo visarpati-prasarati, sa sa pradeśaḥ śāntāgāravad asito nīlo rakto vā bhavet| tathā, saḥ-visarpo, drāg evāgnidagdha iva sphoṭaiś cīyate-vyāpyate| sa ca visarpaḥ śīghragatvāt-tatsvabhāvavaśāt, marmānusārī drutaṃ-tvaritaṃ kṛtvā, syāt| tata eva ca vāto 'tibalo-balīyān, aṅgaṃ-śarīraṃ, vyatheta-pīḍayet| saṃjñāṃ-saṃvidaṃ, haret-nāśayet, nidrāṃ ca haret| śvāsam īrayet-kuryāt, tathā hidhmāṃ ca| saḥ-visarpī, nā-puruṣaḥ, īdṛśīm avasthāṃ gataḥ-prāptaḥ, cetonavasthālakṣaṇayā-aratyā, grastaḥ-abhibhūto, na kvacid bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu śarma-sukhaṃ, labhate| aratigrasta iti hetau prathamā, aratigrastatvād ity arthaḥ| evaṃ kvacid api sukhālābhād bhūmyādiṣu ceṣṭamānaḥ-pariluṭhan, tataḥ kliṣṭo-manasā kāyena ca, manodehaśramodbhavāṃ-tadutthāṃ, nidrām aśnute| kimbhūtaḥ ? duṣprabodhaḥ,-duḥkhena prabodho-nidrāpagamo, yasya sa evam| eṣa cāgnyākhyo visarpa ucyate| 0000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham||56||

div.ab: Sa. kaphena pavano ruddhas tam eva-kaphaṃ, bahudhā bhitvā granthīnāṃ mālāṃ kurute| raktaṃ ca vṛddharaktasya narasya dūṣayitvā granthīnāṃ mālāṃ kurute| kimbhūtaṃ raktam ? tvaksirāsnāvamāṃsagam| kimbhūtānāṃ granthīnām ? dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharasvabhāvānāṃ tathā raktavarṇānām| kimbhūtām, mālām ? tīvrarugjvarām| tīvrau rugjvarau yasyās tām tathā śvāsādibhir yutām| ity ayaṃ-anantarokto, granthivīsarpa ucyate| kaphavātakopajaś cāyaṃ vedyaḥ| 00000

lg.l: āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati||61||
śavagandhiś ca vīsarpaṃ kardamākhyam uśanti tam||64||

div.ab: Sa. kaphapittāt kardamākhyo jāyate| tatra jvarādayaḥ syuḥ| sa ca-visarpaḥ, prāyeṇa-bāhulyena, āmāśaye-nābhistanāntaramadhye, ekadeśaṃ gṛhṇan-ākrāman, anantaraṃ dehaṃ sarpati-vyāpnoti| na cātiruk syāt| tathā, piṭakair avakīrṇo-vyāptaḥ, syāt| kimbhūtaiḥ ? atipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ| tathā, mecakābhādikaḥ syāt| mecako-mayūrakaṇṭhasadṛśo varṇaḥ| taṃ-tādṛśaṃ, visarpaṃ kardamākhyaṃ-kardamasaṃjñaṃ, uśanti, munaya iti śeṣaḥ| 00000
sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvadhātvatisarpaṇaḥ| ------------------------------------------------|65|
Sa. sarvais tribhir doṣair jātaḥ sarvajaḥ-sannipātodbhavo, vīsarpaḥ sarvair lakṣaṇair upalakṣitaḥ| sa ca sarvān dhātūn atiśayena sarpati sarvadhātvatisarpaṇaḥ syāt| 00000

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittam īrayan||65||

div.ab: Sa. māruto-vātaḥ, kṣatād bāhyakāraṇāt kruddhaḥ san visarpaṃ kuryāt| kiṃ kurvan ? pittaṃ saha raktena prerayan| tathā, sphoṭaiḥ-piṭakaiḥ, cittaṃ-vyāptam| kimbhūtaiḥ ? kulatthasadṛśaiḥ| tathā, śophādibhir āḍhyaṃ-atiśayena yutam| tathā, śyāvalohitaṃ-varṇena| 00000

pṛthagdoṣais trayaḥ sādhyā dvandvajāś cānupadravāḥ|
asādhyo kṣatasarvotthau sarve cākrāntamarmakāḥ|67|
śīrṇasnāyusirāmāṃsāḥ praklinnāḥ śavagandhayaḥ| 67 1/2| iti visarpanidānam| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|13|

Sa. pṛthagdoṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphaiḥ kevalaiḥ, trayo visarpāḥ sādhayituṃ śakyāḥ| dvandvajāś cānupadravāḥ-kāsavaivarṇyajvarādibhir upadravaiḥ (hṛ. śā. a. 5|97) rahitāḥ, trayaḥ sādhyāḥ| kṣatasarvotthau dvau visarpāv asādhyau, tathāsvabhāvatvāt| sarve visarpāś cākrāntamarmakāḥ-abhibhūtamarmakāś ca, asādhyāḥ| tathā, śīrṇāni snāyusirāmāṃsāni yais te 'py asādhyāḥ| tathā, prakarṣeṇa-atiśayena klinnāḥ, tathā śavagandhayaḥ-kuṇapagandhatulyāḥ, ye te 'py asādhyāḥ| śavasyeva gandho yeṣām iti "upamānāc ca" iti gandhasyedādeśaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ tṛtīye nidānasthāne pāṇḍurogaśophavisarpanidānaṃ nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 13|| 00000

div.head: kuṣṭhaśvitrakṛminidānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. visarpanidānād anantaraṃ tulyahetvāditvāt kuṣṭhanidānam ārabhyate- 00000

ab.seg: athātaḥ kuṣṭhaśvitrakṛminidānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

lg.l: pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ prāktanair voritā malāḥ|
tvacaḥ kurvanti vaivarṇyaṃ duṣṭāḥ kuṣṭham uśanti tat||3||

div.ab: Sa. mithyāhārādinā tathā sādhunindāvadhādibhiḥ pāpmabhiḥ karmabhiḥ sadyaḥ sevitaiḥ-anuṣṭhitaiḥ, prāktanair vā-anyajanmācaritaiḥ| sevitagrahaṇena sātatyānuṣṭhānaṃ dyotayati| tena kadācitkaraṇatvam eṣāṃ na kuṣṭhahetur iti gamyate| tais tathābhūtaiḥ karmabhir mithyāhārādinā ca īritāḥ-duṣṭāḥ, malāḥ-vātapittakaphāḥ, śirās tiryaggāminīḥ prapadya-āśritya, tvaglasīkāsṛgāmiṣaṃ dūṣayanti| tad eva ca tvagādikaṃ śithilīkṛtya tataḥ-anantaraṃ, bahir niścaranto-bāhyadeśe prasarantaḥ, tvaco [ yat ] vaivarṇyaṃ kurvanti tat kuṣṭham uśanti, munaya iti śeṣaḥ| 00000

kuto 'sya rogasya kuṣṭham iti saṃjñā ? ity āha -
- - - kālenopekṣitaṃ yasmāt sarvaṃ kuṣṇāti tad vapuḥ|
prapadya dhātūn vyāpyāntaḥ sarvān saṃkledya cāvahet||4||
sasvedakledasaṅkothān kṛmīn sūkṣmān sudāruṇān|
lomatvaksnāyudhamanītaruṇāsthīni yaiḥ kramāt||5||
bhakṣayec chvitram asmāc ca kuṣṭhabāhyam udāhṛtam| ------------------------------------------------|6|

Sa. yasmād dhetor upekṣitaṃ-anupakrāntaṃ sat, kālena sarvaṃ vapuḥ-śarīraṃ, kṛṣṇāti tasmāt tat kuṣṭham ity ucyate| tac ca kuṣṭhaṃ dhātūn sarvān prapadya-prāpya, anantaram antar vyāpya-prakṛtatvāt teṣām evāntaraṃ vyāpya, tathā sarvaṃs tān eva dhātūn saṃkledya-kledayitvā, kṛmīn āvahet-kuryāt| kimbhūtān ? svedādibhir yutān| tathā, sūkṣmān| tathā, sudāruṇān-duścikitsyān| yaiḥ-kṛmibhiḥ, tat kuṣṭhaṃ lomādīn bhakṣayet| śvitrasyedṛgrūpatā na vidyate yā kuṣṭhasyoktā| asmāc ca kāraṇāc chvitraṃ kuṣṭhabāhyam udāhṛtam, kuṣṭhād bāhyaṃ tvaggatamātram evoktam ity arthaḥ| 00000

------------------------------------------------|
kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅmiśraiḥ samāgataiḥ||6|| nanu, evaṃ saty ekadoṣajaṃ dvidoṣajaṃ kuṣṭham, na sarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ syāt, ity āśaṅkyāha -
- - - sarveṣv api tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo 'dhikatvataḥ|7|

Sa. kuṣṭhāni saptadhā-saptaprakārāṇi| katham ? ity āha-pṛthak-vātapittakaphaiḥ| tair eva ca miśraiḥ-vātapittābhyāṃ vātakaphābhyāṃ pittakaphābhyām| tair eva doṣaiḥ samāgataiḥ-sannipatitaiḥ| sarveṣv api kuṣṭheṣu tridośeṣu - sannipātajeṣv api, adhikatvena vyapadeśaḥ| sannipātasya samaviṣamātmakatvāt| 00000

ata āha -
- - - vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ, pittād audumbaraṃ, kaphāt||7||
maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca, ṛkṣākhyaṃ vātapittajam|
carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikāḥ||8||
vātaśleṣmodbhavāḥ, śleṣmapittād dadruśatāruṣī|
puṇḍarīkaṃ savisphoṭaṃ pāmā carmadalaṃ tathā||9|| sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ-------------------------| ------------------------------------------------|10|

Sa.
