nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaśuṅgāś ca dvipalonmitāḥ|
triprasthe salilasyaitat kṣīraprasthe ca sādhayet||126||
kṣīraśeṣe kaṣāye ca tasmin pūte vimiśrayet|
kalkīkṛtaṃ mocarasaṃ samaṅgā candanotpalam||127||
priyaṅguṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ kamalasya ca kesaram|
picchābastir ayaṃ siddhaḥ saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaraḥ||128||
pravāhikāgudabhraṃ śaraktasrāvajvarāpahaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|129|

Sa. yavāsādīnāṃ mūlaṃ śālmaleḥ puṣpaṃ tathā nyagrodhādīnāṃ ca śuṅgā etad dravyakadambakaṃ pratyekaṃ dvipalapramāṇaṃ jalaprasthatraye kṣīraprasthe ca pācayet| kṣīraśeṣe ca kaṣāye tasmin pūte sati kalkīkṛtaṃ mocarasādi miśrayet| mocarasādayo 'tra satribhāgamātraśāṇakarṣamātrā grāhyā. (?), bastikalpe kośātakādau niruhe (hṛ. ka. a. 4/17) viṃśatipalapramāṇe kārṣikāṇām eva dravyāṇām abhyanujñānāt| ayaṃ picchābastiḥ siddho ghṛtamākṣikaśarkarānvitaḥ pravāhikādiharaḥ| alpayā mātrayā niruho bastir eva picchābastir ucyate|

---------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭyāhvapuṇḍarīkeṇa tathā mocarasādibhiḥ||129||
kṣīradviguṇitaḥ pakvo deyaḥ sneho 'nuvāsanam| ---------------------------------------------|130|
Sa. madhuyaṣṭikayā prapauṇḍarīkeṇa tathā mocarasādibhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ (ślo.127) kalkīkṛtaiḥ, kṣīradviguṇitaḥ pakvaḥ san sneho 'nuvāsanaṃ deyaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
madhukotpalarodhnāmbu samaṅgā bilvacandanam||130||

div.ab: Sa. madhukādidravyaiḥ snehacaturthabhāgapramāṇaiś cāṅgerīsvarase ghṛtāc caturguṇe ghṛtaṃ sādhitaṃ tridoṣajit| arśaḥprabhṛtiṣv etad ghṛtaṃ deyam| yataḥ paramauṣadham|
Sa. vyatyāsena-viparyayeṇa, madhurāṇy amlāni ca śītāny uṣṇāni ca nityam agnibalāpekṣī yojayet| evaṃ cārśaḥkṛtām atiśayinīṃ rujaṃ jayati|

lg.l: susnigdhaiḥ svedayet piṇḍair vartim asmai gude tataḥ||135||

div.ab: Sa. udāvartenārtaṃ naraṃ tailaiḥ śītajvarāpahaiḥ-tagarāgurukuṅkumādidravyasādhitaiḥ, abhyajya susnigdhaiḥ piṇḍaiḥ svedayet| tataḥ-svedād anantaram, asmai-udāvartavate, gude 'bhyakte 'bhyaktāṃ varti dadyāt| tatkarāṅguṣṭhasannibhāṃ-āturahastāṅguṣṭhasadṛśīm| tathā, anulimakarīṃ dadyāt-kṣipet| kaiḥ kṛtāṃ vartim ? ity āha śyāmety ādi| śyāmādibhiḥ saindhavākṣalavaṇayuktaiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtair guḍagomūtrasaṃyuktaiḥ kṛtāṃ varti kṣipet| tathaiva māgadhikāmadanaphalagṛhadhūmasarṣapair guḍagomūtrānbitair varti kṣipet|
eteṣām eva vā cūrṇaṃ gude nāḍyā vinirdhamet| ---------------------------------------------|138|
Sa. athavā, eteṣām eva-pūrvoktānāṃ, cūrṇaṃ nādyā gude vinirdhamet|

---------------------------------------------|
tadvighāte sutīkṣṇaṃ tu bastiṃ snigdhaṃ prapīḍayet||138||
ṛjū kuryā-daśirāviṇmūtramaruto 'sya saḥ|
bhūyā'nubandhe vātaghner virecyaḥ sneharecanaiḥ||139||
anuvāsyaś ca raukṣyād dhi saṅgo mārutavarcasoḥ| ---------------------------------------------|140|

Sa. tadvivāte-kāryaṃ kartum aśakte tasmiṃśrūrṇe, basti snigdhaṃ snehabastiṃ, sutīkṣṇaṃ dadyāt| saḥ-bastiḥ, asya-āturasya, gudaśirāviṇmūtravātān anulomayet| punar anubandhe sati sneharecanair virecanīyaś cānuvāsanīyaś ca| hi-yasmāt, raukṣyād dhetor marutasya purīṣasya ca saṅgo bhavati|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tripaṭucikaṭuśreṣṭhādantyaruṣkaracitrakam||140||

lg.l: sa pītaḥ sarpiṣā yukto bhakte vā snigdhabhojinā|

div.ab: Sa. tripaṭvādi jarjarīkṛtaṃ-sūkṣmīkṛtaṃ, snehamūtrābhyām akta mantardhūmaṃ kṛtvā vipācayec charāvasampuṭe| ata evāha-śarāvasandhau mṛllipta iti| ayaṃ ca kalyāṇako nāma kṣāraḥ sarpiṣā pītaḥ snehabhojinā vā bhakte yuktaḥ sann udāvartādīn nāśayet|
sarvaṃ ca kuryād yat proktam arśasāṃ gāḍhavarcasām| ---------------------------------------------|144|
Sa. yac ca gāḍhavarcasām arśasāṃ proktaṃ tac ca sarvaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg:
droṇe 'pāṃ pūtivalkadvitulam atha pace- tpādaśeṣe ca tasmin deyā'śītiruguḍasya pratanukarajaso vyoṣato 'ṣṭau palāni|
etan māsena jātaṃ janayati paramā- mūṣmaṇaḥ paktiśaktiṃ śuktaṃ kṛtvā''nulomyaṃ prajayati gudaja- plīhagulmodarāṇi||144||

div.ab: Sa. dvayos tulayoḥ samāharo dvitulam| pūtikarañjasya tvacas tulādvayaṃ-palaśatadvayaṃ, jaladroṇe pacet| tasmiṃś ca pādaśeṣe sati guḍasyāśītiḥ palāni kṣeptavyāni| trikaṭukasya sūkṣmacūrṇasyāṣṭau palāni deyāni| etat sarvaṃ māsena śuktaṃ jātaṃ prabalam agni kurute| ānulomyaṃ kṛtvā gudajādiṇ jayati| sragdharāvṛttam|

lg.l: pacet tulāṃ pūtikarañjavalkād dve mūlataś citrakakaṇṭakāryoḥ|
droṇatraya'pāṃ caraṇāvaśeṣe pūte śataṃ tatra guḍasya dadyāt||145||

ab.seg:
palikaṃ ca sūcirṇitaṃ trijāta trikaṭugranthikadāḍimāśmabhedam|
purapuṣkaramūladhānyacavyaṃ hapuṣām āRdrakam amlavetasaṃ ca||146||

lg.l: yuktaṃ kāmaṃ gaṇḍikābhis tathekṣoḥ sarpiḥpātre māsamātreṇa jātam||147||
cukraṃ krakacam ivedaṃ durdāmnāṃ vahnidīpanaṃ paramam|

div.ab: Sa. pūtikarañjatvacas tulām ekāṃ dve ca tule citrakakaṇṭakārīmūlayor jaladroṇatraye pacet| pādaśeṣe ca tasmin pūte guḍasya palaśataṃ dadyāt| upajātivṛttam| trijātakādi sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ pratyekaṃ palapramāṇaṃ niḥkṣipet| etat sarvaṃ cūrṇitaṃ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaṃ dadyāt| aupacchandasikaṃ vṛttam| etac ca śītībhutaṃ sat kṣaudraviṃśatyopetam ārdradrākṣādibhiś copetam ikṣugaṇḍikābhiśśca yathecchaṃ yuktaṃ sarpiḥpātre māsamātreṇa jātaṃ cukram iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| śuktam idam arśasāṃ krakacam iva-karapatratulyaṃ, kartanaśaktisāmārthyāt| tathā paraṃ vahnidīpanaṃ pāṇḍhvādighnaṃ ca| śālinīvṛttam, āryā ca|

lg.l: droṇaṃ pīlurasasya vastragalitaṃ nyastaṃ havirbhājane yuñjīta dvipalair madāmadhuphalākharjūradhātrīphalaiḥ|
guḍapalaśatarojitaṃ nivāte nihitam idaṃ prapibaṃś ca pakṣamātrāt|
niśamayati gudāṅkurān sugulmā- nanalabalaṃ prabalaṃ karoti cāśu||150||

div.ab: Sa. pīluphalānāṃ rasasya droṇaṃ vastrapūtaṃ sarpirbhāṇḍe nyastaṃ madādibhir dvipalapramāṇaiḥ pāṭhādibhiś ca pālikair yuñjīta| madā dhātakī| madhuphalā-drākṣā| mādrī-reṇukā| vidulo-vetasaḥ| śārdūlavikrīḍitam| tathā guḍapalaśatena yojitaṃ nivāte dhṛtaṃ pakṣamātrād anantaraṃ prapiban nara idam arśāsi gulmaṃ ca śamayati| drāg agnibalaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ vidhatte| puṣpitāgrā|

ab.seg:
kaikaśo daśapale daśamūlakumbha pāṭhādvayārkauṇavallabhakaṭphalaghnām|
dagdhe srute 'nu kalaśena jalena pakve pādāsthate guḍatulāṃ, palapañcakaṃ ca||151||

vahnar muṣṭī dve yavakṣārataś ca|
darvīm ālimpan hanti līḍho guḍo 'yaṃ gulmaplīhārśaḥkuṣṭhamehāgnisādān||152||

div.ab: Sa. daśamūlādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ daśapale dagdhe jaladroṇena srute jale pakve pādaśeṣe cāsmin guḍatulāṃ vyoṣādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ palapañcakaṃ dadyāt| citrakasya paladvayaṃ yavakṣārasya ca paladvayaṃ dadyāt| darvīm ālimpan darvīlepī sann ayaṃ guḍo līḍho-bhakṣito, gulmādīn parākaroti| vasantatilakaṃ vaiśvadevīyaṃ vṛttaṃ ca|

lg.l: toyadroṇe citrakamūlatulārdhaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvat pādadalastham athedam|
aṣṭau datvā jīrṇaguḍasya palāni kvāthyaṃ bhuyaḥ sāndratayā samam etat||153||
jayati gudajakuṣṭhaplīhagulmodarāṇi prabalayati hutāśaṃ śaśvad abhyasyamānaḥ||154||

div.ab: Sa. toyasya droṇe citrakamūlasya tulārdhaṃ sādhyaṃ yāvad aṣṭāṃśaśeṣam idaṃ syāt| tataḥ purāṇagudapalāny aṣtau dattvā punar api kvāthyaṃ yāvat sāndratvaṃ gatam| "mtau jyo bhadrā vedavasū ca virāmaḥ|" trikaṭukādicūrṇayukto 'yaṃ leho nityam abhyasyamāno dāruṇa(durnāma) kuṣṭhādīni jayati| agniṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ kurute| mālinīvṛttam|

lg.l: arśāṃsi hanti gulikā tvagvikāraṃ ca śīlitā||155||

div.ab: Sa. guḍādibhir gulikā kṛtā'bhyastā durnāmāni hanti tvagvikāraṃ ca|
Sa. sauraṇaṃ kandaṃ mṛdā liptam agnau puṭapākavat pakvaṃ tailalavaṇānvitam aśnīyād durnāmopaśamāya|

lg.l: cūrṇikṛtāḥ ṣoḍaśa sūraṇasya bhāgās tato 'rdhena ca citrakasya|
mahauṣadhād dvau maricasya caiko guḍena durnāmajayāya piṇḍī||158||

div.ab: Sa. maricādīn kramavardhitabhāgān citrakacaturguṇasūraṇayojitān guḍān guḍena kuru gudāṅkuracchidaḥ| drutavilambitam| sūkṣmarajīkṛtāḥ sūraṇabhāgāḥ ṣoḍaśa, citrakabhāgā aṣṭau, nāgarasya dvau, maricasya caiko, guḍenaiṣāṃ piṇḍī *kṛtā durnāmajayāya syāt| upajātivṛttam|

lg.l: vaḍavāmukha iva jarayati bahugurv api bhojanaṃ cūrṇaḥ||159||

div.ab: Sa. pathyādibhiḥ sitātulyaiś cūrṇau bahu guru ca bhojanaṃ vaḍavāmukha iva jarayati| "āryāyāḥ pūrvārdhe yathoktamātrād ato mayā lakṣma| gītiṃ [ tatra ] vidhivido vadanti saṃvīkṣya tad itaratrāpi||"
Sa. kaliṅgakādibhir guḍāḥ-vaṭikāḥ, arśoghnāḥ|

lg.l: pibi saptadinaṃ mathitāluḍitān yadi marditum icchāsa pāyuruhām||161||

div.ab: Sa. saindhavādīni takrāloḍitāni piba yady arśāsi jighāṃsasi| "atha toṭakam abdhisakāracitam|"

lg.l: śuṣkeṣu bhallātakam agnyam uktaṃ bhaiṣajyamārdreṣu tu vatsakatvak|
sarveṣu sarvartuṣu kālaśeya- marśaḥsu balyaṃ ca malāpahaṃ ca||162||

div.ab: Sa. śuṣkeṣv arśaḥsu bhallātakaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ agnyaṃ-pradhānam uditam| āRdreṣu punar arśaḥsu kuṭajatvag bhaiṣajyam agnyaṃ kathitam| sarveṣv arśaḥsu-śuṣkaṣv ārdreṣu ca, sarvartuṣu-sarvakālaṃ, kālaśeyaṃ-mathaitaṃ, agnyaṃ balyaṃ-balāvahaṃ, malāpahaṃ-doṣāpahaṃ ca| indravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: bhittvā vibandhān anulomanāya yan mārutasyāgnibalāya yac ca|
tad annapānauśadham arśasena sevyaṃ, vivarjyaṃ viparītam asmāt||163||

div.ab: Sa. vibandhān-styānakaphadirupān, bhittvā yat-annapānauṣadham āsevitaṃ, mārutasyānulomanāya-svavartmapravartanāya, tathā yac cāgnibalāya-agnivardhanāya sampadyate, tad evānnapānauṣadhaṃ durnāmavatā sevyam| asmāt-yathoktāt, viparītaṃ-yad annapānauṣadhaṃ mārutasya vibandhakaram agnisādanaṃ ca tat, tena vivarjya-na se-vyam| upajātivṛttam|

arśotisāragrahaṇīvikārāḥ prāyeṇa cānyonyanidānabhūtāḥ|
sanne 'nale santi, na santi dīpte, rakṣed atas teṣu viśeṣato 'gnim|164| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita- sthāne 'rśaścikitsitaṃ nāmā ṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|8|

Sa. arśotisāragrahaṇyonyanidānabhūtāḥ-parasparaṃ hetubhūtāḥ, prāyeṇa-bāhulyena, anale ca sanna ete rogā bhavanti| dīpte tv agnau na santi, yatas tataḥ-asmāt kāraṇāt, teṣu viśeṣeṣāgni rakṣed iti| indravajrāvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputra śrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne 'rśa- ścikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 8||

div.head: atīsāracikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaram atisāracikitsitaṃ prārabhyate, arśotisārayoḥ parasparaṃ nidānabhūtatvena cikitsāsāmānyāt| ata evāha-

Sa. hi-yasmāt, bāhulyenāgniṃ hatvā-mandīkṛtya, āmāśayānvayo bhavaty atīsāraḥ| asmāt kāraṇād asmin-atīsārākhye vyādhau, vātaje 'pi pūrvaṃ laṅghanaṃ hitam| āmāśayo 'nvayo janmabhūr utpattiḥ yasya sa āmāśayānvayaḥ| apiśabdāt kvacit kaphādije sutarāṃ laṅghanaṃ hitam iti dyotayati| laṅghanaśabdena copavāsa eveha gṛhyate, śodhanādīnāṃ laṅghanānām avasthāvaśād ucyamānatvāt| bhūyiṣṭagrahaṇena kvacid bhayajādāv atīsāre vyabhicāraḥ, nāsāv āmāśayānvayaḥ| prāggrahaṇena nottarakāle laṅhghanaṃ hitam| tadā hi rogasvabhāvād dhātvapacayo 'vaśyaṃbhāvī| laṅghanam api dhātvapacayahetuḥ, atas tatrāyuktam|
śūlānāhaprasekārtaṃ vāmayed atisāriṇam| ---------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. śūlādibhir ārtam atīsāriṇaṃ vāmayet, na tatra prāg laṅghanaṃ hitam| vamanaṃ caitat sāmānyaṃ pittajādiṣv apy evaṃrūpeṣu cikitsitaṃ bodhyam, na kevalaṃ vātaje|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
doṣāḥ sannicitā ye ca vidagdhāhāramurcchitāḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. ye ca doṣāḥ sannicitāḥ-atiśayena vṛddhiṃ gatāḥ, tathā vidagdhena pakvāpakvarūpeṇa, āhāreṇa mūrcchitāḥ-ekatāṃ prāptāḥ, atīsārāya kalpante sampadyante| teṣu tathotkleśanaṃ-utkleśākhyavikārakaraṇaṃ praty unmukhatā bījasyāṅkurotpattāv ucchūnāvastheva, atiśayenoskleśo bhṛśotkleśas tena pravṛttāḥ-atīsārakaraṇaṃ prati samudyatās teṣu, tathā svayam eva-yatnaṃ vinā, calātmasu-calasvabhāveṣu, teṣu-tathābhūteṣu, upekṣāpathyāśitvena samyak pravartanam eva bheṣajam, na tu pācanādikam ity arthaḥ| saṅgrahaṇauṣadhaṃ kuṭajatvagādikaṃ vyādhipratipakṣabhūtaṃ kasmād atra na prayujyate ? api cāgnyasaṅgrahe paṭhiṣyati (hṛ. u. a. 40/49)- "kuṭajo 'tīsāre" iti| tasmād atra saṅgrāhauṣadhaṃ dātum ucitam iti yo manyate taṃ praty āha-
na tu saṅgrahaṇaṃ yojyaṃ pūrvam āmātisāriṇi| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. saṅgrahaṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ pūrvam āmātisāriṇi puruṣe na yojyam| tuśabdo 'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| atra pūrvagrahaṇaṃ paścād īṣadāmātisāriṇi dīyamānaṃ yujyata eveti dyotayati| sāme doṣe 'tīsārakāriṇi prathamam api bhedanam auṣadhaṃ dātuṃ(dattaṃ) viśiṣṭāyām avasthāyāṃ samānakāryam api kadācid atīsāriṇo guṇāya sampadyate nātīsārapratipakṣabhūtam api ca saṅgrahaṇam auṣadham iti kṛtvā|

---------------------------------------------|
api cādhmānagurutāśūlastaimityakāriṇi||4||
prāṇadā prāṇadā doṣe vibaddhe sampravartinī| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. vibaddhe-alpālpaṃ kṛtvā pravartamāne, doṣe 'ta eva vibandhatvād ādhmānādikāriṇi tathābhūte 'smin doṣe 'saṅgrahaṇam apathyam api prāṇadā-harītakī, prāṇān dadātīti-prāṇadā, bhavatīti| evaṃ bahudoṣāṇām atīsāriṇāṃ prāyeṇaiṣa upakramo bodhyaḥ|

ab.seg:
madhyadoṣālpadoṣayos tv āha---- ---------------------------------------------|
pibet prakvathitās toye madhyadoṣo viśoṣayan||5||

div.ab:
Sa. madhyadoṣo 'tīsārī bhūtīkādīḥ pibet| kimbhūtās tāḥ ? toye prakvathitāḥ| nanu, kvathitā ity etāvad evāstu, kiṃ praśabdena ? brūmaḥ| prakarṣeṇa kvathitāḥ pramathyārūpeṇa śṛtāḥ prakvathitā ity asyārthasya pratipādanārthaṃ praśabdokāri| pramathyāyāś ca tantrāntare lakṣaṇam uktam| tathā-
"śṛtaḥ kaṣāyo niryūhaḥ kvātho yūṣo 'kṛtaś ca saḥ|
kṛtayūṣaḥ pramathyā ca dravyāt kalkīkṛtāc chṛtaḥ||" iti| tad evaṃ dravyaṃ kalkīkṛtya piṣṭvā yat kriyate sa kṛtayūṣo bhaṇyate| sa eva ca pramathyāśabdavācyaḥ| tasmān madhyadoṣo 'tīsārī bhūtīkādīni piṣṭvā prakarṣeṇa kvāthayitvā pramathyārūpeṇa pibed ity avatiṣṭhate| muninā'py uktam (ca. ci. a. 19/22)- "pramathyāṃ madhyadoṣebhyo dadyād dīpanapācanīm|" iti| kiṃ kurvan pibet ? viśoṣayan,- laṅghayan, prakṛtatvād ātmānam eva| athavā, bilvadhanikādīni pibet| athavā, biḍādīni śuṇṭhyādīni vā pibet|
śasyate tv alapadoṣāṇām upavāso 'tisāriṇām| ---------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. alpadoṣāṇām atisāriṇām upavāsaḥ śasyate| tuśabdo 'vadhāraṇārthaḥ| atropavāsa evālpadoṣāṇāṃ śasyate na bahudoṣamadhyadoṣokto 'para upakramaḥ, sa na tathā teṣāṃ śasyata iti| sarvam atīsāriṇaṃ doṣadeśādyanurodhena kadācilaṅghayet|

---------------------------------------------|
vacāprativiṣābhyāṃ vā mustāpaparṭakena vā||8||
hnīberanāgarābhyāṃ vā vipakvaṃ pāyayej jalam| ---------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. tṛṣi sañjātāyāṃ doṣadeśādyanurodhena kadācid vacāprativiṣābhyāṃ vipakvaṃ jalaṃ pāyayet kadācin mustāparpaṭakena kadācid vālakanāgarābhyām| pāyayed ity atra kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale parasmaipadam, anyathā "na pādamya" ity ādinā parasmaipadaniṣedhaḥ syāt|

---------------------------------------------|
yukte 'nnakāle kṣutkṣāmaṃ laghvannaprati bhojayet||9||
tathā sa śīghraṃ prāpnoti rucim agnibalaṃ balam| ---------------------------------------------|10|

Sa. yukte-yogye, annakāle kṣutkṣāmam atisāriṇaṃ laghvannaprati bhojayet, nāparavyādhyārtam iva laṅghanocitaṃ samyaglaṅghanād anantaram eva bhojayet| api tu samyaglaṅghitalakṣaṇotpannam apy atīsāriṇaṃ kiñcitkālapratīkṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhojayed iti kṣāmaśabdena dyotayati| alpaṃ laghvannaṃ laghvannaprati, "suppratinā mātrārthe" iti samāso 'vyayībhāvaḥ| evaṃ kriyamāṇe saḥ-atisārī, drāg eva ruciṃ prāpnoti, tathā vahnibalaṃ dehabalam [ca]|

evaṃ ca bhuñjānasya pānam upadiśyate---- ---------------------------------------------|
takreṇāvantisomena yavāgvā tarpaṇena vā||10||
surayā madhunā vā'tha yathāsātmyam upācaret| ---------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. kadācit takreṇa
kadācit kāñjikena kadācit peyayā kadācit tarpaṇena kadācit surayā|
kadācin mārdvīkeṇeti yathāsātmyam upācaret|

---------------------------------------------|
bhojyāni kalpayed ūrdhvaṃ grāhidīpanapācanaiḥ||11||
bālabilvaśaṭhīdhānyahiṅguvṛkṣāmladāḍimaiḥ|
palāśahapuṣājājīyavānībiḍasaindhavaiḥ||12||
laghunā pañcamūlena pañcakolena pāṭhayā| ---------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. asmāt kramād ūrdhvaṃ-anantaraṃ, bhojyāni-bhoktavyāni,kalpayed atīsāriṇe| grāhidīpanapācanair eva saṅgrahaṇāni dīpanāni pācanāni ca yāni dravyāṇi tāni sarvāṇy atīsāriṇe pathyānīti| evaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa sāmānyena cikitsitam uktam| tad eva diṅmātraṃ darśayati-bālety ādi| balabilvādibhir bhojyāni kalpayet|

---------------------------------------------|
śāliparṇībalābilvaiḥ pṛśniparṇyā ca sādhitā||13||
dāḍimāmlā hitā peyā kaphapitte samulbaṇe| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. śāliparṇyādibhiḥ sādhitā dāḍimāmlā peyā kaphapittādhike hitā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
abhayāpippalīmūlabilvair vātānulomanī||14||

div.ab: Sa. abhayādibhiḥ peyā vātānulomanī|

vibaddhaṃ doṣabahulo dīptāgnir yo 'tisāryate|
kṛṣṇāviḍaṅgatriphalākaṣāyais taṃ virecayet||15|| peyāṃ yuñjayād viriktasya vātaghnair dīpanaiḥ kṛtām| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. yo bahudoṣo vibaddhaṃ-alpālpaṃ kṛtvā, atisāryate sa kṛṣṇādikaṣāyair virecayet| viriktasya ca tasya sataḥ peyāṃ vātaghnair dīpanaiś ca dravyaiḥ kṛtāṃ yuñjyāt|

lg.l: śālyodanaṃ tilair māṣair mudgair vā sādhu sādhitam|
suvarcalāyāś cuñcor vā loṇīkāyā rasair api|

div.ab:
Sa. yaḥ-atīsārī, āme pariṇate dīpte 'gnau saty upaveśyate saphenapicchaṃ tathā sarujaṃ tathā savibandhaṃ punaḥ punas tathā'lpam alpaṃ tathā'lpapurīṣaṃ nirviḍ vā-purīṣarahitam, tathā sapravāhikaṃ mistānikāsahitam|
"srute rakte purīṣe ca vāyunā viḍvivarjitam|
pravāhiteti vikhyātaṃ yat phenābhaṃ pravartate||" iti pravāhikālakṣaṇam| ya evaṃvidho 'tīsārī sa dadhitailaghṛtakṣīraiḥ samuditaiḥ śuṇṭhīṃ saguḍāṃ pibet| athavā, svinnāni badarāṇi guḍatailenāśnīyāt| evaṃ doṣādivaśāc chuṇṭhīṃ pāyayitvā kadācit pūrvoktāni badarāṇi bhakṣayitvā'nantaraṃ kṣudhitaṃ-atisañjātabubhukṣaṃ, enaṃ-atīsāriṇaṃ, gāḍhaviḍvihitaiḥ-vāstukādibhiḥ, śākais tathā māṃsarasair bahusnehair dadhidāḍimasaṃskṛtaiḥ śālyodanaṃ bhojayet| athavā tilair māṣair mudgair vā sādhu-śobhanaṃ kṛtvā, sādhitaṃ śālyodanaṃ bhojayet| mūlakapotā-laumūlakaṃ potikāsaṃjñaṃ deśāntare prasiddhaṃ kurukṣetrādau deśe| atra bhāṣyaṃ kiyat tyaktam|
Sa. bilvādibhis takre siddhā yavāgūḥ pakvātīsārajit| dādhikīti| kapitthādijaiḥ pallavair dāḍimādīnāṃ ca pallavair dadhni siddhā dādhikī yavāgūḥ| tathā-pakvātīsārajit|

lg.l: dadhnaḥ saro 'mlaḥ sasnehaḥ khalo hanti pravāhikām||25||

div.ab: Sa. tathā bilvaśalāṭūnāṃ-stokakālajātānāṃ laghūnāṃ bilvānāṃ, kalkaḥ| tathā tilakalkas tatsamo-bilvaśalāṭusamaḥ| tathā dadhnaḥ saro 'mlo-na madhuraḥ, sasneho-deśādyanurodhād dhṛtādinā snehena yathāyathaṃ yuktaḥ| ayaṃ khalaḥ siddhaḥ pravāhikāṃ hanti|

lg.l: piṣṭaiḥ ṣaṅguṇabilvais tair dadhni mudgarase guḍe||27||
snehe ca yamake siddhaḥ khalo 'yam aparājitaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. maricādibhiḥ piṣṭaiḥ ṣaḍguṇaṃ bilvaṃ-bilvamajjā, yeṣāṃ maricādīnāṃ taiḥ siddhaḥ| tathā paripakvaś ca dadhni tathā mudgarase guḍe tathā yamake ca snehe| khalo 'yam aparājito nāma dīpanādiguṇaḥ| bimbiśināśanaḥ-pravāhikāghnaḥ|

kolānāṃ bālabilvānāṃ kalkaiḥ śāliyavasya ca|
mudgamāṣatilānāṃ ca dhānyayūṣaṃ prakalpayet||29||
ekadhyaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam|
varcaḥkṣaye śuṣkamukhaṃ śālyannaṃ tena bhojayet||30||
dadhnaḥ saraṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ saguḍanāgaram|
surāṃ vā yamake bhṛṣṭāṃ vyañjanārthaṃ prayojayet||31||
phalāmlaṃ yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ yūṣaṃ gṛñjanakasya vā|
bhṛṣṭān vā yamake saktun svādehyoṣāvacūrṇitān||32||
māṣān susiddhāṃs tadvad vā ṛtamaṇḍopasevanān|
rasaṃ susiddhapūtaṃ vā chāgameṣāntarādhijam||33||
paced dāḍimasārāmlaṃ sadhānyasnehanāgaram|
raktaśālyodanaṃ tena bhuñjānaḥ prapibaṃś ca tam||34||
varcaḥkṣayakṛtair āśu vikāraiḥ parimucyate| ---------------------------------------------|35|

Sa. kolādīnāṃ kalkaiḥ śāler yavasya ca kalkair mudgādīnāṃ ca kalkair ekadhyaṃ-vyatimiśraṃ, dhānyayūṣaṃ prakalpayet| kimbhūtam ? yamake bhṛṣṭaṃ tathā dadhidāḍimasārikam| varcaḥkṣaye-purīṣakṣaye sati, śuṣkamukhaṃ-mukhaśoṣopadravānvitam atīsāriṇaṃ, tena-yūṣeṇa, śālyannaṃ bhojayet| śāligrahaṇena raktaśālyādināṃ grahaṇam| athavā, dadhnaḥ saraṃ yamake pakvaṃ guḍanāgarasahitaṃ vyañjanārthaṃ prakalpayet| athavā, yamake bhṛṣṭāṃ surāṃ vyañjanārthaṃ prakalpayet| athavā gṛñjanakasya-haritakaviśeṣasya, yūṣaṃ phalaiḥ-dāḍimādibhir amlaiḥ, amlaṃ-amlīkṛtaṃ, vyañjanārthaṃ prakalpayet| yamake snehadvaye, vā saktūn bhṛṣṭan vyoṣāvacūrṇitān bhakṣayet| tathaiva māṣān susvinnān ghṛtamaṇḍopasevanān khādet| athavā, chāgameṣayor antarādhijaṃ rasaṃ susiddhapūtaṃ śobhanaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ siddhaṃ paścāt pūtaṃ-nirmalīkṛtaṃ, tathā dāḍimasāreṇāmlaṃ dhānyakasnehaśuṇṭhīyutaṃ vyañjanārthaṃ pacet| tena rasena raktaśālyannaṃ bhuñjānas tam eva māṃsarasaṃ prapiban varcaḥkṣayakṛtair vikāraiḥ-"purīṣe vāyur antrāṇi" (hṛ. sū. a. 11/21) ity ādibhiḥ sutrasthānoditaiḥ, mucyate| pravāhikā varcaḥkṣaye sati syāt| tasmāt tayā'pi mucyate|

---------------------------------------------|
bālabilvaṃ guḍaṃ tailaṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam||35||
lihyād vāte pratihate saśūlaḥ sapravāhikaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. saṃ-vāte pratihate pravāhikāśūlavān bālabilvādikaṃ lihyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
valkalaṃ śābaraṃ puṣpaṃ dhātakyā badarīdalam||36||
pibed dadhisarakṣaudrakapitthasvarasāplutam| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. rodhratvak dhātakīpuṣpaṃ badarīpatram etat dadhisarādibhir āplutaṃ-āloḍitaṃ, pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
vibaddhavātavarcās tu bahuśūlapravāhikaḥ||37||
saraktapicchas tṛṣṇārtaḥ kṣīrasauhityam arhati|
yamakasyopari kṣīraṃ dhāroṣṇaṃ vā prayojayet||38||
śṛtam eraṇḍamūlena bālabilvena vā punaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|39|

Sa. vibaddhe vātavarcasī yasya, tathā prabhute śūlapravāhike yasya, tathā saharaktena picchayā ca yo vartate, tathā tṛṣṇayā''rtaḥ, evaṃvidho naraḥ kṣīrasauhityaṃ-dugdhatṛptiṃ, arhati| athavā, yamakaṃ pītvā'nu dhāroṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ prayojayet| eraṇḍamūlena vā śṛtaṃ bālabilvena vā śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ prayojayet|

---------------------------------------------|
payasy utkvāthya mustānāṃ viṃśatiṃ triguṇe 'mbhasi||39||
kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tat pītaṃ hanyād āmaṃ savedanam| ---------------------------------------------|40|

Sa. kṣīre triguṇe 'mbhasi mustāviṃśatiṃ prakvāthya kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ pītam āmaṃ sarujaṃ hanyāt| atra ca viṃśatibhir mustaiḥ prāyeṇa palaṃ bhavati| sāmānyakalpanayā ca mustāpalaṃ ṣoḍaśabhir dravapalair utkvāthya catvāri palāni caturbhāgāvaśeṣatayā kāryāṇi| tad evaṃ kṣīrapalāni catvāri pānīyapalāni dvādaśa mustāviṃśatiṃ datvā kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ peyam ity ayam atra kvāthakramo vedyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
pippalyāḥ pibataḥ sūkṣmaṃ rajo maricajanma vā||40||
cirakālānuṣaktā'pi naśyaty āśu pravāhikā| ---------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. pippalyāḥ sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ jalena pibato maricasya vā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ jalena pibato bahukālānuṣaktā'pi pravāhikā naśyati|

---------------------------------------------|
nirāmarūpaṃ śūlārtaṃ laṅghanādyaiś ca karṣitam||41||
rūkṣakoṣṭham apekṣyāgniṃ sakṣāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. nirāmarūpaṃ tathā śūlena pīḍitaṃ laṅghanādyaiḥ karṣitaṃ tathā rūkṣakoṣṭhaṃ vahnim apekṣya kṣārasahitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāyayet|

---------------------------------------------|
siddhaṃ dadhisurāmaṇḍe daśamūlasya cāmbhasi||42||
sindhūtthapañcakolābhyāṃ tailaṃ sadyortināśanam| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. dadhisurāmaṇḍe daśamūlakvāthe ca saindhavapañcakolakalkena tailaṃ siddhaṃ sadyo rujāpaham|

---------------------------------------------|
ṣaḍbhiḥ śuṇṭhyāḥ palair dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ granthyagnisaindhavāt||43||
tailaprasthaṃ paced dadhnā niḥsārakarujāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. śuṇṭhīpalaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pippalīmūlapaladvayena citrakapaladvayena saindhavapaladvayena ca tailaprasthaṃ dadhnā pacet| tan niḥsārakarujāpaham|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
ekato māṃsadugdhājyaṃ purīṣagrahaśūlajit||44||

lg.l: tad dhi vātajitām agryaṃ śūlaṃ ca viguṇo 'nilaḥ||45||

div.ab: Sa. ekataḥ-ekasmin purīṣagrahaśūlajittvapakṣe, māṃsadugdhājyaṃ trayam etat prayuktaṃ purīṣagrahaśūlajit| ekataḥ-ekasmin śūlajittvapakṣe, pānānuvāsanābhyaṅgaiḥ prayuktaṃ tailaṃ purīṣagrahaśūlajit 'sampadyate' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| katham evam ? ity āha-taddhīty ādi| tat-tailaṃ, yasmāt sarveṣāṃ vātajitām agnyaṃ-pradhānam| śūlaṃ ca viguṇo 'nilaḥ-prakupitaḥ pavano, nāparaḥ kaścit| śūlānilayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvāhyatireke saty api śūlasya vātakāryasya vātaprakope saty avinābhāvitvaṃ sūcayituṃ śūlaṃ ca viguṇo 'nila ity evam uktam| kupitaś ced vāyur utpannam eva śūlam ity arthaḥ|

vāyor vaiguṇye kope dhātukṣaya evātra hetuḥ| ata evāha--
-- dhātvantaropamardeddhaś calo vyāpī svadhāmagaḥ|
tailaṃ mandānalasyāpi yuktyā śarmakaraṃ param||46||
vāyvāśaye sataile hi bimbisī nāvatiṣṭhate| ---------------------------------------------|47|

Sa. vāyum apekṣyānye pittaśleṣmādayo-dhātvantarāḥ, teṣām upamardaḥ-anyathābhāvaḥ, tena iddhaḥ-uddhataḥ, calo-vāyvākhyaḥ, sa vyāpī-sakalaśarīravyāpanaśīlo 'pi, svadhāmagaḥ-pakvāśayasthaḥ, tatrādhikyena tasya vṛtteḥ, asyām avasthāyām asyātīsāriṇas tailaṃ mandānalasyāpi yuktyā-yogaviśeṣeṇa, paraṃ-atiśayena, śarmakaram, rogasya duḥkhahetoḥ śamanāt| apiśabdāt kimu dīptāgner atīsāriṇo na sukhakaraṃ bhavati ? atraiva hetum āha-vāyvāśaye-pakvāśayākhye, sataile bimbisī-pravāhikā, nāvatiṣṭhate sthitiṃ na prāpnoti|

lg.l: kṣīṇe male svāyatanacyuteṣu doṣāntareṣv īraṇa ekavīre|
ko niṣṭanan prāṇiti koṣṭhaśūlī nāntarbahis tailaparo yadi syāt||47||

div.ab: Sa. male-purīṣākhye, kṣīṇe tathā doṣāntareṣu-vātavivarjiteṣu pittakaphādiṣu, āyatanacyuteṣu-svādhārabhraṣṭeṣu, vyaktyapekṣayā bahuvacanam, īraṇe-vāyau, ekavīre-ekanāyake, śeṣadoṣāṇāṃ svasthānabhraṣṭatvāt ko 'tīsārī niṣṭanan-pravāhikāṃ kurvan, prāṇiti ?-na kaścij jīvati| yadi nāntarbahiḥ-ubhayatra, pānānuvāsanābhyaṅgaiḥ, tailaparaḥ-atiśayena tailasaivī, na syāt| ākrandanapūrvaṃ saśūlam upaveśanaṃ-niṣṭhanann ucyate| indravajrāvṛttam|

---------------------------------------------|
gudarugbhraṃśayor yuñjyāt sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ haviḥ||48||
rase kolāmlacāṅgeryor dadhni piṣṭe ca nāgare| ---------------------------------------------|49|

Sa. gudaruji gudabhraṃśe ca ghṛtaṃ sakṣīraṃ kolādirase dadhni nāgare ca kalkite pakvaṃ yuñjyāt| atra ca kṣīraṃ sarpiḥpramāṇaṃ ghṛtāt kolādirasādikaṃ caturguṇaṃ śuṇṭhītaś caturguṇaṃ ghṛtam iti pākakramaḥ|

tair eva cāmlaiḥ saṃyojya siddhaṃ suślakṣṇakalkitaiḥ||49||
dhānyoṣaṇabiḍājājīpañcakolakadāḍimaiḥ| --------------------------------------|50|
Sa. tair eva- pūrvoktaiḥ kolādibhir amlaiḥ, saṃyojya sūkṣmarajīkṛtaiś ca dhānyakādibhiḥ siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pūrvaguṇam|

---------------------------------------------|
yojayet snehabastiṃ vā daśamūlena sādhitam||50||
śaṭhīśatāhvākuṣṭhair vā vacayā citrakeṇa vā| ---------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. gudaśūlī ca daśamūlena sādhitaṃ haviḥ-ghṛtaṃ, snehabastiṃ vā yojayet| śaṭhyādibhir vā sādhitaṃ vacayā vā sādhitaṃ citrakeṇa vā sādhitaṃ yojayet| tac ca pūrvaguṇam|

---------------------------------------------|
pravāhaṇe gudabhraṃśe mūtrāghāte kaṭigrahe||51||
madhurāmlaiḥ śṛtaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'py anuvāsanam| ---------------------------------------------|52|
Sa. pravāhaṇādiṣu madhurāmlaiḥ śṛtaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā'nuvāsanaṃ yojayet|

---------------------------------------------|
praveśayehgudaṃ dhvastam abhyaktaṃ sveditaṃ mṛdu||52||
kuryāc ca goḥphaṇābandhaṃ madhyacchidreṇa carmaṇā| ---------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. gudaṃ dhvastaṃ sadhabhyaktaṃ sveditaṃ ca mṛdu kṛtvā'ntaḥ praveśayet| goḥphaṇābandhaṃ carmaṇā madhyacchidravatā kuryāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
pañcamūlasya mahataḥ kvāthaṃ kṣīre vipācayet||53||

lg.l: tailaṃ paced gudabhraṃśaṃ pānābhyaṅgena taj jayet||54||

div.ab: Sa. mahataḥ pañcamūlasya-bilvādeḥ kvāthaṃ tailasamaṃ kṛtvā kṣīre vipācayet| unduruṃ cāntrarahitaṃ tasminn eva kṣīre vipācayet| tenaiva kṣīreṇ taireṇa tailaṃ pacet| kimbhūtam? vātaghnakalkavat| vātaghnānāṃ-rāsnairaṇḍādīnāṃ kalkaḥ, sa yasyāsti vātaghnakalkavat| unduror atra rāsnādyaghrutānusāreṇa pramāṇaṃ nirupya kāryam| tatraivaṃ paṭhyate (carake ci.a.18/42)-"tulārdhaṃ cājamāṃsasya" iti| evaṃ māyurādiṣv api ghṛteṣu (hṛ.u.a.24/47) mayūrādīnāṃ pramāṇaṃ cintyam| tena tailaṃ paced iti vacanāc ca kṣīraṃ tailāc caturguṇaṃ kāryam| atra dravasyāparasyābhāvāt tailāc ca dravaṃ caturguṇaṃ kāryam iti pākakramaḥ| tasmān nānyasnehavad atra kṣīraṃ grāhyam| anyatra hy evam adhītam-"dravyāc caturguṇaḥ snehaḥ snehāt kvāthaś caturguṇaḥ| kṣīraṃ snehasamaṃ" iti| bahukṣīratvena vātakāryasya gudabhraṃśākhyasya śīghraṃ śamaṃ karoti, iti caturguṇam evātra kṣīraṃ nyāyyam|
paitte tu sāme tīkṣṇoṣṇavarjyaṃ prāg iva laṅghanam| --------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. paitte tv atīsāre sāme prāg iva-yathā vātātīsāre pūrvaṃ laṅghanaṃ śarīralāghavaṃ kartuṃ yat karma dravyaṃ vā nirdiṣṭaṃ tat sarvaṃ, tīkṣṇoṣṇavarjyaṃ 'asmin kāryam' iti śeṣaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tṛḍvān pibet ṣaḍaṅgāmbu sabhūnimbaṃ sasārivam||55||

div.ab: Sa. sa pittātīsārī tṛḍvān ṣaḍaṅgāmbu-jvaracikitsitoktaṃ (hṛ. ci. a. 1/15), bhūnimbasārivābhyāṃ sahitaṃ pibet, ardham aṣṭāṅgajalaṃ tena peyam ity avatiṣṭhate| kṣudhitasya-atiśayena bubhukṣitasya, peyādyannam agnisandhukṣaṇaṃ hitam| [ kimbhūtam? ] bṛhatyādinā gaṇenābhīruṇā tathā balādvayena śūrpaparṇīdvayena ca sādhitam|

Sa. evaṃ laṅghanapeyādike kṛte 'py anubandhe 'tīsārasya sati, tam atīsāriṇaṃ kuṭajasya phalaṃ-śakrayavākhyaṃ, piṣṭaṃ savalkaṃ-prakṛttvāt tasyaiva kuṭajasya tvacā yuktaṃ, tathā saghuṇapriyaṃ tathā sakṣaudraṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā pāyayet| athavā, pāṭhādipiṣṭaṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā sakṣaudraṃ tam atīsāriṇaṃ pāyayet| athavā, kvātham ativiṣādijaṃ taṃ pāyayet| athavā, ativiṣāmūrvādijaṃ pāyayet| tārkṣyaṃ-rasāñjanam| samadhv ity ādi| samākṣikam ativiṣādikaṃ kvāthīkṛtaṃ vā pāyayet|

lg.l: yo rasāśī jayec chīghraṃ sa paittaṃ jaṭharāmayam||60||

div.ab: Sa. vatsakabījasya vā palaṃ jalena kvāthayitvā tadrasaṃ yo māṃsarasāśī san pibet sa pittajam atīsāraṃ jayet| evaṃ prāgvat, mustākaṣāyaṃ-mustānāṃ palaṃ śrapayitvā, madhusamāyutaṃ rasāśī san kvāthaṃ pibet sa paittaṃ jaṭharāmayaṃ jayet| śālmalīvṛntakaṣāyaṃ vā himāhvayaṃ-śītakaṣāyaṃ, sakṣaudraṃ vā pibet|

kirātatiktakaṃ mustaṃ vatsakaṃ sarasāñjanam|
kaṭaṅkaṭerī hrīberaṃ bilvamadhyaṃ durālabhā||62||
tilā mocarasaṃ rodhnaṃ samaṅgā kamalotpalam|
nāgaraṃ dhātakīpuṣpaṃ dāḍimasya tvag utpalam||63||
ardhaślokaiḥ smṛtā yogāḥ sakṣaudrās taṇḍulāmbunā| ---------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. kirātatiktādayaś catvāro yogā ardhaślokaiḥ smṛtāḥ samākṣikās taṇḍulajalena yojyāḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
niśendrayavarodhnailākvāthaḥ pakvātisārajit||64||

div.ab: Sa. niśādikvāthaḥ pakvātīsārajit|
rodhrāmbaṣṭhāpriyaṅgvādigaṇāṃs tadvat pṛthak pibet| ---------------------------------------------|65|
Sa. rodhrādīn gaṇān pṛthak [tadvat-] samākṣikāṃs tathaiva taṇḍulāmbhasā, pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kaṭvaṅgavalkayaṣṭyāhvaphalinīdāḍimaṅkuraiḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. kaṭvaṅgatvagādibhiḥ peyādīn sadadhidāḍimān kuryāt| tathaiva dadhitthādibhiḥ peyādīn sadadhidāḍimān kalpayet| dadhitthaḥ-kapitthaḥ|

lg.l: ajāpayaḥ prayoktavyaṃ nirāme, tena cec chamaḥ|
doṣādhikyān na jāyeta balinaṃ taṃ virecayet||67||

div.ab: Sa. ajāpayaḥ pathyaṃ nirāme smṛtam| tena-ajākṣīreṇa, yadi doṣādhikyād dhetoḥ śamo na bhavet tadā taṃ balavantaṃ virecayet-na durbalam|

lg.l: vyatyāsena śakṛd raktam upaveśyeta yo 'pi vā|
tato 'nu koṣṇaṃ pātavyaṃ kṣīram eva yathābalam|

div.ab: Sa. vyatyāsaḥ-parasparakṣepaṇam, śakṛd raktaṃ kṣipati raktaṃ śakṛt kṣipaty evaṃ vyatyāsaḥ, tena ya upaveśyeta sa palāśaphalakvāthaṃ kevalaṃ pibed athavā payasā yuktam| tataḥ-tatkaṣāyaṃ pītvā'nantaraṃ, koṣṇaṃ kṣīram eva yathā-balaṃ-balānatikrameṇa, peyam| tenakṣīreṇa, male pravāhite-niḥsārite sati, atīsāraḥ śāmyati|
palāśavat prayojyā vā trāyamāṇā viśodhanī| ---------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. palāśaṃ yathā tathā trāyamāṇā viśodhanāya prayojyā|

---------------------------------------------|
saṃsargyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ śūlaṃ yady anuvartate||70||
srutadoṣasya taṃ śīghraṃ yathāvahny anuvāsayet| ---------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. srutadoṣasya-apacitamalasyātīsāriṇaḥ, saṃsargyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ-peyādike krame vidhīyamāne, yadi śūlam anuvartate nirvṛttiṃ na yāti, taṃ-āturaṃ, āśu yathāvahni-agnyanatikrameṇa, anuvāsayet|

---------------------------------------------|
śatapuṣpāvarībhyāṃ ca bilvena madhukena ca||71||
tailapādaṃ payoyuktaṃ pakvam anvāsanaṃ ghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|72|
Sa. śatapuṣpādibhis tailapādaṃ kṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvam anuvāsanaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
aśāntāv ity atīsāre picchābastiḥ paraṃ hitaḥ||72||

div.ab: Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa kṛtena, atīsārasyāśāntau satyāṃ paraṃ-anantaraṃ, picchābastiḥ-vakṣyamāṇo, hitaḥ| alpayā mātrayā niruhākhyo bastiḥ-picchābastiḥ|

lg.l: mṛcchoṣe tāni saṅkṣudya tat piṇḍaṃ muṣṭisammitam|
snāto bhuñjīta payasā jāṅgalena rasena vā||75||
jayaty ayaṃ śīghram atipravṛttiṃ virecanāsthāpanayoś ca bastiḥ||76||

div.ab: Sa. ārdraiḥ-aśuṣkair darbhaiḥ, śālmaler ārdravṛntāni-kusumabandhanāni, pariveṣṭya tataḥ kṛṣṇamṛttikayā''lipya gomayāgninā svedayet| mṛcchoṣe sati tāni saṅkṣudya-sañcūrṇya, taṃ piṇḍaṃ muṣṭisammitaṃ-palapramāṇaṃ, payasaḥ prasthe mardayet| tena ca pūtenānantaraṃ natādimatā''sthāpayet| nataṃ-tagaram| puṭapākānāṃ ca sarveṣām ayam eva vidhiḥ| āsthāpitaś ca paścāt| snātaḥ payasā bhuñjīta, sātmyādivaśāj jāṅgalarasena vā| ayaṃ-bastiḥ prayuktaṃ, pittātīsārādīn virecanāsthāpanayoś cātipravṛttiṃ-doṣāṇām atiyogaṃ, jayati| etad uktaṃ bhavati,-bahudoṣasya yā pravṛttir virecanaviṣaye āsthāpanaviṣaye vā tāṃ ca prayuktā'yaṃ jayati| upajātiḥ|
Sa. kuṭajotthaṃ ca phāṇitaṃ vatsakādiyuktam ambaṣṭhādisahitaṃ mākṣīkayuktaṃ sarvātīsāraḥ-āmātīsāraḥ pakvātīsāraś ca, tasya nāśanaṃ syāt|
Sa. nīruk cāsau nirāmaś ca nīruṅnirāmas tam atīsāraṃ, api sāsraṃ-apiśabdāt kim uta nirasram?, taṃ tathābhūtaṃ corotthitaṃ, tathā nānāvarṇaṃ-anekavarṇaṃ, dīptāgneḥ puṭapākair upācaret|

tvakpiṇḍād dīrghavṛntasya śrīparṇīpatrasaṃvṛtāt|
mṛlliptād agninā svinnād rasaṃ niṣpīḍitaṃ himam||79||
atīsārī pibed yuktaṃ madhunā sitayā'thavā| ---------------------------------------------|80|

Sa. tvacaḥ piṇḍas tvakpiṇḍaḥ, dīrghavṛntasya tvakpiṇḍaḥ, tasmāt, kāśmaryapatrasañchāditāt mṛlliptāt sāmānyoktāv api kṛṣṇamṛttikayā liptād iti vedyam| prāg uktaṃ hi (ślo.73)-"kṛṣṇamṛttikayā''lipya" iti| anantaram agninā svinnād rasaṃ niṣpīḍitaṃ śītaṃ kṛtvā'tīsārī madhunā yuktam athavā sitayā yuktaṃ pibet| dīrghavṛntaḥ-śyonākaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
evaṃ kṣīridrumatvagbhis tatprarohaiś ca kalpayet||80||

lg.l: sakṣaudrā hanty atīsāraṃ balavantam api drutam||81||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, kṣīridrumāṇāṃ tvagbhis tatprarohaiḥ-komalair vigatamūlaiś ca, kalpayet| prarohāḥ-aṅkurā ity anye| śyonākatvak ghrutayutā tathoṣṇasaliloṣmaṇā sveditā mākṣikayuktā'tīsāraṃ balavantam api śīghraṃ hanti|

lg.l: pittātisārī seveta pittalāny eva yaḥ punaḥ|
dāruṇaṃ gudapākaṃ ca tatra chāgaṃ payo hitam|

div.ab: Sa. pittātīsārī pittalāny evānnapānāni yaḥ sevate, tasya pittaṃ kartṛ raktātīsāraṃ kurute| kimbhūtam? tṛṣṇājvarayutam| tathā dāruṇaṃ gudapākaṃ karoti| tatra-evaṃvidhe 'tīsāre, chāgaṃ kṣīraṃ padmādibhir mocarasena ca śṛtaṃ hitam| athavā, sārivādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ chāgaṃ kṣīraṃ hitam athavā, vaṭādijaiḥ pallavaiḥ śṛtaṃ kṣaudraśarkarānvitaṃ pāne bhojane gudaseke ca chāgaṃ payo hitam|
Sa. tathaiva rasayūṣādayo 'namlāḥ saghṛtāḥ pānānnayor hitāḥ| kāśmaryaphalayūṣaś ca kiñcid amlaḥ saśarkaro hitaḥ|

payasy ardhodake chāge hrīberotpalanāgaraiḥ|
peyā raktātisāraghnī pṛśniparṇīrasānvitā||86||
prāgbhaktaṃ navanītaṃ vā lihyān madhusitāyutam| ---------------------------------------------|87|
Sa. chāge payasy ardhodake vālakotpalanāgaraiḥ pṛśniparṇīkvāthena ca yuktā peyā raktātīsāraṃ hanti| athavā navanītaṃ prāgbhaktaṃ madhuśarkarānvitaṃ lihyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
baliny asre 'sram evājaṃ mārgaṃ vā ghṛtabharjitam||87||

div.ab: Sa. pravṛddhe rakte chāgaṃ raktam athavā mārgaṃ-mṛgasambandhi raktaṃ, ghṛtabharjitaṃ bhuñjīta, evakārān na tv aparaṃ kiñcid ajasya mṛgasya ceti gamyate| ubhayam api kṣīrānupānaṃ kṣīrāśī ca san bhuñjīta| athavā, kṣīrodbhavaṃ ghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ lihan kapiñjalarasāśano nara ārogyaṃ prāpnoti|

lg.l: raktātisāraṃ hanty āśu tayā vā sādhitaṃ ghṛtam||89||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvarīkalkaṃ kṣīreṇa pītvā kṣīrāśī san raktātīsāraṃ drāg eva parākaroti| athavā, tayā-śatāvaryā, pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ raktātīsāraṃ hanti|

lākṣānāgaravaidehīkaṭukādārvivalkalaiḥ|
sarpiḥ sendrayavaiḥ siddhaṃ peyāmaṇḍāvacāritam||90||
atīsāraṃ jayec chīghraṃ tridoṣam api dāruṇam| ---------------------------------------------|91|
Sa. lākṣādibhiḥ siddhaṃ ghrutaṃ peyāmaṇḍenāvacāritaṃ śīghraṃ tridoṣam apy atīsāraṃ ghoraṃ jayati| apiśabdād raktātīsāram api|

---------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇamṛcchaṅkhayaṣṭyāhvakṣaudrāsṛktaṇḍulodakam||91||
jayaty asraṃ priyaṅguś ca taṇḍulāmbumadhuplutā| ---------------------------------------------|92|
Sa. kṛṣṇamṛdādikaṃ taṇḍulajalāloḍitaṃ raktaṃ jayati| tathā, taṇḍulāmbumadhuyuktā priyaṅgū raktaṃ jayati|

---------------------------------------------|
kalkas tilānāṃ kṛṣṇānāṃ śarkarāpāñcabhāgikaḥ||92||
ojena payasā pītaḥ sadyo raktaṃ niyacchati| ---------------------------------------------|93|
Sa. pañcamo bhāgaḥ pañcabhāgaḥ, sa yasyāsti sa pāñcabhāgikaḥ| ko 'sau? kṛṣṇātilānāṃ kalkaḥ, śarkarāyāḥ pāñcabhāgikaḥ kṛṣṇatilānāṃ kalkaḥ chagalīkṣīreṇa pītaḥ san sadyo raktaṃ niyacchati|

---------------------------------------------|
pītvā saśarkarākṣaudraṃ candanaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā||93||
dāhatṛṣṇāpramohebhyo raktasrāvāc ca mucyate| ---------------------------------------------|94|
Sa. taṇḍulajalena candanaṃ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaṃ pītvā dāhādibhyo mucyate| mucyata iti karmakartari taṅ|
Sa. gudasya dāhe pāke ca sati sekalepā himā hitāḥ|

alpālpaṃ bahuśo raktaṃ saśūlam upaveśyate|
yadā vibaddho vāyuś ca kṛcchrāc carati vā na vā||95||
picchābastiṃ tadā tasya pūrvoktam upakalpayet| ---------------------------------------------|96|

Sa. alpam alpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ śūlena saha yaś ca bahuśo raktam upaveśyate| vāyuś ca yada vibaddho-nānulomagaḥ, ata eva kṛcchreṇa carati na vā carati tadā tasya-puruṣasya, pūrvoktaṃ-"tvakpiṇḍāt" (ślo.79) ity ādikaṃ picchābastim upakalpayet|

---------------------------------------------|
pallavān jarjarīkṛtya śiṃśipākovidārayoḥ||96||
paced yavāṃś ca sa kvātho ghṛtakṣīrasamanvitaḥ|
picchāsrutau gudabhraṃśe pravāhaṇarujāsu ca||97||
picchābastiḥ prayoktavyaḥ kṣatakṣīṇabalāvahaḥ| -------------------------------------------|98|
Sa. śiṃśipākovidārayoḥ pallavān jarjarīkṛtya yavāṃś ca pacet| sa kvātho ghṛtakṣīrasaṃyuktaḥ picchāsrutyādiṣu picchābastiḥ prayoktavyaḥ| sa ca kṣatakṣīṇānāṃ balapradaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
prapauṇḍarīkasiddhena sarpiṣā cānuvāsanam||98||

div.ab: Sa. prapauṇḍarīkapakvena ghṛtenānuvāsanaṃ ca prayoktavyam|

lg.l: raktaṃ viṭsahitaṃ pūrvaṃ paścād vā yo 'tisāryate|

div.ab: Sa. raktaṃ viśā sahitam athavā pūrvaṃ paścād vā yo 'tisāryate tasya lehārthaṃ śatāvarīghṛtakalpayet|

lg.l: kṣaudrapādaṃ jayec chīghraṃ taṃ vikāraṃ hitāśinaḥ||100||

div.ab: Sa. navanītaṃ navaṃ śarkarāyā ārdhabhāgena yuktaṃ mākṣikacaturthapramāṇaṃ mākṣikasya caturthabhagenānvitaṃ līḍhaṃ taṃ-pūrvoktaṃ, vikāraṃ hitāhārasya jayet|

lg.l: ahorātraṃ jale tapte ghṛtaṃ tenāmbhasā pacet||101||
adho vā yadi vā'yūrdhvaṃ yasya raktaṃ pravartate||102||

div.ab: Sa. adho vā ūrdhvaṃ vā yasya raktaṃ pravartate, sa nyagrodhādīnāṃ śuṅgān āpothya-jarjarīkṛtya, tapte jale 'horātraṃ vāsayet| tenāmbunā ghṛtaṃ pacet| tac ca-ghṛtaṃ, śarkarāyā ardhabhāgena yuktaṃ mākṣikacaturthāśakaṃ lehayet| pūrvaguṇam|

śleṣmātisāre vātoktaṃ viśeṣād āmapācanam|
kartavyam anubandhe 'sya pibet paktvā'gnidīpanam||103||
bilvakarkaṭikāmustaprāṇadāviśvabheṣajam|
vacāviḍaṅgabhūtīkadhānakāmaradāru vā||104||
athavā pippalīmūlapippalīdvayacitrakam| ---------------------------------------------|105|

Sa. śleṣmatīsāre vātātīsāroktaṃ yad āmapācanaṃ tad viśeṣāt tatra kartavyam, na tathā vātātīsārokto 'nya upakramaḥ kārya iti viśeṣaśabdasyārthaḥ| asya-atīsārasya, anubandhe-cikitsāyāṃ samyak kṛtāyām apy aśame sati, bilvakarkaṭikādikaṃ pakatvā pānam agnidīpanaṃ pibet| athavā, vacādīni pibet| athavā, pippalīmūlādikaṃ paktvā'gnidīpanaṃ pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
pāṭhāgnivatsakagranthitiktāśuṇṭhīvacābhayāḥ||105||
kvathitā yadi vā piṣṭāḥ śleṣmātīsārabheṣajam| ---------------------------------------------|106|
Sa. ete pāṭhādayaḥ kvathitāḥ pācananyāyena, cūrṇitā vā śleṣmātīsārabheṣajam iti| atrāpi vakṣyamāṇaṃ siṃhāvalokananyāyena' koṣṇavāriṇā ity etat sambadhyate|

---------------------------------------------|
sauvarcalavacāvyoṣahiṅguprativiṣābhayāḥ||106||
pibec chleṣmātisārārtaś cūrṇitāḥ koṣṇavāriṇā| ---------------------------------------------|107|
Sa. sauvarcalādīṃś cūrṇitān koṣṇajalena śleṣmatīsārārtaḥ pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
madhyaṃ līḍhvā kapitthasya savyoṣakṣaudraśarkaram||107||
kaṭphalaṃ madhuyuktaṃ vā mucyate jaṭharāmayāt| ---------------------------------------------|108|
Sa. kapitthasya madhyaṃ savyoṣamākṣikaśarkaraṃ līḍhvā, athavā kaṭphalaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ līḍhvā, jaṭhararogān mucyate|

---------------------------------------------|
kaṇāṃ madhuyutāṃ līḍhvā takraṃ pītvā sacitrakam||108||
bhuktvā vā bālabilvāni vyapohaty udarāmayam| ---------------------------------------------|109|
Sa. kaṇāṃ mākṣikānvitāṃ līḍhvā takraṃ ca sacitrikaṃ pītvā bālabilvāni vā bhuktvā jaṭhararogaṃ vyapohati| "upasargād asyatyūhyor vā vacanam (rveti vācyam)" iti vā'taṅ|

---------------------------------------------|
pāṭhāmocarasāmbhodadhātakībilvanāgaram||109||
sukṛcchram apy atīsāraṃ guḍatakreṇa nāśayet| ---------------------------------------------|110|
Sa. pāṭhādi guḍatakreṇa pītvā'tīsāraṃ sukṛcchram api nāśayet| śleṣmātīsāre prakṛte 'tīsāragrahaṇam anyasyāpi nirāmasya tannāśanam iti dyotanārtham|

---------------------------------------------|
yavānīpippalīmūlacāturjātakanāgaraiḥ||110||
marīcāgnijalājājīdhānyasauvarcalaiḥ *samaiḥ|
*vṛṣāmladhātakīkṛṣṇābilvadāḍimadīpyakaiḥ||111||
triguṇaiḥ ṣaḍguṇasitaiḥ *kapitthāṣṭaguṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ|
cūrṇo 'tīsāragrahaṇīkṣayagulmagalāmayān||112||
kāsaśvāsāgnisādārśaḥpīnasārocakān jayet| ---------------------------------------------|113|

Sa. yavānyādibhir dravyaiḥ samair vṛkṣāmlādibhis triguṇair mūladravyāpekṣayā| kimbhūtair etaiḥ ? ṣaḍguṇā sitā yeṣāṃ vṛkṣāmlādīnāṃ ta evaṃ taiḥ| ṣaḍguṇasitaiś cūrṇaḥ kṛta iti yojyam| evaṃ śarkarābhāgānāṃ śatam aṣṭādhikaṃ bhavati| kva(kaiḥ) kṛtaś cūrṇaḥ ? mūladravyāpekṣayā'ṣṭāguṇaiḥ kapitthaiḥ kapitthaiḥ| kecit tv evaṃ paṭhanti-'ṣaḍguṇasite kapitthe 'ṣṭaguṇe' iti| tatra cedaṃ vyākhyānam-mūladravyāpekṣayā kapitthe 'ṣṭaguṇe| tathā ca kimbhute ? ṣaḍguṇasitā yasmāt tathā tasmin, evaṃ śarkarābhāgā aṣṭacatvāriṃśat syur iti| ayaṃ cūrṇo 'tīsārādin jayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
karṣonmitā tavakṣīrī cāturjātaṃ dvikārṣikam||113||

lg.l: palāni dāḍimād aṣṭau sitāyāś caikataḥ kṛtaḥ||114||

div.ab:
Sa. tugākṣīrī caturjātaṃ ca karṣonmitaṃ-karṣapramāṇam| yavānī ca dhānyakaṃ
cājājī ca yavānīcānyakājāji dvikārṣikam|
granthiś ca vyoṣaṃ ca tat palāṃśakaṃ-palabhāgikam| palāni dāḍimād aṣṭau, caśabdāt sitāyā apy aṣṭau palāni| evam ayam ekataḥ-ekasmin, kṛtaś cūrṇo dāḍimāṣṭakaḥ-etatsaṃjñaḥ| tena caturjātakam ekam evāsya samudāyād yathokta eka eva bhāgaḥ| vyoṣam apy ekam evāsyāpi samudāyād yathokta eka eva bhāgaḥ| evaṃ dravya samudāyasyaikatve kalpanā'py atrāpy ācāryasyābhimataiva| yathā (hṛ. ci. a. 19/43)-"trikaṭūttamātilaruṣkarājyamākṣikasitopalāvihitā| gulikā rasāyanaṃ kuṣṭhajic ca vṛṣyā ca saptasamā||" iti| sapta ceti tugākṣīry ekā, caturjātaṃ dvitīyam, yavānī tṛtīyā, dhānyakaṃ caturtham, ajājī pañcamī, pippalī-mūlaṃ ṣaṣtham, vyoṣaṃ saptamam, dāḍimam aṣṭamam iti| anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate,-palam iti prakṛtam| dāḍimam aṣṭakaṃ-aṣṭapalapramāṇaṃ, yasmin cūrṇe sa dāḍimāṣṭaka iti| yathā cākṣiroge (hṛ.u.a. 16/5)-"sitamaricabhāgam ekaṃ caturmanohvaṃ" ity atra| tac carṇaṃ vātātīsāroktair avasthāvaśāt khalapeyādibhiḥ saha bhojanīyam|
Sa. khalaḥ śleṣmātīsārajit| kimbhūtaḥ ? viḍaṅgādiyutaḥ cāṅgerītakrakolair amlaḥ|

lg.l: kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi pūrvoktam amlaṃ lākṣādi ṣaṭpalam|

div.ab: Sa. kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi pūrvoktam amlaṃ ghṛtaṃ-"gudarugbhraṃśayor yuñjayāt sakṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ haviḥ|" (ślo.48) ity ādi, tathā lākṣādi-"lākṣānāgaravaidehī" (ślo. 90) ity ādi, ṣaṭpalaṃ-yakṣmoktam (hṛ. ci. a. 5/22), purāṇaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ yavāgūmaṇḍamiśritaṃ, dadyāt|

vātaśleṣmavibandhe vā sravaty ati kaphe 'pi vā|
śūle pravāhikāyāṃ vā picchābastiḥ praśasyate||118||
vacābilvakaṇākuṣṭhaśatāhvalavaṇānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------|119|
Sa. vātakaphavibandhe, vā'tiśayena kaphe sravati, tathā śūle sati, pravāhikāyāṃ vā satyāṃ, picchābastiḥ-pūrvokta eva "pallavān jarjarīkṛtya" (ślo. 96) ity ādiko, vacādibhir yuktaḥ praśasyate|

--------------------------------------------|
bilvatailena tailena vacādyaiḥ sādhitena vā||119||
bahuśaḥ kaphavātārte koṣṇenānvāsanaṃ hitam| --------------------------------------------|120|
Sa. bilvamajjabhya utpannaṃ tailaṃ bilvatailam| tena vacādyaiḥ pakvena, athavā tailena-tilatailena vacādyaiḥ sādhitena, ubhayenāpy uṣṇena bahuśo 'nuvāsanaṃ kaphavātārte hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kṣīṇe kaphe gude dīrghakālātīsāradurbale||120||

lg.l: sa balī sahasā hanyāt tasmāt taṃ tvarayā jayet||121||
jayet pūrvaṃ trayāṇāṃ vā bhaved yo balavattamaḥ||122||

div.ab: Sa. kaphe kṣīṇe gude ca dīrghakālo yo 'tīsāras tena durbale-balahīne sati, anilaḥ svasthānasthitaḥ-pāyusthitaḥ, avaśyaṃ prabalo jāyate| saḥ-vāyuḥ, balavān sahasā-jhaṭity eva, vyāpādayet| tasmāt taṃ-vāyuṃ, śīghraṃ jayet| taṃ vāyuṃ jitvā'nantaraṃ pittaṃ jayet| pittasyānantaraṃ kaphaṃ jayet| athavā, trayāṇāṃ madhye yo balavattamo doṣas tam eva pūrvaṃ jayet|

lg.l: bhīśokābhyām api calaḥ śīghRaṃ kupyaty atas tayoḥ|

div.ab: Sa. bhayaśokābhyām apy anilo yasmāt kupyati, atas tayoḥ-bhayaśokātīsārayoḥ, vātahara kriyā kāryā| na kevalaṃ vātaharā, harṣaṇāśvāsanāni ca kāryāṇi, bhayaśokanivṛttaye|

yasyoccārād vinā mūtraṃ pavano vā pravartate|
dīptāgner laghukoṣṭhasya śāntas tasyodarāmayaḥ|124| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita- sthāne 'tīsāracikitsitaṃ nām navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|9|

Sa. yasya-atīsāriṇaḥ puruṣasya, uccārāt-malapravṛtteḥ, vinā mūtram athavā vātaḥ pravartate dīptāgner laukoṣṭhasya sataḥ, tasya jaṭhararogaḥ śānta iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita sthāne 'tīsāracikitsitaṃ nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 9||

div.head: grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. atīsāracikitsitād anantaraṃ grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitam ucyate, nidānasāmānyāt| tathā ca prāg uktam (hṛ. ci. a. 8/164)-"arśotisāragrahaṇīvikārāḥ" ity ādi, ata āha-

ab.seg: athāto grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyamaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. grahaṇyām āśrito doṣo grahaṇīdoṣaḥ,-tadāśritasthānoditakārī vātādyanyatamaḥ, tasya cikitsitaṃ grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|
Sa. grahaṇim āśritaṃ doṣam ajīrṇavad upācaret-tattulyasādhanena laṅghano(nādyu)ktopacārādinopakramet| atīsāroktavidhinā tasya-grahaṇidoṣavataḥ puṃso, yathādoṣamāṃ vipācayet|

lg.l: vitaret paṭulaghvannaṃ punar yogāṃś ca dīpanān||2||

div.ab: Sa. annakāle-samyag jātāyaṃ kṣudhi, yavāgvādyannaṃ-peyāvilepyodanalakṣaṇaṃ, vitaret-dadyāt| kimbhūtam ? pañcakolādibhir yutam| ādiśabdenānyair apy evaṃprakārair dravyair dīpanādiguṇayuktair yuktam| tathā, paṭu-lavaṇam, laghu-ubhayathā mātrayā prakṛtyā ca| punaḥ-bhūyo, dīpanān ṣāḍavādīn yogān vitaret|

lg.l: dadyāt sātiviṣāṃ peyām āme sāmlāṃ sanāgarām|

div.ab: Sa. tathā, āme sati peyāṃ dadyāt| kimbhūtām ? nāgarātiviṣāyutām| tathā, sāmlāṃ-īṣadamlām| pāne 'tīsāravihitaṃ vāri takraṃ surādi ca sātmyādivaśād yathāyogyaṃ tasmai dadyāt|

Sa. grahaṇidoṣiṇāṃ takraṃ pathyam| kasmāt ? dīpanagrāhilāghavāt| dīpanagrāhiśabdayor atra bhāvapradhānayor nirdeśaḥ, yathā "hyekayor dvivacanaikavacane" ity atra| ata evaitau bhāvapratyāntena lāghavaśabdena saha nirdiṣṭau| bhāṣyakāras tv āha-"dvandvāt paro yaḥ śrūyate sa sarvaiḥ sambadhyate|" iti| tena dīpanagrāhiśabdayor api bhavapratyayārthasambandho bhavatīti| madhurapākitvāt pittapradūṣaṇaṃ ca na bhavati| nacapadena prakarṣadūṣaṇaṃ pittasya takraṃ niṣidhyate| tenārthāt kiñcit pittakaram ity uktaṃ bhavati| kaṣāyoṣṇavikāśitvād rūkṣatvāc ca kaphe hitam| takraṃ rūkṣatvāc ceti pṛthaṅkṣirdeśād rūkṣatvasya takragatasya yathā kaphe hitatvaṃ dravyasvabhāvān na tathā kaṣāyādīnām etad dyotayati| vāte svādvamlasāndratvāt takraṃ pathyam| kimbhūtam ? sadyaskaṃ-sadyoviloḍitam, ata eva na vidāhi| nanu, grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ takraṃ pathyam ity etāvad astu| kiṃ hetunirdeśena ? atrocyate| laghvādiguṇebhyaḥ prāṅkṣirūpittebhyo 'dhikān vikāśitvamadhurapākādīn abhidhātuṃ dīpanādayo 'pi tatprasaṅgān nirdiṣṭāḥ| api ca, grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ takraṃ pathyam yathā dīpanādiguṇayogāt tathānyad api yad dravyam evaṃguṇaṃ grahaṇīdoṣacikitsite noktaṃ tad api grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ pathyam iti hetunirdeśena dyotyate| dravyasvabhāvāt tu viśeṣeṇa grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ takraṃ pathyam iti| eṣa ca nyāyo 'natrāpi sahetukadravyakathane yojyaḥ| kiñ ca yattador nityābhisambandhād evaṃnirdeśāc cāyam artho 'vatiṣṭhate,- yad evaṃvidhaṃ takraṃ tad grahaṇīdoṣiṇāṃ pathyam, nānyādruśaṃ yad anuddhṛtasneham athavā'rdhoddhṛtasnehaṃ tathā'tijātatvād amlaṃ tathā'sadyaskaṃ vidāhi ca, tat sarvaṃ grahaṇīdoṣiṇām apathyam eva| takre ca rūkṣasvādvamlādayo guṇāḥ parasparaviruddhā āpi dravyaprabhāvāt kaphavijayitvaṃ vātavijayitvaṃ ca yathāyogaṃ kurvanty eva svaṃ svaṃ karma, yathā satvarajastamaḥsaṃjñā guṇāḥ|

Sa. amlānāṃ caturṇāṃ-koladāḍimavṛkṣāmlacukrikāṇāṃ, prastham| kecit tu vṛkṣāmlāmlavetasadāḍimabadarāṇām ity āhuḥ| trikaṭukāt palatrayam| lavaṇānāṃ ca catvāri palāni| śarakarāyāḥ palāny aṣṭau| tad etac cūrṇaṃ śākādiṣv avacārayet-miśrayet| tac ca kāsādijit|

nāgarātiviṣāmustaṃ pākyam āmaharaṃ pibet|
uṣṇāmbunā vā tatkalkaṃ nāgaraṃ vā'thavā'bhayām||8||
sasaindhavam vacādiṃ vā tadvan madirayā'thavā| ---------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. nāgarādi pākyaṃ kvāthayitvā''maghnaṃ pibet| athavā, teṣāṃ-nāgarādīnāṃ, kalkam uṣṇāmbunā pibet| athavā, śuṇṭhīm uṣṇāmbunā pibet harītakīṃ va| vacādigaṇaṃ vā saindhavānvitaṃ tadvat-uṣṇāmbunā, pibet| vacādim eva madirayā vā pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
varcasyāme sapravāhe pibed vā dāḍimāmbunā||9||

div.ab: Sa. purīṣa āme tathā sapravāhe biḍenopalakṣitaṃ lavaṇaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ piṣṭaṃ dāḍimāmbunā vā pibet| sāme vātakaphe koṣṭharujākare bilvādīni koṣṇavāriṇā pibet|

kaliṅgahiṅgvativiṣāvacāsauvarcalābhayam|
chardihṛdrogaśūleṣu peyam uṣṇena vāriṇā||11||
pathyāsauvarcalājājīcūrṇaṃ maricasaṃyutam| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. chardyādiṣu kaliṅgādikaṃ koṣṇena vāriṇā peyam| pathyādikaṃ cūrṇaṃ samaricam uṣṇajalena pibet| pūrvaguṇam|

---------------------------------------------|
pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ pāṭhāṃ sārivāṃ bṛhatīdvayam||12||
citrakaṃ kauṭajaṃ kṣāraṃ tathā lavaṇapañcakam|
cūrṇīkṛtaṃ dadhisurātanmaṇḍoṣṇāmbukāñjikaiḥ||13||
pibed agnivivṛddhyarthaṃ koṣṭhavātaharaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. pippalyādikaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ dadhyādibhir agnidīptyarthaṃ pibet| tasyāḥ surāyā maṇḍas tanmaṇḍaḥ| koṣṭhavātaharaṃ caitac cūrṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
paṭuni pañca dvau kṣārau maricaṃ pañcakolakam||14||

div.ab: Sa. lavaṇapañcakādibhir guṭikā bījapūrarase kṛtā koladāḍimajale vā kṛtā'tiśayena pācanī dīpanī ca syāt|

lg.l: kṛṣṇātanmūlayor dve dve pale śuṇṭhī palatrayam||16||
guḍena vaṭakān kṛtvā triguṇena sadā bhajet||17||
pakvena vaṭakāḥ kāryā guḍena sitayā'pi vā|
paraṃ hi vahnisamparkāl laghimānaṃ bhajanti te||21||

div.ab: Sa. tālīsapatrādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ palam| pippalī pale dve| pippalīmūlasya dve| śuṇṭhī palatrayam| caturjātam uśīraṃ ca pṛthak karṣabhāgam| guḍena triguṇena vaṭakān kṛtvā madyādīn piban sadā bhajet| kimartham ity āha-vātakaphātmakacchardyādīnāṃ śāntyartham| tatra ca (traiva)-eteṣv eva ca vaṭakeṣu, viḍgrahe-viḍvibandhe sati, abhayāṃ nāgarasthāne dadyāt| chardyādiṣu pūrvokteṣu pittodbhaveṣu satsu guḍavarjaṃ caturguṇasitayā yuktā vaṭakāḥ kāryāḥ| vaṭakānāṃ vidhānam āha-pakvena guḍena vaṭakāḥ kāryāḥ, sitayā vā pakvayā kāryāḥ| kim iti pakvena kriyante ? ity āha-yasmāt kāraṇād agnisamparkāt te-vaṭakāḥ, paraṃ laghutvaṃ bhajanti| laghor bhāvo laghimā, "pṛthvādibhya imanic|" "ṭeḥ" iti ṭilopaḥ|

ab.seg:
sāmacikitsām uktvā nirāmacikitsāṃ viśeṣeṇāha---- athainaṃ parikvāmaṃ mārutagrahaṇīgadam|
dīpanīyayutaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayed alpaśo bhiṣak||22||

lg.l: dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā saṃsnehya svinnābhyaktaṃ nurūhayet||23||

div.ab: Sa. mārutagrahaṇīgadā vidyante yasyeti "arśaāditvāt(bhyo')ac"| enaṃ-mārutagrahaṇīgadavantaṃ, dīpanīyauṣadhayutaṃ-pañcakolaprāyadravyānvitaṃ, vahnisandhukṣaṇārtham alpamātrayā ghṛtaṃ pāyayet| kiñcit sandhukṣite-manāk sandīpite, tv agnau sati saktaviṇmūtrapavanaṃ naraṃ dve dine trīṇi vā sasnehya-snehayitvā, anantaraṃ svinnābhyaktaṃ kṛtvā niruhayet| tato-niruhād anantaraṃ, mārute śānte saty eraṇḍatailenāthavā tailvakena (hṛ.ci.a.29132) ghṛtena sakṣāreṇa srastadoṣaṃ-pracyutadoṣaṃ, virecayet|

lg.l: nirūḍhaṃ ca viriktaṃ ca samyak cāpy anuvāsitam|

div.ab: Sa. śuddho rūkṣa āśayo yasya sa evam, tathā baddhaṃ varcaḥ-purīṣaṃ yasya tam, śuddharūkṣāśayam iti hetau prathamā, śuddharūkṣāśayatvena vaddhavarcaskam ity arthaḥ| tathāvidhaṃ naram anuvāsayet| kena ? dīpanīyāni-nāgarādīni, amlani-vṛkṣāmlamātuluṅgadāḍimādīni, vātaghnāni-kuṣṭharāsrairaṇḍādīni, tair dīpanīyāmlavātaghnaiḥ siddhatailena| nirūḍhaṃ viriktaṃ ca vidhinā cānuvāsitaṃ mātrayety arthaḥ, samyak cāpy anuvāsitaṃ laghvannapratisaṃyuktaṃ punaḥ sarpiḥ śīlayet|

pañcamūlābhayāvyoṣapippalīmūlasaindhavaiḥ|
rāsnākṣāradvayājājīviḍāṅgaśaṭhibhir ghṛtam||27||
śuktena mātuluṅgasya svarasenārdrakasya ca|
śuṣkamūlakakolāmlacukrikādāḍimasya ca||28||
takramastusurāmaṇḍasauvīrakatuṣodakaiḥ|
kāñjikena ca tat pakvam agnidīptikaraṃ param||29||
śūlagulmodaraśvāsakāsānilakaphāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. pañcamūlādibhiḥ kalkair dravyaiḥ śuktādibhir dravadravyaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayā ghṛtaṃ pacet| pañcamūlam iha mahad grāhyam, sutarāṃ vātaghnatvāt| etac ca ghṛtaṃ param agnidīptikaraṃ śūlādighnam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
sabījapūrakarasaṃ siddhaṃ vā pāyayed dhṛtam||30||

div.ab: Sa. bījapūrakarasena saha siddhaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pāyayet|
tailam abhyañjanārthaṃ ca siddham ebhiś calāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. ebhiḥ pañcamūlādibhir ghṛtauṣadhaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vā'bhyañjanārthaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
eteṣām auṣadhānāṃ vā pibec cūrṇaṃ sukhāmbunā||31||
vāte śleṣmāvṛte sāme kaphe vā vāyunoddhate| ---------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. eteṣām auṣadhānāṃ pañcamūlādīnāṃ cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā vā pibet| kasyām avasthāyām ity āha-vāte| kimbhūte? śleṣmāvṛte, tathā sāme kaphe vā, vātenoddhate sāme vā|

ab.seg:
adhunā pittagrahaṇīrogacikitsām āha---- ---------------------------------------------|
agner nirvāpakaṃ pittaṃ rekeṇa vamanena vā||32||

lg.l: annaiḥ sandhukṣayed agniṃ cūrṇaiḥ snehaiś ca tiktakaiḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. agnipittayor grahaṇyāśrayatvād dravatvāc ca yad agneḥ plāvakaṃ pittam ūrdhvādhaḥ prapannaṃ tad yathāsannadeśaṃ vamanena virekeṇa vā hatvā, ānantaraṃ tam agnim annais tiktalaghugrāhidīpanaiḥ sandhukṣayet| kimbhūtaiḥ ? avidāhibhiḥ,-na tu sāmānyena dīpanaiḥ| na kevalam evaṃvidhair annair agniṃ sandhukṣayet, tathā ca cūrṇaiḥ snehaiś ca taṃ sandhukṣayet| kimbhūtaiḥ ? tiktakaiḥ-tiktadravyabhūyiṣṭhaiś cūrṇais tiktadravyasādhitaiḥ snehaiś ca|

paṭolanimbatrāyantītiktātiktakaparpaṭam|
kuṭajatvakphalaṃ mūrvā madhuśigruphalaṃ vacā||34||
dārvītvakpadmakośīrayavānīmustacandanam|
saurāṣṭryativiṣāvyoṣatvagelāpatradāru ca||35||
cūrṇitaṃ madhunā lehyaṃ peyaṃ madyair jalena vā|
hṛtpāṇḍugrahaṇīrogagulmaśūlārucijvarān||36||
kāmalāṃ sannipātaṃ ca mukharogāṃś ca nāśayet| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. madhuśigruḥ-sobhāñjanakaviśeṣaḥ, tasya phalaṃ śvetamaricākhyam| etat paṭolādikaṃ cūrṇitaṃ madhunā lehyam athavā jalena peyaṃ madyair vā| tac ca hṛdrogādīn nāśayet|

---------------------------------------------|
bhūnimbakaṭukāmustātryūṣaṇendrayavān samān||37||
dvau citrakād vatsakatvagbhāgān ṣoḍaśa cūrṇayet|
guḍaśītāmbunā pītaṃ grahaṇīdoṣagulmanut||38||
kāmalājvarapāṇḍutvamehārucyatisārajit| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. bhūnimbādyān samabhāgān citrakāt dvau kuṭajatvacāṃ ṣoḍaśa bhāgāṃś cūrṇayet| tad etac cūrṇaṃ guḍayutena śītāmbunā pītaṃ grahaṇīrogādiharam|

--------------------------------------------|
nāgarātiviṣāmustāpāṭhābilvaṃ rasāñjanam||39||
kuṭajatvakphalaṃ tiktā dhātakī ca kṛtaṃ rajaḥ|
kṣaudrataṇḍulavāribhyāṃ paittike grahaṇīgade||40||
pravāhikārśogudarugraktotthāneṣu ceṣyate| --------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. nāgarādidravyaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kṣaudrataṇḍulajalābhyāṃ saha paittikagrahaṇīroga iṣyate, pravāhikādiṣu ca|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
candanaṃ padmakośīraṃ pāṭhāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṭannaṭam||41||

lg.l: kaṭukāṃ rohiṇīṃ mustāṃ nimbaṃ ca dvipalāṃśakān|
droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayet tena pacet sarpiḥ picūnmitaiḥ||43||
pittagrahaṇyāṃ tat peyaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ tiktakaṃ ca yat||44||

div.ab: Sa. candanādidravyaṃ pratyekaṃ dvipalāṃśakam apāṃ droṇe pacet| tena kvāthena picupramāṇaiś ca kirātatiktādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ sarpiḥ pacet| kuṭannaṭaḥ-śyonākaḥ| āsphotā-utpalasārivā| kapītano-vānīraḥ| atra ca sarpiḥpramāṇaṃ kvāthāpekṣayā dvātriṃśatpalāni kalpyāni, na tu kalkāpekṣayā pañca palāni| kvāthādidravadravyasya snehapāke prādhānyāt| yataḥ kvāthādidravam antareṇa snehapāko 'pi nopapadyate, na tu tathā kalkaṃ vinā| tasmāt kvāthasya prādhānyāt kvāthāpekṣayaiva sarpir grāhyam| tat-etad ghṛtaṃ, pittagrahaṇyāṃ peyam| yac ca kuṣṭhacikitsite (ci. a. 19/2) gaditaṃ tiktakaṃ ghṛtaṃ tac ca peyam| caśabdo mahātiktakasyāpi grahaṇārthaḥ|
Sa. śleṣmaduṣṭāyāṃ grahaṇyāṃ tīkṣṇair dravyaiḥ pracchardane-vamane, kṛte sati prathamaṃ kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣārair agniṃ vivardhayet|
Sa. pañcakolādibhiḥ siddhaiḥ-kvathitaiḥ, peyādikaṃ kalpayet| gandhapalāśaṃ-gandhapatram|

lg.l: kumbhe māsaṃ sthitaṃ jātam āsavaṃ taṃ prayojayet||49||

div.ab: Sa. madhūkakusumānāṃ droṇam| tato-madhūkapuṣpebhyaḥ, ardhena viḍaṅgam| tato-viḍaṅgāt, citrakasyārdham| bhallātakasya cāḍhakam| mañjiṣṭhāyāḥ palāny aṣṭau| etat sarvaṃ pānīyadroṇatraye pacet| etac ca droṇaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ madhuno 'rdhāḍhakena saṃyuktam elādibhiḥ kumme rūṣite-lipte, māsaṃ sthitaṃ taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ jātaṃ, āsavaṃ prayojayet| eṣaḥ-āsavo, grahaṇīṃ dīpayati bṛṃhaṇo raktapittādināśanaḥ|

madhūkapuṣpasvarasaṃ śṛtam ardhakṣayīkṛtam|
kṣaudrapādayutaṃ śītaṃ pūrvavat sannidhāpayet||51||
tatpiban grahaṇīdoṣān jayet sarvān hitāśanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|52|

Sa. madhūkapuṣpāṇāṃ kuḍavasvarasaṃ ca kvathitam ardhakṣayīkṛtaṃ-ardhāvaśeṣaṃ, śītaṃ mākṣikacaturthabhagayutaṃ pūrvavat-pūrveṇa tulyam elādirūṣite bhāṇḍe māsaṃ yāvat, sannidhāpayet-samyak sthāpayet| "madhūkapuṣpakuḍavaṃ" ity ādi yo 'yaṃ parimāṇanirdeśaḥ sa iha mātrādikpradarśanaparaḥ| anayā diśā'yaṃ sandhātavyo bahuḥ, na tv etāvān| anyathā hy alpasambhṛtatvād ayam āsavo na śobhanaḥ syāt| anyatra tv āsavāriṣṭalehādau paripūrṇatvāt yathānirdiṣṭaiva mātrā yathoktaguṇakalāpaṃ karoti, na nyūnādhiketi vedyam| tat etat, pibann āturo hitabhojī san sarvān grahaṇīdoṣān jayati|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tadvad drākṣekṣukharjūrasvarasān āsutān pibet||52||

div.ab: Sa. [tadvat-] yathaiṣa madhūkapuṣpakvātha āsutas tathaiva, drākṣādisvarasān āsutān pibet| yathā ca madhūkapuṣpāṇāṃ kvātha ādiṣṭo granthakṛtā tathaiva drākṣādīnāṃ svarasābhave kvātho grāhyāḥ, tasya dikpradarśanaparatvāt|

hiṅgutiktāvacāmādrīpāṭhendrayavagokṣuram|
pañcakolaṃ ca karṣāṃśaṃ palāṃśaṃ paṭupañcakam||53||
ghṛtatailadvikuḍave dadhnaḥ prasthadvaye ca tat|
āpothya kvāthayed agnau mṛdāv anugate rase||54||
antardhūmaṃ tato dagdhvā cūrṇīkṛtya ghṛtāplutam|
pibet pāṇitalaṃ tasmin jīrṇe syān madhurāśanaḥ||55||
vātaśleṣmāmayān sarvān hanyād viṣagarāṃś ca saḥ| --------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. hiṅgvādi karṣapramāṇaṃ lavaṇāni pañca palapramāṇāni| tad etad ghṛtatailayoḥ kuḍavadvaye dadhiprasthadvaye cāpothya-saṅkṣudya, mṛdāv agnau kvāthayet| rase cānugate-praviṣṭe sati, anantaram antardhūmaṃ kalaśe dagdhvā tataś cūrṇīkṛtya karṣamātraṃ ghṛtāloḍitaṃ pibet| tasmin jīrṇe madhurabhojī syāt| sa ca-kṣāro, vātakapharogādīn hanti|

---------------------------------------------|
bhūnimbaṃ rohiṇīṃ tiktāṃ paṭolaṃ nimbaparpaṭam||56||
dagdhvā māhiṣamūtreṇa pibed agnivivardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. bhunimbādīni dagdhvā māhiṣamūtreṇa pibet| tac ca pītaṃ vahniṃ vardhayati|

---------------------------------------------|
dve haridre vacā kuṣṭhaṃ citrakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī||57||
mustā ca chāgamūtreṇa siddhaḥ kṣāro 'gnivardhanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|58|
Sa. kaṭurohiṇī-kaṭukā| haridrādvayādeś chāgamūtreṇa siddhaḥ pūrvavad agnivṛddhikṛt kṣāraḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
catuṣpalaṃ sudhākāṇḍātripalaṃ lavaṇatrayāt||58||

lg.l: vārtākakuḍavaṃ cārkād aṣṭau dve citrakāt pale|

div.ab: Sa. sudhāstambhāc catvāri palāni, lavaṇatrayātrīṇi palāni, pakvaśuṣkavārtākakuḍavam, arkād aṣṭau palāni, citrakapale dve, etat sarvaṃ dagdhvā, tato vārtākānāṃ rasena kṛtā gulikā bhuktaṃ upayuktaṃ, bhojanaṃ pacanty āśu| kāsādibhyo hitāḥ| visūcikādighnyaś ca smṛtāḥ|

mātuluṅgaśaṭhīrāsnākaṭutrayaharītaki|
svarjikāyāvaśūkākhyau kṣārau pañcapaṭūni ca||61||
sukhāmbupītaṃ tac cūrṇaṃ balavarṇāgnivardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. mātuluṅgādikaṃ cūrṇam uṣṇodakena pītaṃ balādivardhanam|

---------------------------------------------|
ślaiṣmike grahaṇīdoṣe savāte tair ghṛtaṃ pacet||62||
dhānvantaraṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ ca bhallātakaghṛtābhayam| ---------------------------------------------|63|

Sa. ślaiṣmike grahaṇīdoṣe vātānvite taiḥ-mātuluṅgādibhiḥ, ghrutaṃ pacet| athavā, dhānvantaraṃ ghṛtaṃ-pramehacikitsite "daśamūlaśaṭhī" (ci. a. 12/19) ity ādikam| ṣaṭpalaṃ-rājayakṣyacikitsite "pañcakolayavakṣāra" (ci. a. 5/22) ity ādikam| bhallātakaghṛtaṃ-gulmoktaṃ "bhallātakānāṃ dvipalaṃ" (ci. a. 14/80) ity ādikam| abhayghṛtaṃ-udaracikitsite "harītakīsūkṣmarajaḥ" (ci. a. 15/28) ity ādikam|

---------------------------------------------|
biḍakācoṣalavaṇasvarjikāyāvaśūkajān||63||
saptalāṃ kaṇṭakārīṃ ca citrakaṃ caikato dahet|
saptakṛtvaḥ srutasyāsya kṣārasyārdhāḍhake pacet||64||
āḍhakaṃ sarpiṣaḥ peyaṃ tad agnibalavṛddhaye| ---------------------------------------------|65|
Sa. biḍalavaṇaṃ kācalavaṇaṃ-kṛṣṇalavaṇaṃ, kṣāralavaṇaṃ svarjikādīṃś caikasmin kṛtvā dahet| saptavārān asya kṣārasya srutasya cārdhāḍhake sarpiṣa āḍhakaṃ pacet| tad ghṛtam agnibalādivṛddhaye peyam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
nicaye pañcakarmāṇi yuñjyāc caitad yathābalam||65||

div.ab: Sa. nicaye-sannipātaje grahaṇīdoṣe, pañcakarmāṇi-vamanavirecanāsthāpanānuvāsananasyāni, yathābalaṃ yuñjyāt| yady api śirovirecanākhyasya karmaṇo bāhulyena grahaṇīdoṣe prayojanaṃ na tathā dṛśyate yathā vamanādīnām, tathā'pi bhūyastvam urarīkṛtya pañcakarmāṇīty uktam| caśabdād yad etaddhahaṇītraye pratidoṣam āśrityoktaṃ karma tad api nicayotthe grahaṇīdoṣe yuñjyāt|

iti grahaṇidoṣasya caturvidhasya cikitsām ābhidhāyedānīṃ pratipuruṣaṃ pratidoṣaṃ mandāgnitvam āśritya yathāvasthaṃ cikitsitaṃ nirdiśann āha--
-- praseke ślaiṣmike 'lpāgner dīpanaṃ rūkṣatiktakam|
yojyaṃ kṛśasya vyatyāsāt snigdharūkṣaṃ kaphodaye||66||
kṣīṇakṣāmaśarīrasya dīpanaṃ snehasaṃyutam|
dīpanaṃ bahupittasya tiktaṃ madhurakair yutam||67||
sneho 'mlalavaṇair yukto bahuvātasya śasyate| ---------------------------------------------|68|

Sa. praseko dvividhaḥ-vātikaḥ ślaiṣmikaś ca| tatra mandāgneḥ ślaiṣmaprakopaje praseke dīpanaṃ rūkṣatiktaṃ yad dravyaṃ tat prayojyam, na ghṛtaṃ nāpi madhurāmlalavaṇādikam| śleṣmajaprasekasya ca lakṣaṇam (hṛ.ci.a.5/63)- "śleṣmaṇo 'tiprasekena vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇam asyati|" ity ādi| kṛśasya punar mandāgneḥ kaphodaye sati vyatyāsāt paryāyeṇa vyatikarmavyavahārārthaḥ| vyatyāsāt snigdharūkṣaṃ yojyam,-snigdhaṃ yojayitvā rūkṣaṃ yojyaṃ rūkṣaṃ yojayitvā snigdhaṃ yojyam ity arthaḥ| yadi hi kṛśe bahukaphe rūkṣe ca nare rūkṣam eva yuñjyāt, tato rūkṣe kevale yujyamāne kārśyasya vṛddhiḥ syāt| atha sneham eva yuñjayāt, tataḥ snehe kevale yujyamāne kaphavṛddhiḥ syāt| iti vyatyāsena snigdharūkṣam upayojyam| kṣīṇakṣāmaśarīrasya tu kaphodaye dīpanaṃ dravyaṃ-pañcakolādikaṃ, snehaiḥ-ghṛtādibhiḥ, saṃyutaṃ snehasaṃyuktaṃ yuñjyāt| bahupittasya mandāgres tiktaṃ madhurakair dravyair yuktaṃ dīpanaṃ yojyam| bahuvātasay mandāgner narasya sneho 'mlalavaṇair yuktaḥ prāyeṇa śasyate|

snehasya mandāgniviṣayebhyo 'nyadravyebhyaḥ prāyeṇa prādhānyaṃ sarvapuruṣaṃ prati dyotayitum idaṃ brūte---- ---------------------------------------------|
sneham eva paraṃ vidyād durbalānaladīpanam||68||
nālaṃ snehasamiddhasya śamāyānnaṃ sugurv api| ---------------------------------------------|69|

Sa. evety avadhāraṇe| paraṃ-pradhānaṃ, sneham eva mandāgrer vidyāt, na tato 'nyad dravyam| tasmān mandāgner doṣapratipakṣabhutair auṣadhair yuktaḥ sneho bāhulyena pathyaḥ| ata evedaṃ kāraṇaṃ nirdiśann āha-nālam ity ādi| yasmāt snehoddīpitasyāgreḥ suṣṭhu gurv apy annaṃ śamāya nālaṃ-paryāptam| tasmāt sneha eva durbalānaladīpanāya śreṣṭhaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
yo''lpāgnitvāt kaphe kṣīṇe varcaḥ pakvam api ślatham||69||
muñcet paṭvauṣadhayutaṃ sa pibed alpaśo ghṛtam|
tena svamārgam ānītaḥ svakarmaṇi niyojitaḥ||70||
samāno dīpayaty agnim agneḥ sandhukṣako hi saḥ| ---------------------------------------------|71|

Sa. yaḥ-naraḥ, alpāgnitvāt kaphe kṣīṇe sati purīṣaṃ pakvam api śithilaṃ muñcet, saḥ-naraḥ, alpam alpaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| kimbhutam ? paṭvauṣadhayutaṃ-saindhavaśuṇṭhīyuktam| tena-sarpiṣā, samānaḥ svamārgam ānīya svakarmaṇi-annapacanākhye, niyojito 'gniṃ sandīpayati| yato 'sau-samānaḥ, agne sandhukṣakaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
purīṣaṃ yaś ca kṛcchreṇa kaṭhinatvād vimuñcati||71||
sa ghṛtaṃ lavaṇair yuktaṃ naro 'nnāvagrahaṃ pibet| ---------------------------------------------|72|

Sa. yaś ca-puruṣaḥ, purīṣaṃ kāṭhinyāt-saṃhatatvād dhetoḥ,kṛcchreṇa muñcati| saḥ-naraḥ, lavaṇaiḥ pañcabhir yuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| kimbhūtam ? annāvagrahaṃ,-annenāvagrahaḥ sahasordhvakāyagamanapratibandho 'vaṣṭambho yasya tad evam| ghṛtaṃ pītvā'nnaṃ bhoktavyam ity arthaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
raukṣyān mande 'nale sarpis tailaṃ vā dīpanaiḥ pibet||72||

div.ab: Sa. raukṣyād dhetor mande 'gnau sati sarpir athavā tailaṃ dīpanīyair yutaṃ pibet|
kṣāracūrṇāsavāriṣṭān mande snehātipānataḥ| ---------------------------------------------|73|
Sa. snehātipānād dhetor mande 'gnau sati kṣārādīn pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
udāvartāt tu yoktavyā nirūhasnehabastayaḥ||73||

div.ab: Sa. udāvartāt punar mande 'gnau sati nirūhasnehabastayaḥ prayoktavyāḥ|
doṣātivṛdhdyā mande 'gnau saṃśuddho 'nnavidhiṃ caret| ---------------------------------------------|74|
Sa. saṃ-doṣā'tivṛddhayā mande 'gnau sati vamanavirecanādibhir hṛ tadoṣaḥ kṛtasaṃśuddhir annavidhiṃ-peyādikramaṃ, ācaret|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
vyādhimuktasya mande 'gnau sarpir eva tu dīpanam||74||

div.ab: Sa. vyādhimuktasya mande 'gnau sarpir eva dīpanaṃ syāt, nānyat tathadravyam|

lg.l: annāvapīḍitaṃ balyaṃ dīpanaṃ bṛhaṇaṃ ca tat||75||

div.ab: Sa. adhvopavāsakṣāmatvair mande 'gnau yavāgvā saha ghṛtaṃ pāyayet, vaidya iti śeṣaḥ| kimbhūtam ? annenāvapīḍitam annāvapīḍitam, madhyabhaktaṃ ghṛtam ity arthaḥ| evaṃ pītaṃ balyaṃ bṛhaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ ca tad bhavati|

Sa. dīrghakālaprasaṅgāt tu mande 'gnau saty asamyagāhārarasapariṇatyā hetubhūtayā kṣāmakṣīṇakṛśān narān piśitāśināṃ-prasahādīnāṃ, rasaiḥ sāmlair bhojayet| kasmāt tān etān bhojayet? ity āha-laghūṣṇety ādi| laghutvād uṣṇatvāt kaṭutvāc chodhanatvāc ca te rasāḥ śīghram agniṃ dīpayanti| bhāvapradhānanirdeśaḥ pūrvavac cātra yojyaḥ| nanu, prāg abhyadhāyi (hṛ. sū. a. 6/61)- "guruṣṇasnigdhamadhurā vargāś cāto yathottaram|" iti| iha ca prasahānāṃ laghutvam ucyate| tad ime vacasī parasparaṃ vyāghnāte| atra brūmaḥ| lāghavaśabdo 'tra kriyāviśeṣārthaḥ| dhāvanaplavanalaṅghanādikā ceṣṭā, tasyāḥ pāṭavaviśeṣo lāghavam| yathā ca prāg adhyagīṣṭa (hṛ. sū. a. 2/10)-"lāghavaṃ karmasāmarthya" iti| evaṃ cātrāvirodhaḥ| hetunirdeśād anye 'py evaṃprāyā ye māṃ sarasās tān apy etān bhojayed iti| te ca-prasahāḥ, māṃsopacitamāṃsatvād dhetoḥ suṣṭhu balaṃ vardhayanti|

lg.l: samyak prayuktair dehasya balam agneś ca vardhate||78||

div.ab: Sa. snehādibhiḥ samyak prayuktaiḥ śarīrasyāgneś ca balaṃ vardhate| tasmāt snehādayo yathāvasthaṃ prayojyā iti bhāvaḥ|

ab.seg:
adhunā snehasyāgnivṛddhikaratvaṃ dṛṣṭāntena darśayati--
-- dīpto yathaiva sthāṇuś ca bāhyo 'gniḥ sāradārubhiḥ|
sasnehair jāyate tadvad āhāraiḥ koṣṭhago 'nalaḥ||79||

div.ab: Sa. yathā-yena prakāreṇa, sāradārubhiḥ-śamīkhadirādibhiḥ, sasnehair bāhyo 'gnidīptaḥ sthāṇuḥ-sthiraś ca, jāyate| tathaiva koṣṭhago 'gniḥ sasnehaiḥ pathyarūpair āhāraiḥ paṭutaraḥ sthiraś ca sampadyate|

Sa. nābhojanena kāyāgnir dīpyate| na cātibhojanena| atraiva dṛṣṭantam āha-yathā bāhyo 'gnir nirindhano na dīpyate naśyati| alpo 'gnir bāhyo 'tīndhanena-bahubhir dārubhiḥ, āvṛto naśyati,-na dīpyate| evaṃ koṣṭhāgnir apy abhojanātibhojanābhyāṃ naśyati,-na dīpyata ity arthaḥ|

lg.l: yadā kṣīṇe kaphe pittaṃ svasthāne pavanānugam|
paktvā'nnam āśu dhātūṃś ca sarvān ojaś ca saṅkṣipan|
mārayet syāt sa nā svastho bhukte jīrṇe tu tāmyati||82||

div.ab: Sa. yasmin kāle kaphe kṣīṇe-kṣayaṃ yāte, ata eva svasthāne-āmāśayākhye, pittaṃ vṛddham| kimbhūtam ? pavanānugam| mārutena gamanasvabhāvena paścād yuktam| ata eva tat pittam agniṃ vardhayati| tadā-tasmin kāle, asāvanalo-jāṭharāgniḥ, sānilaḥ-pavanasahito, annaṃ paktvā'nantaraṃ paktavyābhāvāt sarvān dhātūn paktvā, āśu puruṣaṃ mārayet| kiṃ kurvan ? ojaś ca saṅkṣipan-saṃharan, vināśayann ity arthaḥ| nanu, pittānilayor dvayoḥ prakṛtatvāt sapittānilo 'nala iti vaktuṃ yuktaṃ syāt| maivam| "pittaṃ vahnir vahnijaṃ vā" (hṛ. śā. a. 3/90) iti kṛtvā tadānīṃ jaṭharāgninā sahaikatāṃ prāptaṃ pittam iti sānilo 'nala iti nirdiṣṭam| saḥ-atyagnipīḍito, nā-puruṣo, bhukte svasthaḥ syāt| jīrṇe tu tāmyati-upatapyate| anekārthatvād dhātūnām upa tāpārthas tāmyatiḥ| tamakalakṣaṇe 'pi prāg adhyagīṣṭa|
tṛṭkāsadāhamūrcchādyā vyādhayo 'tyagnisambhavāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|83|
Sa. tṛṣṇādayo rogā atyagneḥ sambhavanti|

tam atyigniṃ gurusnigdhamandasāndrahimasthiraiḥ||83||
annapānair nayec chāntiṃ dīptam agnim ivāmbubhiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|84|
Sa. tam atyagniṃ-bhasmakākhyaṃ, gurusnigdhādibhir annapānaiḥ śānti nayet| kamiva ? dīptaṃ-iddam agniṃ bāhyaṃ, yathā jalaiḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
muhur muhur ajīrṇe 'pi bhojyāny asyopahārayet||84||
nirindhano 'ntaraṃ labdhvā yathainaṃ na vipādayet| ---------------------------------------------|85|

Sa. muhur muhuḥ-kṣaṇe kṣaṇe, ajīrṇe 'pi bhojyani-kṛśarādīni, upahārayet-āhārārtha prakalpayet| ajīrṇe 'pīty apiśabdāt kim uta jīrṇe bhojyān upahārayed iti| kim ity evaṃ kriyate ? ity āha-yasmāt tasmāt tathā tena prakāreṇājīrṇe 'pi punaḥ punar āhā ropayogena nirindhano 'gnir antaraṃ-avakāśaṃ, labdhvā yathā enaṃ na vipādayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kṛśarāṃ pāyasaṃ snigdhaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ guḍavaikṛtam||85||

lg.l: matsyān viśeṣataḥ ślakṣṇān sthiratoyacarāś ca ye||86||

div.ab: Sa. kṛśarām ityādīni bhuñjīta| guḍavaikṛtam iti| vikṛtam eva vaikṛtam, prajñāditvād aṇ| tathaidakānāṃ-matsyakacchapādīnāṃ piśitāni, tathā''nūpāni-varāhādīnām, bhṛtāni-medurāṇī, bhakṣayet| viśeṣeṇa matsyān| ślakṣṇān-aparuṣān| caśabdād ye ca sthiratoyacarāḥ-avahajjalāśritāḥ, tān apy aśnīyāt|
āvikaṃ subhṛtaṃ māṃsam adyād atyagnivāraṇam| ---------------------------------------------|87|
Sa. āvikaṃ māṃsaṃ subhrutaṃ-atīvameduraṃ, atyagnivāraṇam adyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
payaḥ sahamadhūcchiṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā tṛṣitaḥ pibet||87||

div.ab: Sa. tathā, tṛṣitaḥ san payaḥ pibet| kimbhutam ? sahamadhūcchiṣṭaṃ-samadanaṃ, sarpir vā evaṃbhutaṃ pibet| godhūmacūrṇaṃ bahughṛtaṃ kṣīreṇāloḍitaṃ pibet| athavā, ānupamāṃsarasānvitān snehān pibet| kimbhūtān ? tailavivarjitān| tailasya pittakṛttvān niṣedhaḥ| athavā, śyāmātrivṛndyāṃ vipakvaṃ kṣīraṃ virecanaṃ dadyāt| tathā, punaḥ punaḥ pittasya haraṇaṃ pāyasasya pratibhojanaṃ hitam|

lg.l: yat kiñcid guru medyaṃ ca śleṣmakāri ca bhojanam|
sarvaṃ tadyagnihitaṃ bhuktvā ca svapanaṃ divā||90||

div.ab: Sa. yat kiñcid guru bhojanaṃ yan medaskaraṃ śleṣmakaraṃ ca, tad atyagnaye hitam| bhuktvā ca yad divā svapanaṃ tac ca hitam|
Sa. agniḥ pūrvam āhāraṃ pacati| āhārarahitas tv agnir doṣān pacati| tadabhāvād dhātūn pacati| dhātusaṅkṣaye sati jīvitaṃ pacati-nāśayatīty arthaḥ|

etat prakṛtyaiva viruddhamannaṃ saṃyogasaṃskāravaśena cedam|
ity ādy avijñāya yatheṣṭaceṣṭāś caranti yat sā'gnibalasya śaktiḥ|92|
tasmād agniṃ pālayet sarvayatnai stasmin naṣṭe yāti nā nāśam eva|
doṣair graste grasyate rogasaṅghair yukte tu syān nīrujo dīrghajīvī|93| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsita sthāne grahaṇidoṣacikitsitaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|10|

Sa. etad annaṃ prakṛtyā[eva]-svabhāvenaiva, viruddham apathyam yathā-karamardakadadhisarṣapaśākaphāṇitaśuṣkamāṃsavirūḍhakāmamūla-kalakucādikam| saṃyogaviruddhaṃ yathā-kṣīram amlena saha, ānūpam āmiṣaṃ māṣaiḥ saha, ity ādi| saṃskāraviruddhaṃ yathā-hārītamāṃsaṃ hāridraśūlaprotaṃ hāridravahninā pācitam ity ādi| evam idaṃ prakṛtyā diviruddhaṃ saṃyogasya saṃskārasya ca vaśena-sāmarthyena, cedaṃ viruddham| ādigrahaṇān mātrākālādiparigrahaḥ| tatra mātrāviruddhaṃ yathā-madhughṛtaṃ samāṃśam| kālavaśenedaṃ yathā-rātriparyuṣitā kākamācī| pātravaśenedaṃ yathā-kāṃsye daśāham uṣitam sarpiḥ| ity ādy avijñāya-abuddhvā'paryālocya, yatheṣṭaceṣṭāḥ-yathābhilāṣamā hāram āsevamānāḥ, yac caranti sā'gnibalasya śaktiḥ-sāmarthyam| yata evaṃ tasmād agniṃ pālayet, sarvayatnaiḥ-akhilakriyānuṣṭhānaiḥ, tasmin-agnau, naṣṭe-kṣīṇe, nā-puruṣo, nāśaṃ yāti| doṣair graste vahnau nā-puruṣo, rogasaṅghair grasyate-pīḍyate| yukte-svasthe, punar agnau nīrujo dīrghajīvī ca bhaved iti| upajātiśālinyau vṛtte| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne grahaṇīdoṣacikitsitaṃ nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 10||

div.head: mūtrāghātacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. kṛcchre-mūtrakṛcchre, ādipadalopaṃ kṛtvā nirdiṣṭam| yathā-māṃsarase rasa iti| mūtrakṛcchre vātotthe, aṅgaṃ-śarīraṃ, vātaghnatailena-balātailādinā, abhyaktam adho nāmeḥ samantāt svedaiḥ piṇḍādibhiḥ suṣṭhu snigdhaiḥ-na rūkṣaiḥ, svedayet|
Sa. daśamūlādibhiḥ kvathitakalkitais tailasarpirvarāharkṣavasāḥ siddhāḥ-pakvāḥ, saha pañcalavaṇair vartanta iti sapañcalavaṇāḥ pītāḥ paraṃ-suṣṭhu, śūlaharāḥ|

lg.l: saha tailaphalair yuñjyāt sāmlāni snehavanti ca||4||

div.ab: Sa. etāni-daśamūlādīni, dravyāṇi pānānne tadvijayāya, tathā piṇḍopanāhākhyaṃ svedadvayaṃ tailaphalaiḥ saha yuñjyāt| tailārthāni phalāni nālikerākṣoḍādīni tailaphalāni, yathā-yūpāya dāru, taiḥ saha| kecit tu tailaphalāni tilān āhuḥ| kimbhūtāni? sāmlāni, sahāmlaiḥ-takrāranālādibhiḥ, vartanta iti sāmlāni| tathā, snehavanti-bahusnehāni| "bhūmni matup"|
sauvarcalāḍhyāṃ madirāṃ piben mūtrarujāpahām| ---------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. tathā madirāṃ bahusauvarcalāṃ mūtrarujāpahāṃ pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
paitte yuñjīta śiśiraṃ sekalepāvagāhanam||5||

div.ab: Sa. paitte mūtrakṛcchre śītalaṃ sekalepāvagāhanaṃ yuñjīta|
Sa. tathā śatāvaryādikaṃ pākyaṃ kṛtvā samadhuśarkaraṃ pibet|
Sa. vṛṣakādikaṃ kalkīkṛtya drākṣājalena piban sarvān mūtrāghātān parākaroti| apohatīti "upasargād asyatyūhyor vā vacanam" iti parasmaipadam| vṛṣakaḥ-pāṣāṇabhedakaḥ| laṭvābījaṃ-kusumbhabījam|

lg.l: toyena kalkaṃ drākṣāyāḥ pibet paryuṣitena vā||8||

div.ab: Sa. ervārubījādikaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbhasā pibet pūrvaguṇam| paryuṣitena vā jalena drākṣākalkaṃ pibet|

lg.l: yavānāṃ vikṛtīḥ kṣāraṃ kālaśeyaṃ ca śīlayet||9||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje mūtrakṛcchre vamanādīni śīlayet|

lg.l: tair vā peyāṃ pravālaṃ vā cūrṇitaṃ taṇḍulāmbunā|

div.ab: Sa. tathā madyena sūkṣmailāṃ pibet| āmalakarasena vā sūkṣmailāṃ pibet| [athavā,] sārasāsthyādīni madhuyuktāni gomūtreṇa pibet| athavā, kaṇṭakāryāḥ svarasaṃ samākṣikaṃ pāyayet| [athavā,] śitivārakasya-karañjasya, bījaṃ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaṃ takreṇa saha pāyayet| dhavādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ pākyaṃ-kvāthaṃ, vā samadhu pāyayet| tair vā-dhavādibhiḥ, sādhitāṃ peyāṃ pāyayet| pravālaṃ-vidrumaṃ, rajīkṛtaṃ taṇḍulāmbhasā [vā] pāyayet| pāṭalāyāḥ kṣāraṃ saptavārān srutaṃ tailena vā pāyayet|

pāṭalīyāvaśūkābhyāṃ pāribhadrāt tilād api|
kṣārodakena madirāṃ tvageloṣakasaṃyutām||14||
pibed guḍopadaṃśān vā lihyād etān *pṛthak pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. pāṭalīyavakṣārābhyāṃ kṣārodakena tathā pāribhadratilakṣārodakena madirāṃ tvageloṣakasaṃyuktāṃ pibet| ūṣakaḥ-kallaraḥ| guḍopadaṃśān veti| athavā guḍam upadaṃśya etān-tvagādīn, pṛthak pṛthak lihyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
sannipātātmake sarvaṃ yathāvastham idaṃ hitam||15||
aśmany apy acirotthāne vārabastyādikeṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. sannipātātmake mūtrakṛcchre sarvam idaṃ-pūrvoktaṃ pṛthagdoṣātmakamūtrakṛcchranirdiṣṭaṃ, yathāvasthaṃ-avasthām apekṣya, hitam| na kevalaṃ sannipātātmake kṛcchre prāṅ nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthagdoṣātmakamūtrakṛcchracikitsakaṃ hitam| yāvad aśmaryām apy acirotthāne, acirakālaṃ utthānaṃ-janma, yasya tasmin hitam| caśabdād vātabastyādikeṣu mūtrāghāteṣu hitam| ādiśabdena vātakuṇḍalikādayo gṛhyante|

---------------------------------------------|
aśmarī dāruṇo vyādhir antakapratimo mataḥ||16||
taruṇo bheṣajaiḥ sādhyaḥ pravṛddhaś chedam arhati| ---------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. aśmarī dāruṇo vyādhir antakapratimaḥ-tattulyo mataḥ, śīghraṃ prāṇahāritvāt| sa cāśmarī taruṇaḥ-acirotpannaḥ, auṣadhaiḥ sādhyaḥ-sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ| pravṛddhaḥ punaś chedanaṃ-pāṭanaṃ, śastreṇārhati|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tasya pūrveṣu rūpeṣu snehādikrama iṣyate||17||

div.ab: Sa. tasya-āśmaryākhyasya vyādheḥ, prāgrūpeṣu snehādikrama iṣyate| ādiśabdaḥ svedanavamanādīnāṃ grahāya| atha sneham āha-

lg.l: yavāḥ kulātthāḥ kolāni varuṇaḥ katakāt phalam||19||
bhinatti vātasambhūtāṃ tat pītaṃ śīghram aśmarīm||20||

div.ab: Sa. pāṣāṇabhedādīnāṃ kvāthe ghṛtaṃ śṛtam ūṣakādigaṇoktadravyaprativāpaṃ-tatkalkaṃ sat, pītaṃ vātajām aśmarīṃ bhinatti| vasukaḥ-īśvaramallikā| vaśiraṃ-sāmudralavaṇam| aśmantako-mālukaparṇaḥ| kapotavaṅkā-suvarcalā| bhallūkaḥ-śyonākaḥ|

Sa. gandharvahastādīnāṃ samāhāradvandvaḥ, anityam āgamaśāsanam iti tu prakṛtam| eraṇḍādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ yan mūlaṃ tat kalkīkṛtya madhureṇa dadhnā pibed aśmabhedanam,-prakṛtatvād vātāśmarībhedanaṃ gamyate|

lg.l: kuśaḥ kāśaḥ śaro guṇṭha itkaṭo moraṭo 'śmabhit|
punarnave śirīṣaś ca teṣāṃ kvāthe paced dhṛtam||23||

div.ab: Sa. kuśādīnāṃ kvāthe trapusādīnāṃ-pūrvoktānāṃ (ślo.7) trapusairvārulaṭvānāṃ, bījena nīlotpalabījena madhukena ca piṣṭena śilājatunā ca ghṛtaṃ pacet| tat pittāśmarībhedanaṃ bhavati| śodhanādigaṇasaṅgrahoktās tu (hṛ. sū. a. 15|1) trapusādayo 'tra na gṛhyante, tadantaḥpātināṃ pittavirodhināṃ sarpirā(sarṣapā)dīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ tatra pāṭhāt|

lg.l: bhinatti kaphajām āśu sādhitaṃ ghṛtam aśmarīm||26||

div.ab: Sa. "varuṇasairyaka" (hṛ.sū.a.15|21) ity ādir varuṇādir gaṇaḥ, samīraghnau gaṇau-"vīratarādiḥ (hṛ.sū.a.15|24) . tathā vidāryādiḥ (hṛ.sū.a.15|9) , etair varuṇādibhir dravyaiḥ kalkikṛtais tathoṣakādigaṇena-"ūṣakas tutthakaṃ" (hṛ.sū.a.15|23) ity ādinā, kṛtāvāpaṃ-kalkavat kṛtvā, ghṛtaṃ sādhitam āśu kaphajām aśmarīṃ hanti|
kṣārakṣīrayavāgvādi dravyaiḥ svaiḥ svaiś ca kalpayet| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. kṣārādi ca svaiḥ svaiḥ-tadyogyair dravaiḥ kalpayet|

---------------------------------------------|
picukāṅkollakataśākendīvarajaiḥ phalaiḥ||27||
pītam uṣṇāmbu saguḍaṃ śarkarāpātanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. picukādibhir uṣṇāmbu saguḍaṃ pītaṃ śarkarāyāḥ paraṃ śātanam| picukaḥ-śitivārakaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
krauñcoṣṭrarāsabhāsthīni śvadaṃṣṭrā tālapatrikā||28||

div.ab: Sa. krauñcāsthyādīni pītāni surayoṣṇajalena vā śarkarāṃ hanyuḥ|
Sa. tumbarībījānāṃ cūrṇaṃ mākṣikānvitam avikṣīreṇa saptāhaṃ pītam aśmaripātanam| atrāśmarīśabdasya "ḍhyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasoḥ" iti hrasvaḥ|
kvāthaś ca śigrumūlotthaḥ kaduṣṇo 'śmarīpātanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. sobhāñjanakamūlakvāthaś ca koṣṇaḥ pīto 'śmaripātanaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
tilāpāmārgakadalīpalāśayavasambhavaḥ||31||
kṣāraḥ peyo 'vimūtreṇa śarkarāsv aśmarīṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. tilādisambhavaḥ kṣāro 'vimūtreṇa śarkarāsv aśmarīṣu ca viṣaye peyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
