Sa. bale ca jāte punar api snehapītaṃ viśodhitaṃ santaṃ kṣāraṃ samudraśuktayutthaṃ payasā pāyayet| tathā karañjajaṃ kṣāram amlaiḥ-kāñjikādibhiḥ srutaṃ, biḍakaṇācūrṇabhūyiṣṭhaṃ pāyayet| athavā, saubhāñjanasya kvātham saindhavādiyutaṃ pibet| hiḍgvādijaṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣāraṃ tathā ghṝtaṃ-ṣaṭpalādi, yathābalaṃ prayuñjīta| nanu, yathābalaṃ ihocyate| prāk cābhyadhāyi (hṛ. ni. a. 12|4)- "naṣṭaceṣṭābalāhārāḥ" iti| tad ime vākye parasparaṃ vyāghnāte| brūmaḥ| balaśabdeneha bheṣajabalaṃ soḍhuṃ śaktaṃ yad balamātraṃ tad iha parikalpitam| pūrvaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ yad balaṃ tad vivakṣitam iti nātra pūrvāparavyāhatatvam|

---------------------------------------------|
pippalīnāgaraṃ dantīsamāṃśaṃ dviguṇābhayam||88||
biḍārdhāṃśayutaṃ cūrṇam idam uṣṇāmbunā pibet| ---------------------------------------------|89|
Sa. pippalīnāgarayor dvāv aṃśau, dantyā dvau bhāgau, harītakyāś ca dvau bhāgau, biḍalavaṇasyārdhabhāgaḥ, ity evaṃ cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
viḍaṅgaṃ citrakaṃ saktūn saghṛtān saindhavaṃ vacām||89||
dagdhvā kapāle payasā gulmaplīhāpahaṃ pibet| ---------------------------------------------|90|
Sa. viḍaṅgādikaṃ kapāle-karpare, dagdhvā kṣīreṇa gulmaplīhaghnaṃ pibet|

---------------------------------------------| tailonmiśrair badarakapatraiḥ sammārditaiḥ samupanaddhaḥ||90|| musalena pīḍito 'nu ca yāti plīhā payobhujo nāśam| ---------------------------------------------|91|
Sa. badarakasya patrais tailamiśritaiḥ suṣru marditaiḥ samupanaddhaḥ, anu-paścāc ca, musalena pīḍitaḥ plīhā kṣīrāśino nāśaṃ vrajati| upagītiḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
rohītakalatāḥ klṛptāḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ sābhayā jale||91||

lg.l: mūtre vā''sunuyāt tac ca saptarātrasthitaṃ pibet|

div.ab: Sa. rohītakalatāḥ latāḥ khaṇḍaṃ klṛptāḥ saharītakīr jale mūtre vā''sunuyāt| tac ca saptarātraṃ sthitaṃ jalaṃ mūtraṃ vā pibet| harītakyaś ca lehavad bhuñjīta| tat pītaṃ kāmalādighnam|

rohītakatvacaḥ kṛtvā palānāṃ pañcaviṃśatīm|
koladviprasthasaṃyuktaṃ kaṣāyam upakalpayet||93||
pālikaiḥ pañcakolais tu taiḥ samastaiś ca tulyayā|
rohītakatvacā piṣṭair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||94||
plīhābhivṛddhiṃ śamayaty etad āśu prayojitam| ---------------------------------------------|95|

Sa. rohītakatvacaḥ palānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiṃ kṛtvā badaraprasthadvayasaṃyuktaṃ kaṣāyam avatārayet| pañcakolaiḥ pālikais taiḥ samastaiḥ pañcakolaiḥ rohītakatvacā tulyayā piṣṭair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| etad dhṛtaṃ prayojitaṃ plīhābhivṛddhiṃ drāg eva śamayati|

---------------------------------------------|
kadalyās tilanālānāṃ kṣāreṇa kṣurakasya ca||95||
tailaṃ pakvaṃ jayet pānāt plīhānaṃ kaphavātajam| ---------------------------------------------|96|
Sa. kadalyādīnāṃ kṣāreṇa tailaṃ pakvaṃ pānena kaphavātotthaṃ plīhānaṃ parākaroti|

---------------------------------------------|
aśāntau gulmavidhinā yojayed agnikarma ca||96||
aprāptapicchāsalile plīhni vātakapholbaṇe| ---------------------------------------------|97|
Sa. evam apy anupaśāntau vātakaphotthe plīhny asañjātapicchodake gulmavidhānenāgnikarma yojayet|

---------------------------------------------|
paittike jīvanīyāni sarpīṃṣi kṣīrabastayaḥ||97||
raktāvasekaḥ saṃśuddhiḥ kṣīrapānaṃ ca śasyate| ---------------------------------------------|98|

Sa. paittike-pittelbaṇe, plīhni jīvanīyagaṇasādhitāni sarpīṃṣi tathā kṣīrabastiraktāvasekādi ca śasyate| "sirāṃ bhuktavato dadhnā vāmabāhau vimokṣayet|" (ślo. 85) ity anenaiva raktāvasekasyoktatvāt punarvacanaṃ prakarṣārtham| pittādhikye hi raktātivṛddhiḥ| tasmād atiraktasrāvo yojya iti pratipādanārtham etad uktam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
yakṛti plīhavat karma dakṣiṇe tu bhuje sirām||98||

div.ab: Sa. yakṛti plīhavat karma kāryam| sirāṃ punar dakṣiṇe bāhau dadyāt|

Sa. baddhodariṇe puruṣāya svinnāya gomūtratīkṣṇauṣadhayutaṃ tailasaindhavābhyāṃ saha nirūhaṃ dadyāt, sānuvāsanaṃ-pūrvam anuvāsanaṃ paścāc cety arthaḥ| udarīṇaḥ svedaniṣedhād baddhodariṇaḥ svedānujñānam apavāda iti naitat pūrvāparavyāhatam| parisraṃsīni-anulomakāraṇy annāni, asmai ca-jaṭhariṇe, tīkṣṇaṃ ca virecanaṃ dadyāt| udāvartaharaṃ karma kāryam| yac ca vātghnaṃ tac ca kāryam|

lg.l: jātaṃ jātaṃ jalaṃ srāvyam evaṃ tad yāpayed bhiṣak||101||

div.ab: Sa. chidrodaraṃ svedam antareṇa śleṣmodaravad upakramet| yadā tu kathañcid rasaś chidrebhyaḥ parisravan jaṭharam āpūrayitvā jalaṃ bhavet tadā taj jātaṃ salilaṃ srāvyam| na ca sakṛd eva srāvyam iti pratipādanārthaṃ vīpsā, jātaṃ jātaṃ jalaṃ srāvyam iti| kiyantaṃ kālaṃ srāvyam ? ity āha-evam ity ādi| evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, tat-baddhodaraṃ, yāpayet| svāsthyam iti yogyatayā'tra sambadhyate, tenaiva svāsthyaṃ prāpayed iti bodhyam| na tu yāpyaṃ vidadhyād iti vyākhyeyam, na hi yāpyam udaram asti|

apāṃ doṣaharāṇy ādau yojayed udakodare|
mūtrayuktāni tīkṣṇāni vividhakṣāravanti ca||102||
dīpanīyaiḥ kaphaghnaiś ca tam āhārair upācaret| ---------------------------------------------|103|

Sa. udakodare pūrvam apāṃ doṣaharāṇi yojayet| tāni sarvāṇi gomūtrayuktāni tathā tīkṣṇāni tathā vividhāḥ kṣārā vidyante yeṣu tāni vividhakṣāravanti, anekakṣārayuktānīty arthaḥ| nanu, apām ity anarthakam, "yojayed udakodare" ity anenaivodakaharatvasya siddhatvāt| atrocyate| apāṃ ca harṇāni yaś ca tatra saṃsṛṣṭo doṣo 'dbhis tasya ca haraṇāni jalasaṃsṛṣṭadoṣaharaṇānīti pratipādayitum uktam| ādāv iti nirdeśāt paścād vātādidoṣānusāreṇa copakramaḥ kārya iti dyotayati| tathā bhojanair dīpanīyaiḥ kaphāpahaiś copācaret|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kṣāraṃ chogakarīṣāṇāṃ srutaṃ mūtre 'gninā pacet||103||

lg.l: ghanībhavati tasmiṃś ca karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kṣipet|

div.ab: Sa. kṣāraṃ chāgakarīṣāṇāṃ mūtre srutaṃ cāgninā pacet| asmiṃś ca kṣārajale ghanībhavati sati karṣāṃśaṃ rajīkṛtaṃ pippalyādikaṃ kṣipet| tataḥ-tasmāt kṣārāt, gulikāḥ kolābhāḥ kṛtvā sauvīrakāloḍitā ajarakādau pibet|
Sa. iti-evaṃ, auṣadhair aśāntau satyāṃ triṣu baddhacchidrodakodareṣu vaidya ārtajñātibhir nṛpeṇa cābhyārthitaḥ san śastraṃ prayuñjīta|

lg.l: markoṭair daṃśayec chidraṃ teṣu lagneṣu cāharet||110||
aktāni madhusarpirbhyām atha sīvyed bahir vraṇam||111||

div.ab: Sa. baddhakṣatāntrayoḥ-baddhodare chidrodare ca, snigdhasvinnaśarīrasya nābher adha udaraṃ caturaṅgulād vāmena muktvā caturaṅgulapramāṇaṃ pāṭayet| tena ca-chidreṇa, antrāṇi bahir niṣkāsya bālamalalepopalādikam apanayed iti baddhodaropakramaḥ| chidrodaropakramam āha-chidre tu parīsrāviṇi śalyam uddhṛtya parisravamātraṃ viśodhyānantaraṃ markoṭaiś chidraṃ daṃśayet| teṣu ca-markoṭeṣu, bhakṣayituṃ lagneṣu mūrdhnaḥ-śiraso 'paraṃ, kāyaṃ markoṭānām ākarṣet| anu [ca]-paścāc ca, antrāṇi madhusarpirbhyām aktāni yathāsthānaṃ sthāpayet| [atha-] anantaraṃ, bahir vraṇaṃ sīvyet| bahiḥśabdanirdeśād ābhyantaragataṃ na sīvyed iti gamyate| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, kṛṣṇamṛdā madhuyaṣṭikāmiśrayā''lipya badhnīyāt| anantaraṃ nivātasthaḥ kṣīravṛttiḥ san snehadroṇyāṃ vaset| adhunā jalodarasyānyeṣām api jātajalānāṃ jaṭharāṇāṃ cikitsārtham āha-

lg.l: nidhāya tasmin nāḍīṃ ca srāvayed ardham ambhasaḥ||114||
athāsya nāḍīm ākṛṣya tailena lavaṇena ca|
vraṇam abhyajya badhvā ca veṣṭayed vāsasodaram||115||
tṛtīye 'hni caturthe vā yāvad āṣoḍaśaṃ dinam|
tasya viśramya viśramya srāvayed alpaśo jalam||116||

div.ab: Sa. sajale jaṭhariṇo jaṭhare tailaiḥ-tilānāṃ tailaiḥ sarṣapairaṇḍatailādibhiś ca, anilaghnair abhyaktasya tathoṣṇāmbunā svinnasyākakṣaṃ-kakṣāntaṃ yāvat, udare paṭṭena-vastreṇa veṣṭite, tad udaraṃ vastreṇaiva veṣṭayitvā baddhacchidrodarayor yat kathitaṃ sthānaṃ tasmin sthāne 'ṅgulapramāṇaṃ vidhyet| tasmiṃś ca chidre nāḍīṃ nidhāya jalasyodarasthasyārdhaṃ srāvayet| jalasrāvād anantaram asya-udariṇo, nāḍīm ākṛṣya salavaṇena tailena vraṇam abhyajya baddhvā ca vāsasā jaṭharaṃ veṣṭayet| tṛtīye divase 'thavā caturthe yāvad āṣoḍaśaṃ dinaṃ tasya-udariṇo, viśramya viśramyālpaśaḥ-alpam alpaṃ kṛtvā, jalaṃ-doṣaṃ, srāvayet| sahasā hi pracurajalasrāvaṇād apāyaḥ syāt| tasmāt srutidivasād anantaraṃ tṛtīye caturthe pañcamādau vā dine śarīrabalābalam apekṣya ṣoḍaśadinaṃ maryādīkṛtya jalasrāvaṇaṃ kāryam| jaṭharaṃ ca śithilaṃ vāsasā gāḍhataraṃ viveṣṭayet| niḥsrute ca jale 'sau jaṭharī laṅghitaḥ san peyām asnehalavaṇāṃ< pibet| nañ atra īṣadarthaḥ| īṣat snehalavaṇaṃ kledarakṣārthaṃ vātakoparakṣārthaṃ ca| anyathā hi 'rūkṣāṃ nirlavaṇāṃ pibet' ity evaṃ nirdeśam ācāryaḥ kuryāt|

lg.l: syāt kṣīravṛttiḥ ṣaṇmāsāṃs trīn peyāṃ payasā pibet|
trīṃś cānyān payasaivādyāt phalāmlena rasena vā||118||

div.ab: Sa. ṣaṇmāsān kṣīravṛttiḥ syāt| trīn māsān kṣīrapeyāṃ pibet| trīṃś cānyān māsān payasaiva jīrṇaṃ śyāmākakodravam adyāt| phalāmlena vā māṃsarasena| katham ? alpam alpam| tathā, īṣat snehalavaṇam| [evaṃ-] anena prakāreṇa, prayataḥ salilodaraṃ vatsareṇa vijayet|
varjyeṣu yantrito diṣṭe nātyadiṣṭe jitendriyaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|120|

Sa. varjyeṣv āhāravihārādiṣv atyarthoṣṇāmlalavaṇādiṣu (ślo. 125) yantrita udarī syāt| diṣṭe-kathite 'nnapānādau, nātiyantritaḥ syāt| adiṣṭe-akathite punar annapānādau, jitendriyaḥ syāt-alolupena tatra bhavitavyam ity arthaḥ| jalodaracikitsāprasaṅgena sarvodaracikitsām āha-

---------------------------------------------|
sarvam evodaraṃ prāyo doṣasaṅghātajaṃ yataḥ||120||
ato vātādiśamanī kriyā sarvatra śasyate| ---------------------------------------------|121|
Sa. sarvam evodaraṃ bāhulyena doṣasaṅghātotthaṃ yasmāt tasmāt sarvatrodare vātādiśamanī kriyā praśasyate| prāyograhaṇaṃ kiñcit prāktanakarmanimittam udaraṃ nāvaśyaṃ doṣasaṅghātajam iti|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
vahnir mandatvam āyāti doṣaiḥ kukṣau prapūrite||121||

lg.l: tasmād bhojyāni bhojyāni dīpanāni laghūni ca|

div.ab: Sa. vahnir mandatvaṃ yata āgacchati doṣair udare prapūrite sati tasmāt kāraṇāt bhojyāni-āhārāḥ, bhojyāni-bhakṣayitavyāni, jaṭharibhir dīpanāni laghūni ca| tathā saha pañcamūlena tathā'lpāmlādayo yeṣu tāni|

lg.l: bhāvitānāṃ gavāṃ mūtre ṣaṣṭikānāṃ ca taṇḍulaiḥ|
yavāgūṃ payasā siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ bhojayen naram||123||
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajanty eṣāṃ vātapittakaphās tathā||124||

div.ab: Sa. gomūtre bhāvitānāṃ ṣaṣṭikānāṃ taṇḍulair yavāgūṃ kṣīreṇa siddhāṃ prakāmaṃ-icchayā, naraṃ bhojayet| anu-paścāt, ikṣurasaṃ ca pibed udarāṇāṃ śāntyartham| tathā vātapittakaphāś caiṣāṃ-udariṇāṃ, svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ vrajanti|

atyarthoṣṇāmlalavaṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ grāhi himaṃ guru|
guḍaṃ tailakṛtaṃ śākaṃ vāri pānāvagāhayoḥ||125||
āyāsādhvadivāsvapnayānāni ca parityajet| --------------------------------------------|126|
Sa. atyarthoṣṇāmlalavaṇādikaṃ jaṭharī tyajet| vāri pānāvagāhayor yadi tyajet tarhi kiṃ peyam ? ity āha-

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
nātyacchasāndramadhuraṃ takraṃ pāne praśasyate||126||

div.ab: Sa. takram īṣadacchasāndramadhuraṃ pāne praśasyate| tac ca pavane sapippalīsaindhavaṃ śreṣṭham| pitte samaricaśarkaram| yavānyādibhiḥ sahs kaphodare hitam| trikaṭukādibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ sannipātodare| madhutailādibhiḥ plīhodare| hapuṣādibhir yutaṃ baddhodare| pippalīmadhuyutaṃ chidrodare| jalodare vyoṣayutaṃ śreṣṭham|
Sa. vātakaphārtānāṃ gauravārocakādiyutānāṃ takram amṛtatvāya kalpate-sampadyate| etac ca bruvan vātakaphayoḥ śuddhāv api deyam iti dyotayati|

lg.l: prayogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām anu kṣīraṃ prayojayet|

div.ab: Sa. sarveṣāṃ ca prayogāṇām anu kṣīraṃ prayojayet| tac ca kṣīraṃ sarvadhātūnāṃ sthiratvaṃ karoti| tathā balyaṃ syād doṣānubandhatvaṃ harati|
bheṣajāpacitāṅgānāṃ kṣīram evāmṛtāyate| 131 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne udaracikitsitaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|15|

Sa. bheṣajenāpacitaṃ śarīraṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ kṣīram evāmṛtatvāya sampadyata iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne udaracikitsitaṃ nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 15||

div.head: pāṇḍurogacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ vyākhyātum upakramyate| sambandhaś cāsya nidāna evoktaḥ|

Sa. pāṇḍvāturaḥ kalyāṇakākhyaṃ (hṛ. u. a. 6|27) , sarpir ādau pibet| ādāv ity anenaitad gamayati,-asmin vyādhau prādhānyena pittacikitsā kāryā, tadanu vātakaphayoḥ| tathā ca pittasyaivaitadvyādhikartṛtve prādhānyam| ata eva ca nidāne 'dhyagīṣṭa (hṛ. ni. a. 13|1)- "pittapadhānāḥ kupitāḥ" ity ādi| tasmāt pittasyopaśāntyai sarpiḥpānaṃ yuktam| pañcagavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ-apasmārapratiṣedhoktam (hṛ. u. a. 7|20)| mahātiktaṃ-kuṣṭhacikitsitoktam (hṛ. ci. a. 19|8)| āragvadhādigaṇena (hṛ. sū. a. 15|17) vā pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet|

lg.l: dāḍimāt kuḍavo dhānyāt kuḍavārdhaṃ palaṃ palam|
citrakāc chṛṅgaberāc ca pippalyardhapalaṃ ca taiḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. dāḍimasya kuḍavam, dhānyakāt kuḍavārdham, citrakaśuṇṭhyoḥ pratyekaṃ palam, pippalyā dvau karṣau, taiḥ piṣṭhair ghṛtasya palāni viṃśatiṃ toyāḍhake pacet| tac ca siddhaṃ hṛdayādyartijit, dīpanādiguṇayuktaṃ ca| duḥkhaprasavinīnāṃ strīṇāṃ vandhyānāṃ-aprasavinīnāṃ ca, śasyate|

lg.l: snehitaṃ vāmayet tīkṣṇaiḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ ca śodhayet|

div.ab: Sa. snehitaṃ pāṇḍurogiṇaṃ tīkṣṇair vāmayet| punar api snigdhaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṣīreṇa śodhayet| kevalena vā payasā śodhayet|

dantīphalarase koṣṇe kāśmaryāñjalim āsutam|
drākṣāñjaliṃ vā mṛditaṃ tat pibet pāṇḍurogajit||6||
mūtreṇa piṣṭāṃ pathyāṃ vā tatsiddhaṃ vā phalatrayam| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. dantīphalarase koṣṇe kāśmaryāñjalim āsutaṃ pibet, tad etad ubhayam api pāṇḍurogaghnam| gomūtreṇa piṣṭāṃ haritakīṃ vā pibet| tena-gomūtreṇa, siddhaṃ-kvathitaṃ, phalatrayaṃ vā pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
svarṇakṣīrītrivṛcchyāmābhadradārumahauṣadham||7||

gomūtrāñjalinā piṣṭaṃ śṛutaṃ tenaiva vā pibet|
sādhitaṃ kṣīram ebhir vā pibed doṣānulomanam||8||

div.ab: Sa. svarṇakṣīryādikaṃ gomūtrāñjalinā piṣṭam athavā tenaiva-gomūtreṇa, śṛutaṃ pibet| ebhir vā svarṇakṣīryādibhir dravyaiḥ kṣīraṃ sādhitaṃ doṣānulomakaraṃ pibet|

lg.l: mūtre sthitaṃ vā saptāhaṃ payasā'yorajaḥ pibet|
jīrṇe kṣīreṇa bhuñjīta rasena madhureṇa vā||9||

div.ab: Sa. gomūtre saptāhaṃ sthitaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ kṣīreṇa pibet| jīrṇe tasmin dugdhena sahānnaṃ bhuñjīta| māṃsarasena vā madhureṇa-na tv amlena|
śuddhaś cobhayato lihyāt pathyāṃ madhughṛtadrutām| ---------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. śuddhaś cobhayataḥ-pāyuto mūrdhataś ca, harītakīṃ madhghṛtadrutāṃ lihyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
viśālākaṭukāmustākuṣṭhadārukaliṅgakāḥ||10||

lg.l: pītvā tac cūrṇam ambhobhiḥ sukhair lihyāt tato madhu||11||
pāṇḍurogaṃ jvaraṃ dāhaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsam arocakam|
gulmānāhāmavātāṃś ca raktapittaṃ ca taj jayet||12||

div.ab: Sa. viśālādaya, ṣaṭ karṣamātrāḥ, mūrvā dvikarṣapramāṇā, ardhakarṣadghnī ativiṣā tad etac cūrṇaṃ koṣṇāmbunā pītvā mākṣikaṃ lihyāt| etac ca pāṇḍurogādīn hanti|
Sa. vāsādikvātho madhuyutaḥ pāṇḍvādīn hanti|

vyoṣāgnivellatriphalāmustais tulyam ayorajaḥ|
cūrṇitaṃ takramadhvājyakoṣṇāmbhobhiḥ prayojitam||14||
kāmalāpāṇḍuhṛdrogakuṣṭhārśomehanāśanam| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. vyoṣādibhis tulyam ayorajaś cūrṇitaṃ takrādibhir upayojitaṃ kāmalādināśanam|

---------------------------------------------|
guḍanāgaramaṇḍūratilāṃśān mānataḥ samān||15||
pippalīdviguṇān dadyād guṭikāṃ pāṇḍurogiṇe| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. guḍādikān samabhāgān pippalīdviguṇān imāṃ guṭikāṃ pāṇḍurogiṇe dadyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
tāpyaṃ dārvyās tvacaṃ cavyaṃ granthikaṃ devadāru ca||16||
vyoṣādinavakaṃ caitac cūrṇayed dviguṇaṃ tataḥ|
maṇḍūraṃ cāñjananibhaṃ sarvato 'ṣṭaguṇe 'tha tat||17||
pṛthag vipakve gomūtre vaṭakīkaraṇakṣame|
prakṣipya vaṭakān kuryāt tān khādet takrabhojanaḥ||18||
ete maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ prāṇadāḥ pāṇḍurogiṇāṃ|
kuṣṭhāny ajarakaṃ śopham ūrustambharocakam||19||
arśāṃsi kāmalāṃ mehān plīhānaṃ śamayanti ca| ---------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. tāpyādikaṃ vyoṣādinavakaṃ ca-pūrvoktaṃ, cūrṇayet| tataḥ-tebhyo, dviguṇaṃ maṇḍūram añjanasadṛśaṃ sarvebhyo 'ṣṭaguṇe mūtre pṛthak vipakve ca vaṭakīkaraṇakṣame-ghane sati, prakṣipya vaṭakān kuryāt| tāṃś ca takrapradhānabhojanaḥ san prāśrnīyāt| ete maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ pāṇḍvāmayināṃ prāṇādās tathā kuṣṭhādīn ghnanti|

---------------------------------------------|
tāpyādrijaturaupyāyomalāḥ pañcapalāḥ pṛthak||20||
citrakatriphalāvyoṣaviḍaṅgaiḥ pālikaiḥ saha|
śarkarāṣṭapalonmiśrāś cūrṇitā madhunā drutāḥ||21||
pāṇḍurogaṃ viṣaṃ kāsaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ jvaram|
kuṣṭhāny ajarakaṃ mehaṃ śophaṃ śvāsam arocakam||22||
viśeṣād dhanty apasmāraṃ kāmalāṃ gudajāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. tāpyādayaḥ pṛthak pañcapalāś citrakādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ saha śarkarāṣṭapalayutāś cūrṇīkṛtā madhunā dravīkṛtāḥ pāṇḍurogādīn ghnanti| viśeṣeṇāpasmārādīṃś ca|

---------------------------------------------|
kauṭajatriphalānimbapaṭolaghananāgaraiḥ||23||
bhāvitāni daśāhāni rasair dvitriguṇāni vā|
śilājatupalāny aṣṭau tāvatī sitaśarkarā||24||
tvak''kṣīrīpippalīdhātrīkarkaṭākhyāḥ palonmitāḥ|
nidigdhyāḥ phalamūlābhyāṃ palaṃ yuktyā trijātakam||25||
madhutripalasaṃyuktān kuryād akṣasamān guḍān|
dāḍimāmbupayaḥ pakṣirasatoyasurāsavān||26||
tān bhakṣayitvā'nu piben niranno bhukta eva vā|
pāṇḍukuṣṭhajvaraplīhatamakārśobhagandaram||27||
hṛnmūtrapūtiśukrāgnidoṣaśoṣagarodaram|
kāsāsṛgdarapittāsṛkśophagulmagalāmayān||28||
mehavardhmabhramān hanyuḥ sarvadoṣaharāḥ śivāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. kāṭajādibhir dravyai rasaiḥ-rasatāṃ gataḥ, kvāthīkṛtair ity arthaḥ| śilājatupalāny aṣṭau daśāhāni dviguṇāni triguṇāni vā bhāvitāni| ahaḥśabdo vāropalakṣaṇārthaḥ| tad ayam ātrārtho 'vatiṣṭhate,-śilājatupalāṣṭakaṃ kevalaṃ jaladhautaṃ kauṭajādikaṃ tattulyam aṣṭaguṇite jale kvathitaṃ tato 'ṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣarasaṃ gṛhītvā tena rasena daśa vārān dviguṇān triguṇān vā bhāvayed iti| tāvatī-aṣṭapalapramāṇā sitaśarkarā, tvakkṣīryādikaṃ palonmitaṃ kaṇṭakāryāḥ phalamūlayoḥ palam| trijātakaṃ yuktyā-yāvatā trijātakenātisaugandhyaṃ hīnasaugandhyaṃ vā na syāt, evaṃ na hīnamātram atraitad deyam avyāpakatvāt, na vā'timātram apy ativyāpakatvenāyogārhatvāt| madhunas tribhiḥ palaiḥ saṃyuktān kārṣikān guḍān vidadhyāt| tān guḍān bhakṣayitvā'nu-paścāt, dāḍimajalādīni yathāyogaṃ pibet nirannaḥ kṛtāhāro vā| te ca vaṭakāḥ pāṇḍvādīn hanyuḥ| sarvadoṣaharāḥ śivāś ca syuḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
drākṣāprasthaṃ kaṇāpramthaṃ śarkarārdhatulāṃ tathā||29||

lg.l: dvipalaṃ madhukaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ tvakṣīrīṃ ca vicūrṇitam|

div.ab: Sa. drākṣāyāḥ ṣoḍaśapalāni pippalyāś ca| śarkarāyāḥ palāni pañcaśat| yaṣṭhyādikaṃ rajīkṛtaṃ dvipalapramāṇam| dhātrīphalarasasya droṇe sarvam etat kṣiptvā leham iva pacet| tasmāl lehāc chītāt sato madhunaḥ prasthayutāt pāṇitalaṃ-karṣamātraṃ, lihyāt| sa ca leho halīmakādīn niyacchati-parākaroti|
Sa. pāne bhojane ca śasyate hrasvapañcamūlajam| mṛdvīkārasa āmalakarasaś ca pāṇḍurogiṇāṃ kāmalārtānāṃ ca śasyate|
Sa. iti-evaṃ, pāṇḍuroge sāmānyena bhiṣagajitaṃ-auṣadhaṃ, proktam| bhiṣajdhātuḥ kaṇḍvādau bhiṣajyate smaktaḥ bhiṣagjitam| tadabhijñena vaidyena vikalpya-nirūpya, pṛthagdoṣabalaṃ lakṣaṇīkṛtya yojyam|
Sa. pavanaje pāṇḍau snehaprāyaṃ-snehabhūyiṣṭhaṃ, bheṣajam| tiktaśītaprāyaṃ tu paittike| ślaiṣmike tu kaṭurūkṣoṣṇabhūyiṣṭham| sannipātike vimiśraṃ cikitsitam|

lg.l: mṛdaṃ niryāpayet kāyāt tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ puraḥ|
balādhānāni sarpīṃṣi śuddhe koṣṭhe tu yojayet||35||

div.ab: Sa. kāyāt-śarīrāt, mṛdaṃ-śalyabhūtasthitāṃ, tīkṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ-snuhīkṣīrādibhiḥ, nirharet puraḥ-pūrvam| śuddhe tu koṣṭhe balādhānāni ghṛtāni yojayet| tāny evāha-

lg.l: mustāny ayorajaḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ devadāru ca||36||
vṛścikālī ca bhārgī ca sakṣīres taiḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam|

div.ab: Sa. vyoṣādibhir ghṛtāc caturthāṃśaih śṛtāni samena kṣīreṇa taccaturguṇajalena ghṛtaṃ sarvān vikārān mṛttikākṛtān śamayati|
tadvat kesarayaṣṭyāhvapippalīkṣīraśāḍvalaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. kesarādibhiḥ pakvaṃ sarpis tadvat-pūrvaguṇam|

---------------------------------------------|
mṛddveṣaṇāya tallolye vitared bhāvitāṃ mṛdam||38||
vellāgninimbaprasavaiḥ pāṭhayā mūrvayā'thavā| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. mṛddveṣaṇārthe tasyāṃ mṛdi laulye-lolupatve sati, vellādibhir bhāvitāṃ mṛdaṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
mṛdbhedabhinnadoṣānugamād yojyaṃ ca bheṣajam||39||

div.ab: Sa. mṛdo bhedo-viśeṣaḥ kṛṣṇapāṇḍurādiḥ, tena bhinno-viśeṣito, yo doṣas tasya vātāder jñānāt| "mṛtkaṣāyā'nilaṃ pittam ūṣarā madhurā kapham| dūṣayitvā" (hṛ. ni. a. 13|13) evaṃ lakṣaṇād doṣānugamad bheṣajaṃ yojyam| naivam eva mṛdbhakṣaṇamātravijñānena mṛnnirharaṇauṣadhaṃ caitad dhetuviparītam evety avehi| yato mṛdā hetubhūtayā yaḥ pāṇḍuroga udabhūta tasya mṛnnirharaṇaṃ viparītam eva|
kāmalāyāṃ tu pittaghnaṃ pāṇḍurogāvirodhi yat| ---------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. kāmalāyāṃ pittaharam auṣadhaṃ yat pāṇḍurogāvirodhi tad deyam|

---------------------------------------------|
pathyāśatarase pathyāvṛntārdhaśatakalkitaḥ||40||
prasthaḥ siddho ghṛtād gulmakāmalāpāṇḍuroganut| ---------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. pathyāśatakvāthe pathyāvṛntañcāśatkalkīkṛto ghṛtaprasthaḥ pakvaḥ kāmalādighnaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
āragvadhaṃ rasenekṣor vidāryāmalakasya vā||41||
satryūṣaṇaṃ bilvamātraṃ pāyayet kāmalāpaham| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. ikṣo rasena vidāryā rasenāmalakarasena vā sahatrikaṭukaṃ palapramāṇam āragvadhaṃ kāmalāpahaṃ pāyayet|

---------------------------------------------|
piben nikumbhakalkaṃ vā dviguḍaṃ śītavāriṇā||42||
kumbhasya cūrṇaṃ sakṣaudraṃ traiphalena rasena vā| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. nikumbhakalkaṃ vā paladvayapramāṇaṃ śiśirajalena pibet| kumbhacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrasahitaṃ vā traiphalena kvāthena pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
triphalāyā guḍūcyā vā dārvyā nimbasya vā rasam||43||
prātaḥ prātar madhuyutaṃ kāmalārtāya yojayet| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. triphalādyanyatamarasaṃ madhuyutaṃ prātaḥ kāmaline yojayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
niśāgairikadhātrībhiḥ kāmalāpaham añjanam||44||

div.ab: Sa. niśādibhir añjanaṃ kāmalāhṛt|

lg.l: tilapiṣṭanibhaṃ yas tu kāmalāvān sṛjen malam|

div.ab: Sa. yaḥ punaḥ kāmalāvān malaṃ tilapiṣṭasadṛśaṃ muñcet tasya kapharuddhamārgaṃ tasyāturasya kaphaghnair dravyaiḥ pittaṃ jayet|

rūkṣaśītagurusvāduvyāyāmabalanigrahaiḥ|
kaphasammūrcchito vāyur yadā pittaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet||46||
hāridranetramūtratvak''śvetavarcas tadā naraḥ|
bhavet sāṭopaviṣṭambho guruṇā hṛdayena ca||47||
daurbalyālpāgnipārśvārtihidhmāśvāsārucijvaraiḥ|
krameṇālpe 'nuṣajyeta pitte śākhāsamāśrite||48||
rasais taṃ rūkṣakaṭvamaliḥ śikhitittiridakṣajaiḥ|
śuṣkamūlakajair yūṣaiḥ kulatthotthaiś ca bhojayet||49||
bhṛśāmlatīkṣṇakaṭukalavaṇoṣṇaṃ ca śasyate|
sabījapūrakarasaṃ lihyād vyoṣaṃ tathā''śayam||50||
svaṃ pittam eti tenāsya śakṛd apy anurajyate|
vāyuś ca yāti praśamaṃ sahāṭopādyupadravaiḥ||51||
nivṛttopadravasyāsya kāryaḥ kāmaliko vidhiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|52|

Sa. rūkṣādibhiḥ pavanaḥ kupitaḥ kaphena miśrito yadā pittaṃ bahiḥ kṣipet tadā hāridranetrādiḥ puruṣo bhavet āṭopādimāṃś ca| hṛdayena ca guruṇā yuktaḥ| daurbalyādibhiḥ krameṇa kupito vāyur alpe pitte śākhāsamāśrite 'nuṣajyeta| anuṣajyeteti karmakartari| taṃ-tādṛśaṃ naraṃ, rasai rūkṣakaṭvamlair mayūrādimāṃsajais tathā śuṣkamūlakodbhavair yūṣais tathā kulatthotthair bhojayet| bhṛśāmlādikaṃ ca bhojanaṃ śasyate| tathā bījapūrakarasasahitaṃ vyoṣaṃ lihyāt| evaṃ kṛte saty asya pittaṃ svam āśayam eti, śakṛc cānurajyate, vāyuś ca praśamaṃ yāty āṭopāntrakūjanādibhir upadravaiḥ saha| asya-āturasya, apagatopadravasya sataḥ kāmalāvihito vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
gomūtreṇa pibet kumbhakāmalāyāṃ śilājatu||52||
māsaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ vā kiṭṭaṃ vā'tha hiraṇyajam| ---------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. kumbhakāmalāyāṃ gomūtreṇāloḍitaṃ śilājatu pibet| dhātumākṣikaṃ vā gomūtreṇa āsaṃ yāvat pibet| hiraṇyajaṃ [kiṭṭaṃ]-rūpyotthaṃ malaṃ vā, gomūtreṇa pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
guḍūcīsvarasakṣīrasādhitena halīmakī||53||
mahiṣīhaviṣā snigdhaḥ pibed dhātrīrasena tu|
trivṛtāṃ tadvirikto 'dyāt svādu pittānilāpaham||54||
drākṣālehaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ sarpīṃṣi madhurāṇi ca|
yāpanān kṣīrabastīṃś ca śīlayet sānuvāsanān||55||
mārdvīkāriṣṭayogāṃś ca pibed yuktyā'gnivṛddhaye|
kāsikaṃ cābhayālehaṃ pippalīṃ madhukaṃ balām||56||
payasā ca prayuñjīta yathā doṣaṃ yathā balam| ---------------------------------------------|57|

Sa. halīmakavān guḍūcīsvarasakṣīrapakvena mahiṣīghṛtena snigdhaḥ san trivṛtāṃ dhātrīrasena pibet| guḍūcīsvaraso 'tra ghṛtāc caturguṇaḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtasamam iti pākakramaḥ| tayā-trivṛtayā, virikte sati madhuraṃ vātapittaghnaṃ cādyāt| prāg uktaṃ ca drākṣālehaṃ (ślo. 29) bhakṣayet| madhuradravyasādhitāni ghṛtāni cādyāt| yāpanān-prāṇakāriṇaḥ (hṛ. ka. a. 4|37) , kṣīrabastīṃś ca śīlayed anuvāsanasahitān| mārdvīkāriṣṭayogāṃś ca yuktyā vahnivṛddhaye pibet| abhayālehaṃ ca-āgastyaṃ kāsacikitsitoktaṃ "prasthonmite yavakvāthe viṃśatir vijayāḥ" ity ādi, śīlayet| kṣīreṇa ca pippalīṃ madhuyaṣṭikāṃ balāṃ ca prayuñjīta yathādoṣād balāc ca|

---------------------------------------------|
pāṇḍurogeṣu kuśalaḥ śophoktaṃ ca kriyākramam|57| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|16|

Sa. pāṇḍurogeṣu śophacikitsitaṃ(toktaṃ) ca kriyākramaṃ sudhīḥ prayuñjīta| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne pāṇḍurogacikitsitaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 16||

div.head: śvayathucikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. pāṇḍurogacikitsitād anantaraṃ śophacikitsitaṃ vyākhyātuṃ prakramyate| sambandhaś cāsya nidāna evokta ity āha-

athātaḥ śvayathucikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) sarvatra sarvāṅgasare doṣaje śvayathau purā|
sāme viśoṣito bhuktvā laghu koṣṇāmbhasā pibet||1||
nāgarātiviṣādāruviḍaṅgendrayavoṣaṇam|
athavā vijayāśuṇṭhīdevadārupunarnavam||2||
navāyasaṃ vā doṣāḍhyaḥ śuddhyai mūtraharītakīḥ|
varākvāthena kaṭukākumbhāyastryūṣaṇāni vā||3||
athavā gugguluṃ tadvaj jatu vā śailasambhavam| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. sarvatra doṣaje śvayathau sarvāṅgaje tathā sāme viśoṣitaḥ san laghu bhuktvā koṣṇena jalena nāgarādi pibet| viśoṣaṇam atropavāsaḥ| athavā, vijayādīn koṣṇāmbhasā pibet| doṣabahulo navāyasaṃ-pāṇḍurogoktaṃ (hṛ. ci. 16|14) , pibet| śudhyarthaṃ gomūtreṇa harītakīḥ śīlayet| triphalākvāthena saha kaṭukātrivṛtālohacūrṇatrikaṭukāṇi śīlayet| gugguluṃ vā śilājatu vā triphalākvāthenaiva śīlayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
mandāgniḥ śīlayed āmagurubhinnavibaddhaviṭ||4||

div.ab: Sa. mandāgnir āmagurubhinnavibaddhaviṭ san takraṃ sauvarcalādiyutaṃ śīlayet| guḍayutām abhayāṃ takrānupānāṃ vā| tathaiva guḍanāgaraṃ takrānupānaṃ śīlayet|

lg.l: sakāmalāśoṣamanovikārān kāsaṃ kaphaṃ caiva jayet prayogaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. ārdrakaṃ vā tulyaguḍaṃ palārdhena pratidinaṃ vardhitaṃ paraṃ pañcapalaṃ yāvat| ekasminn eva dine palapañcakapramāṇaṃ syāt, punar api hrāsayed ardhapalaṃ yāvat| evaṃ māsaṃ yāvad eṣa prayogaḥ| yathocitaṃ kaphapittavātādhiko yūṣādibhojī syāt| eṣa ca prayogo gulmādīṃś caturdaśa kaphāntān jayet|

lg.l: ghṛtam ārdrakanāgarasya kalka- svarasābhyāṃ payasā ca sādhayitvā|

div.ab: Sa. ghṛtam ārdrakanāgarasya kalkasvarasābhyāṃ payasā ca sādhayitvā-paktvā, piban śophādibhir abhibhūto 'pi nirāmayaḥ syāt| ārdrakanāgaram ārdrakam ucyate| upajātyaupacchandasike vṛtte|

lg.l: mūtraṃ gor vā mahiṣyā vā sakṣīraṃ kṣīrabhojanaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. nirāmo baddhapurīṣaḥ śophārtaḥ san trivṛtā (trikaṭvā)- dibhiḥ sādhitaṃ payaḥ pibet| gor mahiṣyā vā sambandhi mūtraṃ sa[kṣīraṃ] kṣīrabhojanaḥ san pibet| tathā, uṣṭrakṣīrabhojanaḥ pānāhārābhyāṃ vinā saptāham athavā māsaṃ syāt| uṣṭrakṣīravartana ity atra "kukkuṭyādīnām aṇḍādiṣu" puṃvadbhāvo vaktavya ity uṣṭrīśabdasya puṃvadbhāvaḥ| kecid uṣṭrīkṣīreti jaguḥ|
Sa. yavānakādi karṣāṃśaṃ jalāḍhake pacet| tena-kvāthena, ghṛtaprasthaḥ pakvaḥ śophādihā syāt| brahmādiśabdasya prāyikatvāc chophādiśabdottarād api hanteḥ kvip|
dadhnaś citrakagarbhād vā ghṛtaṃ tattakrasaṃyutam| pakvaṃ sacitrakaṃ tadvad guṇaiḥ-----------------|13|
Sa. citrakagarbhād dadhnaḥ-citrakacūrṇamiśritāt kṣīrād yaj jātaṃ dadhi tasmān mathyamānāt, tattakreṇa-citrakatakreṇa, saṃyuktaṃ pakvaṃ tadvat-yavānakādighṛtasadṛśaṃ, guṇaiḥ|
Sa. kālavit-avasthādoṣādivit, dhānvantaraṃ (hṛ. ci. a. 12|19) , mahātiktaṃ (hṛ. ci. a.19/8) kalyāṇakaṃ (hṛ. u. a.6/27) abhayāghṛtaṃ (hṛ. ci. a. 15|28) yuñjyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
daśamūlakaṣāyasya kaṃse pathyāśataṃ pacet||14||

lg.l: dattvā guḍatulāṃ tasmin lehe dadyād vicūrṇitam|
prasthārdhaṃ ca hime kṣaudrāt tan nihanty upayojitam|

div.ab: Sa. daśamūlakaṣāyasyāḍhake pathyāśataṃ pacet| atra ca sāmānyaparibhāṣayā kvāthyadravyasya ca daśamūlasya dvātriṃśat palāni bhavanti| evaṃ ca tantrāntare virodhaḥ| tathā ca tatraivaṃ kathyate, (ca. ci. a. 12|50)- "dvipañcamūlasya tulākaṣāye kaṃse 'bhayānāṃ ca śataṃ guḍāc ca|" iti| tad evaṃ virodhaṃ paśyanto vyākhyām evaṃvidhāṃ vidvāṃso vidadhati,-daśamūlasya tulā, tasyāḥ kaṣāyo daśamūlakaṣāya iti| mayūravyaṃsakāditvād uttarapadalopi samāsaḥ| evaṃ daśamūlasya palaśataṃ tatkvāthasyāḍhake pathyāśataṃ pacet| guḍatulāṃ dattvā tasmin lehe vicūrṇitaṃ trijātakādi dadyāt| eteṣāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ vāsiṣṭhalehavet (hṛ. ci. a. 3|133) kalpyam| yavakṣārasya karṣamātraṃ deyam| tantrāntare hy uktam-"vyoṣāc catuṣpalaṃ dadyāt tripalaṃ trisugandhataḥ| karṣamātraṃ yavakṣārāt" iti| śīte ca sati mākṣikāt prasthārdhaṃ deyam| tat-etat, upayojitaṃ pravṛddhaśophādīn hanti| kharanādas tu jagāda-"daśamūlāḍhakam abhayāśatasahitaṃ pācayed apāṃ droṇe| avaśeṣitacaturaṃśe tasmin punaḥ prakṣipet pathyāḥ||" iti| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
purāṇayavaśālyannaṃ daśamūlāmbusādhitam||17||

lg.l: anamlaṃ mathitaṃ pāne madyāny auṣadhavanti ca||19||

div.ab:
Sa. śvayathoḥ purāṇayavādi daśamūlākvāthasādhitam alpaṃ tathā'lpalavaṇasnehaṃ bhojanaṃ hitam| kaiḥ saha ? maudgai rasaiḥ| kimbhūtaiḥ ? kṣāratryūṣaṇayuktaiḥ| tathā kaulatthai rasaiḥ| kimbhūtaiḥ ? sapippalīkaiḥ| tathā ca muniḥ (ca. ci. a. 12|62
)- "kulatthayūṣas tu sapippalīko maudgas tu satryūṣaṇayāvaśūkaḥ|
rasas tathā jāṅgalaviṣkirāṇāṃ sakūrmagodhāśikhiśallakānām||" iti| atra ca śikhino jāṅgalaviṣkiratvena gṛhītā api pathyataratvapratipādanārthaṃ punar upāttāḥ| tathā'yam eva tantrakṛd aṣṭāṅgāvatāre 'dhyagīṣṭa
(?)-"daśamūlāmbhasā siddhair vyoṣakṣārarajonvitaiḥ|
rasair jāṅgalajair maudnaiḥ kaulatthair maulakair api||" iti| tathety ādi| tathā jāṅgalamāṃsajais tathā kacchapādijaiś ca| pāne mathitam anamlaṃ madyāni ca sauṣadhāni hitāni|
Sa. ajājīprabhṛtibhiḥ peyā ghṛtatailābhyāṃ yuktyā bhṝṣṭā'tiśayena śophādimatāṃ hitā|
guṇais tadvac ca pāṭhāyāḥ pañcakolena sādhitā| ---------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. pañcakolena sādhitā peyā guṇais tadvac ca-pūrvoktaguṇā| tathaiva pāṭhāyāḥ sādhitā peyā syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śaileyakuṣṭhasthauṇeyareṇukāgurupadmakaiḥ||22||

lg.l: kuryād abhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ lepaṃ snānāya tūdakam||24||

div.ab: Sa. tathā śaileyādibhir abhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ lepaṃ snānārtham udakaṃ ca kuryāt|
snānaṃ vā nimbavarṣābhūnaktamālārkavāriṇā| ---------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. nimbādivāriṇā ca (vā) snānaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
ekāṅgaśophe varṣābhūkaravīrakakiṃśukaiḥ||25||

div.ab: Sa. ekāṅgaje śophe punarnavādibhir jalapiṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇair lepo hitaḥ| iti sāmānyena śvayathor upakramaḥ|

athānilotthe śvayathau māsārdhaṃ trivṛtaṃ pibet|
tailam eraṇḍajaṃ vātaviḍvibandhe tad eva tu||28||
prāgbhaktaṃ payasā yuktaṃ rasair vā kārayet tathā|
svedābhyaṅgān samīraghnān lepam ekāṅgage punaḥ||29||
mātuluṅgāgnimanthena śuṇṭhīhiṃsrāmarāhvayaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. anilaje śophe pakṣaṃ yāvat trivṛtaṃ tathairaṇḍatailaṃ pibet| vātaviḍvibandhe sati tad eva-pūrvoktam auṣadhaṃ, prāgbhaktaṃ kṣīreṇa māṃsarasena vā [yuktaṃ] pibet| tathā, svedābhyaṅgān vātaghnān kārayet, 'vaidyaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| tathā, anilottha ekāṅgage śophe mātuluṅgādibhir lepaṃ kārayet| hiṃsrā-siṃhī|

---------------------------------------------|
paitte tiktaṃ pibet sarpir nyagrodhādyena vā śṛtam||30||
kṣīraṃ tṛḍdāhamoheṣu lepābhyaṅgāś ca śītalāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. pittaśvayathau tiktakākhyaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| nyagrodhādigaṇena (hṛ. sū. a. 15|41) vā śṛtaṃ pibet| tathā, tṛḍādiṣu kṣīraṃ pibet| tathā, lepābhyaṅgāḥ śītā hitāḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
paṭolamūlatrāyantīyaṣṭyāhvakaṭukābhayāḥ||31||
dāru dārvī himaṃ dantī viśālā niculaṃ kaṇā|
taiḥ kvāthaḥ saghṛtaḥ pīto hanty antastāpatṛḍbhramān||32||
sasannipātavīsarpaśophadāhaviṣajvarān| ---------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. paṭolādīnāṃ kvātho ghṛtasahitaḥ pīto 'ntastāpatṛṣṇādīn hanti|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
āragvadhādinā siddhaṃ tailaṃ śleṣmodbhave pibet||33||

div.ab: Sa. kaphodbhave śophe āragvadhādinā siddhaṃ tailaṃ pibet|
Sa. srotovibandhe sati vahnau ca mande 'rocake ca sati stimitāśayaḥ san kṣārādīn śīlayet|
Sa. kṛṣṇādīn koṣṇān pralepa unmardane ca mūtrakalkitān yuñjīta|
Sa. mūtrajale kuṣṭhādibhiḥ siddhe snānāya hite| kulatthaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ vā kvathite gomūtrajale hite| vilepane caṇḍāguruṇī hite|

lg.l: ekaiṣikā ca lepaḥ syāc chvayathāv ekagātrage||37||

div.ab: Sa. kālājaśṛṅgyādaya ekāṅgage śophe lepaḥ syāt| kālā-nīlinī| bastagandhā-kāravī| ekaiṣikā-trivṛtā|
Sa. yathādoṣaṃ-doṣānusāreṇa, śuddhiṃ tathā raktāvasecanaṃ yathāsannaṃ kurvīta| saṃsargaje tu yathābhyadhikadoṣānusāreṇa kriyāṃ kuryāt|

lg.l: śophaṃ tridoṣaṃ cirajaṃ pravṛddhaṃ nighnanti bhūnimbamahauṣadhe ca||39||

div.ab: Sa. ajājyādayaḥ koṣṇajalapītāḥ śophaṃ tridoṣotthaṃ cirakālotpannaṃ vṛddhiṃ gataṃ nighnanti| bhūnimbanāgare ca 'hataḥ' iti vacanavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ| upajātivṛttam|

Sa. amṛtāyugalādikaṃ guggulusahitaṃ gomūtreṇa pītaṃ śophādīn hanti| vaitālīyam| "ṣaḍviṣame 'ṣṭau same kalās tāś ca same syur no nirantarāḥ| na samā'tra parāśritā kalā vaitālīye 'nte ralau guruḥ|" (vṛ. ra. a. 2|12)|

lg.l: iti nijam adhikṛtya pathyam uktaṃ kṣatajanite kṣatajaṃ viśodhanīyam|
srutihimaghṛtalepasekarekai- rviṣajanite viṣajic ca śopha iṣṭam||41||

div.ab: Sa. iti-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, nijaṃ śophaṃ-doṣajam adhikṛtya, [pathyaṃ-] cikitsitam uktam| kṣatotthe śophe kṣatajaṃ-asṛk, viśodhyam| kaiḥ ? raktasrāvādibhiḥ| viṣajanite śophe viṣaharam iṣṭam| puṣpitāgrā|

grāmyābjānūpaṃ piśitam abalaṃ śuṣkaśākaṃ tilānnaṃ gauḍaṃ piṣṭānnaṃ dadhi salavaṇaṃ vijjalaṃ madyam amlam|
dhānā vallūraṃ samaśanam atho gurv asātmyaṃ vidāhi svapnaṃ cārātrau śvayathugadavān varjayen maithunaṃ ca|42| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvayathucikitsitaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|17|

Sa. grāmyādimaṃsādi śophī varjayet| "mtau nyau yau jñeyā kusumitalatāvellitā'kṣartulokaiḥ|" iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvayathucikitsitaṃ nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 17||

div.head: visarpacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ visarpacikitsitam utsedhasāmānyāc cikitsāsādṛśyāc ca vyākhyāyate-
Sa. visarpeṣu pūrvam eva laṅghanādi hitam| snehanaṃ tu na hitam|
Sa. vamanaṃ visarpaghnaṃ madanaphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikendrayavānvitaṃ hitam| paṭolādibhir yutaṃ vā madanaphalaṃ hitam|

rasena yuktaṃ trāyantyā drākṣāyās traiphalena vā|
virecanaṃ trivṛccūrṇaṃ payasā sarpiṣā'thavā||3||
yojyaṃ, koṣṭhagate doṣe viśeṣeṇa viśodhanam| ---------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. trivṛccūrṇaṃ trāyantyā rasena yuktaṃ drākṣārasena vā triphalārasena vā virecanaṃ yojyam, kṣīreṇa ghṛtena vā trivṛccūrṇaṃ yuktam| koṣṭhagate doṣe viśeṣeṇa śodhanaṃ yojyam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
aviśodhasya doṣe 'lpe śamanaṃ candanotpalam||4||

div.ab: Sa. aśodhanārhasya puṃso 'lpe doṣe śamanaṃ candanotpalaṃ yojyam| mustanimbapaṭolaṃ vā yojyam| 'paṭolakaṭurohiṇī' (hṛ. sū. a. 15|15) ity ādikaṃ vā yojyam| sārivādikaṃ vā jale kvathitam|
Sa. durālabhādikaṃ kvathitaṃ śītakaṣāya vā tṛṣṇādimān pibet| tathā dārvyādīn nimbādibhiḥ saha kvathitān sarpir vimiśritān pibet|

lg.l: śākhāduṣṭe tu rudhire raktam evādito haret|

div.ab: Sa. rakte ca śākhāduṣṭe sati prathamaṃ rudhiram eva haret| kutaḥ ? ity āha-tvaṅmāṃsety ādi| yasmāt tvagādikledo raktakledāj jāyate, [ tasmād raktaṃ nirharet| ]

lg.l: ghṛtaṃ tiktaṃ mahātiktaṃ śṛtaṃ vā trāyamāṇayā||9||

div.ab: Sa. nirāme puṃsi tathā vātapittādhike kaphe ca kṣīṇe ghṛtaṃ tiktakādikaṃ hitam| pūrvaṃ sāmānyena visarpiṇaḥ snehanaṃ niṣiddham, avasthāviśeṣeṇa ca snehanam idam uktam, iti pūrvāparavyāhatatvam atra nāśaṅkanīyam|
Sa. rakte nirhṛte 'ntarviśuddhe doṣe tvaṅmāṃsāśrite sati pralepasekādyā bahiḥkriyāḥ-parimārjane vidheyāḥ, śīghram eva visarpaśāntaye syuḥ|

lg.l: surāhvā kṛṣṇagandhā ca kuṣṭhaṃ cālepanaṃ cale||11||

div.ab: Sa. śatapuṣpādikaṃ cale-vātavisarpe, pralepanaṃ hitam| ārtagalo-nīlaḥ sahacaraḥ|
nyagrodhādigaṇaḥ pitte tathā padmotpalādikam| ---------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. nyagrodhādigaṇaḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 15|49) pittavisarpe pralepo hitaḥ| tathā pittavisarpe padmotpalādikaṃ-daśagranthyākhyaṃ (saṅgrahākhya) tantrad avadhāryam| yathā,- ṣaḍdharaṇākhyo yogaḥ (saṃ. ci. a. 21)| saṅgrahe caivaṃ paṭhyate (ci. a. 20)- "padmotpalaśaivālapaṅkadūrvāmṛṇālaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaśarkarāhrīberacandanamuktāmaṇigairikapayasyāprapauṇḍarīkamadhukapadmakaghṛtakṣīrāṇi|" iti|

nyagrodhapādās taruṇāḥ kadalīgarbhasaṃyutāḥ||12||
bisagranthiś ca lepaḥ syāc chatadhautaghṛtāplutaḥ|
padminīkardamaḥ śītaḥ piṣṭaṃ mauktikam eva vā||13||
śaṅkhaḥ pravālaṃ śuktir vā gairikaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam| ---------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. nyagrodhasya pādās taruṇāḥ-abhinavāḥ, kadalīgarbhānvitā bisagranthiś ca lepo 'yaṃ śatadhautaghṛtāloḍitaḥ| tathā, padminīpaṅkaḥ śiśiraḥ, mauktikaṃ vā jalapiṣṭam, śaṅkho vā piṣṭo vidrumo vā śuktir vā, athavā gairikaṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ, lepo hitaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
triphalāpadmakośīrasamaṅgākaravīrakam||14||
nalamūlānyanantā ca lepaḥ śleṣmavisarpahā| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. triphalādibhir lepaḥ śleṣmavisarpahṛt|

---------------------------------------------|
dhavasaptāhvakhadiradevadārukuraṇṭakam||15||
samustāragvadhaṃ lepo vargo vā varuṇādikaḥ|
āragvadhasya patrāṇi tvacaḥ śleṣmātakodbhavāḥ||16||
indrāṇiśākaṃ kākāhvā śirīṣakusumāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. dhavādikaṃ "varuṇasairyaka" (hṛ. sū. a. 15|21) ity ādir vā karṇikārasya vā patrāṇi śleṣmātakatvaco vā indrāṇyādayo vā lepaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
sekavraṇābhyaṅgahavirlepacūrṇān yathāyatham||17||
etair evauṣadhaiḥ kuryād vāyau lepā ghṛtādhikāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. ebhir eva śleṣmavisarpalepauṣadhaiḥ sekādīn kuryāt| vraṇābhyāṅgāya havir iti 'aśvaghāsavat' samāsaḥ| vāyau ye lepā uktās te ghṛtādhikāḥ kāryāḥ| adhikaśabdanirdeśāc cedaṃ gamayati,-anyatrāpi pittavisarpe kaphavisarpe ca ye lepā uktās te 'pi sa ghṛtāḥ kāryāḥ, na tv aghṛtā ity arthaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
kaphasthānagate sāme pittasthānagate 'thavā||18||
aśītoṣṇā hitā rūkṣā raktapitte ghṛtānvitāḥ|
atyarthaśītās tanavas tanuvastrāntarāsthitāḥ||19||
yojyāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe 'nye mandavīryās ta eva ca| ---------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. kaphasthānagate sāme vāyau kiñcicchītoṣṇarūkṣāś ca pralepā hitāḥ, pittasthānagate ca| raktapitte tu ghṛtānvitā gatyantaśītās tanavas tathā tanuvastrāntarāsthitāḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe 'pare 'pare yojyāḥ| ca-śabdo yasmād arthe| yasmāt ta eva punaḥ punaḥ prayujyamānā mandavīryāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe saṃsṛṣṭam etat karma praśasyate||20||

div.ab: Sa. saṃsṛṣṭadoṣe visarpe-ubhayarūpe ca saṃsargākhye sannipātākhye ca, etat karma-idaṃ cikitsitam, yat pratidoṣam uktaṃ tad eva yathāyathaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ kṛtvā tatra praśasyate| iti sāmānyena saṃsṛṣṭadoṣacikitsitam uktvā vātapittajādiṣv agnivisarpādiṣūpakramam āha-

Sa. agniśabdenāgnivisarpa upalakṣyate| tasya ca lakṣaṇam (hṛ. ni. a. 13|50)- "vātapittāj jvara" ity ādi yāvat "duṣprabodho 'śrute nidrāṃ so 'gnivīsarpa ucyate|" iti| tam agnivisarpaṃ śatadhautaghṛtena pralepayet| secayed ity ādi| athavā kevalena ghṛtamaṇḍena secayet| śiśireṇa madhuyaṣṭījalena vā secayet| evaṃ śarkarājalena mustajalena kṣīreṇekṣurasena veti yojyam| pānādiṣu mahātiktaṃ (hṛ. ci. a. 19|8) suṣṭhu hitam|
Sa. granthavisarpe raktapittaghnaṃ karma kṛtvā tataḥ kaphānilaghnaṃ karma piṇḍasvedādikam iṣṭam|
Sa. granthivīsarpaśūle sati daśamūlavipakvenoṣṇena tailena secayet| tathaiva mūtrair daśamūlavipakvair iti vacanavipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ| jalena vā daśamūlakvathitena secayet|
Sa. athavā, kṛṣṇagandhayā piṣṭayā sukhoṣṇayā pradihyāt| athavā, naktamālatvacā piṣṭayā sukhoṣṇayā pradihyāt| śuṣkamūlakaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ sukhoṣṇair athavā kalinā-bibhītakena, sukhoṣṇena lepayet|

lg.l: bhallātakāsthi kāsīsaṃ lepo bhindyāc chilām api||26||
dīrghakālasthitaṃ granthim ebhir bhindyāc ca bheṣajaiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. dantyādibhir dravyair lepaḥ śilām api bhindyāt| kim uta kaphajaṃ bāhyamārgāśritaṃ granthiṃ lepo na bhindyāt| cirakālāvasthitaṃ granthim ebhir eva-pūrvoktair auṣadhaiḥ, bhindyāt|

Sa. mūlakādiyūṣādibhiḥ sakṣāradāḍimair godhūmādibhojanais tathā pānaiḥ sasīdhumadhuśa(śā)rkarais tathā sakṣaudrair vāruṇīmaṇḍair mātuluṅgarasānvitais tathā "triphalāyāḥ prayogaiḥ" ity ārabhya yāvat "taptāyohemalavaṇapāṣāṇādiprapīḍanaiḥ|" "dīrghakālasthitaṃ granthiṃ bhindyāt" ity anuvartya yojyam|

lg.l: ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhir vividhābhir bale sthitaḥ|
athāsya dāhaḥ kṣāreṇa śarair hemnā'pi vā hitaḥ|
pākibhiḥ pācayitvā vā pāṭayitvā tam uddharet||33||

div.ab: Sa. ābhiḥ-pūrvoktābhiḥ, kriyābhiḥ siddhābhiḥ-siddharṣipraṇītatvād asaṃvādinībhiḥ, tathā vividhābhiḥ-anekaprakārābhiḥ prayuktābhiḥ, bale sthito granthir dīrghakālānubandhatvād atiprabṛddhaḥ ata eva pāṣāṇakaṭhino yadi naivopaśāmyati| atha-anantaraṃ, asya dāhaḥ kṣāreṇa hitaḥ, agninā śarair hemnā'pi vā hitaḥ| athavā, pākibhir auṣadhaiḥ-bāhyāntaḥ śodhanaiḥ, pācayitvā pāṭayitvā taṃ-granthiṃ, udvaret|

lg.l: mokṣayed bahuśaś cāsya raktam utkleśam āgatam|

div.ab: Sa. asya-granther gnanthivisarpavato, raktam utkleśam āgataṃ-vikārakāraṇaṃ pratyunmukhatāṃ prāptaṃ, bahuśo mokṣayet| punaś ca rakte 'pahṛte vātaśleṣmajidauṣadhaṃ tatra hitam|

praklinne dāhapākābhyāṃ bāhyāntarvraṇavatkriyā|
dārvīviḍaṅgakampillaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vraṇe hitam||35||
dūrvāsvarasasiddhaṃ tu kaphapittottare ghṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. praklinne sarvasmin visarpe dāhapākābhyāṃ copalakṣite bāhyāntarvraṇavatkriyā syāt| tathā, dārvyādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vraṇe hitam| vātapradhāne visarpa ity arthād gamyate| tathā, kaphapittottare visarpe dūrvāsvarasena pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
ekataḥ sarvakarmāṇi raktamokṣaṇam ekataḥ||36||

lg.l: visarpo na hy asaṃsṛṣṭaḥ so 'srapittena jāyate|
raktam evāśrayaś cāsya bahuśo 'sraṃ hared ataḥ||37||

div.ab: Sa. ekataḥ-ekasmiṃś cikitsāpakṣe, sarvakarmāṇi-yathānirdiṣṭāni, raktamokṣaṇam ekataḥ-ekasmin pakṣe| evaṃ visarpoddiṣṭayā sarvacikitsayā raktamokṣaṇasya ca visarpaśamane tulyatvāt| nanu, katham etat syāt ? ity āha- yasmād visarpaḥ sarvo raktapittenāsaṃsṛṣṭaḥ-asambaddho, na jāyate, na kadācid raktapittābhyām antareṇotpadyata ity arthaḥ| asya ca-visarpasya, raktam evāśrayo nānyaḥ| ataḥ-asmāt, bahuśo-bahūn, raktam eva haret|

na ghṛtaṃ bahudoṣāya deyaṃ yan na virecanam|
tena doṣo hy upastabdhas tvagraktapiśitaṃ pacet|38| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne visarpacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|18|

Sa. bahudoṣāya visarpiṇe tad dhṛtaṃ na deyaṃ yad virecanaṃ na bhavati| pittaṃ hi visarpe prādhānyena cikitsyam| pittasya ca virecanam upakramapradhānam iti| tena-ghṛtena avirecanena, yasmād upastabdhaḥ-stambhito doṣaḥ, tvagraktamāṃsāni pacet| tasmād virecanakaram eva ghṛtaṃ yojyam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne visarpacikitsitaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 18||

div.head: kuṣṭhacikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ kuṣṭhacikitsitam ārabhyate| sambandhaś cāsya nidāna evokta ity āha-

ab.seg: athātaḥ kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. tvagraktamāṃsādidūṣaṇāt tatsravaṇād āmayasvabhāvāc ca kāyakārśyaṃ kuṣṭhinaḥ prāyeṇāvaśyaṃ bhāvi| anenaivānusāreṇa vakṣyati (ślo. 16)- "snehair āpyāyayec cainaṃ kuṣṭhaghnair antarā'ntarā|" ity āha-
kuṣṭhinaṃ snehapānena pūrvaṃ sarvam upācaret| ---------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. kuṣṭhavantaṃ naraṃ sarvam eva snehapānair upakramet-śarīrāpyāyanārthaṃ pūrvam asya snehopayogo yukta ity arthaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
tatra vātottare tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ hitam||1||
daśamūlāmṛtairaṇḍaśārṅgeṣṭāmeṣaśṛṅgibhiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. tasmin vātottare kuṣṭhe daśamūlādibhiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīpāṭhādurālabhāḥ||2||

lg.l: parpaṭaṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca palāṃśaṃ pācayed apām|
sarpiṣo dvādaśapalaṃ pacet tat tiktakaṃ jayet||4||
arśo 'srapittam anyāṃś ca sukṛcchrān pittajān gadān||7||

div.ab: Sa. paṭolādi palāṃśaṃ dvyāḍhake pācayet| tenāṣṭabhāgaśeṣeṇa kvāthena tathā karṣamātrais trāyantyādibhir ghṛtasya palāni dvādaśa pacet| tad evaṃ tiktakākhyaṃ sarpiḥ pittakuṣṭhādīn jayet| aparān api pittajān āmayān hanti| etaiś ca dvādaśapalamātraṃ pakvaṃ prakṛṣṭaguṇaṃ syād iti dṛṣṭaṃ tattvadarśibhir maharṣibhiḥ|

saptacchadaḥ parpaṭakaḥ śamyākaḥ kaṭukā vacā|
triphalā padmakaṃ pāṭhā rajanyau sārive kaṇe||8||
nimbacandanayaṣṭyāhvaviśālendrayavāmṛtāḥ|
kirātatiktakaṃ sevyaṃ vṛṣo mūrvā śatāvarī||9||
paṭolātiviṣāmustātrāyantīdhanvayāsakam|
tair jale 'ṣṭaguṇe sarpir dviguṇāmalakīrase||10||
siddhaṃ tiktān mahātiktaṃ guṇair abhyadhikaṃ matam| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. saptacchadādibhiḥ kalkair ghṛtād aṣṭaguṇe jale dviguṇāmalakarase sarpiḥ pakvaṃ mahātiktasaṃjñaṃ guṇaiś cābhyadhikaṃ tiktān matam, munīnām iti śeṣaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
kaphottare ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ nimbasaptāhracitrakaiḥ||11||
kuṣṭhoṣaṇavacāśālapriyālacaturaṅgulaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphottare nimbādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
sarveṣu cāruṣkarajaṃ tauvaraṃ sārṣapaṃ pibet||12||
snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā kṛmijitpathyābhallātakaiḥ śṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. sarveṣu ca kuṣṭheṣu bhallātakotthaṃ tuvarajaṃ sarṣapajaṃ vā sneham athavā ghṛtaṃ kṛmijidādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
āragvadhasya mūlena śatakṛtvaḥ śṛtaṃ ghṛtam||13||
piben kuṣṭhaṃ jayaty āśu bhajan sakhadiraṃ jalam| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. karṇikārasya mūlena śatavārān ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ piban kuṣṭhaṃ jayati khadirayutaṃ pānīyaṃ sevamānaḥ|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------|
ebhir eva yathāsvaṃ ca snehair abhyañjanaṃ hitam||14||

div.ab: Sa. ebhir eva pūrvoktaiḥ snehair yathāyogam abhyañjanaṃ hitam|
snigdhasya śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ visarpe yad udāhṛtam| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. snigdhasya kuṣṭhinaḥ śodhanaṃ yojyaṃ yad visarpe kathitam| tatra coktam (hṛ. ci. a. 18|3)- "rasena yuktaṃ trāyantyā drākṣāyāḥ" ity ādi|

---------------------------------------------|
lalāṭahastapādeṣu śirāś cāsya vimokṣayet||15||
pracchānam alpake kuṣṭhe śṛṅgādyāś ca yathāyatham| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. lalāṭādiṣu cāsyāturasya balāpekṣī vaidyo śirāṃ vimokṣayet| atyalpe kuṣṭhe pracchānaṃ syāt| yathāyathaṃ-yathāsvaṃ, śṛṅgādyāś ca syuḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
snehair āpyāyayec cainaṃ kuṣṭhaghnair antarā'ntarā||16||

lg.l: prabhañjanas tathā hy asya na syād dehaprabhañjanaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. antarā'ntarā srutaraktaṃ kṛtavirekaṃ ca kuṣṭhaghnaiḥ snehair enaṃ-kuṣṭhinaṃ, āpyāyayet| evaṃ kṛte saty asya-kuṣṭhino, muktaraktasya tathā viriktasyāta eva riktakoṣṭhasya prabhañjano dehasya prabhañjano-vighātako, na syāt|
Sa. vāsādibhiḥ siddhaṃ sarpir visarpādighnam| etac ca vajrakasaṃjñaṃ ghṛtaṃ vadanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: piṣṭaiḥ siddhaṃ sarpiṣaḥ prastham ebhiḥ krūre koṣṭhe snehanaṃ recanaṃ ca|

div.ab: Sa. triphalādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ pratyagrasruhīkṣīrapalena saha piṣṭair ebhir auṣadhair ghṛtaprasthaṃ caturguṇajalasiddhaṃ krūrakoṣṭhe snehanaṃ syāt recanaṃ ca| tathā, kuṣṭhādīn dāruṇān hanyāt| tac ca mahāvajrakaṃ nāma| aupacchandasikaśālinyau vṛtte|

lg.l: dantyāḍhakam apāṃ droṇe paktvā tena ghṛtaṃ pacet|

div.ab: Sa. dantyāś catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni jaladroṇe pacet| tena kvāthena rājakośātakīpale ghṛtaṃ pacet| tat pītam ūrdhvādho viśuddhikaram|

lg.l: tan mūlais tatra niryūhe ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||22||
pītvā tad ekadivasāntaritaṃ sujīrṇe bhuñjīta kodravam asaṃskṛtakāñjikena|
kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsam apacīṃ ca vijetum icchan icchan prajāṃ ca vipulāṃ grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ ca||23||

div.ab: Sa. āvartakyāḥ śataṃ droṇe 'pām aṣṭāṃśaśeṣitaṃ pacet| ttrakvāthe, tasyā mūlaiḥ kalkīkṛtair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| taddhṛtam ekadivasāntaritaṃ pītvā suṣṭhu jīrṇe ca ghṛte kodravam asaṃskṛtena kāñjikena saha bhuñjīta| kuṣṭhādīn vijigīṣuḥ, prajāṃ ca vistīrṇām icchan, grahaṇaṃ smṛtiṃ cābhilaṣan| vasantatilakāvṛttam|

Sa. yateḥ-brahmacaryāsthitasya, lelītakavasā mākṣikajātīrasayutā kuṣṭhaghnī syāt| lelītakavasā-sauvarcalalavaṇatailam, gandhakam eke| jātīraso-bolaḥ| athavā, samaghṛtā khadirāsanodakasahitā kuṣṭhaghnī syāt|

lg.l: annapānaṃ hitaṃ kuṣṭhe, na tv amlalavaṇoṣaṇam|

div.ab: Sa. śālyādikam annapānaṃ ca varādibhir yojitaṃ kuṣṭhe hitam| indurājiḥ-bākucī| amlādikam annapānaṃ na hitaṃ kuṣṭhe syāt| tathā dadhyādīn atiśayena varjayet| pratirogaṃ ca yan nidānavarjanaṃ tac cikitsitam evety avagantavyam|

ab.seg: paṭolamūlatriphalāviśālāḥ pṛthaktribhāgāpacitatriśāṇāḥ| syus trāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca| bhāgārdhike nāgarapādayukte||28||

lg.l: etat palaṃ jarjaritaṃ vipakvaṃ jale pibed doṣaviśodhanāya|
kuṣṭhaṃ kilāsaṃ grahaṇīpradoṣa- marśāṃsi kṛcchrāṇi halīmakaṃ ca|
ṣaḍrātrayogena nihanti caitad hṛdvastiśūlaṃ viṣamajvaraṃ ca||30||

div.ab: Sa. pṛthak-pratyekaṃ, tribhāgenāpacito-nyūnaḥ, tṛtīyaḥ śāṇo yeṣāṃ te paṭolādayaḥ pañca pṛthaktribhāgāpacitatriśāṇāḥ| loke 'pi caivaṃ prayuktā eva| yathā,-tribhāgonās trayo drammā deyā iti| atra hi dvau drammau tṛtīyaś ca drammas tribhāgena hīna iti gamyate| tad evaṃ paṭolasya śāṇau dvau dhānakāś ca catasro bhavanti| ṣaḍdhānako hi śāṇaḥ| evaṃ paṭolamūlādidravyāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśadhānakāḥ syuḥ| syāt trāyamāṇā kaṭurohiṇī ca bhāgārdhike| kimbhūte ? nāgarapādayukte satyau, na tu kevale| tad ayam arthaḥ,-trāyantyā dhānakāḥ ṣaṭ, kaṭukāyā dhānakāḥ ṣaṭ, nāgarasya dhānakāś catasraḥ| ṣoḍaśadhānakā hy atra mūladravyabhāgaḥ| tad evaṃ paṭolādīnāṃ pañcānām aśītir dhānakāḥ, trāyantīkaṭukayoḥ śuṇṭhīpādayutayoḥ ṣoḍaśadhānakāḥ, iti ṣaṇṇavatidhānakābhiḥ palaṃ bhavati| tad idaṃ palaṃ jarjaritaṃ kiñcic cūrṇitaṃ jale vipakvaṃ doṣaviśuddhyarthaṃ pibet| jīrṇe saty auṣadhe jāṅgalamṛgapakṣiṇāṃ māṃsarasaiḥ saha purāṇaśālyodanam aśrnīyāt| upajātī vṛtte| etac ca pītaṃ ṣaḍrātrayogena-ṣaḍdināny upayuktaṃ, kuṣṭhādīn hanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: guḍasya ca dvādaśa, māsam eṣa jitātmanāṃ hanty upayujyamānaḥ||31||
siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāha yakṣo mumukṣo- rbhikṣoḥ prāṇān māṇibhadraḥ kilemam||32||

div.ab: Sa. viḍaṅgasārādīnāṃ samuditānāṃ palatrayam, trīṇi palāni kumbhāt-trivṛtāyās trīṇi palāni, guḍasya ca dvādaśapalāni| eṣa prayogo jitendriyāṇāṃ māsam upayujyamāno vakṣyamāṇān gadān hanti| "upendravajrā tu jatau jagau gaḥ|" māsaśabdopādānāc ca pratyaham asmād yogād ardhapalaṃ dhānakānavaraktikātrayasahitam abhyavaharaṇīyatvenātrāvatiṣṭhate| anyatrāpi pradeśe ya evaṃvidho nirdeśas tatra parimāṇakalpanāyām ayam eva nyāyo 'numantavyaḥ| maṇibhadrākhyo yakṣo bhikṣoḥ prāṇān mumukṣoḥ-jīvitaṃ jihāsoḥ, imaṃ siddhaṃ yogaṃ prāṇakaraṃ prāha,-jagādety arthaḥ| atra bhūte kāle prāheti, tathā sādhu kilety āgamikatvaṃ ca sūcayati| śālinīvṛttam|
Sa. bhūnimbādayastulyā dantyādayaś ca yathottaraṃ dviguṇāś cūrṇitā madhusarpiṣā lihyāt| kuṣṭhādīnām etat paramaṃ bheṣajam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
varāviḍaṅgakṛṣṇā vā lihyāt tailājyamākṣikaiḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādīn vā tailaghṛtamākṣikair lihyāt|
Sa. kākodumbarikādikalkavān vṛkṣakakvāthaḥ pānāt sarvān tvagrogān hanti| kākodumbarikā-phalguḥ| vṛkṣako-vatsakaḥ|
Sa. kuṭajādikvāthe siddhāḥ pakvā harītakīr madhughṛtasaṃyuktāḥ kuṣṭhanudo bhakṣayet| āryāvṛttam|

ab.seg: dārvīkhadiranimbānāṃ tvakkvāthaḥ kuṣṭhasūdanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------||37||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyādīnāṃ tvakkvāthaḥ kuṣṭhanāśanaḥ syāt|

lg.l: kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ kaphapittakuṣṭhaṃ susevito dharma ivocchinatti||38||

ab.seg:
ebhir eva ca śṛtaṃ ghṛtamukhyaṃ bheṣjairjayati mārutakuṣṭham|
kalpayet khadiranimbaguḍūcī- devadārurajanīḥ pṛthag evam||39||

div.ab: Sa. niśādibhiḥ kaṣāyaḥ kṛtaḥ kaphapittajaṃ kuṣṭham uddalayati| suṣṭhu sevito yathā dharmaḥ| ebhir eva-pūrvoktair auṣadhaiḥ, pakvaṃ varaṃ ghṛtaṃ vātakuṣṭhaṃ jayati| evaṃ-anayaiva kalpanayā, pṛthak khadirādīn kalpayet| upajātisvāgate vṛtte|

lg.l: pāṭhādārvīvahnighuṇeṣṭākaṭukābhi- mūtraṃ yuktaṃ śakrayavaiś coṣṇajalaṃ vā|
kuṣṭhī pītvā māsam aruk syād gudakīlī mehīśophī pāṇḍurajīrṇī kṛmīmāṃś ca||40||

div.ab: Sa. pāṭhādibhir indrayavaiś ca gomūtraṃ yuktam athavoṣṇajalaṃ māsaṃ pītvā kuṣṭhī nīruk syāt| arśasādiś ca| "vedai randhrairmtau yasagā mattamayūram|" (vṛ. ra. a. 3|72)|

lg.l: raktā nimbaṃ surataru kṛtaṃ pañcamūlyau ca cūrṇaṃ pītvā māsaṃ jayati hitabhug gavyamūtreṇa kuṣṭham||41||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādicūrṇaṃ gomūtreṇa māsaṃ pītvā hitabhojī san kuṣṭhaṃ jayati| raktā-mañjiṣṭhā| surataruśabdasya napuṃsakatvam auṣadhavācitvāl lokāśrayatvāl liṅgasyeti vā| pañcamūlyau-deśamūlam ity arthaḥ| "mandākrāntā mabhanatatagā gaḥ samudrartulokaiḥ|"

lg.l: gavāmbupītaṃ vaṭakīkṛtaṃ tathā nihanti kuṣṭhāni sudāruṇāny api||42||

div.ab: Sa. niśādikaṃ krameṇa vivardhitaṃ gomūtreṇa pītam athavā vaṭakīkṛtaṃ kuṣṭhāni sukṛcchrāṇy api nihanti| "uśanti vaṃśastham idaṃ jatau jarau|"

lg.l: gulikā rasāyanaṃ ku- ṣṭhajic ca vṛṣyā ca saptasamā||43||

div.ab: Sa. trikaṭukādibhir gulikā vihitā rasāyanaṃ kuṣṭahṛd vṛṣyā ca syāt| evaṃ ca saptasamākhyā| trikaṭukatriphale hy atra samudāyarūpatvād dve eva kalpite| "āryā vipulā tu yā'nyathā pādabhāk|"

ab.seg: cāndraśakalāgnirajanī- viḍaṅgatuvarāsthyaruṣkaratriphalābhiḥ| vaṭakā guḍāṃśaklRptāḥ samastakuṣṭhāni nāśayanty abhyastāḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. candraśakalādibhir vaṭakā guḍāṃśena klRptāḥ-śīlitāḥ, niḥśeṣakuṣṭhāni ghnanti| candraśakalā-bākucī| āryāgītiḥ|
Sa. viḍaṅgādīnāṃ cūrṇena guḍena piṇḍī lāṅgalikādyanvitā kuṣṭhaṃ vijayate|

lg.l: sāyomalā sāmalakā satailā kuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇi nihanti līḍhā||46||

div.ab: Sa. śaśāṅkalekhā viḍaṅgādibhiḥ saha tailena līḍhā kṛcchrāṇi kuṣṭhāni vināśayati| upajātivṛttam(tte)|
Sa. pathyādibhiḥ sabhallātakaiḥ piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ jayet| guḍādibhir vā kṛtā piṇḍī kuṣṭhaṃ hanti|
Sa. khadiracūrṇaṃ viḍaṅgādiyutaṃ mitahitabhojanaḥ kiṭibhādighnaṃ khādet|
Sa. sitādīni lihāno 'śeṣakuṣṭhāni kṛcchrāṇy api jayati|

lg.l: mustaṃ vyoṣaṃ triphalā mañjiṣṭhā dāru pañcamūle dve|

div.ab: Sa. mustādikaṃ samabhāgaṃ saktubhāgair navabhiḥ saṃyojitaṃ madhvaṃśena yutam etac cūrṇaṃ prāyogikaṃ-prayogayogyaṃ, kuṣṭhaghnaṃ satataṃ khādet| āryās tisraḥ|

Sa. rasāyanoktena vidhinā tuvarāsthīni (hṛ. ū. a. 39|84) , śīlayet| bhallātakaṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|75) , somarājīṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|107) , citrakamūlaṃ vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|63) , śilājatu vā (hṛ. u. a. 39|137)|

ab.seg: iti doṣe vijite 'ntas- tvaksthe śamanaṃ bahiḥ pralepādi hitam| tīkṣṇālepotkliṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hi vivṛddhimeti maline dehe||54||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃprakāreṇa, antarvijite doṣe 'ta eva tvaksthe bahiḥ pralepādi hitam| ādiśabdena snānādiparigrahaḥ| nanu, bahirbhāgasthaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kim iti pūrvam eva pralepādinā na jīyate ? ity āha-tīkṣṇety ādi| yasmāt tīkṣṇena lepenotkliṣṭaṃ-utkleśaṃ prāpitaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ maline-sadoṣe, kāye vivṛddhiṃ yāti| tasmād antaḥśuddhe kāye pralepādikaṃ hitam| āryāgītiḥ|

ab.seg: sthirakaṭhinamaṇḍalānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ poṭalair hitaḥ svedaḥ| svinnotsanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrair likhitaṃ pralepanair limpet||55||

div.ab: Sa. sthirāṇi kaṭhināni ca maṇḍalāni yeṣāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ teṣāṃ poṭalaiḥ svedo hitaḥ| svinnotsannaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śastrair likhitaṃ pralepair limpet| gītir āryā|

lg.l: yeṣu na śastraṃ kramate sparśendriyanāśaneṣu kuṣṭheṣu|
teṣu nipātyaḥ kṣāro raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya||56||

div.ab: Sa. yeṣu kuṣṭheṣu sparśendriyanāśaneṣu śastraṃ na kramate, teṣu raktaṃ doṣaṃ ca visrāvya kṣāro nipātanīyaḥ| kramata iti "vṛttisarga" ity ādinā taḍ|

lg.l: lepo 'tikaṭhinapuruṣe supte kuṣṭhe sthire purāṇe ca|

div.ab: Sa. pāṣāṇavat kaṭhine tathā paruṣasparśe tathā supte sthirībhūte tathā purāṇe ca kuṣṭhe saty āturasyopayuktāgadasya viṣair mantrasahitair le(to le)paḥ kāryaḥ| anu-paścāt, agadaiś ca lepaḥ|
Sa. kuṣṭhāni stabdhāni tathā'tisuptāni tathā'svedanāni kaṇḍūvanti ca śuṣkagomayādibhighṛṣṭāny anantaraṃ pralepyāni|

lg.l: mustā triphalā madanaṃ karañja āragvadhaḥ kaliṅgayavāḥ|
eṣa kaṣāyo vamanaṃ virecanaṃ varṇakas tathoddharṣaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. mustādayaḥ snānaṃ syāt| eṣa eva kaṣāyo vamanaṃ [virecanaṃ] varṇakaras tathoddharṣas tvagdoṣādiprabādhanaḥ pāṇḍurogahṛc ca syāt|
Sa. karavīramūlādinā caturguṇe gomūtre kvathite darvīlepī kvātho lepena kuṣṭhaghnaḥ-kuṣṭhāpahaḥ|
Sa. sitakaravīramūlādayaḥ sumanaḥpallavayuto lepo niścitaṃ kuṣṭhaghnaḥ|

lg.l: piṣṭā ca kākamācī caturvidhaḥ kuṣṭhahā lepaḥ||63||

div.ab: Sa. śirīṣatvagādilepaś catuḥprakāraḥ kuṣṭhajit| āryā aṣṭau|
Sa. vyoṣādibhir dravyaiḥ samāṃśais tadardhaviṣopetaiḥ kolapramāṇāvaṭikā lepataḥ śvitraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hanti| [ svāgatāvṛttam| ]

lg.l: nimbaṃ haridre surasaṃ paṭolaṃ kuṣṭhāśvagandhe suradāru śigruḥ|
sasarṣapaṃ tumbarudhānyavanyaṃ caṇḍā ca cūrṇāni samāni kuryāt||65||
tais takrapiṣṭaiḥ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ tailāktam udvartayituṃ yateta|
tathā'sya kaṇḍūḥ piṭikāḥ sakoṭhāḥ kuṣṭhāni śophāś ca śamaṃ vrajanti||66||

div.ab: Sa. pūrvaṃ tailābhyaktaṃ śarīraṃ nimbādibhiḥ samabhāgena cūrṇīkṛtair udvartanārthaṃ yatnaṃ kuryāt| tathā-evaṃ kṛte, asya-āturasya, kaṇḍvādayaḥ śāmyanti| udvartanānantaram uṣṇajalasnānaṃ kāryam|

lg.l: tailāktagātrasya kṛtāni cūrṇā- nyetāni dadyād avacūrṇanārtham|
dadrūḥ sakaṇḍūḥ kiṭibhāni pāmā vicarcikā ceti tathā na santi||68||

div.ab: Sa. mustādīni samāny etāni cūrṇāni kṛtāni tailabhyaktadehasyāvacūrṇanārthaṃ dadyāt| tathā-evam avacūrṇite sati, dadrur ityādayo naśyanti| catvāry etāny upajātisaṃjñāni vṛttāni|

lg.l: lepād vicarcikāṃ hanti rāgavega iva trapām||69||
manaḥśilāle maricāni taila- mārkaṃ payaḥ kuṣṭhaharaḥ pradehaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. sarṣapāṇāṃ kalkaḥ sruhyā gaṇḍe kukūlāgnau pācito lepena vicarcikāṃ hanti, rāgavego lajjāṃ yathā| manaḥśilādayaḥ pralepāt kuṣṭhahṛtaḥ| tadvad eva karañjādi gomūtrapiṣṭam| upajātivṛttam|

lg.l: dinakarakarābhitaptaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ ghṛṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ ca||72||

div.ab: Sa. guggulvādibhir etaiś cakrajatailena miśritaiḥ sūryaraśmitaptaighṛṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ drāk naśyati| cākrikaṃ tailaṃ-sadyaḥpīḍitaṃ cakrastham evoṣṇaṃ tailam| kecit tu bahukālakṛtatailapīḍanāt kollu(hṛ)kakāṣṭhād devadārukāṣṭhavat khaṇḍaśaḥ pāṭitād yuktyā yat tailaṃ gṛhyate tac cakratailam ity āhuḥ|

lg.l: tailena yuktam uṣitaṃ saptāhaṃ bhājane tāmre||73||
māsān navaṃ kilāsaṃ snānena vinā viśuddhasya||74||

div.ab: Sa. maricādikaṃ tailena yuktaṃ saptadināni tāmrabhājane sthitaṃ tena ca-maricādinā, sidhmam āliptaṃ gharmasevino narasya saptāhenāpaiti| māsād yat sadyotthitaṃ śvitraṃ tan naśyati| snānena vinā viśuddhasya narasya| catasra āryāḥ, āryāś ca jaghanacapalāḥ|
Sa. apāmārgakṣārodake saptavārān parisrute suvarṇalatātailaṃ pakvam abhyaṅgena sidhmaṃ nāśayati|
Sa. kākajaṅghāmūlaṃ vamanyāḥ patrāṇi mūlakabījaṃ ca takreṇāṅgārakadine lepaḥ sidhmaghnaḥ siddhaḥ|

lg.l: jīvantī mañjiṣṭhā dārvī kampillakaṃ payas tuttham|
eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ siddhaḥ siddhe ca sarjarasaḥ||77||
deyaḥ samadhūcchiṣṭo vipādikā tena naśyati hy aktā|

div.ab: Sa. eṣa ghṛtatailapākaḥ ghṛtatailābhyāṃ pāko yasya yogasya sa ghṛtatailapākaḥ, gamakatvāt samāsaḥ| siddho-niṣpannaḥ| siddhe 'smin pāke sarjaraso madanena saha deyaḥ| tena-siddhena yogena, vipādikā'bhyaktā naśyati| tathā, carmaikakuṣṭhādikaṃ ca śāmyati| kṣīramūtrārkaṃ grāhyam, yaugikatvād vṛddhavaidyavyavahārāc ca| āryās tisraḥ|

lg.l: mūlaṃ saptāhvāt tvak śirīṣāśvamārā- darkānmālatyāś citrakāsphotanimbāt|
bījaṃ kārañjaṃ sārṣapaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ śreṣṭhā jantughnaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ dve haridre||79||
tailaṃ tailaṃ sādhitaṃ taiḥ samūtrai- stvagdoṣāṇāṃ duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānām|

div.ab: Sa. saptaparṇamūlaṃ śirīṣādīnāṃ tvak karañjādīnāṃ bījaṃ tathā triphalādayaḥ, etair gomūtrasahitais tilatailaṃ paktvā vātakaphodbhavānāṃ tvagdoṣāṇāṃ tathā duṣṭanāḍīvraṇānām abhyaṅgena nāśāya vajrakasaṃjñam etad alaṃ-samartham| tathā vajratulyam, avyāhataśaktitvāt| [ vaiśvadevī śālinī ca| ]
Sa. eraṇḍādibhis tulyasnugarkadugdhaṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ mahāvajrasaṃjñaṃ smṛtam| atiśayena vajrakaguṇaṃ śvitrādighnam| vasantatilakaṃ āryā ca|

lg.l: tailaṃ siddhaṃ viṣāvāpam abhyaṅgāt kuṣṭhajit param||83||

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ viṣāvāpam abhyaṅgāt paraṃ kuṣṭhahṛt|
Sa. sikthakādibhiḥ pakvaṃ sarṣapatailaṃ kacchvādīn nihanti|

lg.l: lākṣā vyoṣaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca bījaṃ saśrīveṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhasiddhārthakāś ca|
takronmiśraḥ syād dharidrā ca lepo dadrūṣūkto mūlakotthaṃ ca bījam||85||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādayo niśā ca takronmiśro dadrūṣu lepa uktaḥ| mūlakabījaṃ ca takramiśraṃ tadvat| śālinīvṛttam|

lg.l: khadiro dhavaś ca lepaḥ, śyāmā dantī dravantī ca||86||

div.ab: Sa. citrakādayo dadhimaṇḍānvitāḥ pādaiḥ ṣaṭ vātaśleṣmakuṣṭhaghnā gaditāḥ| tatra citrakasobhāñjanakāv ity eko lepaḥ, guḍūcyapāmārgadevadārūṇīti dvitīyaḥ, evam anye 'pi vedyāḥ| ārye|

ab.seg:
jalavāpyalohakesarapatraplavacandanamṛṇālāni|
bhāgottarāṇi siddhaṃ pralepanaṃ pittakaphakuṣṭhe||88||

div.ab: Sa. jalādīni bhāgottarāṇi siddhaḥ pittakaphakuṣṭhe pralepaḥ| jalaṃ-vālakam| vāpyaṃ-kuṣṭham| jaghanacapalā''ryā|

lg.l: klede prapatati cāṅge dāhe visphoṭake ca carmadale|

div.ab: Sa. tiktadravyasādhitair ghṛtais tathā jalena dhautair ghṛtair abhyaṅgo dāhayukteṣu kuṣṭheṣu hitaḥ| klede ca prakarṣeṇa patati sati tailaiś candanādiyuktair abhyaṅgaḥ, caśabdād dhṛtaiś ca, prakṛtatvād dhitaḥ| aṅge dāhādimati śītapradehādyās tiktakaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ hitam| vyadhanaṃ-sirāvyadhaḥ|

ab.seg: khadiravṛṣanimbakuṭajāḥ śreṣṭhākṛmijitpaṭolamadhuparṇyaḥ antarbahiḥ prayuktāḥ kṛmikuṣṭhanudaḥ sagomūtrāḥ||91||

div.ab: Sa. khadirādayo gomūtrānvitā abhyantaraṃ bāhyataś ca prayuktāḥ kṛmiyutakuṣṭhahṛtaḥ|
Sa. vātādhikeṣu kuṣṭheṣu ghṛtam agre-pūrvaṃ, hitam| śleṣmādhikeṣu ca vamanam| pittottareṣu raktamokṣo virecanaṃ cāgre hitam|
Sa. nirhṛtāsradoṣāṇāṃ tathā saṃśodhitaśayānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ ye lepā yujyante, teṣāṃ sadyaḥ-śīghram eva, siddhiḥ-āmayanivṛttiḥ, bhavati| ata evedam āha-

lg.l: doṣe hṛte 'panīte rakte bāhyāntare kṛte śamane|
snehe ca kālayukte na kuṣṭhamativartate sādhyam||94||

div.ab: Sa. doṣe-vātādau, hṛte rakte 'panīte bāhye 'bhyantare śamane kṛte snehe kṛte ca kāle yukte kuṣṭhaṃ sādhyaṃ nātivartate| api tūpaśāmyati| āryāḥ ṣaṭ, anyatra jaghanacapalāḥ (?)|

lg.l: doṣe hy atimātrahṛte vāyur hanyād abalam āśu||95||

div.ab: Sa. bahudoṣaḥ kuṣṭhī prāṇān rakṣatā bhiṣajā punaḥ punaḥ saṃśodhyaḥ| ekavelayaiva kasmān na śodhyate ? ity āha-yasmād doṣe 'timātrahṛte saty abalaṃ naraṃ vāto drāg eva hanyāt| āryā|

lg.l: pakṣāt pakṣāc chardanāny abhyupeyā- nmāsān māsāc chodhanāny apy adhastāt|
śuddhir mūrghni syāt trirātrāt trirātrāt ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe māsy asṛḍmokṣaṇaṃ ca||96||

div.ab: Sa. asau kuṣṭhī pakṣeṇa vamanāni seveta| māsān māsād adhaḥśodhanāni bhajet| śirasi trirātre trirātre śuddhiḥ syāt| ṣaṣṭhe ṣaṣṭhe raktamokṣaś ca syāt|

lg.l: yo durvānto durvirikto 'thavā syāt kuṣṭhī doṣair uddhatair vyāpyate 'sau|
niḥsandehaṃ yāty asādhyatvam evaṃ tasmāt kṛtsnān nirhared asya doṣān||97||

div.ab: Sa. yaḥ kuṣṭhī kṛtāsamyagvamanavirecanaḥ syāt, asāv uddhatair doṣair vyāpyate| evaṃ niścayenāsādhyatvaṃ yāti| tasmād dhetor asya-kuṣṭhinaḥ, kṛtsnān-nikhilān, doṣān nirharet| śālinīvṛttam(tte)|

vratadamayamasevā tyāgaśīlābhiyogo dvijasuragurupūjā sarvasattveṣu maitrī|
śivaśivasutatārābhāskarārādhanāni prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ kuṣṭham unmūlayanti|98| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|19|

Sa. vratādisevā tyāgādyabhyāso dvijādipūjā sarvasattvamaitrī śivādyārādhanāni kuṣṭhaṃ prakaṭitamalapāpaṃ nāśayanti| mālinīvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne kuṣṭhacikitsitaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 19||

div.head: śvitrakṛmicikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāyate| cikitsāsāmyam ity āha-
Sa. yat-yasmāt, kuṣṭhād api bībhatsaṃ-jugupsitaṃ nindyaṃ, tathā śīghrataram asādhyatvaṃ śvitraṃ yāti| ataḥ-asmād dhetoḥ, tasya-śvitrasya śamāya, yatnaṃ kuryāt| yathā jvalite gṛhe| āryā|

lg.l: saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣāt prayojayet pūrvam eva dehasya|
śvitre sraṃsanam agryaṃ malayūrasa iṣyate saguḍaḥ||2||
seveta niriktatanus tryahaṃ pipāsuḥ pibet peyām||3||

div.ab: Sa. prathamam eva śarīrasya saṃśodhanaṃ viśeṣeṇa prayojayet| tad evāha-śvitre malayūraso-bākucīkvāthaḥ, saha guḍayā-snuhyā, saguḍo virecanam iṣyate| mukhacapalā| taṃ-kvāthaṃ, pītvā'vyaktaśarīraḥ san yathāśakti sūryakiraṇasantāpaṃ bhajet| viriktaś ca san pipāsitaḥ peyāṃ trīṇi dināni pibet|

ab.seg:
śvitre 'ṅge sphoṭā jāyante kaṇṭakena tān bhindyāt|
sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet tridinam||4||

div.ab: Sa. śvitre sābhyaṅge ye sphoṭā udbhavanti, tān-sphoṭakān, kaṇṭakena bhindyāt| sphoṭeṣu niḥsruteṣu satsu prātaḥ prātas trīṇi dināni malayvādīni samutkvāthya pibet| pālāśaṃ vā kṣāraṃ phāṇitayuktaṃ yathāśakti pibet| tisra āryāḥ|

ab.seg: phalgvakṣavṛkṣavalkalaniryūheṇendurājikākalkam| pītvoṣṇasthitasya jāte sphoṭe takreṇa bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇam||6||

div.ab: Sa. phalgor akṣesya ca tvaco yo niryūhaḥ-kvāthaḥ, tena [indurājikāyāḥ-] bākucyāḥ, kalkaṃ pītvā uṣṇe-ātape, sthitasya sphoṭeṣu jāteṣu satsu takreṇa saha bhojanaṃ nirlavaṇaṃ hitam| āryā gītiḥ (?)|

lg.l: gavyaṃ mūtraṃ citrakavyoṣayuktaṃ sarpiḥkumbhe sthāpitaṃ kṣaudramiśram|
pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ śvitriṇā peyam etat kāryaṃ cāsmai kuṣṭhadṛṣṭaṃ vidhānam||7||

div.ab: Sa. gomūtraṃ citrakādiyuktaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ ghṛtakumbhe sthāpitaṃ pakṣaṃ yāvat pakṣād ūrdhvaṃ śvitravataitat peyam| asmai ca-śvitriṇe, kuṣṭhoktaṃ vidhānam| asmai iti kriyāgrahaṇāt sampradānatvam| [śālinīvṛttam| ]

lg.l: mārkavam athavā svāded bhṛṣṭhaṃ tailena lohapātrastham|

div.ab: Sa. bhṛṅgarājaṃ vā tailena bhṛṣṭaṃ lohapātrasthaṃ khādet| bhuktvā ca paścād bījakaśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ śvitraśāntyai pibet| āryā|

lg.l: pūtikārkavyādhighātasnuhīnāṃ mutre piṣṭāḥ pallavā jātijāś ca|
ghnanty ālepāc chvitradurnāmadadrū- pāmākoṭhān duṣṭanāḍīvraṇāṃś ca||9||

div.ab: Sa. pūtikādīnāṃ pallavā gomūtre piṣṭās tathā jātipallavā gomūtre piṣṭāḥ pralepena śvitrādīn ghnanti|
dvaipaṃ dagdhaṃ carma mātaṅgajaṃ vā śvitre lepas tailayukto variṣṭhaḥ| ------------------------------ ----------------------------|10|
Sa. dvīpasambandhi carma dagdhaṃ hastijaṃ ca carma dagdhaṃ tailānvito lepaḥ śvitre 'tiśayena varaḥ|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------- ------------------------------------|
pūtiḥkīṭo rājavṛkṣodbhavena kṣāreṇāktaḥ śvitram eko 'pi hanti||10||

div.ab: Sa. pūtiḥkīṭo rājavṛkṣajena kṣāreṇa lepata eka eva śvitraṃ hanti| pūtiḥkīṭo-varṣākālodbhavaḥ pilindiketi loke prasiddhaḥ| śālinyau vṛtte|

lg.l: rātrau gomūtre vāsitān jarjarāṅgā- nahni cchāyāyāṃ śoṣayet sphoṭahetūn|
evaṃ vārāṃs trīṃs tais tataḥ ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ snuhyāḥ kṣīreṇa śvitranāśāya lepaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. sphoṭahetūn-bhallātakān, jarjarīkṛtān niśi gomūtre sthitān divase chāyāyāṃ śoṣayet| evaṃ trīn vārān mūtrasthitān śoṣitāṃś ca| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, taiḥ snuhīkṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ śvitraśāntyai lepaḥ| vaiśvadevī|

lg.l: śikhipittaṃ tathā, dagdhaṃ hrīberaṃ vā tadāplutam||12||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇasarpajā maṣī akṣatailena drutā lepaḥ| mayūrapittaṃ ca lepaḥ pūrvaguṇaḥ| athavā, hrīberaṃ dagdhaṃ tena-akṣatailenāloḍitaṃ, lepas tadvat|

lg.l: mūtreṇa gavāṃ piṣṭaḥ savarṇakaraṇaṃ paraṃ śvitre||13||

div.ab: Sa. bākucībījaṃ palacatuṣṭayaṃ haritālapalaṃ gomūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ śvitre savarṇakaraṃ syāt| āryā|

lg.l: kṣāre sudagdhe gajaliṇḍaje ca gajasya mūtreṇa parisrute ca|
droṇapramāṇe daśabhāgayuktaṃ dattvā paced bījam avalgujānām||14||
śvitraṃ jayec cikkaṇatāṃ gatena tena pralimpan bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭam|
kuṣṭhaṃ maṣaṃ vā tilakālakaṃ vā yad vā vraṇe syād adhimāṃsajātam||15||

div.ab: Sa. gajapurīṣaje kṣāre sudagdhe droṇapramāṇe yathāpramāṇaṃ gajasya mūtreṇa kṣāravidhinā parīsrute 'smin bākucībījaṃ dattvā pacet| kimbhūtam ? daśabhāgayuktam,-daśabhir bhāgaiḥ prakṛtatvāt kṣārasya sambandhibhir miśritam| tena cikkaṇatāṃ-madanarūpatāṃ, gatena puruṣo bahuśaḥ praghṛṣṭaṃ śvitraṃ pralimpan jayet, kuṣṭhādīṃś ca| adhimāṃsarūpato yac ca syāt tac ca jayet| upajātī|

lg.l: tutthaṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ lavaṇāni pañca kṣāradvayaṃ lāṅgalikāṃ ca paktvā||16||
snugarkadugdhe ghanam āyasasthaṃ śalakayā tad vidadhīta lepam|
kuṣṭhe kilāse tilakālakeṣu maṣeṣu durnāmasu carmakīle||17||

div.ab: Sa. bhallātakādikaṃ snugarkayor dugdhe paktvā ghanam āyasapātre sthitaṃ tat-etat, śalākayā lepaṃ kuṣṭhādiṣu vidadhīta| indravajropajātī|

lg.l: śuddhyā śoṇitamokṣair virūkṣaṇair bhakṣaṇaiś ca saktūnām|

ab.seg: iti śvitracikitsitam||1||

div.ab: Sa. śvitraṃ kasyacid eva narasya kṣīṇakalmaṣasya śuddhyādibhiḥ śāmyati| āryā| iti śvitracikitsā| asmād anantaraṃ kṛmicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt|

ab.seg:
atha kṛmicikitsitam|
snigdhasvinne guḍakṣīramatsyādyaiḥ kṛmiṇodare|
utkleśitakṛmikaphe śarvarīṃ tāṃ sukhoṣite||19||

lg.l: tasminn eva nirūḍhaṃ taṃ pāyayeta virecanam||21||

div.ab: Sa. kṛmiṇam aduraṃ yasyeti pāmāditvān napratyayaḥ| tasmin kṛmiṇodare nare snigdhasvinne tathā guḍādibhir utkleśitāḥ-svasthānāc cyāvitāḥ , kṛmayaḥ kaphaś ca yasya tasmiṃs tathābhūta udare tathā samutkleśitād anantaraṃ tāṃ rātriṃ sukhoṣite sati satailasvarjikākṣāraṃ bastiṃ yuñjyāt| katham ? ity āha-surasādigaṇaṃ (hṛ. sū. a. 15|30) gomūtre 'rdhavāriṇi kvāthayitvā tatas taṃ kaṣāyaṃ kaṇādīnāṃ kalkena yojitaṃ-miśraṃ kṛtvā| tato-nirūhād anantaraṃ , tasminn evāhani taṃ-nirūḍhaṃ , virecanaṃ trivṛtkalkaṃ phalādikaṣāyāloḍitaṃ pāyayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ , ūrdhvādhaḥśodhite tasmin pañcakolayutaṃ kramaṃ-peyāvilepyādikaṃ , kuryāt| tataḥ kaṭvādibhiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ pariṣecitaṃ samanantaraṃ yadā sandhukṣito 'gnis tadā tasmin kāle viḍaṅgatailena tam anuvāsayet|
Sa. śirorogapratiṣedhe yad uktaṃ tan mūrdhageṣu kṛmiṣv ācaret| anu-paścāt, prabhūtatiktakaṭukam alpasnehaṃ ca bhojanam ācaret|
Sa. tathā viḍaṅgādibhis takrasādhitāṃ peyāṃ pibet|

rasaṃ śirīṣakiṇihīpāribhadrakakembukāt|
palāśabījapattarapūtikād vā pṛthak pibet||26||
sakṣaudraṃ, surasādīn vā lihyāt kṣaudrayutān pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. śirīṣādirasaṃ pibet| kiṇihī-girikarṇikā| palāśabījādīnāṃ vā rasaṃ mākṣikānvitaṃ pṛthak pibet| athavā , surasādīn (hṛ. sū. a. 15|30) kṣaudrayutān pṛthag lihyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
śatakṛtvo 'śvaviṭcūrṇaṃ viḍaṅgakvāthabhāvitam||27||
kṛmimān madhunā lihyād bhāvitaṃ vā varārasaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. aśvapurīṣacūrṇaṃ bahūn vārān viḍaṅgakvāthena bhāvitam athavā'śvaśakṛccūrṇaṃ triphalākvāthena bhāvitaṃ madhunā kṛmimān lihyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ ca tat||28||

div.ab: Sa. śirogateṣu kṛmiṣu tat-śiroroganiṣedhoktaṃ, cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ-nasyaṃ , cācaret|

ākhukarṇīkisalayaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ piṣṭamiśritaiḥ|
paktvā pūpalikāṃ khāded dhānyāmlaṃ ca pibed anu||29||
sapañcakolalavaṇam asāndra takram eva vā| ---------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. tathā, mūṣakakarṇīpallavaiḥ sūkṣmacūrṇitaiḥ śālicūrṇamiśritaiḥ pūpalikāṃ paktvā khādet| tadanu-paścāc ca, dhānyāmlaṃ pibet| athavā , takraṃ-mathitaṃ , pañcakolalavaṇayutaṃ pibet|

---------------------------------------------|
nīpamārkavanirguṇḍīpallaveṣv apy ayaṃ vidhiḥ||30||
viḍaṅgacūrṇamiśrair vā piṣṭair bhakṣyān prakalpayet| ---------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. nīpādiṣv ayam eva-pūrvokto mūṣakakarṇīpallavavidhiḥ , kalpyaḥ| athavā , piṣṭair viḍaṅgacūrṇamiśritair bhakṣyān prakalpayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
viḍaṅgataṇḍulair yuktam ardhāṃśair ātape sthitam||31||

lg.l: dinam āruṣkaraṃ tailaṃ pāne bastau ca yojayet|

div.ab: Sa. aruṣkarajaṃ tailaṃ pāne bastau ca yojayet| kimbhūtam ? ardhabhāgapramāṇair viḍaṅgataṇḍulair miśritaṃ tathā dinam ātape sthitam| dinam ity atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| devadārvāditailaṃ pṛthag evaṃ-viḍaṅgataṇḍulānvitam ātape sthitaṃ , kalpayet|
purīṣajeṣu sutarāṃ dadyād bastivirecane| ---------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. purīṣajeṣu kṛmiṣu sutarāṃ bastiṃ virecanaṃ ca dadyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śirovirekaṃ vamanaṃ śamanaṃ kaphajanmasu||33||

div.ab: Sa. kaphajanmasu kṛmiṣu śirovirekaṃ-nasyaṃ , vamanaṃ śamanaṃ ca kuryāt|
raktajānāṃ pratīkāraṃ kuryāt kuṣṭhacikitsitāt| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. raktotthānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ kuṣṭhacikitsitāt pratīkāraṃ vidadhyāt| lyablope pañcamī , kuṣṭhacikitsitoktapekṣyety arthaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
indraluptavidhiś cātra vidheyo romabhojiṣu||34||

div.ab: Sa. romabhojiṣu kṛmiṣv indraluptavidhiḥ (hṛ. u. a. 24|28) kāryaḥ|

kṣīrāṇi māṃsāni ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca dadhīni śākāni ca parṇavanti| samāsato 'mlān madhurān rasāṃś ca kṛmīn jihāsuḥ parivarjayet|35| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|20|

Sa. kṛmīn jihāsuḥ kṣīrādīn varjayet| upajātivṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ caturthe cikitsitasthāne śvitrakṛmicikitsitaṃ nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 20||

div.head: vātavyādhicikitsitādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ vyākhyātum upakramyate , sarvacikitsābādhitatvāt|

athāto vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) kevalaṃ nirupastambham ādau snehair upācaret|
vāyuṃ sarpirvasāmajjatailapānair naraṃ tataḥ||1||
snehaklāntaṃ samāśvāsya payobhiḥ snehayet punaḥ|
yūṣair grāmyodakānūparasair vā snehasaṃyutaiḥ||2||
pāyasaiḥ kṛsaraiḥ sāmlalavaṇaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
nāvanais tarpaṇaiś cānnaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ svedayet tataḥ||3||
svabhyaktaṃ snehasaṃyuktaiḥ śaṅkarādyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. kevalaṃ-śuddhaṃ , tathā nirupastambhaṃ-anyenādhānakena samīpasambhavinā'nādhāritaṃ , īdṛśaṃ vāyuṃ snehair ādāv evopācaret| katham ? ity āha-sarpir ity ādi| nanu, tailasya pavanavijaye prādhānyād evaṃ nirdeśaḥ kartuṃ yuktaḥ , tailavasāmajjasarpiḥpānair iti| yuktam āha bhavān| kintu, ājanmasātmyāt sarpiḥ pradhānam anavaratam iti sarpiḥ prāg upanyastam| sarpiḥpānādibhis tāvat snehayet yāvat "snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ " (hṛ. sū. a. 16|30) ity ādi snehalakṣaṇaṃ syāt| snehaklāntaṃ ca naraṃ payobhiḥ samāśvāsya punar yūṣādibhiḥ snehānvitaiḥ snehayet| tathā tarpaṇaiś cānnaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ snehayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ , suṣṭv abhyaktaṃ antaṃ śaṅkarādyaiḥ-svedaiḥ svedavidhigaditaiḥ, punaḥ punaḥ svedayet| eva svedite sati yo guṇaḥ syāt tam āha-

---------------------------------------------|
snehāktaṃ svinnam aṅgaṃ tu vakraṃ stabdhaṃ savedanam||4||
yatheṣṭam ānāmayituṃ sukham eva hi śakyate| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. snehābhyaktaṃ gātraṃ svinnaṃ sad vakraṃ tathā stabdhaṃ tathā sarujaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ sukham evānāmayituṃ śakyate| "jalahvalahmalanamām anupasargāṇāṃ vā mitvam|" iti nāmayitum ity atra na hṛsvatvam| etad eva dṛṣṭāntadvāreṇa pratipādayann āha--

---------------------------------------------|
śuṣkāṇy api hi kāṣṭhāni snehasvedopapādanaiḥ||5||
śakyaṃ karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ kimu gātrāṇi jīvitām| ---------------------------------------------|6|

Sa. hi-yasmāt, śuṣkāṇy api kāṣṭhāni snehasvedasaṃyojanena karmaṇyatāṃ netuṃ śakyante| kim uta jīvatāṃ gātrāṇi na śakyante ? śakyanta evety arthaḥ| śakyam iti pūrvoktakramamātre napuṃsakatvam ekatvaṃ ca| yathā kālidāsasya-"śakyam aṅgulibhir uddhṛtair adhaḥ śākhināṃ patitapuṣpakomalaiḥ| patrajarjaraśaśiprabhālavair ebhir utkacayituṃ tavālakān||" iti|

---------------------------------------------|
harṣatodarugāyāmaśophastambhagrahādayaḥ||6||
svinnasyāśu praśāmyanti mārdavaṃ copajāyate| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. svinnasya puṃso harṣādayaḥ śīghraṃ praśāmyanti| mṛdutvaṃ ca gātreṣu jāyate|

---------------------------------------------|
snehaś ca dhātūn saṃśuṣkān puṣṇāty āśūpayojitaḥ||7||
balam agnibalaṃ puṣṭiṃ prāṇāṃś cāsyābhivardhayet| ---------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. tathā, sninnasya sneha upayojito dhātūn viśuṣkān drāg eva puṣṇāti| tathā, asya-vātarogiṇo, balādīn abhivardhayet|

---------------------------------------------|
asakṛt taṃ punaḥ snehaiḥ svedaiś ca pratipādayet||8||
tathā snehamṛdau koṣṭhe na tiṣṭhanty anilāmayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. taṃ-āturaṃ, punaḥ snehasvedābhyāṃ yojayet| tathā-evaṃ kṛte snehamṛdau koṣṭhe sati sarve vātarogā naśyanti|

---------------------------------------------|
yady etena sadoṣatvāt karmaṇā na praśāmyati||9||
mṛdubhiḥ snehasaṃyuktair bheṣajais taṃ viśodhayet| ---------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. anena karmaṇā cen na praśāmyati vātāmayas tadā taṃ-vātāmayinaṃ, mṛdubhir dravyaiḥ-karṇikārādibhiḥ, snehānvitair viśodhayet|

--------------------------------------------|
ghṛtaṃ tilvakasiddhaṃ vā sātalāsiddham eva vā||10||
payasairaṇḍatailaṃ vā pibed doṣaharaṃ śivam| --------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. tilvakena pakvaṃ sātalayā vā pakvaṃ kṣīreṇa vā sahairaṇḍatailaṃ pibet| tac ca pītaṃ doṣaharaṃ śivaṃ ca syāt| nanu, kim ity anulomanaṃ kriyate ? ity āha-

---------------------------------------------|
snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇādyair āhārair hi malaś citaḥ||11||
sroto baddhvā'nilaṃ rundhyāt tasmāt tam anulomayet| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. yasmāt snigdhādibhir āhārair malaś citaḥ srotāṃsi ruddhvā vāyuṃ rundhyāt, tasmān mārutam anulomayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
durbalo yo 'virecyaḥ syāt taṃ nirūhair upācaret||12||

lg.l: dīpanaiḥ pācanīyair vā bhojyair vā tadyutair naram|

div.ab: Sa. yo naro durbalo virecanānarho bhavet taṃ-naraṃ, nirūhair upācaret| kimbhūtaiḥ ? dīpanai pācanīyaiś ca| athavā, tadyutaiḥ-dīpanīyapācanīyayutaiḥ, bhojyair upācaret| anantaraṃ samyak śuddhasya vahnau cotthite sati punar api snehasvedau hitau|

āmāśayagate vāyau vamitapratibhojite|
sukhāmbunā ṣaḍdharaṇaṃ vacādiṃ vā prayojayet||14||
sandhukṣite 'gnau parato vidhiḥ kevalavātikaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. āmāśayagate vāte sati tathā vamitaś cāsau pratibhojitaś ca tasmin vamitapratibhojite nara uṣṇajalena ṣaḍdharaṇaṃ vacādigaṇaṃ (hṛ. sū. a. 15|35) vā prayojayet| ṣaḍdharaṇayogaḥ saṅgrahād evāvagantavyaḥ| tatraivaṃ paṭhyate (ci. a. 21)-
"dārvīkaliṅgakaṭukātiviṣāgnipāṭhā mūtreṇa sūkṣmarajaso dharaṇapramāṇāḥ|
pītā jayanti gudajodarakuṣṭhamehakoṣṭhānilāḍhyapavanagrahaṇīpradoṣān||" iti| dharaṇaṃ-palasya daśamo bhāgaḥ| agnau sandīpite sati, anantaraṃ kevalavātiko vidhiḥ, 'kāryaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
matsyān nābhipradeśasthe siddhān bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||15||

div.ab: Sa. nābhipradeśasthe vāte matsyān bilvaśalāṭubhiḥ siddhā yojayet|
bastikarma tv adhonābheḥ śasyate cāvapīḍakaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. adhonābheḥ sthite vāte 'vapīḍakaḥ śasyate| caśabdān matsyāś ca|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
koṣṭhage kṣāracūrṇādyā hitāḥ pācanadīpanāḥ||16||

div.ab: Sa. koṣṭhage vāyau kṣārādyāḥ pācanā dīpanāś ca hitāḥ|
Sa. hṛdayasthite samīraṇe kṣīraṃ śāliparṇyā śṛtaṃ hitam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------śirobastiḥ śirogate|
snaihikaṃ nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ śrotrādīnāṃ ca tarpaṇam||17||

div.ab: Sa. śirogate śirobastiḥ śasyate| snaihikaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ karṇāditarpaṇaṃ ca hitam|
svedābhyaṅganivātāni hṛdyaṃ cānnaṃ tvagāśrite| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. sa-tvaksthe maruti svedādīni hitāni| hṛdayapriyaṃ cānnaṃ hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śītāḥ pradehā raktasthe vireko raktamokṣaṇam||18||

div.ab: Sa. raktasthe vāte śītāḥ pradehā raktamokṣaṇaṃ ca hitam|
vireko māṃsamedaḥsthe nirūhāḥ śamanāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|19|
