Ā. rā. phāṇṭasyāha-caturbhir iti| phāṇṭe dravyasya palaṃ dravasya catvāri palāni| anayor anavaśeṣyatvaṃ kvathanābhāvāt, yāvat pūtaṃ tāvat peyam| atra tantrāntarokto viśeṣaḥ-"karṣaś cūrṇasya kalkasya guṭikānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ|
dravaśuktyā'valeḍhavyaḥ pātavyaś ca caturdravaḥ|
kvāthena cūrṇapānaṃ yat tatra kvāthapradhānatā
pravartate na tenātra cūrṇāpekṣī caturdravaḥ|| tena dvipale kvāthe cūrṇakarṣaḥ| mātrā kṣaudraghṛtādīnāṃ kalkakvātheṣu cūrṇavat| ādiśabdāt guḍatailaśarkarādīni|
ṣoḍaśāṣṭacaturbhāgaṃ vātapittakaphārtiṣu|
kṣaudraṃ kaṣāye dātavyaṃ viparītā tu śarkarā| ity eke||
uttamā syāt palaṃ mātrā tribhiś cākṣaiś ca madhyamā|
jaghanyā sā palārddhena snehakvāthyauṣadheṣu ca|
dīptānalamahākāyaṃ pāyayanty añjaliṃ jalam|
anye tv arddhaṃ parityajya prasṛtiṃ tu cikitsakāḥ|
kvāthatyāgam anicchantas tv aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣitam|
pāraṃparyopadeśena vṛddhavaidyāḥ paladvayam||
syād dhitaḥ sādhito yūṣas tv aṣṭādaśaguṇe jale|
caturdaśaguṇe peyā yavāgūḥ ṣaṅguṇe jale||
śṛtaṃ pañcaguṇe bhaktaṃ vilepī ca caturguṇe|
kvāthyadravyāñjaliṃ kṣuṇṇaṃ śrapayitvā jalāḍhake|
arddhasthitena tenātra yavāgvādy upayojayet|
vṛddhavaidyāḥ palaṃ dravyam grāhayanty āḍhake 'mbhasi||
bheṣajasyātibāhulyāt kadācid arucir bhavet|
yad apsu śataśītāsu ṣaḍaṅgādi prayujyate|
karṣamātraṃ tato dravyaṃ sādhayet prāsthike 'mbhasi|
ardhasthitaṃ prayoktavyaṃ pānepeyādisaṃvidhau|
karṣārdhaṃ vā kaṇāśuṇṭhyoḥ kalkadravyasya vā palam|
vinīya pācayed yuktyā vāriprasthena cāparān| atra dvātriṃśatpalajale kvāthyasya karṣārddhaṃ karṣaḥ palaṃ vā tīkṣṇasaumyātisaumyatve sati, kaṇāśuṇṭyor iti ṣaḍaṅgādīti kalkatisaumyatve sati, kaṇāśuṇṭhyor iti ṣaḍaṅgādīti kalkadravyasyeti padais tīkṣṇādīnāṃ grahaṇāt yasya kalko 'py atisaumyatvāt pātuṃ śakyate kiṃ punaḥ kvāthas tatkalkadravyasya| aparān-sārdhakarṣadvikarṣādīn, yuktyā-tīkṣṇādyavāntaraviśeṣaparyālocanayā, pācayet| āḍhake 'ñjaliḥ palaṃ vety etata prasthe palaṃ kārṣo vety anena gatārtham apy arucir yathā na syāt tathā kalpyam ity evamartham uktam|
dravyād aṣṭaguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrāt toyaṃ caturguṇam|
kṣīrāvaśeṣaḥ kartavyaḥ kśīrapāke tv ayaṃ vidhiḥ||
na syān muktarasaṃ samyag dravyaṃ kṣīrādibhiḥ saha|
tannirdeśe vāripūrvam pādavat sādhayed bhiṣak|| pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśabhāgaṃ vāri caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ sādhayet, paścāt tena
vāriṇā tulyāni kṣīrādīny āvārikṣayāt pacet|
śuṣkaṃ dravyam upādāya svarasānām asambhave|
vāri ṇyaṣṭaguṇe sādhyaṃ grāhyaṃ pādāvaśeṣitam||
āḍhakaṃ dravyacūrṇānām āsutaṃ salilāḍhake|
ahorātrasthitaṃ kuryāt svarasaṃ svarase 'sati||
mṛdau caturguṇaṃ vāri kaṭhine 'ṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam|
kaṭhināt kaṭhinaṃ yat tu tatra ṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam||
mṛdvādikvāthyasaṅghāte mānānuktau cikitsakāḥ|
madhyasyobhayagāmitvād icchanty aṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam|| pādaśeṣaḥ snehavidhau kvāthas toye caturguṇe|" iti|

Sa. snehapāke vidhātavye kalkasnehadravāṇām amānoktau-māna vacanasya viśiṣṭasyānirdeśe, caturguṇavivardhitaṃ kalkasnehadravaṃ yojyam| kalkaś ca snehaś ca dravaś ca teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ kalkasnehadravam| tad evaṃ kalkāt snehaś cturguṇaḥ snehāt dravaś caturguṇa iti bodhyam| pañcaprabhṛti tu dravaṃ pṛthak snehasamaṃ dadyād ity atra yojyam iti|
Ā. rā. snehapāke mānam āha-snehapāka iti| kalkāc caturguṇaḥ snehaḥ, snehāc caturguṇaṃ dravam|

lg.l: kalkasya yojayed aṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamam||16||

div.ab: Sa. śaunakākhyas tu tantrakṛd adhīte-evaṃ paṭhati| sneha ity ādi| snehaḥ kadācic chuddhāmbunā pacyate kadācin niḥkvāthena kadācit svaraseneti| taiḥ śuddhāmbuniḥkvāthasvarasaiḥ snehe siddhyati sati krameṇa kalkasyāṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭham aṣṭamaṃ yojayed iti|

Ā. rā. śaunakamatam āha-adhīta iti| niṣvkāthe drave kalkāt ṣaṅguṇaḥ snehaḥ, svarase 'ṣṭaguṇaḥ snehaḥ, anyatra caturguṇaḥ| kṣīrādiṣu śuddhāmbuprakṣepasyāvakāśatvāt rasavkāthayoḥ parasparam anyair vā saṅkare sāmānyaparibhāṣāviṣayatvāt| saṅkīrṇaṃ hi dravāntaram|
"śaṇasya kovidārasya vṛṣasya kakubhasya ca|
kalkāḍhyātvāt praśaṃsanti puṣpakalkaṃ caturthakam||" iti|
pṛthak snehasamaṃ dadyāt pañcaprabhṛti tu dravam| ---------------------------------------------------|17|

Ā. rā. s0- snehapākalakṣaṇam adhunā lakṣayann āha- viśeṣāntaram āha-pṛthak snehasamam iti| yatra caturbhyo 'dhikāni dravāṇi tatra tu parasparasāmyena militāni snehāc caturguṇāni| saṅgrahe 'py uktam (ka. a. 8)- "samuditadravasya pādena seho yojyaḥ|" iti| sarvadravāṇāṃ yugāpat prakṣepaḥ, athaikadhyaṃ prati saṃsṛjyādhiśritya ca niryūhavat sādhayet|" iti (ka. a. 8) saṅgrahavacanāt| anirūpitakalpanaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kalkīkuryāt| kalkānuktau nirūpitakalpanam iti, " yataḥ vkāthas tataḥ kaṣkaḥ kevalakāthabhāṣite|" iti vacanāt|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
nāṅguligrāhitā kalke na snehe 'gnau saśabdatā||17||

lg.l: varṇādisampac ca yadā tadainaṃ śīghram āharet|

div.ab: Sa. kalkaviṣaye 'ṅguligrāhitvaṃ yadā na bhavati, agnau prakṣipte vā snehe saśabdatā-caṭacaṭāyitvaṃ na bhavati, tathā varṇagandharasasparśānāṃ yadā sampat-śubhatvaṃ syāt, tadā-tasmin kāle, aśyāmalacchāyāmantaṃ snehaṃ śīghram āharet| agritaḥ snehasya kaṭāhasthitasya sa kālo 'vataraṇa ity arthaḥ| anyad api snehapākalakṣaṇam asti-ghṛtasyeti| ghṛtākhyasya snehasya samyakpākaṃ prāptasya phenopaśamo yadā jāyate, tailākhyasya ca snehasya pacyamānasya tadudbhavaḥ-phenotpattiḥ syāt, tadā ghṛtatailayoḥ pāko bhavati|

Ā. rā. pavkasnehahalakṣaṇam āha-nāṅguligrāhiteti| uktaṃ ca vṛndena (jvarādhikāre ślo 265)-
"snehakalko yadā'ṅgulyā vartito vartivad bhavet|
vahnau kṣipte ca no śabdas tadā siddhaṃ vinirdiśet|| śabdasyoparame prātpe phenasyoparame tathā| gandhavarṇarasānāṃ ca sampattau siddhm ādiśet|" iti| ghṛtatailayoḥ phenopaśamodbhavau viśeṣau|
lehasya tantumattā'psu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca| ----------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. lehasya pākaṃ prāptasya tantumattā-tantuprādurbhāvaḥ pākaḥ| tathā'psu majjanaṃ pākalakṣaṇaṃ saraṇāsaraṇarūpatayā dvidhā sambhavaty ata idam āha-saraṇaṃ na ca| sarvalehasyāpsu majjanaṃ bhavati na tu saraṇaṃ-avayavaśo gamanam, tathā'pi tasya pākaḥ sampanna iti vedyam|
Ā. rā. pavkelehalakṣaṇam āha-lehasyeti| tantumatvam udakamajjanam avisaraṇaṃ ca| snehalehaukvāthabhedau| tayor mānaṃ "uttamā syāt palaṃ mātrā" ity ādinoktam, kvāthyauṣadhaśabdena lehasyāpi grahaṇāt|

----------------------------------------------|
pākas tu trividho mandaś cikkaṇaḥ kharacikkaṇaḥ||19||
mandaḥ kalkasame kiṭṭe cikkaṇo madanopame|
kiñcit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartya(rti)māne ca paścimaḥ||20||
dagdho 'ta ūrdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syād āmas tv agnisādakṛt| ----------------------------------------------|21|

Sa. pākas triprakāro mandaś cikkaṇaḥ kharacikkaṇākhyaḥ [ ca ]| snehapākavidhau kiṭṭākhye vastujāte kalkasame yathā kalko 'ṅgulinā'vaṣṭabhnāti, tathā kiṭṭe 'pi snehapākasyāṅguligrāhitā na bhavati, sa snehapāko manda ucyate| madanopame kiṭṭe saty evam aṅguligrāhiṇi snehapākasya sa cikkaṇaḥ pākaḥ| kiñcit-īṣat, kiṭṭe sīdati sati tathā varṇataḥ kṛṣṇe ca tasmin, tathā vartya(rti)māne-vartimā(tāṃ)gacchati sati, paścimaḥ-kharacikkaṇākhyaḥ pākaḥ| ataḥ asmāt kharacikkaṇāt, ūrdhvaṃ-anantaraṃ, dagdho bhavati snehaḥ| sa ca niṣkāryaḥ syāt-yathānirūpitakāryakaraṇo na bhavet, nirvīryatvāt| āmaḥ-īṣatpākaḥ snehaḥ, punar agnisādakṛt|

Ā. rā. snehapākabhedān āha-pākas tv iti| tatra kalkasame kiṭṭe mandaḥ| pākena snehāt pṛthagbhūtaḥ kalkaḥ-kiṭṭaḥ| vaivarṇyādyabhāvāt kalkasamatvam| madanopame cikkaṇaḥ| madanaṃ madhūcchiṣṭam| paścimaḥ-kharacikkaṇaḥ| sīdati-mlāyati| ata ūrdhva-paśrimād ūrdhvam dagdhaḥ, sa ca niṣphalaḥ| mandād arvāk-āmaḥ, sa cāgnimāndyakṝt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
mṛdur nasye, kharo 'bhyaṅge, pāne bastau ca cikkaṇaḥ||21||

div.ab: Sa. mṛduḥ-mandapākaḥ sneho, nasye-tadviṣaye, prayojyaḥ| kharaḥ-kharacikkaṇaḥ snehaḥ, abhyaṅge-tadviṣaye, prayojyaḥ| pāne tathā bastau-tadviṣaye, cikkaṇaḥ prayojyaḥ|
Ā. rā. trayāṇāṃ viṣayabhedān āha-mṛdur iti|

ab.seg:
adhunā mānasaṅkhyāyāḥ yathāsvaṃ saṃjñāsaṃvidhānārtham āha--
-- śāṇaṃ pāṇitalaṃ muṣṭiṃ kuḍavaṃ prastham āḍhakam|
droṇaṃ vahaṃ ca kramaśo vijānīyāc caturguṇam||22||

div.ab: Sa. śāṇādayo vahaparyantāḥ krameṇa caturguṇāḥ pāṇitalādisaṃjñā vedyāḥ|

Ā. rā. mānabhedān āha-śaṇam iti| śāṇādayo 'ṣṭau yathottaraṃ caturguṇāḥ| śāṇamānaṃ tu saṅgraheṇoktam (ka.a.8)- "ṣaḍvaṃśyo-marīciḥ| tāḥ ṣaṭ-sarṣapaḥ| te 'ṣṭau-taṇḍulaḥ| tau-dhānyamāṣaḥ| tau-yavaḥ| ataḥ paraṃ caturguṇavṛcyā aṇḍikāmāṣakaśāṇāḥ|" iti| vaṃśī-vaṃśarandhrapraviṣṭaraśmisthaṃ rajaḥ|
dviguṇaṃ yojayed ārdraṃ kuḍavādi tathā dravam| ----------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. śuṣkārdrayor ekasmin yoge tulyaparimāṇena nirdiṣṭayoḥ śuṣkadravyād ārdraṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dattvā yojayet| śuṣkārdrayor vā dravyayos tulyaparimāṇanirdiṣṭayoḥ śuṣkadravyābhāve saty ārdraṃ dravyaṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā yojayet| śuṣkadravadravyayayor ekasmin yoge tulyaparimāṇena nirdiṣṭayoḥ śuṣkadravyāt dravadravyam kuḍavādiparimāṇa saṃjñayā nirdiṣṭaṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā yojayet|

Ā. rā. ārdradravayor viśeṣam āha-dviguṇam iti| ādraṃ tv auṣadhaṃ dviguṇaṃ yojayet, palam ity ukte paladvayam| kuḍavādi dravaṃ ca, kuḍava ity ukte kuḍavadvayam|
" vāsākuṭajakūṣmāṇḍaśatapuṣpāsahācarāḥ|
nityam ārdrāḥ prayoktavyā mānato dviguṇā na te||" ity eke|

----------------------------------------------|
peṣaṇāloḍane vāri snehapāke ca nirdrave||23||
kalpayet sadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam|
kalkīkuryāc ca bhaiṣajyam anirūpitakalpanam||24||
aṅgānuktau tu mūlaṃ syād aprasiddhau tad eva tu| ----------------------------------------------|25|

Sa. nirdrave-anuktadrave, peṣaṇāloḍanārthaṃ vāri yojayet| snehapāke cānuktadrave vāry eva yojayet| yatra yatra prayoge dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ noktaṃ tatra tatra dravyāṇāṃ sadṛśān bhāgān kalpayet|

Ā. rā. anuktajñānārtham āha-peṣaṇāloḍana iti| peṣaṇāloḍanasnehapākeṣv anuktadraveṣu vāri yojyam| pramāṇānuktau samabhāgatvam| kalpanānuktau kalkaḥ| aṅgānuktau mūlam| aprasiddhau tad eva| yathā-harītakīty ukte phalam| " anirdiṣṭāprasiddheṣu mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ tvagādiṣu|" iti (ka. a. 8) saṅgrahavacanāt|

|
ṣaḍvaṃśyas tu marīcī syāt, ṣaṇmarīcyas tu sarṣapaḥ|
taṇḍulaḥ sarṣapās tv aṣṭau, dhānyamāṣas tu tau, yavaḥ||1||
tāv aṇḍikā caturbhis tair māṣakaḥ śāṇakas tathā|
] dvau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṃkṣaṇaś ca, tau||25||
akṣam picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ|
karṣo biḍālapadakaṃ tindukaḥ pāṇimānikā||26||
śabdānyatvam abhinne 'rthe śuktir aṣṭamikā picū|
palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭir āmraṃ caturthikā||27||
dve pale prasṛtas tau dvāv añjalis tau tu mānikā|
āḍhakaṃ bhājanaṃ kaṃso, droṇaḥ kumbho ghaṭo 'rmaṇam||28||
tulā palaśataṃ, tāni viṃśatir bhāra ucyate| -------------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. dbau śāṇau vaṭakaḥ kolaṃ badaraṃ draṃkṣaṇaś cety atra śabdānyatvam, na tu tattvato bhedaḥ| tau dvau draṃkṣaṇāv akṣaṃ tathā picus tathā pāṇitalaṃ tathā suvarṇaṃ tathā kavalagrahas tathā karṣas tathā biḍālapadaṃ tathā tindukas tathā pāṇimānikā, ity atrābhinne 'rthe śabdānekatvam| tathā dvau picū śaktis tathā'ṣṭamikā, ity atrāpi śabdānyatvam arthasyaikye sati| palaṃ prakuñco bilvaṃ ca muṣṭir āmraṃ caturthikā, ity atrāpi śabdānāṃ vailakṣaṇye sati nārthato bhedaḥ| dve pale prasṛta ity ucyate| tau dvau prasṛtāv añjaliḥ kathyate| tau dvāv añjalī mānikā,- aṣṭau palānīty eva| āḍhakādīnāṃ śabdanāṃ svarūpato bhinnānāṃ nārthato bhedaḥ| tathaiva droṇādīnāṃ śabdānām| palaśataṃ tulā nigadyate| tāni-palaśatani, viṃśatir bhāra ucyate| kvāthādīnāṃ tūttamādimātrāḥ saṅgrahād avadhāryāḥ| saṅgrahe tv evaṃ paṭhyate (ka. a. 8)- "kvātho niryūhaḥ| tatra bhedyāny auṣadhāny aṇuśo bhedayitvā chedyāni ca chedayitvā prakṣālyodakena śucau rūkṣāyām adhaḥpraliptāyāṃ tāmrāyomṛnmayādyanyatamāyāṃ sthālyāṃ samāvāpya bahvalpapānīyagrāhitām auṣadhānām ākalayya yāvatā muktarasatā syāt tāvad udakam āsecayec choṣayec ca| [agrāv adhiśrayet| yāvanmātrodakadāne tathā tadavaśiṣṭatve ca tatra niyamasāmarthyāt kvāthyadravyaparimāṇasya| atreyatparimāṇāni dravyāṇi, udakam iyatpramāṇaṃ, tadavaśiṣṭatā ceyatpramāṇā, iti na niyamoktir evaṃvidhā vidyate| kiṃ tarhi? abhyūhanīyam etat sarvam iti| atra vidhiḥ|] athāgnāv adhiśritya mahaty āsane sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sarvataḥ satatam avalokayan darvyā ca vighaṭṭayan mṛdunā ca paritaḥ samupagacchatā'nalena sādhayet| avatārya ca suparisrutaṃ yathārhasparśaṃ prayuñjīta| kṣīrādisahitaṃ ca dravyaṃ na samyaṅ muktarasaṃ bhavatīti vārikvāthapūrvakaṃ kṣīrādyais tadupadeśe 'nupadagdhaṃ kvāthayet| śītasalilāplutaṃ tu niśāparyuṣitaṃ pūtaṃ śītaḥ kaṣāyaḥ| uṣṇāmbhasi kṣuṇṇābhiṣutaḥ pūtaḥ phāṇṭa iti| tatra samyag rasavīryādīny auṣadhasya samīkṣya vyādhyāturādibalataś ca niryāsādīnāṃ kalpanāṃ mātrāṃ ca saṃprayojayet| tathā ca kecid āhuḥ|
mātrāyā na vyavasthā'sti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ|
ālocya deśakālau ca bhaiṣajyam avacārayet|| [ evaṃ ca sarvam abhyūhyātra kartavyaṃ niścitaṃ kṛtvoktena vidhineti| ] etad evam upadiṣṭaṃ buddhimatāṃ jñānaprabodhāya| yathā tu sarve bhiṣajo vijñāsyanti tathaivopadekṣyata iti| niryāse madhyamā mātrā catuṣpalam| kalkacūrṇayoḥ karṣaḥ palatrayaṃ tadāloḍane| niryūhe bheṣajapalam udakārdhaprasthe 'dhiśatya pādaśeṣam avatārayet| śītaphāṇṭayor auṣadhapalaṃ ṣaḍbhiś caturbhir ambupalair āsutam iti|" iti| tathā śāṇaparimāṇasya pāṇitalavācakasya [ ca ] kim api parimāṇaṃ noktaṃ yenāsau [ na ] paricchidyata iti na vācyam, saṅgrahe tatparimāṇasyoktatvāt| tatra hy evam uktam ( saṃ.ka.a.8)-"ṣaḍvaṃśyo marīcī| tāḥ ṣaṭ marīcyaḥ sarṣapa ucyate| aṣṭau sarṣapās taṇḍulaḥ| tau dvau taṇḍulāv eko dhānyamāṣaḥ| tau dvau dhānyamāṣau yavaḥ| ataḥ paraṃ caturguṇavṛdhdyā'ṇḍikāmāṣakaśāṇakarṣapalakuḍavaprasthāḍhakadroṇavahāḥ kalpyante| [ evaṃ caturbhir māṣakaiḥ śāṇasya parimāṇaṃ paricchidyate| ] dharaṇaṃ tu palasya daśamo bhāgaḥ| māṣakasya tu paryāyo hemaḥ| karṣasya ṣoḍaśikā| āḍhakasya tu paryāyāḥ kaṃsaḥ pātraṃ bhājanaṃ ca| droṇasya paryāyo nalvaṇaḥ, tathā armaṇaḥ, tathonmānaḥ, tathā ghaṭaḥ kumbhaḥ kalaśaś ca| droṇadvayasya ca śūrpaḥ|" iti|

Ā. rā. saṃjñāntaram āha-dvau śāṇāv iti| śāṇadvayasya vaṭakādayaś catastraḥ saṃjñāḥ| vaṭakadvayasyākṣādayo nava ṣoḍaśikā ca| paladvayasya prasṛtaḥ| prasṛtadvayasyāñjaliḥ kuḍavaś ca| añjalidvayasya mānikā| āḍhakādayas tistra ekārthāḥ| droṇādayaś catastraḥ [c]| palaśataṃ-tulā| viṃśatis tu bhāraḥ| saṅgrahe tu (ka. a. 8)- "dharaṇaṃ tu palasya daśamo bhāgaḥ| māṣakasya paryāyo hemo dhānakaś ca| paladvayasyāṣṭamānam| droṇadvayasya śūrpaḥ|" iti|

himavadvindhyaśailābhyāṃ prāyo vyāptā vasundharā|29|
saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyam āgneyaṃ vaindhyam auṣadham| 29 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāne dravyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|6|

Sa. himavatparvatena vindhyaśailena ca bāhulyena vasundharā vyāptā| tatra-tayor madhyāt, ādyaṃ-haimavatam auṣadhaṃ, saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca svabhāvād bhavati| vaindhyaṃ cauṣadham āgneyaṃ-na tathā dehasya sadā pathyaṃ, syād iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ pañcame kalpasiddhisthāne dravyakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 6||

Ā. rā. śailabhedād dravyaviśeṣam āha-himavad iti|
iti hemādriṭīkāyām āyurvedarasāyane|
dravyakalpaprakaraṇaṃ sāmastyena nirūpitam||

div.head: bālopacaraṇīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ| anantaram uttarasthānārambhaḥ| yataḥ kāyākhyam ādyam aṅgam| tac ca pūrvaiḥ sthānaiḥ sarvam uktam| adhunā bālādīnām uttareṣām aṅgānām avasara ity uttarākhyaṃ sthānam ucyate| tatrāpi yathoddeśas tathā nirdeśa iti bālākhyam aṅgaṃ vivakṣur āha-
athāto bālopacaraṇīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. bālasya-śiśoḥ, upacaraṇaṃ bālopacaraṇam, tasmai hitaḥ| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| itīty ādinā svamanīṣikāparikalpitatvam asya tantrasya nirākaroti|

lg.l: athāsya dakṣiṇe karṇe mantram uccārayed imam||2||

div.ab: Sa. jātamātraṃ-sadya evodbhūtaṃ, bālam ulbāt-aparāparaparyāyāt, saindhavayuktena ghṛtena vividhaiḥ prakāraiḥ śodhayitvā paścāt prasūtyā-prasavena, kleśitaṃ bālaṃ balātailena secayet| paścāt pāṣāṇayor vādanam asya karṇamūle kārayed vaidyaḥ| anantaram asya dakṣiṇe karṇe imaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, mantram uccārayet| tam eva mantram āha-

ab.seg:
tam eva mantram āha ----
"aṅgād aṅgāt sambhavasi hṛdayād abhijāyase|
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sañjīva śaradāṃ śatam||3||

lg.l: nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrir ahaś ca tvā'bhirakṣatu"||4||

div.ab: Sa. aṅgād ity ādi|

svasthībhūtasya nābhiṃ ca sūtreṇa caturaṅgulāt|
badhdvordhvaṃ vardhayitvā ca grīvāyām avasañjayet||5||
nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭatailena secayet snāpayed anu|
kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhodakena vā||6||
koṣṇena taptarajatatapanīyanimajjanaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. samāśvastasya ca bālasya nābhiṃ caturaṅgulād ūrdhvaṃ sūtreṇa badhdvā'nantaraṃ chedayitvā grīvāyāṃ yojayet| nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭatailena secayet| anu-paścāt, kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa snāpayet| athavā sarveṣāṃ gandhānāṃ-candanādīnāṃ, jalena snāpayet| kimbhūtena ? koṣṇena| katham ? taptābhyāṃ-uṣṇābhyāṃ, rūpyasuvarṇābhyāṃ nimajjanaiḥ-asakṛtsecanaiḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
tato dakṣiṇatarjanyā tālūnnamyāvaguṇṭhayet||7||
śirasi snehapicunā, prāśyaṃ cāsya prayojayet|
hareṇumātraṃ medhāyurbalārtham abhimantritam||8||
aindrībrāhmīvacāśaṅkhapuṣpīkalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu| -------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. anantaraṃ dakṣiṇahastatarjanyā vaidyas tālu unnamya śirasi picunā tailāktenāvaguṇṭhayet| asya ca-bālasya, prāśyaṃ-lehaṃ, medhādyarthaṃ prayojayet| kiyanmātram ? hareṇupramāṇam| tathā'bhimantritaṃ-prāṅmantreṇa| kiṃ tat prāśyam ? ity āha-aindrīty ādi| aindrī-indravāruṇī| brāhmī-maṇḍūkaparṇī|

-------------------------------------------------|
cāmīkaravacābrāhmītāpyapathyā rajīkṛtāḥ||9||
lihyān madhughṛtopetā hemadhātrīrajo 'thavā| -------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. athavā suvarṇādikaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇikṛtya lihyāt| rajīkṛtā iti "arur manaḥ" ity ādinā sulopa itvaṃ ca| hemadhātrīcūrṇaṃ vā madhughṛtayuktaṃ lihyāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
garbhāmbhaḥ saindhavavatā sarpiṣā vāmayet tataḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. tataḥ-anantaraṃ, garbhāmbhaḥ sarpiṣā saindhavayuktena vāmayet|
prājāpatyena vidhinā jātakarmāṇi kārayet| -------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. tato jātakarmāṇi-vedavihitāni, prājāpatyena-yo vedokto vidhis tena gṛhyoktena, vidhinā bhiṣak kārayet|

stanyapravartanahetum āha ---- -------------------------------------------------|
sirāṇāṃ hṛdayasthānāṃ vivṛtatvāt prasūtitaḥ||11||
tṛtīye 'hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. hṛdayāśritānāṃ sirāṇāṃ prasavād dhetor yad vivṛtatvaṃ tasmāt kāraṇāt tṛtīye divase kadācic caturthe yoṣitāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate|

-------------------------------------------------|
prathame divase tasmāt trikālaṃ madhusarpiṣī||12||
anantāmiśrite mantrapāvite prāśayec chiśum| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. yata evaṃ dinatricaturmātraṃ kṣīrābhāvaḥ, tasmād dhetoḥ prathame 'hni trīn kālān madhughṛte yavāsakayukte mantreṇa pāvite śiśuṃ prāśayet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ tṛtīye ca ghṛtaṃ, tataḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-dvitīye divase tṛtīye ca divase lakṣmaṇayā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ trīn eva kālān bhojayet| anantaraṃ tasya-śiśoḥ, pāṇes talena- madhyena, sammitaṃ-tatpramāṇaṃ, navanītaprayogāt pūrvaṃ nivāritastanasyāsya-bālasya, dvau kālau navanītaṃ stanyānupānaṃ prayojayet|

mātur eva pibet stanyaṃ tadhdy alaṃ dehavṛddhaye|
stanyadhātryāv ubhe kārye tadasampadi vatsale||15||
avyaṅge brahmacāriṇyau varṇaprakṛtitaḥ same|
nīruje madhyavayasau jīvadvatse na lolupe||16||
hitāhāravihāreṇa yatnād upacarec ca te| -------------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. bālo mātuḥ-jananyā eva, stanyaṃ pibet| kutaḥ ? yasmāc ca tasyāḥ stanyam atiśayena dehasya vṛddhaye syāt| tadasampadi-mātṛstanyāsampattau, dve stanyadhātryau ca vatsale-snehale, kārye| tathā vyaṅgarahite, brahmacāriṇyau-varjitamaithune, varṇena prakṛtyā ca tulye, tathā niramaye, madhyavayaske, jīvadvatse, [ na lolupe-] laulyavarjite ādarayukte, te hitenāhāravihāreṇa yatnād upacaret|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
śukkrodhalaṅghanāyāsāḥ stanyanāśasya hetavaḥ||17||

lg.l: kṣīraṃ kṣīriṇya oṣadhyaḥ śokādeś ca viparyayaḥ||18||

div.ab: Sa. śugādīni stanyanāśasya kāraṇāni| śuk-śokaḥ| stanyasya madyāni hetavaḥ| kiṃbhūtāni ? sīdhuvarjyāni| ānūpajāś ca rasāḥ| tathā kṣīravatya oṣadhayaḥ-jīvantyādyāḥ| śokādivaiparītyaṃ ca|
Sa. tathā viruddha āhāro bhukto yayā tasyāḥ, tathā bubhukṣitāyā ninditāyāś ca, tathā praduṣṭadoṣāyā garbhiṇyāś ca sambandhi stanyam upayuktaṃ bālasya rogahetuḥ|

lg.l: stanyābhāve payaś chāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet|

div.ab: Sa. stanyasyābhāve sati chāgaṃ payaḥ, gavyaṃ vā chāgatulyaguṇaṃ pibet| chāgasamānaguṇaṃ gavyaṃ kathaṃ syāt ? tatrāha-hrasvenety ādi| hrasvena pañcamūlena siddhaṃ śāliparṇīpṛśniparṇīsiddhaṃ vā śarkarāyutaṃ pibet|

lg.l: jāgṛyur bāndhavās tasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam||21||

div.ab: Sa. anyadā' tasya-śiśoḥ, bāndhavā vihitarakṣādayo niśāṃ jāgṛyuḥ| ṣaṣṭhīṃ punas tamasvinīṃ viśeṣeṇa-yatnena, jāgṛyuḥ| kiṃ kurvantaḥ ? paraṃ harṣaṃ dhārayantaḥ|

Sa. daśame dine pūrṇe sati sūtikāyā utthānaṃ kārayet| kathaṃ kārayet ? svakulayogyair vidhānaiḥ| bālasya nāma arcitaṃ-praśastam anugataṃ kulajātyādibhiḥ| kimbhūtasya ? aṅgaiḥ-pāṇyādibhiḥ, manohlādīni dhārayataḥ| kimbhūtaṃ nāma ? nakṣatrasya yā'sau devatā tayā yuktam| athavā bāndhavaṃ-jñātipūrvajaṃ, samavarṇaṃ-na tu viṣamākṣaram|

Sa. tato-nāmakaraṇād anantaraṃ, prakṛtibhede-vikṛtivijñānīye (śā.a. 5) , uktāni yāni rūpāṇi tair āyuṣaḥ parīkṣaṇaṃ bālasya jñānavān-sumatiḥ, vaidyaḥ kuryāt| kimbhūtasya ? prākśirasa uttaraśiraso vā| tathā śucyādiguṇayuktāni upadhānāni śayyāyām āstaraṇārthaṃ vāsāṃsi kuryāt| tathā rakṣoghnair dravyair dhūpitāni|
kāko viśastaḥ śastaś ca dhūpane trivṛtānvitaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. kākaś ca vastrādidhūpane śastaḥ| kimbhūtaḥ ? viśastaḥ vyāpādito, na tu svayaṃ mṛtaḥ| tathā trivṛtāyuktaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
jīvatkhaṅgādiśṛṅgotthān sadā bālaḥ śubhān maṇīn||26|| dhārayed auṣadhīḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmayaindrījīvakādikāḥ|
hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām||27||
āyurmedhāsmṛtisvāsthyakarīṃ rakṣobhirakṣiṇīm| -------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. bālaḥ sarvadā śubhahetūn maṇīn bibhṛyāt| kimbhūtān ? jīvantaś ca te khaṅgādayaś ca, teṣāṃ śṛṅgāṇi, tebhya utthānaṃ yeṣāṃ tān, jīvatām eva ye gṛhītā ity arthaḥ| śṛṅgagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇārtham, ata eva sarpādijān api maṇīn dhārayet| tathā, oṣadhīr brāhmyādīḥ śreṣṭhāḥ-śubhāḥ, dhārayet| kaiḥ ? pāṇyādibhiḥ| viśeṣeṇa sarvadā vacāṃ dhārayet| kimbhūtāṃ vacām ? āyurādikaraṇahetuṃ tathā rakṣonivāriṇīm|

-------------------------------------------------|
ṣaṭsaptāṣṭamamāseṣu nīrujasya śubhe 'hani||28||
karṇau himāgame vidhyed dhātryaṅkasthasya sāntvayan| -------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. anantaraṃ ṣaṣṭhe māsi saptame 'ṣṭame vā bālasya nīrujasya himāgame śubhe divase karṇau vidhyet, dhātryutsaṅgasthitasya| dhātrī-mātā stanadāyinī ca| kathaṃ vidhyet ? sāntvayan prīti vacanādinā|

ab.seg:
kuta ity āha ---- -------------------------------------------------|
prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣag vāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ||29||

lg.l: dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālim anyena pāṇinā|
vidhyed daivakṛte chidre sakṛd evarju lāghavāt|

div.ab: Sa. kumārasya prāk-pūrvaṃ, dakṣiṇaṃ karṇaṃ yoṣitas tu vāmaṃ vaidyo vidhyet| kiṃ kurvan ? dakṣiṇena hastena sūcīṃ dadhat, vāmena pāṇinā pāliṃ dadhat| kva vidhyet ? karṇapīṭhasya madhya bhāge kiñcit-manāk, gaṇḍasthānābhimukham| kīdṛśasya bālasya ? samyaṅ niścalaṃ dhṛtasya| kva vidhyet ? daivakṛte chidre| kimbhūte ? jarāyumātreṇa pracchanne-sthagite| tathā raviraśmibhir avabhāsite-udyotite| tathā'laktakarasenāṅkite-cinhite| kathaṃ vidhyet ? lāghavāt sakṛt-ekavāram eva, tathā ṛju-saralaṃ kṛtvā nopariṣṭān nādhastān na pārśvato vidhyet|
Sa. hi-yasmāt, tatra śirā āśritāḥ| ta evāha kālikety ādi saṃ-tāsāṃ ca vyadhāt rāgādayaḥ syuḥ|
teṣāṃ yathāmayaṃ kuryād vibhajyāśu cikitsitam| -------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. teṣāṃ ca rāgādīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ nirūpya cikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sthāne vyadhān na rudhiraṃ na rugrāgādisambhavaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. sthāne vyadhāt rudhiraṃ na bha(sra)vati, na ca rugādīnāṃ sambhavaḥ|

lg.l: āmatailena siñcec ca bahalāṃ tadvad ārayā||35||
vartis tryahāt tato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||36||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-anu-karṇavyadhasya paścāt, sūtraṃ snehaliptaṃ sūcyā'nusyūtaṃ karṇe nidhāpayet| āmatailena ca secayet| bahalāṃ-ghanāṃ, pālīṃ tadvat-pūrvavat, ārayā vidhyet hitāśinaḥ sataḥ| anantaraṃ tryahād ūrdhvaṃ sthūlatarā vartiḥ sañcāryā| tato rūḍhaṃ karṇaṃ śanaiḥ śanair vardhayet|

lg.l: pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam||37||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-anantaram enaṃ-śiśuṃ, jātadantaṃ santaṃ stanāt krameṇāpasārayet-na sahasā| pūrvoktaṃ-chāgādikaṃ, kṣīram annaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇaṃ yojayet|
Sa. priyālādibhir modako 'pastanasya śiśoḥ prīṇano yojyaḥ| bālabilvādibhir dīpano modako yojyaḥ| dhātukyādibhiḥ saṅgrāhī yojyaḥ|

lg.l: rogāṃś cāsya jayet somyair bheṣajair aviṣādakaiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. yathāvastham asya-śiśoḥ, somyair auṣadhair aviṣādakaiḥ-akṣobhakaiḥ, āmayān jayet| virekam atiśayena varjayed ātyayikaṃ vyādhim antareṇa|
trāsayen nāvidheyaṃ taṃ trastaṃ gṛhṇanti hi grahāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. na ca taṃ-bālaṃ, avidheyaṃ-anāyattaṃ kṛtvā, trāsayet- na bhāyayet| yatas trastaṃ bālaṃ grahā gṛhṇanti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
vastravātāt parasparśāt pālayel laṅghanāc ca tam||41||

div.ab: Sa. vastravātādibhyaś ca taṃ rakṣayet|

brāhmīsiddhārthakavacāsārivākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ|
sakaṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ pītaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtikṛd ghṛtam||42||
āyuṣyaṃ pāpmarakṣoghnaṃ bhūtonmādanibarhaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. brāhmyādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ sādhitaṃ sarpir vāṅmedhādikṛt| āyuṣyaṃ pāpmādiharaṃ bhūtonmādanibarhaṇaṃ ca|

-------------------------------------------------|
vacendulekhāmaṇḍūkīśaṅkhapuṣpīśatāvarīḥ||43||
brahmasomāmṛtābrāhmīḥ kalkīkṛtya palāṃśikāḥ|
aṣṭāṅgaṃ vipacet sarpiḥ prasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇam||44||
tat pītaṃ dhanyam āyuṣyaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtibuddhikṛt| -------------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. vacādibhiḥ pālikaiś caturguṇakṣīrāt ghṛtaprastham aṣṭāṅgaṃ pacet| aṣṭāv aṅgāni-vacādīni yasmiṃs tad aṣṭāṅgam| etat pītaṃ dhanyādiguṇam|

-------------------------------------------------|
ajākṣīrābhayāvyoṣapāṭhogrāśigrusaindhavaiḥ||45||
siddhaṃ sārasvataṃ sarpir vāṅmodhāsmṛtivahnikṛt| -------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. ajākṣīrādibhiḥ siddhaṃ sārasvataṃ ghṛtaṃ vāṅmedhādikaram|

-------------------------------------------------|
vacāmṛtāśaṭhīpathyāśaṅkhinīvellanāgaraiḥ||46||
apāmārgeṇa ca ghrutaṃ sādhitaṃ pūrvavad guṇaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. vacādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pūrveṇa samānam|

-------------------------------------------------|
hema śvetavacā kuṣṭham arkapuṣpī sakāñcanā||47||
hema matsyākṣakaḥ śaṅkhaḥ kaiḍaryaḥ kanakaṃ vacā|
catvāra ete pādoktāḥ prāśā madhughṛtaplutāḥ||48||
varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurmedhābalavarṇakarāḥ śubhāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. hemādiślokoktāḥ pādikāś catvāro yogā madhughṛtābhyāṃ sadravā varṣaṃ līḍhā vapurādikṛtaḥ śubhāś ca|

-------------------------------------------------|
vacāyaṣṭyāhvasindhūtthapathyānāgaradīpyakaiḥ|49|
śudhdyate vāg ghavir līḍhaiḥ sakuṣṭhakaṇajīrakaiḥ| 49 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālo- pacaraṇīyo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ|1|

ab.seg: Sa. vacādibhiḥ sarpir līḍhair vāk śasyate| śudhyata iti cintyam, "karmavat karmakartā" ity asya tv aviṣayaḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ |sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālopa- caraṇīyo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||1||

div.head: bālāmayapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|
trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ|
svāsthyaṃ tābhyām aduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ|1|

Sa. asmād anantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogās taccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- bālas triprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano 'nnavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ| śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati|

ab.seg:
śuddhaṃ kṣīraṃ lakṣayati ---- athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| gadyasūtre|2|
trividhaḥ kathito bālaḥ kṣīrānnobhayavartanaḥ|
svāsthyaṃ tābhyām aduṣṭābhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ rogasambhavaḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ bālasyopacaryamāṇasya ye rogās taccikitsārtho bālāmayapratiṣedha ucyate- bālas triprakāraḥ kathito munibhiḥ| kṣīravartano 'nnavartana ubhayavartanaḥ-kṣīrānnābhyāṃ yo vartate| tābhyāṃ-annakṣīrābhyāṃ, aduṣṭābhyāṃ svāsthyaṃ bhavati| duṣṭābhyāṃ tu kṣīrānnābhyāṃ rogodbhūtiḥ|
Sa. vātaduṣṭaṃ kṣīraṃ jale plavate-taratīva naikatāṃ gacchati| kaṣāyādiguṇayuktaṃ ca syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
pittād uṣṇāmlakaṭukaṃ pītarājy apsu dāhakṛt||3||

div.ab: Sa. pittād duṣṭaṃ kṣīram uṣṇāmlakaṭukam, tathā toye prakṣiptaṃ pītarāji syāt dāhakaraṃ ca|
kaphāt salavaṇaṃ sāndraṃ jale majjati picchilam| -------------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. kaphāt kṣīraṃ duṣṭaṃ salavaṇaṃ ghanaṃ ca syāt| apsu ca majjati|

-------------------------------------------------|
saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ saṃsargāt triliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam||4||
yathāsvaliṅgāṃs tadvyādhīn janayaty upayojitam| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. saṃsargād duṣṭaṃ kṣīraṃ saṃsṛṣṭaliṅgaṃ syāt| sānnipātikaṃ kṣīraṃ triliṅgaṃ syāt| tac ca kṣīram upayojitaṃ bālasya ca yathāsvaliṅgān vyādhīn janayati|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
śiśos tīkṣṇam abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rodanāl lakṣayed rujam||5||

div.ab: Sa. bālasya tīkṣṇaṃ-kharaṃ, abhīkṣṇaṃ ca rujaṃ-pīḍāṃ, rodanāl lakṣayet,- atirodanena kiñcidrodanena ca yathāyogaṃ rujaṃ vidyād ity arthaḥ|
sa yaṃ spṛśed bhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ| tatra vidyād rujaṃ----------------------------------------|6|
Sa. yaṃ dehadeśaṃ sa bhṛśaṃ spṛśet yatra ca dehadeśe sparśanākṣamaḥ syāt tatra deśe rujaṃ vidyāt|
Sa. śirasi pīḍām akṣinimīlanād vidyāt| vināśahetum ata eva jihvauṣṭhadaśanādibhir hṛdi pīḍāṃ vidyāt| vibandhādibhir ādhmānādibhiś ca koṣṭhe rujaṃ vidyāt| bastau guhye ca pīḍāṃ viṭsaṅgādibhir vidyāt|
atha dhātryāḥ kriyāṃ kuryād yathādoṣaṃ yathāmayam| -------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. atha-anantaraṃ, evaṃ jñātvā dhātryā vaidyo yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ kriyāṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
tatra vātātmake stanye daśamūlaṃ tryahaṃ pibet||9||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-teṣu, vātena duṣṭe stanye trīṇi dināni daśamūlaṃ pibet| athavā citrakādīni kvathitāni tryahaṃ pibet|

tataḥ pibed anyatamaṃ vātavyādhiharaṃ ghṛtam|
anu cācchasurām evaṃ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecayet||11||
bastikarma tataḥ kuryāt svedādīṃś cānilāpahān| -------------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. anantaraṃ vātavyādhicikitsitoktaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| paścād acchasurāṃ pibet| evaṃ snigdhāṃ satīṃ mṛdu virecayet-āragvadhena| anantaraṃ bastikarma kuryāt| svedādīṃś ca mārutāpahān| ādiśabdenābhyaṅgāder grahaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
rāsnājamodāsaraladevadārurajonvitam||12||
bālo lihyād ghṛtaṃ tair vā vipakvaṃ sasitopalam| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. rāsnādicūrṇānvitaṃ śiśuḥ sarpir lihyāt| athavā taiḥ siddhaṃ saśarkaraṃ ghṛtaṃ lihyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
pittaduṣṭe 'mṛtābhīrupaṭolīnimbacandanam||13||
dhātrī kumāraś ca pibet kvāthayitvā sasārivam|
athavā triphalāmustabhūnimbakaṭurohiṇīḥ||14||
sārivādiṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ tathā gaṇam|
ghṛtāny ebhiś ca siddhāni pittaghnaṃ ca virecanam||15|| śītāṃś cābhyaṅgalepādīn yuñjyāt--------------| -------------------------------------------------|16|

Sa. pittaduṣṭe guḍūcyādīni kvāthayitvā bālaḥ pibet dhātrī ca| athavā triphalādīn pibet| athavā sārivādigaṇaṃ(gaṇādyanyatamaṃ) pibet saṃ-athavā sārivādibhir gaṇaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak siddhāni ghṛtāni lihyāt| virecanadravyaṃ ca pittaghnaṃ kuryā(yuñjyā)t| abhyaṅgādīṃś ca śītān yuñjyāt|

--------------------------------śleṣmātmake punaḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvasaindhavayutaṃ kumāraṃ pāyayed ghṛtam||16||
sindhūtthapippalīmadvā, piṣṭaiḥ, kṣaudrayutair atha|
rāṭhapuṣpaiḥ stanau limpec chiśoś ca daśanacchadau||17||
sukham evaṃ vamed bālaḥ-------------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. śleṣmaduṣṭe stanye madhuyaṣṭīsaindhavayuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ bālaṃ pāyayet| saindhavapippaliyuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā pāyayet| madanakusumair mākṣikayuktaiḥ stanau limpet| bālasya coṣṭhau limpet| evaṃ kṛte sati bālaḥ sukhaṃ vamet|
Sa. dhātrīṃ tīkṣṇair vamanair vāmayet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
athācaritasaṃsargī mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet||18||

div.ab: Sa. anantaraṃ kṛte saṃsarge sati mustādiṃ kvathitaṃ pibet| tagarādīn vā ativiṣādīn vā pibet|

lg.l: śakṛn nānāvyathāvarṇaṃ, mūtraṃ pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanam|

div.ab: Sa. tridoṣaduṣṭe stanye durgandhyādiguṇaṃ śakṛd upaveśyate, tathā nānāvyathāvarṇam| mūtraṃ ca pītaṃ sitaṃ ghanaṃ-styānaṃ, ca syāt| tathā jvarādayaḥ, anye 'pi-evaṃprakārā rogāḥ, jāyante| taṃ-īdṛśaṃ, gadaṃ kṣīrālasakam iti kathayanti| atyayaṃ-vināśahetum, ata evātidāruṇam tatra-kṣīrālasake, śīghram eva dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca vamanenopakramet|

lg.l: vihitāyāṃ ca saṃsargyāṃ vacādiṃ yojayed gaṇam|

div.ab: Sa. [ vihitāyāṃ ] saṃsargyāṃ-peyādike krame kṛte, vacādiṃ niśādiṃ vā gaṇaṃ prayojayet| mādryādīn vā yojayet|
Sa. pāṭhādaya upayuktāḥ paraṃ stanyadoṣaharāḥ| tiktaḥ kirātatiktaḥ|
anubandhe yathāvyādhi pratikurvīta kālavit| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. anubandhe tu sati yathārogaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryād vaidyaḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
dantodbhedaś ca rogāṇāṃ sarveṣām api kāraṇam||26||

viśeṣāj javaraviḍbhedakāsacchardiśirorujām|
abhiṣyandasya pothakyā visarpasya ca jāyate||27||

div.ab: Sa. rogāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām api dantodbhedo hetur jāyate| viśeṣeṇa jvarādīnāṃ tu hetuḥ sampadyate|

lg.l: dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcin na dūyate||28||

div.ab: Sa. mārjārāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhabhaṅge sati, mayūrāṇāṃ ca śikodbhave sati, dantotthāne ca śiśūnāṃ, naneti dvau pratiṣedhau prakṛtam arthaṃ gamayataḥ, tena sarvaṃ vapur bālasyottaptaṃ bhavet| na kiñcin na dūyate,- api tu sarvāṇy evāṅgāni pīḍyanta ity arthaḥ| tatra doṣānusāreṇa tathā doṣādikyānurodhena tathā rogānusāreṇa ca deśakālasattvasātmyaprakṛtīr nirūpyāuṣadhaṃ prayojayet|

ta eva doṣā dūṣyāś ca jvarādyā vyādhayaś ca yat|
atas tad eva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tv asya kanīyasī||30||
saukumāryālpakāyatvāt sarvānnānupasevanāt| --------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. yat-yasmāt, ta eva vātādayo doṣāḥ, ta eva rasādayo dūṣyāḥ, jvarādayaś ca rogāḥ pūrvoktās ta eva, tasmāt tad eva pūrvoktaṃ bhaiṣajyam| asya tu-bālasya, mātrā kanīyasī| kuto 'sya hrasvatarā mātrā ? ity āha-saukumāryety ādi|

-----------------------------------------------|
snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt||31||
sadyas tān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayen matimān mṛdu| -----------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. śiśavaḥ sarvadaiva snigdhāḥ| kutaḥ ? ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt| yataś caivaṃ tasmāt tān-bālān, sadyo vamanaṃ mṛdu dhīmān pāyayet|

---------------------------------------------|
stanyasya tṛptaṃ vamayet kṣīrakṣīrānnasevinam||32||
pītavantaṃ tanuṃ peyām annādaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutām| ---------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. kṣīrasevinaṃ tathā kṣīrānnasevinaṃ bālaṃ stanyasya tṛptaṃ santaṃ vāmayet| stanyasya tṛptam iti "adhikaraṇavācinaś ca" iti ṣaṣṭhī| vā(va)mayed iti "glāsnāvanuvamāṃ ca" iti mittvavikalpaḥ annādaṃ bālaṃ tanuṃ-aghanāṃ, peyāṃ sasarpiṣkāṃ pītavantaṃ vāmayet|

---------------------------------------------|
bastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa, marśena pratimarśanam||33|| yuñjayād virecanādīṃs tu dhātryā eva yathoditān| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. virekeṇa sādhye roge bastiṃ yuñjayāt| marśena sādhye roge pratimarśaṃ yuñjyāt| virecanādīn punar yathoditān dhātryā eva yuñjyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
mūrvāvyoṣavarākolajambūtvakdārusarṣapāḥ||34||
sapāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param| ---------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. mūrvādayo madhunā līḍhāḥ suṣṭhu stanyadoṣaharāḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
dantapālīṃ samadhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet||35||
pippalyā dhātakīpuṣpadhātrīphalakṛtena vā| ---------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. śiśor dantapālīṃ pippalyāś cūrṇena samākṣikeṇa pratisārayet| athavā dhātakīpuṣpādikṛtena cūrṇena pratisārayet|

---------------------------------------------|
lāvatittirivallūrarajaḥ puṣparasadrutam||36||
drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ dantakesaravan mukham| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. lāvādicūrṇaṃ mākṣikadravīkṛtam upayuktaṃ śiśūnāṃ śīghraṃ dantakesaravan mukhaṃ karoti| dantā eva kesaraṃ tat (rāṇi tāni) vidyate(nte) yasminn iti matup|

---------------------------------------------|
vacādvibṛhatīpāṭhākaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ||37||
madhuraiś ca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani| ---------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. vacādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ dantotthāne siddham,- avyāhataśaktitvāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
rajanīdārusaralaśreyasībṛhatīdvayam||38||

div.ab: Sa. rajanyādicūrṇaṃ mākṣikayuktena sarpiṣā līḍhaṃ grahaṇyā dīpanaṃ suṣṭhu vātasya cānulomanam| tathā'tīsārādijit| bālasya sarvāmayeṣu hitaṃ balavarṇadaṃ ca|

samaṅgādhātakīrodhrakuṭannaṭabalādvayaiḥ|
mahāsahākṣudrasahāmudgabilvaśalāṭubhiḥ||41||
sakārpāsīphalais toye sādhitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam|
kṣīramastuyutaṃ hanti śīghraṃ dantodbhavodbhavān||42||
vividhān āmayān etad vṛddhakāśyapanirmitam| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. samaṅgādibhiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayā toye sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīramastuyutaṃ pakvaṃ dantotthān rogān anekaprakārān hanti| etac ca vṛddhakāśyapena nirmitam|

---------------------------------------------|
dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu na bālam atiyantrayet||43||
svayam apy upaśāmyanti jātadantasya yad gadāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. dantodbhaveṣu rogeṣu bālaṃ nātīva yantrayet-pathyabhojanādinā nātīva niyamayet, yathā'nyarogiṇam| kim ? ity āha-yat-yasmāt, svayam eva(mapi)-cikitsām antareṇāpi, jātadantasya sato bālasya rogāḥ praśāmyanti|

-----------------------------------------------|
atyahaḥsvapnaśītāmbuślaiṣmikastanyasevinaḥ||44||
śiśoḥ kaphena ruddheṣu srotaḥsu rasavāhiṣu|
arocakaḥ pratiśyāyo jvaraḥ kāsaś ca jāyate||45||
kumāraḥ śuṣyati tataḥ snigdhaśuklamukhekṣaṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. bhṛśaṃ divāsvapnādisevino 'rbhakasya kaphena rasavāhiṣu srotaḥsu ruddheṣu satsu arocakādayaḥ prādurbhavanti| tataḥ-teṣu jāteṣu, kumāraḥ śuṣyati| snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ vadananayanaṃ yasya sa evaṃbhūtaḥ san|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
saindhavavyoṣaśārṅgeṣṭāpāṭhāgirikadambakān||46||
śuṣyato madhusarpirbhyām arucyādiṣu yojayet| -----------------------------------------------||47||

div.ab: Sa. tasyārocakādiṣu saindhavādīn samadhughṛtān yojayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
aśokarohiṇīyuktaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca cūrṇitam||47||
badarīdhātakīdhātrīcūrṇaṃ vā sarpiṣā drutam| -----------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. tathā pañcakolaṃ rajīkṛtam aśokakaṭukābhyāṃ yuktaṃ yojayet| athavā badaryādicūrṇaṃ sarpiṣā dravīkṛtaṃ yojayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
sthirāvacādvibṛhatīkākolīpippalīnataiḥ||48||
niculotpalavarṣābhūbhārgīmustaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ|
siddhaṃ prasthārdham ājyasya srotasāṃ śodhanaṃ param||49||
simhyaśvagandhāsurasākaṇāgarbhaṃ ca tadguṇam| -----------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. sthirādibhiḥ kārṣikair ghṛtasya prasthārdhaṃ siddhaṃ paraṃ srotasāṃ viśodhanam| simhyādibhir ghṛtaṃ pūrvaguṇam|

-----------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭyāhvapippalīrodhrapadmakotpalacandanaiḥ||50||
tālīsasārivābhyāṃ ca sādhitaṃ śoṣajid ghṛtam| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. madhuyaṣṭikādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ śoṣajit|

-----------------------------------------------|
śṛṅgīmadhūlikābhārgīpippalīdevadārubhiḥ||51||
aśvagandhādvikākolīrāsnarṣabhakajīvakaiḥ|
śūrpaparṇīviḍaṅgaiś ca kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtam||52||
śaśottamāṅganiryūhe śuṣyataḥ puṣṭikṛt param| -----------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. śṛṅgyādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ śaśasya śiraḥkvāthena sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ śuṣyato bālasyātipuṣṭikaram|

-----------------------------------------------|
vacāvayaḥsthātagarakāyasthācorakaiḥ śṛtam||53||
bastamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam| -----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. vacādibhiś chāgamūtrasurābhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ tailam abhyaṅge hitam|

-----------------------------------------------|
lākṣārasasamaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastu caturguṇam||54||
aśvagandhāniśādārukauntīkuṣṭhābdacandanaiḥ|
samūrvārohiṇīrāsnāśatāhvāmadhukaiḥ samaiḥ||55||
siddhaṃ lākṣādikaṃ nāma tailam abhyañjanād idam|
balyaṃ jvarakṣayonmādaśvāsāpasmāravātanut||56||
yakṣarākṣasabhūtaghnaṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca śasyate| -----------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. lākṣārasatulyaṃ tailaprasthaṃ mastucaturguṇam aśvagandhādibhiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇaiḥ siddhaṃ lākṣādikasaṃjñam| etat tailam abhyaṅgād balyaṃ jvarādijit yakṣmādighnaṃ garbhiṇībhyaś ca hitam|

-----------------------------------------------|
madhunā'tiviṣāśṛṅgīpippalīr lehayec chiśum||57||
ekāṃ vā'tiviṣāṃ kāsajvaracchardirupadrutam| -----------------------------------------------|58|
Sa. ativiṣādīn madhunā kāsādipīḍitaṃ śiśuṃ-bālaṃ, lehayet| athavā, ativiṣām ekāṃ lehayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
pītaṃ pītaṃ vamati yaḥ stanyaṃ taṃ madhusarpiṣā||58||

lg.l: tadval lihyāt tathā vyoṣaṃ maṣīṃ vā romacarmaṇām|

div.ab: Sa. yo bālaḥ pītaṃ pītaṃ stanyaṃ vamet taṃ bṛhatīdvayasya phalasvarasaṃ pañcakolaṃ ca ghṛtamākṣikābhyāṃ lehayet| athavā pippalyādikaṃ tadvat-pūrvavat madhusarpiṣā, bālo lihyāt| vyoṣaṃ tathā-madhusarpiṣā, lihyāt| [ athavā ] śalyakādijanmanāṃ romṇāṃ carmaṇāṃ ca yathālābhaṃ maṣīṃ madhughṛtābhyāṃ lihyāt|
Sa. khadirādirase sakṣīraṃ sarpiḥ pakvam upayuktaṃ vamiṃ śamayati|

-----------------------------------------------|
tālumāṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam||63||
tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate|
tālupātaḥ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrāt pānaṃ śakṛd dravam||64||
tṛḍāsyakaṇḍvakṣirujā grīvādurdharatā vamiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|65|

Sa. kapho madhurādyais tālumāṃse prakupitas tālukaṇṭakaṃ kuryāt| tena-tālukaṇṭakena, śirasi tālupradeśe nimnatā syāt| tathā tālunaḥ patanaṃ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchreṇa stanapānaṃ śakṛc ca dravaṃ syāt| tathā tṛḍādyāḥ syuḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
tatrotkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet||65||
tālu tadvat kaṇāśuṇṭhīgośakṛdrasasaindhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. tatra tālūtkṣipya yavakṣārakṣaudrābhyāṃ pratisārayet| tathaiva kaṇādibhiḥ pratisārayet

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śṛṅgaveraniśābhṛṅgaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavaiḥ||66||

lg.l: badhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ kukūle svedayet tataḥ|
rasena limpet tālvāsyaṃ netre ca pariṣecayet||67||

div.ab: Sa. tathā śuṇṭhyādikaṃ kalkitaṃ vaṭapallavair badhvā gośakṛtā liptaṃ tataḥ kukūle svedayet| anantaraṃ rasena ca-tataḥ srutena, tālu āsyaṃ ca limpet| tathā netre pariṣecayet|
Sa. harītakyādikaṃ mākṣikayuktaṃ stanyena śiśuḥ pītvā tālukaṇṭakād vimucyate

lg.l: pṛṣṭārur gudakuṭṭaṃ ca kecic ca tam anāmikam||70||

div.ab: Sa. gude raktakaphodbhavo malopalepāt svedād vā tāmro vraṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān āntaro bahūpadravo jāyate| taṃ-tathāvidhaṃ, kecin mātṛkādoṣaṃ kathayanti| apare ca pūtanasaṃjñam ity āhuḥ| kecit pṛṣṭārur iti, kecit gudakuṭṭam iti, kecic ca tam anāmikaṃ, bruvate|
tatra dhātryāḥ payaḥ śodhyaṃ pittaśleṣmaharauṣadhaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. tatra-tasminn anekanāmni roge, dhātryāḥ kṣīraṃ śodhanīyam kaiḥ ? pittaśleṣmahṛdbhir auṣadhaiḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śṛtaśītaṃ ca śītāmbuyuktam antarapānakam||71||

div.ab: Sa. saha kṣaudreṇa vartate yat tat sakṣaudram, sakṣaudram ca tat tārkṣyaśailaṃ ca, tena yuktaṃ śītāmbu, antaraṃ pānakaṃ ca hitam| kimbhūtam ? śṛtaśītam| atra ca śītamātrasya śītatvenaiva labdhatvāc chītāmbivatyatiśayārtham| evaṃ hi pittopaśāntir bhavati| ata eva ca tatsahitasya kaphasya śamanāya mākṣikarasāñjanayogo 'tra kṛtaḥ| tena ca jalena vraṇaṃ lepayet| kimbhūtaṃ vraṇam ? triphalādikvāthena pariṣecitaṃ santaṃ kāsīsādibhir amlapiṣṭair vā lepayet| athavā, etair eva cūrṇitair vraṇam avacūrṇayet| athavā madhukādibhiḥ supiṣṭair avacūrṇayet| sārivāśaṅkhanābhibhyām avacūrṇayet| athavā, asanatvacā limpet| rāgakaṇḍvādhikye jalaukobhir asrasrāvaṃ kuryāt| jalaukasā "jātau" ity ekavacanāt tasya prayogo na doṣāya, tathā sallakṣasya dṛṣtatvāt| sarvaṃ cikitsitaṃ pittavraṇatulyaṃ gudakuṭṭake śasyate|

pāṭhāvelladvirajanīmustabhārgīpunarnavaiḥ|
sabilvatryūṣaṇaiḥ sarpivṛścikālīyutaiḥ śṛtam||76||
lihāno mātrayā rogair mucyate mṛttikodbhavaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. pāṭhādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ mātrayā lihan mṛttikodbhavair āmayair mucyate|

vyādher yad yasya bhaiṣajyaṃ stanas tena pralepitaḥ|
sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto 'nu pītas taṃ taṃ jayed gadam|77| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālā- mayapratiṣedho nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|2|

Sa. yasya rogasya yad auṣadham uktaṃ tenaivauṣadhena stanaḥ pralepito muhūrtamātraṃ-nāḍikādvayaṃ yāvad vidhṛtaḥ, stano 'nu dhautaḥ paścāt pītas taṃ taṃ-aniyataṃ rogaṃ, jayet| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattavirachitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālā mayapratiṣedho nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 2||

div.head: balagrahapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bālagrahapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. asmād anantaraṃ bālagrahapratiṣedha ucyate, grahāṇām api roga hetutvāt| bālānāṃ grahā bālagrahāḥ, teṣāṃ pratiṣedho yasmin sa bālagrahapratiṣedhaḥ, tam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

purā guhasya rakṣārthaṃ nirmitāḥ śūlapāṇinā|
manuṣyavigrahāḥ pañca sapta strīvigrahā grahāḥ||1||
skando viśākho meṣākhyaḥ śvagrahaḥ pitṛsaṃjñitaḥ|
śakuniḥ pūtanā śītapūtanā'dṛṣṭipūtanā||2||
mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvad revatī śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. pūrvaṃ śrīmahādevena kārtikeyasya rakṣārthaṃ manuṣyaśarīrāḥ pañca grahā nirmitāḥ| strīśarīrāś ca saptotpāditāḥ| saṃ-skandādayaḥ pañca nararūpāḥ| śakunyādayaḥ sapta strīrūpāḥ|

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------------|
teṣāṃ grahīṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. teṣāṃ-grahāṇāṃ, grahīṣyatāṃ pūrvarūpaṃ pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraś ca|
Sa. teṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ rūpam uttrāsa ity ādi svadhātryaṅgavilekhanāntam|

tatraikanayanasrāvī śiro vikṣipate muhuḥ|
hataikapakṣaḥ stabdhāṅgaḥ sasvedo natakandharaḥ||6||
dantakhādī stanadveṣī trasyan roditi visvaram|
vakravaktro vaman lālāṃ bhṛśam ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate||7||
vasāsṛggandhir udvigno baddhamuṣṭiśakṛc chiśuḥ|
calitaikākṣigaṇḍabhrūḥ saṃraktobhayalocanaḥ||8||
skandārtas tena vaikalyaṃ maraṇaṃ vā bhaved dhruvam| --------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. tatra-teṣu graheṣu madhye, ekalocanasravaṇaśīlas tathā śiro vikṣipata ity ādi saṃraktalocanadvayāntaṃ skandagṛhītasya lakṣaṇam| tena vaikalyaṃ-paṅgutvakāṇatvādi, mṛtyur eva vā dhruvaṃ niścitaṃ, bhavet|

ab.seg:
samprati viśākhasya skandāpasmārāparasaṃjñasya lakṣaṇam āha ---- --------------------------------------------------|
saṃjñānāśo muhuḥ keśaluñcanaṃ kandharānatiḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. saṃjñānāśādikaṃ pūyaśoṇitagandhāntaṃ skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam|

lg.l: ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ, madhye vinamanaṃ, jvaraḥ|

div.ab: Sa. meṣasya naigameṣāparasaṃjñasyādhmānādi ekanetraśophāntaṃ lakṣaṇam|

kampo hṛṣitaromatvaṃ svedaś cakṣurnimīlanam|
bahirāyāmanaṃ jihvādaṃśo 'ntaḥkaṇṭhakūjanam||15||
dhāvanaṃ viṭsagandhatvaṃ krośanaṃ ca śvavac chuni| --------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. śuni-śvagrahe, kampa ity ādikaṃ krośanaṃ śvavad ity antaṃ lakṣaṇam|

--------------------------------------------------|
romaharṣo muhus trāsaḥ sahasā rodanaṃ jvaraḥ||16||
kāsātisāravamathujṛmbhātṛṭśavagandatāḥ|
aṅgeṣv ākṣepavikṣepaśoṣastambhavivarṇatāḥ||17||
muṣṭibandhaḥ srutiś cākṣṇor bālasya syuḥ pitṛgrahe| --------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. pitṛgrahe romaharṣaṃ ity ādikaṃ bālasya syur ity antaṃ lakṣaṇam|

--------------------------------------------------|
srastāṅgatvam atīsāro jihvātālugale vraṇāḥ||18||
sphoṭāḥ sadāharukpākāḥ sandhiṣu syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ|
niśy ahni pravilīyante pāko vaktre gude 'pi vā||19||
bhayaṃ śakunigandhatvaṃ jvaraś ca śakunigrahe| --------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. śakunigrahe srastāṅgatvam ity ādikaṃ jvaraś cety antaṃ liṅgam|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
pūtanāyāṃ vamiḥ kampas tandrā rātrau prajāgaraḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. vamiḥ kampa ity ādikaṃ kākavatpūtigandhitety antaṃ pūtanāgrahe liṅgam|

śītapūtanayā kampo rodanaṃ tiryagīkṣaṇam|
tṛṣṇā'ntrakūjo 'tīsāro vasāvadvisragandhatā||22||
pārśvasyaikasya śītatvam uṣṇatvam aparasya ca| --------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. śītapūtanayā kampo rodanam ity ādikam uṣṇatvam aparasya cety evamantaṃ śītapūranāgrahe liṅgam

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
andhapūtanayā chardir jvaraḥ kāso 'lpanidratā||23||

div.ab: Sa. chardyādikaṃ sāmlagandhatety antam andhapūtanāyā [a] dṛṣṭipūtanāparasaṃjñāyā lakṣaṇam|

mukhamaṇḍitayā pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatā|
sirābhir asitābhābhir ācitodaratā jvaraḥ||26||
arocako 'ṅgaglapanaṃ gomūtrasamagandhatā| --------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. mukhamaṇḍitāyāṃ grahe pāṇipādāsyaramaṇīyatety ādikaṃ lakṣaṇam|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
revatyāṃ śyāvanīlatvaṃ karṇanāsākṣimardanam||27||

lg.l: bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam||28||

div.ab: Sa. revatyāṃ-revatīgrahe, śyāvanīlatvādi liṅgam|

adhunā'sādhyalakṣaṇaṃ vakti ----
jāyate śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramāt sarvāṅgasaṅkṣayaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. śuṣkarevatyāṃ kramāt sarvāṅgasaṅkṣaya iti liṅgam|

--------------------------------------------------|
keśaśāto 'nnavidveṣaḥ svaradainyaṃ vivarṇatā||29||
rodanaṃ gṛdhragandhatvaṃ dīrghakālānuvartanam|
udare granthayo vṛttā yasya nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt||30||
jihvāyā nimnatā madhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet| --------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. keśaśāta ity ādikaṃ śyāvaṃ tālu cety antaṃ yasya bālasya syāt, taṃ na cikitset|

-------------------------------------------------|
bhuñjāno 'nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yo bālaḥ parihīyate||31||
tṛṣṇāgṛhītaḥ kṣāmākṣo hanti taṃ śuṣkarevatī| -------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. bhuñjāno 'nnam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ bālaṃ śuṣkarevatī hanti|

ab.seg:
tribhiḥ kāraṇair grahā gṛhṇantīty āha ---- -------------------------------------------------|
hiṃsāratyarcanākāṅkṣā grahagrahaṇakāraṇam||32||

div.ab: Sa. hiṃsā ca ratiś cārcanā ca, tāsām ākāṅkṣā-abhilāṣaḥ, sā grahāṇāṃ grahaṇe kāraṇaṃ-hetuḥ|

tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān vā srutanāsikaḥ|
kṣatajihvaḥ kvaṇed bāḍham asukhī sāśrulocanaḥ||33||
durvarṇo hīnavacanaḥ pūtigandhiś ca jāyate|
kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdgāti na jugupsate||34||
hastau codyamya saṃrabdho hanty ātmānaṃ tathā param|
tadvac ca śastrakāṣṭhādyair agniṃ vā dīptam āviśet||35||
apsu majjet patet kūpe kuryād anyac ca tadvidham|
tṛḍdāhamohān pūyasya chardanaṃ ca pravartayet||36||
raktaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet| -------------------------------------------------|37|

Sa. tatra-teṣu graheṣu madhyāt, hiṃsātmake grahe sati bālo mahān vā puruṣaḥ srutanāsikādiguṇo jāyate| tathā kṣāmaḥ san idam idaṃ kuryāt| tadvidhaṃ-ātmahananādikaṃ, anyad api kuryāt| tṛṭdāhamohāṃs tathā chardanaṃ ca pūyasya pravartayet| tathā sarvasrotobhyo raktaṃ ca pravartayet, riṣṭotpattiṃ ca| taṃ bālaṃ nopakramet|

sampraty arcanākāmaṃ brūte ---- -------------------------------------------------|
rahaḥstrīratisaṃlāpagandhasragbhūṣaṇapriyaḥ||37||
hṛṣṭaḥ śāntaś ca duḥsādhyo ratikāmena pīḍitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. rahaḥstrīratyādipriyo hṛṣṭādiguṇo bālo ratikāmena graheṇa pīḍitaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ syāt|

adhunaiṣāṃ cikitsitam āha ---- -------------------------------------------------|
dīnaḥ parimṛśan vaktraṃ śuṣkauṣṭhagalatālukaḥ||38||
śaṅkitaṃ vīkṣate rauti dhyāyaty āyāti dīnatām|
annam annābhilāṣe 'pi dattaṃ nāti bubhukṣate||39||
gṛhītaṃ balikāmena taṃ vidyāt sukhasādhanam| -------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. dīnādiguṇaḥ san idam idaṃ karoti| taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ, balikāmena gṛhītaṃ bālaṃ sukhasādhyaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
hantukāmaṃ jayed dhomaiḥ siddhamantrapravartitaiḥ||40||
itarau tu yathākāmaṃ ratibalyādidānataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|

Sa. jighāṃsugrahaṃ homādibhir jayet| nanu, hiṃsākāmo 'sādhyas taṃ tyajed ity uktam, tat kathaṃ tasya sādhanam uktam ? brūmaḥ| asādhyasyāpi cikitsā kāryaiva| tathā ca saṅgrahe 'bhyadhāyi "tasmād ācaramocchvāsāc cikitset|" ity ādi| api ca mantraprabhāvasyācintyatvāt| itarau tu-ratyarcanākāmau, yathābhilāṣaṃ ratibalyādidānena jayet|

-------------------------------------------------|
atha sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte śaraṇe sthitam||41||
trir ahnaḥ siktasaṃmṛṣṭe sadā sannihitānale|
vikīrṇabhūtikusumapatrabījānnasarṣape||42||
rakṣoghnatailajvalitapradīpahatapāpmani|
vyavāyamadyapiśitanivṛttaparicārake||43||
purāṇasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ pariṣiktaṃ sukhāmbunā|
sādhitena balānimbavaijayantīnṛpadrumaiḥ||44||
pāribhadrakakaṭvaṅgajambūvaruṇakaṭūtṛṇaiḥ|
kapotavaṅkāpāmārgapāṭalāmadhuśigrubhiḥ||45||
kākajaṅghāmahāśvetākapitthakṣīripādapaiḥ|
sakadambakarañjaiś ca, dhūpaṃ snātasya cācaret||46||
dvīpivyāghrāhisiṃharkṣacarmabhir ghṛtamiśritaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|47|

Sa. atheti kṛtamaṅgalam| sādhyagrahaṃ bālaṃ vivikte gṛhe sthitam| kimbhūte ? [ triḥ- ] trīn vārān, śodhite sikte ca| trir ahna iti "kṛtvo 'rthaprayoge kāle 'dhikaraṇe" ity adhikaraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| tathā sarvadā nikaṭāgnau| tathā vikṣiptabhūtyādike, rakṣoghnatailapradīptapradīpahatapāpe, vyavāyādinivṛttaparicārake| kimbhūtaṃ bālam ? purāṇaghṛtābhyaktam| tathā snātam uṣṇāmbunā| kimbhūtena jalena ? balādibhiḥ sādhitena| vaijayantī-araṇikā| mahāśvetā_kaṭabhī| pariṣiktasya cāsya dvīpyādicarmādibhir ghṛta miśritair dhūpanaṃ kuryāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
pūtīdaśāṅgasiddhārthavacābhallātadīpyakaiḥ||47||
sakuṣṭhaiḥ saghṛtair dhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pūtyādibhir dhūpaḥ sarvagrahavimokṣaṇaḥ syāt| pūtī-pūtīkarañjaḥ| "vacāhiṅguviḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gajapippalī| pāṭhā prativiṣā vyoṣaṃ" (hṛ. u. a. 37|27) iti daśāṅgaḥ kāśyapena vinirmitaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
sarṣapā nimbapatrāṇi mūlam aśvakhurā vacā||48||
bhūrjapatraṃ ghṛtaṃ dhūpaḥ sarvagrahanivāraṇaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. sarṣapādibhir dhūpo 'śeṣagrahanivāraṇaḥ| aśvakhurā-girikarṇikā|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
anantāmrāsthitagaraṃ maricaṃ madhuro gaṇaḥ||49||

lg.l: śṛgālavinnā mustā ca kalkitais tair ghṛtaṃ pacet|

div.ab: Sa. yavāsādibhiḥ kalkitair daśamūlarasakṣīrayutaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet| tac ca śiśoḥ pathyaṃ paraṃ grahajit|

rāsnāhyaṃśumatīvṛddhapañcamūlabalāghanāt|
kvāthe sarpiḥ pacet piṣṭaiḥ sārivāvyoṣacitrakaiḥ||51||
pāṭhāviḍaṅgamadhukapayasyāhiṅgudārubhiḥ|
sagranthikaiḥ sendrayavaiḥ śiśos tat satataṃ hitam||52||
sarvarogagrahaharaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadam| -------------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. rāsnādikvāthe sārivādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ sarpiḥ pacet| tac ca śiśoḥ sadā pathyaṃ sarvarogagrahaghnaṃ dīpanaṃ balavarṇadaṃ ca|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sārivāsurabhibrāhmīśaṅkhinīkuṣṭhasarṣapaiḥ||53||

lg.l: tan nāśayed grahān sarvān pānenābhyañjanena ca||54||

div.ab: Sa. sārivādibhiḥ surasayuktaiḥ sarpir vipācayet| tac ca pānābhyañjanābhyāṃ sarvagrahanāśanam|
Sa. gośṛṅgādi sarpanirmokādi ca mṛnmaye bhāṇḍe chāgamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ sarvabhūteṣu viṣamajvare ca dhūpanārthaṃ hitam|

lg.l: ghṛtāni bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante yāni tāni ca|
yuñjyāt tathā baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ mantratantravit||58||

div.ab: Sa. yāni ca sarpīṣi bhūtavidyāyāṃ vakṣyante tāni ca yuñjyāt| tathā mantrāḥ-saṅgrahoktāḥ, tantrāṇi ca, etāni vettīti mantratantravit,-vaidyo, baliṃ homaṃ snapanaṃ ca yuñjyāt|

pūtīkarañja(ñjāt)tvakpatraṃ kṣīribhyo barbarād api|
tumbīviśālāralukaśamībilvakapitthataḥ||59||
utkvāthya toyaṃ tad rātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivam| -------------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. pūtīkarañjatvak tathā patraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣād barbarādibhyaś ca toyam utkvāthya tad rātrau bālānāṃ snapanaṃ śivaṃ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ grahāpāye 'py upadravān|60|
bālāmayaniṣedhoktabheṣajaiḥ samupācaret| 60 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bālagrahapratiṣedho nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ|3|

Sa. anubandhān yathākṛcchraṃ tathā grahāṇām apāye-mokṣe, ca ye upadravās tāṃś ca bālāmayapratiṣedhādhyāyoktair auṣadhaiḥ samupakramet| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputra śrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bālagra- hapratiṣedho nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 3|| ity aṣṭāṅgahṛdaye dvitīyaṃ kaumāratantraṃ samāptam|

div.head: bhūtavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto bhūtavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. adhunā bhūtavijñānādhyāyārambho grahasāmānyāt|
athāto bhūtavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
Sa. adhunā bhūtavijñānādhyāyārambho grahasāmānyāt|
Sa. yasya bhūtasya rūpāder anukāraṃ yādṛśaṃ bhajate tena taṃ puruṣam adhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|
so 'ṣṭādaśavidho devadānavādivibhedataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. sa bhūto 'ṣṭādaśaprakāro devādibhedena|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
hetus tadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto 'thavā||3||

div.ab: Sa. tasya bhūtasyānuṣaṅge prajñāparādhaḥ sadyaḥ-adhunātanaḥ, pūrvajanmakṛto vā hetuḥ| tena-prajñāparādhena, kāmakrodhādijena sutarāṃ naṣṭadharmavratācāraḥ san pūjyān apy atikrāmati| taṃ puruṣaṃ tathā luptadharmavratācāratvād bhinnamaryādaṃ devādayo grahā apy atyanta- maryādātikramād anu-paścāt, ghnanti| na kevalaṃ hiṃsātmakānām akṣamā iti dyotanārtho 'piśabdaḥ| kīdṛśās te ? chidraprahāriṇaḥ| hetāv iyaṃ prathamā, chidraprahāritvād ity arthaḥ|

Sa. chidraṃ pāpakriyārambha ucyate| sa cāśubhasya karmaṇaḥ pākaḥ-phalam| ekasya-advitīyasya, śūnye sthāne 'vasthitiḥ, athavā śmaśānādiṣu niśy avasthitiḥ| tathā nagrety ādi| kiṃ vā bahunoditena ? saṅkṣepeṇa dinacaryādikathitasyācārasya ca vyatikrama iti grahagrahaṇe hetuḥ|

lg.l: gandharvās tu carturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ coragāḥ punaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. devāḥ śuklapratipadi śuklatrayodaśyāṃ ca naraṃ gṛhṇanti| śuklatrayodaśyāṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ ca dānavā grahā gṛhṇanti| gandharvāś ca- turdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca| sarpās tu pañcamyām| śuklapakṣasya saptamyām ekādaśyāṃ ca yakṣā gṛhṇanti| śuklāṣṭamyādiṣu brahmarākṣasā gṛhṇanti| rakṣaḥpiśācādayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe navamīdvādaśyoḥ parvasu ca gṛhṇanti| daśamyādiṣu pitaro gṛhṇanti| apare-anuktā guruvṛddhādayaḥ, aṣṭamīnavamyor gṛhṇanti| pūrvākteṣv eva tithiṣu prāyeṇa(yaḥ)-bāhulyena, grahaṇakālaṃ sandhyāsu-parvādiṣu, jānīyāt
Sa. phullapadmopamamukham ity ādi devagrahagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

lg.l: rudraḥ skando viśākho 'ham indro 'ham iti vādinam|

div.ab: Sa. jihmadṛṣṭim ity ādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ daityavaśīkṛtaṃ vidyāt|

svācāraṃ surabhiṃ hṛṣṭaṃ gītanartanakāriṇam|
snānodyānaruciṃ raktavastramālyānulepanam||18||
śṛṅgāralīlābhirataṃ gandharvādhyuṣitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. svācāram ity ādilakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ gandharveṇa gṛhītaṃ vidyāt

-------------------------------------------------|
raktākṣaṃ krodhanaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ vakragatiṃ calam||19||
śvasantam aniśaṃ hihvālolinaṃ sṛkkiṇīliham|
priyadugdhaguḍasnānam adhovadanaśāyinam||20||
uragādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāt trasyāntaṃ cātapatrataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. raktākṣam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ chatrāc ca trasyantaṃ sarpādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
viplutatrastaraktāṃkṣaṃ śubhagandhaṃ sutejasam||21||
priyanṛtyakathāgītasnānamālyānulepanam|
matsyamāṃsaruciṃ hṛṣṭaṃ tuṣṭaṃ balinam avyatham||22||
calitāgrakaraṃ kasmai kiṃ dadāmīti vādinam|
rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ vaidyadvijātiparibhāvinam||23||
alparoṣaṃ drutagatiṃ vidyād yakṣagṛhītakam| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. viplutatrastaraktākṣam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ yakṣagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
hāsyanṛtyapriyaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ chidraprahāriṇam||24||
ākrośinaṃ śīghragatiṃ devadvijabhiṣagdviṣam|
ātmānaṃ kāṣṭhaśastrādyair ghnantaṃ bhoḥśabdavādinam||25||
śāstravedapaṭhaṃ vidyād gṛhītaṃ brahmarākṣasaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. hāsyanṛtyapriyam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ brahmarākṣasagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ bhṛkuṭim udvahantaṃ sasaṃbhramam||26||

lg.l: dṛṣṭvā ca raktaṃ māṃsaṃ vā''lihānaṃ daśanacchadau|

div.ab: Sa. sakrodhadṛṣṭim ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ rākṣasādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|

avasthacittaṃ naikatra tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinam|
ucchiṣṭanṛtyagāndharvahāsamadyāmiṣapriyam||30||
nirbhartsanād dīnamukhaṃ rudantam animittataḥ|
nakhair likhantam ātmānaṃ rūkṣadhvastavapuḥsvaram||31||
āvedayantaṃ duḥkhāni sambaddhābaddhabhāṣiṇam|
naṣṭasmṛtiṃ śūnyaratiṃ lolaṃ nagnaṃ malīmasam||32||
rathyācailaparīdhānaṃ tṛṇamālāvibhūṣaṇam|
ārohantaṃ ca kāṣṭhāśvaṃ tathā saṅkarakūṭakam||33||
bahvāśinaṃ piśācena vijānīyād adhiṣṭhitam| -------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. avasthacittam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ piśācagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
pretākṛtikriyāgandhaṃ bhītam āhāravidviṣam||34||
tṛṇacchidaṃ ca pretena gṛhītaṃ naram ādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. pretākṛtikriyāgandham ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ pretagṛhītaṃ naraṃ vidyāt

-------------------------------------------------|
bahupralāpaṃ kṛṣṇāsyaṃ pravilambitayāyinam||35||
śūnapralambavṛṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet| -------------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. bahupralāpādilakṣaṇaṃ kūṣmāṇḍādhiṣṭhitaṃ vadet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
gṛhītvā kāṣṭhaloṣṭādi bhramantaṃ cīravāsasam||36||

div.ab: Sa. gṛhītvā kāṣṭham ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ tathā paruṣāṇi bhāṣamāṇaṃ niṣādagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|
Sa. yācantam udakam ity ādilakṣaṇam aukiraṇārditaṃ vidyāt
Sa. gandhamālyaratim ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ vetālagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|
Sa. aprasannadṛśam ity ādilakṣaṇaṃ pitṛgrahagṛhītaṃ vidyāt|
Sa. gurvādīnāṃ śāpacintānurūpavacanādibhir yathāyogaṃ tadgrahaṃ vidyāt|

kumāravṛdānugataṃ nagnam uddhatamūrdhajam|
asvasthamanasaṃ dairghyakālikaṃ sagrahaṃ tyajet|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta vijñānīyo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ|4|

Sa. sarvagrahagṛhītaṃ tyajet| kīdṛśam ? kumārasamūhenānuyātaṃ, tathā nagnam uddhatakeśaṃ, tathā'svasthacittaṃ, tathā dīrghakālānuvartinaṃ ceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūtavijñānīyo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 4||

div.head: bhūtapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāto bhūtapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. bhūtagrahavijñānād anantaraṃ bhūtasya pratiṣedhaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, ucyate| nanu, nidānacikitsitapadābhyāṃ prasiddhatarābhyāṃ pūrvavat kim itīdaṃ tantrakṛtā nopanibaddham ? iti kecic codyam acūcudan| tān sañcakṣmahe| śāstrakārasyāsyedṛśī pratijñā,-sūtraśārīranidāna cikitsitakalpottarākhyaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānais tantram idam abhidheyam iti| tad evaṃ yady uttare sthāne 'pi kiñcin nidānacikitsitapadābhyām abhidhīyate, tataḥ ṣaṭsthānakam idaṃ tantram iti pratijñāṃ vyāhanyāt| tasmād ayaṃ viracanāprakāraviśeṣaḥ kṛtaḥ|
Sa. ahiṃsākāmaṃ bhūtaṃ japādibhir jayet|

hiṅguvyoṣālanepālīlaśunārkajaṭājaṭāḥ|
ajalomī sagolomī bhūtakeśī vacā latā||2||
kukkuṭī sarpagandhākhyā tilāḥ kāṇavikāṇike|
vajraproktā vayaḥsthā ca śṛṅgī mohanavally api||3||
srotojāñjanarakṣoghnaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ cānyad auṣadham|
kharāśvaśvāviduṣṭrarkṣagodhānakulaśalyakāt||4||
dvīpimārjāragosiṃhavyāghrasāmudrasattvataḥ|
carmapittadvijanakhā varge 'smin sādhayed ghṛtam||5||
purāṇam athavā tailaṃ navaṃ tatpānanasyayoḥ|
abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyam eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane||6||
ebhiś ca guṭikāṃ yuñjyād añjane sāvapīḍane|
pralepe kalkam eteṣāṃ kvāthaṃ ca pariṣecane||7||
prayogo 'yaṃ grahonmādān sāpasmārāñ śamaṃ nayet| --------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. hiṅgvādaya auṣadham| ālaṃ-haritālam| nepālī- kastūrikā| jaṭā-jaṭāmāṃsī| ajalomī-śvetadūrvā| golomī-dūrvā| latā-priyaṅguḥ| kukkuṭī-śitivārakaḥ| sarpagandhākhyā-nākulī| kāṇaviṣā(kā)ṇike-kākolīkṣīrakākolyau| śṛṅgī-ativiṣā| mohanavallī-vandākaḥ| anyad api rakṣoghnaṃ guggulvādikam auṣadham| tathā gardabhaturaṅgādibhyaś carmādayaḥ| sāmudrasattvato-jaladhijantoḥ| tad etasmin hiṅgvādivarge, ghṛtaṃ purāṇam athavā navaṃ tailaṃ pacet-sādhayet| tac ca-ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā, siddhaṃ pāne nasye 'bhyaṅge ca prayojyam| eṣāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca cūrṇaṃ dhūpane prayojyam| ebhiś cūrṇair guṭikām añjane 'vapīḍane ca yuñjyāt| eteṣāṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ kalkaṃ pralepe kvāthaṃ pariṣecane ca yuñjyāt| ayaṃ prayogo grahādīn śamayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
gajāhvāpippalīmūlavyoṣāmalakasarṣapān||8||

div.ab: Sa. hastipippalyādīni(n) godhādipittapiṣṭāni(n) nasyābhyaṅgasekeṣu grahāpahān kuryāt| mūlaṃ-puṣkaramūlam| jhaṣo jalacarabhedaḥ|

siddhārthakavacāhiṅgupriyaṅgurajanīdvayam|
mañjiṣṭhā śvetakaṭabhī varā śvetā'drikarṇikā||10||
nimbasya patraṃ bījaṃ tu naktamālaśirīṣayoḥ|
surāhvaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ sarpir gomūtre taiś caturguṇe||11||
siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma pāne nasye ca yojitam|
grahān sarvān nihanty āśu viśeṣād āsurān grahān||12||
kṛtyālakṣmīviṣonmādajvarāpasmārapāpma ca| -----------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. sarṣapādi gomūtre caturguṇe sarpiḥ siddhaṃ siddhārthakasaṃjñaṃ pāne nasye ca yojitaṃ sarvān grahān drāk nāśayati| viśeṣeṇāsuragrahān kṛtyādīṃś ca| śvetakaṭabhī-śvetaguñjā| śvetā'drikarṇikā-śuklā girikarṇikā|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
ebhir evauṣadhair bastavāriṇā kalpito 'gadaḥ||13||

lg.l: guṇaiḥ pūrvavad uddiṣṭo rājadvāre ca siddhikṛt||14||

div.ab: Sa. ebhir eva dravyaiś chāgamūtreṇa kalpito 'gadaḥ pānādiṣu yojito guṇaiḥ pūrveṇa tulya ukto rājadvāre ca siddhikaraḥ syāt|

lg.l: bījaṃ karañjāt, kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt||15||
samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca|
bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt||16||

div.ab: Sa. siddhārthakādi bastamūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ gavyena pittena guḍān-guḍakān, kuryāt| te ca-guḍakāḥ, añjananasyalepair duṣṭavraṇādīn sādhayanti| upajātivṛtte indravajrā ca|
Sa. kārpāsāsthyādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ dhūpanaṃ skandādighnaṃ paraṃ syāt| nirmālyaṃ-mahādevasambandhi| vṛṣadaṃśaviṭ-mārjāraviṣṭhā| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam|

ab.seg: trikaṭukadalakuṅkumagranthikakṣārasiṃhī- niśādārusiddhārthayugmāmbuśakrāhvayaiḥ sitalaśunaphalatrayośīratiktāvacā- tutthayaṣṭībalālohitailāśilāpadmakaiḥ| dadhitagaramadhūkasārapriyāhvāviṣākhyā- viṣātārkṣyaśailaiḥ sacavyāmayaiḥ kalkitair ghṛtam anavam aśeṣamūtrāṃśasiddhaṃ mataṃ bhūtarāvāhvayaṃ pānatas tad grahaghnaṃ param||19||

div.ab: Sa. trikaṭukādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ purāṇaṃ sarpir aśeṣamūtrāṇāṃ- gomūtrādīnāṃ, aṃśaiḥ bhāgaiḥ, siddhaṃ bhūtarāvasaṃjñaṃ matam| tat pāne(nataḥ) paraṃ grahaghnaṃ syāt| dalaṃ-tamālapatram| siddhārthayugmaṃ-pītakṛṣṇabhedena| tutthaṃ-karpārikātuttham| śakrāhvayāḥ-indrayavāḥ| sitalaśunaṃ-śuklarasonam| priyāhvā-kaṅguṇikā| viṣākhyā-ativiṣā| viṣā-kākolī| "prathamaka iha daṇḍakaś caṇḍavṛṣṭiprayāto nadvayānāpyanāpyaraiḥ saptabhiḥ| pratipadam iha vṛddhirephavṛddhyā syur arṇārṇavavyālabīmūtalīlākaroddāmaśaṅkhādayaḥ||

ab.seg:
natamadhukarañjalākṣāpaṭolīsamaṅgāvacā- pāṭalīhiṅgusiddhārthasiṃhīniśāyuglatārohiṇī- badarakaṭuphalatrikākāṇḍadārukṛmighnājagandhā- marāṅkollakośātakīśigrunimbāmbudendrāhvayaiḥ| gadaśukatarupuṣpabījograyaṣṭyadrikarṇīnikumbhā- gnibilvaiḥ samaiḥ kalkitair mūtravargeṇa siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vidhivinihitam
āśu sarvaiḥ kramair yojitaṃ hanti sarvagrahonmādakuṣṭhajvarāṃs tan mahābhūtarāvaṃ smṛtam||20||

div.ab: Sa. natādibhir mūtravargeṇa-gomūtrādimūtrakadambakena, sarpiḥ pakvaṃ vidhivinihitaṃ sarvaiḥ kramaiḥ-abhyaṅgapānanasyādibhiḥ, yojitaṃ śīghraṃ sarvān grahādīn hanti| etac ca mahābhūtarāvasaṃjñaṃ ghṛtam| daṇḍako vyālākhyaḥ|

lg.l: grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ teṣu viśeṣataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. yeṣu dineṣu grahā gṛhṇanti teṣu dineṣu teṣāṃ grahāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa balihomādīn bhiṣak prayuñjīta|

lg.l: rocate yad yadā yebhyas tat teṣām āharet tadā||22||

div.ab: Sa. snānavastrādi yad yebhyo grahebhyo rocate tat tebhyas tasmin dine dadyāt|

lg.l: bhakṣyāś ca sarve sarveṣāṃ sāmānyo vidhir ity ayam||23||

div.ab: Sa. tathā ratnādīni tathā bījāni-yavādīni, madhusarpiṣī sarve ca bhakṣyāḥ sarveṣāṃ grahāṇām| ity ayaṃ sāmānyo vidhiḥ|

surarṣiguruvṛddhebhyaḥ siddhebhyaś ca surālaye|
diśyuttarasyāṃ tatrāpi devāyopahared balim||24||
paścimāyāṃ yathākālaṃ daityabhūtāya catvare|
gandharvāya gavāṃ mārge savastrābharaṇaṃ balim||25||
pitṛnāgagrahe nadyāṃ nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇe|
yakṣāya yakṣāyatane saritor vā samāgame||26||
catuṣpathe rākṣasāya bhīmeṣu gahaneṣu ca|
rakṣasāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu pūrvasyāṃ brahmarakṣasām||27||
śūnyālaye piśācāya paścimāṃ diśam āsthite| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. surādibhyaḥ pañcabhyaḥ surālaye baliṃ dadyāt| tatrāpi devāyottarasyāṃ balim upaharet| daityabhūtāya paścimāyāṃ diśi catvare balim upaharet| gavāṃ pathi vastrābharaṇasahitaṃ baliṃ gandharvāyopaharet| pitṛnāgagrahebhyo nadyāṃ baliṃ dadyāt| nāgebhyaḥ pūrvadakṣiṇadeśe baliṃ dadyāt| yakṣāya yakṣaprāsāde athavā saritoḥ-nadyoḥ, samāgame balim upaharet| rākṣasaśabdeneha brahmarākṣaso gṛhyate| rākṣasāya catuṣpathe bhayānakeṣu vaneṣu ca baliṃ dadyāt| dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu diśi rākṣasānāṃ baliṃ dadyāt| pūrvasyāṃ diśi brahmarakṣasām| śūnyālaye paścimāṃ diśam āsthite piśācāya baliṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śuciśuklāni mālyāni gandhāḥ kṣaireyam odanam||28||

lg.l: dadhi chatraṃ ca dhavalaṃ devānāṃ balir iṣyate|

div.ab: Sa. śuciśuklamālyādikaṃ ca devānāṃ balir iṣyate| hiṃgvādibhir ardhapalikaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ caturguṇe gomūtre vipācayet| tatpānādibhir devagrahavimokṣaṇaṃ syāt|
nasyāñjanaṃ vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ bastavāriṇā| -----------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. vacāhiṅgulaśunaṃ chāgamūtreṇa nasyam añjanaṃ ca dadyāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
daitye balir bahuphalaḥ sośīrakamalotpalaḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. daityagrahe balir bahūni phalāni yasmin, tathośīrakamalotpalair yukto deyaḥ|

nāgānāṃ sumanolājaguḍāpūpaguḍaudanaiḥ|
paramānnamadhukṣīrakṛṣṇamṛnnāgakesaraiḥ||32||
vacāpadmapurośīraraktotpaladalair baliḥ|
śvetapatraṃ ca rodhraṃ ca tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ||33||
śītena vāriṇā piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjanayor hitam| -----------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. nāgānāṃ sumanolājādibhir balir deyaḥ| śvetapatrādayaḥ śītalajalapiṣṭā nasye 'ñjane ca hitāḥ| śvetapatraṃ śukla puṇḍarīkam|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīradadhyājyamiśrakaudanaguggulu||34||

div.ab: Sa. yakṣāṇāṃ kṣīrādibhir balir yojyaḥ|
Sa. gomūtrakṣīraghṛtaṃ tulyapramāṇam ekasmin pakvaṃ nasyābhyañjanayor hitam|

---------------------------------------------------|
haritakī haridre dve laśuno maricaṃ vacā||36||
nimbapatram ca bastāmbukalkitaṃ nāvanāñjanam| ---------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. harītakyādi chāgamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ nāvanāñjane hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
brahmarakṣobaliḥ siddhaṃ yavānāṃ pūrṇam āḍhakam||37||
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam| ---------------------------------------------------||38||

div.ab: Sa. pakvaṃ yavānām āḍhakaṃ-pātraṃ, pūrṇaṃ jalakumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ pralepanam iti brahmarākṣasāya baliṃ dadyāt| yavānāṃ pūrṇaṃ siddham āḍhakaṃ-pakvapātraṃ, yavaiḥ pūrṇaṃ pakvapātram ity arthaḥ| pūraṇārthe 'tra ṣaṣṭhī| āḍhakaśabdo 'tra pātravācako na tu mānavācakaḥ| pakvapātraṃ-pakvaśarāvam iti

---------------------------------------------------|
naktamālaśirīṣatvaṅmūlapuṣpaphalāni ca||41||
tadvac ca kṛṣṇapāṭalyā bilvamūlaṃ kaṭutrikam|
hiṃgvindrayavasiddhārthalaśunāmalakīphalam||42||
nāvanāñjanayor yojyo bastamūtrayuto 'gadaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. naktamālādikaṃ bastamūtreṇa yutam agado nasyābhyañjanayor yojyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------|
ebhir eva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ mūtre caturguṇe||43||
rakṣograhān vārayate pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. ebhir eva dravyair ghṛtaṃ gomūtre caturguṇe siddhaṃ pānādibhī rakṣograhanivāraṇaṃ syāt|

---------------------------------------------------|
piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi||44||
mūlakaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarpiḥ sabhūtaudanayāvakam| ---------------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. piśācānāṃ sīdhvādibhir balir deyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------|
haridrādvayamañjiṣṭhāmiśisaindhavanāgaram||45||
hiṅgupriyaṅgutrikaṭurasonatriphalā vacā|
pāṭalīśvetakaṭabhīśirīṣakusumair ghṛtam||46||
gomūtrapādikaṃ siddhaṃ pānābhyañjanayor hitam| ---------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. haridrādvayādibhir gomūtrapādikaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ pānābhyañjanayor hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
bastāmbupiṣṭais tair eva yojyam añjananāvanam||47||

div.ab: Sa. bastāmbupiṣṭair etair eva dravyair nasyam añjanaṃ ca hitam uktam|
Sa. devarṣipitṛgandharve tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi na yojayet| mṛdu sarpiṣpānādikam auṣadham atra yojyam|

lg.l: ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret|
savaidyam āturaṃ ghnanti kruddhās te hi mahaujasaḥ||49||

div.ab: Sa. sarveṣu ca graheṣu piśācam antareṇa pratikūlaṃ nācaret| te hi devādayo mahaujasaḥ pratikūlācaraṇāt kruddhāḥ santaḥ vaidyasahitam āturaṃ ghnanti|

īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nātham āryāvalokitam|
sarvavyādhicikitsāṃ ca japan sarvagrahān jayet||50||
tathonmādān apasmārān anyaṃ vā cittaviplavam| ---------------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. īśvaraṃ dvādaśabhujaṃ nātham āryāvalokitaṃ tathā sarvavyādhicikitsitam ity ādi japan sarvān grahān unmādādīṃś ca parākaroti|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ śuciṃ taṃ śrāvayet sadā||51||

div.ab: Sa. māyurīṃ mahāvidyāṃ taṃ-grahagṛhītaṃ, śuciṃ santaṃ satataṃ śrāvayet|

lg.l: bhūteśaṃ pūjayet sthāṇuṃ pramathākhyāṃś ca tadgaṇān|
japan siddhāṃś ca tanmantrān grahān sarvān apohati||52||

div.ab: Sa. tathā sthāṇuṃ bhūtādhipaṃ pūjayet| tathā tasya gaṇān pramathasaṃjñān pūjayet grahān parākaroti| | siddhāṃś ca tanmantrān japan sarvān

lg.l: yac coktam iha tat sarvaṃ prayuñjīta parasparam||53||

ab.seg: iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhūtapratiṣedho nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.ab:
Sa. yad apynantarayor adhyāyayoḥ-unmādāpasmārapratiṣedhākhyayoḥ, vakṣyati-bhaṇiṣyati, tac cātra hitam| yac ca,[iha-]asminn adhyāye, devagrahādīnāṃ pṛthak cikitsitaṃ kathitaṃ tad api parasparaṃ grahāṇāṃ prayuñjīteti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhūta- pratiṣedho nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 5|| ā raṃ-dravadravyavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyātu pratijānīte-atheti| yataḥ pūrvais tribhir adhyāyair vihāra uktaḥ| āhāro vaktvyaḥ| sa ca dvividhaḥ,-dravo 'dravaś ca| tatra dravo 'sminn adhyāye| ata evāyaṃ dravadravyavijñānīyaḥ| tatra ca pañca vargāḥ| vakṣyati hi (hṛ. sū.a. 5183)- "toyakṣīrekṣutailānaṃ vargair madyasya ca kramāt" iti| ā raṃ-tatrādou toyavargaḥ| tat toyaṃ dvedhā,- divyaṃ bhaumaṃ ca| divyaṃ caturdhā,- dhāraṃ kāraṃ touṣāraṃ haimaṃ ca| dhāraṃ dvedhā,-gāṅgaṃ sāmudraṃ ca| tatra gāṅgaguṇān āha-jīvanam iti| jīvanaṃ prāṇadhāraṇam| tarpaṇaṃ-tṛptijananam| hṛdyaṃ-hṛdayasya priyam, tatprasādakaratvāt| hlādi-sukhajanakam| buddhiprabodhanaṃ-prajñāvikāśajanakam| tanu-sarvebhyo 'pi viralam| acyaktarasaṃ-rasavad apy anabhivyaktamadhurādirasaviśeṣam| mṛṣṭam-jihvendriyapriyam| śītaṃ-sparśavīryābhyām| laghu-śīghrapākam| amṛtopamaṃ-devānām amṛtam ivedaṃ manuṣyāṇām| gaṅgāmbu-ākāśagaṅgātoyaṃ meghair ānītam| nabhaso bhRaṣṭaṃ-ākāśāt patitam, divyam ity arthaḥ| gaṅgāmbv ati sāmudrasya vyāvṛttyartham| nabhaso bhraṣṭam iti bhaumasya| divyasya bhaumād viśeṣam āha-spṛṣṭam iti| divyam eva bhūsambandhād bhaumam ucyate-spṛṣṭam iti| devyam eva bhūsambandhād bhaumam ucyate| tac cārkādibhiḥ spṛśyate| spṛṣṭaṃ ca vyaktarasatvādidoṣasambandhād dhitāhitatve bhūyo deśakālāv apekṣate| bhūyograhaṇaṃ divyasyāpi kiñcid deśakālāpekṣatvaṃ dyotayati| deśāpekṣā yathā-supātrasthaṃ hitam, ahitaṃ duṣpātrastham| vakṣyati hi-"endram ambu supātrastham avipannaṃ sadā pibet|" iti| kālāpekṣā yathā-ārtavaṃ hitam, anārtavam ahitam| vakṣyati hi-"anārtavaṃ ca yad divyam ārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat " iti| bhaumaṃ tu bhūyas tato 'py adhikam apekṣate| tatra deśāpekṣā yathā-jāṅgale hitam, ahitam anūpe| tatrāpi śucyādou hitam, ahitam aśucyādou| tatrāpi kūpādou hitam, ahitaṃ ṣalvalādou| tatrāpi supātre hitam, ahitaṃ duṣpātre| tatrāpi kvacid dehe hitam, ahitaṃ kvacit ity ādi| kālāpekṣā yathā śaraddhīṣmayor hitam, ahitam anyadā| tatrāpi divā hitam, ahitaṃ rātrou| tatrāpi bhuktasya madhye hitam, ahitam antādyoḥ, ity ādi| divyaṃ sarvadā sarvatra sarveṣāṃ hitam| ā raṃ-gāṅgaṃ lakṣayati-yenābhivṛṣṭam iti| abhivṛṣṭaṃ dhārāsampātena siktam| rājate-roupyapātre| aklinnaṇ-sikthaprakledarahitam| avivarṇaṃ-varṇāntararahitam| parīkṣā ca muhūrtamātram| uktaṃ hi suśrute (sū. a. 4517)- "sa yadi muhūrtamātraṃ sthitas tādṛśa eva bhavati, tadā tadā patatīty avagantavyam" iti| peyaṃ-pānārham| ā raṃ-sāmudraṃ lakṣayati-anyathā sāmudram iti| anyathā-kledavaivarṇyotpattau| sāmudrapānaṃ niṣedhayati-tan neti| tat sāmudram, māsād āśvayujād vinā, gṛhītam iti śeṣaḥ| uktaṃ hi suśrute (sū. a. 45/7)-"sāmudram apy āśvayuje māsi gṛhītaṃ gaṅgāvad bhavati" iti| ā raṃ-divyapānaṃ vidhatte-endram iti| endraṃ-divyam| supātrasthaṃ-śuddhasauvarṇādipātrastham| uktaṃ hi saṅgrahe (sū. a.
6)-"khātadhautaśilāpṛṣṭhavastrādibhyaḥ srutaṃ jalam|
haimamṛnmayayātrastham avipannaṃ sadā pibet||" iti| avipannaṃ-sparśarasādivikṛtirahitam| sadā-sarveṣu ṛtuṣu| bhaumapānaṃ vidhatte-tadabhāva iti| tadabhāve-divyābhāve| bhūmiṣṭhaṃ-bhaumam| āntarikṣānukāri-divyasadṛśaguṇam| śucyādau deśe sthitam| śuciḥ-nirmalaḥ| pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇaḥ| asitaḥ-kṛṣṇaḥ| śveto-dhavalaḥ| asitaḥ-kṛṣṇaḥ| śveto-dhavalaḥ|

div.head: unmādapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athāta unmādapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. bhūtapratiṣedhād anantaram unmādāpasmārapratiṣedha ucyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt| tatrāpy apasmārād unmādasya pūrvam upanyāso bahuvaktavyatvād ity āha- unmādasya pratiṣedha-cikitsitaṃ, bhaṇiṣyāmaḥ|
unmādāḥ ṣaṭ pṛthagdoṣanicayādhiviṣodbhavāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. pratyekaṃ doṣais trayaḥ sānnipātika ādhijo viṣajaś ceti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
unmādo nāma manaso doṣair unmārgagair madaḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. unmādo doṣaiḥ-vātapittakaphaiḥ, unmārgagaiḥ-apathaprasthitaiḥ, manaso yo madaḥ sa unmādo nāma roga ucyate|

ab.seg:
adhunā vistareṇotpattikramam unmādānām āha ----
śārīramānasair duṣṭair ahitād annapānataḥ|
vikṛtāsātmyasamalād viṣamād upayogataḥ||2||

lg.l: ebhir hi hīnasattvasya hṛdi doṣāḥ pradūṣitāḥ||4||
dhiyo vidhāya kāluṣyaṃ hatva mārgān manovahān|

div.ab: Sa. śārīramānasair doṣair duṣṭair yāvad upaviṣeṇa ceti| ebhiḥ-amībhir hetubhiḥ, doṣā hṛdaye pradūṣitāḥ santo hīnasattvasya puṃso buddheḥ kāluṣyaṃ kṛtvā tathā cittavahāni srotāṃsi hatvonmādaṃ kurvate| tena-unmādena, deho buddhibhramān naṣṭasukhaduḥkho bhraṣṭasārathiriva ratho bhramati| acintitaḥ-anirūpitakriyaḥ, ārambhaḥ-udyamo, yasya sa evam|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇam unmādasyoktvā pavanādijasya viśiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇam āha ---- ----------------------------------------------| ----------------------tatra vātāt kṛśāṅgatā||6||
asthāne rodanākrośahasitasmitanartanam|
gītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepāsphoṭanāni ca||7||
asāmnā veṇuvīṇādiśabdānukaraṇaṃ muhuḥ|
āsyāt phenāgamo 'jasram aṭanaṃ bahubhāṣitā||8||
alaṅkāro 'nalaṅkārair ayānair gamanodyamaḥ|
