gṛddhir abhyavahāryeṣu tallābhe cāvamānatā||9||
utpiṇḍitāruṇākṣitvaṃ jīrṇe cānne gadodbhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. vātād unmāde sati kṛśāṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ ca jīrṇe cānne gadodbhava ity antam| asthāne-aprasaṅge, rodanādīni| asāmnā auddhatyena, punaḥ punaḥ veṇuvīṇādivādyasyānukaraṇam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
pittāt santarjanaṃ krodho muṣṭiloṣṭādyabhidravaḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. pittād unmāde sati santarjanakrodhādayaḥ syuḥ| asatyānāṃ jvalanādīnāṃ darśanam|

lg.l: unmādo balavān rātrau bhuktamātre ca jāyate||13||

div.ab: Sa. kaphād unmāde saty arocakādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā rātrau balavān sadyo bhukte ca syāt|

lg.l: unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ vidyāt taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. āyatanāni-nimittāni, saṃsthānāni-liṅgāni, sarvāṇi tridoṣaviṣayāṇy āyatanāni saṃsthānāni ca yasmin sannipāte| tadātmakaṃ-tridoṣottham, unmādaṃ dāruṇaṃ-māraṇātmakaṃ, vidyāt| taṃ-unmādaṃ, nopakramet|

ab.seg:
atha cittajam unmādaṃ vakti ----
dhanakāntādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavān|
pāṇḍur dīno muhur muhyan hāheti paridevate||15||

lg.l: rodity akasmān mriyate tadguṇān bahu manyate|

div.ab: Sa. dhanādināśena duḥsahenābhiṣaṅgavān unmādaḥ syāt| tena pāṇḍvādikaḥ sann idam idaṃ karoti| tathā śokakhinnacetāḥ san dhyāyan jāgaraṇaśīlo viceṣṭate|
Sa. viṣeṇonmāde śyāvavadanaḥ syāt| taṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

lg.l: pūrvam āvṛtamārge tu sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanam||18||

div.ab: Sa. athedṛśy unmādalakṣaṇe 'vagate sati pavanajo ya unmādas tasmin snehapānaṃ pūrvaṃ kārayet| āvṛtavartmani tv anile sasnehaṃ mṛdu śodhanaṃ pūrvaṃ snehapānāt kārayet|

kaphapittabhave 'py ādau vamanaṃ savirecanam|
sasnigdhasvinnasya bastiṃ ca śirasaḥ savirecanam||19||
tathā'sya śuddhadehasya prasādaṃ labhate manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. kaphabhave pittabhave conmāde snigdhasvinnasya narasya yathāsaṅkhyaṃ vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca kārayet| apiśabdān na kevalaṃ pavanaje snehapānam ādau, yāvat kaphapittotthe 'pi kāryam iti gamayati| tathā ca muniḥ(?)-"unmādaṃ snehapānena pūrvaṃ sarvam upācaret|" iti| bastiṃ śirasaḥ savirecanaṃ triṣv apy unmādeṣu kārayet| tathā ca-evaṃ, śuddhaśarīrasya sato manaḥ prasīdati|

----------------------------------------------|
ittham apy anuvṛttau tu tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanam añjanam||20||
harṣaṇāśvāsanottrāsabhayatāḍanatarjanam|
abhyaṅgodvartanālepadhūpān pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ||21||
yuñjyāt tāni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. evam apy upakrānta unmāde 'syānubandhe sati tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanāñjanaṃ yuñjyāt, harṣaṇādi ca| kutaḥ ? yasmād etāni kṛtāni śuddhadehasya cittaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāpayanti|

----------------------------------------------|
hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣair dvipalāṃśair ghṛtāḍhakam||22||
siddhaṃ samūtram unmādabhūtāpasmāranut param| ----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. hiṅgvādibhir dvipalikair ghṛtasyāḍhakaṃ gomūtreṇa saha pacet| tac copayuktaṃ paramam unmādādijit|

----------------------------------------------|
dvau prasthau svarasād brāhayā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam||23||
vyoṣaśyāmātrivṛddantīśaṅkhapuṣpīnṛpadrumaiḥ|
sasaptalākṛmiharaiḥ kalkitair akṣasammitaiḥ||24||
palavṛddhyā prayuñjīta paraṃ mātrā catuṣpalam|
unmādakuṣṭhāpasmāraharaṃ vandhyāsutapradam||25||
vāksvarasmṛtimedhākṛd dhanyaṃ brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam| ----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. brāhmīsvarasāt prasthadvayaṃ ghṛtasya prasthaṃ vyoṣādibhiḥ kārṣikai rajīkṛtaiḥ pakvaṃ palavṛddhyā-palaṃ prathame 'hni dvipalaṃ dvitīye 'hni tripalaṃ tṛtīye 'hni catuṣpalaṃ caturthe 'hne tataḥ paraṃ catuṣpalam ity evaṃ, prayuñjīta| tac conmādādijid vandhyāsutapradaṃ vāgādikṛc chivaṃ ca brāhmīghṛtaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
varāviśālābhadrailādevadārvelavālukaiḥ||26||

lg.l: pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mohe mehe gare jvare||29||
kalyāṇakam idaṃ sarpiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ puṃsavaneṣu ca||31||

div.ab: Sa. varādibhiḥ karṣapramāṇair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| tac copayuktaṃ bhūtagrahādiṣu śreṣṭhaṃ balyādiguṇaṃ ca| kalyāṇakākhyam etat sarpiḥ puṃsavaneṣu ca varam| atra ca bhadrailā-sthūlailā|

ebhyo dvisārivādīni jale paktvaikaviṃśatim|
rase tasmin pacet sarpir gṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇam||32||
vīrādvimedākākolīkapikacchūviṣāṇibhiḥ|
śūrpaparṇīyutair etan mahākalyāṇakaṃ param||33||
bṛṃhaṇaṃ sannipātaghnaṃ pūrvasmād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|34|

Sa. ebhyo-varādibhyo, madhyād ādyāni sapta hitvā, dvisārivādīny ekaviṃśatiṃ jale ṣoḍaśaguṇe snehāpekṣayā paced yāvat snehāc caturguṇaḥ kvāthaḥ| tasmin snehacaturguṇe rase sarpir gṛṣṭikṣīracaturguṇaṃ vīrādibhiḥ snehakvathitaiḥ pādikaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet| etan mahākalyāṇakaṃ nāma ghṛtaṃ pūrvasmāt-kalyāṇakāt, guṇair atiriktam| atra dvisārivādināṃ pāṭhād evaikaviṃśatitvaṃ cet atadguṇasaṃvijñāno 'yaṃ bahuvrīhir iti kasyacid bhrāntiḥ syāt| evaṃ ca sārivādidvayasya grahaṇaṃ na prāpnuyād ity ekaviṃśatigrahaṇam

----------------------------------------------|
jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī markaṭī vacā||34||
trāyamāṇā jayā vīrā corakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī|
vayaḥsthā śūkarī chatrā sāticchatrā palaṅkaṣā||35||
mahāpuruṣadantā ca kāyasthā nākulīdvayam|
kaṭambharā vṛścikālī śāliparṇī ca tair ghṛtam||36||
siddhaṃ cāturthikonmādagrahāpasmāranāśanam|
mahāpaiśācakaṃ nāma ghṛtam etad yathā'mṛtam||37||
buddhimedhāsmṛtikaraṃ bālānaṃ cāṅgavardhanam| ----------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. jaṭilādibhir ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| jaṭilā māṃsī| pūtanā-harītakī| keśī-gandhamāṃsī| caraṭī-padmacāriṇī| markaṭī-kapikacchūḥ| jayā-araṇikā| vīrā-kākolī| corakaḥ-caṇḍā| vayaḥsthā-dhātrī| śūkarī-vṛddhadārukaḥ| chatrā-dhānyakam| aticchatrā-śatapuṣpā| palaṅkaṣā-lākṣā| mahāpuruṣadantā-śatāvarī| kāyasthā-kṣīrakākolī| nākulīdvayaṃ-sarpākṣī sarpasugandhā ca| mahāpaiśācakasaṃjñaṃ cāturthikādināśanam| tathā'mṛtatulyaṃ mahāguṇatvāt| buddhyādikaṃ śiśūnāṃ ca saṃvardhayati|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
brāhmīm aindrīṃ viḍaṅgāni vyoṣaṃ hiṅgu jaṭāṃ murām||38||

lg.l: rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasāṃ vacām|

div.ab: Sa. brāhmyādibhir gajamūtrapiṣṭā vartiś chāyāyāṃ viśoṣitā nasyādibhir unmādahṛt| viṣaghnā-ativiṣā| viśalyā-lāṅgalī| nāgavinnā-nāgadantī| kāṅkṣī-saurāṣṭrikā|

avapīḍāś ca vividhāḥ sarṣāpāḥ snehasaṃyutāḥ|
kaṭutailena cābhyaṅgo dhmāpayec cāsya tad rajaḥ||41||
sahiṅgus tīkṣṇadhūmaś ca sūtrasthānodito hitaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. sa-"kalkādyair avapīḍas tu" (hṛ.sū.a. 20/7) iti kathito 'vapīḍaḥ| te 'vapīḍāḥ sarṣapatailayutā hitāḥ| abhyaṅgaś ca sarṣapatailena| tathā'sya tad rajaḥ-sarṣapacūrṇaṃ, ghrāṇe dhmāpayet| tathā sūtrasthānoktas tīkṣṇo dhūmo (a. 21/17) hiṅgunā saha hitaḥ|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
śṛgālaśalyakolūkajalaukāvṛṣabastajaiḥ||42||

div.ab: Sa. śṛgālādimūtrādibhir dhūpādikam ācaret| atra jalaukā carmacaṭikā|
Sa. enaṃ-conmādinaṃ, punaḥ punaś ca gomatsyādibhiḥ suṣṭhu pūtiṃgandhibhir dhūpayet| vātaśleṣmātmake bāhulyenaiṣa upakramaḥ|

lg.l: tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ snehaś ca miśrakaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. paittike tūnmāde tiktakaṃ sarpir jīvanīyaṃ ca śasyate| tathā miśrako-yamakaḥ snehaḥ, praśasyate| tathā śiśirāṇi madhurāṇy annapānāni laghūni ca śasyante|

lg.l: vidhyec chirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā|

div.ab: Sa. tathā śirāvyadhavidhyuktāṃ śirāṃ vidhyet| meduramāṃsasya tṛptaṃ nivāte svāpayec ca| evaṃ kṛte sati mativibhramāt mucyate|

lg.l: āśvāsayet suhṛt taṃ vā vākyair dharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ||47||
bṛyād iṣṭavināśaṃ vā darśayed adbhutāni vā|
kaśābhis tāḍayitvā vā baddhaṃ śvabhre viniḥkṣipet||49||
sarpeṇoddhṛtadaṃṣṭreṇa dāntaiḥ siṃhair gajaiś ca tam||50||
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ||52||

div.ab: Sa. athavā jalavarjite kūpe prakṣipya kṣudhā śoṣayet| athavā taṃ-unmādavantaṃ, suhṛt dharmārthayutair vākyair āśvāsayet-sāntvayet| athavā'sya putrāder vināśaṃ-vighātaṃ, taṃ brūyāt| adbhutāni vā taṃ darśayet| athavā kaṭutailenābhyaktaṃ badhvā tam uttānaṃ kṛtvā''tape nyaset| kapikacchvā, athavā taptairlohādibhiḥ| athavā carmakaśābhir ahatya baddhaṃ santam avaṭe viniḥkṣipet| śastrādivarjite tv agāre('ndhakāre) bhavane vā badhvā vinikṣipet| nanu ca, ekasya śūnyagṛhe sthitir unmādasya nidānam uktam| yac ca yasya nidānaṃ tad eva tasya kathaṃ cikitsitaṃ syāt ? naiṣa doṣaḥ| tadarthakāribheṣajatvāt| tadarthakāriṇi hi bheṣaje yad eva nidānaṃ tad evauṣadham| yathā,-tucchadagdhe 'gnipratapanam, madātyaye madyapānam iti| tadvad ihāpy avagantavyam| athavā samutpāṭitadaṃṣṭreṇa sarpeṇa bhāpayet, dāntair gajādibhir vā| rājapuruṣā bahir nītvā taṃ suṣṭu yantritaṃ kṛtvā rājājñayā tarjayanto vadhena bhāpayeyuḥ| yato dehaduḥkhabhayebhyaḥ sakāśāt paraṃ-atiśayena, prāṇabhayaṃ matam| tena-bhayena, itaś cetaś cittaṃ viplutam unmādinaḥ śamam eti|
siddhā kriyā prayojyeyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā| ----------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. iyaṃ kriyā deśādyapekṣayā siddhā prayojanīyā

----------------------------------------------|
iṣṭadravyavināśāt tu mano yasyopahanyate||53||
tasya tatsadṛśaprāptisāntvāśvāsaiḥ śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. iṣṭadravyavināśād yasya mānasam upahanyate tasya tatsadṛśā-tulyā, prāptiḥ kāryā| tathā sāntvanaiś cāśvāsanaiś ca śamam unmādinaṃ nayet|

----------------------------------------------|
kāmaśokabhayakrodhaharṣerṣyālobhasambhavān||54||
parasparapratidvandvair ebhir eva śamaṃ nayet| ----------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. kāmādijān unmādān anyonyapratikṣair ebhir eva-kāmādibhiḥ, śamaṃ nayet|

----------------------------------------------|
bhūtānubandham īkṣeta proktaliṅgādhikākṛtim||55||
yady unmāde tataḥ kuryād bhūtanirdiṣṭam auṣadham| ----------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. bhūtaiḥ-devādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anubandhaḥ-anuṣaṅgaḥ, tam anantarokta āgantāv unmāde yadīkṣeta tato bhūtapratiṣedhoktam auṣadhaṃ kuryāt| nanu, katham īkṣaṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyate ? iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetum āha-proktaliṅgādhikākṛtim iti| proktāni pūrvaṃ ṣaḍvidhasyonmādasya yāni liṅgāni tebhyo 'dhikā''kṛtiḥ-lakṣaṇaṃ, yasya-bhūtānubandhasya, taṃ tathāvidham|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām||56||

lg.l: catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca||58||

div.ab: Sa. tathā'tra bhūtānubandhe palalayāvakādi ca yāvat puṣpāṇi sahacarasya ceti baliṃ dadyāt| kva ? catuṣpathe, tathā gotīrthe nadyor vā saṅgame|

lg.l: nijāgantubhir unmādaiḥ satvavān na sa yujyate||59||

div.ab: Sa. yaḥ puruṣo nivṛttamadyamāṃso hitabhojī prayataḥ śuciḥ syāt| sa sātviko nijāgantubhir unmādair na yujyate| tasmād īdṛśena bhāvyam iti bhāvaḥ|

prasāda indriyārthānāṃ buddhyātmamanasāṃ tathā|
dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ vigatonmādalakṣaṇam|60| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne unmādapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ|6|

Sa. indriyārthānāṃ prasannatvaṃ tathā buddhyātmamanasāṃ ca, dhātūnāṃ prakṛtisthatvaṃ ceti vigatonmādasya lakṣaṇam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne unmā- dapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 6||

div.head: apasmārapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: athāto 'pasmārapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|
Sa. asmād anantaram apasmārapratiṣedha ucyate, cikitsāsāmānyāt|

smṛtyapāyo hy aposmāraḥ sa dhīsattvābhisaṃplavāt|
jāyate 'bhihate citte cintāśokabhayādibhiḥ||1||
unmādavat prakupitaiś cittadehagatair malaiḥ|
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca||2||
tamo viśan mūḍhamatir bībhatsāḥ kurute kriyāḥ|
dantān khādan vaman phenaṃ hastau pādau ca vikṣipan||3||
paśyann asanti rūpāṇi praskhalan patati kṣitau|
vijihyakṣibhruvo doṣavege 'tīte vibudhyate||4||
kālāntareṇa sa punaś caivam eva viceṣṭate| --------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. smṛter apāyo-vināśaḥ, apasmāra ucyate| sa ca-smṛtivināśo, buddhyādivināśāc citte cintādyabhihate, tathonmādavac cittadehagatair doṣaiḥ prakṛpitaiḥ sattve hate, hṛdaye vyāpte, tathā saṃjñāvāhiṣu srotaḥsu vyāpteṣu satsu, jāyate| tasmiṃś ca jāte sati mūḍhamatiḥ san tamo-mohaṃ, viśan bībhatsāḥ-ninditāḥ, kriyāḥ kurute| na tu tamo dravyaviśeṣa iha gṛhyate, tasya divā'sambhavasyāpi darśanaṃ sambhāvyata eva, rogasvabhāvāt| ata eva vakṣyati,-"paśyann asanti rūpāṇi" iti| tā eva kriyā vakti-dantān ity ādi yāvad vijihvākṣibhruva iti| vijihyam akṣibhruvaṃ yasya sa evam| akṣibhruvaśabdo 'caturādinipātaḥ| doṣavege cātikrānte vibudhyate-prakṛtiṃ yāti| kālāntaraiṇa saḥ-apasmarīm evam eva-pūrvavat, karoti|
Sa. apasmāraś catuḥprakāraḥ| katham ? ity āha-vātādibhiḥ sannipātena ca|

lg.l: pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayor eva ca mehanam||8||

div.ab: Sa. asminn apasmāra udbubhūṣati sati hṛtkampādayaḥ syuḥ| gānādi syāt, tailamadyayoḥ pānaṃ syāt, tathā tayor eva-taila madyayoḥ, mehanaṃ-mūtraṇaṃ, syāt|

tatra vātāt sphuratsakthiḥ prapataṃś ca muhur muhuḥ|
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan||9||
utpiṇḍitākṣaḥ śvasiti phenaṃ vamati kampate|
āvidhyati śiro dantān daśaty ādhmātakandharaḥ||10||
parito vikṣipaty aṅgaṃ viṣamaṃ vinatāṅguliḥ|
rūkṣśyāvāruṇākṣitvaṅnakhāsyaḥ kṛṣṇam īkṣate||11||
capalaṃ paruṣaṃ rūpaṃ virūpaṃ vikṛtānanam| --------------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. tatra-teṣu madhyāt, vātād apasmāre sati sphuratsakathyādikaḥ syāt|

Sa. pittenāpasmāre sati punaḥ punaḥ saṃjñāṃ-cetanāṃ ca labhate| pītaphenākṣimukhatvaṃ syāt| atra ca vaktragrahaṇenaivākṣigrahaṇe siddhe 'kṣigrahaṇam atiśayārtham| tathā''sphālayati medinīm ity ādi ca syāt|

kaphāc cireṇa grahaṇaṃ cireṇaiva vibodhanam|
ceṣṭā'lpā bhūyasī lālā śuklanetranakhāsyatā||14||
śuklābharūpadarśitvaṃ----------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. kaphāc cireṇa kālena grahaṇam| cireṇaiva vimokṣaṇaṃ syāt| śceṣṭā'lpety ādi ca|
Sa. sarvaliṅgam apasmāraṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

--------------------------------------------------------|
athā''vṛtānāṃ dhīcittahṛtkhānāṃ prāk prabodhanam||15|| tīkṣṇaiḥ kuryādiapasmāre karmabhir vamanādibhiḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. atha-evam apasmārasvarūpam avagamya, dhīcittahṛdayasrotasāṃ pūrvaṃ prabodhanaṃ kuryāt| kaiḥ ? vamanādibhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------|
vātikaṃ bastibhūyiṣṭhaiḥ, paittaṃ prāyo virecanaiḥ||16||
ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyair apasmāram upācaret| --------------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. vātikam apasmāraṃ bastiprāyair upācaret| paittaṃ virecanaprāyair upācaret| ślaiṣmikaṃ vamanaprāyair upācaret|

Sa. sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭāc ca viśuddhasya, tathā samyag āśvāsitasya ca-kṛtapeyādyannasaṃsargikasya ca samyagāśvāsanaṃ sampadyate| tasyāpasmāriṇaḥ, apasmāraviśodhanāya vakṣyamāṇān imān yogān ākarṇaya|
Sa. gomayasvarasādibhir ghrutaṃ pakvam apasmārādighnaṃ pibet|

--------------------------------------------------------|
dvipañcamūlatriphalādviniśākuṭajatvacaḥ||19||
saptaparṇam apāmārgaṃ nīlinīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm|
śamyākapuṣkarajaṭāphalgumūladurālabhāḥ||20||
dvipalāḥ saliladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite|
bhārgīpāṭhāḍhakīkumbhanikumbhavyoṣarohiṣaiḥ||21||
mūrvābhūtīkabhūnimbaśreyasīsārivādvayaiḥ|
madayantyagniniculair akṣāṃśaiḥ sarpiṣaḥ pacet||22||
prasthaṃ tadvad dravaiḥ pūrvaiḥ pañcaganyam idaṃ mahat|
jvarāpasmārajaṭharabhagandaraharaṃ param||23||
śophārśaḥkāmalāpāṇḍugulmakāsagrahāpaham| --------------------------------------------------------|24|

Sa. dvipañcamūlādīni pṛthag dvipalapramāṇāni jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣite kvāthe bhārgyādibhiḥ karṣāśaiḥ kalkīkṛtair ghṛtasya prasthaṃ tadvat pūrvaiḥ-gomayasvarasādibhir dravaiḥ, pācayet| mahad idaṃ pañcagavyaṃ paraṃ jvarādiharam, śophādighnaṃ ca| bahudravyayogāc cāsya mahattvam, yathā mahākalyāṇakādeḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------|
brāhmīrasavacākuṣṭhaśaṅkhapuṣpīśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24|| purāṇaṃ medhyam unmādālakṣmyapasmārapāomajit| --------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. brāhmyādibhiḥ purāṇaṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ medhyam unmādādijit|

--------------------------------------------------------|
tailaprasthaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||25||
kṣīradroṇe pacet siddham apasmāravimokṣaṇam| --------------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. tailaprasthaṃ ghrutaprasthaṃ jīvaniyaiḥ rajīkṛtaiḥ palapramāṇaiḥ kṣīradroṇe pacet| tat siddham apasmāravimocanam|

Sa. kṣīrekṣurasayoḥ kaṃse-āḍhake, tathā kāśmaryarase 'ṣṭaguṇe-aṣṭaprasthaparimāṇe, ghṛtād asyāṣṭaguṇatvam| jīvaniyaiḥ kārṣikair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tat vātapittajam apasmāraṃ śīghram eva nihanti| nanu, dvandvajasyāpasmārasyāsambhavāt katham uktaṃ vātapittodbhavaṃ hantīti? ucyate| vātapittotthayor dvayor apy apasmārayor hantīty etad ihokta mity adoṣaḥ|
Sa. tadvat-pūrvavat, kāśādikvāthe śṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ syāt|
Sa. kūṣmāṇḍasvarase 'ṣṭādaśaguṇe madhuyaṣṭikākalkaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ pakvam apasmārajit budhdyādipradaṃ ca|
Sa. kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ nasye suṣṭru hitam, na kṛṣṇānām gavām, acintyatvāt prabhāvasya| śvādīnām api pittaṃ hitam|
Sa. godhādīnāṃ ca pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca śasyate|

lg.l: bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vā dhmāpayed bhiṣak||32||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādibhiḥ kalkitaiś chāgamūtre caturguṇe sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyam unmādāpasmāriṇor hitam| cūrṇaṃ triphalāder vā vaidyo nāsāyā madhye dhmāpayet|

lg.l: tuṇḍaiḥ pakṣaiḥ purīṣaiś ca dhūpam asya prayojayet||33||

div.ab: Sa. nakulādīnāṃ yathāsambhavaṃ tuṇḍādibhir apasmāriṇo dhūmaṃ (paṃ) yojayet|
Sa. tathā tailalaśunaṃ śīlayet| kṣīreṇa vā śatāvarīm adyāt| brāhmīrasaṃ vā kuṣṭharasaṃ madhunā samabhyaset, vacāṃ vā|

Sa. yat-yasmāt, apasmāro yugāpat prakopitaiḥ śārīramānasair doṣair jāyate, yataś caiṣa mahāmarmāśrayaḥ, tata enaṃ-apasmāraṃ, duścikitsyaṃ rasāyanair upācaret| apasmārārtaṃ cāgnijalāder viṣamāt sada pālayet|

muktaṃ mano vikāreṇa tvam itthaṃ kṛtavān iti|
na brūyād viṣayair iṣṭaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ ceto 'sya bṛṃhayet|37| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne 'pasmārapratiṣedho nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ|7|

Sa. manovikāreṇa ca muktaṃ santaṃ tvam itthaṃ kṛtavān iti na brūyāt| asya ca manaḥ kliṣṭam iṣṭair viṣayair upabṛṃhayed iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne 'pasmāra- pratiṣedho nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 7|| ity aṣṭāṅgahṛdaye bhūtatantraṃ tṛtīyaṃ samāptam

div.head: vartmarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: prādhānyāt pūrvam upanyāsa ity āha ---- athāto vartmarogavijñānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )|3|

Sa. apasmārād anantaraṃ śālākyam upakramyate| yathaiva hṛdayākhyamahāmarmāśritair apasmāro janyate tathaiva murdhākhyamahāmarmāśritair ūrdhvajatrūtthā rogā janyante| teṣām api ca madhye cakṣūrogāṇāṃ vartmani rogā vartmarogāḥ,-kṛcchronmīlādayaḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānaṃ-bodhaḥ, sa vidyate yasminn iti chaḥ, tasya pūrvaval luk|

sarvaroganidānoktair ahitaiḥ kupitā malāḥ|
acakṣuṣyair viśeṣeṇa prāyaḥ pittānusāriṇaḥ||1||
śirābhir ūrdhvaṃ prasṛtā netrāvayavam āśritāḥ|
vartma sandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvam akṣi vā||2|| rogān kuryuḥ--------------------------------------------| --------------------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. sarvaroganidāne uktāni-abhihitāni yathāyogaṃ tiktoṣaṇādīni, tair āhāravihāraiḥ prakupita malā rogān kuryuḥ| viśeṣād acakṣuṣyair āhāravihāraiḥ kupitā malāḥ prāyo-bāhulyena, pittānusāriṇas tathā śirādibhiḥ karaṇabhūtābhir ūrdhvaṃ jatruṇaḥ prasṛtās tathā netrasya sambandhinam avayavaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ vartmādikaṃ, āśritāḥ| vartmety ādi| vāśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ yujyate, vartma vā sandhiṃ vā sitaṃ vā'sitaṃ vā dṛṣṭiṃ vā sakalaṃ locanam āśritāḥ| iti sāmānyena nayanarogāṇāṃ samprāptiḥ|

ab.seg:
----------calas tatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ|
suptotthitasya kurute vartmastambhaṃ savedanam||3||

lg.l: vimardanāt syāc ca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tat||4||

div.ab: Sa. tatra-teṣu vartmādyāśriteṣu madhye, vartmāśrayāḥ sirā vāyuḥ prāpya suptotthitasya narasya vartmastambhaṃ kurute, rujayā saha| tathā paṃśupūrṇābhanayanatvaṃ kṛcchreṇonmīlanam aśru ca kurute| vimardanāt-malanāc ca, śamaḥ syāt| taṃ-īdṛksvarūpaṃ, kṛcchronmīlākhyaṃ netrerogaṃ vadanti|
Sa. vāyur vatmanī cālayan nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ punaḥ punaḥ karoti| asau nimeṣākhyo rogo jñeyaḥ|
Sa. yat punar vartma vimuktasandhi tathā niśceṣṭaṃ hīnam ca nimīlyate taṃ vātahatākhyaṃ rogaṃ vadanti, 'munayaḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇāḥ pittena bahvyo 'ntarvartma kumbhīkabījavat||6||
ādhmāyante punarbhinnāḥ piṭikāḥ kumbhisaṃjñitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. pittena kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ piṭikā bahvyo vartmanor madhye kumbhīkabījatulyās tathā bhinnāḥ satyaḥ punar adhmāyante, tāḥ kumbhīsaṃjñāḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------|
sadāhakledanistodaṃ raktābhaṃ sparśanākṣamam||7||
pittena jāyate vartma pittotkliṣṭam uśanti tat| ---------------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. pittena sadāhakledanistodaṃ tathā raktākāraṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ vartma jāyate, tat pittotkliṣṭam uśanti-kathayanti|

---------------------------------------------------------|
karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca pittaṃ pakṣmāntam āsthitam||8||
pakṣmaṇāṃ śātanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. pittaṃ pakṣmāntam āsthitaṃ kaṇḍūm dāhaṃ ca karoti| anu paścāt, pakṣmāṇāṃ śātaṃ karoti| taṃ pakṣmaśātaṃ varṇayanti|

---------------------------------------------------------|
pothakyaḥ piṭikāḥ śvetāḥ sarṣapabhā ghanāḥ kaphāt||9||
śophopadeharukkaṇḍūpicchilāśrusamanvitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. kaphāt piṭikāḥ sitāḥ sarṣapopamā ghanāḥ-nibiḍāḥ, śophādiyutāḥ pothakīsaṃjñāḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------------|
kaphotkliṣṭaṃ bhaved vartma stambhakledopadehavat||10||

div.ab: Sa. stambhādiyutaṃ vartma yad bhavet tat kaphotkliṣṭaṃ nāma|

lg.l: kolamātraḥ sa lagaṇaḥ kiñcid alpas tato 'tha vā||11||

div.ab: Sa. kaphāt yo granthiḥ kolamātraḥ, athavā tataḥ-tasmāt kolāt kiñcid alpaḥ, pāṇḍuḥ pīḍāpākarahitaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhinaś ca syāt, sa lagaṇākhyaḥ|
raktā raktena piṭikā tattulyapiṭikācitā| utsaṅgākhyā------------------------------|12|
Sa. raktena raktevarṇā piṭikā tattulyapiṭikair ācitā utsaṅgākhyā|
Sa. tathā-utsaṅgavat, utkliṣṭākhyaṃ vartma| tac ca na piṭikārupam, kiṃ tarhi ? rājiyutaṃ sparśanākṣamaṃ ca syāt|

lg.l: raktaṃ raktena tat srāvi chinnaṃ chinnaṃ ca vardhate||13||

div.ab: Sa. adhikamāṃsaṃ ca vartmābhyantarasthitam arśo nāma raktena syāt| raktaṃ varṇataḥ, tathā stabdhatādiguṇaṃ syāt| tathā tat srāvi tad raktaṃ sravaty abhīkṣṇam| tat punaḥ punas chinnam api vardhate|

lg.l: madhye vā vartmano 'nte vā kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā|

div.ab: Sa. asṛjā tāmrā piṭikā mudgapramāṇā vartmano madhye 'nte vā kaṇḍvādimatī sthirā cāñjananāmikā syāt|

lg.l: doṣair vartma bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad antaḥ sūkṣmakhācitam|

div.ab: Sa. doṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, bahiḥ śūnaṃ yad vartma sūkṣmaiḥ khaiḥ chidraiḥ, antar ācitaṃ sasrāvaṃ ca tad bisavartma, udakāntaḥsthitasacchidrabisatulyatvāt|

lg.l: yad vartmotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭam akasmān mlānatām iyāt|

div.ab: Sa. yad vartma raktotkleśād doṣatrayotkleśāc ca utkliṣṭaṃ-utkleśitaṃ sat, akasmāt-hetuṃ vinaiva, mlānim iyāt-śuṣkatvaṃ yāyāt, tad utkliṣṭavartma syāt|
śyāvavartma malaiḥ sāsraiḥ śyāvaṃ rukkledaśophavat| ---------------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. raktasahitais trimalair yad vartma śyāvaṃ rujā kledena śophena ca yuktaṃ bhavati, tac chyāvavartma|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------------|
śliṣṭākhyaṃ vartmanī śliṣṭe kaṇḍūśvayathurāgiṇī||17||

div.ab: Sa. śliṣṭe-ekatra saṃlagne, vartmanī kaṇḍvādiyute śliṣṭavartma nāma|
vartmano 'ntaḥ kharā rūkṣāḥ piṭikāḥ sikatopamāḥ| sikatāvartma-----------------------------------|18|
Sa. vartmano madhye vālikātulyāḥ piṭikāḥ kharasparśās tathā rūkṣāḥ, tat sikatāṃvartma|
Sa. kardamasadṛśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vartma kardamākhyam|
bahalaṃ bahalair māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiś cīyate samaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. bahalaiḥ-ghanaiḥ, māṃsaiḥ savarṇaiḥ samaiḥ-na viṣamaiḥ, cīyate tad bahalaṃ nāma|
Sa. kukūṇakaḥ śiśor eva-na mahato, jayate| yato 'sau dantotpattihetuko bhavati| tena-kukūṇakena, bāla ucchūnatāmranayano vīkṣaṇākṣamas tathā vartmaśūlādimān karṇādimardanaś ca syāt|

lg.l: kharatā'ntarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām anyāni vā punaḥ||21||
kaṇṭakair iva tīkṣṇāgrair ghṛṣṭaṃ tair akṣi śūyate|

div.ab: Sa. pakṣmoparodhe vartmanāṃ saṅkoco bhavati| tathā kharatvam antarmukhatvaṃ ca romṇām, anyāni va romāṇi jāyante| taiś ca kharāntarmukhaiḥ, apūrvair vā rogasvabhāvāt tīkṣṇāgraiḥ kaṇṭakair iva ghṛṣṭam akṣi śūyate| uṣyate ca-sāntardāhas tīvroṣmā syād ity arthaḥ| tathā pavanādidviṭ, ādiśabdenānalātapau gṛhyete| stokāny ahāny uddhṛtaiḥ-utpāṭitais tais taiḥ, śāntir bhavati|

lg.l: kanīnake bahir vartma kaṭhino granthir unnataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. kanīnake vartmanor bāhyataḥ kaṭhina unnato granthir alajīty ucyate| kimbhūto granthiḥ ? tāmraḥ pakvaś cāsrasrāvī pūyasrāvī ca| tathā muhur muhuḥ srutaḥ sann ādhmāyate|

lg.l: srāsraiḥ syād arbudo doṣair viṣamo bāhyataś calaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. vartmano 'ntare māṃsapiṇḍākṛtiḥ śvayathuḥ saraktais tribhir doṣair arbudaḥ syāt| kimbhūtaḥ śvayathuḥ ? grathito nīrujaḥ| sa ca bāhyataś calo viṣamaś ca syāt|
caturviṃśatir ity ete vyādhayo vartmasaṃśrayāḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa, caturviṃśatisaṅhkhyā vartmāśrayā rogāḥ syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------|
ādyo 'tra bheṣajaiḥ sādhyo dvau tato 'rśaś ca varjayet||25||
pakṣmoparodho yāpyaḥ syāc cheṣāñ chastreṇa sādhayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. [ atra-] eṣu madhyāt, ādyaḥ-kṛcchronmīlanākhyo, bheṣajaiḥ sādhyaḥ| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, dbau-nimeṣavātahatau arśaś ca varjayet| pakṣmoparodho yāpanīyaḥ| śeṣān-ekonaviṃśatiṃ, śastreṇopacaret|

---------------------------------------------------------|
kuṭṭayet pakṣmasadanaṃ chindyāt teṣv api cārbudam|26|
bhindyāl lagaṇakumbhīkābisotsaṅgāñjanālajīḥ|
pothakīśyāvasikatāśliṣṭotkliṣṭacatuṣṭayam|27|
sakardamaṃ sabahalaṃ vilikhet sakukūṇakam| 27 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhagupasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogavijñānīyo nāma aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ|8|

Sa. teṣv api-śastrasādhyeṣu madhye, pakṣmasadanaṃ kuṭṭayet sūcīkūrcena| arbudaṃ ca chindyād vṛddhipatrādinā| lagaṇādīni vrīhimukhādinā bhindyāt| pothakyādayaḥ kukūṇakāntā ekādaśa vilekhyāḥ| utkliṣṭacatuṣṭayaṃ-pittotkliṣṭaṃ kaphotkliṣṭaṃ raktotkliṣṭam utkliṣṭavartma ceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartmaroga- vijñānīyo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 8||

div.head: vartmarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: vartmarogavijñānād anantaraṃ vartmarogapratiṣedha ārabhyata ity āha ---- athāto vartmarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. kṛcchronmīle vartmaroge purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ drākṣākalkāmbupakvaṃ samaśarkaraṃ yojayet| snigdhaṃ ca nasyādikam|

ab.seg:
kumbhīkāvartmopakramam āha ----
kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ saindhavapratisāritam|
yaṣṭīdhātrīpaṭolīnāṃ kvāthena pariṣecayet||2||

div.ab: Sa. kumbhīkāvartma likhitaṃ vṛddhipatrādinā saindhavalavaṇena pratisāritaṃ sat madhuyaṣṭikādikvāthena pariṣecayet|

kathaṃ vartma lekhanīyam ? ity āha ----
nivāte 'dhiṣṭhitasyāptaiḥ śuddhasyottānaśāyinaḥ|
bahiḥ koṣṇāmbutaptena sveditaṃ vartma vāsasā||3||
nirbhujya vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulīdhṛtam|
na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatas tataḥ||4||
maṇḍalāgreṇa tat tiryak kṛtvā śastrapadāṅkitam|
likhet tenaiva patrair vā śākaśophālikādijaiḥ||5||
phenena toyarāśer vā picunā pramṛjann asṛk|
sthite rakte sulikhitaṃ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||6||
yathāsvam uktair anu ca prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā|
ghṛtena siktam abhyaktaṃ badhnīyān madhusarpiṣā||7||
ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayor dattvā piṇḍīṃ ca yavasaktubhiḥ|
dvitīye 'hani muktasya pariṣekaṃ yathāyatham||8||
kuryāc caturthe nasyādīn muñced evāhni pañcame| ---------------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. nivāte sthāne āptair adhiṣṭhitasya-kṛtāśrayasya, tathā śuddhasya-vamanavirecanādinā, uttānaṃ nityaṃ śete tasya vartma vāsasā koṣṇāmbunā taptena sveditaṃ san nirbhujya-kuṭilīkṛtya, vastrāntaritaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhyāṃ dhṛtam evaṃ na sraṃsate| na vā calati sarvataḥ| anantaraṃ tad vartma tiryaṅ maṇḍalāgreṇa śastrapadāṅkitaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva śastreṇa śākādipatrair vā samudraphenena vā likhet| kiṃ kurvan ? picunā-karpaṭādiyojitena, raktaṃ pramṛjan| rakte sthite-avahati, sulikhitaṃ tad vartma jñātvā sakṣaudrair yathāsvaṃ kathitaiḥ saindhavādibhiḥ pratisārayet| paścāc coṣṇena vāriṇā prakṣālya sarpiṣā siktam anantaram abhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayor yavasaktubhiḥ piṇḍīṃ ca dattvā'vabadhnīyāt| dvitīye divase muktasya vartmano yathāsvaṃ pariṣekaṃ kuryāt| caturthe divase nasyādīn kuryāt| pañcame divase muñced eva-nānyat kiñcit kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------------------|
samaṃ nakhanibhaṃ śophakaṇḍūghārṣādyapīḍitam||9||
vidyāt sulikhitaṃ vartma likhed bhūyo viparyaye| ---------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. samaṃ nakhasadṛśaṃ śophādyapīḍitaṃ sulikhitaṃ vartma jānīyāt| viparyaye-asmāl lakṣaṇād vaiparītye sati, tad vartma punar likhet|
Sa. atilekhanād rujādīni syuḥ| tasmin-atilekhane, snehasvedādiko vātaghno vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------|
abhyajya navanītena śvetarodhraṃ pralepayet||11||
eraṇḍamūlakalkena puṭapāke pacet tataḥ|
svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtam||12||
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam| ---------------------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. śvetarodhraṃ navanītenābhyajya eraṇḍamūlakalkena pralepayet| anantaraṃ puṭapāke pacet| svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ sat yuvatīkṣīreṇa chagalyā vā kṣīreṇa marditaṃ netre secanaṃ hitam|

Sa. atilikhite vartmani navanītenāktaṃ śvetarodhraṃ śālitandulakalkena liptaṃ baddhaṃ pariṣkṛtaṃ-pūrvavat parikalpitaṃ puṭapākīkṛtaṃ svinnaṃ prakṣālitaṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ poṭalīkṛtaṃ cety arthaḥ, tat dadhimastunā mṛditaṃ sekaṃ kuryāt| dadhigrahaṇaṃ takramastvādinivṛttyai| athavā kevalena-kalkarodhrarahitena, mastunā jāṅgalamāṃsāśino narasya sekaṃ kuryāt| apiḥ svedanādisamudāyavikalpārthaḥ|

lg.l: niṣpīḍayed anu vidhiḥ pariśeṣas tu pūrvavat||15||

div.ab: Sa. kaṭhinonnatāḥ piṭikāḥ vrīhivakreṇa bhittvā'nu niṣpīḍayet| pariśeṣo vidhiḥ-pralepanakṣālanabandhanasecanādiḥ, pūrvavat kāryaḥ|
Sa. lekhane bhedane ca eṣa eva kramaḥ sarvatra vartmani kāryaḥ|

---------------------------------------------------------|
pittāsrotkliṣṭayoḥ svāduskandhasiddhena sarpiṣā||16||
sirāvimokṣaḥ snigdhasya trivṛcchreṣṭhaṃ virecanam|
likhite srutarakte ca vartmani kṣālanaṃ hitam||17||
yaṣṭīkaṣāyaḥ, sekas tu kṣīraṃ candanasādhitam| ---------------------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. pittotkliṣṭe raktotkliṣṭe ca madhuraskandhaśṛtena ghṛtena snigdhasya puṃsaḥ sirāvimokṣaḥ kāryaḥ| tathā trivṛtātriphale virecanam| likhite vartmani srutalohite ca sati madhuyaṣṭikākvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| kṣīraṃ candanasādhitaṃ tu seko hitaḥ|
Sa. pakṣmaṇāṃ sadane sati romakūpān-romamūlāni, sucyā vikuṭṭayet| jalaukobhir vā grāhayet| kṣīreṇekṣurasena vā vamanaṃ hitam| madhuraśītalaiḥ-drākṣādibhiḥ, pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|

lg.l: tāmre daśāhaṃ paramaṃ pakṣmaśāte tad añjanam||20||

div.ab: Sa. puṣpakāsīsaṃ cūrṇayitvā tāmrapātre daśāhaṃ surasārasaiḥ-samūrvārasaiḥ, bhāvayet| tat-etat, pakṣmaśāte śreṣṭham añjanam

pothakīr likhitāḥ śuṇṭhīsaindhavapratisāritāḥ|
uṣṇāmbukṣālitāḥ siñcet khadirāḍhakiśigrubhiḥ||21||
apsiddhair dviniśāśreṣṭhāmadhukair vā samākṣikaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. pothakīr likhitā vṛddhipatrādibhiḥ, śuṇṭhīsaindhavābhyāṃ pratisāritāḥ, tathoṣṇāmbunā kṣālitāḥ, jalakvathitaiḥ khadirādibhiḥ siñcet| dviniśādibhir vā jalakvathitaiḥ samākṣikaiḥ siñcet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------------|
kaphotkliṣṭe vilikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||22||

div.ab: Sa. kaphotkliṣṭe vartmani śastreṇa vilikhite saindhavādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtair mākṣikasahitaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| tathā vamanādi hitam| sarvaṃ ca yat kaphajit tac ca hitam|
Sa. lagaṇe 'pīdaṃ kāryam| evam apy aśame sati jvalanena dahet|

|svinnāṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhiṣaga(ḍyotsaṅgāṃ cā)_ ñjananāmikām|
śilailāsaindhavanataiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||1|| ---------------------------------------------------------|
kukūṇe khadiraśreṣṭhānimbapatraśṛtaṃ ghṛtam||24||
pītvā dhātrī vamet kṛṣṇāyaṣṭīsarṣapasaindhavaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kukūṇe khadirādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ dhātrī-stanadāyinī, pītvā kṛṣṇādibhir vamet|
Sa. abhayādikvāthenaināṃ-stanadāyinīṃ, virecayet|
Sa. mustādikalkena kucāv ālepayet| sājyaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ stanau dhūpayet|
Sa. śuddhāṃ ca-vamanavirecanādinā, paṭolādikaṃ kvāthaṃ tāṃ pāyayet|

---------------------------------------------------------|
śiśos tu likhitaṃ vartma srutāsṛg vā'mbujanmabhiḥ||27||
dhātryaśmantakajambūtthapatrakvāthena secayet| ---------------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. śiśoḥ punar vartma likhitaṃ jalaukābhir vā srutaraktaṃ dhātryādipatrakvāthena secayet|
Sa. prāyo-bāhulyena, kṣīraghṛtabhojanatvāc chiśūnāṃ kaphajā rogāḥ syuḥ| tasmād vamanam eva pūrvaṃ teṣāṃ sarvavyādhiṣu pūjitam|

tadeha vamanam āha ---- ---------------------------------------------------------|
sindhūtthakṛṣṇāpāmārgabījājyastanyamākṣikam||29||
cūrṇo vacāyāḥ sakṣaudro madanaṃ madhukānvitam|
kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnam annaṃ ca bhajataḥ kramataḥ śiśoḥ||30||
vamanaṃ sarvarogeṣu viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake| ---------------------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. sindhūtthety ādi vamanaṃ dadyāt, vacācūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro vā, madanaphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭīyuktaṃ vā| kṣīraṃ kṣīrānnaṃ tathā'nnaṃ bhajataḥ śiśor yathākramaṃ vamanatrayam etat yojyam| vamanaṃ sarveṣv evāmayeṣu śiśoḥ śreṣṭham| viśeṣeṇa kukūṇake hitam|
Sa. saptalārasena vā siddhaṃ ghṛtam ūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ hitam|

dviniśārodhrayaṣṭyāhvarohiṇīnimbapallavaiḥ|
kukūṇake hitā vartiḥ piṣṭais tāmrarajonvitaiḥ||32||
kṣīrakṣaudraghṛtopetaṃ dagdhaṃ vā lohajaṃ rajaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. kukūṇake dviharidrādibhis tāmracūrṇayuktair jalapiṣṭair vartir hitā| kṣīrādiyuktaṃ dagdhaṃ lohotthaṃ vā cūrṇaṃ hitam| kecit tu samudraphenacūrṇaṃ dagdhaṃ dugdhamākṣikayuktam ity āhuḥ|
Sa. elādibhiḥ kaṭphalayuktaḥ kukūṇapothakyoḥ surāpiṣṭair vatir hitā|

lg.l: utsṛjya dvau bhruvo 'dhastād bhāgau bhāgaṃ ca pakṣmataḥ|
badhvā lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ ca tatra sīvanasūtrakam|
gairikeṇa vraṇaṃ yuñjyāt tīkṣṇaṃ nasyāñjanādi ca||39||

div.ab: Sa. pakṣmarodhe romasu prakarṣeṇa vṛddheṣu śuddhaśarīrasya narasya bhravo 'dhastād vou bhāgāv utsṛjya-vihāya, pakṣmato bhāgaṃ hitvā yavamātraṃ-yavasaṃsthānaṃ, tiryak chittvā klinnavastreṇa raktam apanayet| rakte cālpībhavati sati vakrayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ sīvyet| tato lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ badhvā tatra ca paṭṭe sīvanasūtrakaṃ nātigāḍhaślathaṃ sūcyā vinikṣipet| anantaraṃ mākṣīkaghṛtakavalikāṃ yojayet| na cātra bandhaṃ kuryāt| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ nyagrodhādi kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrayutaiḥ secayet| pañchame divase sūtram apanīya vraṇaṃ gairikeṇāvacūrṇayet| tīkṣṇaṃ ca nasyādi yuñjyāt|

dahed aśāntau nirbhujya vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīm|
saṃdaṃśonādhikaṃ pakṣma hṛtvā tasyāśrayaṃ dahet|40|
sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena, dāho bāhyālajeḥ punaḥ|
bhinnasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ succhinnasyārbudasya ca|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne vartmarogapratiṣedho nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ|9|

Sa. evam apy aśāntau vartmadoṣāśrayāṃ valīṃ nirbhujya dahet| adhikaṃ pakṣma saṃdaṃśena hṛtvā tasya pakṣmaṇa āśrayaṃ dahet| kena ? sūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena| bāhyālajes tu bhinnasya dāhaḥ kāryaḥ| alajīśabdaḥ puṃsy api dṛṣṭaḥ| arbudasya kṣāravahnibhyāṃ suṣṭu cchinnasya dāhaḥ kārya iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarakhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vartma- rogapratiṣedho nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 9||

div.head: sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: yathoddeśas tathā nirdeśa iti tān eva tāvat sandhirogan āha ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||

div.ab: Sa. vartmarogapratiṣedhād anantaraṃ sthānānupūrvyā sandhisitāsitarogavijñānam ārabhyate- saṃ-sandhī ca sitāsitau ca sandhisitāsitāḥ, teṣu rogāḥ, teṣāṃ vijñānam| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ|
aśru srāvayate vartmaśuklasandheḥ kanīnakāt||1||
tena netraṃ sarugrāgaśophaṃ syāt sa jalāsravaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. pavanaḥ kupito jalavāhinīḥ sirāḥ prāpya jalākṛti aśru srāvayate| kutaḥ ? vartmaśuklasandhe kanīnakāt| tena-jalābhasrāveṇa, nayanaṃ saruk sarāgaṃ saśophaṃ ca syāt| sa ca jalāsravākhyo rogaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet||2||

div.ab: Sa. kaphāt kaphāsrave sati śvetaṃ picchilaṃ bahalaṃ ca sravet|

kaphena śophas tīkṣṇāgraḥ kṣārabudbudakopamaḥ|
pṛthumūlabalaḥ snigdhaḥ savarṇo mṛdupicchilaḥ||3||
mahān apākaḥ kaṇḍūmān upanāhaḥ sa nīrujaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. śleṣmaṇā śophas tīkṣṇāgrādiguṇaḥ| sa upanāhākhyo nīrujaḥ syāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
raktād raktāsrave tāmraṃ bahūṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet||4||

div.ab: Sa. raktena raktāsravo bhavati| tasmiṃś ca tāmravarṇam uṣṇaṃ cāśru saṃsravet|

lg.l: tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī||5||

div.ab: Sa. vartmasandhir āśrayo yasyāḥ sā vartmasandhyāśrayā, śukle piṭikā śūladāhavatī tāmravarṇā mudgasadṝśī parvaṇī bhaṇyate| sā ca bhinnā satī raktaṃ sravati| eṣā ca raktasamutthaiva vedyā, raktāsravād anantaram asyāḥ pāṭhāt raktasrāvitvāc ca|
Sa. pūyāsravākhye doṣā raktasahitā vartmasandheḥ kanīnakāt punaḥ punaḥ pūyaṃ sāsraṃ tvaṅmāṃsapākād dhetoḥ srāvayanti|
Sa. pūyālaso vraṇa ucyate| kīdṛk ? sūkṣmaḥ tathā śophasaṃrambhapūrvakaḥ| kvāsau syāt ? kanīnasandhau| tathā''dhmāyī ānāhavān, pūyāsrāvī saruk ca syāt|
kanīnasyāntar alajī śopho ruktodadāhavān| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. kanīnasyāntaḥ śopho ruktodadāhavān alajīty ucyate|

-----------------------------------------------|
apāṅge vā kanīne vā kaṇḍūṣāpakṣmapoṭavān||8||
pūyāsrāvī kṛmigranthir granthiḥ kṛmiyuto 'rtimān| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. apāṅge kanīne vā kaṇḍvādimāṃs tathā pūyāsrāvī granthir eva kṛmiyukto 'rtimān kṛmigranthir ucyate|

-----------------------------------------------|
upanāhakṛmigranthipūyālasakaparvaṇīḥ||9||
śastreṇa sādhayet pañca sālajīn āsravāṃs tyajet| -----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. upanāhādīṃś cturaḥ śastreṇa sādhayet| āsravān-jalāsravādīṃś caturaḥ, alajīṃ ceti pañca tyajet|

ab.seg:
evaṃ sandhigatān nava rogān ākhyāya sitabhāgasthān rogān āha ---- -----------------------------------------------|
pittaṃ kuryāt site bindūn asitaśyāvapītakān||10||

div.ab: Sa. site netradeśe pittaṃ kartṛ bindūn kṛṣṇaśyāvapītān kuryāt| malalepadigdhadarpaṇasamānaṃ vā sarvam śuklam| evam ubhayaprakāro 'py ayaṃ sadāharuk śuktikasaṃjño rogaḥ, śakṛdbhedena tṛṣā jvareṇa ca yuktaḥ|
kaphāc chukle samaṃ śvetaṃ ciravṛddhy adhimāṃsakam| śuklārma-----------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphāc chuklabhāge samaṃ-na tu viṣamam, tathā śvetavarṇam adhimāṃsakaṃ ciravṛddhi, tat śuklārma|
Sa. śophas tu nīrujaḥ samānavarṇo bahalādis tathā jalabindusamo balāsagrathitaṃ smṛtam|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
bindubhiḥ piṣṭadhavalair utsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ vadet||13||

div.ab: Sa. bindubhiḥ piṣṭavat sitair utsannaiḥ piṣṭakaṃ nāmārma vadet

lg.l: aśophāśrūpadehaṃ ca sirotpā taḥ sa śoṇitāt||14||

div.ab: Sa. raktarājītataṃ śuklaṃ-śuklabhāgaṃ, uṣyate| yatsavedanaṃ śophāśrūpaleparahitaṃ sa śoṇitāt sirotpātaḥ|

lg.l: upekṣitaḥ sirotpāto rājīs tā eva vardhayan|

div.ab: Sa. sirotpāto 'cikitsitas tā eva-raktā eva, rājīr vardhayan sirāharṣaṃ sāsraṃ kuryāt| tena-sirāharṣeṇa, locanaṃ vīkṣaṇākṣamaṃ syāt|
sirājāle sirājālaṃ būhadraktaṃ ghanonnatam| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. sirājāle bṛhat tathā raktaṃ ghanam unnataṃ ca yad bhavati, tat sirājālaṃ nāma|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śoṇitārma samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ padmābham adhimāṃsakam||16||

div.ab: Sa. samaṃ-na tu viṣamaṃ, tathā ślakṣṇaṃ yad adhimāṃsakaṃ tac choṇitārma|
nīruk ślakṣṇo 'rjunaṃ binduḥ śaśalohitalohitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. nīrujaḥ ślakṣṇo binduḥ śaśalohitatāmro 'rjunaṃ nāma|
Sa. māṃsaṃ prastāritaṃ tathā mṛdu tathā āśuvṛddhi tathā nīruk śyāvalohitaṃ prastāryarmety ucyate| tac ca tribhir doṣaiḥ saśoṇitaiḥ syāt|
Sa. snāvasadṛśaṃ tu snāvārmety ucyate|
Sa. śuṣkaraktapiṇḍavac chyāvaṃ yan māṃsaṃ tathā bahalaṃ pṛthu ca syāt, tad adhimāṃsārma bhaṇyate|

ab.seg:
----------------------dāhagharṣavatyaḥ sirāvṛtāḥ|
kṛṣṇāsannāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapopamāḥ||19||

div.ab: Sa. piṭikā dāhādimatyas tathā sirācitāḥ kṛṣṇabhāgāsannāḥ sarṣapasaṃsthānāḥ sirāsaṃjñāḥ|

sitabhāgotthānām eṣāṃ trayodaśānāṃ sādhanaṃ sūtrayati ----
śuktiharṣasirotpātapiṣṭakagrathitārjunam|
sādhayaid auṣadhaiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ śeṣaṃ śastreṇa saptakam||20||
navotthaṃ tad api dravyaiḥ-----------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. śuktyādīn ṣaḍ auṣadhaiḥ sādhayet| śeṣān sapta śastreṇa sādhayet| navotthitān etān api bheṣajair upakramet na kevalaṃ pūrvoktaṃ ṣaṭkam ity arthaḥ|

---------------------armoktaṃ yac ca pañcadhā|
tac chedyam asitaprāptaṃ māṃsasnavasirāvṛtam||21||
carmoddālavad ucchrāyi dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ ca varjayet| -----------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. yac ca pañcaprakāram armoktaṃ-śuklārma śoṇitārma prastāryarma snāvārmādhimāṃsārma, etac chedanārham| yat kṛṣṇabhāgaprāptaṃ māṃsasnāvasirāvṛtaṃ carmoddālavad ucchrāyi tad varjayet-na cikitset| yac ca dṛṣṭiprāptaṃ tad api varjayet|

atha kṛṣṇarogān āha ---- -----------------------------------------------|
pittaṃ kṛṣṇe 'thava dṛṣṭau śukraṃ todāśrurāgavat||22||
chitvā tvacaṃ janayati tena syāt kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam|
pakvajambūnibhaṃ kiñcin nimnaṃ ca kṣataśukrakam||23||
tat kṛcchrasādhyaṃ, yāpyaṃ tu dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāt|
tatra todādibāhulyaṃ sūcīviddhābhakṛṣṇatā||24||
tṛtīyapaṭalacchedād asādhyaṃ nicitaṃ vraṇaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|25|

Sa. pittaṃ kartṛ kṛṣṇabhāge dṛṣṭau vā śukraṃ janayati| kimbhūtam ? todāśrurāgayuktam| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tvacaṃ-prathamaṃ paṭalaṃ chittvā, tena kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ pakvajambūsadṛśaṃ nimraṃ ca kṣataśukrakaṃ syāt| tac ca kṛcchrasādhyam| dvitīyapaṭalavyadhāt tu yāpyaṃ syāt| tatra-dvītīyapaṭalavyadhe, todādīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ tathā sūcīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatvaṃ ca| todādibhūyastvena sevanīviddhopamakṛṣṇamaṇḍalatayā ca dvitīyapaṭalavyadho 'numīyata ity arthaḥ| tṛtīyapaṭalacchedāt vraṇair nicitam asādhyaṃ kṣataśukrakam| evaṃ kṣataśukrakaṃ tridhā'bhidhāya śuddhaśukram ācaṣṭe|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śaṅkhaśuklaṃ kaphāt sādhyaṃ nātiruk śuddhaśukrakam||25||

div.ab: Sa. śaṅkhavac chuklaṃ śuddhaśukrakam| tac ca kaphāj jāyate| na cātivedanam|

Sa. ātāmraṃ-īṣattāmravarṇaṃ, picchilaṃ cāsraṃ sravati yā'sau ātāmrapicchilāsrasrut| tathā ātāmrapiṭikā tathā'tipīḍāvatī tathā'jāviṭsadṛśe ucchrāyakārṣṇye yasyāḥ saivam| ajakākhyā raktena syāt| sā ca varjyā'sādhyatvāt|

sirāśukraṃ malaiḥ sāsrais tajjuṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam|
satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ sirābhir avatanyate||27||
animittoṣṇaśītācchaghanāsrasruc ca tat tyajet| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. saraktair malaiḥ sirāśukraṃ syāt| tena sirāśukreṇa juṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ sirābhir avatanyate| kimbhūtābhiḥ ? satodadāhatāmrābhiḥ| animittaṃ-akasmāt, asmin kadācid uṣṇam acchaṃ ghanaṃ vā'sraṃ sravati| tac ca tyajed asādhyatvāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
doṣaiḥ sāsraiḥ sakṛt kṛṣṇaṃ nīyate śuklarūpatām||28||
dhavalābhropaliptābhaṃ niṣpāvardhadalākṛti|
atitīvrarujārāgadāhaśvayathupīḍitam||29||
pākātyayena tac chukraṃ varjayet tīvravedanam| -----------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. doṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ sakṛt-ekahelayaiva, kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ śuklarūpatāṃ nīyate| kimbhūtam ? dhavalābhropaliptābham| tathā niṣpāvārdhadalasyevākṛtir yasya tad evam| tathā tīvravedanārāgadāhaśvayathubhiḥ pīḍitam| tac ca śukraṃ pākātyayena tīvrarujaṃ varjayet-nopakramet|

-----------------------------------------------|
yasya vā liṅganāśo 'ntaḥ śyāvaṃ yad vā salohitam|30|
atyutsedhāvagāḍhaṃ vā sāśru nāḍīvraṇāvṛtam|
purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye vicchinnaṃ yac ca śukrakam|31|
pañcety uktā gadāḥ kṛṣṇe sādhyāsādhyavibhāgataḥ| 31 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitāsitarogavijñhānīyo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ|10|

Sa. yasya ca śukrasya liṅganāśaḥ-antardṛṣṭivināśa ity arthaḥ, yac ca śyāvam antaḥ, yac ca kiñcil lohitam, tathā'tyunnatam avagāḍhaṃ vā, sāśrunāḍīvraṇāvṛtaṃ vā, tathā purāṇaṃ-vatsarātītam tathā viṣamasaṃsthānam, tathā madhye vicchinnaṃ yac ca śukrakaṃ, tat sarvaṃ varjayet| kṛṣṇamaṇḍale iti-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, pañca rogāḥ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgenoktāḥ| sukhagrahaṇadhāraṇārthaṃ saṅkhyopādānam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅga- hṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sandhisitāsiratogavijñānīyo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 10||

div.head: sandhisitasitarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmād anantaraṃ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedha ucyate ---- athātaḥ sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyadayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2| )||3||

div.ab: Sa. pratiṣidhyate nirākriyate cikitsyata iti pratiṣedhaḥ,-cikitsā| śeṣaṃ pūrvavat|

ab.seg:
jalāsrāvakaphāsrāvayor asādhyatvād upanāhacikitsām āha ----
upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vrīhimukhena ca|
lekhayen maṇḍalāgreṇa tataś ca pratisārayet||1||

div.ab: Sa. vaidyo maṇḍalāgreṇopanāhaṃ sandhirogaṃ lekhayet| kimbhūtam ? svinnaṃ vartmarogapratiṣedhoktena prakāreṇa poṭalikayoṣṇodakaplutayeti| tathā vrīhimukhena bhinnam| tataḥ pippalyādibhiḥ pratisārayet| [ tataḥ-] anantaraṃ, pūrvavat-prakṣālyoṣṇena vāriṇā ghṛtena siktam abhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā ūrdhvādhaḥ karṇayoś ca yavasaktubhiḥ piṇḍīṃ dattvā, badhnīyād iti| tathā paṭolapatrāmalakakvāthena cāścyotayet|

parvaṇī baḍiśenāttā bāhyasandhitribhāgataḥ|
vṛddhipatreṇa vardhyā'rdhe syād aśrugatir anyathā||3||
cikitsā cārmavat kṣaudrasaindhavapratisāritā| -----------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. parvaṇī bāhyasandhitribhāge baḍiśena gṛhītā satī vṛddhi patreṇa vardhyā-chedanīyā| kutra bhāge vardhyā ? ity āha-ardhe| ato 'nyathā-adhikacchedanāt, aśrugatiḥ syāt| cikitsā ceyam armavat| tatra caivam uktam (ślo.
20)-"samyak chinnaṃ madhuvyoṣasaindhavapratisāritam|
uṣṇena sarpiṣā siktam abhyaktaṃ madhusarpiṣā|| badhnīyāt secayen muktvā tṛtīyādidineṣu ca| karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇa' iti|

-----------------------------------------------|
pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet tatas tam upanāhayet||4||
kurvīta cākṣipākoktaṃ sarvaṃ karma yathāvidhi| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. pūyālase sirāṃ vidhyet| anantaram upanāhayet| akṣipākoktaṃ cāśeṣaṃ karma yathāvidhi kurvīta|

-----------------------------------------------|
saindhavārdrakakāsīsalohatāmraiḥ sucūrṇitaiḥ||5||
cūrṇañjanaṃ prayuñjīta sakṣaudrair vā rasakriyām| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. saindhavādibhiś cūrṇāñjanaṃ prayuñjīta| saindhavādibhir eva mākṣikayutai rasakriyāṃ vā|

-----------------------------------------------|
kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ bhittvā vilikhya ca||6||
triphalākṣaudrakāsīsasaindhavaiḥ pratisārayet| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. kṛmigranthi tripalādibhiḥ pratisārayet| kimbhūtam ? karīṣeṇa-gomayādinā svinnam, tathā vrīhimukhādibhir bhittvā vilikhya ca|
Sa. śuktyākhyaṃ rogaṃ pittābhiṣyandena tulyam upācaret|
Sa. balāsagrathitaṃ piṣṭakaṃ ca sirāvyadhaṃ varjayitvā kaphābhiṣyandavad upācaret| tathā bījapūrakarasenāktaṃ vyoṣakaṭphalam añjanaṃ|
Sa. jātīmukulādibhiḥ prasannayā piṣṭair vartiḥ śophakaṇḍūharam añjanam|
raktasyandavad utpātaharṣajālārjunukriyā| -----------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. sirotpātasirāharṣasirājālārjune kriyā raktasyanda iva kāryā|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikam añjanam||10||

lg.l: madhunā cāñjanaṃ śaṅkhaḥ pheno vā sitayā saha||12||

div.ab:
Sa. sirotpāte viśeṣeṇa ghṛtamākṣikam añjanaṃ hitam|
sirāharṣe mākṣikeṇa ślakṣṇaghṛṣṭaṃ rasāñjanam|
arjune śarkarāmastukṣaudreṇāścyotanaṃ hitam| spāṭikādi mākṣikeṇāñjanam athavā sauvīrāñjanaṃ madhunā hitam| śaṅkho vā samudrapheno vā śarkarayā saha hitaḥ|

lg.l: armoktaṃ pañcadhā tatra tanu dhūmāvilaṃ ca yat|
raktaṃ dadhinibhaṃ yac ca śukravat tasya bheṣajam||13||

div.ab: Sa. arma pañcaprakāram uktam| teṣu madhye yat tanu dhūmavad āvilaṃ ca, tathā raktaṃ-raktavarṇaṃ, dadhisadṛśaṃ ca yat, tasyārmaṇaḥ śukrasadṛśam auṣadham|

ab.seg:
athārmaṇaḥ śastracikitsām āha ----
uttānasyetarat svinnaṃ sasindhūtthena cāñjitam|
rasena bījapūrasya nimīlyākṣi vimardayet||14||

lg.l: dhṛtasya niścalaṃ mūrdhni vartmanoś ca viśeṣataḥ||15||
nātyāyataṃ mucuṇḍyā vā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā tataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. uttānasya puṃso vāmadakṣiṇayor itarat-ekamakṣi, svinnaṃ kṛtasvedaṃ ca, tathā bījapūrarasena saindhavānvitenāñjitaṃ nimīlya sthagayitvā, vimardayet-malayet| anena prakāreṇa saṃroṣitākṣasya sato 'rmādhimāṃse pracale sati mūrdhni niścalaṃ ghṛtasya vartmanoś ca viśeṣeṇa ghṛtasya kanīnakād armaṇi vṛddhe saty apāṅgaṃ paśyato yatra valī syāt tatrārma baḍiśenāvalambitaṃ nātyāyataṃ-nātidīrghaṃ yathā bhavati tathā'valambitam| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, mucuṇḍyā sūcyā sūtreṇa vā mocayet| atha mokṣitaṃ ca viccheditaṃ ca sat kanīnakam upānīya caturbhāgāvaśeṣitaṃ maṇḍalāgrena chindyāt| vyavahitānām api padānām arthayogyatāvaśād eva sambandho 'tra yojyaḥ| kanīnakaṃ rakṣet| kanīnakavyadhād aśru nāḍī cākṣṇi pravartate| apāṅgapradeśāc cārmaṇi vṛddhe tathā kanīnakaṃ vīkṣamāṇasya chindyāt|

Sa. samyak chinnaṃ madhvādibhiḥ pratisāritaṃ ghṛtenoṣṇena siktaṃ mākṣikasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ badhnīyāt| tṛtīyādidineṣu ca muktvā kṣīreṇa karañjabījasiddhena secayet| dviharidrādibhiś ca kvathitaiḥ śītaiś ca madhuyutaiḥ sekaṃ kuryāt| saptame dine muñced eva|

lg.l: samyak chinne bhavet svāsthyaṃ hīnāticchedajān gadān|

div.ab: Sa. samyak chinne 'rmaṇi svāsthyaṃ bhavet| hīnāticchedajān rogān sekāñjanādyair yathāyogaṃ lekhanair bṛṃhaṇaiś ca jayet|

sitāmanaḥśilaileyalavaṇottamanāgaram|
ardhakarṣonmitaṃ tārkṣyaṃ palārdhaṃ ca madhudrutam||24||
añjanaṃ śleṣmatimirapillaśukrārmaśeṣajit| -----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. sitādibhir ardhakarṣonmitai rasāñjanaṃ dvikarṣonmitaṃ madhudrutam añjanaṃ śleṣmatimirādijit

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
triphalaikatamadravyatvacaṃ pānīyakalkitām||25||

lg.l: pṛthak śeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthag eva ca bhāvitā||26||
sā maṣī śoṣitā peṣyā bhūyo dvilavaṇānvitā|
triṇy etāny añjanāny āha lekhanāni paraṃ nimiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. triphalāyā ekatamasya harītakyāder dravyasya tvacaṃ pānīyakalkitāṃ śarāvapihitāṃ kapāle dagdhvā cūrṇayet| tata eva triphalāyāḥ pṛthak śeṣauṣadharasaiḥ pṛthag eva caikaikaṃ bhāvitā sā maṣī śoṣitā punaḥ peṣyā lavaṇadvayayutā| trīṇy etāny añjanāni paraṃ lekhanāni timiraghnāni nimir vakti|

lg.l: sirājāle sirā yās tu kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhaiḥ|
na siddhyanty armavat tāsāṃ piṭikānāṃ ca sādhanam||28||

div.ab: Sa. sirājāle yāḥ sirā kaṭhinā lekhanauṣadhair na sidhyanti tāsām armavat cikitsā, piṭikānāṃ ca|
Sa. śukreṣu doṣavaśāt kadācit rūkṣā kadācit snigdhā triphalā hitā| tathā ghṛtaṃ tiktam ūrdhvam asṛksrāvo rekasekādi ceṣyate|

tris trivṛdvāriṇā pakvaṃ kṣataśukre ghṛtaṃ pibet|
sirāyāν hared raktaṃ jalaukobhiś ca locanāt||30||
siddhenotpalakākolīdrākṣāyaṣṭividāribhiḥ|
sasitenājapayasā secanaṃ salilena vā||31||
rāgāśruvedanāśāntau paraṃ lekhanamañjanam| -----------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. trivṛtkvāthena trīn vārān ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ kṣataśukre pibet| paścāt sirayā raktaṃ haret| nayanād vā jalaukobhir haret| tathā''jadugdhenotpalādibhiḥ siddhena saśarkareṇa secanaṃ hitam| athavotpalādikvathitena jalena secayet| rāgāśruvedanāśāntau satyāṃ lekhanamañjanaṃ hitam|

-----------------------------------------------|
vartayo jātimukulalākṣāgairikacandanaiḥ||32||
prasādayanti pittāsraṃ ghnanti ca kṣataśukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. jātimukulādibhir vartayaḥ pittāsraṃ prasādayanti| kṣataśukraṃ ca ghnanti|

-----------------------------------------------|
dantair dantivarāhoṣṭragavāśvājakharodbhavaiḥ||33||
saśaṅkhamauktikāmbhodhiphenair maricapādikaiḥ|
kṣataśukram api vyāpi dantavartir nivatayet||34||
tamālapatraṃ godantaśaṅkhapheno 'sthi gārdabham|
tāmraṃ ca vartir mūtreṇa sarvaśukrakanāśinī||35||
ratnāni dantāḥ śṛṅgāṇi dhātavas tryūṣaṇaṃ truṭiḥ|
karañjabījaṃ laśuno vraṇasādi ca bheṣajam||36||
savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraghnam añjanam|
nimnam unnamayet snehapānanasyarasāñjanaiḥ||37||
sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tṛptipuṭapākena śukrakam| -----------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. gajādyudbhavair dantaiḥ śaṅkhamuktāphenayutaiś cuturthāṃśakamaricaiḥ kṣataśukrakam api vyāpi dantavartir iyaṃ nivartayet| apiśabdāc chuddhaśukrakam api| tamālapatrādibhir vartir gomūtreṇa sarvaśukrakahṛt| ratnani-mauktikādīni, dantāḥ-gajādīnām, śṛṅgāṇi chāgādīnām, dhātavo-gairikādyāḥ, tryūṣaṇādīni, tathā vraṇasādi bheṣajaṃ-svarṇakṣīryādi, etad añjanaṃ savraṇāvraṇagambhīratvaksthaśukraharam| nimnaṃ śukrakaṃ snehapānādibhir unnamayet| sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ ca tarpaṇapuṭapākenonnamayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
śuddhaśukre niśāyaṣṭīsārivāśābarāmbhasā||38||
secanaṃ rodhrapoṭalyā koṣṇāmbhomagnayā'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. śuddhaśukre haridrādikvāthena secanaṃ hitam| athavā rodhrapoṭālyā koṣṇāmbumagnayā|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
bṛhatīmūlayaṣṭyāhvatāmrasaindhavanāgaraiḥ||39||

div.ab: Sa. bṛhatīcūrṇādibhir āmalakajalena piṣṭais tāmrabhājanaṃ lepitaṃ yavādibhir dhūpayet| anantaraṃ tatra guṭikās toyamākṣikapiṣṭāḥ kuryāt| etāś ca mahānīlā iti prathitāḥ paraṃ śuddhaśukraghnāḥ|
Sa. sthire śukre ghane cāturasyāsya bahuśo raktaṃ mokṣayet| śirovirekādīn puṭapākāṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ kuryāt|
Sa. maricādibhir harṣaṇaṃ kuryāt| triphalākvāthapītena saindhavena vā|

kuryād añjanayogau vā ślokārdhagaditāv imau|
śaṅkhakolāsthikatakadrākṣāmadhukamākṣikaiḥ||44||
surādantārṇavamalaiḥ śirīṣakusumānvitaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. imau ślokārdhauktau yogau gha(ha)rṣaṇāya kuryāt| śaṅkhādibhir mākṣikāntair eko yogaḥ, surādibhiḥ kusumāntair anyaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
dhātrīphaṇijjakarase kṣāro lāṅgalikodbhavaḥ||45||
uṣitaḥ śoṣitataś cūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇam añjanam| -----------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. dhātryādirase kṣāro lāṅgalikaja uṣitaḥ śoṣitaś cūrṇaḥ śukraharṣaṇam añjanam|

-----------------------------------------------|
mudgā vā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭāḥ śaṅkhakṣaudrasamāyutāḥ||46||
sāro madhūkān madhumān majjā vā'kṣāt samākṣikā|
gokharāśvoṣṭradaśanāḥ śaṅkhaḥ phenaḥ samudrajaḥ||47||
vartir arjunatoyena hṛṣṭaśukrakanāśinī| -----------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. śaṅkhamadhuyutā mudgā nistuṣāḥ piṣṭā athavā'ñjanam| madhūkāt sāro madhuyuto 'ñjanam| athavā bibhītakān majjā mākṣikānvitā| saṃ-gavādidantāḥ śaṅkhaḥ samudrapheno vā pārthajalena piṣṭā vartihṛṣṭaśukrahṛt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālādibhir likhet||48||

div.ab: Sa. utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ vālaśākapatrādibhir likhet|
sirāśukre tv adṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukravat| -----------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. sirāśukre punar adṛṣṭighne cikitsā vraṇaśukra iva kāryā|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
puṇḍrayaṣṭyāhvakākolīsiṃhīlohaniśāñjanam||49||

lg.l: dhātrīpatraiś ca paryāyād vartir atrāñjanaṃ param||50||

div.ab: Sa. pāṇḍrādikaṃ chāgadugdhena piṣṭaṃ sasarpiṣkair yavair āmalakapatraiś ca paryāyeṇa dhūpitā vartirne(ra)trāñjanaṃ param|
aśāntāv armavac chastram ajakākhye ca yojayet| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. aśāntau satyām armavad ajakākhye ca śastraṃ prayojayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
ajakāyām asādhyāyāṃ śukre 'nyatra ca tadvidhe||51||

div.ab: Sa. asādhyāyām ajakāyāṃ śukre cānyatra roge tatprakāre 'sādhye vedanopaśamaṃ snehapānādibhir vidadhīta| bībhatsatāṃ-nindyatāṃ, jetuṃ śukrasyotsedhasādhanaṃ kuryāt|

lg.l: sādhyeṣu sādhanāyālam idam eva ca śīlitam||54||

div.ab: Sa. nālikerāsthyādijaṃ bhasma adbhiḥ srāvayet| tābhir adbhiḥ karabhāsthijaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhāvayet| tac cūrṇam añjanam asādhyeṣu śukreṣu vaivarṇyaharam| śīlitaṃ caitad eva śukrāṇāṃ sādhanāyālaṃ-śreṣṭham|

ajakāṃ pāRśvato vidhvā sūcyā visrāvya codakam|
samaṃ prapīḍyāṅguṣṭhena vasārdreṇānu pūrayet|55|
vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca|
saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe kṛṣṇabhāge same sthire|56|
snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā|
tathā'pi punar ādhmāne bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyām|57|
yuktyā kuryād yathā nāticchedena syān nimajjanam| 57 1/2|
nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt|
na hīyate labdhabalā tathā'nta- stīkṣṇāñjanair dṛk satataṃ prayuktaiḥ| 58 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sandhisitāsitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|11|

Sa. ajakāṃ pārśvataḥ sūcyā vidhvā jalaṃ ca niḥsrāvyānantaram aṅguṣṭhena samaṃ vasārdreṇa-vasayā dravīkṛtya, vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena pūrayet| baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya sa saptarātrād vraṇe rūḍhe sati tathā kṛṣṇabhāge same sthite sati snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyam| kṣīraghṛte ca nasyam| evam api kṛte punar ādhmāne sati bhedacchedādikāṃ kriyāṃ yuktyā kuryāt| yathā'ticchedena dṛṣṭer nimajjanaṃ na syāt| śukreṣu ca nityaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathāyogaṃ pakvaṃ pānādau vidadhyāt| kim ? ity āha-tathā ghṛtapānasecanena labdhabalā dṛg antaḥ pratataṃ prayuktais tīkṣṇāñjanair na hīyate-na hāniṃ yāyād iti| upajātir vṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sandhisitā- sitarogapratiṣedho nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 11||

div.head: dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogavijñānam āha| tatrāpi pūrvaṃ timiraṃ lilakṣayiṣur āha- [ male- ] doṣe vātādyanyatame, sirānusāriṇi tathā prathamaṃ-bāhyaṃ, paṭalaṃ śrite saty avyaktaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati| vyaktam api kadācin nimittam antareṇa paśyati| eṣa timirākhyo roga iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ|

lg.l: prāpte dvitīyaṃ paṭalam abhūtam api paśyati|
bhūtaṃ tu yatnād āsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmaṃ ca nekṣate||2||
pārśve paśyen na pārśvasthe timirākhyo 'yam āmayaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. dvitīyaṃ paṭalaṃ prāpte 'bhūtam api paśyati, na kevalaṃ bhūtam| bhūtaṃ tu yatnena paśyati, tac cāsannam eva| dūre na ca sūkṣmaṃ paśyati| dūrāntikasthaṃ ca rūpaṃ vaiparītyena manyate,-dūrasthaṃ nikaṭasthaṃ, nikaṭasthaṃ dūrastham ity arthaḥ| doṣe maṇḍalasaṃsthāne dvitīyapaṭalāśrite eva maṇḍalānīvālokate| dṛṣṭimadhyasthe doṣa ekam eva vastu dviprakāraṃ paśyati| bahudhāsthite doṣa ekam eva vastu bahuprakāraṃ paśyati| dṛṣṭer abhyantarāśrite doṣe hrasvaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca tayor viparyayaḥ| hrasvaṃ ca mahāntaṃ, mahāntaṃ ca hrasvam iti vaiparītyena paśyati| adhaḥsthite doṣe samīpasthaṃ padārthaṃ nekṣate| upariṣṭāt sthite doṣe dūragaṃ na paśyati| pārśvasthe doṣe pārśve rūpaṃ na paśyet| ayaṃ sarva eva timirasaṃjño rogaḥ|

prāpnoti kācatāṃ doṣe tṛtīyapaṭalāśrite|
tenordhvam īkṣate nādhas tanucailāvṛtopamam||6||
yathā varṇaṃ ca rajyeta dṛṣṭir hīyeta ca kramāt| -----------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ sthite doṣe kācatvaṃ prāpnoti| tena kācenordhvam īkṣate na tv adhaḥ| tac ca tanuvastracchannasadṛśam| dṛṣṭiś cātra doṣānusāreṇa rajyate| yathā vātena śyāvety ādi| krameṇa ca dṛṣtir hīyate|

-----------------------------------------------|
tathā'py upekṣamāṇasya caturthaṃ paṭalaṃ gataḥ||7||
liṅganāśaṃ malaḥ kurvan chādayed dṛṣṭimaṇḍalam| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. evam apy upekṣamāṇasyācikitsitasya tṛtīyaṃ paṭalaṃ muktvā caturthapaṭalaṃ gato malo-doṣaḥ, liṅganāśaṃ-dṛṣṭināśaṃ ca, kurvan dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ chādayet|

iti sāmānyalakṣaṇam uktva viśeṣam āha ---- -----------------------------------------------|
tatra vātena timire vyāviddham iva paśyati||8||
calāvilāruṇābhāsaṃ prasannaṃ cekṣate muhuḥ|
jalāni keśān maśakān raśmīṃś copekṣite 'tra ca||9||
kācībhūte dṛgaruṇā paśyaty āsyam anāsikam|
candradīpādyanekatvaṃ vakram ṛjv api manyate||10||
vṛddhaḥ kāco dṛśaṃ kuryād rajodhūmāvṛtām iva|
spaṣṭāruṇābhāṃ vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā hatadarśanām||11|| sa liṅganāśo------------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. tatra-timireṣu madhye, pavanena timire sati vyāviddham iva paśyati| tathā calaṃ dhūmāvilam aruṇābhāsaṃ muhuḥ-punaḥ-prasannaṃ cālokate-prakṛtisthanayanena paśyati, pavanasya calarūpatvāt| tathā jālādīni muhuḥ paśyati| āsyaṃ-mukhaṃ, anāsikaṃ-nāsikārahitaṃ, paśyati| tathā candradīpādīnām anekatvaṃ vakram avakram iva ca manyate| vṛddhaḥ kāco rajodhūmāvṛtām iva ca dṛṣṭiṃ kuryāt| tathā spaṣṭā'ruṇā''bhā yasyās tām| tathā vistīrṇāṃ sūkṣmāṃ vā| tathā hatadarśanām| sa evaṃbhūto liṅganāśaḥ| iti vātajās timirakācaliṅganāśā uktāḥ|

ab.seg:
adhunā vāyusāmānyāṃ gambhīrāṃ
dṛṣṭiṃ vyācaṣṭe ---- -------------------vāte tu saṅkocayati dṛksirāḥ|
dṛgmaṇḍalaṃ viśaty antar gambhīrā dṛg asou smṛtā||12||

div.ab: Sa. vāte tu dṛksirāḥ saṅkocayati sati dṛṣṭimaṇḍalam antaḥ praviśati| sā gambhīrā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā| 'munibhiḥ' iti śeṣaḥ|

lg.l: kāce dṛk kācanīlābhā tādṛg eva ca paśyati|

div.ab: Sa. pittodbhave timire vidyudādidīpitaṃ tathā mayūratittiripatrābhaṃ prāyeṇa nīlaṃ ca paśyati| kāce kācanīlasadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| tādṛg eva-kācanīlābhāsaṃ, paśyati| kāce kācanīla sadṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ śyāt| tādṛg eva kācanīlābhasaṃ paśyati| tathā'rkendu pariveṣādīn paśyati|

lg.l: dṛṣṭiḥ pittena hrasvākhyā sā hṛsva hrasvadarśinī||15||

div.ab: Sa. liṅganāśād dṛṣṭiś ca bhramaranīlā nirālokā snigdhā ca syāt| pittena hrasvasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| sā ca hrasvā-hrasvasaṃsthānā, tathā hrasvadarśinī-alpadarśinī|
bhavet pittavidagdhākhyā pītā pītābhadarśanā| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. pittabidagdhasaṃjñā dṛṣṭiḥ pītavarṇā syāt| tathā pītābhaṃ darśanaṃ yasyāḥ sā pītābadarśanā ca|

-----------------------------------------------|
kaphena timire prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ ca paśyati||16||
śaṅkhedukundakusumaiḥ kumudair iva cācitam|
kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkapradīpādyair ivācitam||17||
sitābhā sā ca dṛṣṭiḥ syāl liṅganāśe tu lakṣyate|
mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdho darśananāśanaḥ||18||
bindur jalasyeva calaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ|
uṣṇe saṅkocam āyāti chāyāyāṃ parisarpati||19||
śaṅkhakundendukumudasphaṭikopamaśuklimā| -----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. kaphena timire sati prāyaḥ snigdhaṃ śuklaṃ cālokate| tathā śaṅkhādibhir ivācitaṃ paśyati| kāce tu niṣprabhendvarkādibhir ivācitaṃ paśyati| dṛk śuklābhā syāt liṅganāśe tu dṛśyate mūrtaḥ kapho dṛṣṭigataḥ snigdhas tathā dṛṣṭivināśanaś ca| jalasyeva binduś calaḥ padminīpuṭasaṃsthitaḥ| ātape cāsou binduḥ saṅkucati| chāyāyāṃ prasarati| tathā śaṅkhādiśuklimā syāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
raktena timire raktaṃ tamobhūtaṃ ca paśyati||20||

lg.l: kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭis tadṛk ca paśyati|

div.ab: Sa. raktena timire sati raktābhaṃ tathā tama iva ca paśyati| kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭiḥ syāt| tādṛgeva-rakta kṛṣṇaṃ vā, paśyati| liṅganāśe ca tādṛśy eva-kācavat, dṛṣṭis tathā niṣprabhā hatadarśanā ca syāt|

saṃsargasannipāteṣu vidyāt saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān|
timirādīn akasmāc ca taiḥ syād vyaktākulekṣaṇaḥ||22||
timire, śeṣayor dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ prajāyate| -----------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. saṃsargasannipāteṣu saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇān-vyāmiśralakṣaṇān, timirakācaliṅganāśān vidyāt| tathā'kasmāt-nimittam antareṇa, taiḥ-saṃsargasannipātaiḥ, vyaktaṃ-spaṣṭaṃ, kadācid ākulam īkṣaṇaṃdarśanaṃ, yasya sa evaṃbhūto naras timire syāt| śeṣayoḥ-kācaliṅganāśayoḥ dṛṣṭau citro rāgaḥ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
dyotyate nakulasyeva yasya dṛṅ nicitā malaiḥ||23||
nakulāndhaḥ sa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. yasyāturasya nakulasyeva dṛṣṭir doṣair nicitā dyotyate-dedīpyate, sa nakulāndhaḥ| tatra-nakulāndhe, divā citraṃ paśyati, na tu niśi-rajānyām|

-----------------------------------------------|
arke 'stamastakanyastagabhastau stambham āgatāḥ||24||
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gado 'paraḥ|
divākarakaraspṛṣṭā bhraṣṭā dṛṣṭipathān malāḥ||25||
vilīnalīnā yacchanti vyaktam atrāhni darśanam| -----------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. arke 'staparvatasya mastake nyastā gabhastayo yena tasmin sati stambhaṃ prāptā doṣā dṛśaṃ chādayanti| sa evaṃbhūto doṣāndho nāma rogaḥ| divā kathaṃ paśyati ? ity atra yuktim āha- saṃ-malā ahni divākararaśmibhiḥ spṛṣṭās tathā dṛṣṭipathād bhraṣṭā vilīnāḥ santaḥ, atra-rātryandhe, spaṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ dadati| divākarakaraspṛṣṭā iti hetau prathamā|

-----------------------------------------------|
uṣṇataptasya sahasā śītavārinimajjanāt||26||
tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkto yāty ūṣmordhvaṃ tato 'kṣiṇi|
dāhoṣe malinaṃ śuklam ahany āviladarśanam||27||
rātrāv āndhyaṃ ca jāyeta vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. uṣṇena taptasya sahasā-jhaṭity eva, śiśirajalanimajjanāt tridoṣaraktasaṃpṛkta ūṣmordhvam akṣṇi yāti| tataḥ-ūṣmaṇa ūrdhvagamanāt, akṣṇi dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| śuklabhāgaś ca malino bhavati| ahani-dine, āvilaṃ darśanaṃ jāyate, rātrau cāndhyam| sā dṛṣṭir uṣṇavidagdhākhyā|

-----------------------------------------------|
bhṛśam amlāśanād doṣaiḥ sāsrair yā dṛṣṭir ācitā||28||
sakledakaṇḍūkaluṣā vidagdhā'mlena sā smṛtā| -----------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. atyantam amlāśanāt-amlabhakṣaṇāt, doṣaiḥ saraktair yā dṛṣṭir ācitā kledakaṇḍūkaluṣānvitā syāt| sā vidagdhāmleti dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|

-----------------------------------------------|
śokajvaraśirorogasantaptasyānilādayaḥ||29||
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ| -----------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. śokādisantaptasya narasya vātādayo dhūmenevāvilāṃ dhūmadarśanāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kuryuḥ| sa dhūmaro nāma rogaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
sahasaivālpasattvasya paśyato rūpam adbhutam||30||
bhāsvaraṃ bhāśkarādiṃ vā vātādyā nayanāśritāḥ|
kurvanti tejaḥ saṃśoṣya dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanām||31||
vaidūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthām ivāvyathām| oupasargika ity eṣa liṅganāśo--------------------|32|

Sa. sahasaiva-atarkitasya, puṃso 'lpasattvasya rūpam adbhutaṃ paśyato bhāsvaraṃ bhāskaraprakāraṃ paśyato vā vātādayo locanāśritā dṛṣṭiṃ muṣitadarśanāṃ vaiḍūryavarṇāṃ stimitāṃ prakṛtisthām iva pīḍārahitāṃ kurvanti| kiṃ kṛtvā ? tejaḥ saṃśoṣya| ity eṣa aupasargiko liṅganāśaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| -------------------------------'tra varjayet|32|
vinā kaphāl liṅganāśān gambhīrāṃ hRasvajām api|
ṣaṭ kācā nakulāndhaś ca yāpyāḥ, śeṣāṃs tu sādhayet|33|
dvādaśeti gadā dṛṣṭou nirdiṣṭāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ| 33 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne dṛṣṭirogavijñānīyo nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|12|

Sa. atra-eṣu madhye, kaphād vinā liṅganāśān-vātapittasaṃsargasannipātaraktajoupasargikān ṣaṭ, tathā gabhīrāṃ hrasvajām api dṛṣṭim ity aṣṭau varjayet| ṣaṭ kācāḥ-vātapittakaphasaṃsargasannipātaraktajāḥ, nakulāndhaś ceti sapta yāpyāḥ| śeṣāṃś ca dvādaśa sādhayet, tatra vātapittakapharaktasaṃsargasannipātaiḥ pṛthak timirāṇīti ṣaṭ, saptamaḥ kaphena ca liṅganāśaḥ, aṣṭamaḥ pittavidagdhā dṛṣṭiḥ, navamo doṣāndhaḥ, daśama uṣṇavidagdhā, ekādaśo vidagdhāmlā, dvādaśo dhūmaraḥ, iti| evaṃ dṛṣṭimaṇḍale rogāḥ saptaviṃśatisaṅkhyāḥ kathitāḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne dṛṣṭiroga- vijñānīyo nāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 12||

div.head: timirapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: asmād anantaraṃ timiripratiṣedha ucyate ----- athātas timirapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. nanu, dṛṣṭirogavijñānād anantaraṃ dṛṣṭirogapratiṣedho jñāpyaḥ| upapannam āha bhavān| kiṃ tu dṛṣṭitogacikitsitasya bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo vaktuṃ yuktaḥ| tatrāpi kramaprāptas timirapratiṣedha iti timirapratiṣedhārambha eva yuktaḥ| kācādīnāṃ tv alpavaktavyatvād atraivābhidhānam| tato bahuvaktavyatvāt pṛthagadhyāyo liṅganāśasya| iti sarvaṃ yuktam|

lg.l: timiraṃ kācatāṃ yāti kāco 'py āndhyam upekṣayā|
netrarogeṣv ato ghoraṃ timiraṃ sādhayed drutam||1||

div.ab: Sa. timiram upekṣayā kācatvaṃ yāti| kāco 'py upekṣita āndhyaṃ gacchati| ataḥ kāraṇān netrarogeṣu madhye timiraṃ dāruṇaṃ śīghraṃ sādhayet|

tulāṃ pacet jīvantyā droṇe 'pāṃ pādaśeṣite|
tatkvāthe dviguṇakṣīraṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||2||
prapauṇḍarīkakākolīpippalīrodhrasaindhavaiḥ|
śatahvāmadhukadrākṣāsirādāruphalatrayaiḥ||3||
karṣikair niśi tat pītaṃ timirāpaharaṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. jīvantyāḥ palaśatam apāṃ droṇe pādāvaśeṣitaṃ pacet| tatkvāthe ghṛtaprasthaṃ dviguṇakṣīraṃ prapauṇḍarīkādibhiḥ karṣaparimāṇaiḥ kalkitair vipācayet| niśi pītaṃ tat paraṃ timirāpaham|

----------------------------------------------|
drākṣācandanamañjiṣṭhākākolīdvayajīvakaiḥ||4||
sitāśatāvarīmedāpuṇḍrāhvamadhukotpalaiḥ|
pacej jīrṇaghṛtaprasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ picūnmitaiḥ||5||
hanti tat kācatimiraraktarājīśirorujaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. tathā drākṣādibhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ-karṣāṃśaiḥ, jīrṇasya-purāṇaghṛtasya prasthaṃ samakṣīraṃ pacet| tac ca kācādīn hanti|

----------------------------------------------|
paṭolanimbakaṭukādārvīsevyavarāvṛṣam||6||
sadhanvayāsatrāyantīparpaṭaṃ pālikaṃ pṛthak|
prastham āmalakānaṃ ca kvāthayen nalvaṇe 'mbhasi||7||
tadāḍhake 'rdhapalikaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet|
mustabhūnimbayaṣṭyāhvakuṭajodīcyacandanaiḥ||8||
sapippalīkais tat sarpighrāṇakarṇāsyarogajit|
vidradhijvaraduṣṭārurvisarpāpacikuṣṭhanut||9||
viśeṣāc chukratimiranaktāndhyoṣṇāmladāhahṛt| ----------------------------------------------|10|

Sa. paṭolādikaṃ parpaṭāntaṃ pṛthak palonmitam āmalakānāṃ prasthaṃ nalvaṇe-droṇe 'mbhasi, kvāthayet| tadāḍhake mustādibhiḥ sapippalīkaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ-kalkitaiḥ, ardhapalikair ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tac ca ghṛtaṃ ghrāṇādirogajit, vidradhyādirogajit, viśeṣeṇa śukrādighnam| etat paṭolādyaṃ ghṛtam|

----------------------------------------------|
triphalāṣṭapalaṃ kvāthyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ jalāḍhake||10||
tena tulyapayaskena triphalāpalakalkavān|
ardhaprastho ghrutāt siddhaḥ sitayā mākṣikeṇa vā||11||
yuktaṃ pibet tat timirī tad yuktaṃ vā varārasam| ----------------------------------------------|12|

Sa. triphalāyāḥ palāṣṭakaṃ jalāḍhake pādaśeṣaṃ kvāthyam| tena kvāthena tulyakṣīreṇa triphalāpalakalkayukto ghṛtārdhaprasthaḥ pakvaḥ śarkarayā mākṣikeṇa vā yutaṃ tat timirī pibet| ghṛtena vā tena yuktaṃ triphalākvāthaṃ doṣadūṣyādivaśāt pibet| etac ca triphalāghrutam ucyate|

----------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭīmadhudvikākolīvyāghrīkṛṣṇāmṛtotpalaiḥ||12||
pālikaiḥ sasirādrākṣair ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet samaiḥ|
ajākṣīravarāvāsāmārkavasvarasaiḥ pṛthak||13||
mahātraiphalam ity etat paraṃ dṛṣṭivikārajit| ----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ sahasitādrākṣair ajākṣīrādibhiḥ pṛthak svarasaiḥ samaiḥ prasthapramāṇaiḥ sarpiḥprasthaṃ vipācayet| etan mahātraiphalaṃ suṣṭru dṛṣṭivikārajit|

----------------------------------------------|
traiphalenātha haviṣā lihānas triphalāṃ niśi||14||
yaṣṭīmadhukasaṃyuktāṃ madhunā ca pariplutām|
māsam ekaṃ hitāhāraḥ pibann āmalakodakam||15||
sauparṇaṃ labhate cakṣur ity āha bhagavān nimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. traiphalena ca sarpiṣā triphalāṃ yaṣṭīyuktāṃ mākṣikeṇa ca pariplutāṃ rātrau lihāno māsam ekaṃ hitāśī sann āmalakodakaṃ piban gārutmataṃ cakṣur labhata iti bhagavān nimir āha|

----------------------------------------------|
tāpyāyohemayaṣṭyāhvasitājīrṇājyamākṣikaiḥ||16||
saṃyojitā yathākāmaṃ timiraghnī varā varā| ----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. tāpyādibhiḥ saṃyojitā triphalā yathākāmaṃ varā timiraghnī syāt|

----------------------------------------------|
saghṛtaṃ vā varākvāthaṃ śīlayet timirāmayī||17||
apūpasūpasaktūn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān| ----------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. athavā triphalākvāthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ timirarogaharam abhyaset| apūpādīn vā triphalācūrṇasaṃyutān śīlayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
pāyasaṃ vā varāyuktaṃ śītaṃ samadhuśarkaram||18||

lg.l: prātar bhaktasya vā pūrvam adyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak|

div.ab: Sa. pāyasaṃ triphalāyutaṃ va śītaṃ samadhuśarkaraṃ prātar adyāt| bhaktasya pūrvaṃ vā| harītakīṃ vā mṛdvīkāśarkarākṣaudraiḥ pṛthak pṛthak yutām anārataṃ timirāturo 'dyāt|

lg.l: dhmāpayitvā samāvṛttaṃ tatas tac ca niṣecayet|

div.ab: Sa. srotojāt catuḥṣaṣṭim aṃśāṃs tāmrādibhiḥ pratyekam ekāṃ-śair yutān andhamūṣodarasthitān dhmāpayitvā samyag āvṛttaṃ-āvartitaṃ śilāyāṃ, tataḥ-anantaraṃ, madhurādigaṇakvātheṣu tan niṣecayet pṛthak pṛthak saptavārān| tato vaiḍūryamuktāśaṅkānāṃ tribhir bhāgair yutam etac cūrṇāñjanaṃ sarvatimiraghnaṃ prayuñjīta|
Sa. saṃ-māṃsyādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaiś candre 'śvinīyukte saty akṣiyugmam añjayet timirādiśāntim icchan| ārye mukhacapale|

ab.seg:
|
manohvātutthakastūrīmāṃsīmalayarocanāḥ|
daśakarpūrasaṃyuktam aśītiguṇam añjanam||1||

div.ab: Sa. maricasaindhavayor dvau bhāgau, pippalīsamudraphenayor dvau bhāgau, sauvīrāñjanasya bhāgā nava, etac citrāyāṃ cūrṇitaṃ kaphāmayajit| gītir āryā|

lg.l: tac cūrṇitaṃ sthitaṃ śaṅkhe dṛkprasādanam añjanam|

div.ab: Sa. drākṣādisvaraseṣu pṛthak pṛthak divyajale ca srotoñjanaṃ saptakṛtvo niṣecayet| tac cūrṇikṛtaṃ śaṅke sthitaṃ dṛṣṭiprasādakṛd añjanaṃ sarvākṣirogeṣu śreṣṭhaṃ videhapatinirmitam|

nirdagdhaṃ bādarāṅgārais tutthaṃ cetthaṃ niṣecitam|
kramād ajāpayaḥ sarpiḥkṣaudre tasmāt paladvayam||28||
kārṣikais tāpyamaricasrotojakaṭukānataiḥ|
paṭurodhnaśilāpathyākaṇailāñjanaphenakaiḥ||29||
yuktaṃ palena yaṣṭyāś ca mūṣāntardhmātacūrṇitam|
hanti kācārmanaktāndhyaraktarājīḥ suśīlataḥ||30||
cūrṇo viśeṣāt timiraṃ bhāskaro bhāskaro yathā| ----------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. bādaraṅgārais tutthaṃ nirdagdhaṃ pūrvavat krameṇa chāgakṣīraghṛtamākṣike niṣecitaṃ, tasmāt-nirdagdhāc ca tutthāt paladvayaṃ, tāpyādibhiḥ kārṣikair yaṣṭīpalena ca yuktaṃ, mūṣāntardhmāpitaṃ cūrṇitaṃ, kācādīn hanti| susevito 'yaṃ bhāskaraś cūrṇo viśeṣeṇa timiraṃ hanti| yathā ravir andhakāram ity upamāśleṣo 'laṅkāraḥ|

----------------------------------------------|
triṃśadbhāgā bhujaṅgasya gandhapāṣāṇapañcakam||31||
śulbatālakayor dvau dvau vaṅgasyaiko 'ñjanāt trayam|
andhamūṣīkṛtaṃ dhmātaṃ pakvaṃ vimalam añjanam||32||
timirāntakaraṃ loke dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. bujaṅgasya-sīsakasya triṃśadbhāgāḥ, gandhapāṣāṇasya bhāga pañcakaṃ, śulbatālakayor dvau dbau bhāgau, vaṅgasya-trapuṇa eko bhāgaḥ, añjanād bhāgatrayam andhamūṣādhmātaṃ vipakvam añjanaṃ dvitīyo bhāskara iva loke timirāntakaram| bhujaṅgādīnāṃ śodhitanām atra prayogaḥ, na tu māritānām|

lg.l: gomūtre chagaṇarase 'mlakāñjike ca strīstanye haviṣi viṣe ca mākṣike ca|
yat tutthaṃ jvalitam anekaśo niṣiktaṃ tat kuryād garuḍasamaṃ narasya cakṣuḥ||33||

div.ab: Sa. tat tutthaṃ narasya garuḍanayanatulyaṃ nayanaṃ kuryāt| katamam ? yad dīptaṃ sat gomūtrādiṣv anekaśaḥ-saptakṛtvo, niṣiktam| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|

lg.l: yaṣṭīrasaṃ ca yat sīsaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthak pṛthak||34||
taptaṃ taptaṃ pāyitaṃ tac chalākā netre yuktā sāñjanā'nañjanā vā|
taimiryārmasrāpapaicchilyapaillaṃ kaṇḍūṃ jāḍyaṃ raktarājīṃ ca hanti||35||

div.ab: Sa. yat sīsaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ triphalākvāthādikaṃ pṛthak pṛthak spatakṛtvaḥ pāyitaṃ tasya sīsasya śalākā nayane yuktā sahāñjanā'ñjanena rahitā vā taimiryādīn hanti| śālinīvṛttam| dravyaśalākeyam iti prathitā|
Sa. pāradasīsakau samāṃśau, tayoḥ samam añjanaṃ, ṣoḍaśāṃśakarpūrayutam idam añjanaṃ timirāpahaṃ bhavati|

lg.l: yo gṛdhras taruṇaraviprakāśagalla- stasyāsyaṃ samayamṛtasya gośakṛdbhiḥ|
nirdagdhaṃ samadhṛtam añjanaṃ ca peṣyaṃ yogo 'yaṃ nayanabalaṃ karoti gārdhram||37||

div.ab: Sa. yo gṛdhras taruṇaraviprakāśagallas tasya samayamṛtasyāsyaṃ mukhaṃ, gośakṛdbhiḥ-gomayakarīṣaiḥ, nirdagdhaṃ-bhasmāsātkṛtaṃ, tasya samam añjanaṃ-srotojaṃ, samadhṛtaṃ-samabhāgaṃ, peṣyaṃ-cūrṇayitavyam| ayaṃ yogo nayanayoḥ-netrayoḥ, balaṃ gārdhraṃ-gṛdhratulyaṃ, karoti|

ab.seg:
kṛṣṇasarpavadane sahaviṣkaṃ dagdham añjananiḥsṛtadhūmam|
cūrṇitaṃ naladapatravimiśraṃ bhinnatāram api rakṣati cakṣuḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇasarpasya vadane sahaviṣkam añjanam aniḥsṛtadhūmaṃ dagdhaṃ māṃsīpatrakamiśritaṃ cūrṇītam upayuktaṃ sat cakṣur bhinnatāram api rakṣati| bhinnatāram apīty anena śaktyatiśayam asyāha| na tu bhinnatārasya kathañcid rakṣaṇaṃ syāt| anyatrāpy evaṃvidho nyāyo 'yam anusaraṇīyaḥ| svāgatāvṛttam|

lg.l: kṛṣṇasarpaṃ mṛtaṃ nyasya caturaś cāpi vṛścikān|
tatra yan navanītaṃ syāt puṣṇīyāt tena kukkuṭam|
andhas tasya purīṣeṇa prekṣate dhruvam añjanāt||40||

div.ab: Sa. kṣīrakumbhe mṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaṃ nyasya vṛścikāṃś ca caturas trisaptāhaṃ kledayitvā viloḍayet| tasmin yan navanītaṃ bhavet, tena navanītena kukkuṭaṃ puṣṇīyāt| tasya kukkuṭasya purīṣeṇāndho 'py añjanān niścitam īkṣate|
Sa. kṛṣṇasarpasya vasā śaṅkhaḥ katakaphalaṃ sauvīrāñjanam| iyaṃ rasakriyā drāg evāndhānāṃ dṛṣṭipradā|

ab.seg: maricāni daśārdhapicu- stāpyāt tutthāt palaṃ picur yaṣṭyāḥ| kṣīrārdradagdham añjana- mapratisārākhyam uttamaṃ timire||42||

div.ab: Sa. daśa maricāni, vaṭṭamākṣikād ardhakarṣaṃ, tutthāt palaṃ, madhuyaṣṭikāyāḥ karṣaḥ, etat sarvaṃ kṣīrārdraṃ paścād dagdham apratisārasaṃjñam añjanam atiśreṣṭhaṃ timire| gītir āryā|

lg.l: chāyayaiva guṭikāḥ pariśuṣkā nāśanyanti timirāṇy acireṇa||43||

div.ab: Sa. akṣabījādibhir jalapiṣṭair guṭikāḥ chāyayaiva pariśuṣkāḥ-na tv ātapena, timirāṇi laghu nāśayanti| svāgatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: maricāmalakajalodbhava- tutthāñjanatāpyadhātubhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika iti yoga- stimirārmakledakācakaṇḍūhantā||44||

div.ab: Sa. maricādibhiḥ kramavṛddhaiḥ ṣaṇmākṣika iti yogas timirādighnaḥ| ṣaṇmākṣika iti ko 'rthaḥ ? kīdṛśaḥ samāsaḥ ? brūmaḥ| mākṣikaśabdenādilopākhyayā tantrayuktyā vaṭṭamākṣika ity ucyate| ṣaṭpūraṇo vaṭṭamākṣiko yasminn iti samāsaḥ| tenāsmin yoge ṣaṣṭho vaṭṭamākṣika ity avatiṣṭhate| gītir āryā|

lg.l: ratnāni rūpyaṃ sphaṭikaṃ suvarṇaṃ srotoñjanaṃ tāmram ayaḥ saśaṅkham|

div.ab: Sa. ratnādibhiś cūrṇāñjanam| ratnāny atra vajramarakatādīni yathālābhaṃ grāhyāṇi| lohitagairikaṃ-lohitaṃ gairikam, kecit tu lohitaṃ-kuṅkumam āhuḥ| etac cūrṇāñjanam aśeṣadṛṣṭirogaharam| upajātivṛttam|
Sa. tilatailam akṣatailaṃ ca samāṃśaṃ mārkavasvaraso 'sanāc ca kvāthaś cety ayasaḥ pātre vipakvaṃ dṛṣṭer balam etan nasyaṃ karoti| āryā|
Sa. doṣavaśāc ca snehādibhir muhur muhur enaṃ-netrarogiṇam upakramet| mūrdhabastiḥ-gaṇḍūṣādividhyuktaḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 22)| bastiḥ bastividhyuktaḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 19)| upajātivṛttam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idam pratidoṣam ataḥ śṛṇu||48||

div.ab: Sa. idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ, sāmānyaṃ cikitsitam saṃ-ataḥ-anantaraṃ, pratidoṣaṃ sādhanaṃ śṛṇu|

ab.seg:
kiṃ tat ? ity āha ----
vātaje timire tatra daśamūlāmbhasā ghṛtam|
kṣīre caturguṇe śreṣṭhākalkapakvaṃ pibet tataḥ||49||

div.ab: Sa. [tatra-] teṣu timirādiṣu madhye, vātotthe timire daśamūlakvāthena ghṛtaṃ kṣīre caturguṇe triphalākalkapakvaṃ pibet| anantaraṃ triphalāpañcamūlānāṃ kvāthaṃ kṣīreṇa saṃyutam eraṇḍatailānvitaṃ virecanaṃ yojayet|

samūlajālajīvantītulāṃ droṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet|
aṣṭabhāgasthaite tasmiṃs tailaprasthaṃ payaḥsame||51||
balātritayajīvantīvarīmūlaiḥ palonmitaiḥ|
yaṣṭīpalaiś caturbhiś ca lohapātre vipācayet||52||
loha eva sthitaṃ māsaṃ nāvanād ūrdhvajatrujān|
vātapittāyamayān hanti tad viśeṣād dṛgāśrayān||53||
keśāsyakandharāskandhapuṣṭilāvaṇyakāntidam| ----------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. mūlajālayutāyā jīvantyāḥ palaśataṃ jaladroṇe pacet| tasmin jale 'ṣṭabhāgaśeṣe kṣīratulye tailaprasthaṃ balātritayādibhiḥ palonmitair madhuyaṣṭikāpalaiś caturbhir lohapātre vipācayet| lohabhāṇḍa evaṃ māsaṃ sthitaṃ tan nasyenordhvajatrujān rogān hanti| viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭyāśrayān vātapittarogān parākaroti| keśādiṣu puṣṭilāvaṇyakāntikaram|

lg.l: ghoṣayā bilvamūlaiś ca tailaṃ pakvaṃ payonvitam|

div.ab: Sa. śuklairaṇḍamūlādibhis tailaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ nasyena sarvajatrūrdhvarogādijit|

lg.l: vasā'ñjane ca vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā praśasyate|

div.ab: Sa. vaiyāghrī vārāhī vā vasā'ñjane śasyate| gṛdhrasarpakukkuṭotthā vā vasā pṛthaṅ madhuyaṣṭikāyutā śreṣṭhā|
