Sa. pratyañjane ca srotoñjanaṃ māṃsarasādiṣu krameṇa taptaṃ taptaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ niṣiktaṃ pūrvavad yojyam| etac ca paraṃ timirahṛt|
Sa. yady evaṃ timiraṃ na śāmyet tatas tarpaṇam ācaret-kuryāt|
Sa. śatapuṣpādibhir ghṛtam aṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tarpaṇam|
Sa. tathaiva kṛṣṇahariṇān medaso dugdhe siddhāt khajenāloḍitāt teja uddhṛtya madhikośīracandanaiḥ saha pakvaṃ tarpaṇam uttamam|

lg.l: pṛthak pṛthag anenaiva vidhinā kalpayed vasām||61||

div.ab: Sa. śvāvidādīnāṃ pṛthag anenaiva vidhinā vasāṃ kalpayet|
prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca puṭapākaṃ prayojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. puṭapākaṃ tu prasādanaṃ snehanaṃ ca-tarpaṇapuṭāpākavidhyuktaṃ (hṛ.sū.a. 24/14-16), prayojayet|
Sa. atra ca-vātaje timire, vātapīnasa iva nirūham anuvāsanaṃ ca prayojayet
Sa. pittaje timire jīvanīyaiḥ phalatrikena ca pakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayitvā tataḥ snigdhasya sataḥ sirāṃ vyadhayet|
śarkarailātrivṛccūrṇair madhuyuktair virecayet| ----------------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. śarkarādibhiḥ samākṣikair viracayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
suśītān sekalepādīn yuñjyān netrāsyamūrdhasu||64||

div.ab: Sa. netrāsyaśiraḥsu cātiśiśiran sekalepādīn yuñjyāt|

ab.seg: sanāgapuṣpakarpūrayaṣṭyāhvasvarṇagairikaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------||66||

div.ab: Sa. sārivādibhir vartir añjane śastā| tathā patrādibhiś cūrṇo 'ñjanaṃ śastam|

----------------------------------------------------| sauvīrāñjanatutthakaśṛṅgīdhātrīphalasphaṭikakarpūtam| pañcāṃśaṃ pañcāṃśaṃ tryaṃśam athaikāṃśam añjanaṃ timiraghnam| ----------------------------------------------------|67|

Sa. sauvīrāñjanādikam añjanaṃ śastam| kiyatkiyatpramāṇam ? ity āha-pañcāṃśam ity ādi| tad evaṃ pañca bhāgāḥ sauvīrāñjanasya, pañcaiva tutthakasya, śṛṅgyāmalakānāṃ bhāgās trayaḥ, sphaṭikakarpūrasya bhāga ekaḥ, iti sthitam| evam etad añjanaṃ timirahṛt kuryāt| gītir āryeyam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
nasyaṃ cājyaṃ śṛtaṃ kṣīrajīvanīyasitotpalaiḥ||67||

div.ab: Sa. kṣīreṇa caturguṇena jīvanīyādibhir ājyaṃ-ghṛtaṃ, pakvaṃ nasye śreṣṭham|

śleṣmodbhave 'mṛtākvāthavarākaṇaśṛtaṃ ghṛtam|
vidhyet sirāṃ pītavato dadyāc cānu virecanam||68||
kvāthaṃ pūgābhayāśuṇṭhīkṛṣṇākumbhanikumbhajam| ----------------------------------------------------|69|
Sa. śleṣmotthatimire 'mṛtādibhiḥ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītavataḥ sirāṃ vidhyet| virecanaṃ ca pūgādibhiḥ kvāthaṃ dadyāt|

----------------------------------------------------|
hnīberadārudviniśākṛṣṇākalkaiḥ payonvitaiḥ||69||
dvipañcamūlaniryūhe tailaṃ pakvaṃ ca nāvanam| ----------------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. hnīberādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ payonvitar dvirpañcamūlakvāthe tailaṃ pakvaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|
Sa. śaṅkhādibhir dṛgvaimalyāya vimalākhyeyaṃ vartir hitā syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------kokilā punaḥ|
kṛṣṇaloharajovyoṣasaindhavatriphalāñjanaiḥ||71||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇalohādibhiḥ kokilākhyā vartiḥ|

śaśagokharasiṃhoṣṭradvijā lālāṭam asthi ca|
śvetagovālamaricaśaṅkhacandanaphenakam||72||
piṣṭaṃ stanyājadugdhābhyāṃ vartis timiśukrajit| ----------------------------------------------------|73|
Sa. śaśādijā dvijāḥ-dantāḥ, eṣām eva lālāṭaṃ-lalāṭe bhavam asthi, tathā śvetagovālādīni, strīkṣīracchāgadugdhābhyāṃ piṣṭā vartis timiraśukraharety arthaḥ|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
raktaje pittavat siddhiḥ śītaiś cāsraṃ prasādayet||73||

div.ab: Sa. raktaje timire pittavad upakramaḥ| [śītaiḥ-] śītavīryaiḥ śītasparśair annapānauṣadhasekalepādibhiś ca, raktaṃ prasādayet|

lg.l: sotpalaiś chagaladugdhavartitai- rasrajaṃ timiram āśu naśyati||74||

div.ab: Sa. drākṣādibhiś chāgalīdugdhapiṣṭaiḥ śīghraṃ raktotthaṃ timiraṃ naśyati|
saṃsargasannipātotthe yathādoṣodayaṃ kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|75|
Sa. saṃsargaje sannipātaje ca timire yathādoṣodrekaṃ cikitsitam|

----------------------------------------------------|
siddhaṃ madhūkakṛmijinmaricāmaradārubhiḥ||75||
sakṣīraṃ nāvanaṃ tailaṃ piṣṭair lepo mukhasya ca| ----------------------------------------------------|76|
Sa. madhūkādibhiḥ sakṣīraṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam| madhūkādibhir eva jalena piṣṭair mukhalepo hitaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------|
natanīlotpalānantāyaṣṭyāhvasuniṣaṇṇakaiḥ||76||
sādhitaṃ nāvane tailaṃ śirobastau ca śasyate| ----------------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. natādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nāvane śirobastau ca śasyate|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
dadyād uśīraniryūhe cūrṇitaṃ kaṇasaindhavam||77||

lg.l: tat srutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ ghane kṣipet|
śīte cāsmin hitam idaṃ sarvaje timire 'ñjanam||78||

div.ab: Sa. uśīrakvāthe pippalīsaindhavaṃ rajīkṛtaṃ dadyāt| tac ca srutaṃ sat ghṛtānvitaṃ punaḥ pacet| ghane cāsmin śīte ca kṣaudraṃ kṣipet| etat sarvotthe timire hitam añjanam|

asthīni majjapūrṇāni sattvānāṃ rātricāriṇām|
srotojāñjanayuktāni vahaty ambhasi vāsayet||79||
māsaṃ viṃśatirātraṃ vā tataś coddhṛtya śoṣayet|
sameṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpāṇi sayaṣṭyāhvāni tāny anu||80||
cūrṇitāny añjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ timire sānnipātike| ----------------------------------------------------|81|

Sa. rātricāriṇāṃ prāṇinām asthīni majjapūrṇāni srotoñjanayuktāni jale vahati māsaṃ viṃśatir vā niśā vāsayet| tataḥ-paścāt, uddhṛtya śoṣayet| tani ca meṣaśṛṅgīpuṣpair yutāni madhūkena ca, cūrṇitāni sānnipātike timire 'ñjanaṃ śreṣṭham|

----------------------------------------------------|
kāce 'py eṣā kriyā muktvā sirāṃ, yantranipīḍitāḥ||81||
āndhyāya syur malā dadyāt srāvye tv asre jalaukasaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|82|
Sa. kāce 'py ayeṣā-pūrvoditā kriyā, sirāṃ hitvā| sirā'pi kasmān nānumīyate ? ity āha-yantrety ādi| siropayogiyantranipīḍitā malā āndhyāya yataḥ syuḥ| srāvye tu rakte jalaukaso dadyāt|

----------------------------------------------|
guḍaḥ pheno 'ñjanaṃ kṛṣṇā maricaṃ kuṅkumād rajaḥ||82||
rasakriyeyaṃ sakṣaudrā kācayāpanamañjanam| ----------------------------------------------|83|
Sa. guḍādayo rasakriyā kṣaudrānviteyaṃ kācayāpanamañjanam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
nakulandhe tridoṣotthe taimiryavihito vidhiḥ||83||

div.ab: Sa. nakulāndhe tridoṣaje timiravihito vidhiḥ kāryaḥ|
Sa. ghṛtādidrutai rasāñjanādibhir niśāndhe rasakriyā hitam añjanam|
daghnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe 'ñjanam uttamam| ----------------------------------------------|85|
Sa. dadhnā vighṛṣṭaṃ maricaṃ rātryandhe śreṣṭham añjanam|

----------------------------------------------|
karañjikotpalasvarṇagairikāmbhojakesaraiḥ||85||
piṣṭair gomayatoyena vartidoṣāndhanāśinī| ----------------------------------------------|86|
Sa. karañjikādibhir gomayarasena piṣṭair vartir naktāndhyahṛt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
ajāmūtreṇa vā kauntīkṛṣṇāsrotojasaindhavaiḥ||86||

div.ab: Sa. ajāmūtreṇa piṣṭaiḥ kauntyādibhir vā vartir niśāndhyaghnī| saṃ-kālānusāryādayo 'jākṣīreṇa piṣṭā vartayo niśāndhe hitāḥ|

lg.l: tāḥ śuṣkā madhunā ghṛṣṭā niśāndhe śreṣṭhamañjanam||88||

div.ab: Sa. pippalīr yakṛnmadhye sanniveśyādahan pacet| tataḥ pippalyaḥ śuṣkā madhughṛṣṭā rātryandhe param añjanam|
khādec ca plīhayakṛtī māhiṣe tailasarpiṣā| ----------------------------------------------|89|
Sa. māhiṣe ca plīhayakṛtī tailasarpiṣā saha bhakṣayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet||89||

lg.l: bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam||90||

div.ab: Sa. jīvantyāś ca pallavāni sarpiṣā pakvāni bhuñjīta| tathā atimuktakādīni patrāṇi ghṛtasiddhāni khādet| agastipatraiḥ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pāne ca pūjitam|

lg.l: snigdhaṃ verecayec chītaiḥ śītordihyāc ca sarvataḥ||91||

div.ab: Sa. amlapittoṣṇair vidāho-vidagdhatvaṃ, amlapittoṣṇavidāhaḥ| dhūmarākhyaś cāmlapittoṣṇavidāhaś ca tasmin| tatra dhūmarākhyaḥ-"śokajvarādi" (a. 12/29) ity ādi lakṣaṇaḥ| "bhṛśam amlāśanāt" (a. 12/28) ity ādinā'mlavidagdhā| "bhavet pittavidagdhākhyā" (a. 12/16) iti pittavidagdhā| "uṣṇataptasya" (a. 12/26) ity ādinā uṣṇāvidagdheti| tasmin dhūmarākhyāmlapittoṣṇavidāhe 'tipurāṇasarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ snigdhaṃ śītair viśodhayet| śītaiś ca sarvato lepayet|
Sa. gośakṛdādibhir vapakvam añjanaṃ śasyate| svarṇagairikādīnāṃ cūrṇair āvāpo yasyāṃ sā, evaṃvidhā rasakriyā va śasyate|

lg.l: kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam||93||

div.ab: Sa. medādibhiḥ kṣīrāṣṭāṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailasahitaṃ pakvaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|
tarpaṇaṃ kṣīrasarpiḥ syād aśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|94|
Sa. kṣīrodbhavam sarpis tarpaṇaṃ hitam| evam aśāmyati sirāvyadhaḥ kāryaḥ|

----------------------------------------------|
cintābhighātabhīśokaraukṣyāt sotkaṭakāsanāt||94||
virekanasyavamanapuṭapākādivibhramāt|
vidagdhāhāravamanāt kṣuttṛṣṇādividhāraṇāt||95||
akṣirogāvasānāc ca paśyet timirarogivat| ----------------------------------------------|96|
Sa. cintādibhir atimiravān api timirarogīva paśyet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
yathāsvaṃ tatra yuñjīta doṣādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam||96||

div.ab: Sa. [ tatra- ] tasmiṃś ca timirarogisadṛśadarśane, yathāyogaṃ doṣadūṣyadeśādīn vīkṣyauṣadhaṃ prayuñjīta|

lg.l: santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi kāryaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam||97||

div.ab: Sa. sūryoparāgādivilokanenopahatadarśanasya snigdhahimādi santarpaṇaṃ kāryam| ādiśabdenātisūkṣmātibhāsurādiparigrahaḥ| survaṇaṃ ca ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam añjanaṃ hitam| upājātivṛttam|

lg.l: cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ manuṣyai- ryatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvad icchā|
vyartho loko 'yaṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsām andhānāṃ vidyamāne 'pi vitte||98||

div.ab: Sa. netrarakṣāyāṃ sadā yatno vidheyo yāvaj jīvitābhilāṣitvam| yasmād andhānāṃ tulyarātriṃdivānāṃ puṃsāṃ vidyamāne 'pi dhane loka eva nirarthakaḥ syāt| rātriṃdivaśabdo 'trācaturādisūtre nipātitaḥ| vaiśvadevīvṛttam|

lg.l: triphalā rudhirasrutir viśuddhi- rmanaso nirvṛtir añjanaṃ sanasyam|
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā||99||

div.ab: Sa. triphalādikaṃ sadaiva-sarvakālaṃ, netrarakṣā syāt|

ahitād aśanāt sadā nivṛtti- rbhṛśabhāsvaccalasūkṣmavīkṣaṇāc ca|
muninā niminopadaṣṭam etat paramaṃ rakṣaṇam īkṣaṇasya puṃsām|100| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara sthāne timirapratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|13|

Sa. ahitād āhārāt satataṃ nivṛttiḥ, atibhāsurādyālokanāc coparatiḥ, ity etan nimināmrā muninā paramaṃ nṛṇāṃ nayanasya rakṣaṇam uditam| aupacchandasikaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyām sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne timira- pratiṣedho nāma trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 13||

div.head: liṅganāśapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. liṅganāśas timirapratiṣedhāt pṛthag ucyate, bahuvaktavyatvāt| sujātaṃ-suṣṭhu ghanībhūtaṃ, liṅganāśaṃ niḥprekṣyaṃ kaphodbhavaṃ vidhyet| śeṣās tu liṅganāśā asādhyā iti na tān vidhyet| tathā''vartakyādibhir vakṣyamāṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhir upadravair vivarjitam|

ab.seg:
sujātaṃ kasmād vidhyet ? ity āha ----
so 'sañjāto hi viṣamo dadhimastunibhas tanuḥ|
śalākayā'vakṛṣṭo 'pi punar ūrdhvaṃ prapadyate||2||

lg.l: karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ|
śleṣmalaiḥ pūryate cāśu so 'nyaiḥ sopadravaś cirāt||3||

div.ab: Sa. sa liṅganāśo yasmād asañjāto viṣamo-na samasaṃsthānaḥ, tathā dadhimastusadṛśas tathā tanuḥ-na ghanaḥ, śalākayā'vakṛṣṭo 'pi san punar ūrdhvam pravartate| tīvrāṃ rujaṃ karoti| punar api-kṛtavyadho 'pi san bhūyo 'pi, dṛṣṭim ācchādayet| śleṣmalair āhārair āśu pūryate| so 'paraiś ca-aśleṣmalair āhāraiḥ, sopadravai(va)ś cirāt pūryate|

lg.l: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvāc chleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. yasmāc chlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaś ca śuklatvāc chuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā, abhibhavād ānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|

lg.l: ślaiṣmiko liṅganāśo hi sitatvāc chleṣmaṇaḥ sitaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. yasmāc chlaiṣmiko liṅganāśaḥ śleṣmaṇaś ca śuklatvāc chuklaḥ|tasya-liṅganāśasya, anyadoṣeṇa-vātādinā, abhibhavād ānīlatā bhavati gadaḥ|
Sa. saṃ-śarkarā'rkakṣīralavaniciteva tathā'tighana syāt|
rājīmatī dṛṅ nicitā śāliśūkābharājibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. rājīmatī dṛṣṭiḥ śāliśūkasadṛśībhī rājībhir nicitā syāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
viṣamacchinnadagdhābhā saruk chinnāṃśukā smṛtā||6||

div.ab: Sa. viṣamā chinnadagdhābhā tathā sarujā chinnāṃśukā dṛṣṭiḥ smṛtā|
dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyasamacchāyā candrakī candrakākṛtiḥ| ----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. candrakī dṛṣṭiḥ kāṃsyatulyacchāyā candrakākārā syāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
chatrābhā naikavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā||7||

div.ab: Sa. chatrābhā'nekavarṇā ca chatrakī nāma nīlikā syāt|
Sa. asirārhādīnāṃ narāṇāṃ liṅganāśaṃ na vidhyet|

atha sādhāraṇe kāle śuddhasambhojitātmanaḥ|
deśe prakāśo pūrvāhṇe bhiṣag jānūccapīṭhagaḥ||9||
yantritasyopaviṣṭasya svinnākṣasya mukhānilaiḥ|
aṅguṣṭhamṛdite netre dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvotplutaṃ malam||10||
svāṃ nāsāṃ prekṣamāṇasya niṣkampaṃ mūrdhni dhārite|
kṛṣṇād ardhāṅgulaṃ muktvā tathā'rdhārdham apāṅgataḥ||11||
tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ dhṛtām|
daivacchidraṃ nayet pārśvād ūrdhvam āmanthayann iva||12||
savyaṃ dakṣiṇahastena netraṃ savyena cetarat| vidhyet---------------------------------------|13|

Sa. atheti maṅlārthaḥ| kṛtamaṅgalasya śuddhasya tathā sambhojitātmana āturasya sādharaṇe kāle prakāśe deśe pūrvāhṇe jānutulyāsanasthito vaidya āturasya yantritasyopaviṣṭasya, tathā svinne 'kṣiṇī yasya tasya svinnākṣasya| kaiḥ ? mukhavāyubhiḥ| tathā'ṅguṣṭhena malite nayane sati dṛṣṭau malam utplutaṃ-udgataṃ dṛṣṭvā, svāṃ nāsikāṃ vīkṣamāṇasya mūrdhni niṣkampaṃ dhārite sati kṛṣṇamaṇḍalād ardhāṅgulaṃ hitvā'pāṅgāc cāṅgulacaturbhāgaṃ muktvā tarjanīmadhyamāṅguṣṭhaiḥ śalākāṃ niścalaṃ yathā bhavati tathā dhṛtāṃ daivacchidrasya pārśvaṃ nayet ūrdhvam āloḍayann iva| savyaṃ netraṃ dakṣiṇakareṇa, vāmena ca hastena dakṣiṇam akṣi, vidhyet|

----------------------------------------------| -------suviddhe śabdaḥ syād aruk cāmbulavasrutiḥ||13||
sāntvayann āturaṃ cānu netraṃ stanyena secayet|
śalākāyās tato 'greṇa nirlikheṇ ṇetramaṇḍalam||14||
abādhamānaḥ śanakair nāsāṃ prati nudaṃs tataḥ|
ucchiṅghanāc cāpahared dṛṣṭimaṇdalagaṃ kapham||15||
sthire doṣe cale vā'ti svedayed akṣi bāhyataḥ|
atha dṛṣṭeṣu rūpeṣu śalākām āharec chanaiḥ||16||
ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā baddhākṣaṃ śāyayet tataḥ|
viddhād anyena pārśvena tam uttānaṃ dvayor vyadhe||17||
nivāte śayane 'bhyaktaśiraḥpādaṃ hite ratam| ----------------------------------------------|18|

Sa. suviddhe sati śabdaḥ syāt| tathā'rug jalalavasya ca srutiḥ syāt| sāntvayan rogiṇam anu-paścāt, netraṃ stanyena secayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, śalākāyā agreṇa dṛṣṭimaṇḍalaṃ nirlikhet| katham ? apīḍayan| tathā śanair nāsāṃ prati kaphaṃ nudan| tata ucchiṅghanāc ca dṛṣṭimaṇḍalagaṃ kaphaṃ haret| doṣe cale sthire vā saty akṣibāhyato 'ti svedayet| anantaraṃ rūpeṣu-vastuṣu, dṛṣṭeṣu satsu śanaiḥ śalākām ārkarṣet| tato ghṛtāplutaṃ picuṃ dattvā paṭṭikayā baddhākṣaṃ viddhād anyena pārśvena śāyayet| dvayor akṣṇor vyadhe sati tam uttānaṃ nivāte śayane 'bhyaktaśiraḥ pādaṃ hite rataṃ śāyayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
kṣavathuṃ kāsam udgāraṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ pānam ambhasaḥ||18||

div.ab: Sa. kṣavathvādīn saptāhaṃ nācaret| atra ca snehapīta iva yantraṇā|

lg.l: śaktito laṅghayet seko ruji koṣṇena sarpiṣā|
vilepīṃ vā tryahāc cāsya kvāthair muktvā'kṣi secayet|
vātaghnaiḥ saptame tv ahni sarvathaivākṣi mocayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. śaktyanusāreṇa ca taṃ laṅghayet| pīḍāyāṃ satyāṃ koṣṇena ghṛtena seko hitaḥ| tathā vyoṣāmalakayuktaṃ vāṭhyaṃ dravaṃ saghṛtaṃ tryahaṃ bhuñjīta vilepikāṃ vā| tryahād antaraṃ nayanaṃ muktvā kvāthair vātaghnaiḥ sevayet| saptame tu dine sarvathaivākṣi mocayet|
Sa. dṛṣṭeś ca yantraṇāṃ kuryāt| atisūkṣmabhāsurādīn nekṣetety arthaḥ| sthairyalābho yāvadakṣṇi syāt| sthirībhūtāyām api dṛśi sūkṣmaṇi rūpāṇi bhāsurāṇi ca sahasā nāvalokayet|

lg.l: ahitair vedhadoṣāc ca yathāsvaṃ tān upācaret||23||

div.ab: Sa. ahitair ācaritais tathā vedhadoṣāc ca śophādīnām adhimanthasya codbhūtiḥ| tāṃś ca yathāyogam upakramet|
Sa. dūrvādayaḥ kalkitāḥ saghṛtā mukhālepe prayoktavyā rūgrāgaśamāya|
sasarṣapās tilās tadvan mātuluṅgarasāplutāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. tilāḥ sarṣapayuktā bījapūrarasāplutāḥ pūrvaguṇāḥ|

----------------------------------------------|
payasyāsārivāpatramañjiṣṭhāmadhuyaṣṭibhiḥ||25||
ajākṣīrayutair lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaḥ śarmakṛt param| ----------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. payasyādibhiś chāgakṣīrānvitaiḥ sukhoṣṇo lepaḥ paraṃ sukhakṛt|

----------------------------------------------|
rodhrasaindhavamṛdvīkāmadhukaiś chāgalaṃ payaḥ||26||
śṛtam āścyotanaṃ yojyaṃ rujārāgavināśanam| ----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. rodhrādibhir ajākṣīraṃ śṛtam āścyotane yojyaṃ rujādihṛt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
madhukotpalakuṣṭhair va drākṣālākṣāsitānvitaiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. madhukādibhir vā śṛtam ajākṣīram āścyotanaṃ hitam|

lg.l: manthoktāṃ ca kriyāṃ kuryād vedhe rūḍhe 'ñjanaṃ mṛdu||29||

div.ab: Sa. vātaghnaśṛte kṣīre caturguṇe sarpiḥ padmakādipratīvāpaṃ sarvakarmasu śasyate| saṃ-evam apy anupaśāntau snigdhasvinnasya sirāṃ mokṣayet| manthoktaṃ copakramaṃ yuñjīta| vedhe rūḍhe sati mṛdv añjanaṃ hitam|
Sa. āḍhakyādibhiḥ saguḍā vartir divyāmbupiṣṭhā viddhe nayane yojyā|

jātīśirīṣadhavameṣaviṣāṇipuṣpa vaiḍūryamauktikaphalaṃ payasā supiṣṭam|
ājena tāmram amunā pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punar idaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam||31||
piṇḍāñjanaṃ hitam anātapaśuṣkam akṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛc ca dṛṣṭeḥ| ---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------|32|
Sa. jātyādikam ajākṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭam etena ca tāmraṃ pratanu pradigdhaṃ saptāhāt punar ajākṣīreṇa caitat piṣṭaṃ piṇḍāñjanaṃ chāyāśuṣkaṃ viddhe nayane prasādanaṃ hitam| dṛṣṭeś ca balakṛt|

---------------------------------------- - ----------------------------------|
srotojavidrumaśilāmbudhiphenatīkṣṇai- rasyaiva tulyam uditaṃ guṇakalpanābhiḥ|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitā- yām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma catu rdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|14|

Sa. srotojādibhir ajākṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ piṇḍāñjanaṃ pūrvavad iti| vasantatilakaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne liṅganāśapratiṣedho nāma caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 14||

div.head: sarvākṣirogavijñāniyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
adhunā kramaprāptaṃ sarvākṣirogavijñānaṃ vakti ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
vātena netre 'bhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāho 'lpaśophatā|
śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭasya todasphuraṇabhedanam||1||
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam acchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ|
nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrāj jantūnām iva sarpaṇam||2||
akṣy ādhmātam ivābhāti sūkṣmaiḥ śalyair ivācitam| snigdhoṣṇaiś copaśamanaṃ so 'bhiṣyandaḥ--------|3|
Sa. netre vātenābhiṣyaṇṇe nāsānāha ity ādinā liṅgānirdeśaḥ| snigdhoṣṇaiś copaśamanaṃ-sukham, ity upaśayanirdeśaḥ|

lg.l: adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. vātabhiṣyando mohād upekṣito 'dhimantho bhavet| tatrādhimanthe, karṇanādādikaṃ syāt| araṇiśabdaḥ puṃstrīliṅgaḥ|

lg.l: hatādhimanthaḥ so 'pi syāt pramādāt tena vedanāḥ|
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā||5||

div.ab: Sa. adhimantho 'pi pramādād upekṣito hatādhimantho bhavet| tena-hatādhimanthena, anekarūpā rujā jāyante| vraṇaś ca dṛṣṭau dṛṣṭihā syāt|

manyākṣiśaṅkhato vāyur anyato vā pravartayan|
vyathāṃ tīvrām apaicchilyarāgaśophaṃ vilocanam||6||
saṅkocayati paryaśru so 'nyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. saṃ-manyādibhyo vāyur anyato vā tīvrāṃ vyathāṃ pravartayet (yan) nayanaṃ saṅkocayati| kimbhūtam ? paicchilyarāgaśopharahitam| tathā paryaśru| sa anyatovātasaṃjñitaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
tadvaj jihmaṃ bhaven netram ūnaṃ vā vātaparyaye||7||

div.ab: Sa. tadvat-anyatovāta iva, jihmaṃ netram ūnaṃ-hīnaṃ vā, vātaparyaye syāt|

dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ|
antaḥ kledo 'śru pītoṣṇaṃ rāgaḥ pītābhadarśanam||8||
kṣārokṣitakṣatākṣitvaṃ pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. saṃ-dāha ity ādi pittābhiṣyandalakṣaṇam|
Sa. saṃ-adhimanthe jvaladaṅgārakīrṇābhaṃ yakṛtpiṇḍatulyābhaṃ netraṃ bhavet|

---------------------------syande tu kaphasambhave|
jāḍyaṃ śopho mahān kaṇḍūr nidrā'nnānabhinandanam||10||
sāndrasnigdhabahuśvetapicchāvaddūṣikāśrutā| -----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. kaphaje tu syande jāḍyādikaṃ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
adhimanthe nataṃ kṛṣṇam unnataṃ śuklamaṇḍalam||11||
praseko nāsikādhmānaṃ pāṃśupūrṇam ivekṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. adhimanthe kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ nataṃ śuklamaṇḍalaṃ connataṃ prasekādi ca syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
raktāśrurājīdūṣīkāraktamaṇḍaladarśanam||12||
raktasyandena nayanaṃ sapittasyandalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. raktasyandena raktāśrurājyādikaṃ nayanaṃ syāt| pittasyandalakṣaṇaṃ ca|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
manthe 'kṣi tāmraparyantam utpāṭanasamānaruk||13||

div.ab: Sa. manthe sati tāmraparyantaṃ tathotpāṭanena samānā rug yasya tad evaṃbhūtaṃ nayanaṃ syāt| bandhūkapuṣpatulyarāgam| tathā tāmyati sparśanākṣamaṃ lohitanimagnanimbābhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pāvakasadṛśaṃ ca darśanaṃ syāt|
Sa. adhimanthāś ca yathāsvaṃ sarve syandādhikavyathāḥ, tathā śaṅkhādiṣv atiśayena rukkarāḥ syuḥ|

Sa. vātapittottaraṃ netraṃ gharṣādimat syāt| tathā rūkṣe dāruṇe ca vartmanī yasmis tathā kṛcchrād unmīlanimīlane yasmiṃs tathā'kṣisaṅkocanena viśuṣkatvaṃ tathā śītecchā śūlapākena ca yutam akṣi syāt| ayaṃ śuṣkākṣipāko nāma uktaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------| ----------------------saśophaḥ syāt tribhir malaiḥ||17||
saraktais tatra śopho 'tirug dāhaṣṭhīvanādimān|
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate śuklamaṇḍalam||18||
aśrūṣṇaśītaviśadapicchilācchaghanaṃ muhuḥ| -----------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. tribhir malaiḥ-doṣair vātādibhiḥ, saraktaiḥ saśopho nāma netrarogo bhavet| tatra-saśophe, śopho 'tirug dāhaṣṭhīvanādimān bhavet| tadā śuklamaṇḍalaṃ pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaṃ jāyate| aśru ca muhur uṣṇaṃ muhuḥ śītam ity ādi ghanaṃ ca|

-----------------------------------------------|
alpaśophe 'lpaśophas tu pāko 'nyair lakṣaṇais tathā||19||
akṣipākātyaye śophaḥ saṃrambhaḥ kaluṣāśrutā|
kaphopadigdham asitaṃ sitaṃ prakledarāgavat||20||
dāho darśanasaṃrodho vedanāś cānavasthitāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. pāka iti pākaśabdenākṣipākātyaya upalakṣyate| ādyantalopākhyayā tantrayuktyā

-----------------------------------------------|
annasāro 'mlatāṃ nītaḥ pittaraktolbaṇair malaiḥ||21||
śirābhir netram ārūḍhaḥ karoti śyāvalohitam|
saśophadāhapākāśru bhṛśaṃ cāviladarśanam||22|| amloṣito 'yam--------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pittaraktolbaṇair doṣair annasāro 'mlatvaṃ nītaḥ śirābhir netram ārūḍhaḥ san śyāvalohitaṃ nayanaṃ karoti| tathā śophādiyutam| bhṛśaṃ cāspaṣṭadarśanam| ity ayam amloṣitaḥ|
Sa. ity evaṃ ṣoḍaśa sarvagā rogā uktāḥ| prakṛtatvāt sarvanetragā iti gamyate|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------|
hatādhimantham eteṣu sākṣipākātyayaṃ tyajet||23||

div.ab: Sa. eteṣu rogeṣu madhye sākṣipākātyayaṃ hatādhimanthaṃ tyajet|

vātodbhūtaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saptāhena śleṣmajāto 'dhimanthaḥ|
raktotpanno hanti tadvat trirātrāt mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva|24| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sarvākṣirogavijñānīyo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. vātajo 'dhimanthaḥ pañcarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| mithyācārād iti sarvatrānuvartate| śleṣmajo 'dhimanthaḥ saptarātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| raktajaś cādhimanthas trirātreṇa dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| paittikaś cādhimantho mithyopacārāt sadya eva dṛṣṭiṃ hanti| śālinīvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogavi- jñānīyo nāma pañcadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 15||

div.head: sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
adhunā sarvākṣirogapratiṣedha upakramyate ---- athātaḥ sarvākṣirogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
prāgrūpa eva syandeṣu tīkṣṇaṃ gaṇḍūṣanāvanam|
kārayed upavāsaṃ ca kopād anyatra vātajāt||1||

div.ab: Sa. syandeṣu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāṃ tīkṣṇam eva gaṇḍūṣādikam upavāsaṃ ca syandavantaṃ kārayet, vātotthaṃ kopaṃ muktvā|

dāhopadeharāgāśruśophaśāntyai biḍālakam|
kuryāt sarvatra patrailāmaricasvarṇagairikaiḥ||2||
sarasāñjanayaṣṭyāhvanatacandanasaindhavaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. dāhādiśāntyai biḍālakaṃ kuryāt| sarvatra syande patrailādibhiḥ saindhavāntair biḍālakaṃ kuryāt|

------------------------------------------------|
saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ tārkṣyaṃ bhṛṣṭaṃ maṇḍena sarpiṣaḥ||3||
vātaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā yojyaṃ śabaradeśajam|
māṃsīpadmakakālīyayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ pittaraktayoḥ||4||
manohvāphalinīkṣaudraiḥ kaphe, sarvais tu sarvaje| ------------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. saindhavādi ghṛtamaṇḍena bhṛṣṭaṃ vā pavanaje ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ vā rodhraṃ yojyam| māṃsyādibhiḥ pittaraktayor biḍālakaṃ kuryāt| manaḥśilādibhiḥ kaphaje| sarvaje tu syande sarvaiḥ-pūrvoktair militaiḥ, biḍālakaṃ kāryam|

ab.seg: sitamaricabhāgam ekaṃ caturmanohvaṃ dviraṣṭaśābarkam| sañcūrṇya vastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre 'vaguṇṭhanaṃ netre||5||

div.ab: Sa. caturbhāgapramāṇā manohvā yasmiṃs tac caturmanohvam| dviḥ-dvau vārau, aṣṭāṣṭabhāgapramāṇaḥ śābarako yasmiṃs tat dviraṣṭaśābarakam| tena sitamaricasyaikaṃ bhāgaṃ manaḥśilāyāś caturo bhāgān rodhrasya ṣoḍaśa bhāgān sañcūrṇya etat sūkṣmavastrabaddhaṃ prakupitamātre-sadyaḥ prakupite, nayane 'vaguṇṭhanaṃ hitam| gītiḥ samukhacapalā|

lg.l: āraṇyāś chagaṇarase paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnā nakhavituṣīkṛtāḥ kulatthāḥ|
taccūrṇaṃ sakṛd avacūrṇanān niśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam||6||

div.ab: Sa. āraṇyāḥ kulatthāś chagaṇarase-gośakṛdrase, paṭāvabaddhāḥ susvinnās tathā nakhair vituṣīkṛtās teṣāṃ cūrṇam ekavāram evāvacūrṇanāt sadya eva netrāṇāṃ kopaṃ vidhamati-jayati| praharṣiṇīvṛttam|
Sa. ghoṣādibhiḥ susūkṣmaiḥ ślathavastrabaddhair mūtī-poṭalikā, tāmrasthakāñjikanimagnamūrtiḥ pīḍāṃ nānāvidhāṃ netre dhāritā jayati| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: ṣoḍaśabhiḥ salilapalaiḥ palaṃ tathaikaṃ kaṭaṅkaṭer yāḥ siddham| seko 'ṣṭabhāgaśiṣṭaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite netre||8||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyāḥ palaṃ jalapalaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śṛtam aṣṭabhāgaśeṣaḥ seko madhuyutaḥ sarvadoṣakupite cakṣuṣi hitaḥ| āryā gītiḥ|

lg.l: śīghram eva jayati prayojitaḥ śigrupallavarasaḥ samākṣikaḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. ekaikadoṣajāṃ sannipātajāṃ vā nayanayornānāvidhāṃ pīḍāṃ śīghram eka eva śobhāñjanakarasaḥ sakṣaudro jayati| rathoddhatāvṛttam|

ab.seg: taruṇam urubūkapatraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya siddhamāje kṣīre| vātābhiṣyandarujaṃ sadyo vinihanti saktupiṇḍikā coṣṇā||10||

div.ab: Sa. eraṇḍasya taruṇaṃ patraṃ mūlaṃ ca vibhidya-saṃkṣudya, chāgadugdhasiddhaṃ vātābhiṣyande pīḍāṃ sadya eva nihanti| doṣādivaśāt saktupiṇḍī uṣṇā vā rujaṃ hanti| āryā gītiḥ|

Sa. vātaje 'bhiṣyande bilvādibhir eraṇḍamūlādibhiḥ saha kvāthaḥ kṛtaḥ koṣṇo hitam āścyotanam| hrīberādiṣu sādhitaṃ sajalenājena payasā uttamaṃ śūlāścyotanaṃ prasādanaṃ bhavet| hrīberaṃ-vālakam| vakraṃ-tagaram| mañjiṣṭhādibhiḥ kvāthaḥ sasitaḥ śiśiraḥ seko raktapittaghnaḥ|
Sa. kaserukādirajo vastre śithilaṃ sthitaṃ divyajale kṣiptaṃ syande raktapittaje hitam|
Sa. puṇḍrādibhir mūtī strīkṣīre saśarkare plutā chāgadugdhe vā dāhādihṛt|
Sa. śvetarodhraṃ samadhukaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ vasanasthaṃ stanyena mṛditaṃ pittādijit|
Sa. nāgarādirasaḥ śleṣmaṇy āścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam| sānnipātike 'bhiṣyande miśrair auṣadhaiḥ-etair evānantaroktaiḥ, āścyotanaṃ koṣṇaṃ hitam|

sarpiḥ purāṇaṃ pavane, pitte śarkarayā'nvitam|
vyoṣasiddhaṃ kaphe pītvā yavakṣārāvacūrṇitam||18||
srāvayed rudhiraṃ bhūyas tataḥ snigdhaṃ virecayet| ------------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. pavane purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| pitte śarkarayā yutaṃ ghṛtaṃ hitam| kaphe vyoṣasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ yavakṣārāvacūrṇitaṃ pītvā rudhiraṃ srāvayet| bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ tato virecayet|
Sa. ānūpavesavāreṇa śirovadanalepanam uṣṇena kāryaṃ śūle sati| dāhe tu sati kṣīraghṛtānvitaiḥ śītaiḥ pralepaḥ kāryaḥ|

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca vīkṣya yuñjyād yathāyatham||20||

div.ab: Sa. timirapratiṣedhaṃ ca paryālocya yathāyogaṃ cikitsitaṃ yuñjyāt|

lg.l: ayam eva vidhiḥ sarvo manthādiṣv api śasyate|
aśāntau sarvathā manthe bhruvor upari dāhayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa eva vidhir aśeṣeṣu manthādiṣv api śasyate| sarvathaivāśāntau manthe bhruvor upari dāhayet|

lg.l: rūpyaṃ rūkṣeṇa godadhnā limpen nīlatvam āgate|

div.ab: Sa. rūpyaṃ godadhnā rūkṣeṇa limpet| tasmin dadhni nīlatvam āgate śuṣke ca mastunā vartir vātākṣiroganāśinī|
Sa. sumanaḥkalikādayo vartir divyena jalena piṣṭā pittaraktahṛt|
Sa. saindhavādibhir vartiḥ śleṣmākṣirogajit|

lg.l: jaladroṇe rase pūte punaḥ pakve ghane kṣipet||25||
puṣpāñjanād daśapalaṃ karṣaṃ ca maricāt tataḥ|
ayaṃ pāśupato yogo rahasyaṃ bhiṣajāṃ param||27||

div.ab: Sa. praprauṇḍarīkādikam aṣṭapalaṃ pṛthag jaladroṇe pacet| rase pūte punaḥ śṛte ghane ca puṣpāñjanād daśa palāni, marīcāt karṣaṃ ca kṣipet| kṛtaś cūrṇo 'thavā vartiḥ sarvābhiṣyandotthān rāgādīn hanti| tathā sadya eva dṛṣṭiṃ prasādayet| eṣa pāśupatākhyo yogo bhiṣajāṃ paraṃ rahasyam|

śuṣkākṣipāke haviṣaḥ pānam akṣṇoś ca tarpaṇam|
ghṛtena jīvanīyena nasyaṃ tailena vā'ṇunā||28||
pariṣeko hitaś cātra payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam| ------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. śuṣkākṣipāke ghṛtasya pānam akṣṇoś ca jīvanīyasiddhena ghṛtena tarpaṇaṃ hitam| aṇunā tailena nasyaṃ hitam atra ca kṣīraṃ koṣṇaṃ saindhavayutaṃ pariṣeko hitaḥ|

------------------------------------------------|
sarpiryuktaṃ stanyapiṣṭam añjanaṃ ca mahauṣadham||29||
vasā vā''nūpasattvotthā kiñcitsaindhavanāgarā| ------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. nāgaraṃ stanyapiṣṭaṃ ghṛtānvitam añjanaṃ hitam| ānūpaprāṇijā vā vasā kiñcitsaindhavaśuṇṭhīyutā [ añjanaṃ ] śasyate|

------------------------------------------------|
ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān keśān mallakasampuṭe||30||
dagdhvā''jyapiṣṭā lohasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭham añjanam| ------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. keśān ghṛtāktān darpaṇe ghṛṣṭān mallakasampuṭe dagdhvā ghṛtapiṣṭā lohapātrasthā sā maṣī śreṣṭham añjanam|

------------------------------------------------|
saśophe vā'lpaśophe ca snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām||31||
rekaḥ snigdhe punar drākṣāpathyākvāthatrivṛdghṛtaiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. saśophe 'lpaśophe vā snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet| snigdhasya punar drākṣādibhir virekaḥ|

------------------------------------------------|
śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tāntavasthitam||32||
uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlaharaḥ param| ------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. śvetarodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ vastrasthitam uṣṇāmbunā mṛditaṃ sekaḥ śūlahṛt param|

------------------------------------------------|
dārvīprapauṇḍarīkasya kvātho vā''ścyotane hitaḥ|33|
Sa. dārvīprapauṇḍarīkayoś ca kvātha āścyotane hitaḥ|

ab.seg: sandhavāṃś ca prayuñjīta gharṣarāgāśruruggharān| ------------------------------------------------||33||

div.ab: Sa. sandhāvāṃś ca vakṣyamāṇān gharṣādiharān prayuñjīta|

lg.l: tāmraṃ lohe mūtraghṛṣṭaṃ prayuktaṃ netre sarpirdhūpitaṃ vedanāghnam|
tāmre ghṛṣṭo gavyadadhnaḥ saro vā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavābhyāṃ variṣṭhaḥ||34.5||

div.ab: Sa. lohabhāṇḍe tāmraṃ gomūtreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ sarpirdhūpitaṃ netre prayuktaṃ pīḍāhṛt| gavyadadhisaras tāmre ghṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāsaindhavayukto netre prayukto varīyān vedanāghnaḥ sandhāvaḥ|

lg.l: śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamyāḥ patrair dhūpitaṃ tad yavaiś ca|
netre yuktaṃ hanti sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ kṣipraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanāṃ cātitīvrām||35.5||

div.ab: Sa. śaṅkhaṃ stanyena tāmre ghṛṣṭaṃ śamīpatrair yavaiś ca ghṛtāktair dhūpitaṃ tat sandhāvasaṃjñaṃ netre prayuktaṃ śīghraṃ gharṣaṃ vedanām atidāruṇāṃ ca hanti| śālinyau vṛtte|

------------------------------------------------|
udumbaraphalaṃ lohe ghṛṣṭaṃ stanyena dhūpitam||36||
sājyaiḥ śamīcchadair dāhaśūlarāgāśruharṣajit| ------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. udumbaraphalaṃ lohe stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtāktaiḥ śamīpatrair dhūpitaṃ dāhādijit|

------------------------------------------------|
śigrupallavaniryāsaḥ sughṛṣṭas tāmrasampuṭe||37||
ghṛtena dhūpito hanti śophagharṣāśruvedanāḥ| ------------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. śigrupallavarasaḥ sughṛṣṭas tāmrasampuṭe ghṛtena dhūpitaḥ śophādīn hanti|

------------------------------------------------|
tilāmbhasā mṛtkapālaṃ kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ sudhūpitam||38||
nimbapatrair ghṛtābhyaktair gharṣaśūlāśrurāgajit| ------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. mṛtkapālaṃ tilāmbhasā kāṃsye ghṛṣṭaṃ tathā nimbapatrair ghṛtābhyaktair dhūpitaṃ gharṣādijit|

------------------------------------------------|
sandhāvenāñjite netre vigatauṣadhavedane||39||
stanyenāścyotanaṃ kāryaṃ triḥ paraṃ nāñjayec ca taiḥ| ------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. sandhāvena netre 'ñjite vigatauṣadhavedane sati stanyenāścyotanaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ trīn vārān| taiś ca-sandhāvaiḥ, paraṃ-tribhyo vārebhyo, nāñjayet|

lg.l: tāmram ālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet peṣayet tataḥ||41||

div.ab: Sa. tālīsapatrādibhir mūtrapiṣṭais tāmram ālipya saptāhaṃ dhārayet| tataḥ saptāhād ūrdhvaṃ gomūtreṇaiva guṭikāḥ kuryāt| tāś ca chāyāviśoṣitāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭā gharṣādighnāḥ|
Sa. vyāghryādikam ajākṣīrakalkitaṃ śamyāmalakapatrair ghṛtānvitair dhūpitaṃ śopharukpraṇut|
amloṣite prayuñjīta pittābhiṣyandasādhanam| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. amloṣite netraroge pittābhiṣyandacikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------|
utkliṣṭāḥ kaphapittāsranicayotthāḥ kukūṇakaḥ||44||
pakṣmoparodhaḥ śuṣkākṣipākaḥ pūyālaso bisaḥ|
pothaky amloṣito 'lpākhyaḥ syandamanthā vinā'nilāt||45||
ete 'ṣṭādaśa pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. utkliṣṭādayo 'ṣṭādaśa rogā ime pillākhyā dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
cikitsā pṛthag eteṣāṃ svaṃ svam uktā atha vakṣyate||46||
pillībhūteṣu sāmānyāt atha pillākhyarogiṇaḥ|
snigdhasya charditavataḥ sirāvyadhahṛtāsṛjaḥ||47||
viriktasya ca vartmānu nirlikhed āviśuddhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. eteṣāṃ pṛthak cikitsā yathāsvam uktā| atha bhaṇiṣyate cikitsā pillībhūteṣu sāmānyena| atha pillākhyākṣirogavataḥ snigdhasya charditavato narasya viddhasirasya viriktasya ca vartma nirlikhed āviśuddheḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
tutthakasya palaṃ śvetamaricāni ca viṃśatiḥ||48||
triṃśatā kāñjikapalaiḥ piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet|
pillān apillān kurute bahuvarṣotthitān api||49||
tatsekenopadehāśrukaṇḍūśophāṃś ca nāśayet| ---------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. tutthakasya palaṃ, viṃśatiḥ śvetamaricāni-saubhāñjanabījāni, kāñjikapalais triṃśatā piṣṭvā tāmre nidhāpayet| tatsekena pillān bahuvarṣotthitān apy apillān kurute| upadehādīṃś ca nāśayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
karañjabījaṃ surasaṃ sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||50||

lg.l: saṃkṣudya sādhayet kvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā|

div.ab: Sa. karañjabījādīni saṃkṣudya jale sādhayet| kvāthe pūte tatra rasakriyā| añjanaṃ pille auṣadhaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam|

rasāñjanaṃ sarjaraso rītipuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā|
samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca||52||
añjanaṃ madhunā piṣṭaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnam uttamam| ---------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. rasāñjanādikaṃ madhunā piṣṭam añjanaṃ paraṃ kledakaṇḍūhṛt|

---------------------------------------------|
abhayārasapiṣṭaṃ vā tagaraṃ pillanāśanam||53||
bhāvitaṃ bastamūtreṇa sasnehaṃ devadāru ca| ---------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. harītakīkvāthapiṣṭaṃ tagaraṃ paraṃ pillaghnam| devadārusasnehaṃ bastamūtreṇa bhāvitaṃ tadvat|

---------------------------------------------|
saindhavatriphalākṛṣṇākaṭukāśaṅkhnābhayaḥ||54||
satāmrarajaso vartiḥ pillaśukrakanāśinī| ---------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. saindhavādayas tāmrajaḥsahitā vartiḥ pillaśukrahṛt|

---------------------------------------------|
puṣpakāsīsacūrṇo vā surasārasabhāvitaḥ||55||
tāmre daśāhaṃ tat paillyapakṣmaśātajid añjanam| ---------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. puṣpakāsīsacūrṇaḥ surasārasena daśāhaṃ bhāvitas tad añjanaṃ paillyapakṣmaśātaghnam| surasā-mūrvā|

lg.l: alaṃ ca sauvīrakam añjanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ samaṃ tāmrarajaḥ susūkṣmam|
pilleṣu romāṇi niṣevito 'sau cūrṇaḥ karoty ekaśalākayā'pi||56||

div.ab: Sa. haritālaṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ [ca]| tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tulyaṃ tāmracūrṇaṃ sūkṣmam| eṣa cūrṇo niṣevita ekayā'pi śalākayā pilleṣu romāṇi karoti| upajātiḥ|

lg.l: dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ sarpiṣā tatsamutthā śreṣṭhā pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe maṣī sā||57||

div.ab: Sa. lākṣādirasena śreṣṭhaṃ kārpāsaṃ saptavārān bhāvitam| tena kārpāsena sarpiṣā dīpaḥ prajvālyaḥ| tatsamutthā maṣī pillānāṃ ropaṇārthe śreṣṭhā| vaiśvadevīvṛttam|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------|
vartmāvalekhaṃ bahuśas tadvac choṇitamokṣaṇam||58||

lg.l: punaḥ punar virekaṃ ca nityam āścyotanāñjanam|

div.ab: Sa. pillarogī vartmāvalekhādikaṃ punaḥ punar bhajet|
pūyālase tv aśānte 'nte dāhaḥ sūkṣmaśalākayā| --------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. pūyālase punar aśānte saty ante sūkṣmaśalākayā dāho hitaḥ|

--------------------------------------------|
caturṇavatir ity akṣṇo hetulakṣaṇasādhanaiḥ||60||
parasparam asaṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyena gaditā gadāḥ| --------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. ity evam akṣṇaś caturṇavati gadā lakṣaṇahetusādhanair anyonyam asaṅkīrṇāḥ kārtsnyenoktāḥ|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------|
sarvadā ca niṣeveta svastho 'pi nayanapriyaḥ||61||

lg.l: śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām|
saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam||63||

div.ab: Sa. svastho 'pi nayanavallabhaḥ san sadaiva purāṇayavādikaṃ niṣeveta| evaṃvidhaṃ kaphapittaghnaṃ śākaṃ ca| vidhir vidyate yasmiṃs tac ca śodhanaṃ-virecanādi, bhajet| tathā vegasaṃrodhādikaṃ varjayet|

ab.seg:
dve pādamadhye pṛthusanniveśe śire gate te bahudhā ca netre
tā mrakṣaṇodvartanalepanādīn pādaprayuktān nayane nayanti||66||

div.ab: Sa. dve pādasya madhye pṛthurūpe sire| te ca bahudhā netragate| tāḥ sirāḥ abhyaṅgādīn pādaprayuktān netraṃ(tre)prāpayanti|

malauṣṇyasaṅghaṭṭanapīḍanādyai- stā dūṣayante nayanāni duṣṭāḥ|
bhajet sadā dṛṣṭihitāni tasmā- dupānadabhyañjanadhāvanāni|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|16|

Sa. tāś ca malauṣṇyādibhir duṣṭā nayanāni dūṣayante| yata evaṃ tasmād dṛṣṭihitāni sarvadā upānadabhyañjanādīni bhajet| upajātī vṛtte| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarvākṣirogapratiṣedho nāma ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 16||

div.head: karṇarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ karṇarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

lg.l: prāpya śrotrasirāḥ kuryāc chūlaṃ srotasi vegavat|
cirāc ca pākaṃ pakvaṃ tu lasīkām alpaśaḥ sravet|
śrotraṃ śūnyam akasmāc ca syāt sañcāravicāravat||3||

div.ab: Sa. nayanāmayād anantaraṃ dūragrahaṇasādharmyeṇa karṇarogān āha| yathā hi cakṣur dūradeśastham api paśyati tathā śrotraṃ dūrastham api śṛṇotīty āha- pratiśyāyety ādibhiḥ śabdasya ca mithyābhiyogena pavanaḥ kupito 'parair api sarvanidānaiḥ kupitaḥ śrotrasirāḥ prāpya srotasi-karṇavivare, śūlaṃ vegavat kuryāt| tathā'rdhāvabhedakaṃ śirorogaṃ stambhaṃ karṇasyaiva, tathā śītasyānabhinandanaṃ cireṇa ca pākaṃ kuryāt| pakvaṃ tu śrotram alpaśo lasīkāṃ sravet| akasmāc ca śūnyaṃ syāt| sañcāravicāravac ca-sthagitāsthagitaṃ ca yathā, syāt|

śūlaṃ pittāt sadāhoṣāśītecchāśvayathujvaram|
āśupākaṃ prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti||4||
sā lasīkā spṛśed yad yat tat tat pākam upaiti ca| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. pittena śūlaṃ dāhādyanvitaṃ syāt| tatra ūṣā-prādeśikaḥ santāpaḥ| dāhaḥ-sarvāṅgīṇas tīvroṣmā sadā'ratimān| tathā''śu pāko yasmiṃs tad evam| tathā prapakvaṃ ca sapītalasikāsruti syāt| sā ca lasīkā yad yad aṅgaṃ spṛśet tat tat pākaṃ gacchati|

-------------------------------------------------|
kaphāc chirohanugrīvāgauravaṃ mandatā rujaḥ||5||
kaṇḍūḥ śvayathur uṣṇecchā pākāc chvetaghanasrutiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. kaphāc chirādigauravaṃ jāyate| rujo mandatvaṃ kaṇḍvādi ca syāt| pākāc chvetā ghanā ca srutiḥ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
karoti śravaṇe śūlam abhighātādidūṣitam||6||
raktaṃ pittasamānārti kiñcid vā'dhikalakṣaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. raktam abhighātādidūṣitaṃ karṇe śūlaṃ karoti| kimbhūtaṃ raktam ? pittena samā pīḍā yasmiṃs tad evam| kiñcic cādhikalakṣaṇam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
śūlaṃ samuditair doṣaiḥ saśophajvaratīvraruk||7||

div.ab: Sa. samuditaiḥ-sannipatitair doṣaiḥ, śūlaṃ śophādiyutaṃ jāyate| tathā paryāyeṇoṣṇaśītecchaṃ śrutijāḍyayuktaṃ ca| pakvaṃ sitāsitāraktaghanaṃ pūyaṃ pravahati|

lg.l: nādān akasmād vividhān karṇanādaṃ vadanti tam||9||

div.ab: Sa. śabdavāhinīṣu sirāsu gate vāte muhuḥ śabdān vividhān akasmāc chṛṇoti| taṃ karṇanādaṃ vadanti|

lg.l: uccaiḥ kṛcchrāc chrutiṃ kuryād badhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca||10||

div.ab: Sa. vāyuḥ śleṣmaṇā'nugataḥ karṇanādo vā samupekṣitaḥ-acikitsitaḥ, karṇe-śrotre, uccaiḥ kṛcchrāc chrutiṃ-śravaṇaṃ, kuryāt| krameṇa badhiratvaṃ-bādhiryaṃ ca, kuryāt|

lg.l: vātena śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā śroto limpet tato bhavet|

div.ab: Sa. vātena śleṣmā śoṣitaḥ śroto limpet| tato ruggauravaṃ tasya srotaso gurutvaṃ syāt, sthaganaṃ ca| sa pratīnāhasaṃjñako gadaḥ|
kaṇḍūśophau kaphāc chrotre sthirau tatsaṃjñayā smṛtau| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. kaphāt kaṇḍūśophau karṇe sthirau tatsaṃjñau kaṇḍūśophākhyau bhavataḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tv api||12||
ghanapūtibahukledaṃ kurute pūtikarṇakam| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. kaphaḥ pittena vidagdhaḥ sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ vā ghanapūtibahukledaṃ pūtikarṇakam anugatārthaṃ kurute|

-------------------------------------------------|
vātādidūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ māṃsāsṛkkledajā rujam||13||
khādanto jantavaḥ kuryus tīvrāṃ sa kṛmikarṇakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. vātādibhiḥ dūṣitaṃ śrotraṃ jantavo bhakṣayanto māṃsādikledajāṃ tīvrāṃ rujaṃ kuryuḥ| sa kṛmikarṇakākhyaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------śopho 'rśo 'rbudam īritam|
teṣu ruk pūtikarṇatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca bādhate||15||

div.ab: garbhe 'nilāt saṅkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇakaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. vātād garbhe-abhyantare, saṅkucitā śaṣkulī kucikarṇasaṃjñaḥ|
Sa. māṃsāṃṅkuro garbhe sthira eko 'neko vā nīrujaḥ pippalīty ucyate, karṇapippalīty arthaḥ| sa ca māṃsāṃṅkuraḥ pippalīmānaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------sannipātād vidārikā|
savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ śvayathuḥ, sa upekṣitaḥ||17||

lg.l: saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm||18||

div.ab: Sa. sannipātena vidārikākhyaḥ śvayathuḥ stabdhas tathā savarṇaḥ sarujaḥ| sa upekṣitaḥ san kaṭutailanibhaṃ sravet| kṛcchreṇa rohati| sā ca vidārikā rūḍhā satī niścitaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīṃ saṅkocayati|
sirāsthaḥ kurute vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayam| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. sirāstho vāyuḥ pālīśoṣaṃ tadāhvayaṃ-pālīśoṣasaṃjñaṃ, kurute|

---------------------------------------------|
kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat pālī vātena tantrikā||19||
sukumāre cirotsargāt sahasaiva pravardhite|
karṇe śophaḥ saruk pālyām aruṇaḥ paripoṭavān||20||
paripoṭaḥ sa pavanāt----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|21|

Sa. vātena pālī kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīva syāt| sā tantrīkety ucyate| sukumāre karṇe cirotsargāt sahasaiva-na tu śanaiḥ, pravardhite śvayathuḥ pālyāṃ saruk tathā lohitaḥ paripoṭavāṃś ca| paripoṭaḥ-sphuṭanam| sa vātāt paripoṭasaṃjñaḥ syāt|

----------------------utpātaḥ pittaśoṇitāt|
gurvābharaṇabhārādyaiḥ śyāvo rugdāhapākavān||21||
śvayathuḥ sphoṭapiṭikārāgoṣākledasaṃyutaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. pittaśoṇitāt sa evotpātasaṃjñaḥ| gurvābharaṇabhārādibhir hetubhūtaiḥ prakupitāt pittaśoṇitāt śopho rugādimān sphoṭādisaṃyutaḥ| śyāvo 'nugatārthaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
pālyāṃ śopho 'nilakaphāt sarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ||22||
stabdhaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān unmantho galliraś ca saḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. vātakaphāt pālyāṃ śophaḥ sarvato nirvyathaḥ sthiraḥ stabdhaḥ samānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍūyuta unmantha ucyate| sa eva gallirākhyaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
durviddhe vardhite karṇe sakaṇḍūdāhapākaruk||23||
śvayath uḥ sannipātotthaḥ sa nāmnā duḥkhavardhanaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. karṇe durviddhe sati kaṇḍvādisaṃyutaḥ śophaḥ sanni ppātātmako duḥkhavardhanasaṃjñaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
kaphāsṛk''kṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ sakaṇḍūkledavedanāḥ||24||
lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāstā hi lihyuḥ pālīm upekṣitāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kapharaktajakṛmijāḥ sūkṣmāḥ kaṇḍvādiyutā lehyākhyāḥ piṭikāḥ| yasmāt tā upekṣitāḥ pālīṃ lihyuḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
pippalī sarvajaṃ śūlaṃ vidārī kucikarṇakaḥ|25|
eṣām asādhyāḥ, yāpyaikā tantrikā'nyāṃs tu sādhayet|
pañcaviṃśatir ity uktāḥ karṇarogā vibhāgataḥ|26| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|17|

Sa. pippalyādayaś catvāro rogā eṣāṃ madhye 'sādhyāḥ| tantrikā yāpyā| anyāṃs tu viṃśatirogān sādhayet| iti-evaṃ prāg uktena prakāreṇa, pañcaviṃśatir āmayā vibhāgenoktāḥ| anenānyatantrakṛtāṃ saṅkīrṇakarṇarogakathanaṃ sūcayati| saṅkhyānaṃ ca sukhasmaraṇārtham atra kṛtam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogavijñānīyo nāma saptadaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 17||

div.head: karṇarogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
athātaḥ karṇarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) karṇaśūle pavanaje pibed rātrau rasāśitaḥ|
vātaghnasādhitaṃ sarpiḥ, karṇaṃ svinnaṃ ca pūrayet||1||
patrāṇāṃ pṛthag aśvatthabilvārkairaṇḍajanmanām|
tailasindhūtthadigdhānāṃ svinnānāṃ puṭapākataḥ||2||
rasaiḥ kavoṣṇais tadvac ca mūlakasyāralor api| ---------------------------------------------|3|

Sa. asmād anantaram etac cikitsocyata ity āha- vātodbhave karṇaśūle māṃsarasena bhojito vātaghnadravyasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ niśi pibet| karṇaṃ ca svinnaṃ santaṃ pṛthag aśvatthādijānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tailasaindhavadigdhānāṃ puṭapākataḥ svinnānāṃ rasaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ pūrayet| tathaiva mūlakasya rasena syonākasya ca rasena pūrayet|

---------------------------------------------|
gaṇe vātahare 'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca vipācitaḥ||3||
mahāsneho drutaṃ hanti sutīvrām api vedanām| ---------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. vātahare gaṇe 'mleṣu mūtreṣu ca-gomūtrādiṣu, vipācito mahāsneho drāg eva sudāruṇām api pīḍāṃ jayati|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt||4||

lg.l: yojyaś caivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhāc ca sāralāt||5||

div.ab: Sa. mahataḥ pañcamūlasya ekatamāt kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt tailasiktāt prajvalitāt grāhyaḥ snehaḥ| sa karṇe niṣiktaḥ sadyo rujāhṛt| evaṃ-anenaiva vidhinā, devadārukāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt saralakāṣṭhāc ca cyutaḥ sneho-raso, yojyaḥ|

lg.l: varjayec chirasā snānaṃ śītāmbhaḥpānam ahny api||6||

div.ab: Sa. vātavyādhau pratiśyāye ca yad vihitaṃ bheṣajaṃ tac cātra hitam| śirasā saha snānaṃ varjayet| śītajalapānaṃ divā'pi na kāryam, rātrau tu sarvathā varjyam evety arthaḥ|
Sa. pittaśūle sitānvitaghṛtena snigdhaṃ virecayet| drākṣāmadhukasiddhaṃ strīkṣīraṃ karṇapūraṇaṃ hitam|

yaṣṭyanantāhimośīrakākolīrodhrajīvakaiḥ|
mṛṇālabisamañjiṣṭhāsārivābhiś ca sādhayet||8||
yaṣṭīmadhurasaprasthakṣīradviprasthasaṃyutam|
tailasya kuḍavaṃ nasyapūraṇābhyañjanair idam||9||
nihanti śūladāhoṣāḥ kevalaṃ kṣaudram eva vā| ---------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkair madhukakvāthaprasthena kṣīrasya dviprasthena ca saṃyutaṃ tailakuḍavaṃ sādhayet| nasyakarṇapūraṇābhyañjanair idaṃ śūlādīn hanti| kevalaṃ kṣaudraṃ vā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭyādibhiś ca saghṛtaiḥ karṇau dihyāt samantataḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. yaṣṭyādibhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ, sasarpikaiḥ karṇau ca parito limpet|
Sa. kaphotthe pippalīpakvaghṛtasnigdhaṃ vāmayet| dhūmādīṃś ca kaphaghnān vidadhyāt|
Sa. laśunādīnāṃ pṛthak pṛthak svarasaḥ karṇapūraṇe koṣṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|

arkāṅkurān amlapiṣṭāṃs tailāktāṃl lavaṇānvitān|
sannidhāya snuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛtān||13||
svedayet puṭapākena sa rasaḥ śūlajit param| ---------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. arkāṅkurān amlena-kāñikena, piṣṭāṃs tailena rūkṣi(ṣi)tān lavaṇānvitān snuhīkāṇḍe korite sannidhāya tasyāḥ-snuhyāḥ, patrair āvṛtān puṭapākena svedayet| sa rasaḥ paraṃ śūlajit|

---------------------------------------------|
rasena bījapūrasya kapitthasya ca pūrayet||14||
suktena pūrayitvā vā phenenānvavacūrṇayet| ---------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. tathā bījapūrasya rasena kapittharasena ca pūrayet| athavā suktena pūrayitvā samudraphenacūrṇair avacūrṇayet|

---------------------------------------------|
ajāvimūtravaṃśatvak''siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca pūraṇam||15||
siddhaṃ vā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburunāgaraiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. ajāvimūtrābhyāṃ vaṃśatvacā ca siddhaṃ tailaṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam| sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ hiṅgutumburuśuṇṭhībhiḥ siddhaṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
raktaje pittavat kāryaṃ sirāṃ cāśu vimokṣayet||16||

div.ab: Sa. raktaje karṇaśūle pittavat kāryam| śīghraṃ ca sirāṃ vimokṣayet|

lg.l: yuñjyān nāḍīvidhānaṃ ca duṣṭavraṇaharaṃ ca yat||17||

div.ab: Sa. pakve pūyavahe karṇe dhūmādikaṃ yojyam| nāḍīvidhānaṃ ca yojyam| duṣṭavraṇaghnaṃ yac ca tac ca yojyam|

lg.l: srotaḥ pramujya digdhaṃ tu dvau kālau picuvartibhiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. picuvartibhiś ca karṇasroto digdhaṃ-pūyena, dvau kālau pramṛjya guggulunā dhūpayitvā tato mākṣikeṇa pūrayet| surasādigaṇakvāthakṛtaphāṇitāktāṃ picuvartiṃ ca yojayet| susūkṣmais taccūrṇaiḥ-surasādirajobhiḥ, avacūrṇayet karṇasrotaḥ|

lg.l: pacet tailaṃ tad āsrāvaṃ nigṛhṇāty āśu pūraṇāt||21||

div.ab: Sa. śūlādīnāṃ nivartako vidhir eṣaḥ| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ kapittharasena tailaṃ pacet| tatpūraṇād drāg evāsrāvaṃ nirharati|
Sa. nāde badhiratve ca vātaśūloktam auṣadhaṃ kuryāt| śleṣmānubandhe prāk śleṣmāṇaṃ vamanādibhir jayet|
Sa. eraṇḍādipatraje rase caturguṇe kṣīre cāṣṭaguṇe yaṣṭikādikalkayutaṃ tailaṃ pacet| tac ca nāvanādibhir nādādīn hanti|
Sa. prativiṣādibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ pūraṇād rujādijit|
karṇanāde hitaṃ tailaṃ sarṣapotthaṃ ca pūraṇe| ---------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. sarṣapodbhavaṃ ca tailaṃ karṇanāde hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣāro hiṅgu mahauṣadham||26||
śatapuṣpāvacākuṣṭhadāruśigrurasāñjanam|
sauvarcalayavakṣārasvarjikaudbhidasaindhavam||27||
bhūrjagranthibiḍaṃ mustā madhusuktaṃ caturguṇam|
mātuluṅgarasas tadvat kadalīsvarasaś ca taiḥ||28||
pakvaṃ tailaṃ jayaty āśu sukṛcchrān api pūraṇāt|
kaṇḍūṃ kledaṃ ca bādhiryapūtikarṇatvaruk''kṛmīn||29||
kṣāratailam idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mukhadantāmayeṣu ca| ---------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. śuṣkamūlakakhaṇḍānāṃ kṣārādīni sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇāni tathā tailān madhuyutaṃ suktaṃ caturguṇaṃ tathā bījapūrarasaḥ kadalīsvarasaś ca caturguṇaḥ| tair etais tailaṃ pakvaṃ pūraṇāt sukṛcchrān api kaṇḍvādīn āśu jayet| idaṃ kṣāratailaṃ mukhadantarogeṣu ca śreṣṭham|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
atha suptāv iva syātāṃ karṇau raktaṃ haret tataḥ||30||

div.ab: Sa. yadi karṇau suptāv iva syātāṃ tadā'sraṃ haret|

lg.l: bādhiryaṃ varjayed bālavṛddhayoś cirajaṃ ca yat||31||

div.ab: Sa. karṇayoḥ saśophakledayor mandaśruter āturasya vamanaṃ prayuñjyāt| bādhiryaṃ bālavṛddhayoś cirajātaṃ ca yat tad varjayet|

Sa. pratīnāhe snehasvedaiḥ parikledya karṇaṃ karṇaśodhanakena viśodhayet| paścāt tailasya suktādinā yuktasya karṇau(rṇaṃ) pūrayet| tailasyeti sambandhamātre ṣaṣṭhī| mātuluṅgarasasya vā suktādiyuktasya pūrayet| śodhanena rūkṣatotpattau satyāṃ ghṛtamaṇḍasya pūraṇaṃ hitam|

lg.l: nasyādi, tadvac chophe 'pi kaṭūṣṇaiś cātra lepanam||34||

div.ab: Sa. karṇe malena pūrṇe 'py ayaṃ-pratīnāhoktaḥ, kramaḥ kāryaḥ| kaṇḍvāṃ tathā kaphaghnaṃ nasyādi| śophe 'pi tathaivāyaṃ kramaḥ| kaṭūṣṇaiś ca lepanaṃ hitam|
Sa. pūtikarṇe kṛmi[ṇa]karṇe ca karṇasrāvoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| kṛmiṇakarṇake viśeṣāt kaṭutailena pūraṇaṃ hitam|

Sa. karṇavidradhau vamanapūrvā vidradhikriyā śastā| kṣatavidradhau pittotthakarṇaśūloktaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyam| arśorbudeṣu nāsāvat cikitsā| karṇavidārikā'pakvā karṇavidradhivat cikitsyā, yathādoṣodayena ca|

pālīśoṣe 'nilaśrotraśūlavan nasyalepanam|
svedaṃ ca kuryāt svinnāṃ ca pālīm udvartayet tilaiḥ||38||
priyālabījayaṣṭyāhvahayagandhāyavānvitaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. pālīśoṣe vātaśrotraśūla iva nasyādi svedaṃ ca kuryāt| pālīṃ ca svinnāṃ tilaiḥ priyālabījādiyuktair udvartayet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tataḥ puṣṭikaraiḥ snehair abhyaṅgaṃ nityam ācaret||39||

div.ab: Sa. tataḥ snehaiḥ puṣṭikṛdbhir nityaṃ sā'bhyaktavyā|

lg.l: tailaṃ vipakvaṃ sakṣīraṃ pālīnāṃ puṣṭikṛt param||40||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvaryādibhis tailaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ pālīnāṃ paraṃ puṣṭikṛt|
Sa. jīvantyādigaṇajena kalkena kṣīre ānūpamāṃsakvāthe ca tailaṃ pācitaṃ pālipoṣaṇaṃ pālīvṛddhikṛc ca|
pālīṃ chittvā'tisaṅkṣīṇāṃ śeṣāṃ sandhāya poṣayet| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. pālīm atisaṅkṣīṇāṃ chittvā śeṣāṃ sandhāya vardhayet|

---------------------------------------------|
yāpyaivaṃ tantrikākhyā'pi paripoṭe 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ||42||
utpāte śītalair lepo jalaukohṛtaśoṇite| ---------------------------------------------|43|
Sa. yāpyaivaṃ tantrikāsaṃjñā| paripoṭe 'py eṣa eva vidhir yāpyākhyaḥ| utpāte jalaukobhir apanītarakte śītalair lepaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
jambvāmrapallavabalāyaṣṭīrodhratilotpalaiḥ||43||

div.ab: Sa. jambvādibhiḥ siddhaṃ tailam abhyaṅge hitam| visarpoktaghṛtāni ca hitāni|

unmanthe 'bhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ godhākarkavasānvitam|
tālapatryaśvagandhārkabākucīphalasaindhavaiḥ||45||
surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca siddhaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ ca nāvanam| ---------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. unmanthe tailaṃ godhākarkaṭavasāyuktaṃ tālaparṇyādibhiḥ siddham abhyañjanaṃ hitam| tathā surasālāṅgalībhyāṃ ca tailaṃ siddhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nāvanaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
durviddhe 'śmantajambvāmrapatrakvāthena secitām||46||
tailena pālīṃ svabhyaktāṃ suślakṣṇair avacūrṇayet|
cūrṇair madhukamañjiṣṭhāprapuṇḍrāhvaniśodbhavaiḥ||47||
lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ ca tailam abhyañjane hitam| ---------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. durviddhe 'śmantakādikvāthena secitāṃ pālīṃ tailena svabhyaktāṃ madhukādibhiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtair avacūrṇayet| lākṣāviḍaṅgasiddhaṃ tailam abhyañjane hitam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
svinnāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍair bahuśaḥ parilehikām||48||

div.ab: Sa. parilehikāṃ gomayajaiḥ piṇḍair bahuśaḥ svinnāṃ viḍaṅgasārair urabhrīmūtrakalkitair ālimpet| kauṭajādibījādibhir vā'vimūtreṇa kalkitair ālimpet| athavā tair eva-kauṭajādibhiḥ, kaṭutailaṃ nimbādibhiḥ saha vipācayet lehikāvraṇe|

lg.l: chinnaṃ tu karṇaṃ śuddhasya bandhamālocya yaugikam|
śuddhāsraṃ lāgayel lagne sadyaś chinne viśodhanam||51||

div.ab: Sa. karṇaṃ tu chinnaṃ śuddharaktaṃ śuddhasya yaugikaṃ bandhamālocya lāgayet| lagne karṇe sadyaś chinne viśodhanaṃ-virekādi|

ab.seg:
atha karṇarogavidhānam āha ----
atha grathitvā keśāntaṃ kṛtvā chedanalekhanam|
niveśya sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ na nimnaṃ na samunnatam||52||

div.ab:
Sa. keśāntaṃ grathitvā chedanaṃ lekhanaṃ ca kṛtvā sandhiṃ suṣamaṃ niveśya na nimnaṃ na connatam, suṣamam iti "suṣāmādiṣu ca" iti ṣatvam, abhyajya madhusarpirbhyāṃ picuplotāvaguṇṭhitaṃ sūtreṇa na gāḍhaṃ na ca śithilaṃ badhvā śoṇitasthāpanaiḥ-madhukagairikādibhiḥ, avacūrṇayet| tato vraṇahitam ācāram ācaret| saptāhād ūrdhvam āmatailenāktaṃ śanaiḥ picum apanayet| suśrute(?) (saṅgrahe) tūktam (saṃ. u. a. 22)-
"na karṇe śopharāgādiyukte sandhānam iṣyate|
na ghasmarasya nātyuṣṇe nāviśuddhatanor api||" iti|

lg.l: suvarṣmāṇam arogaṃ ca śanaiḥ karṇaṃ vivardhayet||55||

div.ab: Sa. surūḍhādiguṇaṃ ca karṇaṃ śanair vivardhayet|

varṣmarūpam ucyate(?) ----
jalaśūkaḥ svayaṅguptā rajanyau bṛhatīphalam|
aśvagandhābalāhastipippalīgaurasarṣapāḥ||56||
mūlaṃ kośātakāśvaghnarūpikāsaptaparṇajam|
chucchundarī kālamṛtā gṛhaṃ madhukarīkṛtam||57||
jatūkā jalajanmā ca tathā śabarakandakam|
ebhiḥ kalkaiḥ kharaṃ pakvaṃ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtam||58||
hastyaśvamūtreṇa param abhyaṅgāt karṇavardhanam| ---------------------------------------------|59|

Sa. jalaśūkādibhir gajāśvayor mūtraiḥ piṣṭaiḥ satailaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ kharapākaṃ pakvam abhyaṅgāt karṇavardhanam| jalaśūkaḥ-śevālam| rūpikā-arkaḥ| chucchundarī-mūṣikābhedaḥ| sā ca kālena mṛtā, na tu vyāpāditā| jatūkā-carmacaṭikā| jalajanmā-jalaukā| śabarakandako-laśunaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
atha kuryād vayasthasya chinnāṃ śuddhasya nāsikām||59||

lg.l: chindyān nāsāsamaṃ patraṃ tattulyaṃ ca kapolataḥ|
tvaṅmāṃsaṃ nāsikāsanne rakṣaṃs tat tanutāṃ nayet||60||
sīvyed gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā|
kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyāt sīvyen nāsāṃ ca yatnataḥ|
chindyād rūḍhe 'dhikaṃ māṃsaṃ nāsopāntāc ca carma tat|
sīvyet tataś ca suślakṣṇaṃ hīnaṃ saṃvardhayet punaḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. atheti maṅgale| kṛtamaṅgalasya vayasthasya-taruṇasya, śuddhasya nāsikāṃ chinnāṃ kuryāt| katham ? ity āha-nāsātulyaṃ patraṃ chindyāt| tena-patreṇa, tulyaṃ kapolāc chindyāt| nāsikātulye deśe tvacaṃ māṃsaṃ ca rakṣan tat-patraṃ, tanutāṃ nayet| anantaraṃ sūcyā sevinyā picuyuktayā gaṇḍaṃ sīvyet| atha nāsāchede likhite tat tvacam uparivartya kapolavadhraṃ sandadhyāt| nāsāṃ ca yatnena sīvyet| antaḥ-madhye, nāsikāṃ nāḍībhyām utkṣipet sukhocchvāsapravartanāya| tata āmatailena siktvā pattaṅgamadhukāñjanair avacūrṇayet| anyair api-sirāvyadhavidhyuktaiḥ śoṇitasthāpanaiḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 27|48) , suślakṣṇaiś cūrṇair avacūrṇayet| anantaraṃ mākṣikaghṛtābhyām abhyaktaṃ badhvā, ācārikaṃ-snehavidhyuktaṃ, ādiśet| avasthāntaraṃ ca jñātvā sadyovraṇapratiṣedhavidhiṃ kuryāt| tato rūḍhe saty adhikaṃ māṃsaṃ tac ca nāsāsamīpād adhikaṃ carma chindyāt| anantaraṃ sīvyet| tataḥ suślakṣṇaṃ ca kṛtvā punaḥ sīvyet| hīnaṃ ca vardhayet|

niveśite yathānyāsaṃ sadyaś cchinne 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ|
nāḍīyogād vinauṣṭhasya nāsāsandhānavad vidhiḥ|66| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ|18|

Sa. sadyaśchinne 'pi ghrāṇe yathānyāsaṃ niveśite saty ayam eva vidhiḥ| nāḍīyogam antareṇauṣṭhasyāpi chinnasya nāsāsandhānatulyo vidhir iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne karṇarogapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 18||

div.head: nāsārogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
atha kramaprāptaṃ nāsārogavijñānaṃ bibhaṇiṣur āha ---- athāto nāsārogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
)avaśyāyānilarajobhāṣyātisvapnajāgaraiḥ|
nīcātyuccopadhānena pītenānyena vāriṇā||1||
atyambupānaramaṇacchardibāṣpagrahādibhiḥ|
kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ||2||
janayanti pratiśyāyaṃ vardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam| ---------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. avaśyāyādibhir vātolbaṇā doṣāḥ kruddhā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ-ghanatvaṃ prāptāḥ, pratiśyāyaṃ janayanti| kimbhūtam ? vivardhamānaṃ kṣayapradam|

---------------------------------------------|
tatra vātāt pratiśyāye mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ||3||
ghrāṇoparodhanistodadantaśaṅkhaśirovyathāḥ|
kīṭikā iva sarpantīr manyate parito bhruvau||4||
svarasādaś cirāt pākaḥ śiśirācchakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. [tatra-] teṣu rogeṣu vātapittakaphādyuttheṣu madhye, vātāt pratiśyāye sati mukhaśoṣādayaḥ syuḥ| bhruvau paritaḥ kīṭikāḥ sarpantīriva manyate| bhṛvau parita iti "abhitaḥ paritaḥ" iti dvitīyā| svarasādādayaś ca syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
pittāt tṛṣṇājvaraghrāṇapiṭikāsambhavabhramāḥ||5||
nāsāgrapāko rūkṣoṣṇatāmrapītakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. pittāt pratiśyāye sati tṛṣṇādayo bhavanti| ghrāṇamadhye piṭikā ghrāṇapiṭikāḥ, tāsāṃ sambhavaḥ| nāsāyā agre pāko nāsāgrapākaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
kaphāt kāso 'ruciḥ śvāso vamathur gātragauravam||6||
mādhuryaṃ vadane kaṇḍūḥ snigdhaśuklakaphasrutiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. kaphāt pratiśyāye sati kāsādayaḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
sarvajo lakṣaṇaiḥ sarvair akasmād vṛddhiśāntimān||7||

div.ab: Sa. tridoṣajaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ sarvadoṣalakṣaṇair yutaḥ| akasmāt-nimittaṃ vinā, vṛddhimāṃś chāntimāṃś ca|

duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāpya pratiśyāyaṃ karoty asṛk|
urasaḥ suptatā tāmranetratvaṃ śvāsapūtitā||8||
kaṇḍūḥ śrotrākṣināsāsu pittoktaṃ cātra lakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ nāsāsirāḥ prāptaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ karoti| tasminn urasaḥ suptatva tāmranayanatvādikaṃ pittābhihitaṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
atha duṣṭapratiśyāyalakṣaṇam āha ---- ---------------------------------------------|
sarva eva pratiśyāyā duṣṭatāṃ yānty upekṣitāḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. sarva eva pratiśyāyā upekṣitā duṣṭatvaṃ yānti| sa tu-duṣṭapīnaso, yathoktopadravāṇāṃ-mukhaśoṣādīnāṃ, ādhikyād dhetoḥ sarvendriyatāpano-nāsācakṣurādīnāṃ khedakaḥ, agnisādādiyutaś ca syāt| tathā sahasaiva punaḥ punaḥ kupyati| mukhadaurgandhyādikaraḥ, tathā nāsikākledādikaro muhuḥ pūyasadṛśakṛṣṇaraktapiṇḍitaśleṣmasrutiḥ| atra ca kṛmayo mūrcchanti dīrghāḥ snigdhāḥ śvetāḥ susūkṣmāś ca| teṣu-pratiśyāyeṣu, pakvalakṣaṇāni| tad yathā,-aṅgasya-śarīrasya lāghavaṃ syāt, kṣuteś ca śamaḥ, kaphaḥ sacikkaṇaḥ pīto, rasagandhayoś cājñānam iti| bhṛśakṣavākhyaṃ lakṣayitum āha-

Sa. tīkṣṇasya-marīcādeḥ, ghrāṇāt-siṃhanāt, tathā raviraśmyādibhir vātakopibhir anyair vā nāsātaruṇāsthani vighaṭṭite sati vāyuḥ kṛddho ruddhaḥ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ gacchet| sa nivṛttaḥ san atyantaṃ chikkāṃ kurute| sa bhṛśakṣava ucyate|

śoṣayan nāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca kurute 'nilaḥ|
śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ tataḥ||16||
smṛto 'sau nāsikāśoṣo-----------------------| ---------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. śoṣayan nāsikāsrotaḥ kaphaṃ ca vāyuḥ śūkapūrṇābhanāsātvaṃ kurute| tataḥ kṛcchrād ucchvasanaṃ syāt| asau nāsikāśoṣaḥ smṛtaḥ|

---------------------------nāsānāhe tu jāyate|
naddhatvam iva nāsāyāḥ śleṣmaruddhena vāyunā||17||
niḥśvāsocchvāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. nāsānāhākhye roge jāte sati ghrāṇasya naddhatvaṃ-āpūram iva, jāyate| śleṣmaṇā ruddhena vātena niḥśvāsocchāsasaṃrodhāt srotasī saṃvṛte iva syātām|
Sa. pittaṃ kartṛ nāsāpuṭe tvaṅmāṃsaṃ sadāhaśūlaṃ pacet sa ghrāṇapākākhyaḥ|

ab.seg:
--------srāvas tu tatsaṃjñaḥ śleṣmasambhavaḥ|
accho jalopamo 'jasraṃ viśeṣān niśi jāyate||19||

div.ab: Sa. srāvas tu tatsaṃjño-ghrāṇasrāvākhyaḥ| sa ca kaphād eva kevalād bhavati| accho jalasadṛśo nityaṃ srāvo jāyate, viśeṣeṇa rātrau|

lg.l: kaphaḥ pravṛddho nāsāyāṃ ruddhvā srotāṃsy apīnasam|
aver iva sravaty asya praklinnā tena nāsikā|
ajasraṃ picchilaṃ pītaṃ pakwaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam||21||

div.ab: Sa. kapho nāsāyāṃ pravṛddho ruddhvā srotāṃsy apīnasaṃ ghurghuraśvāsayutaṃ pīnasādhikarujaṃ kuryāt| tena-apīnasena, asya rogiṇo meṣasyevānavarataṃ praklinnā nāsikā picchilādiyuktaṃ kaphaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ sravati|

lg.l: bhaved dhūmopamocchvāsā sā dīptir dahatīva ca||22||

div.ab: Sa. raktena nāsā dagdheva bāhyato 'ntarataś ca sparśanaṃ na sahate| tathā dhūmopamocchvāsā dahatīva ca| sā dīptisaṃjñā rogajātiḥ|

lg.l: śleṣmā ca pūtir nirgacchet pūtināsaṃ vadanti tam||23||

div.ab: Sa. tālumūle doṣair duṣṭair mukhanāsikād vāyuḥ kaphaś ca pūtir nirgacchet, taṃ pūtināsaṃ vadanti|
Sa. sannipātād abhighātād vā nāsā pūyāsṛk sravet| tat pūyaraktas aṃjñaṃ śirodāharujākaram ākhyātam|

lg.l: kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat||25||

div.ab: Sa. pittaśleṣmāvaruddho vāyur antar nāsāyāṃ śoṣayet kapham| sa ca-kaphaḥ, śuṣka(:) puṭatāṃ prāpnoti| puṭakaṃ tad ucyate|

arśorbudāni vibhajed doṣaliṅgair yathāyatham|
sarveṣu kṛcchrocchvasanaṃ pīnasaḥ pratataṃ kṣutiḥ||26||
sānunāsikavāditvaṃ pūtināsaḥ śirovyathā| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. arśāṃsy arbudāni ca doṣaliṅgair yathāsvaṃ jānīyat| sarveṣu-arśaḥsv arbudeṣu ca, kṛcchrād ucchvasanam| tathā pīnaso 'navarataṃ kṣavaḥ, tathā sānunāsikabhāṣitaṃ, tathā pūtināsaḥ śirovyatheti syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
aṣṭādaśānām ity eṣāṃ yāpayed duṣṭapīnasam|27| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogavijñānīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|19|

Sa. eṣām aṣṭādaśānāṃ pīnasādīnāṃ madhye duṣṭapīnasaṃ yāpayed iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogavijñānīyo nāmaikonaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 19||

div.head: nāsārogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
adhunā nāsācikitsābhaṇanāvasara ity āha ---- athāto nāsārogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) sarveṣu pīnaseṣv ādau nivātāgārago bhajet|
snehanasvedavamanadhūmagaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||1||
vāso gurūṣṇaṃ śirasaḥ sughanaṃ pariveṣṭanam|
laghvamlalavaṇaṃ snigdham uṣṇaṃ bhojanam adravam||2||
dhanvamāṃsaguḍakṣīracaṇakatrikaṭūtkaṭam|
yavagodhūmabhūyiṣṭhaṃ dadhidāḍimasārikam||3||
bālamūlakajo yūṣaḥ kulatthotthaś ca pūjitaḥ|
kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet||4||
jighrec corakatarkārīvacājājyupakuñcikāḥ| ----------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. pīnaseṣv akhileṣv api nivātaveśmasthitaḥ san snehanasvedanavamanadhūmān gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaṃ ca sevet| tathā vastraṃ gurūṣṇasvabhāvaṃ kauśeyāvikādibhir mūrdhnaḥ pariveṣṭanaṃ sughanaṃ bhajet| tathā bhojanaṃ laghvādiguṇaṃ bhajet| dāḍimaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ-dāḍimasāram| dadhidāḍimasādhitam iti kecit paṭhanti| bālamūlakottho yūṣaḥ kulatthajaś ca yūṣaḥ pūjitaḥ| daśamūlāmbu koṣṇaṃ prasannāṃ vā jīrṇāṃ-purāṇāṃ, pibet| corakādīn jighret|

----------------------------------------------|
vyoṣatālīsacavikātintiḍīkāmlavetasam||5||
sāgnyajāji dvipalikaṃ tvagelāpatrapādikam|
jīrṇād guḍāt tulārdhena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtam||6||
pīnasaśvāsakāsaghnaṃ rucisvarakaraṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. vyoṣādikaṃ pṛthak dvipaladadhnaṃ, tvagādikaṃ dvikārṣikaṃ, purāṇaguḍena pañcāśatpalapramāṇena pakvena vaṭakīkṛtam etat pīnasādihṛt paraṃ rucyādikṛt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
śatāhvātvag''balā mūlaṃ syonākairaṇḍabilvajam||7||

div.ab: Sa. śatāhvādikaṃ vasādiyutaṃ dhūmaṃ pibet| mallakasampuṭe vā saktūn sasarpiṣkān kṛtvā dhūmaṃ pibet|
tyajet snānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam| ----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. snānādīni tyajet|

ab.seg:
iti sāmānyena cikitsām abhidhāya viśeṣeṇāha ---- ----------------------------------------------|
pibed vātapratiśyāye sarpir vātaghnasādhitam||9||

div.ab: Sa. vātapratiśyāye vātaghnaiḥ-rāsnādibhiḥ, sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| saindhavādibhiḥ pañcabhir lavaṇair vā siddhaṃ, 'vidāripañcāṅgula' (hṛ. sū. a. 15|9) ity ādinā vā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet| tathā, arditoktāṃ cikitsāṃ svedādikāṃ kuryāt|

lg.l: pariṣekān pradehāṃś ca śītaiḥ kurvīta śītalān||11||
kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet||12||

div.ab: Sa. pittotthe raktaje ca pratiśyāye madhuradravyaiḥ śṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pātavyam| pariṣekādīn śītavīryaiḥ śītalān kuryāt| dhavatvagādibhis tailaṃ kṣīre daśaguṇe haridrānvitair nāvanaṃ pacet|

lg.l: sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pītvā vamet, piṣṭais tu nāvanam||13||
kaṭutīkṣṇair ghṛtair nasyaiḥ kavalaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje laṅghanaṃ hitam| tathā śiraso gaurasarṣapair lepaḥ| ghṛtaṃ sayavakṣāraṃ pītvā vamet| chāgamūtreṇa ca piṣṭaiḥ saindhavādibhir nasyaṃ hitam| ghṛtaiḥ kaṭutīkṣṇair nasyaiḥ kavalaiś ca sānnipātikaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ jayet|

lg.l: kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet||17||

div.ab: Sa. duṣṭapīnasaṃ yāpayet, yakṣmaharaṃ kṛmiharaṃ ca cikitsitaṃ kurvan| vyoṣādiśigruphalāntāni turagaviḍ''rasamūtrābhyāṃ hastimūtreṇa caikataḥ piṣṭāni kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ nāsayā mukhena ca pibet|

kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam|
śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhakaṇāvelladrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat||18||
sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut| ----------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca roge tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam| śuṇṭhyādikalkakvāthavat tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ nasyaṃ kṣavaṃ puṭaṃ ca hanti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānādau bhojanaṃ rasaiḥ||19||

lg.l: snigdho dhūmas tathā svedo nāsānāhe 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ|
pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau||20||

div.ab: Sa. nāsāśoṣe balātailaṃ pānanasyādau hitam| bhojanaṃ māṃsarasair hitam| tathā snigdho dhūmaḥ svedaś ca hitaḥ| nāsānāhe 'py eṣa eva vidhiḥ-cikitsety arthaḥ| nāsāpāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ cikitsitam| saṃsrutau-srāve, tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi hitam|

kaphapīnasavat pūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kriyā|
lākṣākarañjamaricavellahiṅgukaṇāguḍaiḥ||21||
avimūtradrutair nasyaṃ kārayed vamane kṛte|
śigrusiṃhīnikumbhānāṃ bījaiḥ savyoṣasaindhavaiḥ||22||
savellasurasais tailaṃ nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam| ----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pūtināsāpīnasayoḥ kaphapīnasavad upakramaḥ| lākṣādibhir urabhramūtradrutaiḥ kṛte vamane nasyaṃ kārayet| śigrvādīnāṃ bījair vyoṣādiyutais tailaṃ pakvaṃ pūtināsāpīnasayor nasyaṃ hitam|
Sa. pūyarakte navotthe raktapīnasa iva cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| atipravṛddhe cāsmin nāḍīvraṇavad upakramaḥ|

---------------------dagdheṣv arśorbudeṣu ca|
nikumbhakumbhasindhūtthamanohvālakaṇāgnikaiḥ|24|
kalkitair ghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet|
śigrvādi nāvanaṃ cātra pūtināsoditaṃ bhajet|25| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogapratiṣedho nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|20|

Sa. arśorbudeṣu ca dagdheṣu nikumbhādibhiḥ
kalkitair ghṛtamadhvaktāṃ ghrāṇe vartiṃ praveśayet|
śigrvādikaṃ ca nasyaṃ pūtināsoktaṃ bhajed iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne nāsārogapratiṣedho nāma viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 20||

div.head: mukharogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
kramaprāptaṃ mukharogavijñānam abhidhitsur āha ---- athato mukharogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitāmakamūlakam|
māṣasūpadadhikṣīrasuktekṣurasaphāṇitam||1||
avākśayyāṃ ca bhajato dviṣato dantadhāvanam|
dhūmarcchardanagaṇḍūṣān ucitaṃ ca sirāvyadham||2||
kṛddhāḥ śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kurvanty antarmukhaṃ gadān| ---------------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. mātsyamāhiṣavārāhapiśitādi bhajato dantadhāvanaṃ dviṣataḥ-asevamānasya, dhūmādikaṃ cocitaṃ dviṣataḥ, sirāvyadhaṃ ca dviṣataḥ, śleṣmolbaṇā doṣāḥ kṛddhā mukhasyāntare gadān kurvanti|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
tatra khaṇḍauṣṭha ity ukto vātenauṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. teṣu mukharogeṣu madhye pavanād oṣṭho dvidhā kṛtaḥ khaṇḍauṣṭha iti gaditaḥ|

lg.l: oṣṭhakope tu pavanāt stabdhāv oṣṭhau mahārujau|

div.ab: Sa. pavanād oṣṭhakope tv oṣṭhau stabdhau mahārujau dālyete tathā paripāṭyete iva| tathā paruṣau kṛṣṇau rūkṣau dṛśyete|
pittāt tīkṣṇāsahau pītau sarṣapākṛtibhiś citau| piṭikābhir bahukledāv āśupākau--------------------|5|
Sa. pittenauṣṭhau tīkṣṇaṃ na sahete| pītau ca syātām| tathā ca sarṣapākṛtibhiḥ piṭikābhiś citau bahukledau śīghrapākau ca|
Sa. kaphena śītāsahau guru śūnau savarṇaiḥ piṭakair ācitau syātām|

---------------------------------------------------|
sannipātād anekābhau durgandhāsrāvapicchilau||6||
akasmān mlānasaṃśūnarujau viṣamapākinau| ---------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. sannipātād oṣṭhau nānāvarṇapiṭakair ācitau durgandhasrāvapicchilau sahasaiva mlānau kadācit saṃśūnau viṣamapākinau vā|

---------------------------------------------------|
raktopasṛṣṭau rudhiraṃ sravataḥ śoṇitaprabhau||7||
kharjūrasadṛśaṃ cātra kṣīṇe rakte 'rbudaṃ bhavet| ---------------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. saṃ-raktena yuktau rudhiraṃ sravantau raktaprabhau ca| kṣīṇe rakte kharjūrākāram arbudam oṣṭhau syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
māṃsapiṇḍopamau māṃsāt syātāṃ mūrcchatkṛmī kramāt||8||

div.ab: Sa. māṃsena māṃsapiṇḍopamāv oṣṭhau| krameṇa ca mūrcchatkṛmī syātām| mūrcchanti kṛmayo yayor iti mūrcchatkṛmī| tayoḥ kṛmayo jāyanta ity arthaḥ|

tailābhaśvayathukledau sakaṇḍvau medasā mṛdū|
kṣatajāv avatīryete pāṭyete cāsakṛt punaḥ||9||
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau| -------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. medasā tailābhaḥ śophaḥ kledaś ca yayos tāv evam| tathā kaṇḍūyutau mṛdū cauṣṭhau syātām| kṣatajāv asakṛd avadīryete paripāṭyete-bhedyete iva, grathitau ca punar oṣṭhau syātāṃ sakaṇḍūkau ca|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
jalabudbudavad vātakaphād oṣṭhe jalārbudam||10||

div.ab: Sa. vātakaphāt jalabudbudākāraṃ jalārbudam oṣṭhe syāt| ity ekādaśa oṣṭhe|
gaṇḍālajī sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍe dāhajvarānvitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. sthiraḥ śopho gaṇḍapradeśe dāhajvarayuto gaṇḍālajīty ucyate| ity eko gaṇḍe|

-------------------------------------------------|
vātād uṣṇasahā dantāḥ śītasparśe 'dhikavyathāḥ||11||
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaś ca saḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. vātena dantā uṣṇasahāḥ śītasparśe 'dhikavyathāḥ, śūlena dālyanta iva ca| asau śītadantasaṃjño dālanaś coktaḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
dantaharṣe pravātāmlaśītabhakṣākṣamā dvijāḥ||12||

div.ab: Sa. dantaharṣe pracaṇḍavātasyāmlaśītabhakṣasyā (sya cā)- sahāḥ, dvijāḥ tathā'mlāśaneneva sarujāś cilitā iva ca syuḥ| dantabhede dantās todādiyutāḥ syuḥ|
Sa. cālākhyo rogo dantaiś ca caladbhir bhakṣaṇād adhikavyathaiś ca syāt| karālānāṃ dantānāṃ samudgamaḥ karālākhyo rogaḥ|

lg.l: jāyamāne 'tirug dante, jāte tatra tu śāmyati||15||

div.ab: Sa. adhiko danto 'dhidantasaṃjño rogaḥ| vardhanaś ca sa evoktaḥ| jāyamāne tasmin dante 'tipīḍā jāyate| jāte tu tasmin pīḍā śāmyati|
adhāvanāmalo dante kapho vā vātaśoṣitaḥ| pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ śarkarā----------|16|
Sa. adhāvanād dante malaḥ kapho vā pavanena śoṣitaḥ pūtigandhiḥ sthirībhūtaḥ| sa evopekṣitaḥ śarkarā syāt|
Sa. kapālikākhyo dantāt kapālāny aṇuśaḥ-stokaṃ stokaṃ, śātayati|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
śyāvaḥ śyāvatvam āyāto raktapittānilair dvijaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. dvijaḥ śyāvatvam āyāto raktapittānilaiḥ śyāvākhyaḥ|

samūlaṃ dantam āśritya doṣair ulbaṇamārutaiḥ|
śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante 'nnamalapūrite||18||
pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante, jāyate tataḥ|
ahetutīvrārtiśamaḥ sasaṃrambho 'sitaś calaḥ||19||
pralūnaḥ pūyaraktasrut sa coktaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. samūlaṃ dantam āśritya doṣair adhikamārutaiḥ śoṣite majjñi suṣire dante 'nnamalapūrite pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā jāyante| tato 'hetu-nimittam antareṇa, tīvrārtiśāntir jāyate| tathā saṃrambhānvitaḥ kṛṣṇaś calaḥ pralūnākhyaḥ pūyaraktasrāvī| sa ca kṛmidantaka uktaḥ| iti dante daśaite|

-------------------------------------------------|
śleṣmaraktena pūtīni vahanty asram ahetukam||20||
śīryante dantamāṃsāni mṛduklinnāsitāni ca| śītādo 'sau---------------------------------|21|
Sa. śleṣmaraktena dantamāṃsāni pūtīni raktaṃ nirnimittaṃ vahanti śīryante| kimbhūtāni ? mṛduklinnāni asitāni ca| asau śītādaḥ kathyate|

-------------------------------------------------| ---------------upakuśaḥ pākaḥ pittāsṛgudbhavaḥ||21||
dantamāmsāni dahyante raktāny utsedhavanty ataḥ|
kaṇḍūmanti sravanty asram ādhmāyante 'sṛji sthite||22||
calā mandarujo dantā pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate| -------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. pittaraktottho yo dantamāṃse pākaḥ sa upakuśasaṃjñaḥ| tena dantamāṃsāni dahyante raktavarṇāni sotsedhāni ca| tataḥ kaṇḍūyutāni raktaṃ sravanti| rakte sthite saty ādhmāyante| calā dantā mandarujaḥ syuḥ| pūti vaktraṃ ca jāyate|

-------------------------------------------------|
dantayos triṣu vā śopho badarāsthinibho ghanaḥ||23||
kaphāsrāt tīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate dantapuppuṭaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. dvayor dantayos triṣu va danteṣu śopho badarāsthisadṛśo ghanaḥ kapharaktāt tīvraruk śīghraṃ pacyate| sa dantapuppuṭasaṃjñaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
dantamāṃse malaiḥ sāsrair bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur guruḥ||24||
sarugdāhaḥ sraved bhinnaḥ pūyāsraṃ dantavidradhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. dantamāṃse bāhye 'bhyantare ca doṣaiḥ saraktair guruḥ śvayathuḥ sarugdāhaḥ| sa ca bhinnaḥ san pūyāsraṃ sravet| sa dantāvidradhiḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
śvayathur dantamūleṣu rujāvān pittaraktajaḥ||25||
lālāsrāvī sa suṣiro dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. saṃ-dantamūleṣu śvayathuḥ pīḍāvān pittaraktottho lālāsrāvī| suṣirasaṃjño dantamāṃsapraśātanaḥ

-------------------------------------------------|
sa sannipātāj jvaravān sapūyarudhirasrutiḥ||26||
mahāsuṣira ity ukto viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. sannipātajvarayutaḥ pūyarudhirasrāvenānvitaḥ mahāsuṣirākhya uktaḥ| sa ca viśīrṇadvijabandhanaḥ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
dantānte kīlavac chopho hanukarṇarujākaraḥ||27||
pratihanty abhyavahṛtiṃ śleṣmaṇā so 'dhimāṃsakaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. dantānte kīlasadṛśaḥ śopho hanau karṇe ca rujāṃ karoti| abhyavahṛtiṃ pratihanti| so 'dhimāṃsakaḥ śleṣmaṇā syāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
ghṛṣṭeṣu dantamāṃseṣu saṃrambho jāyate mahān||28||
yasmiṃś calanti dantāś ca sa vidarbho 'bhighātajaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. dantamāṃseṣu dantakāṣṭhādinā ghṛṣṭeṣu mahān saṃrambho jāyate| yasmin sati dantāś ca calanti| so 'bhighātajo vidarbhākhyaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
dantamāṃsāśritān rogān yaḥ sādhyān apy upekṣate||29||
antas tasyāsravan doṣaḥ sūkṣmāṃ sañjanayed gatim|
pūyaṃ muhuḥ sā sravati tvaṅmāṃsāsthiprabhedinī||30||
tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā lakṣaṇaiḥ svair yathoditaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. dantamāṃsāśritān rogān sādhyān api ya upekṣate, tasyāntareṣu doṣo 'sravan sūkṣmāṃ gatiṃ sañjanayet| sā ca gatiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pūyaṃ sravati| tvaṅmāṃsāsthīni prabhinatti| tāś ca gatayaḥ pañca vijñeyāḥ svaiḥ svair vātādijair lakṣaṇaiḥ| iti dantamūle trayodaśa|

-------------------------------------------------|
śākhapatrakharā suptā sphuṭitā vātadūṣitā||31||
jihvā pittāt sadāhoṣā raktair māsāṅkuraiś citā| -------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. vātadūṣitā jihvā śākapatravat kharā suptā sphuṭitā ca syāt| pittāt sadāhoṣā tathā raktair māṃsāṅkuraiś ca citā jihvā syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
śālmalīkaṇṭakābhais tu kaphena bahalā guruḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. kaphena śālmalīkaṇṭakābhaiḥ kaṇṭakaiś citā bahalā guruś ca jihvā syāt|
Sa. kaphapittāt jihvāyā adhaḥ śopho jihvāstambhakara unnataḥ pakvo matsyagandhir bhavet| so 'lasākhyo māṃsaśātanaḥ|

lg.l: tādṛg evopajihvas tu jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. jihvāyāḥ prabandhane 'dhastāj jihvāgratulyaḥ śophaḥ sahāṅkuraḥ kaphapittaraktair lāloṣāstambhayutaḥ kharasparśayuto 'dhijihvo rukkaṇḍūbhyāṃ yuto vākyāhāravighātaṃ karoti| tādṛg eva-adhijihvāsadṛśa upajihvaḥ, jihvāyā upari sthitaḥ| iti jihvāyāḥ ṣaḍ ete|

lg.l: bahyo ghanāḥ srāvayutās tās tālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ||36||

div.ab: Sa. vātāt tālumāṃse duṣṭe piṭikāḥ sarujaḥ kharā bahyo ghanāḥ srāvānvitāś ca| tās tālupiṭikāḥ smṛtāḥ|

tālumūle kaphāt sāsrāt matsyabastinibho mṛduḥ|
pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayā''hāram īrayan||37||
kaṇṭhoparodhatṛṭkāsavamikṛt galaśuṇḍikā| -------------------------------------------------|38|
