Sa. saṃ-tālumūle kaphād raktānvitāt matsyabastisadṛśo mṛduḥ pralambaḥ picchilaḥ śopho nāsayā''hāraṃ prerayan kaṇṭhoparodhādikṛt| gulaśuṇḍikākhyaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
tālumadhye niruṅmāṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ tālusaṃhatiḥ||38||
padmākṛtis tālumadhye raktāc chvayathur arbudam| -------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. tālumadhye niruṅmāṃsaṃ saṃhataṃ sā tālusaṃhatir ity ucyate| tālumadhye padmākāro raktād duṣṭāc chvayathur arbudam|

-------------------------------------------------|
kacchapaḥ kacchapākāraś ciravṛddhiḥ kaphād aruk||39||
kolābhaḥ śleṣmamedobhyāṃ puppuṭo nīrujaḥ sthiraḥ| -------------------------------------------------|40|

Sa. padārthacandrikā-kaphād duṣṭāt tāludeśe yaḥ śvayathuḥ kacchapākāraś ciravṛddhir aruk ca, sa kacchapa ity ucyate| p cśleṣmamedobhyāṃ duṣṭābhyāṃ kolābhaḥ-kolasadṛśo, nīrujaḥ sthiraś ca yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa puppuṭa ity ucyate|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
pittena pākaḥ pākākhyaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ||40||

div.ab: Sa. p cpittena duṣṭena yas tālunaḥ pākaḥ pūyāsrāvī mahārujaḥ, sa pākākhyaḥ-pākasaṃjñaḥ|
vātapittajvarāyāsais tāluśoṣas tadāhvayaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|41|
Sa. p cvātapittajvarāyāsaiḥ pratibaddho yaḥ śoṣas tāluśoṣaḥ, sa tadāhvayaḥ-tāluśoṣa ity ucyate| ity aṣṭau tālurogāḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
jihvāprabandhajāḥ kaṇṭhe dāruṇā mārgarodhinaḥ||41||
māṃsāṅkurāḥ śīghracayā rohiṇī śīghrakāriṇī| -------------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. p ckaṇṭhe-kaṇṭhapradeśe, ye māṃsāṅkurā jihvāprabandhajāḥ-jihvāmūlotthāḥ, dāruṇāḥ-duḥsahāḥ, kaṇṭhamārgānurodhinaḥ śīghracayāḥ-satvarodbhūtāḥ, bhavanti| sā śīghrakāriṇī-āśuvyāpādanaśīlā, rohiṇīty ucyate|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣakṛd vātāt sā hanuśrotrarukkarī||42||

div.ab: Sa. p csā-rohiṇī, vātāt samutpannā kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaṃ karoti| hanvoḥ śrotrayoś ca rujaṃ karoti|

pittāj jvaroṣātṛṇmohakaṇṭhadhūmāyanānvitā|
kṣiprajā kṣiprapākā'tirāgiṇī sparśanāsahā||43||
kaphena picchilā pāṇḍuḥ------------------------| -------------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. p cpittād rohiṇī jvarādibhir anvitā syāt| kṣiprajā-śīghrotthānā| śīghrapākā atirāgiṇī-bhṛśalohitā| sparśanāsahā-sparśaṃ na sahate| paṃ caṃ-kaphena duṣṭena rohiṇī picchilā pāṇḍurā ca bhavet|

ab.seg:
--------------------------asṛjā sphoṭakācitā|
taptāṅgāranibhā karṇarukkarī pittajākṛtiḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. p casṛjā-raktena duṣṭena, rohiṇī sphoṭakair ācitā samantāt vyāptā syāt| taptāṅgāranibhā-varṇataḥ sparśato vā, karṇayo rujāṃ karoti| pittajākṛtiḥ-pittottharohiṇīlakṣaṇasamanvitā bhavet|

gambhīrapākā nicayāt sarvaliṅgasamanvitā|
doṣaiḥ kapholbaṇaiḥ śophaḥ kolavad grathitonnataḥ||45||
śūkakaṇṭakavat kaṇṭhe śālūko mārgarodhanaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|46|

Sa. p cnicayāt-sannipātāt, rohiṇī gambhīrapākāgūḍhapākā, syāt| sarvaliṅgaiḥ-vātādīnāṃ sambandhibhiḥ, samanvitā-yuktā, syāt| p cdoṣaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, kapholbaṇaiḥ-kaphapradhānaiḥ, kaṇṭhe kolavad grathitonnataḥ śūkakaṇṭakavat mārgarodhano yaḥ śophaḥ syāt, sa kaṇṭhaśālūka ity ucyate|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
vṛndo vṛttonnato dāhajvarakṛd galapārśvagaḥ||46||

div.ab: Sa. p ckaṇṭhe vṛttonnato galapārśvago yaḥ śopho bhavati, dāhajvaraṃ karoti, sa nāmnā vṛnda ity ucyate| p ckaṇṭhapradeśe śophaḥ kārpāsyāḥ phalasannibhaḥ-tadākāraḥ, picchilo mandaruk śophaḥ kaṭhinaś ca| sa nāmnā tuṇḍikerikety ucyate|

bāhyāntaḥ śvayathur ghoro galamārgārgalopamaḥ|
galaugho mūrddhagurutātandrālālājvarapradaḥ||48||
valayaṃ nātiruk śophas tadvad evāyatonnataḥ| -------------------------------------------------|49|

Sa. p ckaṇṭhe śvayathur bāhyāntar ghoro-dustaro, galamārgārgalopamaḥ-sa iva, jāyate| mūrddhagurutādīṃś ca pradadāti| sa galaugha ity ucyate| p cgale yaḥ śopho nātiruk āyatonnataḥ syāt, sa vyādhir valayam ity ucyate| tadvad eva-valayākṛtitvāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
māṃsakīlo gale doṣair eko 'neko 'thavā'lparuk||49||
kṛcchrocchvāsābhyavahṛtiḥ pṛthumūlo gilāyukaḥ|
bhūrimāṃsaṅkuravṛtā tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharuk||50||
śataghnī nicitā vartiḥ śataghnīvātirukvarī| -------------------------------------------------|51|

Sa. p cdoṣaiḥ vātādibhir duṣṭaiḥ, gale māṃsakīla eko 'neko vā'lparug jāto mūle pṛthuḥ-vistīrṇaḥ, kṛcchrāt-duḥkhena, ucchvāsābhyavahṛtirya(tī ya)sya saḥ| tathāvidho vyādhir gilāyuka ity ucyate| p cbhūribhiḥ-prabhūtaiḥ, māṃsāṅkurair āvṛtā-parivṛtā, tīvratṛḍjvaramūrddharugyutā vṛttā yā vartiḥ sā śataghnī| nicayāt sañcayaṃ prāptā śataghnīvac cātirukkarī| sa vyādhir nāmnā śataghnīty ucyate| śataghnī-śastraviśeṣaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
vyāptasarvagalaḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ||51||
pūtipūyanibhasrāvī śvayathur galavidradhiḥ|
jihvāvasāne kaṇṭhādāv apākaṃ śvayathuṃ malāḥ||52||
janayanti sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ tad galārbudam| -------------------------------------------------|53|

Sa. p cvyāptaḥ sarvagalaḥ-kaṇṭho, yeneti| evaṃvidho yaḥ śvayathuḥ śīghrajanmapāko mahārujaḥ pūti-durgandhi, pūyasadṛśaṃ sravati malaṃ,sa galavidradhir ity ucyate| p cjihvāvasāne-paryante, kaṇṭhādau śvayathum apākaṃ sthiraṃ raktaṃ nīrujaṃ malāḥ-doṣāḥ, janayanti| tad galārbudaṃ smṛtam|

lg.l: kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa vātāt kṛṣṇarājimān|
vṛddhas tālugale śoṣaṃ kuryāc ca virasāsyatām||54||

div.ab: Sa. p cduṣṭaiḥ pavanaśleṣmamedobhir galasya bahir galagaṇḍo nāma vyādhir bhavet| sa ca kālena vivardhamāno

lg.l: sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt|
vṛddhas tālugale lepaṃ kuryāc ca madhurāsyatām||55||

div.ab: Sa. p ckaphāt prakupitāt gale galagaṇḍo jātaḥ sthiraḥ samānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍumān śītasparśo guruś ca bhavet| vṛddhaḥ san tālugale lepaṃ kuryāt| tathā madhurāsyatāṃ-madhuravaktratvaṃ ca, kuryāt|

lg.l: dehaṃ vṛddhaś ca kurute gale śabdaṃ svare 'lpatām||56||

div.ab: Sa. p cmedasaḥ pravṛddhād utpanno galagaṇḍaḥ kaphaval lakṣaṇair bhavet| sa ca dehaṃ-śarīraṃ, hānivṛddhyor anuvidhīyate-anukaroti| tena dehasya vṛddhau so 'pi vṛddho bhavet, dehasya kṣayāt kṣīṇaḥ syāt| vṛddhaḥ sa gale śabdaṃ kurute svare cālpatām|

lg.l: tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahā'nilāt||57||

div.ab: Sa. p cśleṣmaṇā duṣṭena yadā'nilasya-vāyoḥ, gatiḥ ruddhā bhavet| tathā sa ca yena vyādhinā puruṣaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭho hatasvaraś ca syāt| te(ye)na ca tāmyan-tamogacchan tamaḥpraviśan, prakarṣeṇa saktaṃ śvāsaṃ muñcati| sa vyādhir anilāt-vātāt, svarahāsvaraghnanāmnā, bhavet| iti galarogā aṣṭādaśa|

lg.l: vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ||59||

div.ab: Sa. p canilo-vāyuḥ, sarvasaraḥ-sarvataḥ prasaran san, sarvato vadanasyāntar vraṇān sañcāriṇo 'ruṇān rūkṣāṃś ca karoti| tathauṣṭhau tāmrau-tāmravarṇau, calatvacau| jihvā ca śītāsahā śītasparśākṣamā, gurvī sphuṭitā kaṇṭakair ācitā syāt| sa ca mukhaṃ-vaktraṃ, kṛcchreṇa vivṛṇoti| sa mukhasya pāka ity ucyate|

lg.l: yāty ūrdhvaṃ vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvann ūrdhvagudas tu saḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. p carśogulmakaphādibhir vāyur adhaḥ pratihato vaktradaurgandhyaṃ kurvann ūrdhvaṃ yāti| sa ūrdhvaguda iti saṃjñitaḥ|

Sa. p cpittaje-pittodbhave, mukhasya pāke dāhoṣe bhavataḥ| tathā tiktavaktratā-tiktāsyatvaṃ, bhavet| vraṇāś ca kṣāreṇokṣitaṃ yat kṣataṃ-vraṇaḥ, tena samānāḥ-tatsamarujāḥ, bhavanti| paṃ caṃ-raktaje pāke mukhasyāntaḥ pittajapākaval lakṣaṇāni bhavanti|

kaphaje madhurāsyatvaṃ kaṇḍūmatpicchilā vraṇāḥ|
antaḥkapolam āśritya śyāvapāṇḍu kapho 'rbudam||62||
kuryāt tad ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate| -------------------------------------------------|63|

Sa. p ckaphaje pāke madhurāsyatvaṃ-madhuramukhatvaṃ, syāt| tathā kaṇḍūmatpicchilāś ca vraṇā bhavanti| p ckapho vṛddho 'ntaḥkapolam āśrityārbudaṃ śyāvaṃ pāṇḍu ca kuryāt| tac cārbudaṃ ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca punar vivardhate|

-------------------------------------------------|
mukhapāko bhavet sāsraiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvākṛtir malaiḥ||63||
pūtyāsyatā ca tair eva dantakāṣṭhādividviṣaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|64|

Sa. p cmalaiḥ-vātādibhiḥ, sarvaiḥ-tribhiḥ, sāsraiḥ-saraktaiḥ, mukhasya pāko bhavet| sa ca sarvākṛtiḥ-sarvalakṣaṇaḥ, syāt| p cdantakāṣṭhavidviṣaḥ puṃsas tair eva doṣaiḥ pūtyāsyatāpūtivaktratvaṃ, syāt| [iti sarvavaktragā aṣṭau|]

-------------------------------------------------|
oṣṭe gaṇḍe dvije mūle jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale||64||
vaktre sarvatra cety uktāḥ pañcasaptatir āmayāḥ|
ekādaśaiko daśa ca trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ||65|| aṣṭāv aṣṭādaśāṣṭau ca kramāt-----------------| -------------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. p coṣṭhāmayā ekādaśoktāḥ| gaṇḍe ekaḥ| dvijedante, daśa| dantamūle trayodaśa| jihvāyāṃ ṣaṭ| tāluny aṣṭau| gale 'ṣṭadaśa| vaktre 'ṣṭav āmayāḥ| evaṃ sarvatra pañcasaptatir āmayā ākhyātāḥ-uktāḥ|

----------------------------teṣv anupakramāḥ|
karālo māṃsaraktauṣṭhāv arbudāni jalād vinā|66|
kacchapas tālupiṭikā galaughaḥ suṣiro mahān|
svaraghnordhvagudaśyāvaśataghnīvalayālasāḥ|67|
nāḍyoṣṭhakopau nicayāt, raktāt sarvaiś ca rohiṇī|
daśane sphuṭite dantabhedaḥ, pakvopajihvikā|68|
galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśī kṛcchrocchvāso 'tivatsaraḥ|
yāpyas tu harṣo bhedaś ca śeṣān śastrauṣadhair jayet|69| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne mukharogavijñānīyo nāmai- kaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|21|

Sa. p coṣṭhādyāmayeṣu madhye 'nupakramāḥ-asādhyāḥ| karālo nāma dantarogaḥ| mahāsuṣiro dantarogaḥ| svaraghno galarogaḥ| ūrdhvagudo vaktrarogaḥ| śataghnīvalayau kaṇṭharogau| alaso 'dhijihvārogaḥ| nicayāt-sannipātāt, nāḍī dantamūlajā| oṣṭhakopaḥ sannipātajo 'sādhyaḥ| raktāt sannipātāt [ca] jātā rohiṇī| dantabhedo daśane-dante, sphuṭite 'sādhyaḥ| pakvopajihvikā'sādhyā| galagaṇḍaḥ svarabhraṃśaḥ(śī)kṛcchrocchvāso 'tivatsaro 'sādhyaḥ| p cdantaharṣo dantabhedaś ca dvāv etau yāpyau| p cśeṣān rogān śastrauṣadhair jayet| yathāyogair vakṣyamāṇair iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mukharoga- vijñānīyo nāmaikaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 21||

div.head: mukharogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
athāto mukharogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
) khaṇḍauṣṭhasya vilikhyāntau syūtvā vraṇavad ācaret| -------------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. p ckhāṇḍauṣṭhasya-chinnauṣṭhasya snigdhasvinnasya, oṣṭhaprāntau vilikhya suṣliṣṭau kṣaumasūtreṇa syūtvā sadyovraṇavad upacāraṃ kuryāt,-śatadhautaghṛtābhyaktāṃ vraṇasyopari kavalikāṃ dadyāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭijyotiṣmatīrodhraśrāvaṇīsārivotpalaiḥ||1||

lg.l: paṭolyā kākamācyā ca tailam abhyañjanaṃ pacet|

div.ab: Sa. p cmadhuyaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkitais tailam abhyañjanaṃ pacet| p cvātaharamadhurauṣadhasādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ prayojyam|

mahāsnehena vātauṣṭhe siddhenāktaḥ picur hitaḥ|
devadhūpamadhūcchiṣṭaguggulvamaradārubhiḥ||3||
yaṣṭyāhvacūrṇayuktena tenaiva pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. p csarjarasasikthakagugguludevadārubhiḥ siddhena mahāsnehena-sarpirmajjavasātailākhyenāktaḥ, picur vātauṣṭhe-vātaja oṣṭhakope, hitaḥ| p ctenaiva-mahāsnehena, madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayuktena vātauṣṭhe vā pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|

-------------------------------------------------|
nāḍyoṣṭhaṃ svedayed dugdhasiddhair eraṇḍapallavaiḥ||4||
khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ nasyaṃ tasya mūrdhni ca tarpaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. p c oṣṭhaṃ-vātauṣṭhaṃ, dugdhasiddhair eraṇḍapallavair nāḍyā svedayet| paṃ caṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhavihitaṃ-khaṇḍauṣṭhoktaṃ, nasyaṃ prayojyam| tathā tasya mūrdhni tarpaṇaṃ-śirobhyaṅgaḥ, kāryaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
pittābhighātajāv oṣṭhau jalaukobhir upācaret||5||
rodhrasarjarasakṣaudramadhukaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. p cpittajam abhighātajam o(jaṃ cau)ṣṭhakopaṃ jalaukobhir upācaret-cikitset tābhī raktaṃ srāvayet| p cpittotthe 'bhighātaje cauṣṭhakope rodhrādibhiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam|

-------------------------------------------------|
guḍūcīyaṣṭipattaṅgasiddham abhyañjane ghṛtam||6||
pittavidradhivac cātra kriyā śoṇitaje 'pi ca| idam eva nave kāryaṃ karma---------------------|7|

Sa. p cguḍūcyādibhiḥ kalkitair ghṛtaṃ siddham abhyañjane hitam| p catra-[e]tayoḥ pittābhighātajayoḥ, pittavidradhivat kriyā-cikitsā, kāryā| paṃ caṃ-śoṇitaje rakto(navo)tthe idam eva-pittoktaṃ, karma kāryam|
Sa. kaphātura oṣṭhe hṛtāsre-hṛtarakte, pāṭhādibhiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| tathā dhūmādayaḥ kaphaghnā hitāḥ|

svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vimedaskaṃ dahen medojam agninā|
priyaṅgurodhratriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet||9||
sakṣaudrā gharṣaṇaṃ tīkṣṇā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude|
avagāḍhe 'tivṛddhe vā kṣāro 'gnir vā pratikriyā||10||
āmādyavasthāsv alajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavad ācaret| -------------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. medojam oṣṭhaṃ svinnaṃ bhinnaṃ-vidāritaṃ, vigatamedasaṃ santam agninā dahet| priyaṅgvādibhiḥ pratisārayet| tīkṣṇāḥ-pippalīmaricādayaḥ, samākṣikā bhinnaśuddhe jalārbude gharṣaṇam| avagāḍhe 'tivṛddhe jalārbude kṣāro 'gnir athavā cikitsitam|

āmādyavasthāsv alajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavad ācaret|
svinnasya śītadantasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ dahet||11||
tailena, pratisāryā ca sakṣaudraghanasaindhavaiḥ|
dāḍimatvagvarātārkṣyakāntājambvasthināgaraiḥ||12||
kavalaḥ kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthair aṇutailaṃ ca nāvanam|
dantaharṣe tathā bhede sarvā vātaharā kriyā||13||
tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. āmādyavasthāsv alajīṃ gaṇḍe śophavad upakramet| śītadantasya svinnasya pālīṃ vilikhitāṃ tailena dahet| dāḍimatvagādibhiḥ kṣaudrādiyutaiḥ pratisāryā ca| kṣīriṇāṃ kvāthaiḥ kavalo hitaḥ| nasyam aṇutailaṃ hitam| dantabhede harṣe ca sarvā vātaghnī kriyā śastā| tilayaṣṭīmadhuśṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sasnehaṃ daśamūlāmbu gaṇḍūṣaḥ pracaladvije||14||

div.ab: Sa. pracaladvije daśamūlāmbu sasnehaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ| tutthādibhir gharṣaṇam| snigdhā nasyādayo 'vasthāvaśād abhyasanīyāḥ|

adhidantakam āliptaṃ yadā kṣāreṇa jarjaram|
kṛmidantam ivotpāṭya tadvac copacaret tadā||16||
anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva kriyā| -------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. adhidantakaṃ kṣāreṇāliptaṃ yadā jarjaraṃ syāt, tadā kṛmidantaṃ yathotpāṭya tathaivopakramet| anavasthitarakte ca dagdhe vraṇa iva cikitsā kāryā|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
ahiṃsan dantamūlāni dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret||17||

lg.l: kapālikāyām apy evaṃ harṣoktaṃ ca samācaret||18||

div.ab: Sa. dantebhyaḥ śarkarāṃ haret, dantamūlāny ahiṃsan-apīḍayan rakṣan| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, śarkarāṃ vilikhya kṣāracūrṇair madhuyutaiḥ pratisārayet| kapālikāyām apy evaṃ-eṣa evopakramaḥ kāryaḥ| dantaharṣoktaṃ ca samācaret|

lg.l: guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madhūcchiṣṭena vā dahet|

div.ab: Sa. kṛmidanatakaṃ svinnam acalaṃ visrāvarṇair visrāvayet(jayet)| tathā snigdhair vātaghnair ālepādibhiḥ| guḍena pūrṇaṃ suṣiraṃ madanena dahed vā| saptaparṇārkakṣīrābhyāṃ pūraṇaṃ hitam| tat kṛmiśūlajit|

lg.l: rajo rujaṃ jayaty āśu vastrasthaṃ daśane dhṛtam||21||
gaṇḍūṣaṃ grāhayet tailam ebhir eva ca sādhitam|

div.ab: Sa. hiṅgvādikaṃ cūrṇaṃ vasanasthitaṃ dante dhṛtaṃ rujāhṛt| ebhir eva-hiṅgvādibhiḥ, kvāthayuktaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ rogiṇaṃ grāhayet| eraṇḍādijaiḥ kvāthair yuktaṃ tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayed vā|

lg.l: dṛḍham apy uddhared dantaṃ pūrvaṃ mūlād vimokṣitam||23||
tailaṃ sayaṣṭyāhvarajo gaṇḍūṣo madhu vā tataḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evamādibhiḥ, kriyāyogair bahuprakāraiḥ kṛtair apy upakramair aśāntapīḍaṃ dantaṃ sudṛḍham api pūrvaṃ mūlād vimokṣitaṃ laghunā sandaṃśakena dantanirghātanena yantreṇa voddharet| anantaraṃ tailaṃ madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayutaṃ gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayet| mākṣikaṃ vā madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇayutam|

tato vidāriyaṣṭyāhvaśṛṅgāṭakakaserubhiḥ|
tailaṃ daśaguṇakṣīraṃ siddhaṃ yuñjīta nāvanam||25||
kṛśadurbalavṛddhānāṃ vātārtānāṃ ca noddharet|
noddharec cottaraṃ dantaṃ bahūpadravakṛd dhi saḥ||26||
eṣām apy uddhṛtau snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|27|

Sa. tato vidāryādibhir daśaguṇakṣīraṃ tailaṃ pakvaṃ nasyaṃ yuñjīta| kṛśādīnāṃ dantaṃ noddharet| uttaraṃ ca dantaṃ noddharet| yasmāt sa uddhṛto bahūpadravakaraḥ| eṣām api dantair uddhṛtaiḥ(dantoddhṛtau) snigdhasvāduśītakramo hitaḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
visrāvitāsre śītāde sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam||27||

div.ab: Sa. visrāvitarakte śītāde mustādibhiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ hitam| teṣāṃ-mustādīnāṃ, kvāthaḥ kavalaḥ| madhuraiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasyam|

dantamāṃsāny upakuśe svinnāny uṣṇāmbudhāraṇaiḥ|
maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrair vā bahuśo likhet||29||
tataś ca pratisāryāṇi ghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ|
lākṣāpriyaṅgupattaṅgalavaṇottamagairikaiḥ||30||
sakuṣṭhaśuṇṭhīmaricayaṣṭīmadhurasāñjanaiḥ|
sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍo tailaṃ vā kavalagrahaḥ||31||
ghṛtaṃ ca madhuraiḥ siddhaṃ hitaṃ kavalanasyayoḥ| -------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. upakuśe dantamāsāni svinnāny uṣṇāmbugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇena| tato maṇḍalāgreṇa śākādipatrair vā bahuśo likhet| tato lākṣādibhir ghṛtamaṇḍamadhudrutaiḥ pratisāraṇīyāni| anantaraṃ sukhoṣṇo ghṛtamaṇḍas tailaṃ vā kavalagrahaḥ| madhuraiś ca pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ kavalanasyayor hitam|

-------------------------------------------------|
dantapuppuṭake svinnachinnabhinnavilekhite||32||
yaṣṭyāhvasvarjikāśuṇṭhīsaindhavaiḥ pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. dantapuppuṭake svinnachinnabhinnavilikhite yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pratisāraṇam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
vidradhau kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaiḥ kavalalepanam||33||

lg.l: rakṣet pākaṃ himaiḥ pakvaḥ pāṭyo dāhyo 'vagāḍhakaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. vidradhau kaṭvādibhiḥ kavalalepanaṃ hitam| kaṭukādibhir gharṣaṇaṃ hitam| himaiḥ-śītalaiḥ, pākaṃ rakṣet| pakvaḥ pāṭanīyaḥ| dāhyo 'vagāḍhaḥ|

suṣire chinnalikhite sakṣaudraiḥ pratisāraṇam|
rodhramustamiśiśreṣṭhātārkṣyapattaṅgakiṃśukaiḥ||35||
sakaṭphalaiḥ, kaṣāyaiś ca teṣāṃ gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate|
yaṣṭīrodhrotpalānantāsārivāgurucandanaiḥ||36||
sagairikasitāpuṇḍraiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. sauṣire chinne likhite ca rodhrādibhir mādhvīkayutaiḥ pratisāraṇam| tair eva kaṣāyair gaṇḍūṣaś ca syāt| yaṣṭyādibhiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ nāvanam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
chittvā'dhimāṃsakaṃ cūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet||37||

div.ab: Sa. adhimāṃsakaṃ chittvā vacādijaiś cūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet| paṭolādikvāthaḥ kavalo hitaḥ|

lg.l: kṣāraṃ yuñjyāt tato nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam||39||

div.ab: Sa. vidarbhe dantamūlāni maṇḍalāgreṇa śodhayet| kṣāraṃ yuñjīta| tato nasyam| gaṇḍūṣādi ca śītalam|

saṃśodhyobhayataḥ kāyaṃ śiraś copacaret tataḥ|
nāḍīṃ dantānugāṃ dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet||40||
kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā|
dhāvanaṃ jātimadanakhadirasvādukaṇṭakaiḥ||41||
kṣīrivṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣo, nasyaṃ tailaṃ ca tatkṛtam| -------------------------------------------------|42|

Sa. ubhayataḥ-ūrdhvam adhaś ca, kāyaṃ mūrdhānaṃ ca, virekeṇa nasyādinā ca saṃśodhya tato nāḍīṃ dantānugām upacaret| dantaṃ samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena samuddhṛtyāgninā dahet| kubjāṃ naikagatiṃ pūrṇāṃ guḍena madanena vā dahet| jātyādibhir dhāvanaṃ hitam| kṣīravṛkṣāmbugaṇḍūṣaḥ| tatpakvaṃ ca tailaṃ nasyam|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
kuryād vātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ kaṇṭakeṣv anilātmasu||42||

lg.l: nave jihvālase 'py evaṃ, taṃ tu śastreṇa na spṛśet||44||

div.ab: Sa. jihvāyāṃ vātottheṣu kaṇṭakeṣu vātauṣṭhakopoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| jihvāyāṃ pittajāteṣu kaṇṭakeṣu ghṛṣṭeṣu rudhire srute pratisāraṇādi madhurair hitam| saṃ-kaphottheṣv apy evaṃ tīkṣṇaiḥ sarṣapādibhiḥ pratisāraṇādi hitam| nave ca jihvālase eṣa evopakramaḥ| kiṃ tu śastreṇainaṃ na spṛśet| etat yuktyā ca pūrveṣāṃ śastrasparśanaṃ kāryam ity anujajñe|
Sa. adhijihvikāṃ baḍiśenākṛṣṭāṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chedayet| kiṃ kṛtvā ? unnamya jihvām| tīkṣṇoṣṇair gharṣaṇādi ca kāryam|
Sa. upajihvāṃ śastreṇa parisrāvya yavakṣāreṇa gharṣayet| śuṇḍikā kaphaghnair nasyādibhiḥ sādhanīyā|

lg.l: chedayen maṇḍalāgreṇa nātyagre na ca mūlataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. vṛddhayāṃ śuṇḍikāyāṃ satyāṃ jihvāyā agre(graṃ) niviṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇadīrghakarkaṭikābījasadṛśaṃ baḍiśādinā'valambitaṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chedayet| katham ? nātiśayena prānte na cātiśayena mūle| yato 'ticchede satyasṛkkṣayān mṛtyuḥ| hīnacchinne sati vyādhir vivarddhate|

maricātiviṣāpāṭhāvacākuṣṭhakuṭannaṭaiḥ|
chinnāyāṃ sapaṭukṣaudrair gharṣaṇaṃ, kavalaḥ punaḥ||49||
kaṭukātiviṣāpāṭhānimbarāsnāvacāmbubhiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. chinnāyāṃ maricādibhiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ kṣaudrair gharṣaṇam| kavalaḥ kaṭukādikvāthena|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
saṅghāte puppuṭe kūrme vilikhyaivaṃ samācaret||50||

div.ab: Sa. [tālu]saṃhatau puppuṭake kacchape[ca] vilikhyaivaṃ-anena krameṇa, samācaret|
Sa. apakve tu tālupāke kāsīsādibhir gharṣaṇam| śītakaṣāyamadhurauṣadhaiḥ kavalaḥ|
Sa. pakve 'ṣṭāpadavad bhinne sati tīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pratisāraṇaṃ kāryam| aṣṭāpadaṃ-caturaṅgapīṭham| vṛṣādibhis tiktadravyaiḥ kavaladhāraṇam|

tāluśoṣe tv atṛṣṇasya sarpir uttarabhaktikam|
kaṇāśuṇṭhīśṛtaṃ pānam amlair gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam||53||
dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ, kṣīrasarpiś ca nāvanam| -------------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. tāluśoṣe tv atṛṣṇasya sataḥ sarpir uttarabhaktikaṃ yojyam| pippalīśuṇṭhībhyāṃ śṛtaṃ jalapānam| amlaiḥ-kāñjikādibhiḥ, gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam| dhanvamāṃsarasāḥ snigdhāḥ| tathā kṣīrasya sarpiś ca nāvanaṃ hitam|

lg.l: kaṇṭharogeṣv asṛṅmokṣas tīkṣṇair nasyādi karma ca||54||

ab.seg:
kvāthaḥ pānaṃ ca dārvītvaṅnimbatārkṣyakaliṅgajaḥ|
harītakīkaṣāyo vā peyo mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ| -------------------------------------------------||55||

div.ab: Sa. kaṇṭharogeṣu sarveṣu sirādibhī raktamokṣaḥ| tīkṣṇair dravyair nasyagaṇḍūṣādi ca| dāRvītvagādīnāṃ kvāthaḥ pātavyaḥ| harītakyā vā kvāthaḥ samākṣikaḥ peyaḥ|

śreṣṭhāvyoṣayavakṣāradārvīdvīpirasāñjanaiḥ|
sapāṭhātejinīnimbaiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ|56|
kavalo, guṭikā vā'tra kalpitā pratisāraṇam| -------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. śreṣṭhādibhiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ kavalaḥ| guṭikā vā'tra-asmin kvāthe, parikalpitā pratisāraṇam|
Sa. śreṣṭhādibhiḥ suktagomūtrasādhitaiḥ kavalaḥ| guṭikā vā'tra-asmin kvāthe, parikalpitā pratisāraṇam|
Sa. atheti maṅgale| maṅgalapurvakaṃ vātajāṃ rohiṇikām antarbāhyataś ca svinnām aṅguliśastrakeṇāthavā paṭuyuktena nakhena śīghram eva likhet| pañcamūlakvāthaḥ kavalaḥ| tailaṃ gaṇḍūṣo nasyaṃ ca|

visrāvya pittasambhūtāṃ sitākṣaudrapriyaṅgubhiḥ|
gharṣet sarodhrapattaṅgaiḥ kavalaḥ kvathitaiś ca taiḥ||60||
drākṣāparūṣakakvātho hitaś ca kavalagrahe| -------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. pittajāṃ rohiṇīṃ visrāvya-raktaṃ nirhṛtya, sitādibhir gharṣayet| taiś ca-sitādibhiḥ, kvathitaiḥ sarodhrādibhiḥ kavalaḥ| drākṣāparūṣakayoḥ kvāthaḥ[ca] kavalo hitaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
upācared evam eva pratyākhyāyāsrasambhavām||61||
sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaṭukaiḥ kaphajāṃ pratisārayet|
nasyagaṇḍūṣayos tailaṃ sādhitaṃ ca praśasyate||62||
apāmārgaphalaśvetādantījantughnasaindhavaiḥ| -------------------------------------------------|63|

Sa. raktajāṃ rohiṇikāṃ pratyākhyāya pittajām ivopakramet| kaṭukaiḥ-kaṭuvargoktaiḥ, sāgāradhūmaiḥ kaphotthāṃ pratisārayet| apāmārgādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sādhitaṃ tailaṃ kapharohiṇyāṃ nasyagaṇḍūṣayoḥ śreṣṭham|
Sa. eṣaiva cikitsā vṛndādiṣu| vidradhau śastreṇa srāvite śreṣṭhādibhir gaṇḍūṣādi hitam|

lg.l: upanāhyo, vraṇe rūḍhe pralepyaś ca punaḥ punaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. galagaṇḍo vātodbhavaḥ svinno niḥsrutāsras tilair laṭvādibījaiś ca upanāhyaḥ| ruḍhe vraṇe sati pralepyaś ca bahuśaḥ śigrvādibhiḥ surayā kāñjikena vā piṣṭaiḥ| ekaiṣikā-trivṛt| guḍūcyādibhiḥ sakṛṣṇādevadārubhiḥ kalkitair galaṇḍinam āturaṃ pakvaṃ tailaṃ pāyayet|

kartavyaṃ kaphaje 'py etat svedavimlāpane tv ati|
lepo 'jagandhātiviṣāviśalyāḥ saviṣāṇikāḥ||69||
guñjālābuśukāhvāś ca palāśakṣārakalkitāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. kaphotthe 'py etat-vātagalagaṇḍoktaṃ cikitsitaṃ, kāryam| kintu svedavimlāpane cātyarthaṃ kārye| kaphaje galagaṇḍe 'jagandhādayaḥ palāśakṣāraniścotakalkitāḥ lepaḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
mūtrasrutaṃ haṭhakṣāraṃ paktvā kodravabhuk pibet||70||

div.ab: Sa. haṭho-mimmiṇiḥ, tasya kṣāraṃ gomūtre srutaṃ paktvā kṣāranyāyena pibej jalena, 'peṣaṇāloḍane vāri' (hṛ.ka.a. 6/23) iti vacanāt| kimbhūtaḥ san ? kodravabhuk| vatsakādibhir vā (hṛ.sū.a. 15/33) tailaṃ sādhitaṃ hitam| kaphaghnān dhūmādīn śīlayet|

medobhave sirāṃ vidhyet kaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ bhajet|
asanādirajaś cainaṃ prātar mūtreṇa pāyayet||72||
aśāntau pācayitvā ca sarvān vraṇavad ācaret| -------------------------------------------------|73|
Sa. medobhave galagaṇḍe sirāṃ vidhyet| kaphaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ seveta| asanādicūrṇaṃ (hṛ.sū.a.15/19) cainaṃ prātar gomūtreṇa pāyayet| saṃ-aśāntau satyāṃ pācayitvā sarvān vraṇavad upakramet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
mukhapākeṣu sakṣaudrā prayojyā mukhadhāvanāḥ||73||

div.ab: Sa. mukhapākeṣu samākṣikā mukhadhāvanāḥ kvathitās triphalādayaḥ prayojyāḥ| athavā triphalādīn bhakṣayitvā niṣṭhevyāḥ bhuktvā niṣṭhīvet| kuṭherādir gaṇo vā-harītakavargokto (hṛ.sū.a.6/106), bhakṣayitvā niṣṭhevyaḥ|
Sa. mukhapāke 'nilāt kṛṣṇādayaḥ pratisāraṇam| vātaghnaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kavale nasye ca hitam|

lg.l: pittāsre pittaraktaghnaḥ kaphaghnaś ca kaphe vidhiḥ|
likhec chākādipatraiś ca piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ||76||

div.ab: Sa. pittāsre pittaraktaghno vidhiḥ| saṃ-kaphe ca kaphahṛt vidhiḥ| piṭikāḥ kaṭhināḥ sthirāḥ śākādipatrair likhet|

yathādoṣodayaṃ kuryāt sannipāte cikitsitam|
nave 'rbude tv asaṃvṛddhe chedite pratisāraṇam||77||
svarjikānāgarakṣaudraiḥ, kvātho gaṇḍūṣa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|78|

Sa. sannipāte yathādoṣodayaṃ cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| arbude navotthe 'saṃvṛddhe chedite ca pratisāraṇaṃ svarjikādibhiḥ| gaṇḍūṣa iṣṭo guḍūcīnimbakalkodbhavaḥ kvātho madhutailayuktaḥ| tathā yavānnabhojī tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgān ācaret|

----------------------------------------------------|
guḍūcīnimbakalkottho madhutailasamanvitaḥ||78||
yavānnabhuk tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgāṃs tathā''caret| ----------------------------------------------------|79|
Sa. arbude navotthe 'saṃvṛddhe chedite ca pratisāraṇaṃ svarjikādibhiḥ| gaṇḍūṣa iṣṭo guḍūcīnimbakalkodbhavaḥ kvātho madhutailayuktaḥ| tathā yavānnabhojī tīkṣṇatailanasyābhyaṅgān ācaret|

----------------------------------------------------|
vamite pūtivadane dhūmas tīkṣṇaḥ sanāvanaḥ||79||
samaṅgādhātakīrodhraphalinīpadmakair jalam|
dhāvanaṃ vadanasyāntaś cūrṇitair avacūrṇitam||80||
śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nāvanādi ca śīlayet| ----------------------------------------------------|81|
Sa. pūtimukhe vamite sati tīkṣṇadhūmo nasyaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ prayojyam| samaṅgādijalena vadanasyāntaḥ kṣālayet| etair eva mukhāntaraṃ cūrṇitair avacūrṇayet| śītādopakuśoktaṃ ca nasyādikam abhyaset|

lg.l: kvāthena teṣāṃ ghanatāṃ gatena taccūrṇayuktā guṭikā vidheyāḥ||82||
tā dhāritā ghnanti mukhena nityaṃ kaṇṭhauṣṭhatālvādigadān sukṛcchrān|

div.ab: Sa. triphalādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kvāthena ghanatvaṃ gatena taccūrṇena triphalādirajasā'nvitā gulikāḥ kāryāḥ| tā mukhena nityaṃ dhāritāḥ kaṇṭhādirogān dāruṇān api ghnanti| viśeṣeṇa rohiṇikādīn| videhapatinā nirmitā etāḥ| amlāgrimavetasaḥ-amlavetasaḥ| atrā[ntyā]dye vṛtte upajātī, madhyamam indravajrā|

lg.l: khadiratulām ambughaṭe paktvā toyena tena piṣṭaiś ca|

ab.seg: suratarurodhradrākṣāmañjiṣṭhācocapadmakaviḍaṅgaiḥ| spṛkkānatanakhakaṭphalasūkṣmailādhyāmakaiḥ sapattaṅgaiḥ||85||
tailaprasthaṃ vipacet karṣāṃśaiḥ pānanasyagaṇḍūṣais tat| hatvā''sye sarvagadān janayati gārdhīṃ dṛśaṃ śrutiṃ ca vārāhīm||86||

div.ab: Sa. khadirapalaśataṃ jaladroṇe paktvā pādāvaśeṣitena tena jalena piṣṭaiś candanādibhiḥ karṣāśais tailaprasthaṃ pacet| tac ca pānanasyagaṇḍūṣair āsye dhāritaṃ sarvān rogān jitvā gṛdhrasambandhinīṃ dṛṣṭiṃ varāhatulyāṃ śrutiṃ[ca] vidhatte| āryā(rye) gītiḥ[ca]|

lg.l: udvartitaṃ ca prapunāṭarodhra- dārvībhir abhyaktam anena vaktram|

div.ab: Sa. prapunnāṭādibhitudvartitaṃ mukhaṃ tailenānenābhyaktaṃ vyaṅgādirahitaṃ candratulyakānti sañjāyate| upajātiḥ|

ab.seg: palaśataṃ bāṇāt toyaghaṭe paktvā rase 'smiṃś ca palārdhikaiḥ khadirajambūyaṣṭyānantāmrair ahimāranīlotpalānvitaiḥ||88||

lg.l: tailaprasthaṃ pācayec chlakṣṇapiṣṭai- rebhir dravyair dhāritaṃ tan mukhena|
rogān sarvān hanti vaktre viśeṣā- tsthairyaṃ dhatte dantapaṅkteś calāyāḥ||89||

div.ab: Sa. nīlasahacarāt palaśataṃ jalaghaṭe paktvā tasmin rasedvikārṣikaiḥ khadirādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sūkṣmarajīkṛtais tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet| tan mukhena dhāritaṃ sarvamukharogahṛt| viśeṣeṇa dantapaṅkteś calāyāḥ sthairyakṛc ca| vṛttaṃ (?) śālinī [ca]|

ab.seg: khadirasārād dve tule paced valkāt tulāṃ cārimedasaḥ| ghaṭacatuṣke pādaśeṣe 'smin pūte punaḥ kvathanād ghane||90||

ākṣikaṃ
kṣipet susūkṣmaṃ rajaḥ sevyāmbupattaṅgagairikam| candanadvaya(śyāmā) rodhrapuṇḍrā- hvayaṣṭyāhvalākṣāñjanadvayam||91||
dhātakīkaṭuphaladviniśātriphalācaturjātajoṅgakam| mustamañjiṣṭhānyagrodhapraroha|vacā]māṃsīyavāsakam||92||
padmakailāsamaṅgāś ca śīte tasmiṃs tathā pālikāṃ pṛthak| jātipatrikāṃ sajātīphalāṃ saha- (nakha)lavaṅgakaṅkollakām||93||
sphaṭikaśubhrasurabhikarpūrakuḍavaṃ ca tatrāvapet tataḥ| kārayed guṭikāḥ sadā caitā dhāryā mukhe tadvadāpahāḥ||94||

div.ab: Sa. khadirasārad dve tule, tulāṃ cārimedaso valkāt, jalaghaṭacatuṣṭaye pacet| pādāvaśeṣite pūte 'smin punaḥ kvathanād ghanībhūte kārṣikāṇi sūślakṣṇacūrṇāni sevyādīni kṣipet| asmin śīte jātīpatrādīn pṛthakpālikān kṣipet| śreṣṭhatamojjvalakarpūrakuḍavaṃ cātra kṣipet| anantaraṃ guṭikāḥ kārayet| etāḥ sadā mukhe dhāryāḥ sarvamukharogaharāḥ| [vṛttāni(?) pañca|]

lg.l: sarvāsyarogoddhṛtaye tadāhu- rdantasthiratve tv idam eva mukhyam||95||

div.ab: Sa. kvāthyauṣadhayoḥ-khadirasārārimedasoḥ, vyatyayo-vaiparītyaṃ,-arimedasaḥ-viṭkhadiravalkalād dve tule prayojye, khadirasārattulām, anyat sarvaṃ pūrvavad deyam iti| tailaṃ paced anayaiva kalpanayā| tat-tailaṃ, sarvamukharogaghnam| dantasthirakṛtau cedam eva pradhānam āhuḥ| indravajrā|

lg.l: khadireṇaitā guṭikā- stailam idaṃ cārimedasā prathitam|

div.ab: Sa. khadireṇaitā guṭikās tailaṃ caitad arimedasā prathitam| dvayam apy etat pratidinamabhyastaṃ svasthasyāpi dvijadārḍhyakṛt| āryā|

lg.l: kṣaudreṇa yuktaḥ kavalagraho 'yaṃ sarvāmayān vaktragatān nihanti||97||
cūrṇaḥ sakṣaudro dantamāṃsārtikaṇḍū- pākasrāvāṇaṃ nāśano gharṣaṇena||98||

div.ab: Sa. kṣudrādibhiḥ kaṣāyaḥ kṣaudreṇa yutaḥ kavalagraho 'yaṃ sarvamukharogān hanti| indravajrā| saṃ-pāṭhādīnāṃ cūrṇaḥ kṣaudrayuto dantamāṃsārtyādīnāṃ gharṣaṇena nāśanaḥ| vaiśvadevī|

ab.seg: gṛhadhūmatārkṣyapāṭhāvyoṣakṣārāgnyayovarātejohvaiḥ| mukhadantagalavikāre sakṣaudraḥ kālako vidhāryaś cūrṇaḥ||99||
dārvītvaksindhūdbhavamanaḥ śilāyāvaśūkaharitālaiḥ| dhāryaḥ pītakacūrṇo dantāsyagalāmaye samadhvājyaḥ||100||

div.ab: Sa. gṛhadhūmādibhiś cūrṇaḥ samākṣikaḥ kālakākhyo mukha[di]vikāre dhāryaḥ| āryā gītiḥ| dārvyādibhiḥ pītakākhyaś cūrṇo dantādyāmaye samadhughṛto dhāryaḥ| gītir āryā|

ab.seg:
dvikṣāradhūmakavarāpañcapaṭuvyoṣavellagiritārkṣyaiḥ|
gomūtreṇa vipakvā galāmayaghnī rasakriyā eṣā||101||

lg.l: attāraṃ naramaṇavo 'pi vaktrarogāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpamiva na spṛśanty anarthāḥ||102||

div.ab: Sa. dvikṣārādibhir gomūtreṇa vipakvā eṣā rasakriyā guṭikā galarogaghnī bhavati| [gītir āryā|] gomūtrakvāthena vilīnaśarīrāṇāṃ pathyānāṃ vālakaśatapuṣpākuṣṭair bhāvitānāṃ bhakṣayitāraṃ naraṃ svalpā api vaktrarogā na spṛśanti| anarthāḥ śrotāraṃ nṛpam ivety upamālaṅkāraḥ| praharṣiṇī|

lg.l: yaṣṭyāhvarājadrumacandanaiś ca kvāthaṃ pibet pākaharaṃ mukhasya||103||
pītaḥ kaṣāyo madhunā nihanti mukhe sthitaś cāsyagadān aśeṣān||104||

div.ab: Sa. saptacchadādibhiḥ kvāthaṃ mukhapākaharaṃ pibet| paṭolādīnāṃ kaṣāyo madhumān pīto mukhe ca sthito gaṇḍūṣo dhārito, mukhagadān aśeṣān nihanti| upajātī

lg.l: khadirasya varāyāś ca pṛthag evaṃ prakalpanā||106||

div.ab: Sa. dārvyā rasaḥ kvathito ghanībhūtaḥ sagairikakṣaudro mukhastho vaktrapākādighnaḥ| paṭolādīnāṃ pṛthag evaṃ prakalpanā kāryā|

lg.l: tasmāt teṣām asakṛd rudhiraṃ visrāvayed duṣṭam||108||

div.ab: Sa. khadirādibhir jalaśṛtair gaṇḍūśo dvijadārḍhyakṛd dhāryaḥ| ahimārakaḥ-arimedaḥ| mukhādigadā bāhulyena kapharaktabhūyiṣṭhā yataḥ, tasmād dhetos teṣāṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ punaḥ punar visrāvayet|

lg.l: kāyaśirasor vireko vamanaṃ kavalagrahāś ca kaṭutiktāḥ|
prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma||109||
yūṣā bhakṣyāś ca hitā yac cānyac chleṣmanāśāya||110||

div.ab: Sa. kāyaśirovirekādikaṃ bāhulyena teṣāṃ śastam| kapharaktaharaṃ ca yat karma tat śastam| yavādayo hitāḥ| yac cāparaṃ śleṣmanāśanaṃ tac ca śastam|

prāṇānilapathasaṃsthāḥ śvasitam api nirundhate pramādavataḥ|
kaṇṭhāmayāś cikitsita- mato drutaṃ teṣu kurvīta|111| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara-
sthāne mukharogapratiṣedho nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|22|

Sa. prāṇapavanamārgasthitā kaṇṭharogāḥ pramādyataḥ śvāsam api nirundhanti yataḥ, ataḥ-asmād dhetoḥ, teṣu rogeṣūpakramaṃ drāg vidadhīta| āryāś catasraḥ| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mukharoga- pratiṣedho nāma dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 22||

div.head: śirorogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha kramaprāptaṃ śirorogavijñānam āha ---- athātaḥ śirorogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. dhūmādibhiḥ śirogatā doṣā rogān janayanti|

-----------------------------------------------| --------------------------tatra mārutakopataḥ||3||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā|
bhruvor madhyaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca patatīvātivedanam||4||
bādhyete svanataḥ śrotre niṣkṛṣyeta ivākṣiṇī|
ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate||5||
sphuraty ati sirājālaṃ kandharāhanusaṅgrahaḥ|
prakāśāsahatā ghrāṇasrāvo 'kasmād yathāśamau||6||
mārdavaṃ mardanasnehasvedabandhaiś ca jāyate| śirastāpo 'yam-----------------------------|7|
Sa. tatra-teṣu madhye, vātakopāt śaṅkhanistodādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā mardanādibhir mārdavaṃ jāyate| ghūrṇatīveti ghūrṇastudādiḥ| ayam īdṛśaḥ śirastāpa ucyate|

lg.l: pakṣāt kupyati māsād vā svayam eva ca śāmyati|
ativṛddhas tu nayanaṃ śravaṇaṃ vā vināśayet||8||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ardhe tu śirasaḥ, ardhāvabhedaka ucyate| sa ca pakṣeṇa kupyati| māsena vā kupyati| svayam eva-cikitsitaṃ vinaiva, upaśāmyati| ativṛddhas tv ayaṃ locanaṃ karṇaṃ vā hanyāt|

lg.l: svedo 'kṣidahanaṃ mūrcchā niśi śītaiś ca mārdavam||9||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje śirobhitāpe 'rucyādayaḥ syuḥ| divā pīḍā mandā bhavati, vibhāvaryām adhikā| tathā tandrādayaḥ syuḥ| raktodbhavo mūrdhatāpaḥ pittādhikarujaḥ syāt| sannipātena sarvalakṣaṇaḥ syāt|

saṅkīrṇair bhojanair mūrdhni kleditte rudhirāmiṣe|
kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ||12||
śirasas te pibanto 'sraṃ ghorāḥ kurvanti vedanāḥ|
cittavibhraṃśajananīr jvaraḥ kāso balakṣayaḥ||13||
raukṣyaśophavyadhancchedadāhasphuraṇapūtitāḥ|
kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍūḥ śoṣaḥ pramīlakaḥ||14||
tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatā karṇanādaś ca jantuje| -----------------------------------------------|15|

Sa. saṅkīrṇair āhāraiḥ śirasi kledite rudhire māṃse ca sannipāte ca kopite kṛmayo mūrdhni jāyante| te ca mūrdhnau raktaṃ pibanto dāruṇāḥ pīḍā manovibhraṃśakāriṇīr janayanti| jvarādayaś ca syuḥ| tathā kapāle tāluśirasoḥ kaṇḍvādyāḥ syuḥ| tathā tāmrācchasiṅghāṇakatvaṃ karṇanādaś ca kṛmije syāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vātolbaṇāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ tatsaṃjñaṃ kurvate malāḥ||15||

lg.l: trirātrāj jīvitaṃ hanti sidhyaty apy āśu sādhitaḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. vātādhikā doṣāḥ śiraḥkampaṃ śiraḥ kampākhyaṃ kurvate| pittādhikair doṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ śaṅkhe śopho 'tidāhādayaś ca syuḥ| sa ca śaṅkhakas tiktāsyaḥ pītavarṇamukhaḥ kṣiprakārī ca syāt| tiktaṃ-tiktasvādam āsyaṃ, yasmin śaṅkhake saḥ| evam anyad api yojyam| sa cānupakrāntas trirātreṇa jīvitaṃ harati| śīghraṃ ca cikitsitaḥ sidhyaty api| apiśabdāt kadācin na sidhyati|

pittānubaddhaḥ śaṅkhākṣibhrūlalāṭeṣu mārutaḥ|
rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryād anusūryodayodayām||18||
āmadhyāhnaṃ vivardhiṣṇuḥ kṣudvataḥ sā viśeṣataḥ|
avyavasthitaśītoṣṇasukhā śāmyaty ataḥ param||19||
sūryāvartaḥ sa ity uktā daśa rogāḥ śirogatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. pittānubaddho mārutaḥ śaṅkhādiṣu rujaṃ saspandanāṃ kuryāt| kimbhūtāṃ rujam ? anusūryodayaṃ udayo yasyāḥ sā tām| āmadhyāhnaṃ-madhyāhnaṃ maryādīkṛtya vardhanaśīlā, sā pīḍā bubhukṣitasya viśeṣeṇa| tathā'niyataśītoṣṇasukhā| ato-madhyāhnāt, paraṃ śamaṃ gacchati| saḥ-ity evaṃ, sūryāvarta uktaḥ| daśaite mūrdhagatā rogā uktāḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śirasy eva ca vakṣyante kapāle vyādhayo nava||20||

lg.l: savarṇo nīrujaḥ śophas taṃ vidyād upaśīrṣakam||21||

div.ab: Sa. śirasy eva kapāle nava rogā bhaṇiṣyante| kapāle pavane duṣṭe garbhasthitasyāpi nīrujaḥ śophas tatsavarṇaḥ-kāyasamānavarṇo, jāyate| tam upaśīrṣakākhyaṃ rogaṃ jānīyāt|

yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt piṭikārbudavidradhīn|
kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ||22||
kaṅgusiddhārthakanibhāḥ piṭikāḥ syur aruṃṣikāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. piṭikādīn trīn yathādoṣodayaṃ brūyāt| kapāle kledabahulāḥ pittāsṛkśleṣmajantubhiḥ kaṅgusiddhārthakaphalarūpāḥ piṭikā aruṃṣikāḥ syuḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
kaṇḍūkeśacyutisvāparaukṣyakṛt sphuṭanaṃ tvacaḥ||23||
susūkṣmaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyād dāruṇakaṃ tu tat|
romakūpānugaṃ pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitam||24||
pracyāvayati romāṇi tataḥ śleṣmā saśoṇitaḥ|
romakūpān ruṇaddhy asya tenānyeṣām asambhavaḥ||25||
tad indraluptaṃ rujyāṃ ca prāhuś cāceti cāpare| ---------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. kaṇḍvādikṛt tvacaḥ sphuṭanaṃ susūkṣmaṃ yat tad dāruṇakaṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ vidyāt| aṃ-pittaṃ vātena saha mūrcchitaṃ romakūpānugataṃ romāṇi pracyāvayati| tataḥ śleṣmā raktasahito romakūpān ruṇaddhi| tena kāraṇenāsya-indraluptavataḥ, anyeṣāṃ romṇām anutpattiḥ| tat-etat, indraluptaṃ rujyāṃ cācety anya āhuḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
khalater api janmaivaṃ śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt||26||

lg.l: kaphād dhanatvag varṇāś ca yathāsvaṃ nirdiśet tvaci||27||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ-etattulyarūpā, khalater utpattiḥ| kintu[tatra-] khalatau, krameṇa keśānāṃ śāto na tv indralupta iva sahasā| sā-khalatiḥ, vātād agnidagdhābhā syāt| pittāt svinnasirāvṛtā syāt| kaphena ghanatvak| tvaci varṇāś ca yathādoṣaṃ nirdiśet|

lg.l: doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvair asādhyā sā nakhaprabhā|
dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate||28||

div.ab: Sa. sarvair doṣaiḥ sarvākṛtiḥ sarvalakṣaṇā khalatiḥ| nakhaprabhā sā cāsādhyā syāt| agnidagdhatulyā romarahitā sadāhā ca yā jāyate, sā'py asādhyā syāt|

śokaśramakrodhakṛtaḥ śarīroṣmā śirogataḥ|
keśān sadoṣaḥ pacati palitaṃ sambhavaty ataḥ||29||
tad vātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jalaprabham|
pittāt sadāhaṃ pītābhaṃ, kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat||30||
sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ, sarvais tu vidyād vyāmiśralakṣaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. śokādibhir udgataḥ śarīroṣmā mūrdhni doṣaiḥ sahitaḥ keśān pacati| ataḥ palitaṃ jāyate| tac ca-palitaṃ, vātāt sphiṭitādiguṇaṃ syāt| pittena sadāhaṃ pītavarṇam| kaphāt snigdhaṃ vivṛddhimat sthūlaṃ suśuklaṃ ca| sarvais tu doṣaiḥ saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt

---------------------------------------------|
śirorujodbhavaṃ cānyad vivarṇaṃ sparśanāsaham||31||
asādhyā sannipātena khalatiḥ palitāni ca| ---------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. śirorujotthaṃ cāparaṃ palitaṃ vivarṇaṃ sparśanāsahaṃ syāt| khalatiḥ sannipātenāsādhyā| palitāni ca sannipātotthāny asādhyāni| doṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ khalatir asādhyeti prāg uktam eva| idaṃ tu vacanaṃ spaṣṭārtham eveti manye, tathā sannipātodbhūtāni palitāny asādhyānīti|

---------------------------------------------|
śarīrapariṇāmotthāny apekṣante rasāyanam|32| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogavijñānīyo nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|23|

Sa. śarīrapariṇāmodbhavāni tu palitāni rasāyanam apekṣanta iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne śirorogavijñānīyo nāma trayoviṃśo- 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 23||

div.head: śirorogapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
athaitac cikitsitaṃ vyākhyātum āha ----- athātaḥ śirorogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
) śirobhitāpe 'nilaje vātavyādhividhiṃ caret| ---------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. pavanaje śirobhitāpe vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------|
ghṛtam aktaśirā rātrau pibed uṣṇapayonupaḥ||1||
māṣān kulatthān mudgān vā tadvat khāded dhṛtānvitān|
tailaṃ tilānāṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet||2||
piṇḍopanāhasvedāś ca māṃsadhānyakṛtā hitāḥ|
vātaghnadaśamūlādisiddhakṣīreṇa secanam||3||
snigdhaṃ nasyaṃ tathā dhūmaḥ śiraḥśravaṇatarpaṇam| ---------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. abhyaktaśirā rātrau ghṛtaṃ pibet| paścād uṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet| māṣādīn ghṛtānvitān khādet, tadvat-uṣṇapayonupaḥ san| tilānāṃ tailaṃ kalkaṃ vā kṣīreṇa saha pāyayet| piṇḍasvedā upanāhasvedāś ca māṃsayuktair dhānyaiḥ kṛtā hitāḥ| vātaharadaśamūlādinā siddhena kṣīreṇa secanaṃ hitam| snigdhaṃ ca nasyādikaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
varaṇādau gaṇe kṣuṇṇe kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet||4||
kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ tac chītaṃ mathitvā sāram āharet|
tato madhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ tat pūjitaṃ haviḥ||5||
varge 'tra pakvaṃ kṣīre ca peyaṃ sarpiḥ saśarkaram| ---------------------------------------------|6|

Sa. varaṇasairyekety ādigaṇe(hṛ.sū.a. 15/21) jarjarite kṣīram ardhodakaṃ pacet| tat kṣīrāvaśiṣṭaṃ śītībhūtaṃ mathitvā sāram āharet| anantaraṃ taddhataṃ madhuradravyaiḥ pakvaṃ nasyaṃ śreṣṭham| saṃ-asminn eva varaṇādau varge kṣīre ca ghṛtaṃ pakvaṃ saśarkaraṃ peyam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kārpāsamajjā tvaṅmustā sumanaḥkorakāṇi ca||6||

div.ab: Sa. kārpāsamajjādīny uṣṇajalena piṣṭāni sarvamūrdharujāghnaṃ nasyam| śarkarākuṅkumaśṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pittāsṛgutthe [nasyaṃ] hitam|

lg.l: ity aśāntau cale dāhaḥ kaphe ceṣṭo yathoditaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. kuṣṭhādibhiḥ saghṛtaiḥ pralepaḥ| kuṭilaṃ-tagaram asmiṃś ca vātodrekabhayāl lohitaṃ nāvasecayet| evam apy anupaśame vāyau dāha iṣṭaḥ| kaphe ca yathoktam uṣṇam iṣṭam| ardhāvabhedake 'py eṣā eva kriyā doṣānvayāt-doṣānurodhāccā, yathāsvaṃ kāryā|

śirīṣabījāpāmārgamūlaṃ nasyaṃ biḍānvitam|
sthirāraso vā, lepe tu prapunnāṭo 'mlakalkitaḥ||10||
sūryovarte 'pi tasmiṃs tu sirayā'pahared asṛk| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. śirīṣabījādibhir nasyaṃ syāt| śāliparṇīkvātho vā nasyam| prapunnāṭabījam amlena piṣṭaṃ lepaḥ| sūryāvarte 'py eṣa evopakramaḥ| tasmiṃś ca sirayā raktaṃ srāvayet|

---------------------------------------------|
śirobhitāpe pittotthe snigdhasya vyadhayet sirām||11||
śītāḥ śiromukhālepasekaśodhanabastayaḥ|
jīvanīyaśṛte kṣīrasarpiṣī pānanasyayoḥ||12||
kartavyaṃ raktaje 'py etat pratyākhyāya ca śaṅkhake| ---------------------------------------------|13|

Sa. mūrdhābhitāpe pittasambhave snigdhasya sataḥ sirāṃ mokṣayet| tathā śiromukhālepādayaḥ śītā hitāḥ| jīvanīyaiḥ śṛte kṣīraghṛte pānanasyayor hite| rakteje 'py etac cikitsitaṃ kāryam| śaṅkhake ca pratyākhyāyaiṣa evopakramaḥ kāryaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śleṣmābhitāpe jīrṇājyasnehitaḥ kaṭukair vamet||13||

div.ab: Sa. śleṣmaṇā śirobhitāpe purāṇaghṛtena snehitaḥ kaṭukair vamet| svedādayo rūkṣādidravyaiḥ śasyante| upavāsaś cātra hitaḥ| sannipāte miśram ācaret|

kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ tena mūrcchanti jantavaḥ|
mattāḥ śoṇitagandhena niryānti ghrāṇavaktrayoḥ||15||
sutīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ kuryān nirharaṇaṃ tataḥ|
viḍaṅgasvarjikādantīhiṅgugomūtrasādhitam||16||
kaṭunimbeṅgudīpīlutailaṃ nasyaṃ pṛthak pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. kṛmije śoṇitaṃ nasyaṃ deyam| tena-śoṇitanasyena, jantavo mūrcchanti| raktagandhena ca mattā ghrāṇena vaktreṇa ca nirgacchanti| anantaraṃ tīkṣṇanasyadhūmābhyāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kuryāt| viḍaṅgādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ sarṣapatailaṃ nimbatailam iṅgudītailaṃ pīlutailaṃ vā pṛthak pṛthak nasyaṃ hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
ajāmūtradrutaṃ nasyaṃ kṛmijit kṛmijitparam||17||
pūtimatsyayutaiḥ kuryād dhūmaṃ nāvanabheṣajaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. ajāmūtradrutaṃ hiṅgu nasyaṃ paraṃ kṛmighnam| pūtimatsyānvitair nasyadravyair dhūmaṃ kuryāt|

---------------------------------------------|
kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvād raktam atra na nirharet||18||
vātābhitāpavihitaḥ kampe dāhād vinā kramaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. atra ca raktaṃ na visrāvayet| kuto hetoḥ ? ity āha kṛmibhiḥ pītaraktatvāt| kampe vātābhitāpokto vidhir dāhād vinā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
nave janmottaraṃ jāte yojayed upaśīrṣake||19||

div.ab: Sa. upaśīrṣake nave janmottaraṃ jāte vātavyādhicikitsitaṃ kuryāt| pakve ca vidradhivihitaṃ karma kuryāt| āme pakve ca vidradhau piṭikāyām arbude ca yathāsvaṃ karma kuryāt|
Sa. aruṃṣikā jalaukobhir niḥsrutaraktā nimbajalena siktā vājiśakṛdrasaiḥ prabhūtalavaṇair limpet| paṭolanimbapatrair niśānvitaiḥ supiṣṭair vā gomūtrādibhir vā| kṛkavākuḥ-kukkuṭaḥ|
Sa. kuṣṭhaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kapālabhṛṣṭaṃ tailasaṃyutaṃ rūṃṣikālepanaṃ kaṇḍvādihitam| mālatyādiprasādhitaṃ tailaṃ cācāruṃṣikayoḥ kṣuraghṛṣṭayor abhyaṅgaḥ|

lg.l: vidhyec chirāṃ dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ, śīlayen mṛjām||25||
nāvanaṃ mūrddhabastiṃ ca, lepayec ca samākṣikaiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. aśāntau satyāṃ mūrdhnaḥ śodhanāya vamanādibhir yateta| dāruṇake lālāṭyāṃ śirāṃ vidhyet| mṛjāṃ śuddhiṃ nasyaṃ mūrddhabastiṃ ca śīlayet| priyālādibhiḥ samākṣikair lepayec ca| lākṣādibhiḥ kṣaudrayutair lepaḥ| kodravatṛṇakṣārajalena prakṣālanaṃ hitam|
Sa. indralupte yathāsanne deśe sirāṃ vidhvā [gāḍhaṃ-] suṣṭu, pracchāya-prachānaṃ kṛtvā, kāsīsādibhir lepayet| vanyadevadārubhyāṃ vā lepayet| hastidantamaṣī tailāktā cācānām auṣadhaṃ param|
Sa. sitaromodgame meṣaviṣāṇajā maṣī tailāktā śreṣṭhā| saṃ-jalasekaṃ ca varjayet yāvad romodbhūtiḥ|

lg.l: khalatau palite valyāṃ harillomni ca śodhitam|
siddhaṃ tailaṃ bṛhatyādyair jīvanīyaiś ca nāvanam|
māsaṃ vā nimbajaṃ tailaṃ kṣīrabhuṅ nāvayed yatiḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. khalatyādiṣu śodhitam āturaṃ nasyādibhir upācaret| bṛhatyādibhir jīvanīyaiś ca pakvaṃ tailaṃ nasyaṃ hitam| nimbodbhavaṃ vā tailaṃ māsaṃ kṣīrabhuṅ nāvayet, yatiḥ-saṃyamī brahmacaryaparaḥ|

nīlīśirīṣakoraṇṭabhṛṅgasvarasabhāvitam|
śelvakṣatilarāmāṇāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakīsamam||35||
piṣṭvā''japayasā lohāl liptād arkāśutāpitāt|
tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrabhujo nāvanāt palitāntakṛt||36||
kṣīrāt sāhacarād bhṛṅgarajasaḥ saurasād rasāt|
prasthais tailasya kuḍavaḥ siddho yaṣṭipalānvitaḥ||37||
nasyaṃ śailāsane bhāṇḍe śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|38|

Sa. nīlyādisvarasena bhāvitaṃ śelvādīnāṃ bījaṃ kākāṇḍakītulyaṃ chāgadugdhena piṣṭvā lohāl lipād raviraśmibhis tāpittāt tailaṃ srutaṃ kṣīrāśino nasyaṃ palitāntakaram| kṣīrāt prasthena, sahacararasāt prasthena, bhṛṅgarājarasāt prasthena, surasārasāt prasthena, tailasya kuḍavaḥ pakvo madhuyaṣṭīpalayutaḥ śaile bhāṇḍe bījasārasya vā bhāṇḍe meṣaśṛṅge vā sthito nasyam|

---------------------------------------------|
kṣīreṇa ślakṣṇapiṣṭai vā dugdhikākaravīrakau||38||
utpāṭya palitaṃ deyāvāśaye palitāpahau|
kṣīraṃ priyālaṃ yaṣṭyāhvaṃ jīvanīyo gaṇas tilāḥ||39||
kṛṣṇāḥ pralepo vaktrasya harillomavalīhitaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. dugdhikākaravīrakau kṣīreṇa sūkṣmapiṣṭau palitam utpāṭya tatsthāne deyau palitaghnau| kṣīrādayo vaktrasya lepa indraluptavalīṣu hitaḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
tilāḥ sāmalakāḥ padmakiñjalko madhukaṃ madhu||40||
bṛṃhayed rañjayec caitat keśān mūrddhapralepanāt|
māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ sārivā nīlam utpalam||41||
kṣaudraṃ ca kṣīrapiṣṭāni keśasaṃvardhanaṃ param| ---------------------------------------------|42|
Sa. tilādikaṃ śiraḥpralepanāt keśān rañjayet puṣṇīyāc ca| māṃsyādīni kṣīrapiṣṭāni paraṃ keśasaṃvardhanāni|

---------------------------------------------|
ayorajo bhṛṅgarajas triphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā||42||
sthitam ikṣurase māsaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet|
māṣakodravadhānyāmlair yavāgūs tridinoṣitā||43||
lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākām api rañjayet| ---------------------------------------------|44|
Sa. lohacūrṇādikam ikṣurase māsaṃ sthitaṃ samūlaṃ palitaṃ rajet| māṣādibhir yavāgūs tridavasoṣitā lohaśuklotkaṭā piṣṭā balākām api rañjayet| kiṃ punaḥ palitaṃ na nihanti?|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
prapauṇḍarīkamadhukapippalīcandanotpalaiḥ||44||

lg.l: sarvān mūrdhagadān hanti palitāni ca śīlitam||45||

div.ab: Sa. prapauṇḍarīkādibhir dhātrīrase siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāvanenābhyañjanena ca sarvān śirorogān hanti| śīlitaṃ ca palitāni hanti|
Sa. śatāvarījīvantikvāthena kṣīreṇa jīvanīyaiś ca yamakaṃ pacet| tat nasyena sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit|

mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrapādaviṭtuṇḍavarjitam|
daśamūlavalārāsnāmadhukais tripalair yutam||47||
jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet|
kalkitair madhuradravyaiḥ sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit||48||
tad abhyāsīkṛtaṃ pānabastyabhyañjananāvanaiḥ| ---------------------------------------------|49|

Sa. mayūraṃ pakṣādivarjitaṃ tripalapramāṇair daśamūlādibhir yutaṃ jale paktvā tasmin jale kalkitair madhuradravyaiḥ kṣīrasamaṃ ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet| pānādibhir abhyastaṃ-śīlitaṃ, tat-ghṛtaṃ, sarvajatrūrdhvarogajit| etan māyūrākhyaṃ ghṛtam|

---------------------------------------------|
etenaiva kaṣāyeṇa ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet||49||
caturguṇena payasā kalkair ebhiś ca kārṣikaiḥ|
jīvantītriphalāmedāmṛdvīkarddhiparūṣakaiḥ||50||
samaṅgācavikābhārgīkāśmarīkarkaṭāhvayaiḥ|
ātmaguptāmahāmedātālakharjūramastakaiḥ||51||
mṛṇālabisakharjūrayaṣṭīmadhukajīvakaiḥ|
śatāvarīvidārīkṣubṛhatīsārivāyugaiḥ||52||
mūrvāśvadaṃṣṭrarṣabhakaśṛṅgāṭakakaserukaiḥ|
rāsnāsthirātāmalakīsūkṣmailāśaṭhipauṣkaraiḥ||53||
punarnavātavakṣīrīkākolīdhanvayāsakaiḥ|
madhūkākṣoṭavātāmamuñjātābhiṣukair api||54||
mahāmāyuram ity etan māyūrād adhikaṃ guṇaiḥ|
dhātvindriyasvarabhraṃśaśvāsakāsārditāpaham||55||
yenyasṛkśukradoṣeṣu śastaṃ vandhyāsutapradam| ---------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. etenaiva kvāthena ghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet| caturguṇena kṣīreṇaibhiḥ-jīvantyādibhiḥ, kalkaiḥ kārṣikair etan mahāmāyuraṃ māyūrād guṇair adhikaṃ dhātvādibhraṃśaghnaṃ ca| yonyādidoṣeṣu śastam| vandhyāsutapradam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
ākhubhiḥ kukkuṭair haṃsaiḥ śaśaiś ceti prakalpayet||56||

div.ab: Sa. mūṣikādibhir eva kalpayet| jatrūrdhvajānāṃ rogāṇāṃ śatadvayam ekatriṃśadadhikam anyonyam asaṅkīrṇaṃ vistareṇa prakāśitam|
Sa. ūrdhvamūlam adhaḥśākhaṃ munayaś ca yasmāt puruṣaṃ jānanti, tasmān mūlāpahāriṇo rogān śīghrataraṃ jayet|

sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ|
tena tasyottamāṅgasya rakṣāyām ādṛto bhavet|59| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne śirorogapratiṣedho nāma- caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|24|

Sa. saṃ-yasmād asmin-uttamāṅge, sarvendriyāṇi, yataś cātra prāṇāḥ saṃśritāḥ, tasmād uttamāṅgasya rakṣāyāṃ yatnavatā bhāvyam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne śiroroga- pratiṣedho nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 24|| iti śālākyaṃ nāma caturtham ūrdhvāṅgam aṅgaṃ sampūrṇam|

div.head: vranapratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. atha kramaprāptaṃ vraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyācikhyāsur āha-

athāto vraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
) vraṇo dvidhā nijāgantuduṣṭaśuddhavibhedataḥ|
nijo doṣaiḥ śarīrotthair āgantur bāhyahetujaḥ||1||
doṣair adhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ śuddhas tair anadhiṣṭhitaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. vraṇo dviprakāro-nijāgantubhedād duṣṭaśuddhabhedāc ca| nijo vraṇaḥ śārīrai doṣair bhavati| āgantur bāhyahetūdbhavaḥ| doṣair adhiṣṭhito duṣṭaḥ| śuddho yo doṣair anadhiṣṭhitaḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
saṃvṛtatvaṃ vivṛtatā kāṭhinyaṃ mṛdutā'ti vā||2||
atyutsannāvasannatvam atyauṣṇyam atiśītatā|
raktatvaṃ pāṇḍutā kārṣṇyaṃ pūtipūyaparisrutiḥ||3||
pūtimāṃsasirāsnāyucchannatotsaṅgitā'tiruk|
saṃrambhadāhaśvayathukaṇḍvādibhir upadrutaḥ||4||
dīrghakālānubandhaś ca vidyād duṣṭavraṇākṛtim| -------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. saṃvṛtatvādir yo vraṇas taṃ duṣṭavraṇākṛtiṃ vidyāt|

Sa. sa ca pañcadaśaprakāro raktasahitair doṣaiḥ syāt| tatra pṛthag doṣais trayaḥ, saṃsargajās trayaḥ, sannipātenaika iti [sapta]| evaṃbhūtā raktasahitaiḥ sapta| evaṃ caturdaśa| raktena kevalenaika iti pañcadaśa| nanu, prāg abhyadhāyi (hṛ.sū.a.29/6)-"śūlaṃ narte 'nilād dāhaḥ pittāc chophaḥ kaphodayāt| rāgo raktāc ca pākaḥ syāt" ity ādi| tad ihaikadoṣajatvaṃ dvidoṣajatvaṃ raktarahitatvaṃ cocyamānaṃ pūrvāparavyāhataṃ syāt| atrocyate| kāsasamprāptivad atra nyāyo bodhyaḥ| tathā hy ekadoṣaje 'pi kāse doṣāntarasyānubandhatvam urarīkṛtya dvidoṣajānusāreṇa yathopakramas tathehāpīti nātra purvāparavyāhatatvam|

-------------------------------------------------| ----------------------------------tatra mārutāt||5||
śyāvaḥ kṛṣṇo 'ruṇo bhasmakapotāsthinibho 'pi vā|
mastumāṃsapulākāmbutulyatanvalpasaṃsrutiḥ||6||
nirmāṃsas todabhedāḍhyo rūkṣaś caṭacaṭāyate| -------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. teṣu madhye mārutāt śyāvādiguṇo mastvāditulyatanvalpavisrāvas tathā nirmāṃsādiguṇaḥ syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
pittena kṣiprajaḥ pīto nīlaḥ kapilapiṅgalaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. pittena vraṇaḥ kṣiprodbhavaḥ pītāduguṇo mūtrādisadṛśabahusrāvaḥ kṣārokṣitatulyarujo rāgoṣmapākavān|
Sa. kaphena pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍūyuto bahuśuklaghanasrāvaḥ sthūlauṣṭhaḥ kaṭhinas tathā srāyusirājālatato 'lparujaḥ|

lg.l: vājisthānasamo gandhe yukto liṅgaiś ca paittikaiḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. raktena vidgumalohitaḥ saraktaṃ pūyaṃ sravet| turagasthānatulyo gandhena| tathā paittikair liṅgair yutaḥ|
dbābhyāṃ tribhiś ca sarvaiś ca vidyāl lakṣaṇasaṅkarāt| -------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. dvābhyāṃ tribhiḥ sarvaiś ca lakṣaṇānāṃ saṅkarāt saṃsargajādīn vidyāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
jihvāprabho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ śyāvauṣṭhapiṭikaḥ samaḥ||11||
kiñcidunnatamadhyo vā vraṇaḥ śuddho 'nupadravaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. jihvāprabhādiguṇo vraṇo 'nupadravaḥ śuddhaḥ syāt|

-------------------------------------------------|
tvagāmiṣasirāsnāyusandhyasthīni vraṇāśayāḥ||12||
koṣṭho marma ca tāny aṣṭau duḥsādhyāny uttarottaram| -------------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. tvagādīni vraṇāśrayās tathā koṣṭho marma cety aṣṭāv ṛttarottaraṃ duḥsādhyāni|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
susādhyaḥ sattvamāṃsāgnivayobalavati vraṇaḥ||13||

lg.l: vṛtto dīrghas tripuṭakaś caturasrākṛtiś ca yaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. sattvādimati vraṇaḥ susādhyaḥ| vṛttādiguṇas tathā sphigādiṣu ca susādhyaḥ|
Sa. akṣyādiṣu sthitaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ|

phenapūyānilavahaḥ śalyavān ūrdhvanirvamī|
bhagandaro 'ntarvadanas tathā kaṭyasthisaṃśritaḥ||16||
kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām|
vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti yeṣāṃ ca syur vraṇe vraṇāḥ||17||
naiva sidhdyanti vīsarpajvarātīsārakāsinām|
pipāsūnām anidrāṇāṃ śvāsinām avipākinām||18||
bhinne śiraḥkapāle vā mastuluṅgasya darśane|
snāyukledāt sirācchedād gāmbhīryāt kṛmibhakṣaṇāt||19||
asthibhedāt saśalyatvāt saviṣatvād atarkitāt|
mithyābandhād atisnehād raukṣyād romādighaṭṭanāt||20||
kṣobhād aśuddhakoṣṭhatvāt sauhityād atikarśanāt|
madyapānād divāsvapnād vavāyād rātrijāgarāt||21||
vraṇo mithyopacārāc ca naiva sādhyo 'pi sidhyati| -------------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. phenādivahaḥ śalyukta ūrdhvanirvamī tathā bhagandaro 'ntarmukhas tathā kaṭhyasthisaṃśritas tathā kuṣṭhyādīnāṃ vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhdyanti| tathā yeṣāṃ vraṇe vraṇāḥ syus te ca duḥsādhyāḥ| visarpajvarādimatāṃ vraṇā naiva siddhyanti| śiraḥkapāle ca bhinne mastuluṅgadarśane [vā] vraṇo na siddhyati| srāyukledādeḥ kāraṇāt sādhyo 'pi vraṇo na siddhyati|

-------------------------------------------------|
kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ||22||
sthirāś cipiṭikāvanto rohatīti tam ādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. yasya kapotavarṇābhāḥ prakledavarjitā antāḥ, tathā cipiṭikānvanto-mlānaprāyāḥ, taṃ-vraṇaṃ, rohatīti nirdiśet|

-------------------------------------------------|
athātra śophāvasthāyāṃ yathāsannaṃ viśodhanam||23||
yojyaṃ śopho hi śuddhānāṃ vraṇaś cāśu praśāmyati| -------------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. atra ca-vraṇe, śophāvasthāyāṃ satyāṃ yathāsannaṃ-ūrdhvam adho vā, śodhanaṃ-vamanaṃ virecanaṃ vā, yojyam| śuddhānāṃ hi śopho vraṇaś ca śīghraṃ śāmyati|

-------------------------------------------------|
kuryāc chītopacāraṃ ca śophāvasthasya santatam||24||
doṣāgnir agnivat tena prayāti sahasā śamam| -------------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. śophāvasthasya satataṃ śītopacāraṃ kuryāt| tena-śītopacāreṇa kṛtena satā, doṣāgnir agnir iva sahasaiva śamaṃ yāti|
Sa. śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhinādiguṇe viśeṣeṇa jalaukaḥprabhṛtibhir asraṃ haret| yato duṣṭarakte 'panīte sadya eva śophādiśamaḥ syāt|

lg.l: hṛte hṛte ca rudhire suśītaiḥ sparśavīryayoḥ|
pratilomaṃ hito lepaḥ sekābhyaṅgāś ca tatkṛtāḥ||28||

div.ab: Sa. punaḥ punaḥ srāvite ca rakte sati sparśavīryayoḥ suṣṭhu śītadravyaiḥ suślakṣṇais tasminn evāhani piṣṭaiḥ-na tu paryuṣitaiḥ, tathā kṣīrādidravaiḥ śatadhautaghṛtayuktair muhur aparair aśoṣibhir lepo hitaḥ| pratilomaṃ-na tv anulomam| sekābhyaṅgāś ca pūrvoktaiḥ kṛtā hitāḥ|
Sa. nyagrodhāditvagbhiḥ pradeho bhūrighṛtaḥ paraṃ śophanirvāpaṇaḥ|

lg.l: srutāsrujāṃ ca śophānāṃ vraṇānām api ced daśām||30||

div.ab: Sa. vātolbaṇānāṃ tathā stabdhānāṃ kaṭhinānāṃ tīvrarujāṃ srutaraktānāṃ śophānāṃ vraṇānām api ced daksvarūpāṇāṃ kuṭṭitaghṛtādi saṃskṛtānūpamāṃsādyaiḥ svedo hitaḥ| atasīyuktās tilā bhṛṣṭā dugdhe nirvāpitās tenaiva kṣīreṇa piṣṭā dāharujāghnāḥ|

lg.l: abhyajya svedayitvā ca veṇunāḍyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. śophān sthirān alpapīḍān vātakaphaghnaiḥ snehair mrakṣāyitvā svedayitvā ca vaṃśanāḍyā vimlāpanārthaṃ śanaiḥ śanair malayet| talenāṅguṣṭhakena vā malayet| yavādibhiḥ siddhapiṣṭaiḥ pradehayet|

lg.l: vilīyate sa cen naivaṃ tatas tam upanāhayet|
avidagdhas tathā śāntiṃ vidagdhaḥ pākam aśrute||34||

div.ab: Sa. evaṃ kṛte yadi śopho na vilīyate, tatas tam upanāhayet| tathā kṛte saty avidagdhaḥ śophaṇ san śāntiṃ prāpnoti| vidagdhas tu pacyate|
Sa. badarādiyutā saktupiṇḍikā'mladadhiyutā kiṇvādyanvitā koṣṇā upanāhe śreṣṭhā|
Sa. śophe supakve grathite pīḍanair dravyair upapīḍite sati dāraṇārhasya sukumārasya narasya dāraṇam iṣyate|
Sa. guglgulvādīni, tathā kṣārauṣadhāni-kṣāravidhyuktāni (hṛ.sū.a. 3018), kṣārāś ca, pakvaśophavidāraṇaṃ syāt| godanto-haritālam|
Sa. pūyagarbhān sūkṣmadvārān sotsaṅgān marmāśritān sneharahitaiḥ pīḍanadravyaiḥ paritaḥ pratipīḍayet|

lg.l: na mukhe cainam ālimpet tathā doṣaḥ prasicyate||39||

div.ab: Sa. pīḍanaṃ prati yo lepas taṃ śuṣyantaṃ samupekṣeta| mukhe cainaṃ vraṇaṃ nālimpet| tathā ca-evaṃ, doṣaḥ, prasicyate-niryāti|
Sa. kalāyādayaḥ picchilānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ tvaco mūlāni ca prapīḍanaṃ syāt|

lg.l: bhṛśaṃ duṣṭe vraṇe yojyau mehakuṣṭhavraṇeṣu ca||41||

div.ab: Sa. saptasu kṣālanādiṣu-kṣālanam ālepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā cūrṇo vartiś ceti sapta teṣu, surasādir āragvadhādiś ceti (hṛ.sū.a. 15) duṣṭe vraṇe bhṛśaṃ yojyau tathā mehādiṣu ca|
Sa. athavā'viśuddhe vraṇe paṭolīnimbapatrajaḥ kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitaḥ| viśuddhe tu vraṇe nyagrodhāditvagudbhavaḥ kvāthaḥ kṣālanādau hitaḥ|
Sa. paṭolādibhir lepaḥ saindhavayuto vraṇaśodhanaḥ|
Sa. vraṇān sūkṣmamukhān sandhimarmāśritān vartyā trivṛtādibhiḥ kṛtayā viśodhayet|
Sa. vātābhibhūtān sāsrāvān dāruṇavedanān yavādibhir dhūpayet|
nirvāpayed bhṛśaṃ śītaiḥ pittaraktaviṣolbaṇān| -------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. pittā[dya]dhikān śītair bhṛśaṃ nirvāpayet|

-------------------------------------------------|
śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīre vraṇa utsādanaṃ hitam||46||
nyagrodhapadmakādibhyām aśvagandhābalātilaiḥ|
adyān māṃsādamāṃsāni vidhinopahitāni ca||47||
māṃsaṃ māṃsādamāṃsena vardhate śuddhacetasaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. vraṇe śuṣkālpamāṃse gambhīra utsādanaṃ hitaṃ vyagrodhādibhiḥ| tathā māṃsādīnāṃ prāṇināṃ māṃsāni suṣṭhu saṃskṛtāni bhakṣayet| yataḥ śuddhamanaso māṃsādamāṃsena piśitaṃ vardhate|
Sa. vraṇānām utsannamṛdumāṃsānāṃ jātīmukulādibhir avasādanaṃ hitam|

-------------------------------------------------|
utsannamāṃsān kaṭhinān kaṇḍūyuktāṃś cirotthitān||49||
vraṇān suduḥkhaśodhyāṃś ca śodhayet kṣārakarmaṇā| -------------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. utsannamāṃsādikā vraṇās tathā ye tu suṣṭhu durviśodhyās tān kṣārakarmaṇā viśodhayet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sravanto 'śmarijā mūtraṃ ye cānye raktavāhinaḥ||50||

lg.l: chinnāś ca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktair ye ca śodhanaiḥ|
śodhyamānā na śudhdyanti śodhyāḥ syus te 'gnikarmaṇā||51||

div.ab: Sa. aśmarijā vraṇā mūtraṃ sravanto, ye cānye raktavāhino, yeṣāṃ ca sandhayas chināḥ, ye ca yathoktaiḥ śodhanaiḥ śodhyamānā na śuddhyanti, te 'gnikarmaṇā śodhyāḥ syuḥ|
śuddhānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam utsādāya yad īritam| -------------------------------------------------|52|
Sa. yad utsādārthaṃ dravyaṃ kathitaṃ tad eva śuddhānāṃ vraṇānāṃ ropaṇaṃ yojyam|

-------------------------------------------------|
aśvagandhā ruhā rodhraṃ kaṭphalaṃ madhuyaṣṭikā||52||
samaṅgā dhātakīpuṣpaṃ paramaṃ vraṇaropaṇam| -------------------------------------------------|53|
Sa. aśvagandhādikaṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ param|

-------------------------------------------------|
apetapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānām arohatām||53||
kalkaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt tilānāṃ madhikānvitam| -------------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. apagatapūtimāṃsānāṃ māṃsasthānāṃ vraṇānām arohatāṃ tilakalkaṃ samadhukaṃ saṃrohaṇaṃ kuryāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
snigdhoṣṇatiktamadhurakaṣāyatvaiḥ sa sarvajit||54||

lg.l: pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syād āśu ropaṇaḥ||55||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa tilakalkaḥ snigdhādiguṇaiḥ sarvarogajit| sa mākṣikanimbapatrābhyāṃ yutas tilakalkaḥ paraṃ saṃśodhanam| pūrvābhyāṃ-kṣaudranimbapatrābhyāṃ, sarpiṣā cāsau tilakalko yutaḥ śīghraṃ saṃrohaṇaḥ syāt|
tilavad yavakalkaṃ tu kecid icchanti tadvidaḥ| -------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. kecid vraṇasvarūpābhijñā yavakalkaṃ tilakalkavad icchanti|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
sāsrapittaviṣāgantugambhīrān soṣmaṇo vraṇān||56||

div.ab: Sa. sāsrapittādīn vraṇān kṣīrayuktaropaṇadravyapakvena ghṛtena ropayet| ropaṇadravyasiddhena tailena kaphavātotthān ropayet|
Sa. kāchchyādikaṃ sūkṣmarajīkṛtaṃ tailamadanair yuktaṃ ropaṇam|
samānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇa iṣyate| -------------------------------------------------|59|
Sa. saṃ-samānāṃ vraṇānāṃ sthiramāṃsānāṃ tvaksthānāṃ cūrṇam iṣṭam|

-------------------------------------------------|
kakubhodumbarāśvatthajambūkaṭphalarodhrajaiḥ||59||
tvacam āśu nigṛhṇanti tvakcūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ| -------------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. saṃ-kakubhādijaiś cūrṇair vraṇāś cūrṇitāḥ śīghram eva tvacaṃ nigṛhṇananti|

-------------------------------------------------|
lākṣāmanohvāmañjiṣṭhāharitālaniśādvayaiḥ||60||
pralepaḥ saghṛtakṣaudras tvagviśuddhikaraḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. saṃ-lākṣādibhir ghṛtakṣaudrasahito lepaḥ paraṃ tvagviśuddhikaraḥ|

-------------------------------------------------|
kālīyakalatāmrāsthihemakālārasottamaiḥ||61||
lepaḥ sagomayarasaḥ savarṇakaraṇaḥ param| -------------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. kālīyakādibhir lepaḥ sagośakṛdrasaḥ paraṃ savarṇakaraṇaḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
dagdho vāraṇadanto 'ntardhūmaṃ tailaṃ rasāñjanam||62||

div.ab: Sa. vāraṇadanto 'ntardhūmaṃ dagdhas tailaṃ rasāñjanaṃ ca lepo romodbhavakaraḥ| tathaiva tailapariplutā catuṣpānnakhādijā maṣī pūrvaguṇā|
vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmoktaṃ pathyāpathyānnam ādiśet| -------------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. vraṇinaḥ śastrakarmavidhikathitaṃ (hṛ.sū.a. 29/34) pathyāpathyānnam ādiśet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------------------------|
dve pañcamūle vargaś ca vātaghno vātike hitaḥ||64||

lg.l: āragvadhādiḥ śleṣmaghnaḥ kaphe, miśrās tu miśraje||65||

div.ab: Sa. dve pañcamūle tathā vargo vātaghno vātādhike hitaḥ| tathā paittike nyagrodhādipadmakādī(hṛ.sū.a. 15/49 a. 15/12) hitau| ślaiṣmika āragvadhādiḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 15/17) kaphaghno hitaḥ| miśre tu miśra upakramo hitaḥ|

lg.l: ebhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ lepo ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ rasakriyā|
cūrṇo vartiś ca saṃyojyā vraṇe sapta yathāyatham||66||

div.ab: Sa. ebhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ, prakṣālanādayaḥ sapta vraṇe sati yathāsvaṃ yojyāḥ|

jātīnimbapaṭolapatrakaṭukādārvīniśāsārivā- mañjiṣṭhābhayasikthatutthamadhukair naktāhvabījānvitaiḥ|
sarpiḥ sādhyam anena sūkṣmavadanā marmāśritāḥ kledino gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ sagatayaḥ śudhdyanti rohanti ca|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭa- viracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇapratiṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|25|

Sa. saṃ-jātyādibhiḥ sarpiḥ sādhyam| abhayaṃ-uśīram atra| anena sarpiṣā sūkṣmamukhā marmasthādayaś ca vraṇāḥ śuddhyanti rohanti ceti| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vraṇaprati- ṣedho nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 25||

div.head: sadyovranapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. vraṇaprakramāt sadyovraṇapratiṣedhaṃ vyācikhyāsur āha-
Sa. abhighātāt sahasaiva ye sadyovraṇā jāyante, asaṅkhyair api tair vraṇaiḥ śarīraṃ juṣṭam aṣṭadhā kathyate|

tān evāṣṭau prakārān āha ----
ghṛṣṭāvakṛttavicchinnapravilambitapātitam|
viddhaṃ bhinnaṃ vidalitaṃ-------------------|2|
Sa. ghṛṣṭety ādi|

lg.l: raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ saploṣaṃ chedanāt sravet|
avagāḍhaṃ tataḥ kṛttaṃ, vicchinnaṃ syāt tato 'pi ca||3||

div.ab: Sa. teṣu madhye ghṛṣṭaṃ lasīkayā raktaleśena vā yuktaṃ sravet, chedanāt saploṣam| tasmād avagāḍham avakṛttaṃ syāt| tato 'py avagāḍhataraṃ vicchinnaṃ syāt| pravilambi saśeṣāsthi yat| patitaṃ yac charīrāt tat pātitaṃ syāt| sūkṣmamukhaśalyaviddhaṃ yat tat viddhaṃ kthyate koṣṭhavivarjitam| anyat koṣṭhe yad viddhaṃ tad bhinnam ucyate| vidalitaṃ tad gadyate yan majjaraktapariplutaṃ prahārādibhiḥ sahāsthnā pṛthutāṃ gatam|
Sa. atha evaṃ vraṇasvarūpatāṃ jñātvā, sadya eveti sadyovraṇaṃ tīvravyathaṃ madhuyaṣṭīghṛtena koṣṇena siñcet| balātailena (hṛ.śā.a. 2/47) vā koṣṇena punaḥ punaḥ siñcet|
Sa. kṣatoṣmaṇaś ca śāntaye tatkālanirgatasya ca kaṣāyādayo lepādyāḥ śasyante|

lg.l: madhusarpiś ca yuñjīta pittaghnīś ca himāḥ kriyāḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. sadyovraṇeṣv āyateṣu sandhānāRthaṃ viśeṣeṇa mākṣikaṃ saghṛtaṃ yuñjīta| tathā pittaghnīś ca śītāḥ kriyā hitāḥ|

lg.l: sasaṃrambheṣu kartavyam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhanam|

div.ab: Sa. sasaṃrambheṣu vraṇeṣūrdhvam adhaś ca śodhanaṃ kāryam| tathopavāso vidhātavyaḥ| avasthāvaśāt pūrvoktaṃ bhojanaṃ hitam| tathā pratataṃ raktasrāvaṇaṃ hitam|

lg.l: ghṛṣṭe vidalite caiṣa sutarām iṣyate vidhiḥ|
tayor hy alpaṃ sravaty asraṃ pākas tenāśu jāyate||10||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛṣṭe vidalite ca eṣā pūrvoktā cikitsā iṣyate| yasmāt tayoḥ-ghṛṣṭavidalitayoḥ, asram alpaṃ sravati| tena ca kāreṇena tayor āśu śīghraṃ pāko jāyate|
Sa. anyatra vikṣate bāhulyena bahu raktaṃ sravati| na ca pākaṃ yāti| anantaram atyantaraktasrāvāt pavane kupite 'tirujākare sati snehapānādikaṃ snehabastiṃ ca vātaharauṣadhasādhitaṃ kurvīta|

lg.l: saptāhād gatavege tu pūrvoktaṃ vidhim ācaret||13||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃ, sāptāhikaḥ sadyovraṇahito vidhir uktaḥ| saptāhena nivṛtta iti "prāg vahateṣ ṭhak" iti ṭhak| saptāhād ūrdhvaṃ gatakṣobhe sati pūrvoktaṃ vidhiṃ-vraṇapratiṣedhoktaṃ, kuryāt|
prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak| ---------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. prāyo bāhulyena sadyovraṇa etat sāmānyaṃ karma| pṛthak pṛthag viśeṣeṇa karma bhaṇiṣyate|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu vraṇe cūrṇāni yojayet||14||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛṣṭe vraṇe pīḍāṃ prāg upaśamayya cūrṇāni yojayet|
Sa. avakṛtte punar vraṇe kalkādīni yojayet|

ab.seg:
-------------------------vicchinnapravilambinoḥ|
sīvanaṃ vidhinoktena bandhanaṃ cānu pīḍanam||15||

div.ab: Sa. vicchinne pravilambani ca vraṇe sīvanaṃ pūrvoktena vidhānena, tathā bandhanaṃ pīḍanaṃ ca paścād yojayet|

lg.l: asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ netram adīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat|
tato 'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ||17||

div.ab: Sa. sphuṭitaṃ locanam asādhyam| asphuṭitaṃ tu yan netram avadīrṇaṃ lambate, tat sve sthāne sanniveśyāvyāvidhasiraṃ padmapatrāntaritena hastena pīḍayet| anantaram asyāturasya ghṛtaṃ chāgaṃ sakṣīrair yaṣṭyādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ pakvaṃ secanādau hitam| yatas tad ghṛtaṃ paraṃ sarvanetrābhighātajit|
Sa. galapīḍanam avasanne netre vamanādayaḥ kāryāḥ, prāṇāyāmo vā| tathā kṣanetrakriyā cātra hitā|
karṇe sthānāc cyute syūte śrotas tailena pūrayet| ---------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. karṇe sthānād bhraṣṭe syūte sati tailena śrotaḥ pūrayet|

---------------------------------------------------|
kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ nirgacchaty api mārute||20||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtvā śīghraṃ nirantaram|
ājena sarpiṣā cātra pariṣekaḥ praśasyate||21||
uttāno 'nnāni bhuñjīta, śayīta ca suyantritaḥ| ---------------------------------------------------|22|

Sa. kṛkāṭikāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ vāte 'pi niryāte sati samaṃ sthāpayitvā syūtvā ca nirantaraṃ śīghraṃ badhnīyāt| atrājena ghṛtena ca pariṣekaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ| uttānāḥ san bhojanaṃ bhuñjīta| suyantritaś ca svapyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
ghātaṃ śākhāsu tiryaksthaṃ gātre samyaṅ niveśite||22||

div.ab: Sa. śākhāsu hatam āturaṃ tiryaksthitaṃ śarīre samyak sthāpite syūtvā vellitabandhena ghanena vāsasā badhnīyāt| asaṅgate vraṇe carmaṇā goṣphaṇābandho vidheyaḥ|

lg.l: pādau vilambimuṣkasya prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā|
kāryaś ca goṣphaṇābandhaḥ kaṭyām āveśya paṭṭakam|
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tatra klidyati hi vraṇaḥ||25||

div.ab: Sa. vilambumuṣkasya pādau netre ca vāriṇā prekṣya vṛṣaṇau praveśya sīvyet| katham ? tunnasaṃjñayā sevanyā| tathā kaṭyāṃ paṭṭakam āsajya goṣphaṇābandhaṃ kuryāt| snehasekaṃ na kurvīta| yataḥ snehaseke saty asmin vraṇaḥ klidyati|
Sa. kālānusāryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ vṛṣaṇayo ropaṇam|

lg.l: chinnāṃ niḥśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktitaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. niḥśeṣeṇa chinnāṃ śākhāṃ dagdhvā tailena yuktyā kośabandhena badhnīyāt| anantaraṃ vraṇam ivācaret|
kāryā śalyāhṛte viddhe bhaṅgād vidalite kriyā| ---------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. viddhe śalyāhṛte sati bhaṅgād vidalite kriyā kāryā|

lg.l: vraṇe rohati caikaikaṃ śanair apanayet kacam||29||

div.ab: Sa. śirasaḥ śalye nipatite sati vālavartiṃ praveśayet| anyathā-vālavarter apraveśāt, mastuluṅgasrāvād vāyuḥ ṛddhaḥ enaṃ- vraṇinaṃ, hanyāt| vraṇe rohati saty ekaikaṃ kacaṃ śanair nayet|

ācaramocchvāsād āturaṃ samupācared iti vacanān mastuluṅgasrutāv apy upakramam āha ----
mastuluṅgasrutau khāden mastiṣkān anyajīvajān| ---------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. mastuluṅgasya-majjākhyasya, srutāv anyajīvajān mastiṣkān khādet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
śalye hṛte 'ṅgād anyasmāt snehavartiṃ nidhāpayet||30||

div.ab: Sa. aṅgād anyasmāc chalye hṛte sati tatra vraṇe snehavartiṃ nidhāpayet|
Sa. ye vraṇā dūrāvagāḍhādiguṇās tāṃś cakratailena-kohlakādyudbhavena tailena, secayet| kimbhūtena ? sūkṣmanetreṇārpitena-kṣiptena|

lg.l: lohagandhitvam āsyasya syād gātre ca vigandhatā||33||

div.ab: Sa. bhinne koṣṭhe raktena pūrṇe sati mūrcchādyāḥ syuḥ|
Sa. āmāśayasthe rudhire raktam udvamaty apy ādhmānenātimātreṇa śūlena ca viśasyate-vyāpadyate|

lg.l: nābher adhastāc chītatvaṃ khebhyo raktasya cāgamaḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. pakvāśayasthe lohite śūlasahitaṃ gauravaṃ bhavet| nābher adhobhāge śaityam| chidrebhyo rudhirasyaivāgamanam|
Sa. āśayo 'bhinno 'pi sūkṣmaiḥ srotobhir lohitena syandamānenābhipūryate| pārśve mūtreṇa bastir iva|
Sa. teṣu madhye 'ntarlohitaṃ vraṇinaṃ śītapādaṃ śītocchvāsaṃ śiśirakaraṃ śītavakraṃ lohitākṣaṃ pāṇḍuvadanam ānaddhaṃ ca varjayet|
Sa. āmāśayasthe rakte vamanaṃ hitam| pakvāśayagate virecanaṃ nirūhaṃ ca vigatasnehair uṣṇaiś ca viśodhanair hitam|
Sa. yavādīnāṃ rasaiḥ sneharahitair annaṃ bhakṣayet| peyāṃ saindhavānvitāṃ vā pibet|
atiniḥsrutaraktas tu bhinnakoṣṭhaḥ pibed asṛk| ---------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. atiniḥsrutalohito bhinnakoṣṭho rudhiraṃ pibet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
kliṣṭacchinnāntrabhedena koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā smṛtaḥ||40||

lg.l: mūrcchādayo 'lpāḥ prathame dvitīye tv ati bādhakāḥ|
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśayī dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati||41||

div.ab: Sa. klinnāntrabhedena bhinnāntrabhedena ca koṣṭhabhedo dviprakāra uktaḥ| prathame-klinnāntrākhye, mūrcchadayo 'lpāḥ-kiñcid eva, syuḥ| dvitīye-bhinnāntrākhye, atiśayena bādhakāḥ syuḥ| klinnāntro dehī saṃśayī syād jīvane| bhinnāntro na jātu jīvati|

lg.l: vyupadravaḥ sa bhinne 'pi koṣṭhe jīvaty asaṃśayam||42||

div.ab: Sa. yasya viṇmūtramārutā yathāyathaṃ mārgaṃ prāptāḥ vigatopadravaś ca sa naro bhinnakoṣṭho 'pi san jīvati|

lg.l: abhinnam antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśyaṃ na tv ato 'nyathā|
utpaṅgilaśirograstaṃ tad apy eke vadanti tu||43||

div.ab: Sa. antram abhinnaṃ niṣkrāntaṃ praveśanīyam antare| na tv ato 'nyathā-bhinnam ity arthaḥ| anye tv evam ācakṣate,-utpaṅgilaśirasā markoṭaśīrṣeṇa, grastaṃ bhinnam apy antraṃ praveśyam| saṃ-antraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ tṛṇādibhir digdhaṃ payasā prakṣālya sarpiṣā'bhyaktaṃ klṛptanakhaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ praveśayet|

kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ bhūrisarpiḥpariplutam|
aṅgulyā pramṛśet kaṇṭhaṃ jalenodvejayed api||45||
tathā'ntrāṇi viśanty antas tatkālaṃ pīḍayanti ca| ---------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. śuṣkam antraṃ kṣīreṇārdrīkṛtaṃ bahughṛtapariplutam aṅgulyā galaṃ pramṛśet jalenodvejayet| tathā-evaṃ, antrāṇy antaḥ praviśanti tatkālaṃ ca pīḍayanti|

---------------------------------------------------|
vraṇasaukṣmyād bahutvād vā koṣṭham antram anāviśat||46||
tatpramāṇena jaṭharaṃ pāṭayitvā praveśayet|
yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyag antre sīvyed anu vraṇam||47||
sthānād apetam ādatte jīvitaṃ kupitaṃ ca tat|
veṣṭayitvā'nu paṭṭena ghṛtena pariṣecayet||48||
pāyayeta tataḥ koṣṇaṃ citrātailayutaṃ payaḥ|
mṛdukriyārthaṃ śakṛto vāyoś cādhaḥpravṛttaye||49||
anuvarteta varṣaṃ ca yathoktāṃ vraṇayantraṇām| ---------------------------------------------------|50|

Sa. vraṇasūkṣmātvād antrasya bahutvāt [vā] koṣṭham anāviśad antraṃ jaṭharaṃ tatpramāṇena pāṭayitvā praveśayet| yathāsthānaṃ sthite samyag antre sati paścād vraṇaṃ sīvyet| sthānāc cyutam antraṃ jīvitaṃ harati| kupitaṃ ca tat-antraṃ, paṭṭena veṣṭayitvā paścād ghṛtena pariṣecayet| anantaraṃ citrātailānvitaṃ koṣṇaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet| śakṛto mRṛdūkaraṇāya pavamānasya ca pravartanāya| yathoktāṃ ca vraṇayantraṇāṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad anuvarteta|

lg.l: avakīrya kaṣāyair vā ślakṣṇair mūlais tataḥ samam|
dṛḍhaṃ badhvā ca sūtreṇa varddhayet kuśalo bhiṣak||51||
sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe sujīrṇe 'nne ghṛtaṃ pibet|

div.ab: Sa. jaṭharān medaso vartiṃ nirgatāṃ bhasmanā vā mṛdā'vakīryāthavā ślakṣṇacūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyair mūlair avakīrya tato mūlena samaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ca kṛtvā sūtreṇa badhvā tīkṣṇena vahniprataptena śastreṇa kuśalo vaidyaḥ sakṛd eva varddhayet| anyathā chinnayā rujā''ṭopo mṛtyur vā syāt| tato vraṇe samākṣike baddhe 'nne ca sujīrṇe sati ghṛtaṃ pibet| athavā śarkarādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ pibet| tac ca ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ vā rujādāhahṛt| anantaraṃ pūrvokto vidhiḥ| tatra medogranthiṣu kathitaṃ tailam abhyañjane hitam|

tālīsaṃ padmakaṃ māṃsīhareṇvagurucandanam|
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ||55||
pakvaṃ sadyovraṇeṣūktaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇam uttamam| ---------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. tālīsādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ tailaṃ sadyovraṇeṣu ropaṇaṃ param uktam|

---------------------------------------------------|
gūḍhaprahārābhihate patite viṣamoccakaiḥ||56||
kāryaṃ vātāsrajit tṛptimardanābhyañjanādikam| ---------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. gūḍhaprahāreṇābhihate, tathā viṣamaṃ patite, tathoccakaiḥ patite ca, vātaraktaharādikaṃ kāryam|

---------------------------------------------------|
viśliṣṭadehaṃ mathitaṃ kṣīṇaṃ marmāhataṃ hatam|57|
vāsayet tailapūrṇāyāṃ droṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinam| 57 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnūśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne sadyovraṇapratiṣedho nāma ṣa- ḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|26|

Sa. viśliṣṭadehādikaṃ naraṃ tailadroṇyāṃ māṃsarasāśinaṃ vāsayed iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām āṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sadyovraṇaprati- ṣedho nāma ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 26||

div.head: bhaṅgapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. asmād anantaraṃ kramaprāpto bhaṅgapratiṣedhaḥ śasyate _

athāto bhaṅgapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||
) pātaghātādibhir dvedhā bhaṅgo 'sthnāṃ sandhyasandhitaḥ|
prasāraṇākuñcanayor aśaktiḥ sandhimuktatā||1||
itarasmin bhṛśaṃ śophaḥ sarvavasthāsv ativyathā|
aśaktiś ceṣṭite 'lpe 'pi pīḍyamāne saśabdatā||2||
samāsād iti bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇaṃ, bahudhā tu tat|
bhidyate bhaṅgabhedena tasya sarvasya sādhanam||3||
yathā syād upayogāya tathā tad upadekṣyate| ----------------------------------------------------|4|

Sa. pātādibhir asthnāṃ bhaṅgaḥ| sa ca dvedhā-dviprakāraḥ, sandhīnāṃ bhaṅgo 'sandher vā| sandhibhaṅge prasāraṇa ākuñcane cāśaktiḥ sandhimuktatā ca| itarasmin-asandhibhaṅge, atiśophaḥ, sarvāsv avasthāsv atiśayena rujā, alpe 'pi ceṣṭite 'śaktiḥ, pīḍyamāne ca saśabdatā, syāt| iti saṅkṣepeṇa bhaṅgasya lakṣaṇam uktam| tac ca bhaṅgabhedenānekadhā bhidyate| saṃ-tasya-bhaṅgasya, sarvasya sādhanaṃ-cikitsitaṃ, yathopayogāya syāt tathopadekṣyate|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
prajyāṇudāri yat tv asthi sparśe śabdaṃ karoti yat||4||

lg.l: unnamyamānaṃ kṣatavad yac ca majjani majjati|
bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ yat kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutaṃ ca yat|
jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yat tad vivarjayet||7||

div.ab: Sa. prājyāś ca te 'ṇavaś ca prājyāṇavaḥ,-prabhūtasūkṣmāḥ| tair drārāḥ-dāraṇāni, vidyante yatrāsthni tat| prabhūtāṇudāri yad asthi tad duḥsādhyam| yac cāsthi sparśe-sparśane sati, śabdaṃ karoti tac ca duḥsādhyam| yatrāsthileśo dāritaḥ-pāṭitaḥ, asthnāṃ madhyaṃ praviśet tac ca duḥsādhyam| yac cābhighātena bhagnam| kimbhūtam ? kiñcid evāvaśeṣitaṃ bhavet, tac ca duḥsādhyam| yac connamyamānaṃ kṣatasamaṃ syāt, tac ca duḥsādhyam| tathā yan majjani majjati, tathā kṛśādīnām api yat, tac ca duḥsādhyam| saṃ-kaṭyāṃ-kaṭipradeśe, yat kapālaṃ bhinnaṃ vidāritaṃ yac ca sandhivimuktaṃ yac ca sandheś cayutaṃ yac ca jaghanaṃ prati piṣṭaṃ bhagnaṃ ca yat tad vivarjayet-pariharet|

asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭaṃ cūrṇitam tathā|
yac ca bhagnaṃ bhavec chaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanāntare||8||
samyag yamitam apy asthi durnyāsād durnibandhanāt|
saṅkṣobhād api yad gacched vikriyāṃ tad vivarjayet||9||
ādito yac ca durjātam asthisandhir athāpi vā|
taruṇāsthīni bhujyante, bhajyante nalakāni tu||10||
kapālāni vibhidyante, sphuṭanty anyāni bhūyasā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. lalāṭam asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ-bhinnaṃ, cūrṇitaṃ ca nopakramet| śaṅkhaśiraḥpṛṣṭhastanānāṃ madhye yac chinnaṃ bhavet, tac ca varjayet| saṃ-tathā'sthi samyag uddhṛtam api durnyāsādinā yad vikriyāṃ gacchet, tac ca varjayet| āditaḥ-prathamam eva, yac cāsthi durjātaṃ-asamyag utpannaṃ syāt, tac ca duḥsādhyam| athavā'sthisandhir yo durjātaḥ syāt, sa ca duḥsādhyaḥ| durjātaṃ ca durjātaś ca durjātam| "napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena" ity ekaśeṣaḥ| saṃ-tathā taruṇāsthīni-nāsākarṇākṣikoṣāṇi, bhujyante-kuṭilīkriyante| tathā nalakāni bhaṅgaṃ yānti| kapālāni ca vidāryante| anyāni cāsthīni bāhulyena sphuṭanti| etat sarvaṃ duḥsādhyam|

----------------------------------------------------|
athāvanatam unnamyam unnataṃ cāvapīḍayet||11||
ācched atikṣiptam adhogataṃ copari vartayet|
āñchanotpīḍanonnāmacarmasaṅkṣepabandhanaiḥ||12||
sandhīn śarīragān sarvān calān apy acalān api|
ity etaiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ samyak saṃsthāpya niścalam||13||
paṭṭaiḥ prabhūtasarpirbhir veṣṭayitvā sukhais tataḥ|
kadambodumbarāśvatthasarjārjunapalāśajaiḥ||14||
vaṃśodbhavair vā pṛthubhis tanubhiḥ suniveśitaiḥ|
suślakṣṇaiḥ sapratistambhair valkalaiḥ śakalair api||15||
kuśāhvayaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari yojayet| ----------------------------------------------------|16|
