Sa. atha-eṣāṃ bhaṅgasthitiṃ jñātvā, avanatam asthy unnamanīyam| unnataṃ cāsthy avapīḍayet| atikṣiptam asthy āñchet| adhastād gataṃ copari vartayet| saṃ-iti-evaṃprakāraiḥ, etaiḥ-āñchanādibhiḥ sthāpanopāyaiḥ, sarvāñ charīragān sandhīṃś calān acalāṃś ca niścalaṃ saṃsthāpya vastrakhaṇḍajaiḥ paṭṭair bahusarpiṣkaiḥ sukhāvahair veṣṭayitvā'nantaraṃ kadambādijair valkalair vaṃśotthair vā śakalaiḥ-khaṇḍaiḥ, vistīrṇais tathā tanubhiḥ-na tu sthūlaiḥ, suniveśitais tathā komalais tathā pratistambhayuktaiḥ kuśāsaṃjñaiḥ samaṃ bandhaṃ paṭṭasyopari kuryāt|

----------------------------------------------------|
śithilena hi bandhena sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate||16||
gāḍhenāti rujādāhapākaśvayathusambhavaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ślathena bandhena sandheḥ sthairyaṃ na sampadyate| atigāḍhena tu bandhena rujādyudbhavaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------|
tryahāt tryahād ṛtau gharme saptāhān mokṣayed dhime||17||
sādhāraṇe tu pañcahād bhaṅgadoṣavaśena vā| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. uṣṇe ṛtau tryahāt tryahān mokṣayet| śīte ca ṛtau saptāhān mokṣayet| sādhāraṇe-śaradvasantākhye, pañcahān mokṣayet| athavā bhāṅgavaśena doṣavaśena mokṣayet|

----------------------------------------------------|
nyagrodhādikaṣāyeṇa tataḥ śītena secayet||18||
taṃ pañcamūlapakvena payasā tu savedanam|
sukhoṣṇaṃ vā'vacāryaṃ syāc cakratailaṃ vijānatā||19||
vibhajya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutam| ----------------------------------------------------|20|

Sa. tato nyagrodhādigaṇadravyakaṣāyeṇa śītena secayet bhaṅgasandhīn| taṃ-sarujaṃ, pañcamūlaśṛtena kṣīreṇa secayet| saṃ-avasthādiviśeṣaṃ vijñāya cakratailaṃ vātaghnauṣadhasaṃyutaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ vijānatā vaidyena vā'vacāraṇīyam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
pratataṃ sekalepāṃś ca vidadhyāt bhṛśaśītalān||20||

div.ab: Sa. pratataṃ sekādīṃś ca suśītalān kuryāt|

lg.l: prātaḥ prātaḥ pibed bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yutam||21||

div.ab: Sa. bhagno naro gṛṣṭikṣīraṃ ghṛtasahitaṃ madhuradravyasādhitaṃ śītalaṃ lākṣayā yuktaṃ prātaḥ pibet|
Sa. savraṇasya bhagnasya vraṇo madhughṛtottaraiḥ kaṣāyaiḥ pratisāraṇīyaḥ| atha śeṣaḥ kramo bhaṅgakathito vidheyaḥ|
Sa. vraṇamāṃsāni lambāni madhughṛtenālipya vraṇān vaidyaḥ sandadhyāt| kṛtasandhānāṃś ca tān yathāsvaṃ bandhair yojayet|

tān samān susthitāñ jñātvā phalinīrodhrakaṭphalaiḥ|
samaṅgādhātakīyuktaiś cūrṇitair avacūrṇayet||24||
dhātakīrodhracūrṇair vā, rohanty āśu tathā vraṇāḥ| iti bhaṅga upakrāntaḥ-------------------------|25|
Sa. tān-vraṇān, susthitān samāṃś ca viditvā phalinyādibhī rajīkṛtair ācūrṇayet| dhātakīrodhrayoś cūrṇena vā| tathā-evaṃ kṛte sati, vraṇā drāg eva rohanti| saṃ-iti-anena prakāreṇa, bhaṅgaś cikitsitaḥ|
Sa. śītartau śtiradhātos tathā māṃsalasya stokadoṣasya vraṇaḥ sukhasādhyaḥ| anyathā-ato viparyayeṇa, dāruṇaḥ-kṛcchrasādhyo 'sādhyo vā|

----------------------------------------------------|
pūrvamadhyāntavayasām ekadvitriguṇaiḥ kramāt||26||
māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet sandher yathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim| ----------------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. yathoktaṃ vidhiṃ kurvatāṃ pūrvamadhyāntavayasām ekadvitriguṇair māsair yathākramaṃ sandheḥ sthairyaṃ jāyate|

----------------------------------------------------|
kaṭījaṅghorubhagnānāṃ kapāṭaśayanaṃ hitam||27||
yantraṇārtha tathā kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ|
jaṅghorvoḥ pāRśvayor dvau dvau tala ekaś ca kīlakaḥ||28||
śorṇyāṃ vā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vā vakṣasy akṣakayos tathā| ----------------------------------------------------|29|

Sa. kaṭyādibhagnānaṃ kapāṭesthirhitā| yantraṇārthaṃ ca kīlāḥ-kīlakāḥ, pañca sthirasthitihetavaḥ kāryāḥ| teṣāṃ ca sthānāny āha-jaṅghorvo dvau dvau kīlakau, tala ekaḥ kīlakaḥ, śroṇyāṃ bhagnasya pṛṣṭavaṃśe tu bhagnasya pārśvayor dvau dvāv eka iti| ata evāha śroṇyāṃ vety ādi| vaktrasya(kṣasya)kṣakayoś ca bhagnasya pañcaiva kīlakā yojyāḥ| viśeṣas tv ato nopariṣṭāt kīlako yojyo yuktivaśāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
vimokṣe bhagnasandhīnāṃ vidhimevaṃ samācaret||29||

div.ab: Sa. bhagnasandhīnāṃ vimokṣa evaṃprakāraṃ vidhiṃ samācaret|

lg.l: uktair vidhānair buddhyā ca yathāsvaṃ sthānam ānayet||30||

div.ab: Sa. ciravimuktāṃs tu sandhīn pūrvaṃ snigdhān paścāt svinnān mṛdūkṛtān yathoktair vidhānair buddhyā ca viśeṣeṇa yathātmīyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayet|

lg.l: āpothya bhaṅgaṃ yamayet tato bhagnavad ācaret||31||

div.ab: Sa. asandhau bhagne rūḍhe ca viṣamolbaṇasādhite sati bhaṅgam āpothya-bhaṅktvā, paścād bhaṅgaṃ yamayet| anantaraṃ bhagnavad ācaret|

lg.l: bhagnaṃ naiti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhiṣak|

div.ab: Sa. bhagnaṃ yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti tathā vaidyo yatnaṃ kuryāt| yataḥ sandhiḥ pakvamāṃsasirāsnāyuḥ san śleṣaṃ na yāti|

lg.l: catuṣprayogān balyāṃś ca bastikarma ca śīlayet||33||

div.ab: Sa. vātavyādhikathitān snehān (ci.a. 21/66) catuṣprayogān-pānanasyābhyaṅgānuvāsanaiḥ, balyān-balāya hitān, bhagnasya yojayet| tathā bastikarma-"prāk sneha ekaḥ pañcānte" (hṛ.sū.ā. 19/63) ity ādinoktaṃ, abhyaset|

śālyājyarasadugdhādyaiḥ pauṣṭikair avidāhibhiḥ|
mātrayopacared bhagnaṃ sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhiḥ||34||
glānir na śasyate tasya, sandhiviśleṣakṛd dhi sā| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. bhagnaṃ naraṃ mātrayā śālyādibhiḥ puṣṭikṛdbhiḥ sandhisaṃśleṣakāribhir avidāhibhir upakramet| tasya-bhagnasya, glānir na śasyate| yataḥ sā-glāniḥ, sandhiviśleṣaṃ kurute|

lg.l: lavaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ kṣāram amlaṃ maithunam ātapam|
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bhojanam||35||

div.ab: Sa. bhagno lavaṇādikaṃ rūkṣaṃ cāhāraṃ na seveta|

kṛṣṇāṃs tilān virajaso dṛḍhavastrabaddhān sapta kṣapā vahati vāriṇi vāsayet|
saṃśoṣayed anudinaṃ pravisārya caitān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye|36|
punar api pītapayaskāṃ- sthān pūrvavad eva śoṣitān bāḍham|
vigatatuṣān arajaskān sañcūrṇya sucūrṇitair yuñjyāt|37|
naladavālakalohitayaṣṭikā- nakhamiśiplavakuṣṭhabalātrayaiḥ|
agurukuṅkumacandanasārivā- saralasarjarasāmaradārubhiḥ|38|
padmakādigaṇopetais tilapiṣṭaṃ tataś ca tat|
samastagandhabhaiṣajyasiddhadugdhena pīḍayet|39|
śaileyarāsnāṃśumatīkaseru- kālānusārīnatapatrarodhraiḥ|
sakṣīraśuklaiḥ sapayaḥ sadūrvai stailaṃ pacet tan naladādibhiś ca|40|
gandhatailam idam uttamam asthi- sthairyakṛj jayati cāśu vikārān| vātāpittajanitān ativīryān| vyāpino 'pi vividhair upayogaiḥ|41| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhāṅgapratiṣedho nāma sapta- viṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|27|

Sa. kṛṣṇān tilān vahati-asthire jale, saptarātrīr vigatareṇūṃs tathā dṛḍhavasanasaṃyatān vāsayet| etāṃś ca praviralān vikīrya pratidinaṃ saṃśoṣayet| tathaiva-pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, kṣīre sthitān anudinaṃ pratisārya śoṣitān sapta rātrīr evaṃ madhuyaṣṭīkvathite ca jale vāsayed viśoṣayec ca| vasantatilakāvṛttam| punar api ca pītakṣīrāṃs tāṃs tilān pūrvavad evātiśayena śoṣitān apagatatuṣaṃs tathā virajasaḥ sañcūrṇya naladādyaiḥ sucūrṇitair yojayet| āryā| tān evāha-naladety ādi| aupacchandasikam| padmakādīty ādi| kimbhūtair naladādibhiḥ ? padmakādigaṇasahitaiḥ sucūrṇitair yojayitvā caitat tilapiṣṭaṃ sakalacorakādigandhadravyasiddhena kṣīreṇa saha pīḍayet| tatas tat tailaṃ sairyakā(śaileyā)dibhir naladādibhiś ca kalkīkṛtair dugdhasahitaiḥ pacet| indravajrā| etat gandhatailam ativīryam asthisthiratvakṛd āmayāś ca pavanapittotthān ativīryān vyāpino 'py āśu jayati vividhaiḥ-pānanasyādibhiḥ, upayogaiḥ| svāgatā| śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhaṅgaprati- ṣedho nāma saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 27||

div.head: bhagandarapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. vraṇasāmānyād bhagandarapratiṣedam ācaṣṭe-

athāto bhagandarapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyaśutre||2||
) hastyaśvapṛṣṭhagamanakaṭhinotkaṭakāsanaiḥ|
arśonidānābhihitair aparaiś ca niṣevitaiḥ||1||
aniṣṭādṛṣṭapākena sadyo vā sādhugarhaṇaiḥ|
prāyeṇa piṭikāpūrvo yo 'ṅgule hyaṅgule 'pi vā||2||
pāyor vraṇo 'ntarbāhyo vā duṣṭāsṛṅmāṃsago bhavet|
bastimūtrāśayābhyāsagatatvāt syandanātmakaḥ||3||
bhagandaraḥ sa sarvāś ca dārayaty akriyāvataḥ|
bhagabastigudāṃs teṣu dīryamāṇeṣu bhūribhiḥ||4||
vātamūtraśakṛcchukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmair vamati kramāt| ----------------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. hastyaśvādigamanādibhir arśonidānoktair aparair api niṣevitair aśubhapurākṛtakarmavipākena sadyo vā sādhunindābhiḥ pāyor aṅgule dvyaṅgule vā yo vraṇo 'ntarbāhyo vā bāhu lyena piṭikāpūrvā duṣṭaraktamāṃsago bastimūtrāśayasamīpagatatvāt syandanasvabhāvaḥ sa bhagandaraḥ syāt| saṃ-bhagādīn sarvān dārayati, kriyārahitasya puṃsaḥ| teṣu-bhagādiṣu, śīryamāṇeṣu khaiḥ-chidraiḥ, sūkṣmair bahubhiḥ krameṇa vātādīn vamati|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
doṣaiḥ pṛthag yutaiḥ sarvair āgantuḥ so 'ṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. bhagandarākhyo vraṇo doṣaiḥ pṛthak tridhā| yuktaiś ca doṣais tridhā| sarvair ekaḥ| āgantur aṣṭamo gaditaḥ|
apakvaṃ piṭikām āhuḥ pākaprāptaṃ bhagandaram| ----------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. apakvaṃ śophaṃ piṭikāṃ kathayanti| pakvaṃ śophaṃ bhagandaram āhuḥ|

----------------------------------------------------|
gūḍhamūlāṃ sasaṃrambhāṃ rugāḍhyāṃ rūḍhakopinīm||6||
bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt piṭikāṃ na tv ato 'nyathā| ----------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. piṭikāṃ gūḍhamūlādiguṇāṃ bhagandarakarīṃ vidyāt| ato 'nyathā-viparyayeṇa, piṭikāmātrāṃ vijānīyāt|
Sa. teṣu madhyāc chyāvādiguṇā piṭikā pavanāt syāt|

ab.seg:
--------------pittād uṣṭragrīvāvad ucchritā|
rāgiṇi tanur ūṣmāḍhyā jvaradhūmāyanānvitā||8||

div.ab: Sa. pittāt piṭikoṣṭragrīvevocchritā rāgādiguṇānvitā ca syāt|
sthirā snigdhā mahāmūlā pāṇḍuḥ kaṇḍumatī kaphāt| ----------------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. kaphāt piṭikā sthirādiguṇā syāt|
Sa. vātapittotthā piṭikā śyāvadiguṇā syāt|
pāṇḍurā kiñcid āśyāvā kṛcchrapākā kaphānilāt| ----------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. śleṣmapavanāt piṭikā pāṇḍurādiguṇā syāt| kaphapittajas tu bhagandaraḥ "arśaḥsa(durnā)māśritya" (ślo.15) ity ārabhyāgre pratipādayiṣyati| teneha tat piṭikā tantrakṛtā nābhihitā|

----------------------------------------------------|
pādāṅguṣṭhasamā sarvair doṣair nānāvidhavyathā||10||
śūlārocakatṛḍdāhajvaracchardir upadrutā| ----------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. sarvair doṣaiḥ pādāṅuṣṭhatulyā nānāvidhavyathā śūlādibhir upadrutā piṭikā syāt|
Sa. tāś ca piṭikāḥ pramādāt-ayatnāt, pakvāḥ sadyo vraṇatāṃ yānti|

Sa. teṣu madhyād vātajā piṭikā śataponakavat-tita uvat, sūkṣmadvāraiś chidraiḥ krameṇa cīyate| kiṃ kurvāṇaiḥ ? acchaṃ-tanuṃ, āsrāvaṃ saha phenam anavarataṃ sravadbhiḥ| ayaṃ śataponakasaṃjño bhagandaraḥ|
Sa. pittajas tu bhagandara uṣṭragrīvākhyaḥ|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
bahupicchāparisrāvī parisrāvī kaphodbhavaḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. kaphottho bhagandaro bahupicchaparisrāvī syāt| sa ca parisrāvī kathyate|

lg.l: jāyate paritas tatra prākāraṃ parikheva ca||14||

div.ab: Sa. vātapittāt parikṣepīty ucyate| tatra gudaṃ parikṣipya gatiḥ puraprākāraṃ paritaḥ parikheva ca jāyate|
Sa. vātakaphād ṛjusaṃjño bhagandaraḥ| tatra ṛjvyā gatyā gudo dīryate|

----------------------------------------------------|
kaphapitte tu pūrvotthaṃ durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ||15||
arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍūdāhādimān bhavet|
sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno 'sya kledayan mūlam arśasaḥ||16||
sravaty ajasraṃ gatibhir ayam arśobhagandaraḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|

Sa. pūrvotthaṃ durnāma samāśritya kaphapitte yadā kupyataḥ, tataḥ-tatkopāt, arśomūle śophaḥ kaṇḍvādimān syāt| saḥ-śophaḥ, pakvabhinno 'sya-arśaso, mūlam āśv eva kledayan gatibhir ajasraṃ sravati| sa śopho 'rśobhagandara ucyate|

----------------------------------------------------|
sarvajaḥ śambukāvartaḥ śambukāvartasannibhaḥ||17||
gatayo dārayanty asmin rugvegair dāruṇair gudam| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. sannipātotthaḥ śambukāvartasaṃjñaḥ śambukāvartasamaḥ syāt| asmin-sarvaje bhagandare, rugvegais tīvrair gatayo gudaṃ dārayanti|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
asthileśo 'bhyavahṛto māṃsagṛddhyā yadā gudam||18||

lg.l: kṣiṇoti tiryaṅ nirgacchann unmārgaṃ kṣatato gatiḥ|
syāt tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ māṃsakothena tatra ca||19||
jāyante kṛmayas tasya khādantaḥ parito gudam|
vidārayanti nacirād unmārgī kṣatajaś ca saḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. asthilavo māṃsagārdhyena bhukto yadā tiryak-unmārgaṃ, nirgacchan gudaṃ kṣiṇoti, tadā kṣātād gatiḥ syāt| tataḥ pūyadīrṇāyāṃ gatau māṃsakothena ca tasmin kṛmayo bhavanti| te ca kṛmayaḥ tasya-bhagandariṇo, gudaṃ bhakṣayantaḥ parito vidārayanti śīghram eva| asāv unmārgī kṣatajaś cocyate|
teṣu rugdāhakaṇḍvādīn vidyād vraṇaniṣedhataḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. teṣu-bhagandareṣu, vraṇaniṣedhato-vraṇapratiṣedhāt, rugādīn vidyāt|

----------------------------------------------------|
ṣaṭ kṛcchrasādhanās teṣāṃ, nicayakṣatajau tyajet||21||
pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam| ----------------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. teṣāṃ madhyāt kṛcchrasādhanāḥ ṣaṭ-ekadoṣajā dvidoṣajāś ca| sannipātajaṃ kṣatajaṃ ca tyajet| pravāhiṇīṃ valīṃ prāptaṃ yad bhagandaraṃ tat tyajet| tathā sevanīm āśritya yaj jātaṃ tac ca varjayet|

----------------------------------------------------|
athāsya piṭikām eva tathā yatnād upācaret||22||
śudhdyasṛksrutisekādyair yathā pākaṃ na gacchati| ----------------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. athāsya-bhagandarasya, piṭikām eva-piṭikāvasthām eva, yatnaṃ kṛtvā śudhdyādibhis tathopakramet yathā pākaṃ na prāpnoti|

Sa. pāke tu saty upasnigdham avagāhena ca sveditaṃ tato 'rśasam iva yantrayitvā suṣṭhu bhagandaraṃ paśyet-avāṅmukhaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ vā, antarmukhaṃ bahirmukhaṃ vā, ity evaṃ suṣṭhu nirūpya| arvācīnam iti "vibhāṣāñcer adik striyām" iti svārthe khaḥ|

athāntarmukham eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet|
bahirmukhaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet||25||
agninā vā bhiṣak sādhu kṣāreṇaivoṣṭrakandharam| ----------------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. anantaram antarmukham eṣiṇyā eṣitvā samyak śastreṇa pāṭayet| bahirmukhaṃ ca bhagandaraṃ niḥśeṣaṃ pāṭayitvā tataḥ kṣāreṇa sādhayet jvalanena vā| uṣṭrakandharaṃ-uṣṭragrīvaṃ, kṣāreṇaiva sādhu kṛtvā vaidyaḥ sādhayet-na tvagninā|
Sa. śataponakākhyam ekāntarā nāḍīḥ kṛtvā pāṭayet| tāsu rūḍhāsu śeṣā api nāḍīḥ pāṭayet| anyathā-ekahelayaiva, gude pāṭite sati mṛtyuḥ syāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
parikṣepiṇī cāpy evaṃ nāḍyuktaiḥ kṣārasūtrakaiḥ||27||

div.ab: Sa. parikṣepiṇi ca bhagandare nāḍīkathitaiḥ kṣārasūtrakair evaṃkramāt, sādhayet|
arśobhagandare pūrvam arśāṃsi pratisādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. arśobhagandare pūrvam arśāṃsi pratisādhayet-upacaret|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
tyaktvopacaryaḥ kṣatajaḥ śalyaṃ śalyavatas tataḥ||28||

lg.l: āhārec ca tathā dadyāt kṛmighnaṃ lepabhojanam|

div.ab: Sa. kṣatajo bhagandaras tyaktvā-pratyākhyāya, cikitsyaḥ| anantaraṃ śalyavataḥ-saśalyasya, śalyam āharet| tathā kṛmighnaṃ lepaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dadyāt| pīḍāyāṃ ca satyāṃ piṇḍasvedādayaḥ susnigdhā hitāḥ|

lg.l: sarvatra ca bahucchidre chedān ālocya yojayet|

div.ab: Sa. bahucchidre ca bhagandare sarvatraivālocya caturaś chedān gotīrthakādikān kuryāt| tān eva chedān āha-gotīrthety ādi|

pārśvaṃ gatena śastreṇa chedo gotīrthako mataḥ|
sarvataḥ sarvatobhadraḥ, pārśvacchedo 'rdhalāṅgalaḥ||31||
pārśvadvaye lāṅgalakaḥ---------------------------| ----------------------------------------------------|32|

Sa. śastreṇa pārśvaṃ gatena yaś chedaḥ sa gotīrthakākhyaḥ, sa ca kāvyagatagomūtrikākāraḥ| sarvato yaś chedaḥ sa sarvatobhadrākhyaḥ, sa ca sarvatobhadrakāvyākāraḥ| ya ekasmin pārśve cedaḥ, sa ca dalalāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-kuṭārahitahalākāraḥ| pārśvadvaye yaś chedaḥ sa lāṅgalakākhyaḥ,-sampūrṇahalākāraḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------samastāṃś cāgninā dahet|
āsrāvamārgān niḥśeṣaṃ naivaṃ vikurute punaḥ||32||

div.ab: Sa. vraṇān sarvāṃś cāsrāvamārgān niḥśeṣaṃ kṛtvā'gninā dahet| evaṃ kṛte sati punar vikāraṃ vraṇo na yāti|
yateta koṣṭhaśuddhau ca bhiṣak tasyāntarā'ntarā| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. tasya-bhagandariṇaḥ, koṣṭhaśuddhau cāntarā'ntarā vaidyo yateta|
Sa. mārjārāsthi triphalārasakalkitaṃ vraṇe lepo hitaḥ|

ab.seg:
jyotiṣmatīmalayulāṅgaliśelupāṭhā- kumbhāgnisarja(rji)karavīravacāsudhārkaiḥ|
abhyañjanāya vipaceta bhagandarāṇāṃ tailaṃ vadanti paramaṃ hitam etad eṣām||34||

div.ab: Sa. jyotiṣmatyādibhir abhyaṅgārthaṃ tailaṃ pacet| bhagandarāṇām eteṣām etat paramaṃ-atiśayena, hitaṃ gadanti| vasantatilakāvṛttam| vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca madhukādi drutavilambitam|

ab.seg:
madhukarodhrakaṇātrureṇukā- dvirajanīphalinīpaṭusārivāḥ|
kamalakesarapadmakadhātakī- madanasarjarasāmayarodikāḥ||35||

div.ab: Sa. madhukādibhir etaiḥ sabījapūrapatrais tailaṃ vipācitaṃ bhagandarādighnam|
Sa. viḍaṅgasārādayo mākṣikatailayuktā līḍhāḥ kṛmyādivraṇaropaṇāḥ syuḥ| māgadhikākaṇāḥ-pippalītaṇḍulāḥ| aupacchandasikaṃ vṛttam|
Sa. amṛtādikam idaṃ krameṇa bhāgavṛdhdyā vṛddhaṃ madhunā drutaṃ piṭikādīn jayet| vaitālīyam|
Sa. māgadhikādikair bilvadhṛtaiḥ-pṛthak palamitaiḥ, triphalāpalaṣaṭkasahitaiḥ sarvais tulyena guggulunā yutair madhusametair miśritair mātrayā bhakṣitaiḥ(?) samastavyādhiharaṇaṃ syāt|

lg.l: guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthak syāt|

div.ab: Sa. guggulupalāni pañca, pippalyādayaḥ palāṃśikāḥ, tvagelayoḥ pṛthak karṣam| tad etan madhulīḍhaṃ kuṣṭhādighnam| svāyambhuvākhyo guggulur eṣa prasiddhaḥ| dodhakaṃ(ke) vṛttam(tte)|
Sa. tad eva-guggulvādikaṃ dravyaṃ, śuṇṭhīcūrṇayutaṃ daśamūlakvāthena subhāvitaṃ viśeṣeṇa vātarogajit|
Sa. triphalādirajo 'sanakvāthena bhāVvitaṃ tulyamahiṣākhya(kṣa)mākṣikaṃ śīlayan kuṣṭhādīn hanti| ro narau lagayutā rathoddhatā|

lg.l: bhagandareṣv eṣa viśeṣa uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni|
vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanāc ca samyag viditvaupayikaṃ vidadhyāt||43||

div.ab: Sa. bhagandareṣu sarveṣv ayam upakramaviśeṣo 'bhihitaḥ| śeṣāṇi tu vraṇāni prakaṭasādhanāni| teṣu vraṇādhikārāt pariśīlanāc ca samyag viditvopakramaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kuryāt| upajātiḥ|

aśvapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ calarodhaṃ madyamaithunam ajīrṇam asātmyam|
sāhasāni vividhāni ca rūḍhe vatsaraṃ parihared adhikaṃ vā|44| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara- sthāne bhagandarapratiṣedho nāmā- ṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|28|

Sa. bhagandare vraṇe rūḍhe 'pi turagapṛṣṭhagamanādikaṃ varṣaṃ yāvad adhikaṃ vā parihared iti| svāgatāvṛttam| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne bhagandara pratiṣedho nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 28||

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. granthyādivijñānam ucyate-
Sa. saṃ-medomāṃsaraktasthitāḥ kaphapradhānā doṣā vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ, kurvanti, sa grathanād granthiḥ smṛtaḥ|
doṣāsramāṃsamedosthisirāvraṇabhavā nava| te---------------------------------------|2|
Sa. saṃ-te ca-granthayo, doṣādyātmakatvāt navasaṅkhyāḥ syuḥ|

lg.l: mṛdur bastir ivānaddho vibhinno 'cchaṃ sravaty asṛk||3||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-teṣu madhye vātād āyāmādiguṇaḥ śvayathuḥ syāt| sa ca vibhinno lohitam acchaṃ sravati|

lg.l: pittāt sadāhaḥ pītābho rakto vā, pacyate drutam|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-pittena dāhayutaḥ pītacchavir athavā raktaḥ| śophaḥ śīghraṃ pacyate| bhinnaḥ sa uṣṇam asṛk sravati|
Sa. saṃ-kaphena nīrujo ghanaḥ śophaḥ śītasparśaḥ śarīrasamānavarṇaḥ kaṇḍūyutaś ca syāt| sa pakvaḥ pūyaṃ ghanaṃ sravet|

----------------------------------------------------|
doṣair duṣṭe 'sṛji granthir bhaven mūrcchatsu jantuṣu||5||
sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya sasvāpaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. saṃ-doṣair duṣṭe lohite sati granthir bhavet| jantuṣu-kṛmiṣu, vṛddhiṃ gacchatsu sirāmāṃsaṃ ca saṃśritya svāpānvitaḥ śophaḥ pittasamānalakṣaṇaḥ syāt|

----------------------------------------------------|
māṃsalair dūṣitaṃ māṃsam āhārair granthim āvahet||6||
snigdhaṃ mahāntaṃ kaṭhinaṃ sirānaddhaṃ kaphākṛtim| ----------------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. saṃ-māṃsalair āhārair māṃsaṃ dūṣitaṃ granthi snigdhādiguṇayuktaṃ kaphākāraṃ karoti|

----------------------------------------------------|
pravṛddhaṃ medurair medo nītaṃ māṃse 'thavā tvaci||7||
vāyunā kurute granthi bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam|
śleṣamatulyākṛtiṃ dehakṣayavṛddhikṣayodayam||8||
sa vibhinno ghanaṃ medas tāmrāsitasitaṃ sravet| ----------------------------------------------------|9|

Sa. saṃ-medurair bhojanair medaḥ pravṛddhaṃ vāyunā māṃse nītam athavā tvaci nītaṃ medogranthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhādiguṇaṃ śleṣmasamānākāraṃ tathā śarīrakṣayavṛddhibhyāṃ kṣayodayau yasya taṃ tādṛśaṃ karoti| sa ca granthibhinnaḥ san ghanaṃ tāmram asitaṃ sitaṃ ca medaḥ sravati|
Sa. saṃ-asthibhāṅgenābhighātena vā'sthny unnatam avanataṃ vā yat syāt, so 'sthigranthiḥ |

ab.seg:
-------------------padātes tu sahasā'mbhovagāhanāt|
vyāyāmād vā pratāntasya sirājālaṃ saśoṇitam||10||

lg.l: vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca|
niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-padāteḥ sahasaiva jalāvagāhād vyāyāmād vā pratāntasya glānasya, pavanaḥ kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ sirājālaṃ sampīḍya tathā saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca niḥṣphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāsaṃjñaḥ| niḥṣphuram iti "sphuratisphulatyoḥ" ity ādinā ṣatvam|

lg.l: vāto 'sram asrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇam|
kuryāt sadāhaḥ kaṇḍūmān vraṇagranthir ayaṃ smṛtaḥ||13||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-aruḍhe vraṇe tathā rūḍhamātre-sadyorūḍhe vraṇe, sarvarasāśino narasyāthavā sārdre vraṇe bandharahite śarīre 'śmābhihate vā vāto raktam asrutaṃ duṣṭaṃ saṃśoṣya grathitaṃ vraṇaṃ kuryāt| dāhādiyuta eṣa vraṇagranthiḥ smṛto munibhiḥ|

lg.l: sādhyā doṣāsramedojāḥ, na tu sthūlakharāś calāḥ|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-doṣāsramedojā granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ| na punaḥ sthūlāḥ kharāś calās tathā marmasthāḥ kaṇṭhasthā udarasthāś ca granthayaḥ sādhyāḥ |

lg.l: tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ ṣoḍhā doṣādibhis tu tat|
prāyo medaḥ kaphāḍhyatvāsthiratvāc ca na pacyate||15||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-granther yan mahat tad arbudam| tasya cārbudasya lakṣaṇaṃ ṣaṭ prakāram| katham ? doṣais trīṇi, raktamāṃsamedobhis trīṇīti| tac ca-arbudaṃ, medaḥkaphabāhulyāt sthiratvāc ca prāyaḥ pacanaṃ na yāti|

lg.l: sirāsthaṃ śoṇitaṃ doṣaḥ saṅkocyāntaḥ prapīḍya ca|
māṃsāṅkuraiś citaṃ yāti vṛddhi cāśu sravet tataḥ|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-sirāsthitaṃ raktaṃ doṣo-vātādyanyatamaḥ, saṅkocyāntaḥ abhyantare, ca prapīḍya pācayet| tat pakvaṃ ca sadānaddhaṃ sāsrāvaṃ māṃsapiṇḍitaṃ māṃsāṅkuraiś citaṃ vṛddhiṃ gacchati| vṛddhaṃ ca sadāśu satataṃ duṣṭaṃ rudhiraṃ prabhūtaṃ sravati| tat-evaṃvidhaṃ, śoṇitārbudaṃ gadyate| māṃsārbudamedorbudayoś ca lakṣaṇaṃ tadgranthilakṣaṇenaivoktaprāyatvān nehoktam|
teṣv asṛṅmāṃsaje varjye, catvāry anyāni sādhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. saṃ-teṣu-ṣaṭsv arbudeṣu madhye,śoṇitamāṃsaje dve arbude nopakramet| aparāṇi catvāri sādhayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
prasthitā vaṅkṣaṇoorvādim adhaḥkāyaṃ kapholbaṇāḥ||18||

lg.l: śanaiḥ śanair ghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ tat pracakṣate||19||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-adhaḥkāyaṃ vaṅkṣaṇoruprabhṛti doṣā gatāḥ kapholbaṇā māṃsalohitagāḥ kālena pādau samāśritya nibiḍaṃ śvayathuṃ śanaiḥ śanair vidadhati| tad etad chlīpadaṃ pracakṣate |
paripoṭayutaṃ kṛṣṇam animittarujaṃ kharam| rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt---------------------------|20|
Sa. saṃ-ślīpadaṃ vātāt paripoṭena yuktaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇam ahetupīḍaṃ kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca syāt|
Sa. saṃ-pittāt pītaṃ dāhajvarayutaṃ ca syāt|

-----------------------------------------------------|
kaphād guru snigdham aruk citaṃ māṃsāṅkurair bṛhat|21|
Sa. saṃ-kaphena guru snigdhaṃ rujārahitaṃ māṃsāṅkuraiś citaṃ mahac ca syāt|
Sa. saṃ-tat-ślīpadaṃ, varṣātikrāntaṃ sumahat suparisrāvaṃ ca tyajet|

lg.l: ślīpadaṃ jāyate tac ca deśe 'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhṛśam||22||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-pāṇyādiṣv api pādavac chlīpadaṃ jāyata ity eke vadanti| tac cānūpadeśe 'tiśayena rogasvabhāvāj jāyate|

lg.l: avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃś cirapākāṃś ca kurvate|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-medasthāḥ kaṇṭhādigā doṣāḥ savarṇān kaṭhinān snigdhān vārtākāmalakākārān avagāḍhān bahūn gaṇḍāṃś cirapākāṃś ca kurvate| te ca-gaṇḍāḥ stokapīḍāḥ pacyante| anye ca sravanti| apare cātikaṇḍurāḥ, kaṇḍuṃ rānti dadata iti kaṇḍurāḥ| naśyanty anye| anye jāyante dīrghakālānubandhinaḥ| iyaṃ-īdṛśī, gaṇḍamālā apacī cocyate| dūrveva kṣayavṛddhibhāk|

ab.seg: tāṃ tyajet sajvaracchardipārśvarukkāsapīnasām| -----------------------------------------------------||25||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-tāṃ-gaṇḍamālāṃ, jvarādiyutāṃ tyajet| atha nāḍīvijñānam āha--

----------------------------------------------------|
abhedāt pakvaśophasya vraṇe cāpathyasevinaḥ||26||
anupraviśya māṃsādīn dūraṃ pūyo 'bhidhāvati|
gatiḥ sā dūragamanānnāḍī nāḍīva saṃsruteḥ||27||
nāḍy ekā'nṛjur anyeṣāṃ saivānekagatir gatiḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. śām-pakvaśophasyābhedanād apathyasevinaś ca puṃso vraṇe pūyo māṃsādīn anupraviśya dūraṃ vrajati| sā dūragamanāt gatir ity ucyate| nāḍīva saṃsruter nāḍīty ucyate| anyeṣāṃ tu tantrakṛtāṃ mata ekā nāḍy anṛjuḥ-vakrā, nāḍīty ucyate| saiva nāḍy anekagatir gatir ity ucyata iti |

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
sā doṣaiḥ pṛthag ekasthaiḥ śalyahetuś ca pañcamī||28||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-sā-nāḍī, pṛthag doṣais trisaṅkhyā, sannipātena caturthī, pañcamī śalyahetuḥ |
Sa. saṃ-vātāt sarujādiguṇā|
Sa. saṃ-pittāt tṛḍādikṛt| pītoṣṇapūtipūyasrāvī| divase cātiśayena sravati |
Sa. saṃ-kaphāt ghanapicchilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśi cābhyadhikledā syāt|
Sa. saṃ-kaphāt ghanapicchilasrāvā kaṇḍūmatī kaṭhinā niśi cābhyadhikledā syāt|

antaḥsthitaṃ śalyam anāhṛtaṃ tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sā'sya|
phenānuviddhaṃ tanum alpam uṣṇaṃ sāsraṃ ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam|31| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|29|

Sa. saṃ-antare sthitaṃ śalyam anākṛṣṭaṃ san nāḍīṃ karoti| asya ca-śalyavataḥ puṃsaḥ, sā-nāḍī, phenilaṃ tanvādiguṇaṃ ca pūyaṃ nityam eva sarujaṃ vahata iti| upajātivṛttam| iti śrīmRṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthya rbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīvijñānīyaṃ nāma ekonatriṃ- śo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 29||

div.head: granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiśedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. adhunā granthyādīnāṃ cikitsitaṃ bibhaṇiṣur āha-

athāto granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
) granthiṣv āmeṣu kartavyā yathāsvaṃ śophavat kriyā| ----------------------------------------------------|1|
Sa. āmeṣu-apakveṣu, granthiṣu yathāsvaṃ śopheṣv iva kriyācikitsitam|

----------------------------------------------------|
bṛhatīcitrakavyāghrīkaṇāsiddhena sarpiṣā||1||
snehayec chuddhikāmaṃ ca, tīkṣṇaiḥ śuddhasya lepanam| -----------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. bṛhatyādibhiḥ siddhena sarpiṣā śuddhikāmaṃ naraṃ snehayet| tataḥ śuddhasya-kṛtavamanavirekasya sataḥ, tīkṣṇair dravyair lepanaṃ kāryam |

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
saṃsvedya bahuśo granthiṃ vimṛdnīyāt punaḥ punaḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. granthiṃ samyak svedayitvā'ṅguṣṭhādibhiḥ punaḥ punar vimṛdnīyāt|

lg.l: eṣa vāte viśeṣeṇa kramaḥ, pittāsraje punaḥ|
jalaukaso himaṃ sarvaṃ, kaphaje vātiko vidhiḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. eṣa kramo viśeṣeṇa vāte kāryaḥ| pittāsraje granthau jalaukasaḥ| sarvadā śītaṃ pralepādikaṃ hitam| kaphaje granthau vātodbhavagranthivihitaḥ kramaḥ|

ab.seg:
tathā'py akvaṃ chittvainaṃ sthite rakte 'gninā dahet|
sādhvaśeṣaṃ, saśeṣo hi punar āpyāyate dhruvam||4||

div.ab: Sa. evam apy apakvam enaṃ granthiṃ sādhu yathā bhavaty aśeṣaṃ ca tathā chittvā sthite rakte saty agninā dahet| śeṣaḥ kasmān na kriyate ? ity āha-saśeṣa iti| yasmāt saśeṣo granthir niścayenaiva punar āpyāyate-vṛddhiṃ yāti|
māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī yāpayed evam eva ca| ----------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. sa- māṃsavraṇodbhavau granthī evam eva yāpayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
kāryaṃ medobhave 'py etat taptaiḥ phālādibhiś ca tam||5||

lg.l: śastreṇa pāṭayitvā vā dahen medasi sūddhṛte||6||

div.ab: Sa. medoje 'py etat kāryam| taṃ ca-medodbhavaṃ granthiṃ, tilakalkadigdhena dviguṇavāsasā channaṃ santaṃ taptaiḥ phālādibhir upaspṛśet| athavā śastreṇa pāṭayitvā medasi niḥśeṣam uddhṛte saty agninā dahet|

lg.l: sirāgranthau nave peyaṃ tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ, tathā|

div.ab: Sa. sirāgranthau ca nave sāhacaraṃ tailaṃ peyam| tathā vātaghnair upanāho hito bastikarma sirāvyadhaś ca|

ab.seg:
arbude granthivat kuryāt yathāsvaṃ sutarāṃ hitam| -----------------------------------------------------|8| | ajāśakṛcchigrūmūlalākṣāsurasa(lavaṇakṣāra)-kāñjikaiḥ|
vastrabaddhair upasvedya mardayitvā pralepayet||1||

lg.l: niveśya paṭṭaṃ badhnīyāc chāmyaty evaṃ navārbudam||2||

div.ab: Sa. arbude granthāviva sarvaṃ yathāyogaṃ sutarāṃ hitaṃ kuryāt |

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
ślīpade 'nilaje vidhyet snigdhasvinnopanāhite||8||

lg.l: sirām upari gulphasya dvyaṅgule, pāyayec ca tam|
traivṛtaṃ vā pibed evam aśāntāv agninā dahet||10||

div.ab: Sa. ślīpade vātotthe snigdhe svinna upanāhite ca gulphasya dvayaṅgula upari sirāṃ vidhyet| taṃ ca-ślīpadinaṃ, māsam eraṇḍodbhavaṃ tailaṃ gomūtrayutaṃ pāyayet| jīrṇe cairaṇḍataile purāṇam annaṃ śālyodanaṃ śuṇṭhīśṛtena kṣīreṇa sahāśnīyāt| traivṛtaṃ vā pibet| evam apy aśāntau vahninā dahet| tathā gulphasyādhastāt sirāṃ mokṣayet|
gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ paitte sarvaṃ ca pittajit| -----------------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. paitte tu ślīpade sarvaṃ pittajic cikitsitaṃ hitam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
sirām aṅguṣṭhake vidhvā kaphaje śīlayed yavān||11||

div.ab: Sa. kaphaje tu sirām aṅguṣṭhake vidhvā yavānnaṃ śīlayet| kaṣāyaguṇayuktāni dravyāṇi mākṣikānvitāni hitāni| tathā vardhamānā dvitryādikrameṇa harītakyo hitāḥ| sarṣapair vārtākīmūlena ca limpet| dhānya(dhanva)yā-yavāsakayā vā, niśuṇṭhyā limpet|

ab.seg:
|
palam arddhapalaṃ vā'pi karṣaṃ vā'py uṣṇavāriṇā|
kāñcanāratvacaṃ pītvā gaṇḍamālāṃ vyapohati]||1||

div.ab: Sa. apacyām ūrdhvādhaḥ śodhanaṃ dantyādibhiḥ sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pātavyam| tathā kaphamedoharaṃ dhūmādikam abhyaset| sirayā raktaṃ haret| rasāñjanaṃ gomūtreṇāloḍitaṃ pibet|
Sa. āmān granthīn nākulyādibhir ālimpet| kaṭhinān granthīl lavaṇapoṭalyā svinnān paścād aṅguṣṭhādinā mardayet |

ab.seg:
|
kṣuṇṇāni nimbapatrāṇi klRptair bhallātakaiḥ saha|
śarāvasampuṭe dagdhvā sārdhaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ samaiḥ||1||

div.ab: Sa. śamyādibhir amlatakrapiṣṭair lepo granthyādivimlāpa(lāya)naḥ|
Sa. pākonmukhān granthīn srutaraktasya pittaśleṣmaghnair dravyair jayet| athavā'pakvān eva granthīn uddhṛtya kṣārāgnibhyām upakramet |

Sa. saṃ-kākādanyādibhiḥ kalkair dvikarṣonmitair viṣakarṣayutaiḥ karañjatailasya prasthaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarasasyāḍhake pacet| tena (anena) tailena gaṇḍamālā cirotthā pūyavāhinī cāsādhyaprāyā'pi pānādibhiḥ sidhyati|
Sa. lāṅgalikīkandakalkapādaṃ nirguṇḍīsvarase caturguṇe tailaṃ pakvaṃ nasyādyair apacījit| lāṅgalikīkandakalkaḥ pādo yasmis taile tad evam |
Sa. bhadraśrīdārvādibhiḥ palikair gomūtrapiṣṭair viṣasya cārdhapalena yuktair brāhmīrasādibhiḥ saṃyutaṃ sarṣapatailaprasthaṃ pakvaṃ pānādyair abhyastaṃ kuṣṭhādīn śīghram eva hanti |

lg.l: tailaṃ prasādhitaṃ pītaṃ samūlām apacīṃ jayet||25||

div.ab: Sa. vacāharītakyādibhiḥ kalkitais tailaṃ pakvaṃ pītaṃ nirmūlām apacīṃ kuryāt|
Sa. śarapuṅkhāmūlaṃ tandulajalena piṣṭaṃ nasyena lepanena ca duṣṭāruḥprabhṛtīn hanti|

mūlair uttamakāraṇyāḥ pīluparṇyāḥ sahācarāt|
sarodhrābhayayaṣṭyāhvaśatāhvādvīpidārubhiḥ||27||
tailaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ siddhaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca pūjitam| ----------------------------------------------------|28|

Sa. saṃ-uttamakāraṇyādīnāṃ mūlais tailaṃ kṣīratulyaṃ siddhaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca hitam| uttamaivottamaketi "anyatarasyām" iti hrasvaḥ| uttamakā cāsāv araṇiś ca(ṇī ca) uttamakāraṇīty arthaḥ| uttamakāraṇī-karambhaḥ(mbhā)|

----------------------------------------------------|
govyajāśvakhurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena lepanam||28||
aiṅgudena tu kṛṣṇāhir vāyaso vā svayaṃ mṛtaḥ| -----------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. gavādīnāṃ khurā dagdhāḥ kaṭutailena vimiśritena lepo hitaḥ| kṛṣṇasarpo dagdha iṅgudītailena, kāko vā svayaṃ mṛta iṅgudītailena, lepanaṃ hitam |

----------------------------------------------------|
ity aśāntau gadasyānyapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritam||29||
baster ūrdhvam adhastād vā medo hṛtvā'gninā dahet| -----------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. saṃ-evam apy aśāntau satyāṃ rogasyāparapārśvajaṅghāsamāśritaṃ baster ūrdhvam adhastād vā medo hṛtvā jvalanena dahet |

----------------------------------------------------|
sthitasyordhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena ca pārṣṇitaḥ||30||
tata ūrdhvaṃ hared granthīn ity āha bhagavān nimiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. sthitasya puṃsa ūrdhvaṃ padaṃ mitvā tanmānena pārṣṇipradeśāt tāvanmātraṃ mitvā tata ūrdhva granthīn haret, iti nimimuniḥ prājyāśayo vadatīti|

lg.l: pārṣṇiṃ prati dvādaśa cāṅgulāni muktvendrabastiṃ ca gadānyapārśve|
vidārya matsyāṇḍanibhāni madhyāj jālāni karṣed iti suśrutoktiḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. pārṣṇiṃ lakṣīkṛtya dvādaśāṅgulāni mittvā indrabastiṃ muktvā gadasyāparapārśve vidārya madhyān matsyāṇḍasadṛśāni jālāni karṣet, evaṃ suśrutasya vacanam| upajātivṛttam|

lg.l: ā gulphakarṇāt sumitasya jantos tasyāṣṭabhāgaṃ khuḍakād vibhajya|
ghrāṇārjave 'dhaḥ surarājabaster bhittvā'kṣamātraṃ tv apare vadanti||32||

div.ab: Sa. gulphāntaṃ yāvat karṇād ārabhya prāṇinaḥ suṣṭhu mitasya karṇānāṃ hrasvalambatvenāniyatasthānatvāt sthānaniyamaṃ karoti| ghrāṇārjava iti| etad uktaṃ bhavati| nāsāgrāt karṇaṃ prati sṛṣṭatve sati sumitasya karṇād gulphaṃ yāvan na tv evam eva, tathā tasya narasya khuḍakād gulphād aṣṭabhāgaṃ bibhajya-tyaktvā, indrabaster adhastād bhīttvā'kṣamātraṃ karṣet, ity apare vadanti| indravajrāvṛttam|
Sa. vātān nāḍīm upanāhya pāṭayitvā sādhu kṛtvā'pāmārgādibhir lepayet|
paittīṃ tu tilamañjiṣṭhānāgadantīniśādvayaiḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. paittiṃ tu pāṭitāṃ satīṃ tilādibhiḥ pradehayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
ślaiṣmikīṃ tilasaurāṣṭrīnikumbhāriṣṭasaindhavaiḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. śalaiṣmikīṃ ca pāṭitāṃ tilasaurāṣṭryādibhiḥ pradehayet|
śalyajāṃ tilamadhvājyair lepayec chinnaśodhitām| ----------------------------------------------------|35|
Sa. śalyajāṃ gatiṃ chinnāṃ śodhitāṃ ca tilamadhvājyair lepayet|
Sa. saṃ-śastreṇa chedanānarhāṃ gatiṃ samyag eṣitām eṣiṇyā bhittvā'nte kṣārayuktena sūtreṇa punaḥ punar dārayet|

----------------------------------------------------|
vraṇeṣu duṣṭasūkṣmāsyagambhīrādiṣu sādhanam||36||
yā vartyo yāni tailāni tan nāḍīṣv api śasyate| -----------------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. duṣṭeṣu sūkṣmamukheṣu gambhīrādiṣu vraṇeṣu yat sādhanaṃ kathitaṃ, yā vartaya uktāḥ, yāni tailāni, tat-etac cikitsitaṃ, nāḍīṣv api yujyate|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------------|
piṣṭaṃ cañcuphalaṃ lepān nāḍīvraṇaharaṃ param||37||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-cañcoḥ phalaṃ piṣṭaṃ lepena paraṃ nāḍīvraṇahṛt|

lg.l: ghoṇṭāphalatvak lavaṇaṃ salākṣaṃ būkasya patraṃ vanitāpayaś ca|
srugarkadugdhānvita eṣa kalko vartīkṛto hanty acireṇa nāḍīm||38||

div.ab: Sa. ghoṇṭāphalādikaḥ strīkṣīrasrugarkadugdhayuta eṣa kalko vartīkṛto drāg eva nāḍīṃ hanti| indravajrāvṛttam|

sāmudrasauvarcalasindhujanma supakvaghoṇṭāphalaveśmadhūmāḥ|
āmrātagāyatrijapallavāś ca kaṭaṃkaṭeryāv atha cetakī ca|39|
kalke 'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ caiteṣu śīlyamāneṣu|
agatiriva naśyati gatiś capalā capaleṣu bhūtir iva|40| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|30|

Sa. samudralavaṇādikaṃ kalke 'bhyaṅge cūrṇe vartyāṃ cāmīṣv abhyasyamāneṣv avidyamānagatir iva gatiḥ śīghraṃ naśyati| capalā capaleṣu nareṣu bhūtiḥ-vittaṃ, yatheti| upajātirāryā ca| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛda yaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne granthyarbudaślīpadāpacīnāḍīpratiṣedho nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 30||

div.head: kṣudrarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg:
kṣudrarogavijñānaṃ kramaprāptam ācikhyāsur āha ---- athātaḥ kṣudrarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
snigdhā savarṇā grathitā nīrujā mudgasannibhā|
piṭikā kaphavātābhyāṃ bālānām ajagallikā||1||

div.ab: Sa. bālānāṃ kaphavātābhyāṃ snigdhādiguṇayuktā piṭikā'jagallikākhyā syāt|
yavaprakhyā yavaprakhyā tābhyāṃ māṃsāśritā ghanā| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. tābhyāṃ-vātakaphābhyāṃ, yavaprakhyā-yavasaṃjñā| sā yavaprakhyā-yavākārā, maṃsāśritā ghanā kaṭhinā ca|

-----------------------------------------------|
avaktrā cālajī vṛttā stokapūyā ghanonnatā||2||
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍ vā, kimbhūtāḥ ? amukhās tathā'lajīva vṛttāḥ-vartulāḥ, stokapūyā ghanā unnatāś ca kacchapīty ucyate| sā ca kacchaponnatā syāt|
Sa. karṇasyopariṣṭāt parito vā piṭikā kaṭhinā tīvrarujā śālūkanibhā panasikāsaṃjñā|

ab.seg:
---------------------śophas tv alparujaḥ sthiraḥ|
hanusandhisamudbhūtas tābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. śopho 'lparujaḥ sthiro hanusandhisamāśrito vātakaphābhyāṃ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ|

lg.l: medogarbhā mukhe yūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikāḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. vātakaphābhyāṃ śālmalīkaṇṭakasadṛśāḥ piṭikā rujānvitā ghanā medogarbhās taruṇānāṃ mukhe syuḥ| tāś ca mukhadūṣikāḥ|

lg.l: te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ padmam iva kaṇṭakaiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. padmakaṇṭakasaṃjñās te vedyāḥ, yaiḥ kaṇṭakair nīrujaiḥ śvetavarṇair vātakaphajaiḥ padmam iva śarīraṃ cīyate|
Sa. pittena yā piṭikā vartulā pakvodumbaraphalanibhā mahādāhajvarakṛc ca, sā vivṛtākhyā vivṛtamukhā syāt|
Sa. gātreṣu-avayaveṣu, vaktrasya cāntare dāhādiyutā masūrapramāṇās tadvarṇās tatsaṃjñā masūrikā ghanāḥ piṭikāḥ|
tataḥ kaṣṭatarāḥ sphoṭā visphoṭākhyā mahārujāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. tābhyo masūrikābhyo dāruṇatamāḥ sphoṭā mahārujā visphoṭāsaṃjñāḥ|
Sa. padmakarṇikānibhā yā piṭikā piṭakair ācitā, sā vātapittābhyāṃ viddhākhyā syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------tābhyām eva ca gardabhī|
maṇḍalā vipulotsannā sarāgapiṭikācitā||10||

div.ab: Sa. tābhyām eva-vātapittābhyāṃ, gardabhīsaṃjñā maṇḍalākārā vistīrṇā tathotsannā sarāgapiṭakair ācitā|

lg.l: pittād bhavanti piṭikāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. kakṣānikaṭeṣu pradeśeṣu sā gardabhī kakṣety ucyate| sā ca vātāt syāt| tasyām eva pittena sūkṣmāḥ piṭikā lājākārā ghanāḥ kakṣāsaṃjñā eva syuḥ|
tādṛśī mahatī tv ekā gandhanāmeti kīrtitā| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. tādṛśī-lājasadṛśī, mahatī piṭikaikā gandhanāmeti smṛtā|

-----------------------------------------------|
gharmasvedaparīte 'ṅge piṭikāḥ sarujo ghanāḥ||12||
rājikāvarṇasaṃsthānapramāṇā rājikāhvayāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. gharmasvedayukte śarīre piṭikā rujāyutā ghanā rājikāvarṇā rājikākārā rājikāpramāṇā rājikāsaṃjñāḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
doṣaiḥ pittolbaṇair mandair visarpiti visarpavat||13||
śopho 'pākas tanus tāmro jvarakṛj jālagardabhaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. pittādhikair doṣair mandair yaḥ śopho visarpa iva visarpati, tathā'pākas tanustāmravarṇo jvarakārī ca, sa jālagardabhaḥ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------------|
malaiḥ pittolbaṇaiḥ sphoṭā jvariṇo māṃsadāraṇāḥ||14||

lg.l: pañcāhāt saptarātrād vā pakṣād vā hanti jīvitam||15||

div.ab: Sa. pittolbaṇair malair jvaravato māṃsadāraṇāḥ sphoṭāḥ kakṣāpradeśeṣu ye 'gnisadṛśā jāyante, sā'gnirohiṇīty ucyate| pañcāhena saptarātreṇa pakṣeṇa vā jīvitaṃ hanti|
triliṅgā piṭikā vṛttā jatrūrdhvam irivellikā| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. tridoṣalakṣaṇā piṭikā vartulā jatruṇa ūrdhvam irivellikākhyā|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vidārīkandakaṭhinā vidārī kakṣavaṅkṣaṇe||16||

div.ab: Sa. vidārīkandavat kaṭhinā kakṣāyāṃ vaṅkṣaṇe ca vidārī syāt| kakṣā ca vaṅkṣaṇaṃ ca kakṣāvaṅkṣaṇaṃ tasmin| "pāṇyoḥ"(?) ity ādinā hrasvaḥ|

medonilakaphair granthiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayaiḥ|
bhinno vasājyamadhvābhaṃ sravet tatrolbaṇo 'nilaḥ||17||
māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarām upapādayet|
durgandhaṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ||18||
tāṃ srāvayanti nicitāṃ vidyāt tac charkarārbudam| -----------------------------------------------|19|

Sa. medaḥpavanakaphaiḥ snāyumāṃsasirāśrayair granthiḥ syāt| sa ca bhinno vasāghṛtamadhunibhaṃ sravet| tasmin pavano 'dhiko māṃsaṃ viśoṣya grathitāṃ śarkarāṃ kuryāt| tato doṣās tāṃ-śarkarāṃ, nicitāṃ durgandhaṃ lohitaṃ klinnaṃ vividhavarṇaṃ srāvayanti| tat evaṃvidhaṃ, śarkarārbudaṃ vidyāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
pāṇipādatale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vopacīyate||19||

lg.l: valmīkavac chanair granthis tadvad bahvaṇubhir mukhaiḥ|

div.ab: Sa. pāṇitale pādatale sandhau jatrūrdhvaṃ vā granthir valmīka iva śanair upacīyate| tadvat valmīkavat, bahūni ca tāny aṇūni ca, tair bhūrisūkṣmair vadanair upalakṣito rugdāhakaṇḍūkledabahulo valmīkākhyo 'sau tridoṣajaḥ|

lg.l: granthiḥ kīlavad utsanno jāyate kadaraṃ tu tat||21||

div.ab: Sa. śarkarādibhir unmathite pāde kaṇṭakādibhir vā kṣate kīlasadṛśo granthir utsanno jāyate, tat kadaraṃ nāma|

vegasandhāraṇād vāyur apāno 'pānasaṃśrayam|
aṇūkaroti bāhyāntarmārgasya tataḥ śakṛt||22||
kṛcchrān nirgacchati vyādhir ayaṃ ruddhagudo mataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. apānākhyo vāyur vegasandhāraṇād apānāśrayaṃ mārgaṃ bāhyāntar aṇūkaroti| tato 'sya-āturasya, kṛcchreṇa śakṛn niryāti| ayaṃ rogo ruddhagudo mataḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
kuryāt pittānilaṃ pākaṃ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaram||23||
cipyam akṣatarogaṃ ca vidyād upanakhaṃ ca tam| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. pittānilaṃ kartṛ nakhamāṃse sarugjvaraṃ pākaṃ kuryāt| taṃ cipyaṃ tathā'kṣatarogam upanakhaṃ ca vidyāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇo 'bhighātād rūkṣaś ca kharaś ca kunakho nakhaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. abhighātāt kṛṣṇavarṇo rūkṣaś ca kharaś ca nakhaḥ kunakhākhyaḥ|
Sa. duṣṭakardamasaṃsparśāt kaṇḍūkledayutāntarā aṅgulyo 'lasam iti vadanti|
Sa. tilasadṛśān kṛṣṇavarṇān arujāṃs tvaksthāṃs tilakālakān āhuḥ|
Sa. tān eva tilakālakān unnatān maṣān āhuḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
maṣebhyas tūnnatatarāṃś carmakīlān sitāsitān||26||

div.ab: Sa. maṣebhyaḥ sakāśād unnatatarān varṇataḥ sitāsitān carmakīlāṃs tān āhuḥ|
tathāvidho jatumaṇiḥ sahajo lohitas tu saḥ| -----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. tatpramāṇo jatumaṇiḥ sahajo lohitavarṇaś cāsau syāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam||27||

div.ab: Sa. śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā sahajaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ śarīrasamaṃ lāñchanam āhuḥ|

śokakrodhādikupitād vātapittān mukhe tanu|
śyāmalaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vyaṅgaṃ, vaktrād anyatra nīlikā||28||
paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt|
pittāt tāmrāntam ānīlaṃ, śvetāntaṃ kaṇḍumat kaphāt||29||
raktād raktāntam ātāmra sauṣaṃ cimicimāyate| -----------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. vātapittāc chokādikruddhāt tanu śyāmavarṇaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ mukhe vyaṅgaṃ vadanti| mukād anyatra nīlikā| paruṣacchavis tathā paruṣasparśaṃ śyāmavarṇaṃ ca vyaṅgaṃ vātāt syāt| pittena tāmrāntaṃ kiñcin nīlam| kaphena śvetāntaṃ sakaṇḍu ca syāt| raktād raktāntaṃ kiñcit tāmram oṣayutaṃ cimicimāyate ca|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vāyunodīritaḥ śleṣmā tvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati||30||

lg.l: tatas tvag jāyate pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā|

div.ab: Sa. pavanena kaphaḥ preritas tvacaṃ prāpya viśuṣyati| anantaraṃ tvak pāṇḍuḥ krameṇa ca vicetanā alpakaṇḍūr vikledarahitā ca jāyate| sā prasuptitaḥ prasuptiḥ syāt|

asamyagvamanodīrṇapittaśleṣmānnanigrahaiḥ|
maṇḍalāny atikaṇḍūni rāgavanti bahūni ca||32|| utkoṭhaḥ--------------------------------| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. asamyagvamanena preritapittaśleṣmānnanigrahair maṇḍalāny atiśayakaṇḍūni lohitāni bahūni ca utkoṭhaḥ syāt|
Sa. sa evānubaddhaḥ koṭha ity ucyate|

-----------------------------------------------|
proktāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad ity ete kṣudrarogā vibhāgaśaḥ|33| |
yān avijñāya muhyeta cikitsāyāṃ cikitsakaḥ| ] iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogavijñānīyaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|31|

Sa. iti-anena prakāreṇa, ṣaṭtriṃśat kṣudrarogā vibhāgenoktā iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudraroga vijñānīyaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 31||

div.head: kṣudrarogapratiṣedhādhyayaḥ
div.ab:
athaiṣāṃ cikitsitaṃ vivakṣur āha ---- athātaḥ kṣudrarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
visrāvayej jalaukābhir apakvām ajagallikām| -----------------------------------------|1|
Sa. ajagallikām apakvāṃ jalajanmabhir visrāvayet|
Sa. yavaprakhyāṃ svedayitvā vilāyanārthaṃ pralepayed dārvādibhiḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------ity āpāṣāṇagardabhāt|
vidhis tāṃś cācaret pakvān vraṇavat sājagallikān||2||

div.ab: Sa. pāṣāṇagardabhaṃ yāvad eṣa vidhiḥ| tena granthi(alajī)kacchapaśālūka(panasikā)pāṣāṇagardabhānāṃ pūrvoktaṃ kāryam ity avatiṣṭhate| tāṃś ca pakvān ajagallikāṃ ca vraṇavad upakramet|

rodhrakustumbaruvacāḥ pralepo mukhadūṣike|
vaṭapallavayuktā vā nārikelotthaśuktayaḥ||3||
aśāntau vamanaṃ nasyaṃ lalāṭe ca sirāvyadhaḥ| -----------------------------------------|4|
Sa. mukhadūṣike rodhrādayaḥ pralepaḥ, vaṭapallavayuktā nārikelaśuktayo vā| evam apy anupaśame vamanaṃ nasyaṃ ca hitam| lalāṭe ca sirāmokṣaḥ|

-----------------------------------------|
nimbāmbuvānto nimbāmbusādhitaṃ padmakaṇṭake||4||
pibet kṣaudrānvitaṃ sarpir nimbāragvadhalepanam| -----------------------------------------|5|
Sa. padmakaṇṭake nimbāmbunā kṛtavamano nimbakvāthapakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ sakṣaudraṃ pibet| nimbakarṇikārābhyāṃ lepaḥ|
Sa. vivṛtādīn jālāntān nirivellikāṃ ca pittavisarpam iva cikitset| agnirohiṇīṃ ca pratyākhyāya cikitset|

lg.l: vilaṅghanaṃ raktavimokṣaṇaṃ ca virūkṣaṇaṃ kāyaviśodhanaṃ ca|

div.ab: Sa. jālakagardabhasya laṅghanādi yathāvasthaṃ sadā kuryāt|
vidārikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivad ācaret| -----------------------------------------|7|
Sa. vidārikāṃ rakte srute kaphagranthim iva cikitset|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
medorbudakriyāṃ kuryāt sutarāṃ śarkarārbude||7||

div.ab: Sa. śarkarābude suṣṭhu medorbudakriyāṃ kuryāt|
pravṛddhaṃ subahucchidraṃ saśophaṃ marmaṇi sthitam| valmīkaṃ hastapāde ca varjayed-------------------|8|
Sa. valmīkaṃ pravṛddhādiguṇaṃ hastapāde jātaṃ ca varjayet|
Sa. itarat punar valmīkaṃ śuddhasya rakte hṛte śyāmādibhiḥ salavaṇakarṇikāraguḍūcībhir limpet|

lg.l: pakve tu duṣṭamāṃsāni gatīḥ sarvāś ca śodhayet|
śastreṇa samyag anu ca kṣāreṇa jvalanena vā||10||

div.ab: Sa. pakve tu [valmīke] duṣṭamāṃsāni sarvāś ca gatīḥ śodhayet| kena ? śastreṇa| katham ? samyak| paścāt kṣāreṇāgninā ca (vā)|
śastreṇotkṛtya niḥśeṣaṃ snehena kadaraṃ dahet| ---------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. kadaraṃ śastreṇa niḥśeṣam utkṛtya snehena dahet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
niruddhamaṇivat kāryaṃ ruddhapāyoś cikitsitam||11||

div.ab: Sa. ruddhagude cikitsitaṃ niruddhamaṇisadṛśaṃ kāryam|
cipyaṃ śuddhyā jitoṣmāṇaṃ sādhayec chastrakarmaṇā| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. cipyaṃ śuddhyā-virekādikayā, jitoṣmāṇaṃ santaṃ śastrakarmaṇā sādhayet|
Sa. kunakhaṃ duṣṭam apy evam eva sādhayet|
Sa. alase tu caraṇau kañjikasiktau kāsīsādibhiḥ sanimbapatrair ālimpet|
Sa. tilakālakān maṣāṃś ca sūryakāntadibhir dahet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
tadvad utkṛtya śastreṇa carmakīlajatūmaṇī||14||

div.ab: Sa. carmakīlajatūmaṇī śastreṇoddhṛ(tkṛ)tya tathaiva sūryakāntādibhir dahet|
Sa. lāñchanādiṣu triṣu-lāñchanavyaṅganīlikāsu, yathāsannaṃ sirāṃ vidhyet| kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ tvagbhir aṅkuraiś ca kṣīrapiṣṭair lepayet|

lg.l: vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvag vā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā|

div.ab: Sa. vyaṅgādiṣu cāyaṃ lepo 'rjunavalkaṃ kṣīrapiṣṭaṃ vā| mañjiṣṭhā mākṣikasahitā vā| śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī sanavanītā vā|
Sa. raktacandanādayo vyaṅgaharā mukhakāntikarāḥ 'lepāḥ' iti prakṛtatvād gamyate|

lg.l: dve jīrake kṛṣṇatilāḥ sarṣapāḥ payasā saha|
piṣṭā vā chāgapayasā sakṣaudrā mauśalī jaṭā|

div.ab: Sa. jīrakadvayādayo lepe prayuktāḥ payasā piṣṭā vaktracandraṃ nirastavyaṅgalāñchanaṃ vidadhati| vaktram evenduḥ, vyaṅgam eva lāñchanam iti rūpakālaṅkāraḥ| masūrā bhṛṣṭā nistuṣāś ca kṣīrapiṣṭāḥ sarpir mākṣikānvitā lepaḥ| śālmalīkaṇṭakās tīkṣṇāḥ kṣīrapiṣṭā vā lepaḥ| kolasya-amlabadarasya, majjā śaśāsṛkkṣaudrapiṣṭo guḍānvito lepaḥ| saptāhaṃ bījapūrasyāntarasthitaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ mākṣikayutaṃ vā lepaḥ| mouśalī jaṭā-śālmalīmūlaṃ, chagalīkṣīrapiṣṭaṃ sakṣaudraṃ vā lepaḥ| gavyam asthi tālapatrīmūlānvitaṃ saghṛtamākṣikaṃ vā lepaḥ

lg.l: jambvāmrapallavā mastu haridre dve navo guḍaḥ|
lepaḥ savarṇakṛt piṣṭaṃ svarasena ca tindukam||22||

div.ab: Sa. jambvāmrapallavādiko lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ| tindukaṃ ca svarasena piṣṭaṃ lepaḥ savarṇakaraḥ|
Sa. utpalādikam etad udvartanaṃ padmasadṛśaṃ mukhaṃ vidhatte| āryā|
Sa. ebhir eva-pūrvoditaiḥ, piṣṭair madhukakvāthānvitair mukhābhyaṅgārthaṃ yathādoṣaṃ yathartu snehān pācayet|

lg.l: yavān sarjarasaṃ rodhram uśīraṃ madanaṃ madhu|
ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ ca gomūtre paced ādarvilepanāt||25||

div.ab: Sa. yavādīn darvīlepaṃ yāvad gomūtre pācayet| etadabhyaṅgād drāg eva nīlikādīn hanti| vaktraṃ śatapatrasadṛśaṃ karoti| caraṇau paṅkajapatratulyau vidadhāti|

lg.l: paktvā pādāvaśeṣeṇa tena piṣṭaiś ca kārṣikaiḥ||28||

div.ab: Sa. kuṅkumādikaṃ sanīlotpalamañjiṣṭhaṃ palapramāṇaṃ jalāḍhake paktvā tena pādāvaśeṣeṇa lākṣādibhiś ca piṣṭaiḥ kārṣikais tailasya kuḍavaṃ chāgīkṣīraṃ dvikuḍavaṃ pacet| tat-tailaṃ, nasyaṃ śīlitaṃ nīlikādīn hanti| mukhopacayakaraṃ varṇakaraṃ ca|

lg.l: mañjiṣṭhā śabarodbhavas tuvarikā lākṣā haridrādvayaṃ nepālī haritālakuṅkumagadā gorocanā gairikam|
patraṃ pāṇḍu vaṭasya candanayugaṃ kālīyakaṃ pāradaṃ pataṅgaṃ kanakatvacaṃ kamalajaṃ bījaṃ tathā kesaram||31||
sikthaṃ tutthaṃ padmakādyo vasā''jyaṃ majjā kṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣāmbu cāgnau|
siddhaṃ siddhaṃ vyaṅganīlyādināśe vaktre chāyām aindavīṃ cāśu dhatte||32||

div.ab: Sa. kanakasya tvak-kanakatvak, tāṃ kanakatvacam| mañjiṣṭhādīni vasā ghṛtaṃ majjā gokṣīraṃ kṣīrivṛkṣakvātha etad agnau pakvaṃ vyaṅgādināśe siddhaṃ-avyāhataśakti| mukhasya kāntiṃ cāndramasīṃ śīghraṃ karoti| śārdūlavikrīḍitaśālinyau vṛtte|
mārkavasvarasakṣīratoyānīṣṭāni nāvane| ---------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. nāvane-nasye, mārkavasvarasādīni|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
prasuptau vātakuṣṭhoktaṃ kuryād dāhaṃ ca vahninā||33||

div.ab: Sa. prasuptau vātakuṣṭhavihitaṃ kuryāt| vahninā ca dahet|
Sa. utkoṭhe kaphapittavihitaṃ kāryam|

----------------------koṭhe sarvaṃ ca kauṣṭhikam| 33 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|32|

ab.seg: Sa. koṭhe ca sarvaṃ kuṣṭhoktam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kṣudrarogapratiṣedho nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ||32||

div.head: guhyarogavijñānīyādhyāyaḥ
div.ab:
athāto guhyarogavijñānīyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||
strīvyavāyanivṛttasya sahasā bhajato 'thavā|
doṣādhyuṣitasaṅkīrṇamalināṇurajaḥ pathām||1||
anyayonim anicchantīm agamyāṃ navasūtikām|
dūṣitaṃ spṛśatas toyaṃ ratānteṣv api naiva vā||2||
vivardhayiṣayā tīkṣṇān pralepādīn prayacchataḥ|
muṣṭidantanakhotpīḍāviṣavacchūkapātanaiḥ||3||
veganigrahadīrghātikharasparśavighaṭṭanaiḥ|
doṣā duṣṭā gatā guhyaṃ trayoviṃśatim āmayān||4||
janayanty upadaṃśādīn-------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|5|

Sa. vanitāsambhogān nivṛttasya sahasā-akasmād eva, strīvyavāyaṃ bhajataḥ| kecit karādinaiva vyavāyābhāsaṃ kurvanti tannivṛttyai strīgrahaṇam| athaveti vakṣyamāṇaguṇāṃ striyaṃ sevamānasya| kimbhūtām ? vātādyadhiṣṭhitas tathā saṅkīrṇaḥ-saṅkaṭo, malino 'ṇuḥ-sūkṣmo, rajomārgo yasyās tāṃ tathāvidhāṃ striyam| tathā'nyayoni-mahiṣyādim| tathā'nabhilaṣantīm| tathā'gamyāṃ-bhaginyādim| tathā navaprasūtām| tathā dūṣitaṃ saviṣajantvādibhir jalaṃ spṛśato, ratānteṣv api naiva vā jalaṃ spṛśataḥ| vivardhayitum icchayā tīkṣṇān pralepasekādīn vā prakṛtatvāt guhye prayacchataḥ| tathā muṣṭyādipātanais tathā vegarodhanena tathā dīrghātikharasparśanena ca yāni vighaṭṭanāni, tair eva doṣā duṣṭā guhyaṃ prāptās trayoviṃśati vakṣyamāṇān upadaṃśādīn kurvanti|
--------------------------upadaṃśo 'tra pañcadhā| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sarudhiraiḥ samastaiś ca--------------|5|
Sa. atra-eṣu madhye, upadaṃśaḥ pañcaprakāraḥ| katham? ity āha-doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ, raktena caturthaḥ, sannipātena pañcamaḥ|
Sa. eṣāṃ madhye vātenopadaṃśe meḍhre śopho bhavati| dāruṇāḥ pīḍāḥ stambhas tathā tvacaḥ paripoṭanam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittena śvayathur jvaraḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. pittena śvayathuḥ pakvodumbaraphalanibho jvaraś ca syāt|
śleṣmaṇā kaṭhinaḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān śītalo guruḥ| ---------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. śleṣmaṇā śvayathuḥ kaṭhinādiguṇaḥ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śoṇitenāsitasphoṭasambhavo 'srasrutir jvaraḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. lohitena kṛṣṇasphoṭasambhavādayaḥ syuḥ|
Sa. sarvadoṣaje sarvaliṅgatvaṃ śvayathuś ca muṣkayoḥ syāt| tīvrā ruk śīghrapākādiś ca|
yāpyo raktodbhavas teṣāṃ mṛtyave sannipātajaḥ| ---------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. eteṣāṃ madhye raktajo yāpyaḥ| sannipātottho mṛtyuhetuḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
jāyante kupitair doṣair guhyāsṛkpiśitāśrayaiḥ||9||
antar bahir vā meḍhrasya kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ|
picchilāsrasravā yonau tadvac ca cchatrasannibhāḥ||10||
te 'rśāṃsy upekṣayā ghnanti meḍhrapuṃstvaṃ bhagārtavam| ---------------------------------------------|11|

Sa. saṃ-doṣair guhyaraktamāṃsāśrayaiḥ kruddhair meḍhrasyāntar bahir vā kaṇḍūlā māṃsakīlakāḥ-śaṅkavo, jāyante| tathā picchilaraktasrāviṇaḥ| tathaiva yonau chatrasadṛśāḥ syuḥ| te māṃsakīlā arśāṃsi gadyante| upekṣitāś ca meḍhre jātāḥ puṃstvaṃ ghnanti| bhage jātā ārtavaṃ ghnanti|

---------------------------------------------|
guhyasya bahir antar vā piṭikāḥ kapharaktajāḥ||11||
sarṣapāmānasaṃsthānā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ| ---------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. guhyasya bāhyato 'ntare vā kapharaktajāḥ piṭikāḥ sarṣapapramaṇāḥ sarṣapākārā ghanāḥ sarṣapikāḥ smṛtāḥ|

---------------------------------------------|
piṭikā bahavo dīrghā dīryante madhyataś ca yāḥ||12||
so 'vamanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣavān| ---------------------------------------------|13|
Sa. piṭikā bahavo dīrghā madhye ca yā dīryante, so 'vamantho vedanāromāñcavān kapharaktābhyāṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
kumbhīkā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā''śujā||13||

div.ab: Sa. jāmbavāsthirūpā kumbhīkā raktapittodbhavā śīghrotpattiś ca|
Sa. alajīṃ pramehe yathā, tathā'sminn api vidyāt|
---------------------uttamāṃ pittaraktajām| piṭikāṃ māṣamudgābhāṃ-------------------------|14|
Sa. uttamākhyāṃ pittaraktajāṃ meḍhrapiṭikāṃ māṣasamāṃ mudgābhāṃ vidyāt|
Sa. piṭikācitā yā piṭikā syāt, tathā padmakarṇikākārā puṣkarakarkaṭābhā, tāṃ puṣkariketi vidyāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasaṃvyūḍhe saṃvyūḍhapiṭikā bhavet||15||

div.ab: Sa. hastābhyām atiśayena saṃvyūḍhe-ghṛṣṭe sati, saṃvyūḍhapiṭikākhyā syāt|
mṛditaṃ mṛditaṃ vastrasaṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ| ---------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. mṛditaṃ-malitaṃ, vastrasaṃrabdhaṃ-vāsasā kṣobhitaṃ, vātakopān mṛditaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
viṣamā kaṭhinā bhugnā vāyunā'ṣṭhīlikā smṛtā||16||

div.ab: Sa. yā piṭikā viṣamā samunnatā tathā kaṭhinā kuṭilā ca pavanenāṣṭhīlikā gaditā|

lg.l: nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacit pākaṃ ca gacchati||17||
piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ carma tat pralambam adho maṇeḥ|

div.ab: Sa. vāyunā vimardanādiduṣṭena meḍhrajaṃ carma sarugdāhaṃ nivartate| kvacit-kadācit, pākam api yāti| tat-carma, maṇer adhaḥ piṇḍitaṃ granthitaṃ pralambaṃ ca syāt| tat sakaphaṃ-kaphena tu saha, kaṇḍūkāṭhinyayutaṃ nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ syāt|
duruḍhaṃ sphuṭitaṃ carma nirdiṣṭam avapāṭikā| ---------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. kṛcchreṇa rohati yac ca duḥsphuṭitaṃ carma, tat kathitam avapāṭikā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet||19||

lg.l: maṇer vikāśarodhaś ca sa niruddhamaṇir gadaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. vātena carma dūṣitaṃ maṇau saktaṃ cet sroto ruṇaddhi| tato mandadhāram arujaṃ mūtram eti| maṇeś ca vikāśarodhaḥ| sa evaṃ vidho rogo niruddhamaṇisaṃjñaḥ|
liṅgaṃ śūkair ivāpūrṇaṃ grathitākhyaṃ kaphodbhavam| ---------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. liṅgaṃ śūkair ākīrṇam iva syāt, tad grathitasaṃjñaṃ kaphajam|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
śūkadūṣitaraktotthā sparśahānis tadāhvayā||21||

div.ab: Sa. śūkadūṣitaraktodbhavā sparśahāniḥ, sā sparśahānisaṃjñā|

lg.l: chidrair aṇumukhair yat tu mehanaṃ sarvataś citam|

div.ab: Sa. yat punar meḍhraṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ sarvataḥ-paritaḥ, citaṃ vātaśoṇitakopāt, taṃ śataponakaṃ vidyāt|
pittāsṛgbhyāṃ tvacaḥ pākas tvakpāko jvaradāhavān| ---------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. pittaraktābhyāṃ tvacaḥ pāko jvaradāhānvitas tvakpākākhyaḥ|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
māṃspākaḥ sarvajaḥ sarvavedano māṃsaśātanaḥ||23||

div.ab: Sa. sarvadoṣottho māṃspākākhyaḥ sarvavedano māṃsaśātanaḥ|

lg.l: sarāgair asitaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiś ca pīḍitam|
mehanaṃ vedanā cogrā taṃ vidyād asṛgarbudam||24||

div.ab: Sa. īṣallohitaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ piṭikābhiś ca pīḍitaṃ liṅgaṃ vedanāś ca dāruṇāḥ, taṃ-evaṃvidhaṃ, raktārbudaṃ jānīyāt|
Sa. māṃsārbudaṃ pūrvam uktaṃ granthyādirogavijñānīye(u. a.29)| tac ca tridoṣajam|
Sa. vidradhiś ca tridoṣajaḥ| sa ukto vidradhyādinidāne (ni. a. 11/9)|

---------------------------------------------|
kṛṣṇāni bhūtvā māṃsāni viśīryante samantataḥ||25||
pakvāni sannipātena tān vidyāt tilakālakān| ---------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. liṅge kṛṣṇāni māṃsāni bhūtvā parito viśīryante pakvāni sannipātena| tān-evaṃprakārān, tilakālakān vidyāt|

---------------------------------------------|
māṃsottham arbudaṃ pākaṃ vidradhiṃ tilakālakān||26||
caturo varjayed eṣāṃ śeṣāṃś chīghram upācaret| ---------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. eṣāṃ madhye māṃsārbudādīṃś caturas tyajet-nopakramet| śeṣān-ṣoḍaśa rogān, śīghram upakramet|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
viṃśatir vyāpado yoner jāyante duṣṭabhojanāt||27||

div.ab: Sa. yoner vyāpado viṃśatir duṣṭāhārād bhavanti|

viṣamasthāṅgaśayanabhṛśamaithunasevanaiḥ|
duṣṭārtavād apadravyair bījadoṣeṇa daivataḥ||28||
yonau kruddho 'nilaḥ kuryād ruktodāyāmasuptatāḥ|
pipīlikāsṛptim iva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanam||29||
phenilāruṇakṛṣṇālpatanurūkṣārtavastrutim|
srasaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca||30||
tāṃs tāṃś ca svān gadān vyāpad vātikī nāma sā smṛtā| ---------------------------------------------|31|

Sa. viṣamasthāṅgaśayanādibhir yonau pavanaḥ kupito rujādīn kuryāt| tathā pipīlikopasarpaṇam iva stambhaṃ karkaśatāṃ svanaṃ, tathā phenilādiguṇārtavasrutiṃ, tathā vaṅkṣaṇādau bhraṃśaṃ rujāṃ, krameṇa ca gulmaṃ kuryāt| taṃs tāṃś ca-anekavidhān, rogan kuryāt| sā-evaṃvidhā, vyāpat vātikī smṛtā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
saivāticaraṇā śophasaṃyuktā'tivyavāyataḥ||31||

div.ab: Sa. saivāticaraṇā śvayathuyutā'tivyavāyāt syāt|

lg.l: rujan sandūṣayed yoniṃ vāyuḥ prākcaraṇeti sā||32||

div.ab: Sa. maithunād atibālāyāḥ pavanaḥ pṛṣṭhajaṅghoruvaṅkṣaṇaṃ pīḍayan yoniṃ sandūṣayet| prākcaraṇeti sā syāt|

vegodāvartanād yoniṃ prapīḍayati mārutaḥ|
sā phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ vimuñcati||33||
iyaṃ vyāpad udāvṛttā-------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|34|
Sa. vegodāvartanena māruto yoniṃ prakarṣeṇa pīḍayati| tataḥ sā-yoniḥ, phenilaṃ rajaḥ kṛcchrād udāvṛttaṃ visṛjati| eṣā vyāpad udāvṛttākhyā|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------jātaghnī tu yadā'nilaḥ|
jātaṃ jātaṃ sutaṃ hanti raukṣyād duṣṭārtavodbhavam||34||

div.ab: Sa. yadā tu vāyuḥ sutam utpannam utpannaṃ raukṣyād duṣṭārtavajaṃ hanti, tadā jātaghnī syāt|

atyāśitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyāḥ surate marut|
annenotpīḍito yoneḥ sthitaḥ srotasi vakrayet||35||
sāsthimāṃsaṃ mukhaṃ tīvrarujam antarmukhīti sā| ---------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. atisuhitāyā viṣamaṃ sthitāyā nidhuvane pavano 'nnenotpīḍito yoneḥ sambandhini srotasi sthito mukhaṃ yoner eva vakrīkuryāt, asthimāṃsena saha dāruṇapīḍaṃ, sā'ntarmukhīty ucyate|

---------------------------------------------|
vātalāhārasevinyāṃ jananyāṃ kupito 'nilaḥ||36||
striyo yonim aṇudvārāṃ kuryāt sūcīmukhīti sā| ---------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. vātalāhārasevinyāṃ mātari vāyuḥ kupitaḥ striyo garbhasthāyāḥ sūkṣmadvārāṃ yoni kuryāt| sūcīmukhī sā syāt|

---------------------------------------------|
vegarodhād ṛtau vāyur duṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṅgraham||37||
karoti yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca śuṣkākhyā sā'tivedanā| ---------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. ṛtau vegadhāraṇād vāyur duṣṭo viṇmūtrasaṅgrahaṃ karoti| yoneḥ śoṣaṃ ca karoti| sā śuṣkasaṃjñā'tirujā syāt|

---------------------------------------------|
ṣaḍahāt saptarātrād vā śukraṃ garbhāśayān marut||38||
vamet saruṅ nīrujo vā yasyāḥ sā vāminī matā| ---------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. ṣaḍahenāthavā saptāhena garbhāśayād vāyuḥ sarujo nīrujo vā yasyāḥ śukraṃ vamet, sā vāminī gaditā|

---------------------------------------------|
yonau vātopataptāyāṃ strīgarbhe bījadoṣataḥ||39||
mṛdveṣiṇy astanī ca syāt ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñā'nupakramā| ---------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. vātopataptāyāṃ yonau strīgarbhe bījadoṣān naradveṣiṇī stanarahitā ca strī syāt| sa ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñā'nupakramā|

ab.seg:
---------------------------------------------|
duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ||40||

lg.l: kurute vivṛtāṃ srastāṃ vātikīm iva duḥkhitām|

div.ab: Sa. pavano duṣṭo yonyāsyaṃ viṣṭabhya garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca vivṛtamukhīṃ bhraṣṭāṃ vātikīm iva suduḥkhām utsṛṣṭapiśitāṃ prakṛtatvād yoniṃ kurute| tāṃ mahārujāṃ mahāyoniṃ vadanti|

yathāsvair dūṣaṇair duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonim upāśritam|
karoti dāhapākoṣāpūtigandhijvarānvitām||42||
bhṛśoṣṇabhūrikuṇapanīlapītāsitārtavām| sā vyāpat paittikī---------------------|43|
Sa. yathāyogaṃ dūṣaṇaiḥ-sarvaroganidānādyuktaiḥ, duṣṭaṃ pittaṃ yonau sthitaṃ yoniṃ dāhādyanvitāṃ karoti, tathā bhṛśoṣṇādiguṇayutārtavām| sā paittikī vyāpat|
Sa. raktayonyākhyā raktasyātisruteḥ syāt|

kapho 'bhiṣyandibhiḥ kruddhaḥ kuryād yonim avedanām|
śītalāṃ kaṇḍulāṃ pāṇḍupicchilāṃ tadvidhasrutim||44|| sā vyāpac chlaiṣmikī---------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. śleṣmā'bhiṣyandakaraṇahetubhiḥ kupito yoniṃ pīḍārahitāṃ śītalādiguṇāṃ tathā tadvidhā-pāṇḍupicchilā, srutir yasyās tāṃ tathāvidhāṃ kuryāt| sā-evaṃvidhā, vyāpat ślaiṣmikī syāt|

ab.seg:
---------------------vātapittābhyāṃ kṣīyate rajaḥ|
sadāhakārśyavaivarṇyaṃ yasyāḥ sā lohitakṣayā||45||

div.ab: Sa. yasyāḥ vātapittābhyāṃ rajaḥ kṣīyate dāhakārśyavaivarṇyayutaṃ, sā lohitakṣayākhyā|

pittalāyā nṛsaṃvāse kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt|
pittayuktena marutā yonir bhavati dūṣitā||46||
śūnā sparśāsahā sārtir nīlapītāsravāhinī|
bastikukṣigurutvātisārārocakakāriṇī||47||
śroṇivaṅkṣaṇaruktodajvarakṛt sā pariplutā| ---------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pittalāyāḥ striyā narasaṃyoge kṣavathūdgāradhāraṇāt pittānvitena vāyunā yonir dūṣitā śūnādiguṇā bastyādigurutvādividhāyinī tathā śroṇyāditodakarī syāt| sā pariplutākhyā|
Sa. vātaśleṣmarogeṇa vyāptā śuklapicchilasrāviṇī yonir upaplutā syāt|

ab.seg:
-------------------------viplutākhyā tv adhāvanāt|
sañjātajantuḥ kaṇḍūlā kaṇḍvā cātiratipriyā||49||

div.ab: Sa. akṣālanāt tu yoniḥ sambhūtakṛmiḥ kaṇḍūyutā, kaṇḍvā ca hetunā sutarāṃ suratābhilāṣiṇī viplutākhyā|

akālavāhanād vāyuḥ śleṣmaraktavimūrcchitaḥ|
karṇikāṃ janayed yonau rajomārganirodhinīm||50|| sā karṇinī-------------------------------| ---------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. marud akālavāhanāt kapharaktamiśrito yonau karṇikāṃ rajomārganirodhinīṃ kuryāt| sā karṇinī gadyate|

ab.seg:
---------------tribhir doṣair yonigarbhāśayāśritaiḥ|
yathāsvopadravakarair vyāpat sā sānnipātikī||51||

div.ab: Sa. tribhir doṣair yonigarbhāśayāśritair yathāyogam upadravakāribhir yā vyāpat sā sānnipātikī syāt|

iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati|
tato garbhaṃ na gṛhṇāti rogāṃś cāpnoti dāruṇān|52|
asṛgdarārśogulmādīn ābādhāṃś cānilādibhiḥ| 52 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|33|

Sa. iti- samāptau| evaṃ yonirogāḥ 'kathitāḥ' iti śeṣaḥ| yair āmayair yoniḥ śukraṃ na pratīcchati| tato garbhaṃ nādatte| rogāṃś ca dāruṇān asṛgdarādīn aśrute| vātapittakaphaiś cābādhān-pīḍāviśeṣān, prāpnoti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyarogavijñānīyo nāma trayāstriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 33||

div.head: guhyarogapratiṣedhādhyayaḥ
div.ab:
athaitac cikitsāṃ brūte ---- athāto guhyarogapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
meḍhramadhye sirāṃ vidhyed upaṃdaśe navotthite|
śītāṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ śuddhiṃ virekeṇa viśeṣataḥ||1||
tilakalkaghṛtakṣaudrair lepaḥ pakve tu pāṭite| ---------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. upadaṃśe 'cirodbhūte liṅgasya madhye sirāṃ mokṣayet| śiśirāṃ ca cikitsāṃ lepasekādibhiḥ kuryāt| viśeṣeṇa virecanena śuddhiṃ vidadhīta| pakve pāṭite ca tilakalkājyamadhubhir lepaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
jambvāmrasumanonīpaśvetakāmbojikāṅkurān||2||
śallakībadarībilvapalāśatiniśodbhavāḥ|
tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca triphalāṃ ca pacej jale||3||
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ, tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam| ----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. jambvādyaṅkurān śallakyādīnāṃ tvacaḥ kṣīrivṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tvacas triphalāṃ ca jale pacet| sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ hitam| tena ca kvāthena tailaṃ pakvaṃ ropaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
tutthagairikalodhrailāmanohvālarasāñjanaiḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. tutthādibhir mākṣikadrutaiḥ sūkṣmīkṛtair lepa upadaṃśavraṇaharaḥ|
kapāle triphalā dagdhā saghṛtā ropaṇaṃ param| ----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. karpare triphalā dagdhā ghṛtānvitā paraṃ ropaṇam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
sāmānyaṃ sādhanam idaṃ pratidoṣaṃ tu śophavat||6||

div.ab: Sa. sāmānyam etat sādhanam| pratidoṣaṃ tu śophatulyaṃ cikitsitaṃ jñeyam|

lg.l: na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ prayateta tathā bhṛśam|
pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ||7||

div.ab: Sa. yathā ca pākaṃ na yāti tathā'tiyatnaḥ kāryaḥ| yataḥ pakvaiḥ snāyvādibhiḥ prāyeṇa meḍhro naśyati|
arśasāṃ chinnadagdhānāṃ kriyā kāryopadaṃśavat| ----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. arśasāṃ chinnānāṃ dagdhānāṃ copadaṃśatulyā kriyā kāryā|

----------------------------------------------|
sarṣapā likhitāḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kaṣāyair avacūrṇayet||8||
tair evābhyañjanaṃ tailaṃ sādhayet vraṇaropaṇam| ----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. sarṣapikāḥ śastreṇa likhitāḥ kaṣāyadravyair jambvādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ sūkṣmacūrṇair avacūrṇayet| tair eva kaṣāyais tailaṃ pacet| tad abhyañjanaṃ vraṇaropaṇaṃ syāt|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------|
kriyeyam avamanthe 'pi raktaṃ srāvyaṃ tathobhayoḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. etac cikitsitam avamanthe 'pi kāryam| tathaita(thobha)-yoḥ-sarṣapāvamanthayoḥ, asraṃ srāvyam|

lg.l: kumbhīkāyāṃ hared raktaṃ pakvāyāṃ śodhite vraṇe|

div.ab: Sa. kumbhīkāyāṃ lohitaṃ mokṣayet| pakvāyāṃ tu vraṇe śodhite sati tindukādibhir lepaḥ| tindukādibhir eva siddhaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇaṃ syāt|
alajyāṃ srutaraktāyām ayam eva kriyākramaḥ| ----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. alajyāṃ srutaśoṇitāyām eṣa evopakramaḥ|

----------------------------------------------------|
uttamākhyāṃ tu piṭikāṃ sañcchidya baḍiśoddhṛtām||11||
kalkaiś cūrṇaiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ kṣaudrayuktair upācaret| ---------------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. uttamākhyāṃ piṭikāṃ baḍiśoddhṛtāṃ samyak chedayitvā kaṣāyāṇāṃ kalkaiś cūrṇaiḥ kṣaudrayuktair upakramet|
Sa. puṣkarikāyāṃ saṃvyūḍhe ca pittavisarpavihitaṃ cikitsitaṃ hitam| saṃ-tvakpākasparśahānyoḥ secanam|

ab.seg:
------------------------------mṛditaṃ punaḥ|
balātailena koṣṇena madhuraś copanāhayet||13||

div.ab: Sa. mṛditaṃ nāma liṅgarogaṃ vakṣyamāṇena (ślo.42) balā tailena secayet| tathā madhurair dravyaiḥ kalkitaiḥ sukhoṣṇair ghṛtasnigdhair upanāhaś ca kāryaḥ|
aṣṭhīlikāṃ hṛte rakte śleṣmagranthivad ācaret| ----------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. aṣṭhīlikāṃ rakte hṛte kaphagranthim ivopakramet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
nivṛttaṃ sarpiṣā'bhyajya svedayitvopanāhayet||14||

lg.l: svedayitvā tato bhūyaḥ snigdhaṃ carma samānayet||15||
maṇau punaḥ punaḥ snigdhaṃ bhojanaṃ cātra śasyate||16||

div.ab: Sa. nivṛttasaṃjñaṃ liṅgarogaṃ ghṛtenābhyajya svedayitvā copanāhayet trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā susnigdhaiḥ śālvalādibhiḥ| tato bhūyaḥ svedayitvā snigdhaṃ carma maṇiṃ samānayet| kiṃ kṛtvā ? maṇiṃ śanaiḥ prapīḍya| praviṣṭe maṇau copanāhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryāt| bhojanaṃ cātra snigdhaṃ hitam|
ayam eva prayojyaḥ syād avapāṭyām api kramaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ayam eva kramo 'vapāṭikāyāṃ yojyaḥ syāt|

lg.l: snehāktāṃ srotasi nyasya siñcet snehaiś calāpahaiḥ|
tryahāt tryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nyasya nāḍīṃ vivardhayet||18||
srotodvāram asiddhau tu vidvān śastreṇa pāṭayet|

div.ab: Sa. niruddhe-niruddhākhye niruddhamaṇau, nāḍīṃ dvidvārāṃ jatunā sṛtāṃ liptāḥ snehāktāṃ liṅge nyasya liṅgaṃ balātailādibhiḥ snehaiḥ siñcet| tryahāt tryahāt sthūlatarāṃ nāḍīṃ kṣiptvā srotodvāraṃ vṛddhiṃ nayet| evam apy asiddhau dhīmān vaidyaḥ sevanīṃ pariharan śastreṇa pāṭayet| tataḥ-pāṭanād anantaraṃ, sadyaḥkṣatavidhānaṃ yuñyāt|
granthitaṃ sveditaṃ nāḍyā snigdhoṣṇair upanāhayet| ----------------------------------------------------|20|
Sa. granthitasaṃjñaṃ nāḍyā sveditaṃ snigdhoṣṇair upanāhayet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
limpet kaṣāyaiḥ sakṣaudrair likhitvā śataponakam||20||

div.ab: Sa. śataponakaṃ liṅgarogaṃ likhitvā kaṣāyadravyacūrṇaiḥ samākṣikair limpet|
raktavidradhivat kāryā cikitsā śoṇitārbude| ----------------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. śoṇitārbude raktavidradhivac cikitsā kartavyā|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
vraṇopacāraṃ sarveṣu yathāvasthaṃ prayojayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. sarveṣu liṅgarogeṣu yathāvasthaṃ-avasthāvaśāt, vraṇopacārān-antaḥśuddhikaṣāyalepaghṛtatailarasakriyācūrṇāṃś chodhanaropaṇān, prayojayet|

lg.l: na hi vātād ṛte yonir vanitānāṃ praduṣyati|
ato jitvā tam anyasya kuryād doṣasya bheṣajam||23||

div.ab: Sa. yonivyāpatsu viṣaye prāyeṇa pavanavijayi cikitsitaṃ yuktam| snehanādi vātotthāsu vyāpattiṣu viśeṣeṇa śasyate| saṃ-yato vātam antareṇa yoṣito yonir na duṣyati| tasmāt taṃ mārutaṃ, jitvā parasya doṣasyauṣadhaṃ kuryāt|

pāyayeta(ttāṃ) balātailaṃ miśrakaṃ sukumārakam|
snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayet samām||24||
pāṇinā namayej jihyāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ vyadhayet punaḥ|
praveśayen niḥsṛtāṃ ca vivṛtāṃ parivartayet||25||
sthānāpavṛttā yonir hi śalyabhūtā striyo matā| ----------------------------------------------------|26|

Sa. tāṃ-striyaṃ, balātailaṃ (ci. a.21/73), miśrakākhyaṃ(ci. a.14/89), vā, sukumārakāhvayaṃ (ci. a.13/41), pāyayet| tathā yoniṃ snigdhāṃ svinnāṃ ca duḥsthitāṃ samāṃ sthāpayet| jihyāṃ-kuṭilāṃ yoniṃ, hastena namayet| saṃvṛtāṃ tu vyadhayet-prasārayed ity arthaḥ| niḥsṛtāṃ ca praveśayet| vivṛtāṃ tu satīṃ parivartayet| yataḥ sthānād bhraṣṭā yoniḥ striyaḥ śalyarūpā bhavet|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
karmabhir vamanādyaiś ca mṛdubhir yojayet striyam||26||

div.ab: Sa. vamanādīni ca karmāṇi mṛdūni-akharāṇi, strī(striyā) kārayitavyā(ni)| sarvataḥ-adha upariṣṭāc ca, viśuddhāyā nāryāḥ pariśiṣṭaṃ karma-bastyādikaṃ, kriyate|

lg.l: parūṣakaiś ca vipacet prastham akṣasamair ghṛtāt|

div.ab: Sa. kāśmaryādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ kārṣikair ghṛtāt prasthaṃ pacet| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pītaṃ yonivātavikāraharaṃ suṣṭhu garbhadaṃ ca|
Sa. vacādikaṃ piṣṭvā prasannayā''loḍya ghṛtabharjitaṃ khādet yonipārśvārtyādiśāntaye|
Sa. vṛṣakādīni madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet| tathā pippalī sthūlajīrake vā madyaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ pibet|
rāsnāśvadaṃṣṭrāvṛṣakaiḥ śṛtaṃ śūlaharaṃ payaḥ| ----------------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. rāsnādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ śūlaghnam|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
guḍūcītriphalādantīkvāthaiś ca pariṣecanam||33||

div.ab: Sa. guḍūcyādibhiḥ kvāthaiḥ pariṣecanaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ hitam, prakṛtatvād yoneḥ|

lg.l: tailāt prasādhitād dhāryaḥ picur yonau rujāpahaḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. natādibhis tailāt pakvāt picur yonau dhṛto rujāghnaḥ|

lg.l: śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca||35||

div.ab: Sa. pittalānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ śītādikāḥ kriyāḥ sekādyāḥ kāryāḥ| snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca deyāni|

lg.l: siddhaśīte tu madhunaḥ pippalyāś ca palāṣṭakam|
śarkarāyā daśapalaṃ kṣipel lihyāt picuṃ tataḥ||38||
kṣataṃ kṣayam asṛkpittaṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ halīmakam||39||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvarīmūlatulācatuṣṭayāt kṣuṇṇapīḍitād rasena dugdhasamena sarpiṣa āḍhakaṃ pacej jīvanīyādibhiḥ karṣāṃśaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ| pakve śīte ca mākṣikapalāṣṭakaṃ, kaṇāṣṭapalaṃ, sitāpalāni ca daśa, kṣipet| tasmāc ca karṣamātraṃ lihyāt yonyādidoṣaghnaṃ vṛṣyādiguṇaṃ ca|

lg.l: garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam||41||

div.ab: Sa. anenaiva krameṇa kṣīraṃ sarpir vā jīvanīyaiḥ pakvaṃ garbhapradaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paraṃ hitam|

balādroṇadvayakvāthe ghṛtatailāḍhakaṃ pacet|
kṣīre caturguṇe kṛṣṇākākanāsāsitānvitaiḥ||42||
jīvantīkṣīrakākolīsthirāvīrardhijīvakaiḥ|
payasyāśrāvaṇīmudgapīlumāṣākhyaparṇibhiḥ||43||
vātapittāmayān hatvā pānād garbhaṃ dadhāti tat| ----------------------------------------------------|44|

Sa. balāyā droṇadvayasya kaṣāye ghṛtatailayor āḍhakaṃ pacet| kṣīre caturāḍhake kṛṣṇādibhiḥ kalkitaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣayoktapramāṇaiḥ| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pānena vātapittarogān hatvā garbhaṃ dhatte| mudgādīnāṃ parṇyā pratyekaṃ sambandhaḥ,- mudgaparṇī pīluparṇī māṣaparṇīti|

----------------------------------------------------|
raktayonyām asṛgvarṇair anubandham avekṣya ca||44||
yathādoṣodayaṃ yuñjyād raktasthāpanam auṣadham| ----------------------------------------------------|45|
Sa. raktayonyāṃ lohitaṃ varṇair lakṣayitvā'nubandhaṃ ca yathādoṣodayaṃ, raktasthāpanaṃ bheṣajaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------------------------|
pāṭhāṃ jambvāmrayor asthi śilodbhedaṃ rasāñjanam||45||

lg.l: pibed arśaḥsv atīsāre raktaṃ yaś copaveśyate||48||
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃś ca nāśayet|

div.ab: Sa. pāṭhādikaṃ puṣye gṛhītvā sañcūrṇya kṣaudrānvitaṃ tandulāmbhasā pibet arśoviṣayādiṣu| ye ca doṣā jantukṛtā bālānāṃ, tāṃś ca yonidoṣādīn hanti| puṣyānugasaṃjñam etac cūrṇaṃ hitam ātreyapūjitaṃ ca| yonyāṃ balāsenā duṣṭāyāṃ sarvam eva rūkṣoṣṇaṃ hitam|

dhātakyāmalakīpatrasrotojamadhukotpalaiḥ|
jambvāmrasārakāsīsarodhrakaṭphalatindukaiḥ||51||
saurāṣṭrikādāḍimatvagudumbaraśalāṭubhiḥ|
akṣamātrair ajāmūtre kṣīre ca dviguṇe pacet||52||
tailaprasthaṃ tad abhyaṅgapicubastiṣu yojayet|
tena śūnonnatā stabdhā picchilā srāviṇī tathā||53||
viplutopaplutā yoniḥ siddhyetatsphoṭaśūlinī| ----------------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. dhātakyādibhiḥ kārṣikaiś chāgamūtre dviguṇe, kṣīre ca dviguṇe, tailaprasthaṃ pacet| tat tailam abhyaṅgādiṣu yojyam| anena tailena śūnādiguṇā yoniḥ sidhyati|

--------------------------------------------------|
yavānnam abhayāriṣṭaṃ sīdhu tailaṃ ca śīlayet||54||
pippaly ayorajaḥ pathyāprayogāṃś ca samākṣikān| --------------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. tathā yavānnādikaṃ śīlayet| pippalyādiprayogāṃś ca kṣaudrānvitān abhyaset|

--------------------------------------------------|
kāsīsaṃ triphalā kāṅkṣī sāmrajambvasthi dhātukī||55||
paicchilye kṣaudrasaṃyuktaś cūrṇo vaiśadyakārakaḥ| --------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. kāsīsādikaś cūrṇo mākṣikānvitaḥ paicchilye viśadatvakṛt|

lg.l: durgandhe picchile klede stambhanaś cūrṇa iṣyate|

div.ab: Sa. palāśādijaś cūrṇo durgandhādiṣu stambhanam iṣyate| āragvadhādivargakvātho (hṛ.sū. a. 15/17) durgandhādau pariṣekaḥ|
Sa. saṃ-stambdhānāṃ kharasparśānāṃ ca yonīnāṃ mṛdutvakaraṃ vesavārādidhāraṇaṃ vidheyam| vesavāraḥ-kuṭṭitasvinnasaṃskṛtamāṃsaviśeṣaḥ| kṛsarā ca pāyasaṃ ca kṛsarāpāyasam|

lg.l: durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ syāt tailaṃ vā kalka eva vā|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-durgandhānāṃ yonīnāṃ sarvagandhadravyāṇāṃ kaṣāyaḥ-kvātho, hitaḥ| tatpakvaṃ tailaṃ tatkalka eva vā| athavā sarvagandhānāṃ cūrṇaḥ pūtigandhā(ndhya) pahaḥ|
Sa. śleṣmalānāṃ yonīnāṃ kaṭuprāyā gomūtrayutāś ca bastayo hitāḥ| pitte madhuyaṣṭīkṣīrayuktā bastayaḥ| vāte tailāmlayutā bastayo hitāḥ|
sannipātasamutthāyāḥ karma sādhāraṇaṃ hitam| ---------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. sannipātotthāyāḥ sādhāraṇaṃ karma hitam|

---------------------------------------------|
evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ||61||
aduṣṭe prākṛte bīje jīvopakramaṇe sati| ---------------------------------------------|62|
Sa. evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, yoniṣu viśuddhāsu satīṣu striyo garbhaṃ labhante| prākṛte bīje 'duṣṭe sati tathā jīvasyopakramaṇe kṣepe sati|

---------------------------------------------|
pañcakarmaviśuddhasya puruṣasyāpi cendriyam||62||
parīkṣya varṇair doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭaṃ tadghnair upācaret| ---------------------------------------------|63|
Sa. narasya pañcabhiḥ karmabhiḥ śuddhasya, indriyaṃ,śukraṃ, doṣāṇāṃ varṇair duṣṭaṃ parīkṣya tadghnaiḥ-doṣaghnaiḥ, upakramet|

---------------------------------------------|
mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhatagaratriphalāśarkarāvacāḥ|63|
dve niśe madhukaṃ medāṃ dīpyakaṃ kaṭurohiṇīm|
payasyāhiṅgukākolīvājigandhāśatāvarīḥ|64|
piṣṭvā'kṣāṃśā ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacet kṣīracaturguṇam|
yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu tat sarveṣu praśasyate|65|
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param|
phalasarpir iti khyātaṃ puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat|66|
mriyamāṇaprajānāṃ ca garbhiṇīnāṃ ca pūjitam|
etat paraṃ ca bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ dehavardhanam|67| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne guhyarogapratiṣedho nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|34|

Sa. saṃ-mañjiṣṭādibhiḥ kārṣikaiḥ piṣṭair ghṛtaprasthaṃ kṣīracaturguṇaṃ pacet| tad dhṛtaṃ sarveṣu yoniśukrapradoṣeṣu śasyate| āyuṣyādi guṇaṃ paraṃ puṃsavanaṃ mriyamāṇagarbhāṇāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca hitam| phalasarpir iti nāmnā prasiddham| kutaḥ ? yasmāt puṣpe-ārtavasamaye, pītaṃ phalāya jāyate| tathā paraṃ bālānāṃ grahaghnaṃ śarīravṛddhikaraṃ ceti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne guhyaroga pratiṣedho nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 34|| iti śalyatantraṃ nāma pañcamam aṅgaṃ samāptam|

div.head: viṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. adhunā viṣatantram ucyate, sadyaḥprāṇahāritvena tulyasādharmyāt|
athāto viṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)|2|
Sa. tatra viṣasya prāgutpattidarśanārtham āha-

lg.l: jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ||2||

div.ab: Sa. samudre surāsurair amṛtārthaṃ viloḍyamāne 'mṛtotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ puruṣo dāruṇadṛṣṭiḥ samiddhadhāmā caturdaṃṣṭro harivarṇakaco dahanatulyanetro jātaḥ| taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvanaṃ viṣādaṃ gatam| ata evāsau jagad viṣadanāt viṣasaṃjñaḥ| brahmaṇa huṃkṛtas tu sann asau vañcanasvabhāvaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ hitvā sthāvarajaṅgamākhye mūrtī adhitasthau| puruṣarupī tiṣṭhed asau tato brahmā śāpaṃ dadyāt|

lg.l: sthiram atyulbaṇaṃ vīrye yat kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitam|
