div.ab: Sa. yad viṣaṃ sthiraṃ-sthāvaraṃ, kandeṣu pratiṣṭhitaṃ vīrye atyulbaṇaṃ tat kālakūṭādibhedabhinnam| phalādiṣv api tad bhavati, kintu kande vīryātikṛt| ādiśabdena saṅgrahoktā bhedā gṛhyante| yathā (saṃ.u. a. 40)-"kālakūṭaṃ vatsanābhaṃ sāktukaṃ vālakaṃ kardamakaṃ vairāṭaṃ mustakaṃ śṛṅgī puṇḍarīkaṃ mahāviṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ markaṭakaṃ karkaṭaṃ kāśapuṣpakam indrāyudhaṃ tathā tailam|" iti (tyādi) bhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| eṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ tatroktam| tadahi vistarataragranthaśaṅkayā noktam|
sarpalūtādidaṃṣṭrāsu dāruṇaṃ jaṅgamaṃ viṣam| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. sarpādidaṃṣṭrāsu tu yad vyavasthitaṃ taj jaṅgamam| tac ca dāruṇam| daṃṣṭrety upalakṣaṇārtham, nakhaviṣāṇamūtrādīnām api puro viṣatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------------|
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti viṣaṃ proktam akṛtrimam||5||

div.ab: Sa. sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ceti dviprakāraṃ viṣam akṛtrimam|

kṛtrimaṃ garasaṃjñaṃ tu kriyate vividhauṣadhaiḥ|
hanti yogavaśenāśu cirāc ciratarāc ca tat||6||
śophapāṇḍūdaronmādadurnāmādīn karoti vā| --------------------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. garasaṃjñaṃ tu kṛtrimam| yasmāt tat kriyate| ata eva vividhāni vakṣyamāṇāny auṣadhāni yasmiṃs tad evam| tac ca yogavaśāc chīghraṃ hanti| tathā vividhayogavaśāc cirāc ciraṃ hanti| śophādīṃś ca vidhatte|

atha viṣaguṇān nirdiśati --------------- --------------------------------------------------------|
tīkṣṇoṣṇarūkṣaviśadaṃ vyavāyyāśukaraṃ laghu||7||
vikāṣi sūkṣmam avyaktarasaṃ viṣam apāki ca| --------------------------------------------------------|8|

Sa. tat sarvaṃ viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiguṇaṃ syāt| guṇanirdeśanād asya raukṣyād vātam uṣṇatvāt pittaṃ karotīti jñāpyate| nanu, raukṣyādibhir guṇair vāyoḥ kopo na yujyate, raukṣyādīnāṃ guṇatvād vāyoś ca dravyatvāt| brūmaḥ| vāyor ye raukṣyādayo guṇās teṣām eva viṣasthai raukṣyādibhir guṇair vṛddhiḥ kriyate| te ca vāyor ātmabhūtāḥ, tannāśe vāyor nāśaḥ syāt, yathā tantunāśe paṭanāśaḥ| tasmād yuktaḥ pavanasya raukṣyādibhir guṇaiḥ prakopaḥ| evaṃ pitte 'pi yojyam| kaṭvamlādikathane 'pi viṣasyāvyaktarasatvam, anekarasasambhavād ekasyāpi ca vyaktasyānupalabdheḥ| vyavāyitvaṃ cāsya drāg evākhilakāyasya vyāpteḥ| tathā apāki,-viṣasya hi mantratantrābhyām antareṇa pākābhāvāt, pakve 'py anne viṣasyāpakvasyevopalabdheḥ| ata eva śamitam api kiñcit kāraṇaṃ prāpya punaḥ kupyati|

Sa. saṃ-tathā viṣam ojaso viparītaṃ tīkṣṇādibhir daśabhir guṇair yuktam| tīkṣṇādyair anvitam iti hetau prathamā| tīkṣṇādiguṇayuktatvād ojaso viparītam ity arthaḥ| tathā vātapittotaraṃ narāṇāṃ drāg eva jīvitaṃ harati|

ab.seg:
kutaḥ ? ity āha---- -----------------------------------------------------|
viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya prāg dūṣayati śoṇitam||9||

div.ab: Sa. yasmād viṣaṃ śarīraṃ prāpya pūrvaṃ raktaṃ sarvaśarīragataṃ dūṣayati, paścāt kaphapittavātānāśayasahitān dūṣayati| anantaraṃ kaphādibhiḥ samam eva hṛdayam āśritya śariranāśāya sampadyate| nanu, viṣasya tīkṣṇādibhir guṇair yugapat tridoṣakopitvād raktakopitvāc ca pūrvaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣayati paścātrīn doṣān iti yad uktaṃ tad ayuktimad iva dṛśyate| atra bhaṇāmaḥ viṣaprabhāveṇa raktam ākṛṣṭaṃ pūrvaṃ saha tena saṃyuktaṃ viṣeṇa dūṣyate, tato yugapad eva doṣatrayakopaḥ, tato doṣaiḥ śoṇitena saha hṛdayaṃ vyāpya sarvasrotāṃsi baddhvā dehocchedāya pravartata iti na kiñcid atrānupapannam|

lg.l: jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrcchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ||11||

div.ab: Sa. sthāvarasya viṣasyopayuktasya prathame vege rasanāśyāvatādi jāyate|

lg.l: dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo dāhaḥ kaṇṭhe ca vedanā|
viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām||12||

div.ab: Sa. dvitīye vege vepathvādayaḥ| viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ hṛdaye vedanāṃ vidhatte|

tāluśoṣas tṛtīye tu śūlaṃ cāmāśaye bhṛśam|
durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane||13||
pakvāśayagate todahidhmākāsāntrakūjanam| --------------------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. tṛtīye ca vege tāluśoṣaḥ āmāśaye 'tirujā syāt| netre cāsya durbalādiguṇe bhavataḥ| pakvāśayagate todādayaḥ syuḥ|
Sa. caturthe vege mūrdhno 'tigurutvaṃ jāyate| caśabdāt pūrvoktā rasanāśayāvatādayaḥ syuḥ| evam agre 'pi caśabdārtho bodhyaḥ|
Sa. pañcame vege kaphaprasekādiḥ| sarvadoṣāṇāṃ prakopaḥ| pūrvoktāś ca| pakvāśaye vyathā ca|
ṣaṣṭhe saṃjñāpraṇāśaś ca subhṛśaṃ cātisāryate| --------------------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe vege cetanāyāḥ praṇāśo 'tiśayenātisāraś ca|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------------|
skandhapṛṣṭhakaṭībhaṅgo bhaven mṛtyuś ca saptame||16||

div.ab: Sa. saptame skandhādibhaṅgaḥ, saptānāṃ dhātūnāṃ dūṣaṇān mṛtyuś ca syāt|
Sa. prathame viṣavege tu kṛtavamanaṃ śiśirajalasecitaṃ śīghram evāgadaṃ saghṛtamākṣikaṃ pāyayet|
Sa. dvitīye viṣavege pūrvavat-śītāmbusecitaṃ, vāntaṃ viriktaṃ cānu-paścāt, agadaṃ pāyayet|
Sa. tṛtīye vege 'gadapānaṃ nasyam añjanaṃ ca hitam|
Sa. caturthe vege snehasaṃyutam agadaṃ pratiyojayet|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------------|
pañcame madhukakvāthamākṣikābhyāṃ yutaṃ hitam||19||

div.ab: Sa. pañcame vege madhuyaṣṭikākvāthamākṣikābhyāṃ yuktam agadaṃ hitam|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe vege 'tisāratulyā cikitsā|

ab.seg:
----------------------------------avapīḍas tu saptame|
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛg vā piśitaṃ kṣipet||20||

div.ab: Sa. saptame vege 'vapīḍo-rogānutpādanīyokto (hṛ.sū. a. 4/6), deyaḥ| athavā mastake kākapadaṃ kṛtvā saraktaṃ piśitaṃ nyaset|

kośātaky agnikaḥ pāṭhā sūryavalyamṛtābhayāḥ|
śeluḥ śirīṣaḥ kiṇīhī haridre kṣaudrasāhvayā||21||
punarnave trikaṭukaṃ bṛhatyau sārive balā|
eṣāṃ yavāgūṃ niryuhe śītāṃ saghṛtamakṣikām||22||
yuñjyād vegāntare sarvaviṣaghnīṃ kṛtakarmaṇaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. kośātakyādīnāṃ kvāthe yavāgūṃ siddhāṃ śītāṃ sasarpiṣkamākṣikāṃ yuñjayāt| sūryavallī-karavīrakākārapuṣpī| kṣaudrasāhvayaṃ-vaṭamākṣikam| vegāntare-vegamadhye, sarvaviṣaghnīm| kṛtaṃ karma yasya tasyaivaṃ kāryam|
Sa. madhūkādikvāthe peyāṃ śītāṃ saghṛtamākṣikāṃ yuñjyāt|

lg.l: dvijān abhyarcya taiḥ puṣye kalpayed agadottamam|
vaidyaś cātra tadā mantraṃ prayatātmā paṭhed imam||27||

ab.seg: etena satyavākyena agado me prasidhyatu| namo vaidūryamāte huluhulu rakṣa māṃ sarvaviṣebhyaḥ||29||

gauri gāndhāri cāṇḍāli mātaṅgi svāhā|
" piṣṭe ca dvitīyo mantraḥ "harimāyi svāhā||30||

|
vāsavo vṛtram avadhīt samāliptaḥ kilāmunā| ]||32||

div.ab: Sa. añjanādīni dravyāṇi| kanyā kṛtopavāsā snātāśuklavastrā taiḥ-pūrvoktair dravyaiḥ, mākṣikasiktaiḥ puṣyanakṣatre viprān pūjayitvā'nantaram agadavaram imaṃ kalpayet| vaidyaś ca samīpastho mantraṃ nama ity ādikaṃ paṭhet| piṣṭe cāgade dvitīyo mantro harimāyyādiko 'tra yojyaḥ| nikhileṣu viṣādiṣu pānādimaṇibandhādi yojito 'yaṃ candrodayo nāmāgadaḥ paraṃ śāntaṃ(nti) svastyayanam|

ab.seg: jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhir hataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā| svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣiviṣākhyāṃ viṣam abhyupaiti||33||

lg.l: mūrcchan vaman gadgadavāk vimuhyan bhavec ca dūṣyodaraliṅgajuṣṭaḥ|
bhaven naro dhvastaśiroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ|
sthitaṃ rasādiṣv athavā vicitrān karoti dhātuprabhavān vikārān||36||

div.ab: Sa. yad viṣaṃ purāṇaṃ, viṣaghnauṣadhibhir vā hatavīryaṃ, yad vā dāvāgnīty ādibhiḥ śoṣitaṃ, svabhavenaiva vā guṇair na suṣṭhu yuktaṃ, tad dūṣīviṣasaṃjñām upaiti| tathā vīryasyālpatvād etad avibhāvyaṃ-alakṣyam| tathā kaphenāvṛtaṃ varṣavṛndaṃ ca tat sthāyi| tena-dūṣīviṣeṇa, pīḍito bhinnapurīṣavarṇādikaḥ syāt| tathā mūrcchāṃ gacchan vamann asphuṭavāk tathā vimuhyan tathā dūṣyenopalakṣita udare yāni liṅgāni (hṛ.ni. a. 12/20), taiḥ sevitaś ca bhavet| āmāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe kaphavātarogī syāt pakvāśayasthe dūṣīviṣe 'nilapittarogī syāt| upajātayaḥ| dhvastāḥ kacāḥ śarīraṃ ca yasya sa dhvastaśirotuhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ pakṣīva bhavet| rasādiṣu ca sthitaṃ nānāvidhān dhātuprabhavān vikārān karoti| upendravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: duṣṭaṃ dūṣayate dhātūn ato dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam||37||

div.ab: Sa. tac ca purovātādibhir duṣṭaṃ sad dhātūn dūṣayati yataḥ, tato 'pi hetor dūṣīviṣaṃ smṛtam|

lg.l: dūṣīviṣārtaṃ susvinnam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca śodhitam|

div.ab: Sa. dūṣīviṣapīḍitaṃ naraṃ susvinnam ūrdhvam adhastāc ca śodhitaṃ santaṃ dūṣīviṣāri-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, mākṣikeṇāplutam agadaṃ lehayet|

tam evāha ----
pippalyo dhyāmakaṃ māṃsī rodhram elā suvarcikā|
kuṭannaṭaṃ nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ yaṣṭī candanagairikam||39||
dūṣīviṣārir nāmnā'yaṃ na cānyatrāpi vāryate| --------------------------------------------------------|40|
Sa. pippalyādiko 'yam agado nāmnā dūṣīviṣāriḥ| na cānyasminn api vāryate| kintu viśeṣeṇa prayujyate|

lg.l: śūyate pacyate sadyo gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām|

div.ab: Sa. viṣadigdhena-viṣaliptena śastreṇa, viddho naraḥ punaḥ punaḥ pratāmyati| tathā vaivarṇyaṃ prayāti| drāg eva viṣādam eti| asya ca-viṣadigdhena viddhasya, śarīraṃ kīṭair iva vyāptaṃ cimicimāyate| śroṇyādayaś cāsya sarujāḥ syuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ kṣarati| tṛḍādiyutaḥ kṣaṇenaiva ca dṛṣṭikāluṣyādikaraḥ syāt| tathā vraṇa īṣadraktaprayantaḥ śyāvamadhyo mahārujaḥ syāt| tathā śūyate pākaṃ yāti| teṣāṃ sadya eva ca māṃsaṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gatvā praklinnaṃ sad dīryate nityam eva picchilayutaṃ parisravaṃ kuryāt|

kuryād amarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutam|
śalyam ākṛṣya taptena lohenānu dahed vraṇam||45||
athavā muṣkakaśvetāsomatvaktāmravallitaḥ|
śirīṣād gṛdhranakhyāś ca kṣāreṇa pratisārayet||46||
śukanāsāprativiṣāvyāghrīmūlaiś ca lepayet| --------------------------------------------------------|47|
Sa. amarmaviddhasya hṛdayāvaraṇaṃ drutaṃ vidadhīta| śalyam ākṛṣya taptena lohena vraṇaṃ paścād dahet| athavā muṣkakādikṣāreṇa pratisārayet| śukanāsādibhiś ca lepayet vraṇam|
Sa. tasya ca-digdhaphalaviddhasya, kīṭadaṣṭacikitsitaṃ yathāyogaṃ kuryāt|
Sa. vraṇe ca pūtimāṃse pittavisarpa iva cikitsā kāryā|

--------------------------------------------------------|
saubhāgyārthaṃ striyo bhartre rājñe vā'rāticoditāḥ||48||
garam āhārasampṛktaṃ yacchanty āsannavartinaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. saṃ-nānākāntāḥ yoṣitaḥ patye saubhāgyārthaṃ rājñaś ca(rājñe vā) nikaṭavartino narāś cārātipreritā garayuktaṃ bhojanaṃ dadati|
Sa. nānāprakāraprāṇyaṅgaśakṛtāṃ tathā viruddhauṣadhibhasmanāṃ viṣāṇāṃ ca stokavīryāṇāṃ yo yogaḥ, sa gara iti smṛtaḥ|

--------------------------------------------------------|
tena pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo 'lpāgniḥ kāsaśvāsajvarārditaḥ||50||
vāyunā pratilomena svapnacintāparāyaṇaḥ|
mahodarayakṛtplīhī dīnavāg durbalo 'lasaḥ||51||
śophavān satatādhmātaḥ śuṣkapādakaraḥ kṣayī|
svapne gomāyumārjāranakulavyālavānarān||52||
prāyaḥ paśyati śuṣkāṃś ca vanaspatijalāśayān|
manyate kṛṣṇam ātmānaṃ gauro, goraṃ ca kālakaḥ||53||
vikarṇanāsānayanaṃ paśyet tadvihatendriyaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|54|

Sa. tena gareṇa pāṇḍvādiguṇaḥ kāsādipīḍitaś ca syāt| vātena pratilomena yuktas tathā svapnacintāparaḥ syāt| tathā bṛhajjaṭharayakṛtplīhavān dīnavāgādiguṇaś ca syāt| svapne śṛgālādīn paśyati| prāyeṇa śuṣkavṛkṣodapānāni lokate| ātmānaṃ ca gauraḥ san kṛṣṇaṃ manyate| kṛṣṇaś ca gauraṃ manyate| tena-garaviṣeṇa, vihatendriyaḥ san vikarṇaghrāṇacakṣuṣaṃ paśyet|
Sa. etaiḥ-uktair upadravaiḥ, aparaiś cānuktair dāruṇaiḥ kliṣṭaḥ san garapīḍitaḥ kaścid acikitsitaḥ sadya eva nāśam aśnute|

--------------------------------------------------------|
garārto vāntavān bhuktvā tatpathyaṃ pānabhojanam||55||
śuddhahṛc chīlayed dhema sūtrasthānavidheḥ smaran| --------------------------------------------------------|56|

Sa. garāturaḥ kṛtavamanaḥ san tat-pūrvoktaṃ, pathyaṃ pānabhojanaṃ bhuktvā śuddhahṛdayaḥ suvarṇaṃ śīlayet| kiṃ kurvan ? sūtrasthānoktavidheḥ-"śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet|" (hṛ.sū. a. 7/28) iti smaran| vidheḥ smarann ity atra "adhīgartha-" ity ādinā vidhiśabdāt karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī|

--------------------------------------------------------|
śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyuktaṃ cūrṇaṃ tāpyasuvarṇayoḥ||56||
lehaḥ praśamayaty ugraṃ sarvayogakṛtaṃ viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|57|
Sa. mākṣīkadhātukāñcanayoś cūrṇaṃ śarkarāmākṣikānvitaṃ leho dāruṇaṃ garayogajaṃ viṣaṃ hanti|
Sa. mūrvādīni takrādibhir amlena vā-bījapūrarasādirasena, garopahatāgniḥ pumān pibet|
Sa. pārāvatāmiṣādibhiḥ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ jalaṃ garatṛṣṇādighnam|

Sa. viṣaprakṛtyādiyoge sati viṣasaṅkaṭaṃ kathitam| [atra-] asmiṃś ca viṣasaṅkaṭe, viṣārtaḥ śatamadhya eko jīvet| tatra viṣaprakṛtiḥ-pittaprakṛtiḥ| kālo-varṣāḥ| viṣānnaṃ-sarṣapādi| viṣadoṣaḥ-pittam| dūṣyaṃ-raktam| ādiśabdena sātmyādīnāṃ grahaṇam|

kṣuttṛṣṇāgharmadaurbalyakrodhaśokabhayaśramaiḥ|
ajīrṇavarcodravatāpittamārutavṛddhibhiḥ||61||
tilapuṣpaphalāghrāṇabhūbāṣpaghanagarjitaiḥ|
hastimūṣikavāditraniḥsvanair viṣasaṅkaṭaiḥ||62||
purovātotpalāmodamadanair vardhate viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|63|
Sa. kṣudhādibhir viṣaṃ vṛddhim eti|

lg.l: visarpati ghanāpāye, tad agastyo hinasti ca|

div.ab: Sa. prāvṛṣi ca jalaprabhavatvād viṣaṃ saṃkledaṃ guḍavad yāti| visarpati-prasarati, ghanāpāye-vigatavarṣāsamaye| tat-viṣaṃ, agastyo hinasti-alpaśakti karoti| tasmād ghanātyaye-śaratsamaye, mandavīryatvaṃ prayāti|
Sa. iti-evaṃ pūrvoktena prakāreṇa, prakṛtyādikaṃ buddhvā-yatnena nirūpya, tataḥ karma kuryāt|
Sa. ślaiṣmikaṃ viṣaṃ vamanair uṣṇādiguṇaiḥ pralepaiś ceddaśair bhojanaiś ca kaṣāyādiguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ nayet|
Sa. paittikaṃ viṣaṃ virecanais tathā'tiśītalaiḥ sekaiḥ pralepaiś ca tathā bhojanaiḥ kaṣāyatiktamadhurair ājyayutaiś ca śamayet|
Sa. vātikaṃ madhurādiyuktaiḥ sasarpiṣkair bhojanair lepair māṃsabhojanaiś ca jayet|

nāghṛtaṃ sraṃsanaṃ śastaṃ pralepo bhojyam auṣadham|
sarveṣu sarvāvastheṣu viṣeṣu na ghṛtopamam||69||
vidyate bheṣajaṃ kiñcid viśeṣāt prabale 'nile| --------------------------------------------------------|70|

Sa. viṣe sraṃsanaṃ-virecanaṃ, pralepo vā bhojyam auṣadhaṃ vā nāghṛtaṃ śastam| kiṃ tarhi ? sarvam eva tat saghṛtaṃ śastam| sarveṣu viṣeṣu sarvāvastheṣu ca ghṛtatulyaṃ nānyad auṣadhaṃ kim apy asti| viśeṣeṇa ca vāte 'tirikte|

--------------------------------------------------------|
ayatnāc chleṣmagaṃ sādhyaṃ, yatnāt pittāśayāśrayam|70|
suduḥsādhyam asādhyaṃ vā vātāśayagataṃ viṣam| 70 1/2| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīvadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|35|

Sa. kaphagataṃ viṣam alpayatnena sādhyam| pittāśayāśrayaṃ yatnena sādhyam| vātāśayāśritaṃ suṣṭhu duḥkhena sādhyate 'sādhyaṃ vā syād iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne viṣapratiṣedho nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 35||

div.head: sarpaviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣaprakramāt sarpaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vivakṣur āha-

athātaḥ sarpaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātrayādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre|2|
) darvīkarā maṇḍalino rājīmantaś ca pannagāḥ|
tridhā samāsato bhaumāḥ, bhidyante te tv anekadhā||1||
vyāsato yonibhedena nocyante 'nupayoginaḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. darvīkarādibhedena bujaṅgāḥ saṅkṣepeṇa triprakārā bhaumāḥ| te tu yonibhedena vistarato 'nekadhā bhidyante| viśeṣāś cehānupayogino yataḥ, tato na nigadyante|

Sa. darvīkaramaṇḍalirājīmantas teṣāṃ viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ krameṇa ca vātapittakaphānāṃ kopanaṃ syāt| yady api viṣaṃ rūkṣādiguṇaṃ, tathā'py atiśayārthaṃ punar iha guṇakathanam| viśeṣāc ca viṣaṃ hy uṣṇam eva kathitaṃ na śītalam|

Sa. ete ca-darvīkarādyayaḥ, tāruṇyādiṣu yathākramaṃ vṛṣṭyādiṣu ca viṣolbaṇā bhavanti| vṛṣṭiśabdeneha śrāvaṇādayaś catvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| evaṃ śītātapadyāś catvāro māsā gṛhītāḥ| vyantarāḥ-vijātayaḥ, ṛtusandhiṣu viṣādhikāḥ syuḥ| ṛtusandhiḥ prāg uktaḥ (hṛ. sū. a. 3/58)|

--------------------------------------------------------|
rathāṅgalāṅgalacchatrasvastikāṅkuśadhāriṇaḥ||4||
phaṇinaḥ śīghragatayaḥ sarpā darvīkarāḥ smṛtāḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. rathāṅgādidhāriṇaḥ phaṇāvanto drutagatayo bhujaṅgā darvīkarā iti munibhiḥ smṛtāḥ|
Sa. abhogāḥ-alpabhogāḥ tathā nānāprakārair maṇḍalaiś citāḥ prāṃśavo 'śīghragatayo maṇḍalino vedyāḥ|

ab.seg:
----------------------------rājīmantas tu rājibhiḥ|
snigdhā vicitravarṇābhis tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca citritāḥ||6||

div.ab: Sa. snigdhābhā nānāprakārābhis tiryagūrdhvagarājibhir vicitritā rājīmanto vedyāḥ|

vijātayo 'dhunocyante -
godhāsutas tu gaudhero viṣe darvīkaraiḥ samaḥ| catuṣpād------------------------------------|7|

Sa. godhāputro gaudheraḥ| nanu, gaudhera iti nāmnaiva godhāsutaḥ pratyapādi| tathā ca "godhāyā ḍhrak" ity apatyārthavyutpādito 'yam| satyam āha bhavān| yādṛcchikanāmaśaṅkānirāsāya tv etat| sa ca darvīkarair viṣeṇa tulyaḥ, tair eva jātatvāt| catuṣpāt-catuṣpādo 'sau|
Sa. vyantarāṃś caiteṣām eva saṅkareṇa jānīyāt| yataś ca te saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇāḥ| tasmāt sannipātaprakopānāḥ syuḥ|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------------|
āhārārthaṃ bhayāt pādasparśād ativiṣāt krudhaḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. āhārādibhiḥ kāraṇair bhujaṅgā daśanti| teṣu yathottaraṃ viṣasyādhikyaṃ kathitam|
ādiṣṭāt kāraṇaṃ jñātvā pratikuryād yathāyatham| --------------------------------------------------------|10|
Sa. ādiṣṭāt sarpāt hetuṃ viditvā viditvā yathāsvaṃ cikitset|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------------------|
vyantaraḥ pāpaśīlatvān mārgam āśritya tiṣṭhati||10||

div.ab: Sa. vyantaro bhujaṅgamaḥ pāpasvabhāvatvād vartma āśrityāste|

yatra lālāparikledamātraṃ gātre pradṛśyate|
na tu daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśaṃ tat tuṇḍāhatam ādiśet||11||
ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā vyālīḍhākhyam aśoṇitam|
daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ, trīṇi tāni tu||12||
māṃsacchedād avicchinnaraktavāhīni daṣṭakam|
daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvad daṣṭanipīḍitam||13||
nirviṣaṃ dvayam atrādyam asādhyaṃ paścimaṃ vadet| --------------------------------------------------------|14|

Sa. yasmin kāye lālāparikledamātram upalabhyate, na punar daṃṣṭrākṛtaṃ daṃśam| tat-evaṃbhūtaṃ, tuṇḍāhataṃ kathayanti| ekaṃ daṃṣṭrāpadaṃ dve vā daṃṣṭrāpade raktavarjite tad vyālīḍhasaṃjñam| dve damṣṭrāpade saśoṇite vyāluptaṃ vidyāt| trīṇi tu daṃṣṭrāpadāni māṃsacchedāt santatāsravāhīni daṣṭakam ādiśet| daṃṣṭrāpadāni catvāri tadvat-daṣṭakam iva, daṣṭanipīḍitaṃ syāt| eṣu madhye dvayam ādikathitaṃ nirviṣaṃ vadet| paścimaṃ-daṣṭanipīḍitākhyaṃ, asādhyaṃ vadet| vyāluptadaṣṭakaṃ tu kṛcchrasādhyam ity arthād gamyate|

Sa. sarpajaṃ viṣaṃ na śoṇitam aprāpya śarīraṃ dūṣayate, api tu prāpya| kintu raktaṃ stokam api prāpya viṣaṃ vardhate| yathā tailaṃ jalaṃ prāpya prasarati tathaiva| āheyam iti "dṛtikukṣi" ity ādinā bhavārthe ḍhañ|
Sa. bhīroḥ-sabhayasya puṃsaḥ, sarpasaṃsparśād dhetor yad bhayaṃ tena vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ kadācic chophaṃ vidhatte| tat sarpāṅgābhihataṃ syāt|

lg.l: viṣodvego jvaraś cardir mūrcchā dāho 'pi vā bhavet|

div.ab: Sa. durgāndhakāre kenacit prāṇinā viddhasya daṣṭaśaṅkayā viṣodvegādayaḥ syuḥ, tacchaṅkāviṣaṃ nigadyate|

lg.l: dahyate grathitaḥ kiñcid viparītas tu nirviṣaḥ||18||

div.ab: Sa. saviṣo daṃśo vyathyate, kaṇḍvādiyuto dahyate, jālakavat kiñcit grathitaḥ| asmād viparītaś ca nirviṣaḥ syāt|

lg.l: pūrve darvīkṛtāṃ vege duṣṭaṃ śyāvībhavaty asṛk|
śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ||19||
dvitīye granthayo vege, tṛtīye mūrdhni gauravam|
dāho hidhmā ca, ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam||21||
mūrcchā vipāko 'tīsāraḥ, prāpya śukraṃ tu saptame|

div.ab: Sa. darvīkarāṇāṃ prathame viṣavege śyāvavarṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca raktaṃ syāt| tena ca-tādṛśā raktena, mukhanayanādau śyāvatā syāt| kīṭakāś ca gātre sarpantīva| dvitīye viṣavege granthayaḥ syuḥ| tṛtīye śirogurutvādayaḥ syuḥ| caturthe ṣṭhīvanādayaḥ| pañcame sandhiviśleṣaṇaṃ tandrā parvabhedanaṃ dāho hikkā ca| ṣaṣṭhe ca vege hṛdayapīḍādyāḥ| saptame śukraṃ prāpya skandhādibhaṅgaḥ sarvaceṣṭānivartanaṃ syāt|

lg.l: tṛtīye daṃśavikledaḥ svedas tṛṣṇā ca jāyate|

div.ab: Sa. maṇḍalinā daṣṭasya prathame vege raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pītībhavati| tena ca raktena pītāṅgatā dāhaś ca| dvitīye śvayathūdbhūtiḥ| tṛtīye daṃśavikledādayaḥ| caturthe vege jvaro dāhaḥ| pañcame sarvaśarīragato dāhaḥ|

daṣṭasya rājilair duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ yāti śoṇitam|
pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ, dvitīye gurutā'ti ca||25||
tṛtīye daṃśavikledo nāsikākṣimukhasravāḥ|
caturthe garimā mūrdhno manyāstambhaś ca, pañcame||26||
gātrabhaṅgo jvaraḥ śītaḥ śeṣayoḥ pūrvavad vadet| --------------------------------------------------------|27|

Sa. rājimatā duṣṭasya raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gaccati| tena hetunā gātrāṇāṃ pāṇḍutā| dvitīye vege 'tigātragurutvam| tṛtīye daṃśavikledādayaḥ| caturthe mūrdhno garimādayaḥ| pañcame gātrabhaṅgādayaḥ| śeṣayoḥ-ṣaṣṭhasaptamayor lakṣaṇaṃ, pūrvavat-darvīkaravat, vadet|
Sa. pañcasu vegeṣu cikitsitaṃ kuryāt| na tu tasmāt param, asādhyatvāt|

jalāplutā ratikṣīṇā bhītā nakulanirjitāḥ|
śītavātātapavyādhikṣuttṛṣṇāśramapīḍitāḥ||28||
tūrṇaṃ deśāntarāyātā vimuktaviṣakañcukāḥ|
kuṣauṣadhīkaṇṭakavad ye caranti ca kānanam||29||
deśaṃ ca divyādhyuṣitaṃ sarpās te 'lpaviṣā matāḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|30|

Sa. jalāplutādayaḥ sarpā alpaviṣā jñeyāḥ| divyādhyuṣito deśo-yatra devatāḥ kṛtasannidhānāḥ, taṃ deśaṃ caranti|
[ "śmaśānacaityavalmīkayajñāśrayasurālaye|
catuṣpathe jalasthāne jīrṇodyāneṣu koṭhare||
kṣīradrume nimbatarau nirjhare girigahvare|
cakravajragadākuntatriśūlāṅkajaṭādharāḥ||
raktāsyanayanā ye ca te syur āśīviṣopamāḥ|
na teṣu kālaniyamo na ca vegeṣv anukramaḥ|
mantratantrabalān nāpi prasahya vinivartanam|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| ] (saṃ.u.a. 41)

--------------------------------------------------------|
śmaśānaciticaityādau pañcamīpakṣasandhiṣu||30||
aṣṭamīnavamīsandhyāmadhyarātridineṣu ca|
yāmyāgneyamaghāśleṣāviśākhāpūrvanaiḥṛte||31||
naiḥ-ṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet| --------------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. śmaśānādiṣu daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca daṣṭaṃ tyajet| yāmyaṃ-bharaṇī| āgneyaṃ-kṛttikā| naiḥ-ṛtaṃ-mūlam| naiḥ-ṛtākhyo muhūrto-sandhyodaya eva|

--------------------------------------------------------|
daṣṭamātraḥ sitāsyākṣaḥ śīryamāṇaśiroruhaḥ||32||
stabdhajihvo muhur mūrcchan śītocchvāso na jīvati| --------------------------------------------------------|33|

Sa. yaḥ śuklamukhanayanaḥ patatkacaḥ stabdharasanaḥ punaḥ punar mūrcchan śītocchvāsaḥ, sa na jīvati|
[ "vepathur vedanās tīvrā grīvābhaṅgo 'kṣiraktatā|
mūrcchā galagrahaś chardiḥ pretarājasya kiṅkarāḥ||
jāmbavapratimo daṃśaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhavad unnataḥ|
raktaṃ khebhyaḥ samastebhyo vartate na tu daṃśataḥ||
romaharṣo na śiśiraiḥ śvayathur lohito 'sitaḥ|
hṛṣṭamehanatā vakravaktratvaṃ yasya taṃ tyajet||" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| } (saṃ.u. a. 41)
Sa. yasya dehina ekakālam eva hidhmādayo hṛcchūlaṃ ca syāt, sa na jīvati|

--------------------------------------------------------|
phenaṃ vamati niḥsaṃjñaḥ śyāvapādakarānanaḥ||34||
nāsāvasādo bhaṅgo 'ṅge viḍbhedaḥ ślathasandhitā|
viṣapītasya daṣṭasya digdhenābhihatasya ca||35||
bhavanty etāni rūpāṇi samprāpte jīvitakṣaye| --------------------------------------------------------|36|

Sa. yaś ca phenaṃ vamati niścetanaḥ śyāvapādādis tathā nāsāvasādādayaś ca, yasya puṃso viṣapītasya tathā daṣṭamātrasya viṣaliptakenābhihatasya ca sāmānyenaitāni rūpāṇi tasya jīvitakṣaye samprāpte syuḥ| viṣapītasyety āhitāgniṣūktatvāt paranipātaḥ|

Sa. tīkṣṇair nasyair na cetanā-na caitanyam| tathā kṣatāc chinnād raktāgamo na bhavati| tathā daṇḍena-laguḍena, āhatasya rājiḥ-lekhā, na bhavati| yamasamīpaṃ prayātasya-gamiṣyato narasya| prayāta syeti "vartamānasāmīpye vartamānavad vā" iti bhaviṣyati ktaḥ|
Sa. ato 'nyathā-sādhyatve sati, tvarayā-sadyo drāg eva, kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān jvalitagṛham iva rakṣan viṣaṃ śīghraṃ śāntiṃ nayet|

--------------------------------------------------------|
mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ||38||
dehaṃ prakramate dhātūn rudhirādīn pradūṣayat| --------------------------------------------------------|39|
Sa. śarīriṇo daṣṭasya daṃśe mātrāśaratulyakālaṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā dehaṃ prakramate rudhirādīn dhātūn dūṣayat| prakramata iti "propābhyām" iti taṅ|
Sa. asminn antare-avasare, daṃśasyotkartanādikaṃ karma capalaṃ vidadhīta, yathā viṣavallī kāye na rohati| viṣaṃ vallīveti "upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ" iti samāsaḥ|

lg.l: loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanais chittvā cānu sasambhramam|

div.ab: Sa. daṣṭamātraḥ puruṣas tam eva sarpaṃ-daṣṭāraṃ, śīghram eva khādet (daśet)| athavā loṣṭaṃ dharaṇīṃ daśanaiś chittvā paścāc ca jhaṭiti niṣṭhīvena daṃśam ālimpet| karṇamalena vā''limpet|

lg.l: kṣaumādibhir veṇikayā siddhair mantraiś ca mantravit||42||
na vahanti sirāś cāsya viṣaṃ bandhābhipīḍitāḥ||43||

div.ab: Sa. daṃṣasyopariṣṭāc caturaṅgule 'riṣṭāṃ kṣaumādibhir veṇikayā siddhaiś ca mantrair upalakṣito mantrair upalakṣito mantrajño badhnīyāt| bandhena hi viṣaṃ stabhyate| jalaṃ yathā setubandhena| asya ca daṣṭasya, sirā viṣaṃ bandhanapīḍitā na vahanti|

lg.l: na jāyate viṣād vego bījanāśād ivāṅkuraḥ||44||

div.ab: Sa. anu-paścāt, niṣpīḍya daṃśam uddharet marmasandhiṃ varjayitvā| tathā-evaṃ kṛte sati, viṣavego na jāyate| yathā-aṅkuro bījanāśāt|

daṃśaṃ maṇḍalināṃ muktvā pittalatvād athāparam|
prataptair hemalohādyair dahed āśūlmukena vā||45||
karoti bhasmasāt sadyo vahniḥ kiṃ nāma tu kṣatam| --------------------------------------------------------|46|
Sa. maṇḍalināṃ ca daṃśaṃ pittalatvād dhetor muktvā, athāparaṃ daṃśaṃ hemādibhiḥ prataptaiḥ śīghraṃ dahed ulmukena vā| yato 'gniḥ sadya eva bhasmatāṃ sarvam eva vastu nayati| kṣataṃ tu kiyanmātram|

--------------------------------------------------------|
ācūṣet pūrṇavaktro vā mṛdbhasmāgadagomayaiḥ||46||
pracchāyāntar ariṣṭāyāṃ māṃsalaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ|
aṅgaṃ sahaiva daṃśena lepayed agadair muhuḥ||47||
candanośīrayuktena salilena ca secayet| --------------------------------------------------------|48|

Sa. athavā pittalaprāyaḥ syāt tadā mṛdādibhiḥ pūrṇavadano 'riṣṭāmadhyaṃ pracchāya-pracchānaṃ kṛtvā, ācūṣet| māṃsalaṃ tu sthānaṃ viśeṣeṇa pracchāyācūṣet| tathā daṃśena sārdham aṅgam agadena punaḥ punar lepayet| candanośīrānvitenodakena secayec ca śarīram|
Sa. viṣe pravisṛte sati sirāṃ vidhyet| sā hi uttamā kriyā| yato 'syāsṛji nirhriyamāṇe viṣaṃ sarvam eva nirhriyate, tadāśritatvāt|
Sa. saviṣaṃ śoṇitaṃ durgandhaṃ syāt| vahnau ca kṣiptaṃ caṭacaṭāyate| viśuddhaṃ ca raktaṃ doṣānusāreṇa pūrvavat-sirāvyadhavidhyuktena (hṛ.sū. a. 27) lakṣaṇena, vidyāt|
Sa. sirāsu tu śophādinā'nupalabhyamānāsu śṛṅgaṃ jalaukaso vā yuñjyāt|
Sa. srutaśeṣaṃ ca lohitaṃ viṣoṣmaṇā pravilīnaṃ lepādibhiḥ punaḥ punar upayuktair atiśītalaiḥ stambhayet|

lg.l: bhavanti tān jayec chītair bījec cāromaharṣataḥ||52||

div.ab: Sa. askanne-asrute 'styāne, hi rakte viṣavegena mūrcchādyā bhavanti| tāṃś ca śītair lepādibhir jayet| tathā romāñco yāvac chīte na syāt tāvad bījec ca|
Sa. asre tu skanne sati viṣavegaḥ śīghram eva praśāmyati|

lg.l: pibed dhṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudram agadaṃ vā ghṛtāplutam|

div.ab: Sa. viṣaṃ tīkṣṇādiyogād hṛdayaṃ karṣati| tasya-hṛdayasya, guptaye-rakṣaṇāya, ghṛtaṃ ghṛtakṣaudram agadaṃ vā pibet ghṛtāplutam| asya-puruṣasya, hṛdayāvaraṇe sati śleṣmā hṛdaye cayaṃ yāti|

pravṛttagauravotkleśahṛllāsaṃ vāmayet tataḥ|
dravaiḥ kāñjikakaulatthatailamadyādivarjitaiḥ||55||
vamanair viṣahṛdbhiś ca naivaṃ vyāpnoti tad vapuḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|56|
Sa. pravṛttāḥ-sañjātāḥ, gauravotkleśahṛllāsā yasya sa evaṃ bhūtas taṃ dravaiḥ kāñjikādirahitair vamanair vāmayet viṣaharaiś ca vāmayet| evaṃ kṛte sati tasya-viṣārtasya, śarīraṃ viṣaṃ na vyāpnoti|
Sa. bhujaṅgadoṣādikaṃ susūkṣmayā buddhyā samyag ālocya viśiṣṭāṃ kriyāṃ samācaret|
Sa. sinduvāritamūlādikaṃ jalānvitaṃ darvīkarair daṣṭe pānaṃ nasyaṃ mākṣikaṃ kuṣṭhasahitaṃ hitam|
Sa. kṛṣṇabhujaṅgadaṣṭasya rakte hṛte sati daṃśaṃ guñjānākulībhyāṃ limpet| tīkṣṇena mūlaviṣena vā limpet| kṣaudrādiyutaṃ ca sarpiḥ pānam|

tandulīyakakāśmaryakiṇihīgirikarṇikāḥ|
mātuluṅgī sitā śeluḥ pānanasyāñjanair hitaḥ||60||
agadaḥ phaṇināṃ ghore viṣe rājīmatām api| --------------------------------------------------------|61|
Sa. tandulīyakādikaḥ pānādibhir agadaḥ phaṇināṃ rājīmatāṃ ca dāruṇe viṣe hitaḥ|
Sa. sugandhādayaḥ samāḥ-samabhāgāḥ, ardhabhāgena surasapatrādikam iti samākṣiko maṇḍalino viṣe viśeṣeṇāgado hitaḥ|

lg.l: sakṣaudro himavān nāma hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam|

div.ab: Sa. pañcavalkādiko mākṣikayuto himavān nāmāgado maṇḍaliviṣaṃ lepena hanti, śophādihā ca| śirīṣapippalavaṭaplakṣavetasānāṃ pañcānāṃ tvak-pañcavalkam ucyate|

lg.l: mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet||65||

div.ab: Sa. kāśmaryādikaṃ maṇḍalidaṣṭo naraḥ pibet|

vaṃśatvagbījakaṭukāpāṭalībījanāgaram|
śirīpabījātiviṣe mūlaṃ gāvedhukaṃ vacā||66||
piṣṭo govāriṇā'ṣṭāṅgo hanti gonasajaṃ viṣam| --------------------------------------------------------|67|
Sa. vaṃśatvagādiko 'ṣṭāṅgo 'gado gomūtrapiṣṭo gonasaviṣaṃ hanti| vaṃśasya tvagbīje|
Sa. kaṭukādayo rājīmatāṃ viṣaṃ ghnanti|

--------------------------------------------------------|
nikhanet kāṇḍacitrāyā daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi||68||
uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpir dhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet|
pibet purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ varācūrṇāvacūrṇitam||69||
jīrṇe virikto bhuñjīta yavānnaṃ sūpasaṃskṛtam| --------------------------------------------------------|70|

Sa. kāṇḍacitrāyāḥ-sarpaviśeṣasya, daṃśaṃ yāmadvayaṃ bhuvi nikhanet| tata uddhṛtya pracchitaṃ sarpair dhānyamṛdbhyāṃ pralepayet| dhānyasya mṛd dhānyamṛt| tathā purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ triphalācūrṇayutaṃ pibet| jīrṇe virikto yavānnaṃ śālyādikaṃ sūpena saṃskṛtam adyāt|
Sa. karavīrārkayoḥ kusumamūlaṃ lāṅgalikādīṃś ca kāñjikena kalkayet| eṣo 'gadaḥ sārvakārmiko vyantaradaṣṭānāṃ hitaḥ| sārvakārmika iti "anuśatikāditvāt(dīnāṃ ca)" [iti] ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ|
Sa. śirīṣakusumarase saptavāsarāṇi sitamaricaṃ bhāvitaṃ bhujaṅgadaṣṭānāṃ pānādau hitam|
Sa. tagarakuṣṭhayor dve pale ghṛtamākṣikayoś catvāri palāni| takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭānāṃ tat pītaṃ śarmadam|

lg.l: atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve vistrāvya śoṇitam|

div.ab: Sa. darvīkṛtāṃ ca prathame vege pūrvaṃ raktaṃ visrāvyānantaraṃ madhughṛtayutam agadaṃ śīghram eva pibet|
Sa. dvitīye vege vamanaṃ vidhāya tathaivāgadaṃ pibet|
Sa. tṛtīye vege viṣaghnam añjanādi dadyāt|
Sa. caturthe vege kṛtavamanaḥ pūrvoktāṃ yavāgūṃ pibet|

--------------------------------------------------------|
ṣaṣṭhapañcamayoḥ śītair digdhaṃ siktam abhīkṣṇaśaḥ||76||
pāyayed vamanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ yavāgūṃ ca viṣāpahaiḥ| --------------------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhapañcamayor vegayoḥ puruṣaṃ śiśirair muhur liptaṃ siktaṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ vamanaṃ pāyayet| yavāgūṃ ca viṣaghnaiḥ kṛtāṃ pāyayet|

lg.l: māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet||78||

div.ab: Sa. saptame vege tīkṣṇam agadam añjane nasye ca yuñjyāt| tataḥ śastreṇa kākapadam avagāḍhaṃ mūrdhni vidhāya tatas tasya-daṣṭasya, tasmin kākapade māṃsaṃ saśoṇitaṃ nyaset, athavā carma nikṣipet|
Sa. tṛtīye maṇḍalināṃ vege vamitaḥ peyāṃ pibet|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe 'tīkṣṇam agadaṃ padmakādiṃ vā gaṇaṃ (hṛ.sū. a. 15/12) yojayet|

lg.l: alābunā hared raktaṃ pūrvavac cāgadaṃ pibet||80||

div.ab: Sa. rājīmatāṃ prathame vege 'tiśayena pracchāyālābunā raktaṃ haret| pūrvavac cāgadaṃ pibet|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe 'ñjanam atitīkṣṇaṃ yojayed avapīḍaṃ ca| nanu, atra kecid vegā noditā eva| teṣu kiṃ vidheyam ? ity āha-
Sa. akathiteṣu darvīkaroktāṃ kriyāṃ yojayet|
Sa. garbhīṇyādiṣu mṛduṃ kriyāṃ yojayet| sirāṃ ca na vyadhayet|

lg.l: hanti sarvaviṣāṇy etad vajraṃ vajram ivāsurān||83||

div.ab: Sa. tvagādikam idaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītaṃ sarvāṇi viṣāṇi hanti| vajrivajram ivāsurān ity upamālaṅkāraḥ|

lg.l: bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam|
phalatrikaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca vastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam||84||
ārtān narān bhūtavidharṣitāṃś ca svasthīkaroty añjanapānanasyaiḥ||85||

div.ab: Sa. bilvamūlādikaṃ chāgamūtreṇa suślakṣṇapiṣṭam añjanādibhir bhujaṅgādibhir ārtān puruṣān bhūtopadrutāṃś ca svasthayati| upajātivṛtte|

lg.l: pralepādyaiś ca niḥśeṣaṃ daṃśād apy uddhared viṣam|
bhūyo vegāya jāyet śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā||86||

div.ab: Sa. daṃśād api-kiṃ punaḥ kāyāt, sarvaṃ viṣam uddharet| śeṣaṃ hi viṣaṃ punar vegāya sampadyate, dūṣīviṣāya vā|

Sa. viṣāpagame sati vāyuṃ kupitaṃ snehādibhir upakramet, tailādivarjitair vātanāśanaiḥ| pittaṃ pittajvaraharaiḥ kvāthaiḥ snehabastibhiś copakramet| āragvadhādigaṇena (hṛ. sū. a. 15/17) samākṣikeṇa kapham upācaret|

sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu|
pānaṃ samantrapūtāmbu prekṣaṇaṃ sāntvaharṣaṇam||89||
sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt tathā śaṅkāviṣārdite| --------------------------------------------------------|90|
Sa. sitādikaṃ mantrapūtajalena sahitaṃ pānam| prokṣaṇaṃ prakṛtatvān mantrapūtajalena vegaśo 'ṅgaśaś ca| tathā sāntvanaharṣaṇaṃ sarpāṅgābhihate yuñjyāt, śaṅkāviṣapīḍite ca yuñjyāt|

lg.l: tathā droṇāṃ mahādroṇāṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim|

div.ab: Sa. karketanādīni viṣāṇi ca vīryavanti viṣaśāntyarthaṃ dhārayet|

chatrī jharjharapāṇiś ca cared rātrau viśeṣataḥ|
tacchāyāśabdavitrastāḥ praṇaśyanti bhujaṅgamāḥ|93| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|36|

Sa. chatravān jharjharahastaś ca caret, viśeṣeṇa rātrau| tayoḥ chatrajharjharayoḥ, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ chāyāśabdābhyāṃ vitrastāḥ sarpāḥ praṇaśyanti, tasmād evam ācaraṇīyam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne sarpaviṣapratiṣedho nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 36||

div.head: kīṭālūtādiviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣaprakramāt kīṭalūtādicikitsitaṃ vakti-
Sa. sarpāṇāṃ-pūrvoktānāṃ, viṇmūtrādijāḥ kīṭā doṣaiḥ pṛthag yuktās triprakārāḥ samuditaiś ca yuktā iti catuḥ prakārāḥ syuḥ|
daṣṭasya kīṭair vāyavyair daṃśas todarujolbaṇaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|2|
Sa. teṣu madhye vāyavyaiḥ-vātalaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśas todarujādhiko bhavet|

-----------------------------------------------|
āgneyair alpasaṃsrāvo dāharāgavisarpavān||2||
pakvapīluphalaprakhyaḥ kharjūrasadṛśo 'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|3|
Sa. āgneyaiḥ kīṭair daṣṭasya daṃśo 'lpasrāvādimān syāt| pakvapīluphalanibhaḥ kharjūrasadṛśo vā syāt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kaphādhikarimandarujaḥ pakvodumbarasannibhaḥ||3||

div.ab: Sa. kaphādhikaiḥ kīṭair daṣṭasya daṃśo mandarujaḥ pakvodumbarasadṛśaḥ|
srāvāḍhyaḥ sarvaliṅgas tu vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|4|
Sa. sānnipātikaiḥ-tridoṣādhikaiḥ kīṭaiḥ, daṣṭasya daṃśaḥ srutyadhikaḥ sarvaliṅgaḥ| sa ca varjyo-nopakramaṇīyaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
vegāś ca sarpavac chopho vardhiṣṇur visraraktatā||4||
śirokṣigauravaṃ mūrcchā bhramaḥ śvāso 'tivedanā| -----------------------------------------------|5|
Sa. vegāś ca sarpavat kīṭeṣu syuḥ| tathā śvayathur vardhanasvabhāvo visraśoṇitatvaṃ ca mūrdhanetragurutvaṃ mūrcchādyāś ca syuḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
sarveṣāṃ karṇikā śopho jvaraḥ kaṇḍūr arocakaḥ||5||

div.ab: Sa. karṇikādyāś ca sarveṣāṃ daṃśānāṃ syuḥ|

vṛścikasya viṣaṃ tīkṣṇam ādau dahati vahnivat|
ūrdhvam ārohati kṣipraṃ daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati||6||
daṃśaḥ sadyo 'tiruk śyāvas tudyate sphuṭatīva ca| -----------------------------------------------|7|

Sa. vṛścikasya tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| tac ca prathamam agnir iva dahati| upariṣṭād āśv evārohati| paścāc ca daṃśe tiṣṭhati| daṃśo vṛścikasambandhī sadyo 'tirugādiḥ syāt| tudyate sphuṭatīva ca| tudyata iti karmakartari taṅ|

-----------------------------------------------|
te gavādiśakṛtkothād digdhadaṣṭādikothataḥ||7||
sarpakothāc ca sambhūtā mandamadhyamahāviṣāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. te-vṛścikāḥ, gavādiśakṛtkothāt viṣadigdhadaṣṭādi kothāt sarpakothāc ca sambhūtā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ mandaviśā madhyaviṣā mahāviṣāś ca syuḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvāḥ rūkṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ||8||
romaśā bahuparvāṇo lohitāḥ pāṇḍurodarāḥ| -----------------------------------------------|9|
Sa. mandaviṣāḥ kīṭāḥ pītādiguṇāḥ| romaśā iti "lomādi" ity ādinā śaḥ|
Sa. madhyaviṣās tu kapilādiguṇāḥ|

ab.seg:
-------------------------------mahāviṣāḥ|
agnyābhā-dvyekaparvāṇo raktāsitasitodarāḥ||10||

div.ab: Sa. mahāviṣā darbhadūrvāsadṛśā dviparvāṇa ekaparvāṇo vā| raktodarāḥ kecit kṛṣṇodarāḥ kecit sitodarāś ca|

lg.l: khair vaman śoṇitaṃ kṛṣṇam indriyārthān asaṃvidan||11||

div.ab: Sa. taiḥ-mahāviṣaiḥ, daṣṭaḥ san śūnajihvādiḥ syāt| tathedam idaṃ kurvann īdṛśaḥ san prāyaśo jīvitaṃ tyajati|

lg.l: karoti sekam aṅgānāṃ daṃśaḥ śītāmbuneva ca|
uṣṭradhūmaḥ sa evokto rātricārāc ca rātrikaḥ||14||

div.ab: Sa. ucciṭiṅgākhyo vṛściko vaktreṇa daśati| sādhyād dṛścikād atiriktavyathaḥ| tathā stambhaṃ karoti meḍhrasya| tathā hṛṣṭaromatāṃ-romaharṣaṃ, karoti| tathā daṃśaś ca śiśirajaleneva sekam aṅgānāṃ vidhatte| sa evoṣṭradhūmakaḥ kathitaḥ| rātricaraṇāc ca rātrikaḥ sa evoktaḥ|
Sa. kīṭā vātapittādhikāḥ| kaṇabhondurāḥ śleṣmolbaṇāḥ| prāyeṇa vṛścikā vātolbaṇaviṣā uṣṭradhūmakāś ca|
Sa. yasya yasyaiva doṣasya liṅgādhikyaṃ jñāyate, tasya tasya doṣasya bheṣajair viparītaguṇaiḥ kriyāṃ vidadhīta|
Sa. vātike viṣe hṛtpīḍādayaḥ syuḥ|
Sa. pittolbaṇe saṃjñānāśādayaḥ syuḥ|
Sa. kaphādhikaṃ viṣaṃ chardyādibhir jānīyāt|

lg.l: svedo nāḍīpulākādyair bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhir hitaḥ||20||

div.ab: Sa. vātike viṣe piṇyākena vraṇalepo yojyaḥ, tailābhyaṅgaś ca nāḍyādibhiś ca svedo bṛṃhaṇaś ca vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ|
paittikaṃ stambhayet sekaiḥ pradehaiś cātiśītalaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. pittādhikaṃ viṣaṃ sekādibhir atiśiśiraiḥ stambhayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
lekhanacchedanasvedavamanaiḥ ślaiṣmikaṃ jayet||21||

div.ab: Sa. ślaiṣmikaṃ lekhanādyair jayet|

kīṭānāṃ triprakārāṇāṃ traividhyena kriyā hitā|
svedālepanasekāṃs tu koṣṇān prāyo 'vacārayet||22||
anyatra mūrcchitād daṃśapākataḥ kothato 'thavā| -----------------------------------------------|23|
Sa. kīṭānāṃ trividhānāṃ yathāsvaṃ trividhaiva cikitsā hitā| svedādīṃś ca prāyeṇa koṣṇān kuryāt| mūrcchitaṃ naraṃ daṃśapākaṃ ca varjayitvā tathā daṃśakothaṃ ca hitvā|

-----------------------------------------------|
nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo jīrṇaś ca dhūpanam||23||
viṣadaṃśasya sarvasya kāśyapaḥ param abravīt| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. narakacādayo dhūpanaṃ sarvasya viṣadaṃśasya paraṃ hitam iti bhagavān kāśyapo 'vādīt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca||24||

div.ab: Sa. tathā viṣaghnaṃ vidhiṃ sakalaṃ vidadhyāt| saṃśodhanāni ca kuryāt|
sādhayet sarpavad daṣṭān viṣograiḥ kīṭavṛścikaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. viṣograiḥ kīṭavṛścikair daṣṭān sarpavat sādhayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
tandulīyakatulyāṃśāṃ trivṛtāṃ sarpiṣā pibet||25||
yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|26|
Sa. trivṛtāṃ tandulīyakasamāṃ ghṛtena naraḥ pibet| evaṃ kīṭaviṣaiś ca kampaṃ-kṣobhaṃ, na yāti| kailāsa iva vāyubhiḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ śuddhe kīṭaviṣāpahaḥ||26||

div.ab: Sa. śuddhe sati kṣīrivṛkṣatvagālepaḥ kīṭaviṣaghnaḥ|
muktālepo varaḥ śophatodadāhajvarapraṇut| -----------------------------------------------|27|
Sa. mauktikalepaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śophādighnaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vacā hiṅgu viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ gajapippalī||27||

div.ab: Sa. vacādikadaśadravyanirmitatvāt daśāṅgam agadaṃ kāśyapena nirmitaṃ pītvā sarvaṃ kīṭaviṣaṃ hanti|

Sa. vṛścikotthaṃ daṃśaṃ sadya eva cakratailena secayet| śāliparṇīsiddhena vā itareṇa-cakratailena, koṣṇena vā secayet| saindhavānvitena vā''jyena muhur muhuḥ siñcet| kavoṣṇena kāñjikena dugdhasaindhavānvitena vā siñcet|
upanāho ghṛte bhṛṣṭaḥ kalko 'jājyāḥ sasaindhavaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. jīrakakalkaḥ saindhavayukto ghṛtena bhṛṣṭa upanāhaḥ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
ādaṃśaṃ sveditaṃ cūrṇaiḥ pracchāya pratisārayet||31||
rajanīsaindhavavyoṣaśirīṣaphalapuṣpajaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. ā- samantato, daṃśaṃ sveditaṃ pracchāya cūrṇai rajanyādijair gharṣayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
mātuluṅgāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ ca surasāgrajam||32||
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaś ca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayo 'pi vā| -----------------------------------------------|33|
Sa. bījapūrāmlagomūtrapiṣṭaṃ surasāpuṣpaṃ lepaḥ syāt| tathā sukhoṣṇaḥ piṇyāko gomayo vā lepo hitaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
pāne sarpir madhuyutaṃ kṣīraṃ vā bhūriśarkaram||33||

div.ab: Sa. pāne haiyaṃgavīnaṃ kṣaudrayuktaṃ, dugdhaṃ vā prabhūtasitaṃ, hitam|
Sa. pārāpataśakṛtādibhiḥ phalapūrarasasaṃyuktaḥ śreṣṭho vṛścikāgadaḥ|
saśaivaloṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam| -----------------------------------------------|35|

Sa. karabhadaṃṣṭrā śaivālayutā vṛścikaviṣaghnī|
["sasaindhavoṣṭradaṃṣṭrā ca hanti vṛścikajaṃ viṣam|
manohvā saindhavaṃ hiṅgu mālatī pallavāni ca||
gośakṛdrasapiṣṭeyaṃ gulikā vṛścikārdite|
laśuno maricaṃ hiṅgu surasaṃ viśvabheṣajam|| arkakṣīreṇa guṭikā vṛścikārditaśaṅkarī|" vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt (saṃ. u. a. 43)| ]

-----------------------------------------------|
hiṅgunā haritālena mātuluṅgarasena ca||35||
lepāñjanābhyāṃ guṭikā paramaṃ vṛścikāpahā| -----------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. hiṅguharitāle sabījapūrarase lepāñjanābhyāṃ gulikā paraṃ vṛścikaviṣahṛt|

-----------------------------------------------|
karañjārjunaśelūnāṃ kaṭabhyāḥ kuṭajasya ca||36||
śirīṣasya ca puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśalepanam| -----------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. karañjādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi mastunā daṃśalepaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
yo muhyati praśvasiti pralapaty ugravedanaḥ||37||

div.ab: Sa. yo naro muhyaty ādīn vidhatte, tathā dāruṇapīḍaḥ, tasya pathyādikaṃ vārtākarasapiṣṭaṃ pralepanaṃ kāryam|
Sa. sarvasmin sudāruṇe vṛścikaviṣe dadhisarpiṣī pāyayet| sirāṃ ca vidhyet| vamanādikaṃ ca kuryāt| uṣṇaguṇādikaṃ ca bhojanaṃ vātaghnaṃ hitam|

lg.l: saindhavaṃ ca vinihanty agado 'yaṃ lepato 'likulajaṃ viṣam āśu||40||

div.ab: Sa. nāgarādikam ayam agado lepena vṛścikaviṣaṃ śīghraṃ parākaroti| svāgatāvṛttam|
Sa. saṃ-vṛścikadaṣṭānām ante bhṛśaṃ samudīrṇe viṣe viṣeṇa daṃśam ālepayet| ucciṭiṅgasaṃjñe 'py eṣaiva cikitsā|

lg.l: kuryād guṭikāṃ lepād iyam aliviṣanāśanī śreṣṭhā||42||

div.ab: Sa. gajapurīṣacchatraṃ kattṛṇamūlaṃ ca śleṣmātakajalena guṭikāṃ vidadhīta| eṣā ca lepena paraṃ vṛścikaviṣaghnī| [āryā}

lg.l: arkasya dugdhena śirīṣabījaṃ trir bhāvitaṃ pippalīcūrṇamiśram|

div.ab: Sa. arkakṣīreṇa śirīṣabījaṃ trīn vārān bhāvitaṃ pippalīrajoyutam agadaḥ kīṭādīnāṃ viṣāṇi hanti|
Sa. śirīṣakusumādikam eṣo 'gado rātrikavṛścikānāṃ viṣakrāntikṛd bhagavatā jinenoktaḥ| upajātivṛtte|

ab.seg:
kīṭebhyo dāruṇtarā lūtāḥ ṣoḍaśa tā jaguḥ|
aṣṭāviṃśatir ity eke tato 'py anye tu bhūyasīḥ||45||

div.ab: Sa. kīṭebhyo 'pi ghorā lūtāḥ| tāś ca munayaḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyā adhyagīṣan| anye aṣṭāviṃśatir ulūtā ity avocan| tato 'py apare bahutarā ācakhyuḥ| anye tu raver anucarāḥ sahasraśo vadanti| iti nānāmatam uktvā svamataṃ yuktyā sarvamatānugrāhi vakti| anekopadravasvabhāvatvenaikaiva lūtā viṣātmikā|
Sa. nāmnā yāni rūpāṇi, tāni tasyā atisaṅkarād dhetor durjñānāni| sthānavyavasthā'pi nāsti| tasmād doṣavaśena bhaṇiṣyate|
kṛcchrasādhyā pṛthagdoṣair asādhyā nicayena sā| -----------------------------------------------|48|
Sa. pṛthagdoṣair lūtā kṛcchrasādhyā, sannipātena cāsādhyā|

-----------------------------------------------|
taddaṃśaḥ paittiko dāhatṛṭsphoṭajvaramohavān||48||
bhṛśoṣmā raktapītābhaḥ kledī drākṣāphalopamaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|49|
Sa. tasyā daṃśaḥ paittiko dāhādimān bhṛśoṣmā pītaraktābhaḥ kledavān drākṣāphalākāraḥ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
ślaiṣmikaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuḥ parūṣakaphalākṛtiḥ||49||
nidrāṃ śītajvaraṃ kāsaṃ kaṇḍūṃ ca kurute bhṛśam| -----------------------------------------------|50|
Sa. ślaiṣmiko lūtādaṃśaḥ kaṭhinaḥ pāṇḍuvarṇaḥ parūṣakaphalanibho nidrādīn atiśayena karoti|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vātikaḥ paruṣaḥ śyāvaḥ parvabhedajvarapradaḥ||50||

div.ab: Sa. vātiko daṃśaḥ paruṣasparśaḥ syāvas tathā parvabhedajvarakṛt|
tadvibhāgaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣaliṅgair vibhāvayet| -----------------------------------------------|51|
Sa. tāsāṃ vibhāgaṃ doṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇair yathāyogaṃ lakṣayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
asādhyāyāṃ tu hṛnmohaśvāsahidhmāśirograhāḥ||51||
śvetapītāsitāraktāḥ piṭikāḥ śvayathūdbhavaḥ|
vepathur vamathur dāhas tṛḍ āndhyaṃ vakranāsatā||52||
śyāvauṣṭhavaktradantatvaṃ pṛṣṭhagrīvāvabhañjanam|
pakvajambūsavarṇaṃ ca daṃśāt sravati śoṇitam||53||
sarvā'pi sarvajā prāyo vyapadeśas tu bhūyasā| -----------------------------------------------|54|
Sa. āsādhyāyāṃ lūtāyāṃ hṛnmohādyāḥ syuḥ| śvetādiguṇāḥ piṭikās tathā śvayathvādyāś ca| daṃśād raktaṃ pakvajambūnibhaṃ sravati| saṃ-sarvā ca lūtā tridoṣajaiva| bāhulyena tu vyapadeśaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
tīkṣṇamadhyāvaratvena sā tridhā hanty upekṣitā||54||
saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt| -----------------------------------------------|55|
Sa. sā ca lūtā tīkṣṇādibhedena triprakārā| upekṣitā ca satī yathāsaṅkhyaṃ daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca hanti|

-----------------------------------------------|
lūtādaṃśaś ca sarvo 'pi dadrumaṇḍalasannibhaḥ||55||
sito 'sito 'ruṇaḥ pītaḥ śyāvo vā mṛdur unnataḥ|
madhye kṛṣṇo 'thavā śyāvaḥ paryante jālakāvṛtaḥ||56||
visarpavāṃs chophayutas tapyate bahuvedanaḥ|
jvarāśupākavikledakothāvadaraṇānvitaḥ||57||
kledena yat spṛśaty aṅgaṃ tatrāpi kurute vraṇam| -----------------------------------------------|58|

Sa. sarvaś ca lūtādaṃśo dadrumaṇḍalākāraḥ sitādivarṇo mṛdur unnato madhye kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śyāvavarṇo vā parito jālakavṛto visarpādimān syāt| tathā tapyate 'nekarujaḥ| tathā jvarādiyutaḥ| tathā ca daṃśaḥ kledena yad yad aṅgaṃ spṛśet tatra tatra ca vraṇaṃ vidadhāti|

-----------------------------------------------|
śvāsadaṃṣṭrāśakṛnmūtraśukralālānakhārtavaiḥ||58||
aṣṭābhir udvamaty eṣā viṣaṃ vaktrād viśeṣataḥ| -----------------------------------------------|59|
Sa. śvāsādibhir aṣṭābhir eṣā lūtā viṣam udvamati| vaktreṇa viśeṣeṇa|

-----------------------------------------------|
lūtā nābher daśaty ūrdhvam ūrdhvaṃ cādhaś ca kīṭakāḥ||59||
taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt| -----------------------------------------------|60|
Sa. nābher ūrdhvaṃ lūtā daśati| ūrdhvam adhastāc ca kīṭā daśanti| daśatīti "daṃśasañjasvañjāṃ śapi" iti nalopaḥ| tayā-lūtayā dūṣitaṃ, vastrāsanādi śarīre lagnaṃ vikārakṛt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
dinārdhaṃ lakṣyate naiva daṃśo lūtāviṣodbhavaḥ||60||

div.ab: Sa. lūtāviṣajo daṃśo dinārdhaṃ na lakṣyata eva| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, asau-daṃśaḥ, prathame dine sūcīvyadhatulya ābhāti| avyaktavarṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa calo manāk kaṇḍūrugyutaś ca|
Sa. dvītīye 'hany abhyunnato 'nteṣu piṭikair iva vā''cito vyaktavarṇo madhye nataḥ sakaṇḍūr granthinibhaḥ|
Sa. tṛtīye 'hani jvarānvito romāñcakṛd raktamaṇḍalaḥ śarāvākāro 'dhikavyatho romakūpeṣu srāvavān|
mahāṃś caturthe śvayathus tāpaśvāsabhramapradaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|64|
Sa. caturthe vāsare mahāṃś chophas tāpādikṛt|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vikārān kurute tāṃs tān pañcame viṣakopajān||64||

div.ab: Sa. pañcame dine tāṃs tān-pūrvoktān, viṣakopajān vikārān vidhatte|
Sa. ṣaṣṭhe dine marmāṇy aśnute|
Sa. saptame divase jīvitaṃ hanti|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
iti tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaṃ, madhyaṃ hīnaṃ ca vibhajed ataḥ||65||

div.ab: Sa. iti-evaṃrūpaṃ, tīkṣṇaṃ viṣam| madhyaṃ hīnaṃ vā'to nirūpya lakṣayet|
ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣaṃ śāmyati sarvathā| -----------------------------------------------|66|
Sa. saṃ-sarvathā ekaviṃśatirātreṇa viṣaṃ śamaṃ yāti|

-----------------------------------------------|
athāśu lūtādaṣṭasya śastreṇādaṃśam uddharet||66||
dahec ca jāmbavauṣṭhādyair na tu pittottaraṃ dahet| -----------------------------------------------|67|
Sa. saṃ-atheti maṅgale| kṛtamaṅgalasya lūtādaṣṭasya, ā-samantāt, daṃśaṃ kṣipraṃ śastreṇoddharet| jāmbvauṣṭhādibhiś ca dahet, pittādhikaṃ varjayitvā|

-----------------------------------------------|
karkaśaṃ bhinnaromāṇaṃ marmasandhyādisaṃśritam||67||
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahen na ca| -----------------------------------------------|68|
Sa. saṃ-karkaśādiguṇaṃ daṃśaṃ daṃśaṃ na chindyāt na ca dahet|

-----------------------------------------------|
lepayed dagdham agadair madhusaindhavasaṃyutaiḥ||68||
suśītaiḥ secayec cānu kaṣāyaiḥ kṣīrivṛkṣajaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|69|
Sa. dagdhaṃ daṃśam agadair mākṣikasaindhavānvitair lepayet| paścāt kṣīrivṛkṣajaiḥ kaṣāyair atiśiśiraiḥ secayec ca|

-----------------------------------------------|
sarvato 'pahared raktaṃ śṛṅgādyaiḥ sirayā'pi vā||69||
sekalepās tataḥ śītā bodhiśleṣmātakākṣakaiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|70|
Sa. sarvato raktaṃ visrāvayec chṛṅgādibhiḥ| anantaraṃ sekālepāś ca śiśirā hitāḥ pippalādibhiḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
phalinīdviniśākṣaudrasarpirbhiḥ padmakāhvayaḥ||70||
aśeṣalūtākīṭānām agadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|71|
Sa. phalinyādiko 'yaṃ padmakasaṃjño 'gadaḥ sārvakārmikaḥ| aśeṣakriyāsu(?) lūtākīṭānāṃ hitaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
haridrādvayapattaṅgamañjiṣṭhānatakesaraiḥ||71||
sakṣaudrasarpiḥ pūrvasmād adhikaś campakāhvayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|72|
Sa. haridrādvayādibhiḥ kṣaudraghṛtānvitaś campakanāmā'gadaḥ pūrvasmād adhikaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
tadvad gomayaniṣpīḍaśarkarāghṛtamākṣikaiḥ||72||

div.ab: Sa. gośakṛnnīṣpīḍādibhir agadas tadvat-pūrvaguṇaḥ|
Sa. apāmārgādibhir agado mandaro nāma| anyaś ca-vakṣyamāṇo natādiḥ(dibhiḥ), gandhamādano nāma|
viṣaghnaṃ bahudoṣeṣu prayuñjīta viśodhanam| -----------------------------------------------|75|
Sa. bahudoṣeṣu nareṣu viṣaghnaṃ viśodhanaṃ prayuñjīta|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
yaṣṭyāhvamadanāṅkollajālinīsinduvārikāḥ||75||

lg.l: kaphe jyeṣṭhāmbunā pītvā viṣam āśu samudvamet|

div.ab: Sa. kaphe yaṣṭyāhvādīni tandulodakena pītvā viṣaṃ kṣipram udvamet| athavā śirīṣapatrādikam aṅkollamūlayutaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pītvodvamet|
virecayec ca triphalānīlinītrivṛtādibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|77|
Sa. triphalādibhir virecayec ca|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
nivṛtte dāhaśophādau karṇikāṃ pātayed vraṇāt||77||

div.ab: Sa. dāhādāv upaśānte sati vraṇāt karṇikāṃ pātayet|

kusumbhapuṣpaṃ godantaḥ svarṇakṣīrī kapotaviṭ|
trivṛtā saindhavaṃ dantī karṇikāpātanaṃ, tathā||78||
mūlam uttaravāruṇyā vaṃśanirlekhasaṃyutam|
tadvac ca saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dantīkaṭukadaugdhikam||79||
rājakośātakīmūlaṃ, kiṇvo vā mathitodbhavaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|80|
Sa. kusumbhakusumādikaṃ dantīparyantaṃ karṇikāyāḥ pātanaṃ varam| uttamāraṇīmūlaṃ vaṃśanirlekhanayuktaṃ vā| saindhavādikaṃ pūrvaguṇam| takrajo vā kiṇvaḥ-upariṣṭāt phenābhaḥ, pūrvaguṇaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
karṇikāpātasamaye bṛṃhayec ca viṣāpahaiḥ||80||

div.ab: Sa. karṇikāpātanakāle ca viṣaghnair bṛṃhayet|

lg.l: viṣasya vṛddhaye tailam agner iva tṛṇolupam||81||

div.ab: Sa. lūtāyām aśeṣaṃ snehane yat kāryaṃ-kartuṃ yogyaṃ, tad ghṛtenaiva kuryāt| yatas tailaṃ viṣasya vṛddhaye, tṛṇolupam iva vahneḥ|

lg.l: agadavarā vṛttasthāḥ kugatīr iva vārayanty ete||85||

div.ab: Sa. hrīberādikam indravajrāvṛttam| rajanyādikaṃ vailālīyaṃ vṛttam| bilvādikaṃ svāgatāvṛttam| ete trayogadavarā vṛttasthāḥ pittaśleṣmānilalūtāḥ kramāt pānādibhiḥ kugatīr iva vārayanti| āryā|

rodhnaṃ sevyaṃ padmakaṃ padmareṇuḥ kālīyākhyaṃ candanaṃ yac ca raktam|
kāntāpuṣpaṃ dugdhinīkā mṛṇālaṃ lūtāḥ sarvā ghnanti sarvakriyābhiḥ|86| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma sapta triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|37|

Sa. rodhrādīni sarvābhiḥ-pānādibhiḥ kriyābhiḥ, sarvā lūtā ghnanti| śālinī| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne kīṭalūtādiviṣapratiṣedho nāma saptatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 37||

div.head: mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. viṣacikitsāprakramāt mūṣikālarkaviṣam upakramate-

ab.seg: athāto mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedhaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre||2||

div.ab: Sa. lālanādibhedena daśāṣṭādhikā ity aṣṭādaśa mūṣikā bhavanti|

lg.l: śukraṃ patati yatraiṣāṃ śukradigdhaiḥ spṛśanti vā|
yad aṅgam aṅgais tatrāsre dūṣite pāṇḍutāṃ gate||3||

div.ab: Sa. eṣāṃ mūṣikāṇāṃ yatra śukraṃ patati, śukradigdhair aṅgair vā yad aṅgaṃ spṛśanti, tasminn aṅge rakte dūṣite pāṇḍutvaṃ yāti sati granthyādayaḥ syuḥ| tathā tatprabhāvāt kaphānugatabahumūṣikapotakavamanaṃ satṛṭ syāt|
vyavāyyākhuviṣaṃ kṛcchraṃ bhūyo bhūyaś ca kupyati| -----------------------------------------------|6|
Sa. ākhuviṣaṃ vyavāyi-sakalaśarīravyāpanaśīlaṃ, tathā kṛcchraṃ-kṛchrasādhyaṃ, punaḥ punaś ca kupyati|

-----------------------------------------------|
mūrcchāṅgaśophavaivarṇyakledaśabdāśrutijvarāḥ||6||
śirogurutvaṃ lālāsṛkchardiś cāsādhyalakṣaṇam| -----------------------------------------------|7|
Sa. mūrcchādayo 'sādhyalakṣaṇam|

-----------------------------------------------|
śūnabastiṃ vivarṇauṣṭham ākhvābhair granthibhiś citam||7||
chucchundarasagandhaṃ ca varjayed ākhudūṣitam| -----------------------------------------------|8|
Sa. śūnabastiṃ vivarṇādharaṃ mūṣikanibhair granthibhir vyāptaṃ chucchundaragandhatulyagandhaṃ ca mūṣikaviṣadūṣitaṃ nopakramet|

-----------------------------------------------|
śunaḥ śleṣmolbaṇāṃ doṣāḥ saṃjñāṃ saṃjñāvahāśritāḥ||8||
muṣṇantaḥ kurvate kṣobhaṃ dhātūnām atidāruṇam|
lālāvān andhabadhiraḥ sarvataḥ so 'bhidhāvati||9||
srustapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiroduḥkhī natānanaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|10|

Sa. śunaḥ-sārameyasya, śleṣmādhikā doṣāḥ saṃjñāvahāni srotāṃsy āśritāḥ saṃjñām apaharanto dhātūnām atighoraṃ kṣobhaṃ kurvanti| saḥ-śvā, lālāyuto 'ndhabadhiro dhvastapucchahanuskandhaḥ śiro duḥkhī natamukhaḥ sarvato dhāvati|

-----------------------------------------------|
daṃśas tena vidaṣṭasya suptaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kṣaraty asṛk||10||
hṛcchirorugjvarastambhatṛṣṇāmūrcchādbhavo 'nu ca| -----------------------------------------------|11|
Sa. tena-śunā, vidaṣṭasya daṃśaḥ suptaḥ-acetanaḥ, kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ sravati| paścād hṛtpīḍādyudbhūtiḥ syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
anenānye 'pi boddhavyā vyālā daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ||11||
śṛgālāśvatarāśvarkṣadvīpivyāghravṛkādayaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. anena-daṃśādisvarūpeṇa, apare vyālāḥ-duṣṭāḥ, daṃṣṭrāprahāriṇaḥ śṛgālādaya evaṃ vedyāḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
kaṇḍūnistodavaivarṇyasuptikledajvarabhramāḥ||12||
viḍaharāgarukpākaśophagranthivikuñcanam|
daṃśāvadaraṇaṃ sphoṭāḥ karṇikā maṇḍalāni ca||13||
sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ, viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe| -----------------------------------------------|14|
Sa. sarvatraiva saviṣe daṃśe kaṇḍvādayo liṅgam| nirviṣe ca daṃśe 'to viparītaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan vinaśyati||14||
paśyaṃs tam eva cākasmād ādarśasalilādiṣu| -----------------------------------------------|15|
Sa. yena prāṇinā daṣṭas tacceṣṭārutaṃ kurvan mriyate| tam eva daṣṭāraṃ, ādarśakādiṣu sahasā paśyan vinaśyati|

-----------------------------------------------|
yo 'dbhyas trasyed adaṣṭo 'pi śabdasaṃsparśadarśanaiḥ||15||
jalasantrāsanāmānaṃ daṣṭaṃ tam api varjayet| -----------------------------------------------|16|
Sa. yo jalebhyo 'daṣṭo 'pi santrasyet śabdasaṃsparśadarśanair hetubhiḥ, taṃ jalasantrāsasaṃjñaṃ daṣṭaṃ varjayet|

-----------------------------------------------|
ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet||16||
darpaṇonāthavā, tīvrarujā syāt karṇikā'nyathā| -----------------------------------------------|17|
Sa. ākhunā daṣṭamātrasya narasya sato daṃśaṃ kāṇḍena dāhayet| darpaṇena vā dāhayet| anyathā-evam adagdhe sati, karṇikā dāruṇapīḍā syāt|

-----------------------------------------------|
dagdhaṃ visrāvayed daṃśaṃ pracchitaṃ ca pralepayet||17||
śirīṣarajanīvakrakuṅkumāmṛtavallibhiḥ| -----------------------------------------------|18|
Sa. daṃśaṃ dagdhaṃ pracchitaṃ visrāvayet| śirīṣabījādibhiḥ pralepayec ca|

-----------------------------------------------|
agāradhūmamañjiṣṭhārajanīlavaṇottamaiḥ||18||
lepo jayaty ākhuviṣaṃ karṇikāyāś ca pātanaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|19|
Sa. agāradhūmādiko lepo hy ayaṃ mūṣikaviṣaṃ hanti| karṇikāṃ ca pātayati|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
tato 'mlaiḥ kṣālayitvā'nu toyair anu ca lepayet||19||

lg.l: anyaiś ca viṣaśophaghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayed drutam||20||

div.ab: Sa. anantaram amlaiḥ kṣālayitvā'nu jalaiḥ kṣālayet| paścāt pālindyādibhir aparaiś ca viṣaghnaiḥ śvayathughnaiś ca lepayet| athavā śīghraṃ sirāṃ vyadhayet| pālindī-mālavikā trivṛt|
chardanaṃ nīlinīkvāthaiḥ śukākhyāṅkollayor api| -----------------------------------------------|21|
Sa. nīlinīkvāthena chardanaṃ kāryam| śukākhyāṅkollayoś ca kvāthena vamanam| śukākhyaḥ-śirīṣaḥ|

-----------------------------------------------|
kośātakyāḥ śukākhyāyāḥ phalaṃ jīmūtakasya ca||21||
madanasya ca sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet| -----------------------------------------------|22|
Sa. kośātakyādīnāṃ phalāni sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
vacāmadanajīmūtakuṣṭhaṃ va mūtrapeṣitam||22||

div.ab: Sa. vacādiṃ vā gomūtreṇa sañcūrṇya pūrvakalpena-dadhnā, pītvā sarvonduraviṣaṃ hanti| virecanaṃ trivṛtādikalka iṣyate|
śirovirecane sāraḥ śirīṣasya phalāni ca| -----------------------------------------------|24|
Sa. śirovirecane śirīṣasya sāraḥ phalaṃ ca yojyam|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
añjanaṃ gomayaraso vyoṣasūkṣmarajonvitaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. gomayarasaś cūrṇīkṛtas trikaṭukānvito 'ñjanam|
kapitthatomayaraso madhumānavalehanam| -----------------------------------------------|25|
Sa. kapitthagomayarasaḥ samākṣiko 'valehanam|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
tandulīyakamūlena siddhaṃ pāne hitaṃ ghṛtam||25||

div.ab: Sa. tandulīyakamūlena pakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāne hitam| dviniśādibhir vā sādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāne hitam| athavā'rkamūlena siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāne hitam| athavā pañcakāpitthasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pāne hitam| kapitthasyemāni kāpitthāni,-mūlatvakpatrapuṣpaphalāni pañca, pañca ca tāni kāpitthāni ca, taiḥ siddhaṃ pañcakāpittham|

sinduvāraṃ nataṃ śigrubilvamūlaṃ punarnavā|
vacāśvadaṃṣṭrājīmūtam eṣāṃ kvāthaṃ samākṣikam||27||
pibec chālyodanaṃ dadhnā bhuñjāno mūṣikārditaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. sinduvārādīnāṃ kvāthaṃ samākṣikaṃ pibet| mūṣikaviṣapīḍito dadhnā śālyodanaṃ bhuñjānaḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya vā pibet||28||

div.ab: Sa. athavā śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ sañcūrṇya mathitena pibet|
Sa. aṅkolamūlakalko vā chāgamūtreṇa piṣṭaḥ pānalepanayor yuktaḥ sarvākhuviṣahā|

lg.l: gavāṃ mūtreṇa, payasā mañjarīṃ tilakasya vā||30||

div.ab: Sa. kapitthabījādikaṃ gomūtreṇa pibet| kṣīreṇa vā tilakamañjarīṃ pibet|
athavā sairyakān mūlaṃ sakṣaudraṃ tandulāmbunā| -----------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. sairyakamūlaṃ vā samākṣikaṃ jyeṣṭhāmbhasā pibet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kaṭukālābuvinyastaṃ pītaṃ vā'mbu niśoṣitam||31||

div.ab: Sa. athavā kaṭukālābuni jalaṃ nikṣiptaṃ rātristhitaṃ pītaṃ mūṣikaviṣanāśanaṃ syāt|
Sa. sinduvāramūlādiko jalapiṣṭo 'gado nasyādyair mūṣikaviṣaṃ hanti|
Sa. mūṣikaviṣaṃ kiñcic cheṣaṃ jaladonnatau kupyati| athavā vātādīnāṃ yathāsvaṃ kāleṣu vṛddhikāraṇeṣu prakupyati|

lg.l: tatra sarve yathāvasthaṃ prayojyāḥ syur upakramāḥ|
yathāsvaṃ ye ca nirdiṣṭās tathā dūṣīviṣāpahāḥ||34||

div.ab: Sa. tatrāvasthāvaśād upakramāḥ sarve yathāyogaṃ prayojyāḥ syuḥ| ye ca dūṣīviṣaghnāḥ nirdiṣṭās te ca prayojyāḥ

lg.l: daṃśaṃ tv alarkadaṣṭasya dagdham uṣṇena sarpiṣā|
pradihyād agadais tais taiḥ purāṇaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ pibet||35||

div.ab: Sa. alarkadaṣṭasya daṃśam uṣṇena ghṛtena dagdham agadais tais taiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, lepayet| purāṇaṃ ca sarpiḥ pibet|
arkakṣīrayutaṃ cāsya yojyam āśu virecanam| -----------------------------------------------|36|
Sa. arkakṣīrānvitaṃ cāsya virecanaṃ kṣipraṃ yojyam|

-----------------------------------------------|
aṅkollottaramūlāmbu tripalaṃ sahaviḥpalam||36||
pibet sadhattūraphalāṃ śvetāṃ vā'pi punarnavām| -----------------------------------------------|37|
Sa. aṅkollottaramūlajalaṃ palatrayamātraṃ saghṛtapalaṃ pibet| dhattūraphalayutāṃ śvetāṃ vā punarnavāṃ jalena pibet|

-----------------------------------------------|
aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ||37||
bhinatti viṣam ālarkaṃ ghanavṛndam ivānilaḥ| -----------------------------------------------|38|
Sa. bhṛṣṭatilacūrṇaṃ, tailaṃ, rūṣikāyāḥ-arkasya kṣīraṃ, guḍaḥ, ekatra miśritaṃ prakṛtatvāj jalena pītaṃ viṣam alarkaṃ bhinatti| payodaugham iva vāyuḥ|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
samantraṃ sauṣadhīratnaṃ snapanaṃ ca prayojayet||38||

div.ab:
Sa. mantrānvitam auṣadhīratnayutaṃ snapanaṃ ca kārayet|
["aṣṭottaraśataṃ vārān siddhamantrābhimantritaiḥ|
aṣṭottaraśatonmānaiḥ puṣpamālāvaguṇṭhitaiḥ||
gocarmamātrake lipte jvalite 'gnau kuśāstṛte|
sthaṇḍile saritas tīre snānaṃ vā'sya catuṣpathe||
alarkādhipate yakṣa sārameyagaṇādhipa|
alarkajuṣṭam etan me nirviṣaṃ kuru mā cirāt|| svāheti mantro 'larkārte sarvakarmasu śasyate|" iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt (saṃ.u. a. 46)|]
Sa. catuṣpādbhiḥ-dantyaśvaprabhṛtibhiḥ prāṇibhiḥ, dvipādbhiḥ-manuṣyamayūrakukkuṭādibhiḥ, vā nakhaparikṣataṃ dantaparikṣataṃ ca śūyate pacyate ca rāgādyanvitam|

somavalko 'śvakarṇaś ca gojihvā haṃsapādikā|
rajanyau gairikaṃ lepo nakhadantaviṣāpahaḥ|40| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|38|

Sa. khadirādibhir lepo nakhadantaviṣaghnaḥ iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne mūṣikālarkaviṣapratiṣedho nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 38|| iti viṣatantraṃ nāma ṣaṣṭam aṅgaṃ samāptam

div.head: rasāyanavidhir adhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: adhunā pūrvoktahetusambandhaṃ rasāyanādhyāyaṃ jigadiṣur āha ---- athāto rasāyanavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

lg.l: dīrgham āyuḥ smṛtiṃ medhām ārogyaṃ taruṇaṃ vayaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. dīrghāyuḥprabhṛtīn rasāyanād adhigacchati| kasmād etāni rasāyanāl labhyante? ity āha-lābhopāya iti| yasmāt śreṣṭhānāṃ rasarudhirādīnāṃ yo lābhopāyaḥ, sa rasāyanam ucyate|

lg.l: pūrve vayasi madhye vā tat prayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. tat-rasāyanaṃ, jitātmanaḥ puruṣasyādye vayasi-atibālyātikrāntamātre, athavā madhyame vayasi prayojyam| kīdṛśasya puṃsaḥ ? snigdhety ādi| snigdhādiguṇayuktasya, tathā sarvathā adha upariṣṭāc ca śuddhasya|

lg.l: aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto rāsāyano vidhiḥ|
vājīkaro vā maline vastre raṅga ivāphalaḥ||4||

div.ab: Sa. yasmād aviśuddhe śarīre rāsāyano vidhir upayukto vājīkaro vopayukto niṣphalaḥ syāt| yathā maline vastre raṅgaḥ| malinaṃ hi vastraṃ na rajyate|
Sa. munayo rasāyanānāṃ prayogaṃ dviprakāraṃ jānanti| tatra mukhyaṃ kuṭīpraveśanirvṛttam| vātātapikam anyathā-amukhyam ity arthaḥ|

lg.l: diśy udīcyāṃ śubhe deśe trigarbhāṃ sūkṣmalocanām||6||

div.ab: Sa. kva tat kurvīta ? pure, prāpyopakaraṇīye, harmyaṃ-dhavalagṛhaṃ, nivātaṃ nirbhayaṃ ca yasmin tasmin, tathodīcyāṃ diśi, śubhe-durbhikṣamarakādirahite, kuṭīṃ trigarbhāṃ kārayet| prathamam ekaṃ gṛham, tasyābhyantare dvitīyam, tasyābhyantare tṛtīyam, evaṃ trigarbhā| trayo garbhāḥ-antarāṇi, yasyā iti kṛtvā| tathā sūkṣmagavākṣām| tathā dhūmādibhir aviliṅghitāṃ-anākrāntām| tathā praguṇāni vaidyopakaraṇāni-bheṣajādīni, yasyāṃ tāṃ tathāvidhām| sumṛṣṭāṃ-upalepanādikaraṇena śuddhām|

lg.l: atha puṇye 'hni sampūjya pūjyāṃs tāṃ praviśec chuciḥ|
tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ||8||

div.ab: Sa. atha-kṛtamaṅgalaḥ, śubhe divase śuciḥ pūjyān-gurumitrādīn, sampūjya tāṃ-pūrvopavarṇitāṃ kuṭīṃ, praviśet| tasyāṃ kuṭyāṃ kṛtasanniveśaḥ saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ| sukhī-arogaḥ| etac ca bāhulyenoktam| śilājatucyavanaprāśādīnāṃ vyādhiṣv apy anujñātatvāt| tathā ca vakṣayati (ślo.142)-"na so 'sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya|" iti| tathā (ślo.39)-"ity eṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ| jarjarito 'py āsīn nārīnayananandanaḥ|| kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ kṣayaṃ śophaṃ vaisvaryaṃ ca vyapohati||" iti| punarjātabalaṃ iti prakṛtibalena yo balavān nāsīt tasya saṃśodhanena balahīnatvena punarjātabalo bṛṃhaṇāhārādinā yadā, sa tadā rasāyanam ārabhetety arthaḥ| asañjātabalo hy utkṛṣṭavīryāṇāṃ rasāyanānāṃ vīryaṃ soḍhuṃ na kṣamata iti punarjātabala ity uktam| brahmacārīty uktaṃ nivṛttastrīsaṅgaparam| tathā jātasantoṣaḥ| śraddhālur alolupaś ca| tathā dānarataḥ dayāditatparaḥ| tathā devatābhaktaḥ| yuktau svapnaprajāgarau yasya sa evam| tathā bheṣajānurāgavān madhuravacanaḥ|

harītakīm āmalakaṃ saindhavaṃ nāgaraṃ vacām|
haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet||11||
snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ, tena sādhu viricyate| -----------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. harītakyādikaṃ yogam uṣṇajalena prāk snigdhasvinno naraḥ pibet| tena yogena samyag viricyate|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
tataḥ śuddhaśarīrāya kṛtasaṃsarjanāya ca||12||

lg.l: trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam|

div.ab: Sa. anantaraṃ, śuddhadehāya kṛtapeyādikakramāya ca trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā sarpiryutaṃ yāvakaṃ dadyāt| athavā purāṇaśakṛtaḥ śuddhiṃ yāvat tāvad yāvakaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ dadyāt| trividhamalāpekṣayā trividhaṃ parijñānam,-hīnapurīṣasya trirātram, madhyapurīṣasya pañcarātram, utkṛṣṭapurīṣasya saptarātram iti| tathā hi [madhya]bahuvarcaskasya pañcarātreṇa saptarātreṇa vā malaḥ śuddhyati, alpamalasya trirātreṇaiva, iti trividhaṃ parijñānaṃ yuktam| bahutaramalasya bahutarair evāhobhiḥ śuddhiḥ syād ity uktavān'āśuddheḥ purāṇaśakṛto 'thavā' iti|

lg.l: yasya yad yaugikaṃ paśyet sarvam ālocya sātmyavit||14||

div.ab:
Sa. evaṃ saṃskṛtakoṣṭhasya narasya yasya yad rasāyanaṃ yaugikam upalabhyate, sātmyajño bhiṣak sarvam ālocya tasya tad rasāyanam upāharet|
["haraṇāt sarvatogāṇaṃ yā'sāv uktā harītakī|
pathyatvāt sarvadhātūnāṃ pathyā, śivatayā śivā||
yasmād vijayate vyādhīn samagrān vijayā tataḥ|
abhayaṃ sarvarogebhyo bhavaty āyuś ca śāśvatam||
yataḥ śīlayatām enāṃ teneyam abhayā smṛtā|
navā vṛttā ghanā snigdhā gurvī majjati cāpsu yā||
bālasya sā prayoktavyā navanītasamanvitā|
vāte sasarpirlavaṇā pitte saguḍaśarkarā|| kaphe sapippalīkṣaudrā sarvadā sā praśasyate|" iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt (saṃ.u. a. 49)|]

lg.l: dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tad agnau lehatāṃ gatam||19||
avatīrṇaṃ himaṃ yuñjyād viṃśaiḥ kṣaudraśatais tribhiḥ|
yā noparundhyād āhāram ekaṃ mātrā'sya sā smṛtā|
ṣaṣṭikaḥ payasa cātra jīrṇe bhojanam iṣyate||21||
brahmaṇā vihitaṃ dhanyam idaṃ praśya rasāyanam||22||

div.ab:
Sa. abhayānāṃ sahasram āmalakasahasratritayayutam| tathā pañcānāṃ pañcamūlānāṃ palaśatadvayaṃ sārdhaṃ salile daśaguṇe paktvā daśāṃśasthite rasa āpothya-mṛditvā, harītakyāmalakāni vyasthīni kṛtvā tasmin kvāthe prakṣipya kuḍavapramāṇaṃ tvagelādikaṃ cūrṇitaṃ yojayet| kanakaṃ-nāgakesaram| vyasthīnīti "napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena" ity ekaśeṣaḥ| palaśatenādhikaṃ śarkarāyā ardhabhāram, ghṛtasya trīṇy āḍhakāni, dve cāḍhake tailāt, tat sarvaṃ vahnau pacet| tac ca lehatāṃ gatam avatīrṇaṃ śītaṃ kṣaudraśatais tribhir viṃśatyadhikair yuñjīta| viṃśair iti 'viṃśateḥ pūraṇe' iti pūraṇe 'rthe ḍibhiḥ| 'viṃśater ḍit' iti ṭilope viṃśaśabdaḥ| anantaraṃ khajenāloḍitaṃ ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidadhyāt| yā-mātrā, ekam āhāraṃ-sāyaṃtanaṃ, noparundhyāt sā'sya rasāyanasya mātrā smṛtā| āhāram ekam iti vacanāc ca prathamāhārakālasya rasāyanamātrayā'vaśyam uparodhaḥ kārya iti vedayati| asmiṃś ca lehe jīrṇe ṣaṣṭikaḥ kṣīreṇa saha bhojanam iṣṭam| vaikhānasādayo brahmaṇā nirmitam etad upayujya rasāyanaṃ tandrādivarjitā medhādiyutā amitajīvitāś cābhūvan| dhanyam iti dhanāya hitam| nanu, rasāyanasya dhanārjanopāyatvābhāvāt kathaṃ dhanyatvam ? atra brūmaḥ| kārye kāraṇopacārād evam uktam| tathā hi rasāyanam idam āmayaghnatvād ārogye ca sati medhāsmṛtyāyuktasya dhanāyodyamaṃ kurvato 'vaśyaṃ dhanasampa[mprā]ttir iti yuktam eva| nanu, āmayavarjaitā ity anenaivoktārthatvāt tandrādigrahaṇam avācyam eva| atrācakṣamahe| āmayavarjite svāsthyānuvṛttikaraṇasāmarthyam asya rasāyanasyāvādīt tantrakṛt| tandrādigrahaṇaṃ ca roganāśe 'py asya jyāyastvam iti pratipādanārtham| ["abhayāmalakabibhītakapañcātmakapañcamūlaniryūhe| vallīpalāśakarase dviguṇe kṣīre 'ṣṭaguṇe ca vipaceta||
ghṛtasya kumbhaṃ madhukaṃ madhūkaṃ kākoliyugmaṃ ca balāṃ svaguptām|
sakṣīraśuklām ṛṣabhaṃ sajīvaṃ sukhāmbupas tac ca pibed guṇāḍhyam|| (sam. u. a. 49)"]

lg.l: tad ghṛtakumbhe bhūmau nidhāya ṣaṇmāsasaṃstham uddhṛtya|
prāhṇe prāśya yathānalam ucitāhāro bhavet satatam||26||

ab.seg: ity upayuñjyāśeṣaṃ varṣaśatam anāmayo jarārahitaḥ| jīvati balapuṣṭivapuḥsmṛtimedhādyanvito viśeṣeṇa||27||

div.ab: Sa. abhayāmalakānāṃ sahasraṃ dṛḍhaṃ kaṇāsahasrānvitam ajīrṇapalāśakṣāradravīkṛtaṃ bhājane sthāpayet| kṣāre copayukte sati chāyāyāṃ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇitaṃ ca śarkarāyāś caturthāṃśena caturguṇābhyāṃ ghṛtamākṣīkābhyāṃ yojyam| etad ghṛtakumbhe nidhāya bhūmau ṣaṇmāsasthitaṃ samuddhṛtya pūrvāhṇe yathāgni bhuktvā sātmyāhāraḥ sadā syāt| tisra āryāḥ| evam etat sarvam upayujya saṃvatsaraśataṃ nīrogo jarārahito jīvati| viśeṣeṇa balādiyutaḥ| gītir āryā|

lg.l: ādīpya gomayair vanyair nirvāte svedayet tataḥ||29||
svinnāni tāny āmalakāni tṛptyā khaden naraḥ kṣaudraghṛtānvitāni|
kṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ cānu pibet prakāmaṃ tenaiva varteta ca māsam ekam||30||
varjyāni varjyāni ca tatra yatnāt spṛśyaṃ ca śītāmbu na pāṇinā'pi|
ekādaśāhe 'sya tato vyatīte patanti keśā daśanā nakhāś ca||31||
athālpakair eva dinaiḥ surūpaḥ strīṣv akṣayaḥ kuñjaratulyavīryaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. nīrujo-jantvādibhir anupadruto, yaḥ palāśas tasya śirasi chinne 'ntardvihastamātraṃ tat kṣataṃ-suṣirīkṛtaṃ, gambhīraṃ navair āmalakaiḥ pūraṇīyam| pūrṇaṃ yāvad darbhair veṣṭitaṃ padminīkardamena lepitaṃ tata āraṇyair gomayair ādīpya nivāte svedayet| tāni cāmalakāni svinnāni kṣaudraghṛtayutāni tṛptyā puruṣaḥ khādet| paścād dugdhaṃ kvathitaṃ bahu pibet| tenaiva ca dugdhena māsam ekaṃ varteta| indravajrā| rasāyanavidhau yāny uktāni kṣārādīni varjyāni tāni parihartavyāni yatnena| hastenāpi śiśiraṃ jalaṃ na sparśayitavyam| tato 'sya rasāyanavidhātur ekādaśe 'hni vyatikrānte keśādayaḥ patanti| tato 'lpakair eva dinai rūpavāṃs taruṇīviṣaya akṣayaśaktir gajasamānasāmarthya utkṛṣṭamedhādir asau bhavati| varṣasahasrajīvī ca| upajātī vṛtte|

lg.l: parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭiḥ||33||
jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī|
pādaśeṣaṃ rasaṃ tasmād vyasthīny āmalakāni ca|
snehārdhaṃ madhu siddhe tu tavakṣīryāś catuṣpalam||37||
ity eṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ prāśya cyavano muniḥ|
kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam|

ab.seg:
bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇakṛśānām aṅgavardhanaḥ| medhāṃ smṛtiṃ kāntim anāmatva- māyuḥprakarṣaṃ pavanānulomyam|
strīṣu praharṣaṃ balam indriyāṇā- magneś ca kuryād vidhinopayuktaḥ||41||

div.ab: Sa. daśamūlādikaṃ palonmitam aikadhyaṃ toyadroṇa āmalakaśatāni pañca pacet| tasmāc caturthāśaṃ rasaṃ vigatāsthīni cāmalakāny ādāya tailaghṛtayoḥ pratyekaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ palair bharjayet| śarkarātulārdhenānvitaṃ tad etat sarvaṃ leham iva pacet| snehasyārdhaṃ pakve śīte madhu tathā tavakṣīrīcatuṣpalaṃ kaṇādvipalaṃ kaṇārdhena caturjātaṃ ca dadyāt| ato-lehāt, mātrāṃ kuṭīsthitaḥ pathyāny aśnann ava lehayet| iti-evaṃ prakāraḥ, ayaṃ cyavanaprāśākhyo lehaḥ| yaṃ lehaṃ, prāśya cyavanasaṃjño munir jarākrānto 'pi taruṇīlocanarañjana asīt| ayaṃ lehaḥ kāsādīn vyapohati| "upasargād asyatyūhyor vā vacanam (rveti vācyam)" iti taṅ| bālādīnām aṅgavṛddhikṛt| medhādīṃś ca vidadhyāt vidhinā rasāyanoktenopayukto 'yam| indravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: sitayā vā samā yuktā samāyuktā rasāyanam|

div.ab: Sa. madhukena samā-tulyā, yuktā triphalā tathā samaiḥ sarvaiḥ, yuktā-upayuktā, rasāyanaṃ sarvarogaghnī medhādidā ca syāt| tavakṣīryādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ triphalāṅgatvena rasāyanāni nirupyāṇi| sindhujanmanā-saindhavena, lohāḥ-rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ sīsaṃ trapu aya iti pañca, taiḥ suvarṇena ca, pṛthag yuktā varā rasāyanam iti yojyam| madhusarpiṣety ekavacananirdeśād dvābhyām api yugapad yoga ekaṃ rasāyanaṃ vedyam|

lg.l: maṇḍūkaparṇyāḥ svarasaṃ yathāgni kṣīreṇa yaṣṭīmadhukasya cūrṇam|
rasaṃ guḍūcyāḥ sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ||44||
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī||45||

div.ab: Sa. maṇḍūkaparṇīsvarasaṃ prayuñjīta, agnibalāpekṣayā| dugdhena madhuyaṣṭīcūrṇaṃ yuñjīta| tathā guḍūcyā rasaṃ prayuñjīta| tathā saha mūlapuṣpābhyāṃ vartate sahamūlapuṣpī, tasyāḥ śaṅkhapuṣpyāś ca kalkaṃ prayuñjīta| ity etāni rasāyanāny āyuṣpradāni rogaghnāni balādi vardhanāni medhāyai hitāni ca| atiśayena śaṅkhapuṣpī medhyā| upajātī vṛtte|

lg.l: triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ||46||
triguṇena rasena śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ vipakvam|
upayujya bhavej jaḍo 'pi vāgmī śrutadhārī pratibhānavān arogaḥ||47||

div.ab: Sa. naladādibhiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇāt triguṇena śaṅkhapuṣpīrasena ghṛtasyāḍhakaṃ(sya droṇaṃ) kṣīrasahitaṃ vipakvaṃ praśya jaḍo 'pi naro vāgmī śrutadharaḥ sapratibho nirāmayaś ca syāt| aupacchandasike vṛtte|

lg.l: paiṣyair mṛṇālabisakesarapatrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca sarpiḥ|
pañcāravindam iti tat prathitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prabhraṣṭapauruṣabalapratibhair niṣevyam||48||

div.ab: Sa. mṛṇālādibhiḥ kalkaiḥ suvarṇaśakalānvitaṃ haiyaṃgavīnaṃ sakṣīraṃ pakvaṃ pañcāravindam iti pañcāravindāni yasminn iti samāsaḥ, evam agre 'pi kāryaḥ| etad ghṛtaṃ naṣṭaśukrādibhir niṣevitavyam, etanniṣevaṇe naitāne syur ity arthaḥ|

lg.l: yan nālakandadalakesaravad vipakvaṃ nīlotpalasya tad api prathitaṃ dvitīyam|
sarpiś catuṣkuvalayaṃ sahariṇyapatraṃ medhyaṃ gavām api bhavet kimu mānuṣāṇām||49||

div.ab: Sa. yad ghṛtaṃ nīlotpalasya nālādimat kāñcanaśakalānvitaṃ sakṣīraṃ vipakvaṃ tad api catuṣkuvalayaṃ prasiddham| gavām api jaḍānām api, etan medhyam| kiṃ punar mānuṣāṇām ? teṣāṃ samedhānām atiśayenety arthaḥ| vasantatilake vṛtte|

lg.l: vaidehikā ca triyavāḥ pṛthak syu- ryavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya||50||
sarpiṣaś ca palam ekata eta- dyojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyam|
bhojanaṃ samadhu vatsaram evaṃ śīlayann adhikadhīsmṛtimedhaḥ||51||

ab.seg:
viśeṣataḥ kuṣṭhakilāsagulma viṣajavaronmādagarodarāṇi|
atharvamantrādikṛtāś ca kṛtyāḥ śāmyanty anenātibalāś ca vātāḥ||53||

div.ab: Sa. brāmhyādayas triyavapramāṇāḥ pṛthak syuḥ| matsyākṣakaḥ pattūraḥ| suvarṇasya yavau dbau| tila eko viṣasya| ghṛtasya ca palam| etad ekato yojayet| jīrṇe cāsmin bheṣaje bahughṛtaṃ bhojanaṃ samākṣikaṃ yojayet| evaṃ varṣaṃ śīlayan vipulabuddhyādikaḥ syāt| upajātisvāgate vṛtte| jarādirahitaḥ pūrṇalakṣyādiko varṣaśataṃ jīvati| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhādayo 'nena śāmyanti, atibalā vātāś ca| upajātiḥ|

lg.l: akṣamātraṃ tato mūlāc cūrṇitāt payasā pibet||54||

div.ab: Sa. śaradādau puṣyanakṣatre nāgabalāmūlaṃ samuddharet| tasmān mūlāc cūrṇitād akṣamātraṃ-karṣamātraṃ, dugdhena pibet, mākṣikājyābhyāṃ vā lihyāt, kṣīravartano 'nannāśī| evaṃ varṣaprayogeṇa balavān san varṣaśataṃ jīvet|

ab.seg: phalonmukho gokṣurakaḥ samūla- śchāyāviśuṣkaḥ suvicūrṇitāṅgaḥ| subhavitaḥ svena rasena tasmā- nmātrāṃ parāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ pived yaḥ||56||

lg.l: kṣīreṇa tenaiva ca śālim aśnan jīrṇe bhavet sa dvitulopayogāt|
śaktaḥ surūpaḥ subhagaḥ śatāyuḥ kāmī kukudmān iva gokulasthaḥ||57||

div.ab: Sa. gokṣurakaḥ phalābhimukho mūlayutaś chāyāviśuṣkaḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇitaḥ svarasena subhābitaḥ| tasmāt-gokṣurakāt, mātrāṃ prāsṛtikīṃ parāṃ yaḥ kṣīreṇa pibet, pariṇate tasmin dugdhenaiva ca śālīn bhakṣayet, sa puruṣaḥ palaśatadvayopayogāt śaktyādiguṇaḥ syāt| upajātīndravajrāvṛtte|

lg.l: māsaṃ niranno māsaṃ ca kṣīrānnādo jarāṃ jayet||58||
ghṛtakṣaudraplutaṃ lihyāt tatpakvaṃ vā ghṛtaṃ pibet||59||

div.ab: Sa. vārāhyāḥ-vṛddhadārakasya, mūlam atyārdraṃ dugdhena māsaṃ pibet| jīrṇe 'pi kṣīrapo nirannaḥ syāt| aparaṃ ca māsaṃ kṣīrānnāśī san jarāṃ jayati| saṃ-tasyāḥ-vārāhyāḥ, mūlaṃ ślakṣṇacūrṇaṃ vā svarasena suṣṭhu bhāvitaṃ ghṛtamākṣikāplutaṃ lihyāt| tena vā mūlakalkena pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet pūrvaguṇam|
Sa. vidāryādīṃś ca pṛthak pṛthak tadvat-vṛddhadārakavat sarpirdugdha(rmadhu)yutān, medhādyāvahān upayuñjīta| tataś copayuktā vayaḥsthairyādipradāḥ syuḥ|

lg.l: yathottaraṃ sa guṇavān vidhinā ca rasāyanam||62||
chāyāśuṣkaṃ tato mūlaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ lihan|
sarpiṣā madhusarpirbhyāṃ piban vā payasā yatiḥ||63||
ambhasā vā hitānnāśī śataṃ jīvati nīrujaḥ|
tailena līḍho māsena vātān hanti sudustarān|

div.ab: Sa. citrako yathāyogaṃ puṣpaiḥ pītaiḥ śuklaiḥ kṛṣṇaiś ca yathottaraṃ guṇavān veditavyaḥ| vidhinā ca prayukto rasāyanaṃ syāt| saṃ-tasmāc citrakāt mūlaṃ chāyāśuṣkaṃ māsaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ ghṛtena madhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt| payasā vā brahmacārī pibet| pānīyena vā hitānnabhojanaḥ san pibet| sukhī medhāvān balavān ramaṇīyo vapuṣmān dīptāgniḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati| saṃ-tailena līḍhaś citrako māsena dāruṇān vātān jayati| gomūtreṇa pītaḥ śvitrakuṣṭhāni hanti| takreṇa pīto 'rśāṃsi jayet|

lg.l: saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat trīṇi trīṇi tataḥ param||68||

div.ab: Sa. bhallātakāni suniṣpannāni grīṣme saṃgṛhya dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet| hemante madhurasnigdhaśītalaiḥ saṃskṛtaśarīras tāny aṣṭāv aṣṭaguṇe jale kvāthayet| tatkvātham aṣṭāṃśaśeṣaṃ kṣīrasahitaṃ śītaṃ pibet| paścāt tasmin pratidinaṃ caikaikaṃ bhallātakaṃ vardhayet-adhikīkṛtya kvāthayed ity arthaḥ| saptarātratrayaṃ yāvat| saptarātratrayāt paratas trīṇi trīṇy aruṣkarāṇi catvāriṃśataṃ yāvad vardhayet| anantaraṃ tāni-aruṣkarāṇi, vṛddhivad dhrāsayet| iti-evaṃ, saptabhiḥ saptāhaiḥ sahasram upayuñjīta| yantritātmā puruṣo ghṛtakṣīraśāliṣaṣṭikabhojanaḥ| tathaiva ca bhallātakaprayogānta ekaviṃśatisaptāhān ghṛtakṣīraśāliṣaṣṭikabhojanaṃ kuryāt| evaṃ kṛtabhallātakaprayogo 'pūrvāḥ-abhilaṣitā dayitāḥ, āśiṣo labhate, tathā viśeṣeṇa vahnipāṭavam| pramehādivarjitaś ca syāt|

lg.l: parivāritaṃ samantāt pacet tato gomayāgninā mṛdunā|
tatsvaraso yaś cyavate gṛhṇīyāt taṃ dine 'nyasmin||73||
pūrvavidhiyantritātmā prāpnoti guṇān sa tān eva||74||

div.ab: Sa. piṣṭaṃ śālicūrṇaṃ svedyate 'sminn iti piṣṭasvedanaṃ,- bhāṇḍam| tad arujaiḥ-dṛḍhaiḥ, bhallātakais tathā vijarjaritaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sat kṛtacchidraṃ bhūminikhāte kumbhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ kṛṣṇamṛttikayā liptam anantaraṃ gomayāgninā mṛdunā parivāritaṃ pacet| tatsvaraso yas tatra dharānikhāte kumbhe patet, tam anyasminn ahani gṛhṇīyāt| amuṃ-pūrvoktaṃ, svarasaṃ mākṣikāṣṭamabhāgaṃ dviguṇaghṛtaṃ pūrvavidhinā yantritātmā sann upayujya, tān eva-pūrvoktān, guṇān prāpnoti| āryās tisraḥ, madhyamā'tra mukhacapalā|

lg.l: ghṛṣṭveṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair jalena prakṣālya saṃśoṣya ca mārutena||75||
tadrasaṃ punar api śrapayeta kṣīrakumbhasahitaṃ caraṇasthe||76||
sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tatra tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarāyā rajobhiḥ|
ekībhūtaṃ tat khajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ suguptam||77||
tam amṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ prage prāśam aśnan anu pibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā|
smṛtimatibalamedhāsattvasārair upetaḥ kanakanicayagauraḥ so 'śnute dīrgham āyuḥ||78||

div.ab: Sa. suniṣpannāni bhallātakāni pākena paricyutāny āḍhakasammitāni iṣṭikācūrṇakaṇair ghṛṣṭāni jalena prakṣālya, mārutena saṃśoṣya-na tv ātape, tato jarjarāṇi jaladroṇe vipacet| pādaśeṣadhṛtagālitaṃ śītaṃ ca tadrasaṃ punar api kṣīradroṇasahitaṃ pacet| [tatra-] tasmin pādaśeṣasthe, tulyapramāṇaṃ sarpiḥ pakvaṃ śarkarācūrṇena yutaṃ yathecchaṃ prakṛtyādivaśād yuñjīta| tac ca khajaloḍanenaikībhūtaṃ dhānyamadhye saptarātraṃ suguptaṃ sthāpyam| indravajrāsvāgatāśālinyo vṛttāni| tam amṛtarasatulyapākaṃ yaḥ pūrvāhṇe prāśaṃ-lehaṃ, bhakṣayan paścād yatheṣṭaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ māṃsarasaṃ vā pibati, sa smṛtyādiyutaḥ suvarṇaughagauro dīrgham āyuḥ prāpnoti| mālinī|

lg.l: droṇe 'ṃbhaso vraṇakṛtāṃ triśatād vipakvāt kvāthāḍhake palasamais tilatailapātram|

div.ab: Sa. jaladroṇe vraṇakṛtāṃ bhallātakānāṃ śatatrayād vipakvāt kvāthasyāḍhake 'vaśiṣṭe tilatailāḍhakaṃ tiktādibhiḥ pālikaiḥ kalkitaiḥ pakvaṃ niḥśeṣakuṣṭhaniṣūdanāya paraṃ-śreṣṭham| vasantatilakam|

lg.l: sahāmalakaśuktibhir dadhisareṇa tailena vā guḍena payasā ghṛtena yavasaktubhir vā saha|
tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā vapuṣkaram aruṣkaraṃ paramamedhyam āyuṣkaram||80||

div.ab: Sa. āmalakatvagādibhir ekādaśabhiḥ saha pratyekaṃ bhallātakam upayuktaṃ praśastaśarīrakaraṇakāraṇam| tathā paraṃ-atiśayena, medhyam āyuṣpradaṃ ca syāt| pṛthvīvṛttam|
Sa. bhallātakāni tīkṣṇāni suniṣpannāni dahanatulyāni tāni yathāvidhi prayuktāny amṛtatulyāni bhavanti|

lg.l: kaphajo na sa rogo 'sti na vibandho 'sti kaścana|
yaṃ na bhallātakaṃ hanyāc chīghram agnibalapradam||82||

div.ab: Sa. śleṣmottho rogaḥ sa nāsti, vibandhaś ca sa kaścid api na vidyate, yaṃ-rogaṃ vibandhaṃ vā, bhallātakaṃ drutataraṃ paṭutaradahanakaraṃ na hanyāt|
Sa. vātātapavidhāv api bhallātakasya kulatthādīni viśeṣeṇa varjayet|

lg.l: tilavat pīḍayed droṇyāṃ, kvāthayed vā kusumbhavat|
