tat tailaṃ sambhṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paced āsalilakṣayāt||86||
snigdhasvinno hṛtamalaḥ pakṣād uddhṛtya tat tataḥ||87||
tenāsyordhvam adhastāc ca doṣā yānty asakṛt tataḥ|
pañcāhāni pibet tailam itthaṃ varjyān vivarjayan|

div.ab: Sa. tuvarasaṃjñā vṛkṣās tuvarakāḥ paścimasamudrataṭodbhūtāḥ| vīcīty ādinā viśeṣaṇena toyanidhinikaṭataratvaṃ pratipādayati| tebhyo vṛkṣebhyo jaladāgame supakvāni phalāni gṛhṇīyāt| phalebhyo 'pi majjño gṛhītvā śoṣayitvā suṣṭhu cūrṇayitvā ca tilavad droṇyāṃ pīḍayet| kusumbhavad vā kvāthayetj| tac ca tailaṃ siddhaṃ punaḥ pacet toyakṣayaṃ yāvat| pakvaṃ cāvartāya karīṣe māsārdhaṃ nidhāpayet| yantrapīḍitaṃ tu prakṛtyaiva nistoyaṃ tailaṃ tad akvathitam eva nidhāpayet| tataḥ-pakṣād anantaraṃ, tailam udddhṛtya snigdhasvinno hṛtadoṣo mantreṇānena majjasārety ādinā pavitritasya tailasya śubhadivase caturthena bhaktenāntarito 'harmukhe karṣaṃ pibet| tena tailenāsya puṃsa ūrdhvam adhaś ca punaḥ punar doṣā yānti| anantaram aparāhṇe 'snehalavaṇāṃ yavāgūṃ śiśirāṃ pibet| itthaṃ-anena prakāreṇa, parihāryān pariharan pañca divasāni tailaṃ pibet| pakṣaṃ mudgarasānnabhojanaḥ sarvakuṣṭhair vimucyate|

lg.l: tad eva khadirakvāthe triguṇe sādhu sādhitam|
nihitaṃ pūrvavat pakṣaṃ piben māsaṃ suyantritaḥ||92||

div.ab: Sa. tad eva-tuvarāsthitailaṃ, khadirakvāthena triguṇena samyak pakvaṃ pūrvavat-karīṣe pakṣaṃ nihitaṃ, māsaṃ suyantritaḥ pibet| tena ca tailenābhyaktaśarīro bhojanaṃ pūrvoktaṃ mudgarasānnaṃ vidadhyāt| etena prayogeṇa śīghraṃ kuṣṭhavantaṃ puruṣam upakramet|

lg.l: sarpirmadhuyutaṃ pītaṃ tad eva khadirād vinā|

div.ab: Sa. tad eva-tuvarāsthitailaṃ, khadiram antareṇa ghṛtamadhuyutaṃ pakṣaṃ pītaṃ san māṃsarasāhāraṃ naraṃ dviśatāyuṣaṃ vidhatte|0
Sa. tad eva tailaṃ nasye pañcāśad vāsarān sevitaṃ varaśarīraṃ śrutadharaṃ trivarṣaśatāyuṣaṃ puruṣaṃ karoti|

lg.l: pañcāṣṭau sapta daśa vā pippalīr madhusarpiṣā|

div.ab: Sa. pañca pippalīr athavā saptāṣṭau vā daśa vā mākṣikasarpirbhyāṃ rasāyanaguṇam abhilaṣya varṣam ekaṃ prayojayet|

tisras tisras tu pūrvāhṇe bhuktvā'gre bhojanasya ca|
pippalyaḥ kiṃśukakṣārabhāvitā ghṛtabharjitāḥ||97||
prayojyā madhusammiśrā rasāyanaguṇaiṣiṇā| -----------------------------------------------|98|
Sa. palāśakṣārabhāvitāḥ pippalyaḥ sarpiṣā bharjitā mākṣikānvitās tisraḥ pūrvāhṇe, tisro bhuktvā, tisro bhojanasyāgre, prayojyāḥ rasāyanaguṇaṃ kāmayamānena|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
kramavṛddhyā daśāhāni daśapaippalikaṃ dinam||98||

lg.l: piṣṭās tā balibhiḥ peyāḥ śṛtā madhyabalair naraiḥ||100||

ab.seg:
|
śītīkṛtā hīnabalair vīkṣya doṣāmayān prati| ]||1||

div.ab: Sa. daśa dināni daśapaippalikaṃ dinaṃ kramavṛddyā kṣīreṇa saha yojayet, vardhamānā daśa pippalīḥ prayojayed ity arthaḥ| tathaiva daśapaippalikaṃ dinaṃ payasā sahāpanayet| pariṇatabheṣajaś ca ṣaṣṭikaṃ dugdhaghṛtenādyāt| ayaṃ-evaṃprakāraḥ, sahasrapippalīnāṃ prayogo rasāyanaṃ syāt| tāḥ-pippalyaḥ, piṣṭāḥ satyo balavadbhir naraiḥ pātavyāḥ, madhyabalair naraiḥ kvathitāḥ peyāḥ|
tadvac ca chāgadugdhena dve sahasre prayojayet| -----------------------------------------------|101|
Sa. tadvac ceti anenaiva krameṇa chāgakṣīreṇa saha dve sahasre prayojayet|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
ebhiḥ prayogaiḥ pippalyaḥ kāsaśvāsagalagrahān||101||

lg.l: ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam||102||

div.ab: Sa. ebhiḥ-pūrvoktaiḥ prayogaiḥ, pippalya upayuktāḥ kāsādīṃś chophādīṃś ca jayanti|

lg.l: bilvārdhamātreṇa ca pippalīnāṃ pātraṃ pralimped ayaso niśāyām|
prātaḥ pibet tat salilāñjalibhyāṃ varṣaṃ yatheṣṭāśanapānaceṣṭaḥ||103||

div.ab: Sa. pippalīkarṣadvayamātreṇa niśāyāṃ lohapātraṃ limpet| tac ca jalāñjaliyugena prātaḥ pibet saṃvatsaraṃ svecchābhojanapānakriyaḥ| etac ca rasāyanaṃ pūrvaguṇam| indravajrā vrattam|

lg.l: lohopaliptāḥ pṛthag eva jīve- tsamāḥ śataṃ vyādhijarāvimuktaḥ||105||

div.ab: Sa. śuṇṭhyādīn pṛthag eva pippalīr iva lohopaliptān upayujya varṣaśataṃ rogajarārahito jīvati|

lg.l: kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ ca rasāyanāni yuktāny amūny āyasalepanāni|
kurvanti pūrvoktaguṇaprakarṣa- māyuḥprakarṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataś ca||106||

div.ab: Sa. amūni-pūrvoktāni rasāyanāni, lohalepanāni kṣīrāñjalibhyāṃ-dugdhapalāṣṭakena, upayuktāni pūrvoktaguṇātiśayam āyuḥ prakarṣaṃ ca tato dviguṇaṃ vidadhati| ādyante indravajrākhye, madhyamaṃ tūpajātiḥ|

lg.l: śaradam avalihānaḥ pāriṇāmān vikārāṃ- styajati mitahitāśī tadvad āhārajātān||107||

div.ab: Sa. asanādikvāthena bhāvitāṃ bākucīṃ mākṣikādibhir yuktāṃ varṣam avilahan pāriṇāmān-vayaḥpariṇatijān, vikārān jahāti| tathā hitamitabhojana āhārajān vikārāṃs tyajati| mālinī|

lg.l: tīvreṇa kuṣṭhena parītamūrti- ryaḥ somarājīṃ niyamena khādet|

div.ab: Sa. dāruṇena kuṣṭhena vyāptadeho yaḥ śaśāṅkalekhāṃ kṛṣṇatilayutāṃ niyamena vatsaraṃ bhakṣayet, sa candrakāntiṃ śarīreṇa jayet| upajātiḥ|

lg.l: ye somarājyā vituṣīkṛtāyā- ścūrṇair ūpetāt payasaḥ sujātāt|
uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tad evānu pibanti cānte||109||

div.ab: Sa. ye puruṣā vituṣīkṛtāyā indurājyāś cūrṇair yuktāt kṣīrāt sujātāt sāraṃ-navanītākhyaṃ, uddhṛtya mākṣikeṇa saha lihanti, paścāt tad eva takraṃ ca ye pibanti, te kuṣṭhavantaḥ śīryamāṇaśarīrāḥ samudbhūtāṅgulighrāṇāḥ śobhante| tarava iva bhūyaḥ sañjātapratyagrapallavāḥ| indravajrā|

ab.seg:
|
śītavātahimadagdhatanūnāṃ stabdhabhagnakuṭilavyathitāsthnām|
bheṣajasya pavanopahatānāṃ vakṣyate vidhir ato laśunasya||1||

lg.l: amṛtasya kaṇā bhūmau te rasonatvam āgatāḥ||111||

div.ab: Sa. atha laśunakalpam ācaṣṭe- saṃ-svarbhānor amṛtāpaharaṇāparādhena kaṇṭhāc chinnādye 'mṛtasya bindavo dharitryāṃ patitās te laśunatvaṃ prāptāḥ| ya(a)-asmād dhetoḥ, daityadehotthaṃ laśunam ato dvijā na bhakṣayanti| sākṣāc cāmṛtasambhūtatvād dhetor asau rasono rasāyanaṃ grāmaṇīḥ śreṣṭhaḥ|

Sa. śīte-hemantaśiśirayoḥ, laśunaṃ śīlayet| kaphādhiko vasante 'pi śīlayet| vātottaro varṣāsv api śīlayet| sarvadaiva vā vātārtau grīṣmartucaryācaraṇena śīlayet| kīdṛśaḥ san ? snigdhā śuddhā ca tanur yasya sa evam| tathā śītalair madhuraiś copaskṛtaḥ-saṃskṛtaḥ, āśayo yasya sa evam| tathā tasya-laśunasya, śekharakarṇapūrābhyāṃ maṇḍitā anucarāḥ-sevakāḥ, aṅgaṇe yasya sa tathā|

tasya kandān vasantānte himavacchakadeśajān|
apanītatvaco rātrau timayen madirādibhiḥ||115||
tatkalkasvarasaṃ prātaḥ śucitāntavapīḍitam|
madirāyāḥ sūrūḍhāyās tribhāgena samanvitam||116||
madyasyānyasya takrasya mastunaḥ kāñjikasya vā|
tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktam ālocya mātrayā||117||
tailasarpirvasāmajjakṣīramāṃsarasaiḥ pṛthak|
kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalam eva vā||118||
pibed gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ prāk kaṇṭhanāḍīviśuddhaye| -----------------------------------------------|119|

Sa. tasya-laśunasya, kandān vasantaṛtajāṃs tathā himaveddeśajāṃś chakadeśajān vā uddhṛtatvaco rātrau madirābījapūrarasādibhis timayet-kledayet| tatkalkasya svarasaṃ dhautavastrapīḍitaṃ madirāyāḥ suruḍhāyās tribhāgena yutaṃ, madyāder vā tribhāgena yutaṃ, athavā tasminn eva kāle surādibhir yutaṃ, mātrayā-deśakālāturādyapekṣiṇyā, ālocya-nirūpya, tailādibhir vā pṛthak yuktaṃ yadi vā kvāthena yathāvyādhivaśād yuktaṃ, kevalam eva vā rasaṃ, prāk-pūrvaṃ, gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ pibet galanāḍīviśodhanāya|

-----------------------------------------------|
pratataṃ svedanaṃ cānu vedanāyāṃ praśasyate||119||
śītāmbusekaḥ sahasā vamimūrcchāyayor mukhe| -----------------------------------------------|120|
Sa. vedanāyāṃ satyāṃ satataṃ svedanaṃ śreṣṭham| tathā vamau mūrcchāye ca sahasā-jhaṭity eva, śītalajalaseko mukhe śasyate|

ab.seg:
-----------------------------------------------|
śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi||120||

div.ab: Sa. śeṣaṃ rasaṃ klānter apagama ojasi sthairyaṃ prāpte sati pibet|
Sa. vidāhopaśāntaye 'tiśītānulepanaḥ syāt| tathā muktāmālikāḥ karpūtamālikāś ca sajalakaṇā dhārayet|

lg.l: kuḍavo 'sya para mātrā tadardhaṃ kevalasya tu|
palaṃ piṣṭasya tanmajjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prāk ca śīlayet||122||

div.ab: Sa. asyottamā mātrā surāsahitasya kuḍavaḥ| kevalasya tu rasasya kuḍavārdhaṃ paraṃ mātrā| tanmajjñaḥ piṣṭasya palaṃ parāmātrā| sabhaktaṃ prāk cāhārāt tac chīlayet|

lg.l: bhuñjīta yūṣaiḥ payasā rasair vā dhanvacāriṇām||123||

div.ab: Sa. purāṇaśālibhaktaṃ pariṇate śaṅkhādivat sitaṃ yūṣādibhiḥ sātmyādivaśāt bhuñjīta|

lg.l: madyam ekaṃ pibet tatra tṛṭprabandhe jalānvitam|

div.ab: Sa. tatra ca tṛṣi jātāyāṃ kevalaṃ madyaṃ jalayutaṃ pibet| amadyapas tu naro dhānyāmlādīni pibet| parisikthikā-saṭṭakaviśeṣaḥ, kiṭṭir iti kvacit prasiddhā|

lg.l: sthitaṃ daśāhād aśnīyāt tadvad vā vasayā samam||125||

div.ab: Sa. athavā tasya-laśunasya, kalkaṃ tulyaghṛtaṃ khajenāloḍitaṃ ghṛtabhāṇḍe sthitaṃ daśāhād ūrdhvaṃ bhuñjīta| tathaiva vasayā saha sthitaṃ daśāhād ūrdhvaṃ bhuñjīta|

lg.l: nimardakān vā ghṛtaśuktayuktān prakāmam adyāl laghu tuccham aśnan||126||

div.ab: Sa. vikañcuko-vigatatvag, yaḥ prājyaḥ-prabhūto laśunaḥ, sa garbho yeṣāṃ tāṃs tathāvidhān, tathā sahaśūlyamāṃsena saśūlyamāṃsān, tathā nānāvidharucakān, īdṛśān vā nimardakān ghṛtaśuktakānvitān, yathecchaṃ laghu tathā tucchaṃ-alpaṃ, bhuñjānaḥ| upendravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunāt param||127||

div.ab: Sa. vāte laśunāt param anyad dravyaṃ na vidyate| kimbhūte ? pittaraktavihīnasakalāvaraṇāvṛte| śuddhe-kevale vā, pavane 'paraṃ dravyaṃ na vidyate|

lg.l: atitikṣor ajīrṇaṃ ca rasono vyāpade dhruvam||128||

div.ab: Sa. laśunaṃ priyajalāder narasya, māṃsādidveṣiṇaḥ, tathā'jīrṇam atitikṣoḥ, niścayena vyāpattaye syāt|

Sa. laśunaprayogānte ca pittakopabhayāt mṛdu-atīkṣṇaṃ virecanaṃ ca kārayet| evaṃ-anena prakāreṇa yukte rasone, rasāyanaguṇān paripūrṇān prāpnoti|
[ "āmāmbupānekṣuvikāramatsyayānādhvavātātapabhāṣyacintāḥ|
svapnaṃ divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśāsu piṣṭaṃ vyavāyaṃ dadhi cātra necchet||
pāṇḍūdaroraḥkṣataśophatṛṣṇāpānātyayacchardiviṣavraṇeṣu|
paitte vikāRre 'kṣigade 'tisāre kṣāme śarīre ca sa varjanīyaḥ||" iti vṛddhavāgbhaṭāt| rasonasyopari etāni viruddhāni| ]

ab.seg:
adhunā śilājatukalpaṃ brūte--
-- grīṣme 'rkataptā girayo jatutulyaṃ vamanti yat|
hemādiṣaḍdhāturasaṃ procyate tac chilājatu||130||

div.ab: Sa. grīṣme ṛtau girayo ravitaptā jatutulyaṃ yat vamanti kṣaranti, suvarṇādayaś ca te ṣaḍdhātavaś ca teṣāṃ rasaṃ, tat śilājatu gadyate|

lg.l: sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ|
chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate||131||

div.ab: Sa. sarvaṃ-ṣaḍdhātujam api, girijaṃ tiktakaṭukaṃ na cātiśayenoṣṇaṃ pāke kaṭukaṃ chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa| tatra madhye lauhaṃ śilājaṃ praśasyate|

lg.l: snigdham anamlakaṣāyaṃ mṛdu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham||132||

div.ab: Sa. gomūtragandhyādiguṇaṃ śilājatu varaṃ syāt|

lg.l: prāk kevalajaladhautaṃ śuṣkaṃ kvāthais tato bhāvyam||133||
tatsamarasatāṃ yātaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣiped rase bhūyaḥ|
svaiḥ svair evaṃ kvāthair bhāvyaṃ vārān bhavet sapta||135||

div.ab: Sa. vyādhiś ca vyādhitaś ca tayoḥ sātmyaṃ-upaśayaṃ, samanusmaran lohapātre girijaṃ bhāvayet| katham ? ity āha-pūrvaṃ kevalajalena dhautaṃ tataḥ śuṣkaṃ sat kvāthair bhāvanīyam| saṃ-samaṃ girijaṃ yasmin bhāvanauṣadhe tad evam aṣṭaguṇe jale niḥkvāthyam| tatkvāthe 'ṣṭāṃśaśeṣe pūtoṣṇe sati śilājatu prakṣipet| tatsamarasatāṃ prāptaṃ śuṣkaṃ punā rase prakṣipet| evaṃ svaiḥ svaiḥ kvāthaiḥ sapta vārān bhāvanīyam| āryāś catasraḥ|

lg.l: tryahaṃ yuñjīta girijam ekaikena tathā tryaham||136||
yogaṃ yogyaṃ tatas tasya kālāpekṣaṃ prayojayet||137||

ab.seg:
śilājam evaṃ dehasya bhavaty atyupakāram|
guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaṃ na ca||138||

div.ab: Sa. atha girijam evaṃ bhāvayitvā snigdhasya śuddhasya ca narasya tiktakasādhitaṃ ghṛtaṃ divasatrayam upayuñjīta| nanu, yadi snigdhaśuddha evāsau, tat kim iti punaḥ sarpir yujyate ? brūmaḥ| kṛtaghṛtasya śilājatuvidhānaṃ sutarāṃ śastam| tathā coktam-"yathā hi kavacī śastraṃ parebhyaḥ sahate 'dhikam| tathā snehādhike gātre sevyamānaṃ śilājatu||" ity ādi| tathā ekaikena vakṣyamāṇena saha, śailajaṃ tryaham upayuñjyāt| triphalāyāḥ kvāthena tryahaṃ, paṭolyāś ca kvāthena tryahaṃ, madhuyaṣṭyāś ca kvāthena tridivasam| anantaraṃ yogyaṃ yogaṃ kālādīn apekṣya prayojayet| evaṃ anena vidhinā, girijaṃ yuktaṃ śarīrasyopakārakataraṃ syāt| sakalān guṇān vidhatte| aksmād eva ca vyāpadaṃ na karoti|

Sa. saṃ-ekaṃ saptāhaṃ trisaptāhaṃ saptasaptāham iti kālayogaḥ, karṣam ardhapalaṃ palam iti mātrāyogaḥ, iti dvaye 'py atra yathākramaṃ hīnamadhyottamatvam| ekaś ca trayaś ca sapta ca teṣāṃ saptāham iti samāsaḥ| muninā'py uktam (ca. ci. a. 1 pā. 3/54)-
"prayogaḥ saptasaptāhās traya ekaś ca kālataḥ|
nirdiṣṭas trividhas tasya varo madhyo 'varas tathā|| palam ardhapalaṃ karṣaṃ mātrā tasya tridhā matā|" iti|

lg.l: kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca kapotāṃś ca sadā tyajet||141||

div.ab:
Sa. saṃskṛtaṃ-pavanādiharair dravyair bhāvitaṃ, saṃskṛte dehe-snehanaśodhanaiḥ kṛtasaṃskāre śarīre, śilājatu prayuktaṃ prayuktaṃ tāmrādibhiḥ samuditair vyastair vā yuktaṃ dugdhenāloḍitaṃ kṣipram eva rasāyanaphalaṃ vidadhyāt| kulatthādīni kṛtatatprayogaḥ sadaiva jahyāt| kharaṇāde kākamācīkapotau na varjitau| tadvacanaṃ hi-"śuṣkāmiṣaṃ viruḍhaṃ piṣṭaṃ śuktam vidāhi guru cānyat| pānāśanaṃ kulatthān viśeṣato varjayec cātra||" ity ādi| muninā'pi naitau varjitau| tathā ca tadgranthaḥ (ca. ci. a. 1 pā.3/62)
_"śilājatuprayogeṣu vidāhīni gurūṇi ca|
varjayet sarvakāleṣu kulatthāṃś ca sadā tyajet||" iti| vidāhyādivarjanaṃ rasāyanakālād dviguṇaṃ kālaṃ vidheyam| kulatthāṃś ca yāvajjīvam ity eke| anye tu vadanti sadāśabdena saṃvatsara ucyate| yato ya ete ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ| etāvān eva kālo, na ṣāḍ ṛtuvyatirikto 'nyaḥ kālo 'stīti teṣām ayam abhiprāyaḥ| nanu, vidāhigurvādibhyaḥ kim iti kulatthānām adhikaḥ parihāra iṣyate ? brūmaḥ| pāṣāṇabhede kulatthānām adhikatarasvabhāvatvāt| tathā hi-santaptakulatthajalenāplutānāṃ pāṣāṇānāṃ pāṣāṇahantṛbhiḥ sukhenaiva vidāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam| śilājatu ca girijam ity uktam| ataḥ śilājatuprayogāt tanmayam eva śarīraṃ sampadyate| tena tasya kulatthā bādhāvidhāyinaḥ, iti parihāras teṣām adhikaḥ kṛtaḥ|

lg.l: na so 'sti rogo bhuvi sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya|
tat kālayogair vidhivat prayuktaṃ svasthasya corjāṃ vipulāṃ dadhāti||142||

div.ab:
Sa. atra bhūlokagrahaṇaṃ sakalabhūlokaparigrahārtham| anyathā kaścid eva deśo gṛhyeta, na tv aśeṣo bhūlokaḥ| rūpagrahaṇena sādhyaḥ savikalpo 'pi gṛhyate, tena kṛcchrasādhyo 'pi gṛhyate| rūpa padam antareṇa tu sukhasādhya eva kevalo gṛhyeta| prasahyety anena śīghrataraṃ niścitaṃ ca rogajayaṃ karotīti gamayati| tad ayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-kuṣṭhaghnāni mūtrakṛcchraharāṇi vā yathauṣadhāni teṣāṃ śamayati, tataḥ kṣiprataraṃ niścitaṃ ca rogajayaṃ karoti girijam iti| na sa rogo sādhyarūpo vidyate, yaṃ śilājatu prasahya na jayet| girijaṃ kālayogena ca vidhinā prayuktaṃ nīrujasya puruṣasya mahatīm ūrjāṃ ca karoti| upajātiḥ| ata eva saṅgrahe jagāda (u. a.
49)-"jvarī jvaraghnāmbudaparpaṭādeḥ kvāthena raktī madhuyaṣṭikāyāḥ|
śoṣī rasaiḥ kravyabhugāmiṣotthair māyūramāṃsaiḥ payasā ca kārśye||
madhvambunā medasi saṃpravṛddhe kṣīreṇa paryākulabuddhisattvaḥ|
pāṇḍau saśophe jaṭhare sakṛcchre pibec chilājaṃ mahiṣījalena||
aśma vīratarādyena kuṣṭhaṃ khadiravāriṇā|
viṣaṃ viṣaghnair agadair hanty evaṃ tad yathāmayam|| śailajatrikaṭukaṭukṣaudrakṣaudradhātūn viṣevate| kṣīrodanāśī yo jīrṇe yakṣmaṇā na sa bādhyate||
subhāvitāṃ sārajalais tulāṃ pītvā śilodbhavāt|
sārāmbunaiva bhuñjānaḥ śālīn jāṅgalajai rasaiḥ||
apohya madhumehākhyam antakaṃ rogasaṅkaram|
vapurvarṇabalopetaḥ śataṃ jīvaty anāmayaḥ||
amaramandiramandarasambhavāt palaśataṃ girijād upayojaya|
yadi jarāmayaduḥkhavivarjitāṃ suciram icchasi jīvitasantitam||
daśaguṇam upayuṅkte yaḥ śataṃ śailajātāl laghuhitamitabhojī varjayan varjanīyān|
satatasamanuṣaktān varjitān vaidyavṛndair vidhamati sa gadaughān nekṣate cāyuṣo 'ntam||" iti| śivaguṭikā cātraivoktā (saṃ. u. a. 49)| yathā-"śilāhvāt ṣoḍaśapalaṃ tris trir ekatra bhāvayet| varāyā daśamūlasya guḍūcyāḥ karkaṭasya ca||
balāyā madhuyaṣṭyāś ca rase gavye ca vāriṇi|
kṣīre sakṛt krameṇaivaṃ saptakṛtvas tathā punaḥ||
kākoliyugmaghanapuṣkaravahnirāsnāmedāyugarddhicavikāgajapippalīnām|
pāṭhādvijīvakanikumbhavidāriyugmavīrāvarīmadhuphalāṃśumatīdvayānām|| palikānām abdroṇe siddhānāṃ pādaśeṣite kvāthe| bhāvitam itthaṃ girijaṃ dvipalaiś cūrṇīkṛtair yuñjyāt|) karkaṭaśṛṅgīdhātrīvyoṣais tālīsapatrakuḍavena| cūrṇapalena vidāryās tvakkṣīryāḥ karṣayugmena|| kuḍavena caturjātāt tailaghṛtakṣaudraśarkarābhiś ca| dvipalādidviguṇābhiḥ kuryād gulikās tato 'kṣasamāḥ|| tāḥ śuṣkā navakumbhe jātīpuṣpādhivāsite sthāpyāḥ| tāsām ekāṃ khādet pratidinam anupānam atreṣṭam|| kṣīrarasadāḍimāmbhomārdvīkasurāsavānyatamam| jīrṇe 'nnaṃ laghu bhojyaṃ yūṣapayaḥpiśitaniryūhaiḥ|| saptāhamātram evaṃ sarvānnīnaḥ kramād bhavet parataḥ| bhaktasyānte prāg vā gulikā na virudhyate caiṣā|| nirapāyā bhūriphalā parihārasukhopayojitā jayati| prabalam api vātaśoṇitam ūrustambhaṃ jvaraṃ dīrgham|| bhagamūtraśukradoṣaplīhayakṛdraktapāṇḍuhṛdrogān| vardhmavamigulmapīnasahidhmākāsāruciśvāsān|| vidradhim udaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śvitraṃ ṣāṇḍhyaṃ kṣayaṃ madaṃ mūrcchām| unmādam apasmāraṃ mukhanetraśirogadāṃs tāṃs tān|| ānāham atīsāraṃ halīmakaṃ kāmalāgrahaṇirogān| granthyarbudān sapiḍakān bhagandaraṃ gaṇḍamālāṃ ca|| atikārśyam atisthaulyaṃ svedam api ślīpadaṃ gude kīlān| daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ samūlaṃ garaprayogān sughorāṃś ca|| abhicāram arātikṛtaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ bhautikīṃ tathā bādhām| pāpmālakṣmīṃ ceyaṃ gulikā śamayec chivā nāma|| vṛṣyā''yuṣyā dhanyā kāntiyaśaḥ śrīvibodhanī medhyā| kurute nṛpavallabhatāṃ jayaṃ vivāde ca vaktrasthā|| jitakhalativalīpalitaṃ jīvayati sukhaṃ śatadvayaṃ śaradām| varṣadvayaprayogād varṣaśatacatuṣṭayaṃ jīvet||" [iti|] kharanāde tūktam-"kanakād rajatāt tāmrād ayasaḥ sīsāt tathā trapuṇaḥ| girivivaraniḥsṛtaṃ tatkvāthasnigdhātimṛdumṛtsnam|| jatvābhaṃ ca śilājatu vidyād etaj jaḍātmakaṃ girijam| saṃraktapītavarṇaṃ satiktamadhuraṃ rase kaṭuvipāki|| śītaṃ kanakaśilājatu viśeṣataḥ śleṣmapittaghnam|| śvetaṃ ca tiktamadhuraṃ pācanaval lekhanaṃ śītam| kiñcil lavaṇaṃ vidyā(rūpyā)dviśeṣato vātapittaghnam|| śitikaṇṭhatulyavarṇaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ lekhanaṃ vipākakaṭu| kiñcil lavaṇaṃ tāmrātmakaṃ smṛtaṃ kaphakṛ(hṛ)dviśeṣeṇa|| guggulukābhaṃ snigdhaṃ tiktaṃ lavaṇaṃ saraṃ viśadatīkṣṇam|| kaṭupākinātiśītaṃ trimalaghnaṃ tv āyasaṃ śreṣṭham|| svākarasamānavarṇe sīsatrapusambhave śilājatunī|| alpāntarakarmaguṇe kṛṣṇāyasajāc chilājatunaḥ|| gomūtragandham asitaṃ guggulukābhaṃ viśarkaraṃ mṛtsnam| snigdham anamlakaṣāyaṃ śilodbhavaṃ sarvakarmaṇyam||" ity atra gurumṛduguṇau noktau| tathoktam-"sasnehalavaṇabhāvād vātaghnaṃ pittanut saratvāt tat| rasapākayoḥ kaṭutvāttaikṣṇyāc ca śleṣmamedoghnam|| kaṭutīkṣṇatvād dīpanam agner uddīpanān malān pacati| tiktatvād raktaghnaṃ kaṭutaikṣṇauṣṇyāt kṛmighnaṃ ca|| śobhanabhāvād dṛṣyaṃ snigdhatvāt pauṣṭikaṃ ca balyaṃ ca| āyuṣyaṃ ca viṣaghnaṃ maṅgalyam amṛtānvayatvāc ca|| śodhanabhāvāt srotodhātvindriyabuddhiśodhanaṃ varṇyam| putryaṃ ca vṛṣyabhāvān medhyaṃ yonisvabhāvāc ca||" ity ādi| tathā "bhāvitam anyair dravyair vīryotkarṣād viśeṣakarmaṇyam| tat syāt tasmād bhāvyaṃ vātādiharauṣadhakaṣāyaiḥ|| 'rāsnādaśamūlabalāpunarnavairaṇḍaśuṇṭhimadhukānām| kvāthena bhāvitaṃ tadviśeṣato vātarogaghnam|| drākṣā bhīrupaṭolītrāyantiguḍūcijīvanīyānām| kvāthena bhāvitaṃ tad viśeṣataḥ pittarogaghnam|| triphalāvacāviḍaṅgakarañja ghanamukhyapañcamūlānām| sahapañcakolākānāṃ kvāthena kaphāmaye bhāvyam|| laghupañcamūlaśuṇṭhīdrākṣākāśmaryavājigandhānām| suguḍūciśarabalānāṃ rasena pittānilagadeṣu|| ghanakuṣṭhavacātriphalāsuradāruviḍaṅgapañcakolānām| rajanīmaricātiviṣāyuktānāṃ vātakaphajeṣu|| pāṭhāpaṭolanimbatriphalāghanakuṭajasaptaparṇānām| trāyantyamṛtātiviṣāsahitānāṃ pittakaphajeṣu (saṃ. u. a. 49)||" trimaleṣu yathādoṣaṃ yogān etān vikalpya bhāvyaṃ syāt| prāk kevalajaladhautaṃ śuṣkaṃ kvāthais tato bhāvyam|| girijaṃ caturguṇajalaṃ kvāthyaṃ syād bhāvanauṣadhaṃ tatra| caturthaśeṣe kvāthe pūtoṣṇe prakṣiped girijam||" iti| atra caturguṇajalasyauṣadhasya kvāthena muktarasatā na tathā syād iti vāgbhaṭoktam evāṣṭaguṇajalakvāthena kāryam iti manyāmahe| tathoktam-"salilaviśuddhād girijāt pibed arogaḥ phalatrikarasena| mātrāṃ kramābhivṛddhāṃ tryahaṃ paṭolasya ca rasena|| mūtreṇa gavāṃ tadvat tryahaṃ kaṣāyeṇa madhukasya|" iti| "rogānviteṣu girijaṃ jalaśuddhaṃ bhāvitaṃ kaṣāyaiś ca| doṣavyādhibalāturakālāpekṣī prayuñjīta|| jīrṇauṣadhaḥ sukhodakapariṣikto māṃsarasapayoyūṣaiḥ| raktādiṣaṣṭikaudanam anavamarogo gadī vā'dyāt|| vyādhyāturadoṣabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya tridhā prayogaḥ syāt| śreṣṭhas triṣaṣṭirātraṃ māso madhyas trisaptarātram avaraḥ|| pānāvagāhayoḥ syād divyaṃ śailodbhavaṃ kaupam|" munis tv asya caturdhātujatvam eva saṃgirate| tathā ca tadgranthaḥ (ca. ci. a. 1 pā. 2/47)-
"anamlaṃ ca kaṣāyaṃ ca kātupāke śilājatu|
nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ cātubhyaś caturbhyas tasya sambhavaḥ||| hemnaḥ sarajatāt tāmrād varaṃ kṛṣṇāyasād api|" iti| saṅgrahe ca guggulukalpo 'bhihitaḥ| yathā (u. a. 49)-
"dānavendravijitān purā surān bhraṣṭakāntidhṛtiśauryatejasaḥ|
vīkṣya viṣṇur amṛtaṃ kilāsṛjad gugguluṃ balavapurjayapradam||
adyāpy ataḥ suragaṇāḥ kila dhūpamukhyān hitvā varāguruturuṣkahimendudarpān|
nirdahyamānavapuṣo 'pi śikhāṃ pibanto gandhena yasya muditā dadhati prasādam||
sa yogavāhī sa śivaḥ sa sārvaḥ sarvartusevyaḥ sukhaśīlanīyaḥ|
hartā jarāpāpmamalāmayānāṃ kartā'gnimedhāsmṛtipāṭavānām|| gandhotkaṭaḥ sa dāhe snigdhadravapicchilo vigataśalyaḥ| mahiṣākhyaḥ puṣparāgasphaṭikāsitanīradacchāyaḥ|| yaḥ padmarāgarāgo yaḥ kanakacchedapātalo yo vā| jayatīndranīlam amalaṃ bhagno 'py atikāntimattvena||
śreṣṭhaḥ prayogo 'sya tulā palān naivādhikaṃ pibet|
ātreyamunigītaś ca mantro 'yaṃ karmasiddhikṛt||
'bhagavān puṇḍarīkākṣo devāś ca sapurandarāḥ|
ājñāpayanti samyak tvāṃ prabhāvaṃ cādiśanti te||
jarāmaraṇaduḥkhebhyo yathā te 'bhyutthitāḥ surāḥ|
upayoktus tathaivāsya bhava tvaṃ hi mahābalaḥ||' iti|
pañcamūlasya mahataḥ kvāthena hitabhojinā|
gugguluḥ śīlito hanti sarvān vātakaphāmayān||
laghīyaso 'pi tadvac ca sukhoṣṇena jalena vā|
mastudhānyāmlamadyair vā vacādeḥ salilena vā||
varaṇādes tu bādhiryaṃ dantakarṇaśirorujaḥ|
svarabhedodaraścāsavardhmāntargulmavidradhīn||
vātapittāsrarogeṣu bṛṃhaṇārthini ceṣyate|
kvāthena vājigandhāyā jīvanīyagaṇasya vā||
kvāthenotpalamṛdvīkāraktacandanajanmanā|
vātapittaṃ nihanty eṣa padmakādigaṇasya vā||
cavyakuṣṭhaviḍaṅgānāṃ yavānyā nāgarasya vā|
prasāraṇyāś ca toyena gugguluḥ kaphavātajit||
tryūṣaṇāgnighanavellavarābhir bhakṣayan samadhṛtaṃ mahiṣākṣam|
āśu hanti kaphamārutamedodoṣajān balavato 'pi vikārān||
paṭolanimbatriphalāguḍūcīgāyatrirātridvayabījakānām|
kvāthaiḥ pṛthak pathyaparasya hanti māsena ghorān kaphapittarogān||
viśeṣāc chophavīrsarpaduṣṭavraṇabhagandarān|
śukrārtavamanodoṣapramehaśvitrapāṇḍutāḥ||
paṭolāriṣṭaniryūhapiṣṭas tulyarasāñjanaḥ|
galarogāpacīvyaṅgagranthisthaulyakṛmipraṇut||
śilājatusamaḥ pītaḥ payasā vātaśoṇitam|
nivartayaty atibalaṃ kṣīramāṃsaghṛtāśinaḥ||
rasena payasā mūtrair vātapittakaphāpahaḥ|
brāhmīmaṇḍūkaśaṅkhānāṃ pṛthaṅh medhādikṛd rasaiḥ||
māgadhikāgniviḍaṅgakaliṅgair bilvadhṛtaiḥ savacāpalaṣaṭkaiḥ|
guggulunā sadṛśena sametaiḥ kṣaudrayutaiḥ sakalāmayanāśaḥ||
pibet palaśataṃ yo 'sya vidhinā niyato yatiḥ|
nākālamṛtyor na vyādher na tasya jaraso bhayam||
kalpayed oṣadhaiḥ svaiḥ svair vyādhiṣu vyādhināśanaiḥ|
śilājatuvidhānaṃ ca gugguloḥ sarvam iṣyate||
guṇanidhir api kuryāt so 'timātropayuktas timiravadanaśoṣaklībatākārśyamehān|
śamalaśithilabhāvaṃ deharaukṣyaṃ ca tasmād rajanicaraniṣevī syān na rogeṣv amīṣu||" [iti|]

lg.l: ato 'nyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ||143||

div.ab: Sa. kṣaṇināṃ-vyāpārakaraṇaṃ prati svatantrāṇām, tathā paricchadavatāṃ-saparivārāṇām, kuṭīpraveśalakṣaṇo vidhir hitaḥ| ataḥ-asmāt, ye 'nyathā-paratantrāḥ parivārarahitāḥ, teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhir hitaḥ|

lg.l: sukhopacārā bhraṃśe 'pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ||144||

div.ab: Sa. ataḥ-asmāc ca hetoḥ, ye vātātapasahā yogās te viśeṣeṇa vakṣyante| tathā ye na duḥkhāvahāḥ, bhraṃśe 'pi-vyāpattāv api, śarīrasya na pīḍākṛtaḥ|

lg.l: śītodakaṃ payaḥ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtam ekaikaśo dviśaḥ|
triśaḥ samastam athavā prāk pītaṃ sthāpayed vayaḥ||145||

div.ab: Sa. śiśirajalādikam ekaikaśo dviśas triśo vā prāg bhojanāt pītaṃ vayaḥ sthāpayet| tena śītāmbho vā, kṣīraṃ vā, madhu-mākṣikaṃ vā, sarpir vā, pītam athavā śītāmbhaḥpayasī, śītajalakṣaudre, śītadalaghṛte, ity evaṃ yathāsambhavaṃ dve saṃyukte prāk pīte 'thavā trīṇi saṃyuktāni pītāni samastaṃ vā catuṣṭayam ity evam avatiṣṭhate|

lg.l: guḍena madhunā śuṇṭhyā kṛṣṇayā lavaṇena vā|
dve dve khādan sadā pathye jīved varṣaśataṃ sukhī||146||

div.ab: Sa. guḍādinā pratyekaṃ dve dve harītakyau sarvadā bhakṣayan samāśataṃ sukhaṃ jīvet|

lg.l: harītakīṃ sarpiṣi sampratāpya samaśnatas tat pibeto ghṛtaṃ ca|
bhavec cirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakṛt kṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛtajñe||147||

div.ab: Sa. ghṛte harītakīṃ samyak tāpayitvā bhakṣayatas tac ca ghṛtaṃ pibato dehe 'tidṛḍhaṃ balaṃ sthirataraṃ bhavet| yathā kṛtajñe nare sakṛt-ekavāraṃ, śobhanaṃ kṛtaṃ cirasthāyi bhavet| upendravajrā|

lg.l: praṇāśam āyānti jarāvikārā granthā viśālā iva durgṛhītāḥ||148||

div.ab: Sa. āmalakasvarasamākṣikaśarkarāghṛtāni narāṇāṃ hitāśanānāṃ lihatāṃ jarāvikārāḥ praṇāśam āyanti| yathā viśālā granthā duḥpaṭhitāḥ praṇāśaṃ yānti|
Sa. dhātryādikam āsevamānasya narasya yauvanādikaṃ praṇaṣṭam apy avipraṇaṣṭaṃ bhavati|

lg.l: lauhaṃ rajo vellabhavaṃ ca sarpiḥ- kṣaudradrutaṃ sthāpitam abdamātram|
samudgake bījakasāraklṛpte lihan balī jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ||150||

div.ab: Sa. lohacūrṇādikaṃ samudgake-sampuṭe, bījasāramaye varṣamātraṃ sthāpitaṃ lihan balī-balasahitaḥ, kālakaco jīvati|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgabhallātakanāgarāṇi ye 'śnati sarpirmadhusaṃyutāni| jarānadīṃ rogataraṅgiṇīṃ te| lāvaṇyayuktāḥ puruṣās taranti||151||

div.ab: Sa. viḍaṅgādīni ye puruṣā madhvājyayutāni khādanti, te jarānadīṃ gadakallolavatīṃ lāvaṇyavantas taranti-nirāmayā jīvantīty arthaḥ| upajātayaḥ|

lg.l: niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvanty arujaḥ kim atra citram|152|

div.ab: Sa. khadirabījasārayūṣabhāvitāṃ triphalāṃ ghṛtamadhuyutāṃ niyamena ye khādanti, te nirāmayā niścayena bhavanti, ity atra nāsti sandehaḥ| aupacchandasikam|

lg.l: niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvanty arujaḥ kim atra citram||152||

div.ab: Sa. khadirabījasārayūṣabhāvitāṃ triphalāṃ ghṛtamadhuyutāṃ niyamena ye khādanti, te nirāmayā niścayena bhavanti, ity atra nāsti sandehaḥ| aupacchandasikam|

lg.l: bījakasya rasam aṅgulihāryaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ triphalāṃ ca|
śīlayatsu puruṣeṣu jarattā svāgatā'pi vinivartata eva||153||

div.ab: Sa. bījasārasya rasam aṅgulihāryam atikharaṃ śarkarādikaṃ ca śīlayan naro jarābhāvaṃ suṣṭhv āgatam apy apākurute| svāgatākhyaṃ cedaṃ vṛttam iti śleṣaleśaḥ| tallakṣaṇaṃ ca-"svāgatā ranubhagair gurukāntā|" iti|

lg.l: punarnavasyārdhapalaṃ navasya piṣṭaṃ pibed yaḥ payasā'rdhamāsam|
māsadvayaṃ tat triguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇo 'pi bhūyaḥ sa punarnavaḥ syāt||154||

div.ab: Sa. punarnavasya pratyagrasya karṣadvayaṃ piṣṭaṃ māsārdhaṃ, māsadvayaṃ, tat triguṇaṃ-ṣaṇmāsān, varṣaṃ vā, deśapuruṣādyapekṣayā yaḥ payasā pibet, sa puruṣo jīrṇaśarīro 'pi punarnavo bhavet|
Sa. mūrvādīnāṃ kalpanāṃ punarnavāsadṛśīṃ kathayanti|

lg.l: tān jīvitādhvānam abhiprapannā- nna vipralumpanti vikāracaurāḥ||156||

div.ab: Sa. śatāvarīkalkakvāthābhyāṃ pakvaṃ ghṛtaṃ śarkarāsahitaṃ ye khādanti, tān jīvitamārgam abhiprapannān vikāracaurā na chindanti| jīvitādhvānam iti vikāracaurā iti samāsarūpakam| tasya hi lakṣaṇam-"upasarjanopameyaṃ kṛtvā samāsam etayor ubhayoḥ| yatra prayujyate tad rūpakam anyat samāsoktam||" iti|

lg.l: pītā'śvagandhā payasā'rdhamāsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā vā|
kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā suvṛṣṭiḥ||157||

div.ab: Sa. aśvagandhā'rdhamāsaṃ payasā ghṛtādyanyatamena vā pītā kṛśasya vapuṣaḥ puṣṭiṃ karoti| yathā bālasya sasyasya śobhanā vṛṣṭiḥ|

lg.l: poṣaḥ śarīrasya bhavaty analpo dṛḍhībhavanty āmaraṇāc ca dantāḥ||158||

div.ab: Sa. anudinaṃ kṛṣṇatilapalaṃ śiśirajalānupānaṃ bhakṣayatāṃ śarīrasya puṣṭir mahatī syāt| maraṇāvadhayaś ca dvijā dṛḍhāḥ syuḥ|

lg.l: vṛṣaḥ sthiraḥ śāntavikāraduḥkhaḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvati kṛṣṇakeśaḥ||159||

div.ab: Sa. gokṣurakādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ ghṛtamākṣikamiśraṃ lihan vṛṣādiguṇānvito varṣaśataṃ kṛṣṇakaco jīvati| ṣaḍupajātayaḥ|

lg.l: sārdhaṃ tilair āmalakāni kṛṣṇai- rakṣāṇi saṃkṣudya harītakīr vā|
ye 'dyur mayurā iva te manuṣyā ramyaṃ parīṇāmam avāpnuvanti||160||

div.ab: Sa. kṛṣṇatilaiḥ saha dhātrīphalāni saṃkṣudya bibhītakāni harītakīr vā ye narā bhakṣayeyuḥ, te śikhina iva ramaṇīyaṃ vayaḥpariṇāmaṃ prāpnuvanti,-darśanīyā bhavantīty arthaḥ| indravajrāvṛttam|

ab.seg: śilājatukṣaudraviḍaṅgasarpi- rlohābhayāpāradatāpyabhakṣaḥ| āpūryate durbaladehadhātu- striyapañcarātreṇa yathā śaśāṅkaḥ||161||

div.ab: Sa. śilājatvādibhakṣo 'rdhamāsena durbalaśarīradhātur āpūryate| indur ivety upamā|

lg.l: ye māsam ekaṃ svarasaṃ pibanti dine dine bhṛṅgarajaḥsamuttham|
kṣīrāśinas te balavīryayuktāḥ samāḥ śataṃ jīvatam āpnuvanti||162||

div.ab: Sa. ye mārkavasvarasam anudinaṃ māsaṃ yāvat pibanti dugdha bhojanāḥ santaḥ, te balavīryayutā varṣaśataṃ jīvitam aśnuvate|

lg.l: māsaṃ vacām apy upasevamānāḥ kṣīreṇa tailena ghṛtena vā'pi|

div.ab: Sa. vacāṃ ca māsaṃ kṣīrādyanyatamenopayuñjānā rākṣasair anupadrutarūpā medhāvanto jvaladujvalavacanāś ca syuḥ| medhāvina iti "asmāyāmedhāsrajaḥ" iti viniḥ| upajātayaḥ|

lg.l: maṇḍūkaparṇīm api bhakṣayanto bhṛṣṭāṃ ghṛte māsam anannabhakṣāḥ|

div.ab: Sa. maṇḍūkaparṇīṃ ghṛtena pakvāṃ khādanto māsam anannāśino mahāntaṃ kālaṃ jīvanti prāgalbhyādiguṇayuktāḥ| indravajrāvṛttam|

lg.l: chāyāviśuṣkaṃ gulikārdham adyāt pūrvaṃ samastām api tāṃ krameṇa|
bhajed viriktaḥ kramaśaś ca maṇḍaṃ peyāṃ vilepīṃ rasakaudanaṃ ca||166||
sarpiḥsnigdhaṃ māsam ekaṃ yatātmā māsād ūrdhvaṃ sarvathā svairavṛttiḥ|
varjyaṃ yatnāt sarvakālaṃ tv ajīrṇaṃ varṣeṇaivaṃ yogam evopayuñyāt||167||
bhavati vigatarogo yo 'py asādhyāmayārtaḥ prabalapuruṣakāraḥ śobhate yo 'pi vṛddhaḥ|
upacitapṛthugātraśrotranetrādiyukta- staruṇa iva samānāṃ pañca jīvec chatāni||168||

div.ab: Sa. lāṅgalyādīnāṃ palapaścāśatā bhṛṅgasvarasena kṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭyā'dhikaṃ gulikānāṃ śatatrayaṃ chāyāviśuṣkam| tato gulikāyā ardhaṃ pūrvam adyāt| krameṇa tāṃ samastām api bhuñjīta| tato viriktaḥ krameṇa maṇḍādīn adyāt| upajātir vṛttam| māsam ekaṃ sarpiḥsnigdham annaṃ jitātmā bhuñjīta| māsād anantaraṃ yatheṣṭabhojanaḥ syāt| sarvadā tu yatnenājīrṇaṃ varjyam| evaṃ anena prakāreṇa, varṣeṇa sarvā gulikā upayuñjyāt| [ śālinīvṛttam| ] kṛtopayogo nīrogo yo 'py asādhyarogārto, vṛddho 'pi prakṛṣṭapuruṣakāravān jāyate| puṣṭavistīrṇaśarīraḥ praśastanayanakarṇādimāṃs taruṇa iva pañca varṣaśatāni jīvati| [ mālinīvṛttam| ]

lg.l: gāyatrīśikhiśiṃśipāsanaśivā- vellākṣakāruṣkarān piṣṭvā'ṣṭādaśasaṃguṇe 'mbhasi dhṛtān khaṇḍaiḥ sahāyomayaiḥ|
pātre lohamaye tryahaṃ ravikarai- rāloḍayan pācaye- dagnau cānu mṛdau salohaśakalaṃ pādasthitaṃ tat pacet||169||

ab.seg:
pūtasyāṃśaḥ kṣīratoṃ'śas tathāṃ'śau bhārṅgān niryāsād dvau varāyās trayoṃ'śāḥ|
aṃśāś catvāraś ceha haiyaṅgavīnā- dekīkṛtyaitat sādhayet kṛṣṇalauhe||170||

lg.l: vimalakhaṇḍasitāmadhubhiḥ pṛthak yutam ayuktam idaṃ yati vā ghṛtam|
śrīmān nirdhūtapāpmā vanamahiṣabalo vājivegaḥ sthirāṅgaḥ keśair bhṛṅgāṅganīlair madhusurabhimukho naikayoṣinniṣevī|
vāṅmodhādhīsamṛddhaḥ supaṭuhutavaho māsamātropayogād dhatte 'sau nārasiṃhaṃ vapur analaśikhā- taptacāmīkarābham||172||
attāraṃ nārasiṃhasya vyādhayo na spṛśanty api|

div.ab: Sa. gāyatryādīn piṣṭvā'ṣṭādaśaguṇe jale lauhaiḥ śakalaiḥ saha dhṛtān āyase bhājane trīṇi dināni dinakarakarair āśoṣayan pācayet| paścād atīkṣṇe vahnau lohaśakalaiḥ saha pādasthitaṃ tat pacet| śārdūlavikrīḍitam| pūtasyāsya bhāgaḥ, kṣīrād aṃśaḥ, bhṛṅgarajaḥkvāthād aṃśau dvau, tathā varāyāś cāṃśās trayaḥ, ghṛtād aṃśāś catvāraḥ, etat sarvaṃ melayitvā kṛṣṇalohe pacet| vaiśvadevīvṛttam| ujjvalakhaṇḍaśarkarāmākṣikaiḥ pṛthag yutam ayutaṃ vā ghṛtam etad ātmecchayā kṛtāhārapānavihāro naraḥ palaṃ palam aśnan śrīmadādiyuto bhavet| drutavilambitavṛttam| śrīmān nirdhūtapāpmā bhavet| tathā vanamahiṣatulyabalaḥ, vājinaḥ-aśvasya, vegena samaḥ, sthirāṅgaḥ-dṛḍhaśarīraḥ, tathā keśair bhramarakṛṣṇair upalakṣito bhavet, tathā madhuvat surabhimukhaḥ syāt, tathā bahustrīgamanasāmarthyayuktaḥ syāt, tathā vāṅmedhādibhiḥ samṛddhaḥ, tathā suṣṭhu paṭuḥ-tīkṣṇo, hutavahaḥ-agniḥ, yasya sa tathāvidho, māsamātropayogāt-syāt| asau-asya ghṛtasyopayoktā, narasiṃhasadṛśaṃ śarīram atidārḍhyayogāt tathā vahniśikhāsantaptasuvarṇakāntiṃ dhārayed iti| sragdharāvṛttam| narasiṃhākhyasya haviṣo bhoktāraṃ rogā na spṛśanty eva,-āsatāṃ tāvad vyādhayaḥ| yathā nārasiṃhaṃ rūpaṃ cakrojjvalabhujaṃ praveṣṭuṃ daityā bhītyā(tāḥ) spraṣṭumaśaktāḥ, ity upamā|

lg.l: bhṛṅgapravālān amunaiva bhṛṣṭān ghṛtena yaḥ khādati yantritātmā|

div.ab: Sa. mārkavapallavān etenaiva sarpiṣā bhṛṣṭān yo 'śnāti [ni]-yataḥ śuddhakoṣṭhaḥ san| bījakasārasiddhakṣīrānupaḥ, tenaiva-asanasārasiddhena dugdhena, kṛtabhojanārthaḥ-taddvṛttir ity arthaḥ| saḥ-puruṣo, māsopayogāt sukhī-nīrogo, varṣaśate dve jīvati| tathaikavāram api kathitaṃ gṛhṇāti| kīdṛk san ? aviluptāni smṛtīndriyāṇi yasya sa evam|

lg.l: anenaiva ca kalpena yas tailam upayojayet|
tān evāpnoti sa guṇān kṛṣṇakeśaś ca jāyate||176||
mahānuśaṃsāny api cāparāṇi prāptyādikaṣṭāni na kīrtitāni||177||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ- anenaiva vidhānena yaḥ puruṣas tailam upayojayet, sa tān eva-pūrvoktān guṇān, prāpnoti| kṛṣṇakacaś ca sampadyate| saṃ-rasāyanāni yāni śakyāni phalayuktāni yugānurūpāṇi ca tāny uktāni| aparāṇi cāśakyāni yāni mahāphalāny api tāni na kathitāni| upajātiḥ|

lg.l: yathāsvam auṣadhaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ muktvā rasāyanam||178||

div.ab: Sa. rasāyanasya vidhibhraṃśāt-vyapāyāt, yadi rogā bhaveyuḥ, tato rasāyanaṃ vihāya teṣāṃ yathāyogaṃ sarvam auṣadhaṃ kāryam|
Sa. satyabhāṣiṇaṃ, tathā krodharahitaṃ, tathā'dhyātmapravaṇāni yogapravaṇāni, indriyāṇi yasya taṃ, tathā śamayuktaṃ, tathā saddṛttanirataṃ, sthitam evaṃbhūtaṃ naraṃ nityarasāyanaṃ jānīyāt|

lg.l: guṇair ebhiḥ samuditaḥ sevate yo rasāyanam|
sa nivṛttātmā dīrghāyuḥ paratreha ca modate||180||

div.ab: Sa. ebhiḥ-satyavacanādibhir guṇaiḥ, saṃyuktaḥ puruṣo rasāyanaṃ sevate yaḥ, sa puruṣo nivṛttacito dīrghāyuś ca sann iha modate 'nyajanmani ca|

śastrānusāriṇī caryā cittajñāḥ pārśvavartinaḥ|
buddhir askhalitā'rtheṣu paripūrṇaṃ rasāyanam|181| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭaviraci- tāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne rasāyanavidhir nāma ekonacatvā- riṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|39|

Sa. saṃ-ceṣṭā śāstrānusāriṇī, pārśvasīnāś ca cittavidaḥ, artheṣu-viṣayeṣu, buddhir askhalitā, ity etat paripūrṇaṃ rasāyanam iti| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayaṭī- kāyāṃ sarvaṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭha uttarasthāne rasāyanavidhi- rnāma ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 39|| iti rasāyanākhyaṃ saptamam aṅgaṃ samāptam|

div.head: vājīkaraṇavidhir adhyāyaḥ
div.ab: Sa. atha kramaprāptaṃ vājīkaraṇādhyāyaṃ brūte|

ab.seg: athāto vājīkaraṇavidhim adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāhur ātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ| (gadyasūtre)||2||

div.ab: Sa. vājīvayena samarthaḥ kriyate, tad vājīkaraṇam, tasyādhyāyaḥ| śeṣam āyuṣkāmīyavad yojyam|
vājīkaraṇam anvicchet satataṃ viṣayī pumān| --------------------------------------------|1|

Sa. viṣayī yaḥ puruṣaḥ, sa satataṃ vājīkaraṇam auṣadham anvicchet| puṃgrahaṇaṃ strīṣaṇḍhādinivṛttyartham, anyathā yathā pañcakarmāṇi ṛtuvidhānādi ca sāmānyoktatvāt stryādīnām api prasajjati, tathedam api vijñāyate, tasmāt tadvyavacchedārthaṃ puṃgrahaṇam| satatagrahaṇenaitad dyotayati,-yathā rasāyanam upayuktaṃ cirakālam anuvartate na tathā vājīkaraṇam iti| api tu yasminn evāhni prayujyate tasminn eva kāryakaraṇasamarthaṃ prāyeṇa syād iti satataṃ-anavarataṃ, vājīkaraṇam anvicched ity uktam| vājīkaraṇena ko 'rthaḥ syāt ? ity āha-

--------------------------------------------|
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭir apatyaṃ ca guṇavat tatra saṃśritam||1||
apatyasantānakaraṃ yat sadyaḥ saṃpraharṣaṇam| --------------------------------------------|2|

Sa. tatra vājīkaraṇe tuṣṭyādi saṃśritam| apatyaṃ kimbhūtam ? guṇavat, na tu durapatyaṃ kulāṅgārarūpam| yato 'patya[nāṃ] santānakaraṃ-avicchedasthitikaraṃ ca, yac ca sadyaḥ-śīghram eva, saṃpraharṣaṇaṃ vājīkaraṇam|

ab.seg:
--------------------------------------------|
vājīvātibalo yena yāty apratihato 'ṅganāḥ||2||

lg.l: tad vājīkaraṇaṃ tad dhi dehasyorjaskaraṃ param||3||

div.ab: Sa. yena vājīkaraṇena turaṅga ivāpratihatasāmarthyas tarūṇīḥ saṃgacchati, tathā yena yoṣitām ativallabhaḥ syāt, tathā yenopacayaṃ prāpnopti, tad vājīkaraṇam ucyate| tad dhi śarīrasyorjaskaram atiśayena| nanu, vājīkaraṇam upāyahetur viṣayāṇām ihaiva bandhanadarśanāt| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare-"kośakāro yathaivāṃśūn upādatte vandhavahān" ity ādi| tasmān nārtho vājīkaraṇenety āha-

Sa. yato dharmād anapetaṃ-dharmyaṃ, brahmacaryaṃ tad anumodāmahe| tathā yaśasyādihetuḥ| tathā lokadvaye-ihaloke paraloke ca, rasāyanam iva rasāyanaṃ, sadopakāratvāt| tathā ekāntena sarvathā, nirmalam| yato brahmacaryam| na tu brahmacaryavat svadārādi(re)ṣu putrādyartham eva nirmalam| ato hetos tad anumodāmahe| kintv ābhyudayikaṃ mārgam āśritya vājīkaraṇopadeśaḥ| dvividho hi mārgaḥ,-naiḥśreyasika ābhyudayikaś ca| tatra naiḥśreyasikaṃ mārgaṃ samanusṛtya brahmacaryopadeśaś ca kośakāradṛṣṭantaś ca kleśanāśakṛc ca| ābhyudayikaṃ ca mārgam āśrityāyam upadeśa ity atrāha|
Sa. stokasattvasya puṃsaḥ kleśair viṣayotthaiḥ pīḍyamānasya rāgiṇaḥ-kāminaḥ, śarīrakṣayarakṣārthaṃ vājīkaraṇm ucyate| anena śāstrakṛtā, aparaiś ca tantrakāraiḥ|

lg.l: sarveṣv ṛtuṣv ahar ahar vyavāyo na nivāryate||6||

div.ab: Sa. kalpa(lya)sya-samarthasya, tathā yauvanasthasya, vājīkaraṇaṃ satataṃ kurvataḥ, tasya sarveṣv eva ṛtuṣu dine dine vyavāyo maithunaṃ, na niṣidhyate|

Sa. atha-kṛtamaṅgalasya, snigdhasya tathā viśuddhasya tathā kṣīrādyāśino yogavit-vaidyaḥ, prāṅh nirūhān sānuvāsanān ghṛtādisaṃyuktān kārayet| tataḥ-anantaraṃ, vājīkarān yogān yojayet| kimbhūtān ? śukrādipradān|

lg.l: yathaikaś caikaśākhaś ca nirapatyas tathā naraḥ||9||

div.ab: Sa. acchāyatvādibhir guṇair yukto 'rthināṃ yathā tarur anāśrayaṇīyaḥ, tathā tādṛśo mānavo nirapatya iti| ekavacanenaiva ekārthasya labdhatvād ekagrahaṇaṃ kevalārthapratipattyartham| ekaḥ kevalo mādhavīlatādirahitaḥ|

Sa. skhaladgamanādikam apatyaṃ kena padārthena darśanādiṣu samānam| kiṃ punar yad yaśādivardhanāt tasya kena tulyatā bhavet ? apatyaśabdasya puṃstvam atra cintyam(?)| tat kila nitarāṃ sukhapradam ity arthaḥ|
śuddhakāye yathāśakti vṛṣyayogān prayojayet| --------------------------------------------|12|
Sa. śuddhaśarīre puruṣe yathāgnibalaṃ vṛṣyayogān prayojayet|

tān evāha ----
śarekṣukuśakāśānāṃ vidāryā vīraṇasya ca||12||
mūlāni kaṇṭakāryāś ca jīvakarṣabhakau balām|
mede dve dve ca kākolyau śūrpaparṇyau śatāvarīm||13||
aśvagandhām atibalām ātmaguptāṃ punarnavām|
vīrāṃ payasyāṃ jīvantīm ṛddhiṃ rāsnāṃ trikaṇṭakam||14||
madhukaṃ śāliparṇī ca bhāgāṃs tripalikān pṛthak|
māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ caitad dvidroṇe sādhayed apām||15||
rasenāḍhakaśeṣeṇa pacet tena ghṛtāḍhakam|
dattvā vidārīdhātrīkṣurasānām āḍhakāḍhakam||16||
ghṛtāc caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ peṣyāṇīmāni cāvapet|
vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau yaṣṭiṃ phalgūni pippalīm||17||
drākṣāṃ vidārīṃ kharjūraṃ madhukāni śatāvarīm|
tatsiddhapūtaṃ cūrṇasya pṛthak prasthena yojayet||18||
śarkarāyās tugāyāś ca pippalyāḥ kuḍavena ca|
maricasya prakuñcena pṛthag ardhapalonmitaiḥ||19||
tvagelākesaraiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ kṣaudradvikuḍavena ca|
palamātraṃ tataḥ khādet pratyahaṃ rasadugdhabhuk||20||
tenārohati vājīva kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati| --------------------------------------------|21|

Sa. śarādīnāṃ mūlāni kaṇṭakāryāś ca, tathā jīvakādīn, tripalikān bhāgān pṛthak, māṣāṇām āḍhakaṃ ca, etat sarvaṃ jaladroṇadvaye pācayet| tena rasenāḍhakaśeṣeṇa ghṛtāḍhakaṃ dattvā vidāryādirasādīnāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthag āḍhakaṃ dattvā kṣīrāḍhakacatuṣṭayaṃ ca dattvā pacet| vīrādīn kalkān sāmānyaparibhāṣoktapramāṇān nikṣipet| tat-ghṛtaṃ, pakvaṃ pūtaṃ pṛthak śarkarātugayoś cūrṇaprasthena kaṇāyāḥ palacatuṣṭayena maricapalena ca yojayet| tvagādibhiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ pṛthag ardhapalonmitaiḥ kṣaudrasya kuḍavayugalena yojayet| tato miśritāt palamātraṃ pratidinaṃ bhakṣayet, māṃsarasakṣīrabhojī san| tenopayuktena turaṅga ivārohati| caṭaka iva hṛṣyati|

------------------------------------------------|
vidārīpippalīśālipiyālekṣurakād rajaḥ||21||
pṛthak svaguptāmūlac ca kuḍavāṃśaṃ tathā madhu|
tulārdhaṃ śarkarācūrṇāt prasthārdhaṃ navasarpiṣaḥ||22||
so 'kṣamātram ataḥ khādet yasya rāmāśataṃ gṛhe| ------------------------------------------------|23|

Sa. vidāryādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ kapikacchumūlāc ca cūrṇaṃ pṛthak kuḍavamātraṃ, mākṣikasya ca kuḍavaḥ, śarkarāpalāni pañcāśat, pratyagraghṛtasya palāni ṣoḍaśa, ataḥ-saṃyojitāt, karṣamātraṃ sa khādet yasya bhavane kāntāśatam asti|

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
sātmaguptāphalān kṣīre godhūmān sādhitān himān||23||

lg.l: jāgarti rātriṃ sakalām akhinnaḥ khedayan striyaḥ||24||

div.ab: Sa. godhūmān sakapikacchuphalān dugdhe sādhitān himān māṣān vā ghṛtamākṣikānvitān khādan gṛṣṭikṣīram anu pibed yaḥ, sa sarvāṃ rātrim akhinno rāmā ramayan jayati(jāgarti)|

lg.l: yaḥ khādet sasitān gacchet sa strīśatam apūrvavat||25||

div.ab: Sa. chāgalāṇḍapakve kṣīre tilān asakṛd bhāvitān saśarkarān yaḥ khādet, sa kāntāśatam apūrva iva yāti|
Sa. śṛgālikāyāś cūrṇaṃ vidārīsvarasenaiva bahuśo bhāvitaṃ madhughṛtayuktaṃ līḍhvā rāmāśataṃ yāti|

kṛṣṇādhātrīphalarajaḥ svarasena subhāvitam|
śarkarāmadhusarpirbhir līḍhvā yo 'nu payaḥ pibet||27||
sa naro 'śītivarṣo 'pi yuveva parihṛṣyati| ------------------------------------------------|28|
Sa. kṛṣṇāmalakacūrṇaṃ dhātrīsvarasena subhāvitaṃ śarkarākṣaudraghṛtair līḍhvā yo 'nu kṣīraṃ pibet, sa puruṣo 'śītivarṣo 'pi taruṇa iva hṛṣyati|

------------------------------------------------|
karṣaṃ madhukacūrṇasya ghṛtakṣaudrasamanvitam||28||
payo 'nupānaṃ yo lihyān nityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet| ------------------------------------------------|29|
Sa. madhuyaṣṭikācūrṇasya karṣaṃ ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ kṣīrānupānaṃ yo leḍhi, so 'praṇaṣṭavegaḥ puruṣaḥ syāt|

------------------------------------------------|
kulīraśṛṅgyā yaḥ kalkam āloḍya payasā pibet||29||
sitāghṛtapayonnāśī sa nārīṣu vṛṣāyate| ------------------------------------------------|30|
Sa. karkaṭaśṛṅgyāḥ kalkaṃ kṣīreṇāloḍya yaḥ pibed charkarāsarpiḥkṣīrānnabhuk, sa rāmāsu vṛṣāyate|

------------------------------------------------|
yaḥ payasyāṃ payaḥsiddhāṃ khāden madhughṛtānvitām||30||
pibed bāṣkayaṇaṃ cānu kṣīraṃ na kṣayam eti saḥ| ------------------------------------------------|31|
Sa. kṣīrakākolīṃ kṣīrasiddhām mākṣikaghṛtayutāṃ yaḥ khādet, baṣkayaṇīkṣīram anuḥ yaḥ pibet, sa śukrakṣayaṃ na yāti|

------------------------------------------------|
svayaṃguptekṣurakayor bījacūrṇaṃ saśarkaram||31||
dhāroṣṇena naraḥ pītvā payasā rāsabhāyate| ------------------------------------------------|32|
Sa. kapikacchvikṣurakabījacūrṇaṃ śarkarāsahitaṃ dhāroṣṇena kṣīreṇa pītvā naro bāleya ivācarati|

ab.seg:
------------------------------------------------|
uccaṭācūrṇam apy evaṃ śatāvaryāś ca yojayet||32||

div.ab: Sa. uccaṭāyāḥ śatāvaryāś ca cūrṇam evam eva yojayet|
Sa. dadhnaḥ saraṃ śaśidhavalaṃ śarkarāṣaṣṭikaudanayuktaṃ vastreṇa subhāvi(mārji)taṃ bhuktvā vṛddho 'pi taruṇa ivācarati|
Sa. śvadaṃṣṭrādīn kṣīreṇa piban vṛddho 'pi rāmāśataṃ yāti|

lg.l: yat kiñcin madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ balavardhanam|
manaso harṣaṇaṃ yac ca tat sarva vṛṣyam ucyate||35||

div.ab: Sa. yat kiñcid vastu madhurādiguṇaṃ cittaharṣajananaṃ ca, tat sarvam api vṛṣyaṃ kathyate|

lg.l: dravyair evaṃvidhais tasmād darpitaḥ pramadāṃ vrajet|

div.ab: Sa. tasmād evaṃprakāralir dravyaiḥ kṛtadarpaḥ śataṃ lalanānāṃ yāyāt| na kevalaṃ vṛṣyadravyair darpito yāvad ātmavegena codīrṇaḥ-preritaḥ| na tu vājīkaraṇaṃ me yuktam iti yoṣitaṃ gacchet| strīguṇaiḥ-lāvaṇyakaumalyādibhiḥ , kṛtapraharṣaḥ san|

Sa. tathā viṣayātiśayāḥ-manoharāḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ, sevanīyāḥ \\\\\ kimbhutāḥ ? sarvendriyāṇāṃ sukhahetavaḥ, tathā dharma eva kalpavṛkṣe 'ṅkurā ivāṅkurāḥ| tathā puṣpacāpasya pañcaśilīmukhā iti vākyarūpakam|

lg.l: iṣṭā hy ekaikaśo 'py arthā harṣaprītikarāḥ param|
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṅghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ||38||

div.ab: Sa. yasmād ekaiskaśo 'pi-vyastā api, arthāḥ-śabdādayaḥ sevyamānāḥ, paraṃ harṣaprītyutpādakāḥ| kim uta striyāḥ śarīre ye samudāyena vyavasthitāḥ|

lg.l: nāmāpi yasyā hṛdayotsavāya yāṃ paśyatāṃ tṛptir anāptapūrvā|
priyaṃvadā tulyamanaḥśayā yā sā strī vṛṣatvāya paraṃ narasya||40||

div.ab: Sa. yasyāḥ striyā nāmāpi hṛdayotsavāya| yaṃ striyam ālokayatām anāptapūrvā tṛptiḥ syāt| tathā yā'śeṣāṇāṃ karaṇānām ākarṣaṇapāśaḥ| tathā kāntasya-bhartuḥ, anuvartanaṃ tad eva vrataṃ tatra yā dīkṣitā| indravajrāvṛttam| tathā kalādaya eva vibhūṣā yasyāḥ saivam| tathā śuciḥ-antarbahiś ca, lajjānvitā, rahasi surate, prauḍhā| tathā saumyavacanā| tathā tulyaḥ-samo, manaḥśayo-manasijo, yasyāḥ saivaṃ yā, sā strī-vāmalocanā, paraṃ atiśayena, puṃso vṛṣatvāya kalpate| upajātiḥ|

lg.l: ācarec ca sakalāṃ raticaryā kāmasūtravihitām anavadyām|

div.ab: Sa. tathā kāmasūtre vihitā yā sakalā raticaryā tām agarhyāṃ deśādivaśād ācaret| tathā vaidyakaśāstrācāre 'viruddhām| svāgatāvṛttam|

lg.l: tāmbūlam acchamadirā kāntā kāntā niśā śaśāṅkāṅkā|
yad yac ca kiñcid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājīkaraṃ tat tat||45||

div.ab: Sa. tathā'bhyañjanādi vājīkaraṇam iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ| gītādikuśalās tulyasvabhāvā vaśagāḥ sahāyāḥ| tathā dīrghikākrīḍāpuṣkariṇī, svagṛhasamīpe kṛtā| padmareṇumadhudbhyāṃ mattā vihaṅgā yasyāṃ saivam| haritasamabhūbhāgaṃ yat parvataśṛṅgaṃ, tasya nitambaḥ, tatra ca yāni kānanāni, tāni purasamīpabhūtāni| upajātisvāgate vṛtte| dṛṣṭisukhakāriṇī tathā nānāprakārā mahīruhajātiḥ| kalakaṇṭhakūhitaṃ śravaṇasukhakāri| aṅge sukhānurodhena ṛtvanurodhena ca bhūṣaṇam| tathā sakalaḥ parivāro manaḥsukhahetuḥ| tathā tāmbūlādikaṃ vājīkaraṇam| na ca kevalaṃ tāmbūlādikam, api tu yad yac ca kiñcic cetasaḥ priyaṃ tat tat vājīkaraṇam| dodhakam udgītir āryā|

lg.l: madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kalaraṇanā parivādinī priyeva|
kusumacayamanoramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā||46||
deśe śarīre ca na kācid arti- rartheṣu nālpo 'pi manovighātaḥ|
vājīkarāḥ sannihitāś ca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti||47||

div.ab: Sa. tathā mārdvīkaṃ sajalajaṃ dayitāvadanam iva| parivādinī-vīṇā, madhurakvaṇanā vallabheva| puṣpanikararamaṇīyā śayyā pallavavatī kusumapradhānā lateva| puṣpitāgreti vṛttanāmaśleṣaḥ| deśa ity ādi| ete padārthāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ-icchāṃ pūrayanti, kāmam utpādayantīty arthaḥ| puṣpitāgrendravajre vṛtte|

ab.seg:
adhunā'gryasaṅgraham āha--
-- mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare, tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭodbhavaṃ, lājāś chardiṣu, bastijeṣu girijaṃ, meheṣu dhātrīniśe|
pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo 'bhayā'nilakaphe, plīhāmaye pippalī, sandhāne kṛmijā, viṣe śukatarur medonile gugguluḥ||48||

lg.l: sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ, krimiṣu kṛmighnaṃ, śoṣe surā cchāgapayo 'tha māṃsam||49||
akṣyāmayeṣu triphalā, guḍūcī vātāsraroge, mathitaṃ grahaṇyām|
kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ, sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca||50||
unmādaṃ ghṛtam anavaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ, vyapasmṛtiṃ brahmī|
māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ, laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ, stabdhagātratāṃ svedaḥ|

ab.seg: navanītakhaṇdamarditam auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram| nasyaṃ mūrdhavikārān, vidradhim acirottham asravisrāvaḥ||53||
nasyaṃ kavalo mukhajān, nasyāñjanatarpaṇāni netrarujaḥ| vṛddhatvaṃ kṣīraghṛte, mūrcchāṃ śītambumārutacchāyāḥ||54||

samaśuktārdrakamātrā mande vahnau, śrame surā snānam|
duḥkhasahatve sthairye vyāyāmo, gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre||55||

lg.l: vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī, triphalā guggulur vraṇe||56||

ab.seg: bastir vātavikārān, paittān rekaḥ, kaphodbhavān vamanam| kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ, sarpiḥ pittaṃ, samīraṇaṃ tailam||57||

lg.l: ity agryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam|

div.ab: Sa. mustāparpaṭakaṃ jvare śreṣṭhaṃ-rogopaśamanahetuḥ| evaṃ śeṣeṣv api yojyam| sandhāne-uraḥsandhāne, kṛmijā-lākṣā, śreṣṭhā| śukataruḥ-śirīṣaḥ| śārdūlavikrīḍitaṃ vṛttam| vṛṣādayo raktapittādiṣu śreṣṭhāḥ| upajātiḥ| akṣyāmayādiṣu triphalādīni sevyāni| indravajrā| anavaṃ-purāṇaṃ, sarpiḥ kartṛbhūtam unmādaṃ jayati| vyapasmṛtiṃ-apasmāraṃ, brāhmī jayati| evaṃ kṣīrādayo nidrānāśādīn jayantīti yojyam| guḍamañjarī-kālā śālmalī, tasyāḥ khapuro-niryāso, nasyena skandhādijāṃ rujaṃ hanti| navanītayuktaṃ khaṇḍamarditam| auṣṭraṃ payo mūtraṃ ca jaṭharaṃ parākaroti| auṣṭram iti cintyam| uṣṭrādruñi prāpte kecit tu tasyedam iti vivakṣayā aṇpratyayaḥ kārya ity āhuḥ| nasyādayo mūrdhavikārādīn jahatīti sambandhaḥ| nanu, vṛddhatvaṃ kṣīraghṛte hata ity anupapannam| tathā hi-"ekarasābhyāso daurbalyakarāṇām|" (ca. sū. a. 25) ity uktam| daurbalyakaraṇaṃ ca kathaṃ vṛddhatvahṛt syāt ? brūmaḥ| utsargatvāt tasya vacasaḥ, apavādarūpaṃ tv idaṃ vacanam| tasmāt kṣīraghṛtād anyatraikarasābhyāsasya daurbalyakaraṇtvaṃ vedyam| gītayas tisraḥ(pañca)| kāsety ādi| [ bastir ity ādi|] āryā| iti-uktena prakāreṇa, yac chreṣṭham auṣadham uktam, tad rogāṇāṃ śamāya-śāntyai, alaṃ-samartham| tac ca-agnyaṃ, deśādīnāṃ balena yathāsvaṃ kalpanīyam| jaghanacapalā''ryā| etac ca yathāsvaṃ cikitsiteṣu kathitaṃ saṅkṣepatayā punaḥ kathitam| śāstraṃ hi vyāsena samāsena ca vimatayo virundhate| tasmāt pūrvaṃ vyāsenopadeśaḥ, idaṃ(ayaṃ) tu samāsenety avabudhyasva|

lg.l: ity ātreyād āgamayyārthasūtraṃ tatsūktānāṃ peśalānām atṛptaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ātreyāt-bhagavataḥ punarvasoḥ, iti-uktena prakāreṇa, arthasūtraṃ-abhidheyatattvaṃ ca, āgamayya-avabudhya, agniveśaḥ saṃśayāno-na tu śāstrāvabodhāhaṃkṛtaḥ, idaṃ-vakṣyamāṇaṃ, papraccha| kimbhūtaḥ ? tasya-ātreyasya muneḥ, sūktāni-subhāṣitāni, yuktiyuktārthapratipādanāt teṣāṃ sūktānāṃ madhurāṇām atṛptaḥ sākāṅkṣaḥ| tathā ca kimbhūtaḥ ? bheḍajātūkarṇyādīnāṃ punarvasuśiṣyāṇāṃ sammataḥ| tathā bhaktinamro-na tu jñānoddhataḥ san, sa papraccha| śālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg:
kiṃ pṛṣṭavān ? ity āha--
-- dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ|
dravyopasthātṛsampannā vṛddhavaidyamatānugāḥ||60||

kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato 'gniveśamukhyasya|
śiṣyagaṇasya punarvasu- rācakhyau kārtsnyatas tattvam||62||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-bhagavan-punarvaso, kecin narā ātmavanto hitāhāravihārā api rogiṇaḥ pratyakṣānumānādyair upalabhyante| ātmavanto 'pīty apiśabdād anātmavanto 'pi| kadācit śeṣapādatrayavikalatvena rogitvaṃ syāt, nety āha-dravyopasthātṛsampannā vṛddhavaidyamatānugā iti| tathā''mayāś ca prāṇāś cāmayaprāṇāḥ, kṣīyamāṇā āmayaprāṇā yeṣāṃ ta evam, kecid rogād vimucyamānāḥ kecic ca mriyamāṇā ity arthaḥ| viparītās tathā'para iti anātmavanto dravyopasthātṛvikalā vṛddhavaidyamatānanusāriṇaś caivaṃbhāvā dṛśyante| tasmāt-anantaroktāt kāraṇāt, hitāhitavibhāgasya tantroktaṃ phalam aniścitaṃ-anaikāntikam| aniścitaphalatvāc ca kāraṇāt śāstraṃ-āyurvedākhyaṃ, kiṃ śāsti ? na-kiñcic chikṣayatīti| ataś caitadārambho niṣphalaḥ kākadantaparīkṣāśāstravat| iti vikalpayataḥ śiṣyagaṇasya-jātūkarṇyabheḍādeḥ, bhagavān punarvasus tattvaṃ-paramārthaṃ, kārtsnyena-sāmastyena, jagāda| kimbhūtasya śiṣyagaṇasya ? agniveśo mukhyaḥ-pradhāno, yasya tasyeti|

ab.seg:
kiṃ tad uktavān? ity āha--
-- na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati|
vinā'pi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśayā||63||

div.ab: Sa. cikitsā-catuṣpātṣoḍaśaguṇayuktā, acikitsā-hitāhitavibhāgāparāmarśe yatkiñcanakāritā, sā tulyā bhavituṃ nārhati| keṣām ? kriyāṃ vinā svāsthyam api gacchatām| apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ, svāsthyam apī'tyato 'nantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| kimbhūtayā kriyayā ? ṣoḍaśāṃśayā| tad ayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-ṣoḍaśa bhāgayā cikitsayā vinā yatra rogopaśāntiḥ syāt, tatrāpi cikitsayā kṣiprataraṃ tatsādhanaṃ cikitsā viśiṣṭā| tathā cikitsāsādhyānāṃ rohiṇikādīnāṃ cikitsām antareṇa śāntir nāsti| tad evam api cikitsayā tulyā'cikitsā na bhavitum arhatīti|

Sa. tasmād ātaṅka eva paṅko duruttaratvāt tasmin magnānāṃ taptānāṃ, bhiṣagjitaṃ-tadupadeśakaśāstraṃ, upacārād evam uktam| tad bhiṣagjitaṃ hastālambo-hastālambatulyam| mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām evāsādhyānām api bheṣajāj jīvitaṃ na ca bhavati|

lg.l: na hy upāyam apekṣante sarve rogā, na cānyathā|

div.ab: Sa. yasmāt sarve rogāḥ-asādhyā api, upāyaṃ-catuṣpādalakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ, nāpekṣante, asādhyarogāṇāṃ cikitsānirapekṣatvāt| ye copāyasādhyā rogāḥ-rohiṇyādayaḥ, te 'nyathā cikitsām antareṇa, naiva sidhyanti| yato yo 'hetuḥ sa hetumān na bhavati| api tu niryuktika evāyaṃ hetuvādaḥ, yac cikitsākhyena hetunā vinaiva rogopaśāntir ddaśya iti|

lg.l: mṛtyur bhavati, tan naivaṃ nopāye 'sty anupāyatā||66||

div.ab: Sa. yat tūktaṃ sarvasampattiyuktayā'pi cikitsayā mṛtyur bhavati| dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ| yāvat kṣīyamāṇāmayaprāṇāḥ ity ādi| tad evaṃ na bhavati, yathā tvaṃ vadasi| yasmān na upāye 'nupāyatā'sti| yo hi yasya yayā yuktyopāyaḥ prathitaḥ, sa na kadācit tasyānupāyaḥ| yathā,-ghaṭasya mṛddaṇḍacakrādisāmagrīviśeṣo na kadācid anupāyo bhavitur mahati| tasmāc catuṣpāccikitsāsādhyasya rogasyopāya eva cikitsā, na tv anupāyaḥ|

lg.l: na sidhyed daivavaiguṇyān na tv iyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā||67||

div.ab: Sa. dhīmataḥ-prājñasya narasya, upāyayuktasyāpi daivāparādhāt iyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmikā kriyā kadācin na sidhyati| ta(ya)smād āyuḥ parīkṣya sādhyāsādhyavibhāgjño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsāyāṃ vaidyaḥ pravartate tasmād daivavaiguṇyam| vimalavipulamatyā samyak paricchedāc cikitsāyā rogaviṣaye pravṛttāyāḥ siddhir eva syān nāsiddhiḥ| yasmād yo yatropāyaḥ, sa tatrānupāyo na bhavati| muninā'py uktam (ca.sū. a. 10/7)-"sādhyāsādhyavībhāgajño jñānapūrvaṃ cikitsakaḥ| kāle cārabhate karma yat tat sādhayati dhruvam||" iti|

ab.seg:
etad eva pratipādayann āha--
-- kasyāsiddho 'gnitoyādiḥ svedastambhādikarmaṇi|
na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam||68||

lg.l: kaḥ prāptaḥ kalyatāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu||70||

div.ab: Sa. kasya puruṣasya vahniḥ svedakarmaṇi, stambhanakarmaṇi ca toyaṃ, na siddham| ādiśabdān mūrcchāpagamādau śītānilādiḥ| api tu sarvasyaiva siddho 'nvayavyatirekāt| evaṃ yāvad rohiṇikādiṣv iti vyākhyeyam| evaṃ niścitaphalā cikitseti sthitam|

Sa. na kevalaṃ pūrvoktād dhetoś cikitsātantraṃ saphalam| yataś cākālamaraṇaṃ sarvasiddhāntaniścitam| tad anyathā-cikitsāśāstram antareṇa, parameṇāpi yatnena kathaṃ-kena prakāreṇa, nirvāyatām ? na kenacid ity arthaḥ|

ab.seg:
na cākālamṛtyurakṣaiva prayojanam asya tantrasyety āha--
-- candanādy api dāhādau rūḍham āgamapūrvakam|
śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇam||72||

div.ab: Sa. dāhādau viṣaye candanādi cāgamapūrvakam eva lokarūḍham, na tv evam eva| tathā śāstrād eva-cikitsākhyāt, sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ jvare laṅghanabṛṃhaṇaṃ bhaktacchedakṣīrādi siddhim upagatam, nānyasmāt|
Sa. tasmāc catuṣpādā[nāṃ] ye guṇāḥ-āyuṣkamīyoktāḥ (hṛ.sū.a. 1/27), taiḥ sampanne-yukte, tathā suṣṭhu nirūpya deśakālādīn yojite cikitsite, vyādhinirghātaṃ prati vicikitsāṃ-saṃśayaṃ, mā kṛthāḥ|

lg.l: etad dhi mṛtyupāśānām akāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham|

div.ab: Sa. yataś cākāṇḍe-akāle, mṛtyupāśāḥ-jvarādayas teṣāṃ etat-cikitsāśāstraṃ, dṛḍhaṃ-sāraṃ, chedanam| tathā samutpannebhyo jvarādibhyas trastānāṃ śaṅkayā bhītānāṃ sūtrarahitaṃ rakṣāsūtrakaṃ, tatkāryakaraṇād ity arthaḥ| tasmād adhyetavyaṃ cikitsāśāstram|

Sa. tathaitat-cikitsāśāstraṃ, tat-sakalalokaprasiddhaṃ, sākṣāt-svarūpeṇa, amṛtaṃ mṛtyujaye, ta(ya)t lokaprasiddhaṃ jagataḥ surāsurarūpasya, āyāsād utpannaṃ kṣīrodamathanakāle, tena varjitam idam| amṛtam api durbhājanasthitaṃ sadyaḥ-śīghram eva, viṣatvaṃ yāti|

ab.seg:
tad eva durbhājanaṃ darśayati--
-- ajñātaśāstrasadbhāvān śāstramātraparāyaṇān|
tyajed dūrād bhiṣakpāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva||76||

div.ab: Sa. ajñātaḥ śāstrasadbhāvaḥ-paramārtho, yais tāṃs tathāvidhān bhiṣakpāśān dūratas tyajet| tathā śāstramātraparāyaṇān-śāstrapāṭhamātraśaraṇān| ata eva viṣasāmānyataḥ śāstrapāṭhamātratvena niṣiddham| tathā śāstraparamārthānavabodhāc ca viṣatvam| kān iva ? vaivasvātān-yamasambandhinaḥ, pāśān yathā| iti tāvad asampūrṇān|

ab.seg:
samyagbhiṣajaḥ ślāghamāno brūte ----
bhiṣajāṃ sādhuvṛttānāṃ bhadram āgamaśālinām|
abhyastakarmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām||77||

div.ab: Sa. suvaidyānāṃ saccaritānām iha loke 'nyatra ca sadaiva bhadram| kiṃvidhānām ? āgamena-granthato 'rthataḥ, ślāghituṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣām| īdṛśā apy anabhyastakarmāṇo na ślāghārhāḥ syur ity āha, abhyastaṃ-asakṛt tailalehādipākādyanuvāsananirūhādiyojanaṃ ca, [karma] yais teṣāṃ lokadvaye 'pi bhadram| sarvasattvānāṃ putramitrādirūpeṇa bhadram iva hitaṃ sukhaṃ cābhilaṣanti-icchanti ye, teṣām api bhadraṃ-śastam|

lg.l: cikitsāśāstram akhilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam||78||
tasmād analpaphalam alpasamudyamānāṃ prītyartham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram||80||

div.ab:
Sa. tantryate-dhāryate śarīram aneneti tantram, tasya guṇās tantraguṇāḥ,-yais tantram alaṅkriyate tantrayuktyādayaḥ, tair evazṃprakārair yuktam| tathā coktaṃ saṅgrahe (u. a.50)-"alaṅkṛtaṃ yuktipadaiḥ sadratnair iva kāñcanam| ṣaṭtriṃśatā'rthadurgeṣu bhiṣajāṃ saṅkramair iva||
tatrādhikaraṇaṃ yogo hetvartho 'rthaḥ padasya ca|
pradeśoddeśanirdeśavākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam||
upadeśāpadeśātideśārthāpattinirṇayāḥ|
prasaṅgaikāntanaikāntāḥ sāpavargo viparyayaḥ||
pūrvapakṣavidhānānumatavyākhyānasaṃśayāḥ|
atītānāgatāpekṣāsvasaṃjñohyasamuccayāḥ||
nidarśanaṃ nirvacanaṃ niyogo 'tha vikalpanam|
pratyutsāras tathoddhāraḥ sambhavas tantrayuktayaḥ||" iti| tatra 1 adhikaraṇaṃ nāma,-yad adhikṛtya pravartate śāstraṃ sthānam adhyāyaḥ prakaraṇaṃ vākyaṃ vā| tatra śāstrādhikaraṇaṃ-yad adhikṛtya śāstraṃ pravartate| yathā-aṣṭāv aṅgāny adhikṛtya hṛdayākhyaṃ sarvaṃ śāstraṃ pravṛttam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a. 1/5)-"kāyabāla" ity ādi| sthānādhikaraṇaṃ yathā (hṛ.sū.a. 30/53)-"atrārthāḥ sūtritāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pratanyante hi sarvataḥ|" iti| adhyāyo 'pi yad adhikṛtya pravartate tad adhyāyādhikaraṇaṃ| yathā (hṛ. sū. a . 2)_"athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" iti| prakaraṇaṃ yad adhikṛtya pravartate tat prakaraṇādhikaraṇam| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/18)-"daśa mūlasirā hṛtsthās tāḥ sarvaṃ sarvato vapuḥ|" ity ādi yāvat "ity avedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" ity ādi| evaṃ vākyam api yad adhikṛtya pravartate tad vākyādhikaraṇaṃ vedyam| 2 yogo nāma,-yojanā, uddeśanirdeśayoḥ sūtrabhāṣyaryor vā| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3)-"athāto 'ṅgavibhāgaṃ śārīraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" ity uddiśyāṅgāni vibhajate-"śiro 'ntarādhir dvau bāhū sakthinī ca samāsataḥ| ṣaḍaṅgam" ity ādi| yuktir vā yogaḥ, pratijñā hetur dṛṣṭānta upanayo nigamanam iti pañcavidhaḥ| yathā-agniḥ śarīrasthiter mūlam iti pratijñā| agnipakvāhāre sati tastthiter iti hetuḥ, "tatrāgnir hetur āhārān na hy apakvād rasādayaḥ|" (hṛ.śā. a.3/54) iti vacanāt| yathā-śālyaṅkurasya bījam iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ| upanayo yathā-cikitsāśāstrasya prayojanatvasādhanāya bahudhā dṛṣṭāntopanayaṃ kṛtavāṃs tantrakṛt, "kasyāsiddho 'gnitoyādiḥ" (hṛ.u. a.40/68) ityādayaḥ| tasmāt saprayojanam eva cikitsāśāstraṃ pratyakṣaphalatvād ity upanayaḥ| tasmād ārambhaṇīyam iti pramāṇapadopadarśanamukhena nigamanam| yathoktam(hṛ.u. a.
40/73)-catuṣpādguṇasampanne samyag ālocya yojite|
mā kṛthā vyādhinirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite||" sādhyavyādhicikitsāyāṃ saṃśayānupapattyā pratipāditayā pramāṇaphalopasaṃhārakaraṇam| 3 hetvartho nāma,-yad anyaprastāvoktam anyatrāpi tathaivopapadyate| yathā (hṛ. śā. a.3/20)-"tatraikaikaṃ ca śākhāyāṃ śataṃ tasmin na vedhayet| sirāṃ jālandharāṃ nāma tisraś cābhyantarāśritāḥ||" ity ādi| tathā (hṛ.śā.a.3/34)-"avedhyāḥ saṅkīrṇā grathitāḥ kṣudrāḥ ity ādi| tad etebhyo viśeṣavacanebhyo 'numīyate śeṣā vedhyā iti| anyathaitāni vacāṃsi nirarthakāni syur iti|

Sa. 4 padārtho nāma,-padenārtho gamyate| yathā-dravyam iti padam, tasyārtho bhūjalādiḥ| guṇa iti padam, tasyārtho gurvādiḥ| 5 pradeśo nāma,-yeṣām arthānām atibahutvāt sākalyenābhidhānasyāśakyatvāt stokam ucyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū.a.5/84)-"iti dravaikadeśo 'yaṃ yathāsthūlam udāhṛtaḥ|" iti|
Sa. 6 uddeśo nāma,-saṅkṣepābhidhānam| yathā (hṛ. sū. a. 1/6)-"vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaś ceti trayo doṣāḥ samāsataḥ| ity ādi|
Sa. 7 nirdeśo nāma,-tasyaiva vistāroktiḥ| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a. 1/11)-"tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaś calo 'nilaḥ|" iti|

Sa. 8 vākyaśeṣo nāma,-yasmin sūtre lāghavikenārthād gamya mānam anuktapūraṇārtham adhyāhriyate| yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/3)-"tatra khāt khāni dehe 'smin" 'bhavanti' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ| "āpyā jihvārasakaledāḥ" (hṛ.śā. a.3/4) ity uttaratra bhavārthe taddhitaśravaṇāt|
Sa. 9 prayojanaṃ nāma,-yadarthaṃ śāstrādi pravartate| yathā (hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"ātaṅkapaṅkamagnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣagjitam|" iti| anena prayojanena cikitsāśāstram adhyeyam ity ādi|

Sa. 10 upadeśo nāma,-āptavacanam| yathā(hṛ.sū. a.17/29)-"snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhāsthisaṃsthāḥ| doṣāḥ svedais te dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyakśuddhibhVir nirhriyante||" ity ādi|

Sa. 11 apadeśo nāma,-yad ācāryaḥ kiñcid arthaṃ pratijñāya hetum upadiśati| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/64)-"jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt|" iti pratijñāya hetum āha(hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"na hy apāyayapekṣante sarve rogāḥ" sarvarogāṇām upāyāpekṣābhāvāt|

Sa. 12 atideśo nāma,-yat kiñcid evārthajātam uktvā'nuktārthasādhanāya evam anyad api pratyetavyam iti paribhāṣāyāṃ sthāpayati| yathoktaṃ karṇarogapratiṣedhe (hṛ.u. a.
18/4)-"mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṣṭhāt kṣaumeṇa veṣṭitāt|
tailasiktāt pradīptāgrāt snehaḥ sadyo rujāpahaḥ|| yojyaś caivaṃ bhadrakāṣṭhāt kuṣṭhāt kāṣṭhāc ca sāralāt|" ity ādi|

Sa. 13 arthāpattir nāma,-yo 'nyenārthenoktena tato 'paro 'pyartho gadita iva jñāyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.5/31)-"naivādyān niśi naivoṣṇam" ity uktam, na tūktaṃ divā bhuñjīteti| etac cārthāpattyā gamyate| [nanu,] kaḥ punar arthaḥ ? kā cāsyāpattiḥ ? brūmaḥ| dadhyabhyavahāro 'rthas tatra tantrakṛtā 'naivādyān niśi' iti kālo niṣiddho na tu dadhibhakṣaṇam| tato yo 'yam apratiṣiddho 'rthaḥ, sa āpadyate divā dadhibhojanārthaḥ, rātripratiṣedhe dinavyatirekeṇa kālāntarābhāvāt| sarvathā anabhyavaharaṇīyasyāhāraprastāve pratiṣedhānupapatteḥ| evam anyatrāpi vyākhyeyam|

Sa. 14 nirṇayo nāma,-yan nivāritasyārthasya pratiṣṭhāpanam| yathā(hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ|" ity ādinā cikitsāśāstraphalaṃ prati saṃśayakaraṇe paścān nirṇayārtham uktam| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/63)-"na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati|" ity ādi|

Sa. 15 prasaṅgo nāma,-pūrvābhihitasyārthasya kenacit sambandhāntareṇa punar abhidhānam| yathoktaṃ sirāvyadhavidhau (hṛ.sū. a. 27/2)-"lohitaṃ pravadec chuddhaṃ tanos tenaiva ca sthitiḥ|" ity uktvā punaḥ śārīre śuddhārtavaprasaṅgenoktam (hṛ. śā. a.1/1)-"śuddhe śukrārtave sattvaḥ svakarmakleśacoditaḥ| garbhaḥ sampadyate yuktivaśād agnir ivāraṇau||" iti| na ca punaruktatā tasya| yasmāt sirāvyadhe śarīraprabhavatvam eva raktasyoktam, na tu kramo varṇitaḥ| śārīre tu yayā''nupūrvyā śarīrahetuḥ syāt tad vistareṇoktam| yathā(hṛ.śā. a.1/2)-"bījātmakair mahābhūtaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sattvānugaiś ca saḥ| mātuś cāhārarasajaiḥ kramāt kukṣau vivardhate||" iti|

Sa. 16 ekānto nāma,-ya ekam eva pakṣam avyabhicāreṇa śrayati nānyam| tad yathā (hṛ.sū. a.
4/31)-"ye bhūtaviṣavāyvagnikṣatabhaṅgādisambhavāḥ|
rogadveṣabhayādyāś ca te syur āgantavo gadāḥ||" iti|
Sa. 17 naikānto nāma,-anyatarapakṣānavadhāraṇāt| yathā (hṛ.su. a.40/64)-"jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt|" ekāntena (hṛ.u. a. 40/64)-"na hy upā yam apekṣante sarve rogāḥ" ity ādi|

Sa. 18 apavargo nāma,-sākalyenotsṛṣṭasya yat punas tadekadeśāpakarṣaṇam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.27/4)-"śītoṣṇasnigdharūkṣādyair upakrāntāś ca ye gadāḥ| samyak sādhyā na sidhyanti te ca raktaprakopajāḥ|| teṣu srāvayituṃ raktam udriktaṃ vyadhayet sirām|" ity utsargam abhidhāya ekadeśe 'pavādaṃ vakti (hṛ.sū. a. 27/6)-"na tūnaṣoḍaśātītasaptatyabdasrutāsṛjām|" ity ādi|

Sa. 19 viparyayo nāma,-yathopadiṣṭaviparyayeṇa lakṣaṇādikaraṇam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.16/30)-"vātānulomyaṃ dīpto 'gnir varcaḥ snigdham asaṃhatam| snehodvegaḥ klamaḥ samyak snigdhe, rūkṣe viparyayaḥ||" iti|

Sa. 20 pūrvapakṣo nāma,-pratijñātārthasaṃdūṣaṇaṃ vākyam| yathā hitāhitavibhāgaṃ pratyācikhyāsann āha| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecit" ity ārabhya yāvat "hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād aniścitam|" ity ādi|
Sa. 21 vidhānaṃ nāma,-yat prakaraṇānupūrvaṃ vidhānam āvekṣyate|
Sa. 22 anumataṃ nāma,(hṛ.sū. a.9-10)-"uṣṇaṃ śītaṃ dvidhaivānye vīryam ācakṣate 'pi ca| nānātmakam api dravyam agnīṣomau mahābalau||" ity ādinā hy anumatam, na vighātaḥ kṛtaḥ|

Sa. 23 vyākhyānaṃ nāma,-yan mādṛśebhyo viśiṣṭatarabuddhigamyam| yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 1/37)-"saptahāt kalalībhavet|" (hṛ.śā. a. 1/49)-"dvitīye māsi kalalāt ghanaḥ peśy athavārbudam| puṃstrīklībāḥ kramāt" iti| na hy atra garbhasyāvartamānā bhāvāḥ śakyā vijñātuṃ yogidṛṣṭiṃ muktvā|
Sa. 24 saṃśayo nāma,-sākāṅkṣatvam aniścitavastuvijñānam| yathā (hṛ. śā. a. 5/128)-"saṃśayaṃ prāptamātrayo jīvitaṃ tasya manyate|" ity ādi|

Sa. 25 atītāpekṣaṇaṃ nāma,-yad atikrāntam apekṣya prastutasya sādhanam ucyate| yathoktaṃ hṛdrogacikitsite (hṛ.ci. a.6/39)-"rāsnājīvaka" ity ādi yāvat "mahāsnehaṃ vipācayet||" iti| atra ca na jñāyate katamo māhāsneha iti| tad etad atikrāntam apekṣya prasādhyate snehavidhyuktam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 16/4)-"dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhis tair yamakas trivṛto mahān|" ity apekṣya vyākhyāyate|

Sa. 26 [anāgatāpekṣā nāma,-] ............................ 27 svasaṃjñā nāma,-yā tantrakāraiḥ svatantrasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ praṇitā satī paratantreṣu na vyavaharati| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.12/44)-"śākhā raktādayas tvak ca" iti|

Sa. 28 ūhyaṃ nāma,-yad apratibaddhaṃ granthe svayaṃ prajñayā tarkayitvā yojyam| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.15/46)-"trayastriṃśad iti proktā vargās teṣu tv alābhataḥ| yuñjyāt tadvidham anyac ca dravyaṃ jahyād ayaugikam||' [iti|]

Sa. 29 samuccayo nāma,-yathā(hṛ.sū. a.18/29)-"peyāṃ vilepīm akṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yūṣaṃ rasaṃ" ca samuccinoti, tathā-"trīn ubhayaṃ tathaikam| krameṇa seveta naro 'nnakālān pradhānamadhyāvaraśuddhiśuddhaḥ||" iti|

Sa. 30 nidarśanaṃ nāma,-yan nidarśayitavyaṃ sūkṣmam apy arthaṃ svadharmasādṛśyāt spaṣṭīkaroty ādarśa iva mukhavidhum| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.19/84)-"yathā kusumbhādiyutāt toyād rāgaṃ haret paṭaḥ| tathā dravīkṛtād dehād bastir nirharate malān||" ity ādi|

Sa. 31 nirvacanaṃ nāma,-nirṇayārthaṃ vacanaṃ niruktam| yathoktaṃ viṣavidhāne (hṛ.u. a.35/1)-"mathyamāne jalanidhāv amṛtārthaṃ surāsuraiḥ|" yāvat "jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ||" iti| viṣasya nirvacanaṃ jagadviṣadanād viṣam iti|
Sa. 32 niyogo nāma,-yo yasyānuṣṭheyaḥ| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 16/26)-"uṣṇodakopacārī syāt" ity ādi|
Sa. 33 vikalpo nāma,-vividhaṃ kalpanam, idaṃ kāryam idaṃ vā kāryam| yathoktaṃ pūrvarūpadarśane jvarādau [vā] hitaṃ laghvaśanam apatarpaṇaṃ vā|

Sa. 34 pratyutsāro nāma,-yatropapattiṃ darśayantaḥ parasparamatāni nivārayanti| tad yathā (hṛ.śā. a.3/16)-"asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭhiś ca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha| dhanvantaris tu trīṇy āha, sandhīnāṃ ca śatadvayam|| daśottaraṃ, sahasre dve nijagādātrinandanaḥ|" iti pūrvamatāt ṣaṣṭiṃ prayutsārayati| dhanvantarer api mataṃ daśottaraṃ sandhiśatadvayam iti punarvasuḥ pratyutsārayati sandhisahasradvayaṃ sādhayan|

Sa. 35 uddāro nāma,-śāstrārambhapratyākhyānādicodyasya samādhānam| tad yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ|" yāvat "hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād aniścitam|" iti kṛte codye (hṛ.u. a.40/63)-"na cikitsā'cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati|" iti parihāraḥ|

Sa. 36 sambhavo nāma,-upapattir yasminn upapadyate anupadiṣṭe| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.26/47)-"duṣṭaraktāpagamanāt sadyo rāgarujāṃ śamaḥ|" ity uktam| pracchānālābujalaukāśṛṅgasirāvyadhair yathāsambhavaṃ raktam apanīyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.26/53)-"pracchānenaikadeśasthaṃ grathitaṃ jalajanmabhiḥ| harec chṛṅgādibhiḥ suptam asṛg vyāpi sirāvyadhaiḥ||" iti| evam anyatrāpi sambhavārtho yojyaḥ|

Sa. vyākhyā api tantrasya guṇaḥ| tābhir api tantram alaṅkriyate| tāś ca pañcadaśaprakārāḥ| tad yathā,-piṇḍapadapadārthādhikaraṇaprakaraṇārthakṛcchraphaloccitakanyāsaprayojanānulomapratilomātisūtrasamastavyākhyāḥ|

Sa. tatra 1 piṇḍavyākhyā nāma,-saṅkṣepatayā sūtrarūpeṇādhyāyādināṃ vyākhyā| yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 5/4)-"rūpendriyasvaracchayāpraticchāyākriyādiṣu| anyeṣv api ca bhāveṣu prākṛteṣv animittataḥ|| vikṛtir yā samāsena riṣṭaṃ tad iti lakṣayet|" ity anena sūtreṇa sakalariṣṭādhyāyasamāsa uktaḥ|
Sa. 2 padavyākhyā nāma,-yat padānāṃ chedaṃ kṛtvoccāraṇam| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 1)-"atha ataḥ āyuṣkāmīyaṃ adhyāyaṃ vi ā khyāsyāmaḥ|" iti saptapadaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvaṃ vyākhyātam|
Sa. 3 padāRthavyākhyā nāma,-teṣām eva padānāṃ vivaraṇam| yathā-athaśabda ānantarye adhikāre vā, ataḥśabdo hetā vityādi|

Sa. 4 adhikaraṇavyākhyā nāma,-yad vastu prakṛtam ārabhya tadanuṣaṅgeṇa vyākhyānam ārabhyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.2)-"athāto dinacaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" iti prastutya "brāhme muhūrta uttiṣṭhet svastho rakṣārtham āyuṣaḥ|" ity ādinā saiva dinacaryā vivṛtya vyākhyāyate savistarā|
Sa. 5 prakaraṇavyākhyā nāma,-yasminn arthe sūtre vā prakṛtenāprakṛtaṃ sādhyate, yathā-trilavaṇādye cūrṇe guṇān uktvā'bhayākhye evam āha 'samānaṃ pūrveṇa'iti| tatra samānaguṇatā vyākhyātā|

Sa. 6 arthavyākhyā nāma,-yatra prakaraṇe sūtre vā svabhāvasyopavarṇanaṃ kriyate| tad yathā,-prakṛtir ucyate svabhāvaḥ| sa punar āhārauṣadhadravyāṇāṃ svābhāviko gurvādiguṇayogaḥ| tad yathā,-māṣamudgayoḥ sūkaraiṇayoś ca|

Sa. 7 kṛcchravyākhyā nāma,-yatra leśata uktānām avispaṣṭanāṃ prakaraṇe sūtre vā arthānāṃ yatnata udbhāvanaṃ kriyate| tad yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/30)-"anuyāyāt pratipadaṃ sarvadharmeṣu madhyamām|" iti leśato bruvāṇaḥ śāstrakāraḥ sarveṣu hetuliṅgauṣadhādiṣu madhyamā pratipad āśrayaṇīyeti sūcayati|

Sa. 8 phalavyākhyā nāma,-yatra vastuni bahuṣv aniścitārtheṣv ekīyamateṣu prastuteṣu vastusārabhūtaṃ svamataṃ svam artham upanikṣipyaikīyamatāni tasminn eva svamate 'ntarbhāvaṃ nayati| yathā-nirūhamātrāpuṭakādiṣv iyattāyāṃ sādhyāyāṃ ca niścitāni maharṣirbhir bahūni matāni praśastāni| yathā-"dvādaśaprasṛto nirūhaḥ kāryaḥ" ity eke| "mātrāṃ tripalikāṃ kuryāt snehamākṣikayoḥ pṛthak|" (hṛ.sū. a.19/44) ity ādy anye| tad etāni matāni doṣauṣadhabalāpekṣayā svamatāntarbhāvitāni pramāṇāni ca| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.19/62)-"doṣauṣadhādibalataḥ sarvam etat pramāṇayet|" anyonyaviruddham api "samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅgaṃ tu nāsambhāvya nivartayet||" iti|

Sa. 9 uccitakavyākhyā nāma,-yasmin sūtre nidarśanabhūtāny udāharaṇāni tantrāntaḥ samakṛṣyārthaḥ śasyate| yathā-pṛthivyādiṣu ca mahābhūtasaṃjñā sthāpitā, rasādiṣu ca dhātusaṃjñā niveśitā| "rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjaśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ|" (hṛ.sū. a. 1/13) iti| punar ucyate (hṛ.śā. a.3/65)- "parasparopasaṃstambhād dhātusnehaparamparā|" iti| atra kiṃ dhātor grahaṇena bhūtāny api dhātuśabdavānyāni bhavanti ? iti|

Sa. 10 nyāsavyākhyā nāma,-yasminn adhikāre vartamāne tenādhikāraṇārthena sahitaṃ sambandham abhivīkṣyānyasyārtho vinikṣipyate| yathā (hṛ.u. a.40/60)-"dṛśyante bhagavan kecid ātmavanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ|" iti hitāhitavibhāgasya phalaṃ prati saṃśayam abhivīkṣya "na cikitsā'cikitsā tulyā bhavitum arhati|" (hṛ.u. a.40/63) ity ādinā uttaraṃ dattvā tenaiva prasaṅgenānyo 'rtho nikṣipyate| yathā (hṛ.u. a.
40/75)-"etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāj jagadāyāsavarjitam|
yāti hālāhalatvaṃ tu sadyo durbhājanasthitam||" iti| evam anyeṣām apy arthānāṃ sambandham avadhārya vyākhyārthārhā kalpanīyā|

Sa. 11 prayojanavyākhyā nāma,-yat sūtram abhidhīyamānaṃ svārthatya niṣpattau nimittabhāvam upaiti| yathā-ukto 'ṅgavibhāge 'nekadhāsirāvistaraḥ| na ca tena sirāvistareṇoktena kiñcid ihopakāro dṛśyate| yadi prakaraṇāvasare prayojanam idaṃ brūyāt "ity avedhya vibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" (hṛ.śā. a. 3/33) etadarthaṃ sirāvivaraṇaṃ pravṛttam| kaścid ayaṃ vaidyo vedhyāvedhyavibhāgaṃ sirāṇāṃ jānīyād iti|

Sa. 12 ānulomyaṃ nāma,-yena.....tatra 1-2 pradhānakalpanā dvidhā,-pradhānasya kalpanā pradhānena vā kalpanā pradhānakalpanā| pradhānasya kalpanā yathā sarpiḥ snehanam, kṣīraṃ jīvanam, madhu sandhānakṛt, ity atra madhye prakṛṣṭaguṇatvāt sarpiḥkṣīre snehanajīvane kalpyete, na tu tailatoyādiṣv api snehanajīvanatvaṃ nāstīti| mākṣikaṃ ca sandhāne pradhānatvāt sandhānakṛd ity uktam, na tu sikyakamadhuyaṣṭikādiṣv api sandhānakṛttvaṃ nāstīti| pradhānena tu kalpanā yathā-kṣīradadhitakramastunavanītakṣīraghṛtapurāṇaghṛtakilāṭāpīyūṣakūcīkāmoraṇādivargaḥ sarvaḥ kṣīravarga ity uktaḥ, kṣīraprādhānyāt| pradhānena kalpanāvyapadeśa ity eko 'rthaḥ|

Sa. 3 guṇakalpanā nāma,- yena dharmeṇopeto 'rthaḥ prayujyamānaḥ samartho bhavati, tena dharmeṇa yuktasya tasyāsāv aguṇo 'pi gurvādiṣv apāṭhād guṇa iti kalpyate| yathoktam (hṛ.sū. a.1/26)-"bhiṣak dravyāṇy upasthātā rogī pādacatuṣṭayam| cikitsitasya nirdiṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ tac caturguṇam|| ity ādi| dakṣatvādicaturguṇanirdeśaḥ sarvathā praśaṃsāguṇa iti gamyate|

Sa. 4 leśakalpanā nāma,-anupadiṣṭasya vidheḥ kaṇṭhapāṭhena yatkiñcisūtrāvayavāntaram āśrityārthaḥ kalpyate| yathā-nātra śāstre kālamṛtyor akālamṛtyor vā kiñcil lakṣaṇaṃ praṇītam| tat tu leśato 'numīyate| katham iti, yadā hi kālaniyatam āyuḥ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ bhavati, tadā riṣṭam utpadyate, na viṣamāparihāreṇa mriyamāṇe nare| uktaṃ hi (hṛ.śā. a.
5/60)-"bhiṣagbheṣajapānānnagurumitradviṣaś ca ye|
vaśagāḥ sarva evaite vijñeyāḥ samavartinaḥ||" iti| atra vikṛtivijñānīye gurumitradviṣaś ceti caśabdo 'smāc chlokāt pūrvakāṇi yāni cottarāṇi tāni sarvāṇy eva samuccinoti| samavartī hi kālo mṛtyur iṣṭaḥ, itaras tv asamavartī| ata eva cācaṣṭe tantrāntare-"kālamṛtyor eva riṣṭāni nākālamṛtyoḥ|" iti svābhiprāyaprakāśanārthaṃ tantrakāraḥ śakaṭodāharaṇaṃ dattavān| yathā-sama eva vāhyamānaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye bhaṅgapūrvarūpāṇy āpnoti| tathā niyatāyuṣaḥ svapramāṇakṣaye riṣṭasambhavaḥ| yathā ca-sa evātibhārakrāntatvād viṣamapathāśritatvād akāle 'pi kṣayam āpnoti| tathā aniyatāyuṣo riṣṭotpattim antareṇa mṛtyuḥ| yadi punar aniyatā yuṣṭo 'pi riṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇaṃ kalpyeta, tadā vārṣike ṣāṇmāsike vā'riṣṭe samutpanne śubhahetuyogān na mṛtyuḥ syāt| aniyatāyuṣo hi samyagupacārāj jīvitānuvṛttiḥ| viṣamahetvaparihārān mṛtyuḥ| ata evāniyatāyuṣam adhikṛtya rasāyanāny upadiṣṭani| tadyogād ayaṃ bahūny api varṣāṇi jīvet| niyatāyuṣas tu kālamṛtyuvarṣaśatāt pareṇa jīvitaṃ na nirdiṣṭam| yathoktaṃ śārīre (hṛ.śā.a.
5/132)_'maraṇaṃ prāṇināṃ dṛṣṭam āyuḥpuṇyobhayakṣayāt|
tayor apy akṣayād dṛṣṭaṃ viṣamāparihāriṇām||" iti| tasmād aviśeṣoktāv api niyatāyuṣa evāriṣṭotpattipūrvaṃ maraṇam iti niścitam| tathā ca "ṛtucaryādhyāyaṃ vyākhyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" (hṛ.sū. a.3) iti pratijñāyāṃ ṣaḍṛtuviśeṣe pratipattir bhavati| na tu "ṛtus tu dvādaśa niśāḥ" (hṛ.śā. a.1/26) asya ṛtor iti|

Sa. 5 vidyākalpanā nāma,-yathā sarvavidyānugatārthanirdeśe śāstrakārasya sarvavidyāsthānānupraveśa iha śāstre hita iti vacanād vinā'pīṣyate| tatra "ārdrasantānatātyāgaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a. 2/45) ity ādinā vākyena buddhivacanaviṣaya adhyātmavidyāsaṅgraha iṅgyate| "arcayed devagovipra" (hṛ.sū. a. 2/23) ity ādinā dharmaśāstropadeśasaṅgrahaḥ| tathā "jagad viṣaṇṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tenāsau viṣasaṃjñitaḥ|" (hṛ.u. a. 35/2) ity ādinā padavyutpādanān niruktakaraṇāc ca śabdavidyāyā nirakteś copasaṅgrahaḥ| "sādhake 'hani" (hṛ.śā. a. 1/73) sūtikāṃ gṛhaṃ praveśayet| tathā-"bharaṇīkṛttikāśleṣāpūrvārdrāpitṛnairrūte|" iti jyotiḥśāstroparodhaḥ| vicitrabhūṣitaśāstrasyotprekṣaṇīyam|
Sa. 6 bhakṣyakalpanā nāma,-"etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāt" (hṛ.u. a. 40/75) ity ādi|

Sa. 7 ājñākalpanā nāma,-yasyānuṣṭhāne hetuḥ samyag avantuṃ na śakyaḥ, kevalam āptavacanaṃ pramāṇīkṛtyānuṣṭhīyate| yathā-"na chindyāt tṛṇam, na bhuvaṃ likhet|" iti| na hy atra hetur vaktuṃ śakyate, etad anuṣṭheyam iti|

Sa. iyaṃ saptavidhā kalpanā viṃśatyāśrayā bhavati| yathā-1 ādilopaḥ, 2 madhyalopaḥ, 3 antalopaḥ, 4 ubhayapadalopaḥ, 5 ādimadhyāntalopaḥ, 6 varṇopajananam, 7 ṛṣikliṣṭam, 8 tantraśīlam, 9 tantrasaṃjñā, 10 prākṛtam, 11 samānatantrapratyayaḥ, 12 paratantrapratyayaḥ, 13 hetuhetukadharmaḥ, 14 kāryakāraṇadharmaḥ, 15 ādyantaviparyayaḥ, 16 śabdāntaram, 17,pratyayaḥ 18 upanayaḥ 19 sambhavaḥ 20 vibhavaḥ, [iti|]

Sa. tatra 1 ādilopo [nāma],-yathā (hṛ.sū. 2|a.6/32)-"bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano vṛṣyaś cakṣuṣyo vraṇahā rasaḥ|" ity atra māṃsaśabdalopena| tathā ca (hṛ.ni. a. 1/14)-"dhāraṇodīraṇaniśā" ityādau dhāraṇaṃ-vegadhāraṇam, udīraṇaṃ-vegodīraṇam iti|

Sa. 2 madhlopo [nāma],- yathā(hṛ.sū. a. 5)-"dravadravyavijājānīyam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|" ity atra dravadravyasvarūpa vijñānīyo dravadravyavijñānīya ity uktaḥ, anantaraṃ "annasvarūpavijñānīyaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a.6) ity atra svarūpaśabdaśravaṇāt|

Sa. 3 antalopo nāma,-yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/37)-"kaphaṃ punaḥ| gauryaḥ snigdhāḥ śirāḥ śītā vahante" ity atrāsraśabdasya lopo draṣṭavyaḥ, pūrvatrāsraśabdasya prakṛtatvāt| yathoktam (hṛ.śā. a.3/36)-"tatra śyāvāruṇāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pūrṇariktāḥ kṣaṇāt sirāḥ| praspandinyaś ca vātāsram" iti| evam ihāpi kaphāsraṃ vahanta ity anumeyam, tulyajātīyatvāt|

Sa. 4 ubhayapadalopo [nāma],-yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/57)-"ādau ṣaḍrasam apy annaṃ madhurībhūtam īrayet|" iti vacane 'madhye' "vidhāhād amlatāṃ tataḥ|| pittam āmāśayāt kuryāc cyavamānaṃ cyutaṃ punaḥ|" 'ante' agninā śoṣitaṃ pakvaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kaṭu mārutam||" iti| ādiśabdaśravaṇāt madhyāntaśabdāv atra luptanirdiṣṭau draṣṭavyau|
Sa. 5 ādimadhyāntalopo [nāma], yathā(hṛ.śā. a.3/55)-"annaṃ kāle 'bhyavahṛtaṃ" ādau "koṣṭhaṃ prāṇānilāhṛtam|" madhye, ante ca "dravaiḥ" ity ādi|

Sa. 6 varṇopajananaṃ nāma,- yatrānukto granthe varṇa ācāryeṇa paścād vyākhyākāla upajanyārtho 'bhidhīyate| [yathā] (hṛ.śā. a. 3/3)-"tatra khāt khāni dehe 'smin śrotraṃ śabdo viviktatā|" tathā-"vātāt sparśatvagucchvāsā vahner dṛgrūpapaktayaḥ||" 'bhavanti' iti varṇatrayam upajanya vyākhyā karaṇīyā| "āpyā jihvārasakaledā ghrāṇagandhāsthi pārthivam|" iti dvayor bhūtayor bhavārthe taddhitapratyayaśravaṇāt| vākyaśeṣo 'py ayam evaṃprāya eva|
Sa. 7 ṛṣikliṣṭaṃ nāma,-yad ṛṣī ṛṣiputro vā'samāhitacittatayā'śaktyā vā kiñcit padajātama(jātaṃ)bhraṣṭam uccāritavān tathaiva tal loke prayuñyate| yathā-'roma loma' ity ādi|

Sa. 8 tantraśīlaṃ nāma,-yā tantrakārāṇāṃ prakṛtiḥ svabhāva ity arthaḥ| yathā-kiñcic chaṣyānugrahārthaṃ vistīrṇaṃ saṅkṣipanti, yathā (hṛ.śā. a. 3/16)-"asthnāṃ śatāni ṣaṣṭiś ca trīṇi dantanakhaiḥ saha|" iti na tāny aṅgulihastapādamaṇibandhādivibhāgena vistāritāni| kiñcid vistārayanti, yathā-tatraivāṅgavibhāge sirā vistāritāḥ (hṛ.śā. a. 3/33)-"ity avedhyavibhāgārthaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ varṇitāḥ sirāḥ|" iti vacanād iti|

Sa. 9 tantrasaṃjñā nāma,-yat kasmiṃścid arthe madhye vyākhyāyamāne svatantrasiddhodāharaṇaṃ tatpramāṇārtham ucyate| yathā-navajvare kaṣāyā apakveṣu doṣeṣu varjanīyā uktāḥ, (hṛ.ci. a.1/39)-
"tataḥ pakveṣu doṣeṣu laṅghanādyaiḥ praśasyate|
kaṣāyo doṣaśeṣasya pācanaḥ śamano 'thavā||" iti viśeṣavacanāt tatra svarasādeḥ pañcavidhasya kaṣāyasya pratiṣedhaḥ prasaktaḥ| tataḥ svarantrasaṃjñayā viśeṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate (hṛ.ci. a. 1/40)-"tiktaḥ pitte viśeṣeṇa prayojyaḥ, kaṭukaḥ kaphe|" ity ādi| tasmāt svatantrasaṃjñayā tiktakaṭukaṣayau niṣiddhau pañcavidhayā svarasādikalpanayā|
Sa. 10 prākṛtaṃ nāma,-"ūṣakas tutthakaṃ hiṅgu kāsīsadvayasaindhavam|" (hṛ.sū. a. 15/23) ity auṣadhādhikārāt saindhavaṃ lavaṇam, na tv aśvādikam||

Sa. 11 samānatantrapratyayo nāma,-yat sādhyasya kasyacid arthasya sādhanāyānupalabhyamāne svantrāt pratyaye samānebhyas tantrebhyaḥ pratyaya iti| udāharaṇaṃ yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/31)- "nīcalomanakhaśmaśruḥ" ity ācāreṣūktam| iyadbhir iyadbhir dinaiḥ keśanakhaśmaśruṇy avatārya nīcalomādinā bhavitavyam iti noktam| tato vyākhyākārāḥ kṣārapāṇiprabhṛtayaḥ prasiddhyā daśarātreṇa keśādiṇāṃ saṃharaṇam iti niścinvanti| munis tv avādīt (ca.sū. a. 8/18)-"triḥ pakṣasya keśaśmaśrulomanakhān saṃhārayet|" iti|

Sa. 12 paratantrapratyayo nāma,-yasyārthasya prasiddhito na svakīyam udāharaṇaṃ śakyam abhidhātuṃ nāpy anyebhyo bhiṣaktantrebhyaḥ| tatas tasmin dvaye paratantrād udāharaṇaṃ kalpyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.
1/19)-"kālārthakarmaṇāṃ yogo hīnamithyātimātrakaḥ|
samyagyogaś ca vijñeyo rogārogyaikakāraṇam||" ity uktam| yogasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ noktaṃ tantre anyatra vā bhiṣaktantre| tatra bauddhatantrapratyayena niścīyate-"svahetubhyaḥ śītoṣṇādilakṣaṇena kālasyotpattir eva yogaḥ|" iti|

Sa. 13 hetuhetukadharmau nāma,-yo hetuhetukena dharmo jñāyate| yathā-pittātisāriṇaḥ pittalātisevanāt pittam udriktaṃ raktātisārāya na cirād asya bhaviṣyatīty anumīyate, samarthasya hetoḥ svakāryasyāvyabhicārāt|

Sa. 14 kāryakāraṇadharmo nāma,-yatra kāryasaṃjñayā kāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate kāraṇasaṃjñayā vā kāryam, tatra kāryasaṃjñayā tāvat kāraṇaṃ nirdiśyate| yathā-doṣā api rogaśabdaṃ labhante| tatra doṣāḥ kāraṇam, "sarveṣām eva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ|" (hṛ.ni. a.1/12) iti vacanāt| sa cedānīṃ doṣo roga iti vyapadiśyamānaḥ kāraṇe doṣe kāryaṃ roga upacarito bhavati| evaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇasaṃjñayā nirdiśyate|

Sa. 15 ādyantaviparyayo nāma,-yathā-annasvarūpavijñānaṃ prāptum ujjhitvā pānam eva prathamam uktaṃ dravadravyavijñānaṃ kurvatā, toyādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vargāṇām alpavaktavyatvāt| samudropamatayā śāstrasyānupūrvasukhāvagāhanārtham, pūrvaṃ hy alpaṃ sukhenāvagāhyate paścāt prabhūtam iti nyāyāt|

Sa. 16 śabdānyatvaṃ nāma, yadarthaṃ paryāyaśabdaṃ varṇayanti śāstrakṛtaḥ| yathā (hṛ.ni. a.
1/1)-"rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhir vikāro duḥkham āmayaḥ|
yakṣmātaṅkagadābādhāḥ śabdāḥ paryāyavācinaḥ||' ity ādi|

Sa. 17 pratyayadharmo nāma,-yo na ca hetur hetudharmopapattimātreṇa ca kenacid dhetutvena vyapadiśyate| yathā-devadānavagandharvādyunmādāpasmārādivicitragrahavikārā uktāḥ| yathoktam (hṛ.u. a.4/13)-"phullapadmopamamukhaṃ sau-myadṛṣṭim akopanam|" yāvat "anidram apradhṛṣyaṃ ca vidyād devavaśīkṛtam||" ity ādi| na caite paramārthato hetavaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? prajñāparādhaḥ| tathā coktam (hṛ.u. a. 4/3)-"hetus tadanuṣaktau tu sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto 'thavā| prajñāparādhaḥ sutarām" iti|

Sa. 18 upanayo nāma,-sūtrahetuprastāvena yatrānyat prakaraṇam upanīyate| yathā-mātrāśitīye āhāramātrālakṣaṇaprastāve atimātrabhojananimittāyā visūcikāyāś cikitsā upanītā| mātrāyāṃ hi vibhajyamānāyām avaśyam ūnātimātre 'pi vibhajanīye tadapekṣayā mātrāyāḥ samyak pratipādanasaukaryāt tatprastāvena ca visūcikāyāś cikitsā|

Sa. 19 sambhavo nāma,-yat sūtraṃ prakaraṇaṃ vā vidhīyamānam arthasya vyāpakatvāt sakalena śāstreṇa vyākhyāyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a.
1/5)-"kāyabālagrahordhvāṅgaśalyadaṃṣṭrājarāvṛṣān|
aṣṭāv aṅgāni tasyāhuś cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā||" iti| etāny aṣṭāv aṅgāni sakalena śāstreṇopadiśyanta ity ācāryaḥ pratijānīte|
