Sa. 20 bhaṅgyā....vibhavakalpanāyā ścāsyāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ| ayaṃ vyākhyāyā vibhavo bhavati| sa tu vinaiva vyākhyāyāḥ paṭhyamāna eveti|

Sa. saptadaśa tācchīlyādī[nī]ty uktam| tad yathā-1 tācchīlyam, 2 avayavaḥ, 3 vikāraḥ, 4 sāmīpyam, 5 bhūyastvam, 6 prakāraḥ, 7 guṇiguṇavibhavaḥ, 8 saṃsaktatā, 9 taddharmatā, 10 sthānam, 11 tādarthyam, 12 sāhacaryam, 13 karma, 14 guṇanimittatā, 15 ceṣṭānimittatā, 16 mūlasaṃjñā, 17 tātsthyam, iti|

Sa. tatra 1 tācchīlyaṃ nāma,-yat kenacid eva dharmasādṛśyena yukto bhāvas tācchīlyam ucyate| yathā (hṛ.ni. a. 15/15)-
"sarvāṅgasaṃśrayastodabhedasphuraṇabhañjanam|
stambhanākṣepaṇasvāpasandhyākuñcanakampanam|| kupito 'nilaḥ karoti|" ity ante na cāṅani svapanti| kiṃ tarhi ? devadattaḥ svapiti| taddharmasādṛśyād aṅgāni svāpaśabdenocyante| tad yathā-"puruṣaḥ supto na kiñcid vedayate| na cetayate| tathā'ṅgam api yat kiñcin na vedayate nakhatodādi| tat suptam iva supatam ity ucyate|" [iti|]

Sa. 2 avayavo nāma,-yatraikadeśodāharaṇe kriyamāṇe 'nukto 'nyo 'pi tajjātīyako 'rtho labhyate| yathā (hṛ.ci. a.1/3)_"laṅghanaiḥ kṣapite doṣe dīpte 'gnau lāghave sati| svāsthyaṃ kṣuttṛḍruciḥ paktir balam ojaś ca jāyate||" ity anenaikadeśodāharaṇena laṅghanena doṣakṣapaṇena lāghave sati svāsthyādyutpattiḥ| tatpratipakṣeṇa tv alaṅghanena doṣakṣapaṇe na jāte saty asvāsthyādayo 'nuktā api labhyante|

Sa. 3 vikāro nāma,-viparītakriyā| yathā-vikārasaṃjñayā prakṛtir api labhyate| prakṛtisaṃjñayā ca vikāraḥ| tatra vikārasaṃjñayā ca prakṛtir yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 6/114)-"puṣpe patre phale nāle kande ca gurutā kramāt|" [iti] śākam adhikṛtyoktam| atra prakṛtiḥ pāṭhāśūkā(ṣā)dīnāṃ patrādīni| tāni hi pākena vikriyamāṇāni cāvasthāntaraṃ pratipadyamānāni śākasaṃjñāṃ labhante| tad ayaṃ śāstrakāras teṣāṃ vikārasaṃjñāṃ, yavādimaṇḍadisaṃjñāyā yavādikaṃ coktavān|

Sa. 4 [samīpyaṃ nāma,-] ..................5 bhūyastvaṃ nāma,-yad ekasmin vartamānam ādhikyena kvacil labhyate| yathā tantre (ca.sū. a.26/42)-"amlo bhaktaṃ rocayati" ity uktam, na ca madhurādir api na rocayatīti| kasyacic cāmlavidveṣiṇo 'mlo raso bhaktavidveṣam eva kuryāt| tatra bhūyastvam āśrityedam uktam-'amlo rocayati|' kadācit kasyacid vā nāsau rocayen na tāvatā tan na rocanam|
Sa. 6 prakāro nāma,-yo yasya samānadarmā sa tasya prakāraḥ| yathā-"kaṇṭham eraṇḍanālena spṛśan vamet|" ity uktam| na ca tatprakārāṇāṃ suvarcalāśatapuṣpādinālānāṃ na grahaṇam|

Sa. 7 guṇiguṇavibhavo nāma,-kvacit guṇīni guṇaśabdenoktāni| yasmād āha (hṛ.śā. a. 3/60)-"pārthivāḥ pārthivān eva" iti| na hi pārthivā guṇāḥ santi kecit, ye paṭhyeran| guṇaś ca guṇivad yathā (hṛ.u. a. 39/23)-"medhāsmṛtibalopetā babhūvur amitāyuṣaḥ|" iti| atrāyurguṇopetam amitatvam| nāyuṣaḥ parimāṇaguṇa āyurguṇenaiva śakyaḥ|

Sa. 8 saṃsaktatā nāma,-yad ekasya bahubhiḥ sambandhaḥ| yathā vidyamāneṣv api tatrānyeṣu sambandheṣu tasyaiva vyapadeśaḥ kriyate| yathā-madhuraskandhanirdeśena mākṣikādayo guṇitāḥ kaṣāyādirasopeto api madhuraprāyatvān madhurasaṃsaktatayā|

Sa. 9 taddharmatā nāma,-yena tathābhūtaṃ sat taddharmatām āsādya darśanāt tām evākhyāṃ labhate| yathā (hṛ.u. a. 40/76)-"vivarjayed bhiṣak pāśān pāśān vaivasvatāniva|" iti| māraṇadharmo hi vaivasvatapāśena samāno dṛṣṭa ity atas te 'pi tathaivoktāḥ|

Sa. 10 sthānaṃ nāma,-yatra sthāninā sthānaṃ sthānena vā sthānī vyapadiśyate| tatra sthāninā sthānaṃ yathā-karṇanādaḥ śrotraroga ity uktaḥ| na ca śrotrendriyasyāsti nādaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? tadadhiṣṭhānasya karṇasya| tasmād ayaṃ śrotreṇa sthāninā karṇam adhiṣṭhānam uktavān| sthānena sthānī yathā-jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti| tatra na jihvā rasaṃ gṛhṇāti, kiṃ tarhi ? rasanā|
Sa. 11 tādarthyaṃ nāma,-yatprayojanārthaṃ pravartate yo bhāvas tenaiva vyapadiśyate| yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 15/1)-"madanamadhukalambā" ityādīni chardanāni,-chardanaprayojanānīty arthaḥ|

Sa. 12 sāhacaryaṃ nāma,-yo yena nityaṃ sambandha upalabhyate, sa tasmāt sambandhāt tam eva sambandhiśabdaṃ labhate| tathā-'mathyamānād dhūmaṃ dṛṣṭvā jvaladbhāsuraṃ vahnidravyam avaśyam abhyutthito vahnir ity eva|

Sa. 13 karma nāma,-yatra karmakarmeti copacaryate| yathocyate "munayaḥ praśamaṃ jagmuḥ|" na cāgrāmasthānīyaḥ kaścit praśamo 'sti| kiṃ tarhi ? indriyāṇāṃ viṣayebhyaḥ kevalaṃ śaktiniyamaḥ praśamaḥ| atha ca gatiḥ-karmaviṣayebhyas tivandriyāṇāṃ kriyānivṛttiḥ| tad eva ca karmety uktam|

Sa. 14 guṇanimittaṃ nāma,-yat kasya vibhūtiḥ praśaṃsādikā khyāpyate| "dharmyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ lokadvaparāyaṇam| anumodāmahe brahmacaryam ekāntinirmalam||" (hṛ.u. a. 40/4) iti brahmacaryasya praśaṃsāvibhūtiḥ khyāpyate| vrahmacaryasya hīme guṇāḥ, nābrahmacaryasyeti|

Sa. 15 ceṣṭānimittaṃ nāma,-yasmin nāmamātraṃ kasyacit kriyayā bhavati bhāvasya| nātra praspandakriyeṣṭā| yathā-"dīpavad asya jñānaṃ jvalati|" ity ucyate| na ca jñānasya pradīpasyevārcīṃṣi santi ūrdhvagāmīni, dīpavad vā sannikṛṣṭāni dravyāntarāṇi dahanti| rūpaṃ vā sparśaṃ vā tailādikopādānam| kintu prakāśakriyāmātraṃ parigṛhya jvalatīti praśaṃsākarmaṇi krodhabhayaśokalobhaharṣerṣyāmohādibhir upahataṃ vijñānaṃ malopahatadarpaṇavad aprakāśavṛtti bhavet|

Sa. 16 mūlasaṃjñā nāma,-yā loke 'nyasminn arthe prasiddhā tantre cānyasmin [arthe] niveśitā| yathā (hṛ.ni. a. 1/2)-"nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇy upaśayas tathā| samprāptiś ca" iti| rūpaṃ ca loke nīlapītalohitādi prasiddham, svaśāstre saṃjñayā tu rūpaṃ-liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇam iti|

Sa. 17 tātsthyaṃ nāma,-yad anyasyaivārthasya tatsthatvād anyasyaiva kalpyate| tad yathā (hṛ. ni. a.10/23)-"bastimehanayoḥ śūlam" iti| tatra puṃsaṃsthena kāraṇena bastimehanayor iti kalpyate| caitanyābhāve bastimehanayoḥ sator api śūlābhāvāt tatpradeśasthi tatvāt tayor ity ucaryate|

Sa. tathā tantradoṣaiḥ pañcadaśabhir aprasiddhaśabdādibhir varjitam| [ tad yathā-]1 aprasiddhaśabdam, 2 duḥpraṇītam, 3 asaṅgatārtham, 4 asukhārohi, 5 viruddham, 6 ativistṛtam, 7 atisaṃkṣiptam, 8 aprayojanam, 9 bhinnakramam, 10 saṃdigdham, 11 punar uktam, 12 niḥpramāṇakam, 13 asamāptārtham, 14 apā(na)rthakam, 15 vyāhatam, [iti]|

Sa. tatra 1 aprasiddhaśabdam nāma,-yal loke nātīva prasiddham| yathā-"udakyāgamanalakṣaṇam asukhānām|" iti| yathā vā "ādhārasyāsipāṇidhāreṣv akuśalayogatā|" iti| asyārthaḥ,-aku nāma vṛkṣaḥ tasya śalam iti|
Sa. 2 duḥpraṇītaṃ nāma,- sūtrabhāṣyaprayojanarahitam|
Sa. 3 asaṅgatārthaṃ nāma,- yat sūtreṇāsambaddham|
Sa. 4 asukhārohi padaṃ nāma,-yat padasanniveśasya viṣamatayā duḥkhenoccāryate, carkarītādiprāyam| yathā-"dhātaryaripradam|" iti|

Sa. 5 viruddhaṃ nāma,-yad dṛṣṭāntasiddhāntasamayair viruddham| yathā kaścid vaden nityaḥ puruṣo 'kṛtakatvād iti hetuḥ, ghaṭa iti dṛṣṭāntaviruddham| tathā-madhurāmlalavaṇāḥ kaphaṃ śamayanti, kaṭutiktakaṣāyā vātaṃ jayanti, iti vaidyakasiddhāntaviruddha metat| samayaviruddhaṃ nāma,-yathā-yaḥ samayaḥ pūrvācāryais tattvadarśibhiḥ kṛtas taṃ vyutkramyāgacchati| yathā-"na loṣṭaṃ vimṛdgīyāt, na tṛṇaṃ chindyāt," iti| etat tattvadarśibhir uktatvāl loṣṭamardanādi na kriyate| na tu hetur atrāsti| 6 ativistṛtaṃ nāma,-yathā-madhurādiskandhaṃ bruvan yāvanti madhurāṇi jagati santi madhuraprāyāṇi madhuraprabhavāṇi tāny aśeṣāṇi yady abhidadhāti, tadā'tivistṛtatvaṃ syāt| 7 atisaṃkṣiptaṃ nāma,-yathā-yogaśatakaprāyam| yathā vā-hetuliṅgauṣadhoddeśa eva kriyate, na tu tadavabodhakavākyānām iti śeṣaḥ| 8 aprayojanaṃ nāma,-yathā (hṛ.sū. a. 2/48)-"ity ācāraḥ samāsena" ity etāvad yadi vadet, na tu brūyāt "yaṃ prāpnoti samācaran| āyur ārogyam aiśvaryam" ity ādi, tadā na kaścid anutiṣṭhed iti|

Sa. 9 bhinnakramaṃ nāma,-pūrvaṃ yenānukrameṇoktaṃ na tenaiva nirdiśyate prayojanāntarāsambhave 'pi| yathā-vātapittakaphān uddiśya "tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ (hṛ.sū. a.1/11) ityādau vātaguṇanirdeśam akṛtvaiva pittasya vidadhīta| evaṃ kramo bhinno bhavet
Sa. 10 saṃdigdhaṃ nāma,-yathā-'kim akālamṛtyur asti uta nāsti ?" ity ubhayatra hetvābhāsaparigrahāt saṃśayaḥ|
Sa. 11 punar uktaṃ nāma,-yo 'rtha ukto 'pi punar ucyate|
Sa. 12 niḥpramāṇaṃ nāma,-yathā (hṛ.ci. a. 1/46)-"pākyaṃ śītakaṣāyaṃ vā mustāparpaṭakam" iti| .........
Sa. 13 [asamāptārthaṃ nāma,-]............atra tāvad ucyate| parato 'pi ced ity etat tataḥ samāptārthatvānna jñāyate kim anena kāryam iti|
Sa. 14 anarthakaṃ nāma,-yad anyārthenāpi padenāpagatābhidheyam||1|

Sa. 15 vyāhataṃ nāma,-yathā-pūrvayā vākyayuktyā'parā vyāhanyate, aparayā pūrvā vā| yathā-"anāsthāpyā mehinaḥ" (hṛ.sū. a. 19/4) ity uktvā punar āsthāpanam anujajñe| mustāder niryūhe papāṭha (hṛ.ka. a. 4/40)-"vātāsṛkśophamehārśogulmaviṇmūtrasaṅgraham|" ity ādi| tad atra vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ parasparavirodhād vyāhatatvam| atra samādhānārthaṃ vipulamataya evam abhidadhuḥ,-pramehiṇam āsthāpyaniṣedhād bastikalpe punar anujñānāt tantrakṛto 'bhiprāyaviśeṣa īdṛg anumīyate,-mehino vātasya prabalatvena bastim antareṇa nānyas tathāvidha upakramo 'ti, tasmāt tasyāvasthātur avaśād yojyo bastiḥ| yadā''rtamehino dṛśyate pavanasyālpatve(tvaṃ), tadopakramāntareṇaiva cikitsituṃ śakya iti, tadā bastir na yojya iti pratipādayitum evaṃvidho vinyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ| iti-pūrvoktaiḥ, tantraguṇaiḥ-tantrayuktyākhyair yuktam, tantradoṣaiḥ-aprasiddhaśabdādibhir varjitam, alpasamudyamānāṃ-stokavyāyāmānāṃ, prītyarthaṃ pṛthag evedaṃ tantram uktam| kimbhūtam ? cikitsāśāstram,-śatasahasraṃ brahmaproktam agniveśādipraṇitaṃ vā, vyāpya paritaḥ-samantāt, sthitam| na caitat svamanīṣānirūpitam ity āha-vipulety ādi| vipulaṃ-vistīrṇaṃ samastavastuviṣayaṃ, amalaṃ nirmalam aviparyastaṃ, vijānaṃ yeṣāṃ mahāmunīnāṃ-ātreyādīnāṃ, ta evam| te ca te vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunayaś ca| teṣāṃ mataṃ abhiprāyaḥ, tadanu gacchati-anuvartate, yat tat vipulāmalavijñānamahāmunimatānugam| nanu, saṅgraheṇaiva mahāmunitaṃ saṅgṛhītam| tat kim anena ? ity āha-mahāsāgara iva gambhīro yaḥ saṅgrahākhyas tasyopalakṣaṇaṃ-upāya[na]bhūtam etat| tasmāt pṛthag etat tantram uditam| aṣṭāv aṅgāni yasya tad evam, aṣṭāṅgaṃ ca tad vaidyakaṃ ca, tad eva mahodadhir aṣṭāṅgavaidyakamahodadhiḥ, tasya manthanam iva manthanaṃ-pāṭhaśravaṇacintanādibhir vikṣobhaṇāt, tena karaṇabhūtena| yo 'ṣṭāṅgasaṅgraha eva mahān amṛtarāśir āptaḥ| tasmāt-aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahamahāmṛtarāśeḥ sakāśāt, pṛthag etat tantram uditam| kīdṛśam ? analpaṃ phalaṃ-āyurārogyaiśvaryasukhādikaṃ yasya tad evaṃ, mahāphalam ity arthaḥ| tad ayaṃ bhāvaḥ,-tantrasyāsyālpatvāt pāṭhādiṣu svalpa evāyāso bhavati mahac ca phalaṃ yataḥ syāt, tato 'yam ādaraṇīya ity arthaḥ| vasantatilakaṃ vṛttam|

Sa. saṃ-idaṃ-anantarābhihitaṃ tantraṃ, mantravad ācaritaṃ saṃprayoktavyam| na kathañcid api mīmāṃsyam,-kim idaṃ syād vā naveti saṃśayo na kārya ity arthaḥ| kasmāt ? suviśuddhajñānebhyo mahāmunibhya āgamena śuddhatvāt, tathā pratyakṣaphalasya-jvaracikitsādikasya, darśanāt|

lg.l: dīrghajīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ|

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-ataḥ-aṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyāt tantrāt, pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānaiḥ-rogacikitsālakṣaṇena, dhruvaṃ-avaśyaṃ, dīrghajīvitādīn prāpnoti| na ca tān eva prāpnoti| kiṃ tarhi ? param apīty āha-

lg.l: etat paṭhan saṅgrahabodhaśaktaḥ svabhyastakarmā bhiṣag aprakampyaḥ|
ākampayaty anyaviśālatantra- kṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram||83||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-etat-anantaroktam aṣṭāṅgahṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, adhīyānaḥ(paṭhan)-kaṇṭhe dadhat, saṅgrahabodhaśaktaḥ-etadgranthārthaviśeṣa-śeṣavastvavabodhārtham| tasmāt svabhyastakarmā ata eva pāṭhāvabodhaḥ| svabhyastakarmā-tasya guṇaśatayogād aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasya vyākhyānām anyeṣāṃ bheṣajakarmajena satsvabhyastakarmaṇā cikitsakaḥ, akṣobhyaḥ san, anyeṣu-carakādiṣu, viśālatantreṣu vihitābhiyogān vaidyān yadi kampayati-kṣobhayati, tan nāścaryam| upajātir vṛtam| yathā cākampayante 'pare bhiṣajas tathā darśayann āha-

lg.l: yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi- praṇigaditagadānāṃ nāmamātre 'pi bāhyaḥ|
atha carakavihīnaḥ prakriyāyām akhinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ||84||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-yadi kevalaṃ carakaṃ paṭhati tatas tasmāt suśrutādipraṇigaditānāṃ-vartmasandhisitādijānāṃ rogāṇāṃ, dhruvaṃ saṃjñāmātrāvabodhe 'pi bāhyaḥ| kintu hetulakṣaṇopakrameṇānabhijña ity apiśabdārthaḥ| atha carakavihīnaḥ kevalaṃ suśrutapāṭhasādhyaprakriyāyāṃ doṣadūṣyakālabalaśarīrasattvasātmyādilakṣaṇāyāṃ, akhinnaḥ san vyādhitānāṃ-kāsaśvāsādyabhibhūtānāṃ, kim iva varākaḥ-alpadhīḥ, vidadhātu ? na kiñcid vidadhātuṃ śakta ity arthaḥ| iha tu carakoktaprakriyāyāḥ pratipādanāt suśrutoktāmayābhidhānāc ca tadadhyetā rogacikitsāyāṃ pravartamāno rogaśānti dhruvaṃ vidadhāty eva| mālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg:
athaiva manyase yady api tatra tantram etadguṇam, tathā'py ārṣatantrādhyayane samādhānātiśaya iti| tata idam āha--
-- abhiniveśavaśād abhiyujyate subhaṇite 'pi na yo dṛḍhamūḍhakaḥ|
paṭhatu yatnaparaḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam anirvidaḥ||85||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-abhiniveśo-vastupakṣapātaḥ, tasya vaśaḥ-sāmarthyaṃ, tasmāt| anyatra guṇadoṣāv abhiyoktā śobhanokte 'pi tantre yonābhiyujyate-ṛṣipraṇīte prītiṃ karoti, sa nara ādau bhavam ādyaṃ,-prathamapraṇītaṃ brahmoktaṃ śatasāhasraṃ, vaidyakaṃ yatnaparas tathā anirvedaḥ san puruṣāyuṣaṃ-varṣaśataṃ, paṭhatu| kilāsmin kāle hīyamānabuddhimedhājīvitasya puruṣasya śravaṇacintanāvabodhānuṣṭhānāni sudūrotsāritāny evety arthaḥ| puruṣāyuṣam ity acaturādisūtre nipātitam| [ drutavilambitaṃ vṛttam| ]

ab.seg:
athaivaṃ manyase vaktṛtvaviśeṣād avaśyam evārthātiśayo bhavati| tasmād ādyeṣu sukṛteṣv evābhiyogo yukto, na tv idānīntanakavikṛteṣv iti, tad etan na vācyam| kutaḥ ? ity āha--
-- vāte pitte śleṣmaśāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa|
etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahajo vā kā nirmantre vaktṛbhedoktiśaktiḥ||86||

div.ab: Sa. saṃ-vāte tailaṃ pathyaṃ, pitte ghṛtaṃ pathyaṃ, śleṣmākṣikaṃ pathyaṃ, yathākramam| ity evaṃ bhagavān brahmā bhāṣatām, brahmajo vā-sanatkumārādiḥ, bhāṇatu| nirmantre-aśabdasvabhāve tailādike svākarata utpanne, vātādiśamanaśakter vaktṛviśeṣoktyā śaktir na kācid ity arthaḥ| śālinīvṛttam|

ab.seg:
tad evopasaṃharan spaṣṭayati ----
abhidhātṛvaśāt kiṃ vā dravyaśaktir viśiṣyate|
ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām||87||

div.ab: Sa. vaktṛvaśāt kiṃ tailāder dravyasya śaktir viśiṣyate ? api tu na kaścid eva viśeṣa utpadyate| yataḥ svabhāvahetubhya eva etacchaktiyuktāś cotpannāḥ| ato-vidhātṛśād dravyaśaktiviśeṣalakṣaṇād dhetoḥ, matsaram utsṛjya-vidveṣaṃ vihāya, mādhyasthyam āśrīyatām| madhyastho hi puruṣaḥ kālabudhdyādyanurūpam idam eva śāstram upakārakaṃ mama, na tv ato 'paraṃ śāstram upakārakaṃ buddhyā parāmarśyādhyeṣyate, na tv ajñānābhiniveśāgraham etīty arthaḥ|

ab.seg:
nanu, kim asmākam upakārakatvādidvāreṇa ṛṣipraṇītam eva tantram anurāgavaśād adhyeṣyam ? ity āśaṅkyāha ----
ṛṣipraṇīte prītiś cen muktvā carakasuśrutau|
bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ subhāṣitam||88||

div.ab: Sa. yadi ṛṣipraṇīte prītis tataś carakasuśrutākhyau hitvā bheḍajātūkarṇyādimunipraṇītāni śāstrāṇi kim iti na paṭhyante sarveṇaiva vaidyavṛndena| api tu subhāṣitapriyatayā carakasuśrutau bāhulyena yathā paṭhyete, na tathā bheḍādayaḥ| tasmāt sthitam etat subhāṣitaṃ grāhyam, na tu munipraṇītam eva tantram| ataś carakasuśrutavad anārṣam apīdaṃ guṇavattvān matimadbhir grāhyam eva|

hṛdaya hṛdayam etat sarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ|
kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ|89| iti śrīvaidyapatisiṃhaguptasūnuśrīmadvāgbhaṭavira- citāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttara-
sthāne vājīkaraṇavidhir nāma catvā- riṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ|40|

Sa. saṃ-etat-hṛdayākhyaṃ tantraṃ, hṛdayam iva| kasya ? sarvāyurvedavāṅmayapayodheḥ| yathā hṛdayaṃ śarīrasyaikadeśam api daśabhir mūlasirābhiḥ sakalaṃ kāyaṃ vyāpnoti, tathedam api ṣaḍbhiḥ sthānaiḥ sakalam aṣṭāṅgāyurvedavāṅmayaṃ vyāpya sthitam iti sādharmyāt| tad evam īdṛśaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā-vidhāya, yat kalyāṇaṃ paraṃ-śreṣṭhaṃ, prāptaṃ [ tataḥ- ] tasmāc chubhāt, jagataḥ-bhuvanasya, maṅgalaṃ bhavatv iti| āryā| iti śrīmṛgāṅkadattaputraśrīmadaruṇadattaviracitāyām aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya- ṭīkāyāṃ sarvāṅgasundarākhyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe uttarasthāne vājīkaraṇa- vidhir nāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ|| 40|| iti vājīkaraṇam aṣṭamam aṅgaṃ samāptaṃ|
